title: WISP: Composable Representations for Wrist-Worn Activity Recognition
comment: Code and saved results are available at https://huggingface.co/Zipeng365/WISP, and the benchmark data at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Zipeng365/WristHARBench
summary: Smartwatches and fitness bands are among the most common wearable devices, and large national health studies record movement at the wrist. Yet existing human activity recognition benchmarks mix sensors worn on different parts of the body, so they do not show how well activities can be recognised from the wrist alone. We introduce WristHARBench, a benchmark that standardises participant-disjoint evaluation across nine wrist-acceleration datasets and two additional multichannel inertial datasets. We hypothesise that different human activities leave complementary patterns in wrist motion, such as local shape, rhythm, temporal order and cross-axis relationships, and propose WISP (Wrist-Informed Space of Predictive Representations), a composable representation space that combines representations of these patterns with compatible classifiers. Across the nine primary datasets, WISP with random search achieves 70.20% mean Macro-F1, compared with 59.62% for the strongest of 18 external baselines. Controlled ablations and baseline comparisons indicate that recognition improves mainly when a representation adds motion patterns that the others lack, rather than when it represents the same pattern in a different way.

AI.tldr: 论文提出腕部加速度人体活动识别基准 WristHARBench 与可组合表示空间 WISP，在九个腕部数据集上取得 70.20% 平均 Macro-F1，显著优于 18 个外部基线中最强的 59.62%。
AI.motivation: 腕部设备（智能手表、手环）与国家级健康研究常用腕部动作记录，但现有人体活动识别基准混合了身体不同部位的传感器，无法反映"仅凭腕部"识别活动的真实水平；同时作者假设不同活动在腕部运动中留下互补的模式（局部形状、节律、时序次序、跨轴关系），需要通过表征组合来验证。
AI.method: 构建 WristHARBench：统一九个月腕部加速度数据集与两个多通道惯性数据集的"参与者不重叠（participant-disjoint）"评估协议；提出 WISP（Wrist-Informed Space of Predictive Representations）组合式表示空间，将局部形状、节律、时序次序、跨轴关系等模式对应的表示与相容分类器组合，并配合随机搜索进行模型选择；通过受控消融与基线对比分析表征互补性。
AI.result: 九个主数据集上，WISP + 随机搜索平均 Macro-F1 为 70.20%，最强外部基线（共 18 个）为 59.62%；消融与基线对比显示，性能提升主要来自引入其他表示所缺失的运动模式，而非以不同方式表达同一模式。
AI.conclusion: 腕部单独活动识别需专门的标准化基准与"互补模式"驱动的表示设计；WISP 表明表示空间的增益来源于模式多样性而非表示形式冗余，为可穿戴 HAR 提供可复现的评估框架与设计原则。

title: Measuring and Teaching Language Model Agents to Act on Delayed Consequences
summary: Language model agents are increasingly asked to run ongoing multi-day operations rather than finish isolated single-turn tasks. In daily operations, today's choices reshape later observations and cash constraints because empty shelves hide lost walk-in demand, short-shipped customers quietly shrink future orders weeks later, and emergency buying drains working capital. We introduce SMB Bench, a calibrated 90-day wholesale simulator with 18 causally paired tasks and an 859-run frontier trace dataset, to ask what experience and learning signal make an agent better at noticing, attributing, and acting on the delayed consequences of its own decisions in unseen businesses. Across 16 frontier models, only 3 outperform a fixed buying rule; models often record a relevant diagnosis in their notes without changing later purchases in time, showing that diagnosing a problem, changing behavior, and improving a business are separate achievements. To study how experience improves those failures in an open model (Qwen3.8-27B), we used training-business records to identify operational rules and archived frontier quarters as starting states to continue from rather than transcripts to copy. On an unseen test business under identical evaluation instructions, the trained policy followed customer-protection commitments more consistently and reduced severe-loss quarters, while the additional profit benefit remained uncertain. Carrying those commitments through the quarter exposed the cost of fulfilling them, as early-quarter stocking habits left the buyer relying on emergency supply and a deteriorating supplier. The results separate recognizing a delayed effect, acting on it consistently, and coordinating surrounding decisions so that the response improves profit. SMB Bench connects these observations to a learning method by turning archived decisions and their consequences into reusable training experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SMB Bench——一个校准的90天批发经营模拟器（含18个因果配对任务与859条前沿模型运行轨迹），用于考察语言模型智能体能否察觉、归因并应对自身决策的延迟后果；并进一步用归档的经营决策及其后果作为可复用训练经验，提升开放模型（Qwen3-27B）在未见过企业上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多面向孤立的单轮任务，而真实运营是持续多日的长程过程，其中当日决策会重塑后续观测与现金约束：空货架会掩盖流失的到店需求、缺货交付会延后数周削弱客户未来订单、应急采购会消耗营运资金。核心问题在于：何种经验与学习信号能让智能体在未见过的新企业中，更好地识别、归因并应对自身决策的延迟后果。
AI.method: (1) 构建 SMB Bench：90天批发经营校准模拟器，18个因果配对任务，以及859次运行的前沿模型轨迹数据集；(2) 在16个前沿模型上进行评测，并与固定采购规则作对照；(3) 分析模型笔记中的诊断与后续采购行为的脱节；(4) 以开放模型 Qwen3-27B 为对象，从训练企业的经营记录中抽取运营规则，并将前沿模型的历史季度作为"续跑起点状态"而非照抄的对话转录，构建训练经验；(5) 在相同评测指令下于未见企业上测试策略。
AI.result: 16个前沿模型中仅3个优于固定采购规则；模型常在笔记中记录相关诊断，却未及时改变后续采购，说明"诊断问题""改变行为""改善经营"是三件彼此独立的事。经训练的 Qwen3-27B 策略在未见测试企业上更一致地遵守客户保护承诺，减少了严重亏损季度，但额外利润增益仍不确定；在整季度贯彻承诺也暴露了履约成本——早期季度的备货习惯使采购方依赖应急供应，并导致供应商状况恶化。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了三个层次：识别延迟效应、一致地据此行动、以及协调周边决策使响应真正提升利润。SMB Bench 将上述观察与一种学习方法相连接——把归档的决策及其后果转化为可复用的训练经验，为长程经营智能体的学习与评测提供了统一框架。

title: RefineKV: Query-Adaptive KV Cache Compression via Attention-Error Bounds
summary: Repeatedly accessing the full key--value (KV) cache is a major bottleneck in long-context language model decoding. We find that small query-specific subsets can accurately approximate full attention, yet their union covers nearly the entire cache, motivating query-adaptive access for the KV cache. A natural approach is to split the KV cache into clusters, using compact representatives for clusters that incur negligible error while expanding the rest to their original KV entries. We derive a selection criterion from an upper bound on attention-output error, which reveals two complementary factors governing the error: importance measures the impact of a cluster, while distortion measures how faithfully the cluster can be represented. Based on this criterion, we propose RefineKV, a decoding-time query-adaptive KV compression method. Experiments on two models and three benchmarks demonstrate that RefineKV retains near-full-attention quality while achieving up to 7.6x speedup in the attention phase and 1.66x faster decoding, establishing a new quality-latency Pareto frontier.

AI.tldr: 提出 RefineKV：一种解码期查询自适应的 KV 缓存压缩方法，基于注意力输出误差上界推导的选择准则（重要性 + 失真度），对部分簇使用紧凑代表、其余簇展开为原始 KV 条目，兼顾质量与延迟。
AI.motivation: 长上下文解码中反复访问完整 KV 缓存是主要瓶颈。作者观察到：每个查询只需很小的查询特定子集即可较好近似完整注意力，但不同查询的子集并集几乎覆盖整个缓存——说明"全局静态压缩"不适用，需要查询自适应访问。
AI.method: 将 KV 缓存划分为簇；由注意力输出误差上界推导选择准则，该上界包含两个互补因子：importance（簇对输出的影响程度）与 distortion（簇被紧凑表示时的保真度）。据此在解码时动态决定哪些簇只用紧凑代表（误差可忽略）、哪些簇展开为原始 KV 条目。
AI.result: 在两个模型、三个基准上，RefineKV 保持接近全注意力的质量，注意力阶段最高 7.6× 加速，整体解码最高 1.66× 加速，建立了新的质量—延迟 Pareto 前沿。
AI.conclusion: 查询自适应、簇粒度的"代表/展开"混合策略能在误差可控的前提下大幅降低 KV 访问开销，是长上下文解码中优于静态 KV 压缩的一条有效路径。

title: A world model for longitudinal health-trajectory prediction in older adults across multinational cohorts
summary: Aging is characterized by continuously evolving health states, yet most existing prediction models focus on static health risk at isolated time points rather than explicitly modelling how health trajectories unfold over time. We developed a health world model based on the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture to represent evolving health states and simulate future trajectories under specified actions. The model combines a state encoder, an action- and context-conditioned predictor, a stop-gradient target encoder, and clinical outcome heads. We trained the model on the US Health and Retirement Study (HRS) and evaluated it without refitting in the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing (ELSA) and the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS). Open-loop evaluation assessed discrimination and calibration for mortality and worsening of activities of daily living (ADL) and instrumental activities of daily living (IADL). In the held-out HRS test set, the areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROCs) for mortality, ADL worsening, and IADL worsening were 0.89, 0.93, and 0.93 at the first horizon and 0.84, 0.84, and 0.85 at the fifth horizon, respectively. Predicted risks stratified subsequent outcomes across horizons. Across the evaluated horizons, mortality AUROC ranged from 0.867 to 0.881 in ELSA and from 0.796 to 0.801 in CHARLS. Simulated trajectories preserved the expected risk ordering across predefined action regimes. In counterfactual simulations, changes in lifestyle actions shifted predicted risks in directions consistent with observed associations. The model provides a framework for longitudinal risk prediction and action-conditioned simulation in older adults.

AI.tldr: 提出基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的"健康世界模型"，表征老龄化过程中动态演化的健康状态并在指定行为条件下模拟未来轨迹；在HRS训练，在ELSA与CHARLS中零重训外部验证，死亡与ADL/IADL恶化的判别与校准表现良好。
AI.motivation: 既有老龄化预测模型多聚焦于孤立时间点的静态健康风险，未显式建模健康轨迹随时间展开的演化过程，也无法在假设干预（行为）条件下推演未来状态。
AI.method: 构建健康世界模型，采用Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture：由状态编码器、以行动与情境为条件的预测器、带stop-gradient的目标编码器以及临床结局预测头组成；在US HRS上训练，在ELSA与CHARLS上不做重拟合直接评估；采用开环评估考察对死亡、ADL恶化与IADL恶化的判别力（AUROC）与校准，并进行多horizon风险分层与反事实行为模拟。
AI.result: HRS留出测试集中，第1个horizon死亡/ADL恶化/IADL恶化AUROC分别为0.89、0.93、0.93，第5个horizon为0.84、0.84、0.85；预测风险可对各horizon后续结局分层。外部验证中，ELSA死亡AUROC为0.867–0.881，CHARLS为0.796–0.801。模拟轨迹在预设行为方案下保持预期风险排序；反事实模拟中生活方式行为改变对预测风险的影响方向与观察性关联一致。
AI.conclusion: 该健康世界模型为老年人群提供了纵向风险预测与行为条件化模拟的统一框架，具备跨队列泛化能力，可作为轨迹层面健康演化的建模与情景推演工具。

title: 5G NR Sensing of Robotic Arm Motion in Indoor Factory Environments
summary: This paper investigates the performance of monostatic Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) systems for tracking robotic arm kinematics in industrial factory (InF) environments. Building on a part-specific quasi-deterministic channel model previously derived from high-resolution robotic-arm measurements using our context-aware channel sounder and digital twin, we develop a framework for generating arbitrary articulated motion profiles through hierarchical kinematic transformations. By integrating this high-fidelity target model with the standardized 3GPP InF channel model, we employ 5G New Radio (NR) Positioning Reference Signals (PRS) as the sensing waveform to enable comprehensive system-level evaluation. Simulations are conducted for both sparse clutters (InF-SH) and dense clutters (InF-DH) scenarios using 3GPP-compliant antenna radiation patterns and analog beamforming, allowing us to assess the impact of industrial clutter on sensing performance. The results show that while high estimation accuracy is achievable under Line-of-Sight (LOS) conditions, dense clutter in InF-DH environments introduces severe blockage that significantly limits sensing reliability. In particular, the effective sensing coverage in InF-DH is drastically reduced, with detection probability dropping to approximately \(P_d \approx 10\,\%\) even when the robotic arm is located directly beneath the Transmission Reception Point (TRP). Furthermore, in InF-SH, achieving a high detection probability (e.g., \(P_d \geq 90\,\%\)) requires the target to remain in close proximity to the TRP, with an effective coverage radius of approximately 13 m.

AI.tldr: 该文构建了面向工业工厂(InF)环境中机械臂运动跟踪的单站ISAC系统级评估框架，结合准确定性机械臂信道模型与3GPP InF信道模型，采用5G NR PRS作为感知波形，仿真表明LOS下精度高，而密集杂波(InF-DH)造成严重遮挡使检测概率降至约10%，稀疏杂波(InF-SH)下需目标距TRP约13 m内才能达到Pd≥90%。
AI.motivation: 工业场景中机械臂等运动目标的通感一体化跟踪缺乏高保真、可系统级评估的目标与信道建模手段，且工业杂波对感知可靠性的影响尚不明确，需要量化评估InF环境下ISAC对机械臂运动学的感知性能与有效覆盖。
AI.method: 基于此前由高分辨率机械臂测量（上下文感知信道探测仪与数字孪生）获得的部件级准确定性信道模型，通过分层运动学变换生成任意关节运动轨迹；将该高保真目标模型与标准化3GPP InF信道模型集成，以5G NR PRS为感知波形，采用符合3GPP的天线方向图与模拟波束赋形，在InF-SH与InF-DH两类场景下进行系统级仿真。
AI.result: LOS条件下可实现高估计精度；InF-DH密集杂波引入严重遮挡，显著限制感知可靠性，即使机械臂位于TRP正下方检测概率也降至约Pd≈10%，有效感知覆盖大幅缩减；InF-SH中欲达到Pd≥90%需目标靠近TRP，有效覆盖半径约13 m。
AI.conclusion: 工业杂波是制约单站ISAC机械臂跟踪可靠性的主导因素，密集杂波场景下覆盖极为受限；所提出的分层运动学目标建模与3GPP信道集成框架可为InF场景ISAC系统级性能评估与部署规划提供有效工具。

title: SAMA: Training-Free Consensus Ridge Tracking for Camera-Based Heart Rate on Five Public Datasets
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) is usually benchmarked by one heart rate per video, a figure that hides the short windows in which a tele-consultation would actually read the pulse. We present SAMA, a training-free estimator that (i) forms a quality-weighted consensus of POS and CHROM chrominance spectra, (ii) discounts frequencies occupied by pulse-free references derived from the same frames (frame motion, skin-mask geometry and background brightness), (iii) follows the heart rate through time with a Viterbi ridge under a random-walk prior, and (iv) returns a track-filtered, amplitude-normalised waveform with a per-window confidence. No parameter is learned and no dataset-specific tuning is used. On 218 recordings from 111 participants in five public datasets (UBFC-rPPG, PURE, SUMS, M3PD and a two-participant subset of MMPD), all processed with the same fixed face box and scored with a re-implementation of the rPPG-Toolbox protocol, SAMA has the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) averaged over datasets at every protocol level: 4.40 against 5.13,bpm for POS per video, 4.80 against 5.43 on 30,s windows and 5.05 against 6.59 on 10,s windows. Pooled over participants, the bootstrap interval of its paired difference from POS excludes zero on 30,s and 10,s windows (Wilcoxon p=0.11 and 0.004) but not per video, and it does not beat POS on SUMS per video or on the MMPD subset. Withholding the 20\% least confident windows lowers the pooled 10,s error from 4.06 to 2.33,bpm. We also show that the per-video protocol has a floor of 1.2--1.6,bpm on datasets where heart rate drifts, and that skin tone cannot be recovered from uncalibrated video, which motivates the instrumented, skin-tone-stratified collection we propose for the Indian population. The method does not surpass the best published neural networks on UBFC-rPPG; we report where it stands against them without re-running them.

AI.tldr: SAMA是一个免训练、无数据集调参的rPPG估计器，通过对POS与CHROM色度谱做质量加权共识、扣除无脉搏参考频率、用随机游走先验下的Viterbi脊线跟踪心率，并输出带逐窗置信度的归一化波形；在五个公开数据集（218段/111人）统一流程下，各协议层级的跨数据集平均MAE均最低（视频级4.40 vs 5.13 bpm，30 s窗4.80 vs 5.43，10 s窗5.05 vs 6.59）。
AI.motivation: 现有rPPG评测以"每视频一个心率"为基准，掩盖了远程问诊实际依赖的短时窗心率读数；同时需要避免依赖学习参数或数据集特定调参，并厘清短窗评估的可信度边界与肤色公平性问题。
AI.method: 免训练估计器，四个环节：(i) 对POS与CHROM色度谱做质量加权共识；(ii) 利用同帧导出的无脉搏参考（帧间运动、肤色掩膜几何、背景亮度）对应的频率进行折扣抑制；(iii) 随机游走先验下以Viterbi脊线时序跟踪心率；(iv) 输出经轨迹滤波、幅度归一化的波形及逐窗置信度。所有218段录制使用同一固定人脸框处理，评分采用rPPG-Toolbox协议的复实现。
AI.result: 跨数据集平均MAE在每一协议层级均为最低：视频级4.40 vs POS 5.13 bpm；30 s窗4.80 vs 5.43；10 s窗5.05 vs 6.59。按参与者合并后，其与POS配对差的bootstrap区间在30 s与10 s窗上不含零（Wilcoxon p=0.11与0.004），但视频级不显著；在SUMS（视频级）与MMPD子集上未优于POS。剔除置信度最低的20%窗后，合并10 s误差由4.06降至2.33 bpm。另显示在心率漂移数据集上视频级协议存在1.2–1.6 bpm误差下限，且未校准视频无法还原肤色。在UBFC-rPPG上未超过已发表最优神经网络（仅对照引用，未重跑）。
AI.conclusion: SAMA以无需训练与调参的方式在短窗心率估计上取得跨数据集一致的改进，并给出可用的逐窗置信度以支持低置信窗拒识；但优势在视频级不显著、在部分数据集/子集上不及POS，且不及最优神经网络。视频级协议的误差下限与肤色不可恢复性，构成了对面向印度人群、仪器化且按肤色分层采集的倡议依据。

title: Following the Error Through a Compressed Network:An Angular Measure for FFN Weight Compression in ViT-L/16
summary: We study the compression of the 48 feed-forward network (FFN) matrices of the Vision Transformer ViT-L/16 to 2--8 bits with four schemes: a per-token grid, a fixed Gaussian Lloyd--Max table, a table fitted to the matrix, and a random-sign Hadamard rotation followed by the fixed table. We evaluate on 50,000 images. At 4 bits the top-1 accuracy of the four schemes lies within 0.8 points of the float32 model, while the agreement with its predictions ranges from 98.4\% to 94.4\%. We use the angular error between the compressed and the float32 residual stream, followed through the blocks, as a portable measure that ranks the schemes as the final classification does and shows where the ranking is built: with rotation the angle grows close to the square root of the number of blocks, the signature of independently accumulating errors, while the other schemes are amplified in the later blocks. The same measure shows that a scheme that is better on one block in isolation can be worse in the whole network. To address this inconsistency we introduce an angular measure of the spectrum of the output of a block, which in isolation orders the schemes as the whole network does where they diverge most. We support these observations with real samples and with statistically generated ones. The scope is one model, the FFN weights only, and float evaluation of compressed weights; no speed-up is claimed. The error measures and the sample generation, however, can be applied to other models and precisions.

AI.tldr: 将ViT-L/16全部48个FFN矩阵量化到2–8比特，比较四种方案（逐token网格、固定Gaussian Lloyd–Max表、拟合表、随机符号Hadamard旋转+固定表），并提出沿block传播的残差流角度误差与block输出谱角度两种可移植度量来解释量化方案在整网中的排序来源。
AI.motivation: 现有量化研究多以最终精度作为唯一评价，缺少对"误差如何在网络深度上累积、为何单层更优方案在整网中反而更差"的可解释度量。作者希望找到一个既能复现最终分类排序、又能定位排序成因的轻量指标，并为逐层方案选择与整网表现的不一致提供诊断工具。
AI.method: 在50,000张图像上，对ViT-L/16的48个FFN权重矩阵做2–8比特压缩，比较四种量化方案：(1) per-token网格；(2) 固定Gaussian Lloyd–Max码表；(3) 针对矩阵拟合的码表；(4) 随机符号Hadamard旋转后接固定码表。评价指标包括top-1精度、与float32预测的一致率，以及压缩后与float32残差流之间的角度误差随block传播的演化；并引入block输出谱的角度度量，用于在孤立单块上评估方案。实验中同时使用真实样本与统计生成样本，压缩权重以浮点方式推理。
AI.result: 4比特时四种方案top-1精度与float32模型相差在0.8个百分点以内，预测一致率为98.4%–94.4%；残差流角度误差的排序与最终分类排序一致。带旋转时角度误差近似按block数平方根增长，呈现误差独立累积的特征，而其余方案在后段block被放大。该角度度量还揭示：某方案在单块孤立评估中更优，在整网中可能更差。为此提出的输出谱角度度量在方案分歧最大的区间上，其单块排序与整网排序一致。
AI.conclusion: 残差流角度误差是一种能复现整网分类排序、并能定位排序形成位置的可移植度量；输出谱角度度量可缓解逐层评估与整网表现的不一致。结论限于单一模型、仅FFN权重、压缩权重的浮点评估，未声称任何加速；但误差度量与样本生成方法可推广到其他模型与精度。

title: Feedback Shortcut: Speculative Decoding for Latent Feedback Transformers
summary: Feeding each position's top-layer hidden state back into the next position's input improves Transformer performance. However, this feedback breaks speculative decoding, since verifying a drafted token requires the top-layer state from its preceding position, which forces the draft to rely on an approximate stand-in. Training the model to adapt to this stand-in can lower the exact-decoding performance ceiling, while using it at inference time further introduces approximation error. We propose Feedback Shortcut to address both bottlenecks. First, state alignment trains a lightweight projection from multi-token prediction head states to stand-ins, leaving base model training untouched. Second, pipelined correction re-evaluates each draft using its predecessor's newly computed state, a much closer proxy to true feedback. Running this correction inside the verification pass of subsequent drafts improves accuracy with zero extra calls. Across 135M and 780M scales, Feedback Shortcut stays within $10^{-4}$ bits per byte of the exact-decoding ceiling on Paloma and accelerates decoding by 2.4-2.8x with about 2% more training compute than the latent feedback Transformer. At large batch sizes, skipping correction still preserves Transformer speed and over 80% of latent feedback's gains.

AI.tldr: 提出 Feedback Shortcut，通过“状态对齐”与“流水线纠错”两个机制，使带隐状态反馈的 Transformer 在保持精确解码性能上限的同时实现 2.4–2.8× 的投机解码加速。
AI.motivation: 将每层顶层的隐状态反馈回下一位置输入可提升 Transformer 性能，但这种反馈破坏了投机解码：验证一个草稿 token 需要其前一位置的顶层状态，而草稿阶段只能使用近似的替代状态。让模型训练去适应该替代会压低精确解码的性能上限，而在推理时直接使用又引入近似误差。论文旨在同时解决这两个瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 状态对齐（state alignment）：训练一个轻量投影，将多 token 预测头（MTP）的状态映射为替代状态，不触碰基座模型的训练；2) 流水线纠错（pipelined correction）：用草稿前驱新计算出的状态重新评估每个草稿，作为更接近真实反馈的代理；该纠错被嵌入后续草稿的验证过程中执行，因此不增加额外调用。
AI.result: 在 135M 与 780M 两个规模上，Feedback Shortcut 在 Paloma 上与精确解码上限的差距保持在 10^-4 bits-per-byte 以内，解码加速 2.4–2.8×，相比 latent feedback Transformer 仅增加约 2% 训练算力。在大 batch 场景下，跳过纠错仍可保持 Transformer 的速度，并保留 latent feedback 增益的 80% 以上。
AI.conclusion: Feedback Shortcut 以极小的训练开销弥合了隐状态反馈与投机解码之间的不兼容性，在不牺牲精确解码性能上限的前提下获得显著加速，并给出大 batch 下可省略纠错的高效折中方案。

title: FlowPAC: Flow-Guided Visual Pruning and Action Caching for Efficient VLA Inference
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for embodied AI, yet their high inference latency and memory footprint remain major barriers to edge deployment. Existing training-free acceleration techniques, such as visual token pruning and action caching, typically rely on static resource allocation. This mismatch with dynamic robotic interactions not only degrades control performance but also causes severe hardware inefficiencies, including fragmented KV-cache layouts and wasted compute on non-critical regions. To address this, we propose FlowPAC, a locality-aware framework that leverages task-aware optical flow as a shared physical signal to jointly optimize visual and action computation. Specifically, we introduce Direction-Aware Trajectory Propagation (DATP) and Locality-Aware Contiguous Token Selection (LACT) to jointly handle visual token dynamics and enforce spatial locality, reducing memory fragmentation and enabling efficient KV-cache compression. This is complemented by Flow-Conditioned Action-Block Refresh (FCAR) for adaptive action computation based on motion dynamics. Extensive closed-loop evaluations on LIBERO demonstrate that FlowPAC achieves a 2.13$\times$ end-to-end speedup over the dense baseline while essentially maintaining the success rate with 30% visual-token retention. These results validate that aligning computation allocation with both physical dynamics and hardware constraints is essential for efficient VLA deployment on edge systems.

AI.tldr: FlowPAC：以光流为共享物理信号，联合优化视觉token选择与动作计算，实现VLA模型的无训练加速，在LIBERO上取得2.13×端到端加速且成功率基本保持。
AI.motivation: VLA模型的推理延迟与内存占用阻碍边缘部署；现有免训练加速方法（视觉token剪枝、动作缓存）采用静态资源分配，与机器人交互的动态性不匹配，导致控制性能下降及KV-cache布局碎片化、非关键区域算力浪费等硬件低效问题。
AI.method: 提出局部性感知框架FlowPAC，利用任务感知光流作为统一物理信号协同调度视觉与动作计算：1）方向感知轨迹传播（DATP）与局部性感知连续token选择（LACT）联合处理视觉token动态并施加空间局部性约束，降低内存碎片、支持高效KV-cache压缩；2）光流条件动作块刷新（FCAR）依据运动动力学自适应决定动作块重算。
AI.result: 在LIBERO闭环评测中，仅保留30%视觉token时相对稠密基线取得2.13×端到端加速，成功率基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 将计算分配同时对齐物理动力学与硬件约束，是VLA在边缘系统高效部署的关键原则。

title: torchtsetlin: Fast, Interpretable Tsetlin Machines for PyTorch
summary: The Tsetlin machine learns propositional rules with teams of Tsetlin automata that are driven by reward and penalty rather than gradients, so its models are interpretable by construction and cheap to evaluate. Its software, however, consists of C and CUDA kernels behind scikit-learn-style wrappers that sit outside the deep learning ecosystem. torchtsetlin implements the Tsetlin machine family as ordinary PyTorch modules: vanilla and weighted, coalesced, regression, convolutional over sequences, images and volumes, and dense per-pixel segmentation. The automata are a tensor buffer, so a model moves with .to(device), is saved with state_dict() and learns from a mini-batch with one update(x,y) call. Its core technique is a batched formulation of Type I and Type II feedback, in which automaton transitions become event counts realised as binomial draws, with one commit per mini-batch. On ten benchmarks taken from the existing libraries, it matches their accuracy, and on all but the two smallest it trains 2.4-10.9X faster than PyTsetlinMachineCUDA and 10.3-81.2X faster than tmu on the same GPU. The package is pure Python, MIT-licensed and on PyPI; every number in this paper is reproduced by one script. Code: https://github.com/vlbthambawita/torchtsetlin; package: https://pypi.org/project/torchtsetlin/.

AI.tldr: 提出 torchtsetlin，将 Tsetlin 机家族以标准 PyTorch 模块形式实现，用批量化的 Type I/Type II 反馈（事件计数 + 二项抽样、每个 mini-batch 一次提交）替代 C/CUDA 内核，在十个基准上精度持平，训练速度较 PyTsetlinMachineCUDA 快 2.4–10.9 倍、较 tmu 快 10.3–81.2 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有 Tsetlin 机实现为 C 与 CUDA 内核，仅通过类 scikit-learn 封装暴露接口，游离于深度学习生态之外，难以与 PyTorch 的张量、设备迁移、状态保存与自动微分式工作流集成。
AI.method: 以普通 PyTorch 模块实现 Tsetlin 机系列（vanilla、weighted、coalesced、回归、序列/图像/体数据卷积、逐像素稠密分割）；自动机状态存为张量缓冲区，支持 .to(device)、state_dict() 与单次 update(x,y) 小批量学习；核心技术是 Type I 与 Type II 反馈的批量化表述，将自动机状态转移转化为事件计数，以二项分布抽样实现，每个 mini-batch 仅一次提交。
AI.result: 在取自现有库的十个基准上精度与之持平；除两个最小数据集外，同 GPU 下训练速度较 PyTsetlinMachineCUDA 快 2.4–10.9 倍，较 tmu 快 10.3–81.2 倍。代码为纯 Python、MIT 许可、发布于 PyPI，论文全部数值由单一脚本复现。
AI.conclusion: 将 Tsetlin 机的规则学习原语张量化并融入 PyTorch 生态，可在保持可解释性与精度不变的前提下显著提升训练效率，为该类模型提供易用、可复现的开源实现。

title: Fairness Evaluation for Diffusion and Flow Models Should Account for the Generation Path: Implications for Clinical Imaging
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 GenAI4Health Workshop Position Paper Track
summary: Medical image generation models are often evaluated using images produced by a single sampling procedure. However, diffusion and flow models can use different numbers of sampling steps, sampling schedules, or numerical solvers without changing their trained parameters. These changes may affect the generated images and the clinical measurements derived from them. We argue that fairness results obtained under one sampling procedure should not be assumed to hold under another, particularly when changes in sampling affect clinical task errors differently across patient groups. Building on previous work on medical image quality, accelerated sampling, generation dynamics, and generative model fairness, we examine why the sampling procedure should be considered part of the evaluated system. We define subgroup differences in clinical task error across sampling procedures and provide a mathematical example showing that two groups can have identical outputs under the exact dynamics and a reference sampler but different errors under an alternative sampler. We also extend this result to stochastic generation under shared noise. An exploratory experiment with an age-conditioned image generation model illustrates how changing the number and timing of sampling steps can alter image-derived measurements, although these differences do not establish clinical unfairness. We therefore argue that fairness evaluation should assess the sampling procedure used in practice and examine intermediate generation states when they help explain differences in clinically relevant errors across patient groups. Analysis code is available here https://github.com/rdharini2001/generation-path-fairness

AI.tldr: 论文指出，医学图像生成模型的公平性评估不应只针对单一采样流程；因为在参数不变的前提下，改变采样步数、采样调度或数值求解器会改变生成图像及其临床测量结果，从而可能影响不同患者群体间的临床任务误差差异。作者给出数学示例并开展初步实验，主张公平性评估必须包含实际使用的采样流程，并在必要时考察中间生成状态。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像生成模型的评估通常基于单一采样流程产出的图像，但扩散与流模型的采样步数、采样调度和数值求解器可自由更换而不改变训练参数。这类改动可能影响生成图像及由图像导出的临床测量，并可能对不同患者群体造成不同程度的临床任务误差，因此单采样流程下的公平性结论不宜直接外推。
AI.method: 基于医学图像质量、加速采样、生成动力学与生成模型公平性的既有工作，论证采样流程应视为被评估系统的一部分；定义跨采样流程的临床任务误差亚组差异；构造数学示例说明两组在精确动力学与参考采样器下输出相同、但在替代采样器下误差不同，并将结论推广到共享噪声下的随机生成；用年龄条件图像生成模型做探索性实验，改变采样步数与时序。
AI.result: 理论示例表明，亚组间公平性结论依赖采样流程：相同输出可伴随不同误差，随机生成下同样成立。探索性实验显示，改变采样步数与时机可改变图像导出的测量值，但作者明确指出这些差异尚不足以构成临床层面的不公平证据。
AI.conclusion: 公平性评估应针对实际部署中使用的采样流程，而非默认其在其他采样设置下成立；当中间生成状态有助于解释患者群体间临床相关误差差异时，应将其纳入分析。代码已公开。

title: Learning the Projection onto the Data Support: Distribution Learning that Avoids Memorization
summary: We introduce a framework for learning distributions supported on manifolds based on estimating the nearest-point projection onto the data support. Specifically, we define an objective functional over a class of functions whose minimizer recovers this projection. The proposed framework automatically adapts to the intrinsic dimension and allows for data supported on unions of manifolds with varying dimensions. The resulting objective can be optimized using standard neural network architectures. We present population-level results establishing recovery of the manifold projection and prove finite-sample Wasserstein generalization bounds. Furthermore, we validate the approach empirically across a range of settings. In contrast to widely used generative models such as diffusion models, whose objectives can be minimized by memorizing training samples, our formulation excludes such behavior. We also introduce a direct memorization metric to verify that the learned projection generates new samples rather than reproducing the training set.

AI.tldr: 提出通过学习最近点投影（nearest-point projection）来学习流形支撑上的分布的框架，目标泛函的极小化子即恢复该投影，自动适应内在维度并支持混合维度流形并集；给出总体层面恢复保证与有限样本Wasserstein泛化界，并从理论上排除记忆训练样本的行为，同时提出直接记忆度量进行实证验证。
AI.motivation: 现有主流生成模型（如扩散模型）的目标函数可能通过记忆训练样本来最小化，缺乏对"是否真正学习分布而非复制数据"的保证；同时数据常位于低维流形或其并集上，需要能自动适应内在维度的建模方式。
AI.method: 在一个函数类上定义目标泛函，使其极小化子恰好恢复数据支撑上的最近点投影；该泛函可用标准神经网络架构优化，框架自动适应内在维度，并适用于不同维度流形之并上的数据。
AI.result: 给出总体层面的流形投影恢复结果，证明有限样本Wasserstein泛化界；在多种设定下进行实证验证，并引入直接记忆度量，确认所学投影生成新样本而非复现训练集。
AI.conclusion: 以最近点投影为目标的学习框架在理论（投影恢复、泛化界）与实证上均可行，且其目标形式天然排除记忆训练样本的行为，为流形支撑分布学习提供了区别于扩散模型等方法的替代路线。

title: Neural Fidelity Calibration: Turning Field Anomalies into Simulation Fine-Tuning
comment: The code and demonstration videos are available at https://www.youwei-yu.com/nfc/
summary: A policy that transfers from simulation to a lab robot often fails in the field. Calibrating a simulator from real-world data typically targets only a few hand-picked parameters, and even calibrated simulators fail to capture unmodeled dynamics, while environments reconstructed via onboard perception inherit sensing noise and artifacts. We propose Neural Fidelity Calibration (NFC), a framework based on conditional flow matching that infers online, directly from a robot's execution data, both simulator physical parameters and residual fidelity - the remaining dynamics discrepancy and the gap between perceived and true environment geometry. A simulation-trained anomaly detector determines when recalibration or fine-tuning is required using onboard sensory signals alone, while an exploration policy actively modulates posterior uncertainty using optimism in the face of uncertainty. Across five robot platforms with up to 39 calibrated parameters and a 128x128 residual terrain map, NFC achieves the most accurate posterior distributions compared to established simulation-based inference baselines. In physical outdoor experiments with a wheeled robot suffering an axle failure across snow, mud, and wet grass, NFC increases rough-terrain navigation success from 26% to 70% while reducing orientation jerk by 88%.

AI.tldr: 提出神经保真度校准（NFC）框架，用条件流匹配从机器人执行数据在线推断仿真器物理参数与残余保真度（未建模动力学+感知环境几何偏差），并配合异常检测器触发重校准与乐观探索策略降低后验不确定性，在五个平台上取得最准确的后验分布，实车雪地/泥地/湿草导航成功率由26%提升至70%。
AI.motivation: 仿真到实物的策略迁移在真实场景中常失效。现有校准只针对少数人工挑选的参数，即使校准后仿真器仍无法刻画未建模动力学；而基于机载感知重建的环境又带有传感噪声与伪影，导致仿真与现实的保真度差距难以消除。
AI.method: NFC基于条件流匹配（conditional flow matching），直接从机器人执行数据在线推断两类量：仿真器物理参数与"残余保真度"（剩余动力学差异、感知环境与真实几何之间的差距），后者以参数化/地图形式（最高39个参数、128×128残余地形图）表示。采用仿真训练的异常检测器，仅依赖机载传感信号判断何时需要重校准或微调；并设计探索策略，基于不确定性乐观原则（OFU）主动调制后验不确定性以加速辨识。
AI.result: 在五个机器人平台（至多39个标定参数、128×128残余地形图）上，NFC的后验分布精度优于既有基于仿真的推断（SBI）基线。在轮式机器人断轴故障条件下，于雪地、泥地、湿草等真实户外环境实验：崎岖地形导航成功率从26%提升到70%，姿态抖动（orientation jerk）降低88%。
AI.conclusion: 将仿真器校准从"少数参数点估计"扩展为对参数与残余差异的联合在线贝叶斯推断，是缩小sim-to-real差距的有效途径；在线残余建模结合异常触发的重校准与主动探索，可显著提升真实退化/故障场景下的导航鲁棒性与运动平滑性。

title: From Point Clouds to Engineering Models: Benchmarking Agentic 3D Reconstruction in the Built Environment
summary: Coding agents can translate 3D measurements into CAD geometry, but reconstructing engineering models for the built environment demands semantic interpretation and consistent construction constraints beyond surface fitting. We formulate scene-level Scan-to-BIM (Building Information Modeling) as an agentic 3D coding task and introduce S2Bench, comprising public and proprietary scans of 128 real-world scenes across five domains, paired with expert-curated reference models spanning diverse spatial scales. A shared framework lets agents measure scans in Python, build class-labeled components in a live CAD/BIM kernel, and iteratively refine their code. We also propose parallel asynchronous collaboration, where a lead delegates versioned tasks, continues modeling while workers execute, and integrates revision-bound proposals. Evaluating five agents and a collaborative team across 1,028 reconstructions shows that scan-to-model residuals directly guide geometric repair, whereas inferring semantic classes and construction relations requires joint geometric, visual, and engineering reasoning that agents struggle to ground and verify. Consequently, the leading agent fits scan geometry closely ($96\%$ coverage within $5\,\text{cm}$) yet reaches only $63\%$ mIoU, and no agent passes all engineering checks on more than $38\%$ of scenes. Coverage and engineering conformance drop with scene scale, whereas running a smaller model as a team improves all three axes with greater coverage gains on larger scenes. The project page is available at https://tumcms.github.io/S2Bench.github.io/

AI.tldr: 论文提出场景级Scan-to-BIM的智能体式3D编码任务与基准S2Bench（128个真实场景、1028次重建评估），并给出并行异步协作机制；结果显示几何拟合易、语义与工程约束难。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体可将3D测量转为CAD几何，但面向建成环境的工程模型重建不止于表面拟合，还需语义解释与一致的构造约束；现有工作缺乏场景级、跨领域的统一评测。
AI.method: 将场景级Scan-to-BIM形式化为智能体3D编码任务；构建S2Bench，含5个领域128个真实场景的公开与私有扫描及专家精标参考模型，覆盖多种空间尺度；提供共享框架，使智能体可用Python测量扫描、在实时CAD/BIM内核中构建带类别标签的构件并迭代优化代码；提出并行异步协作——由lead分发版本化任务、在worker执行时继续建模并整合与修订绑定的提案；评测5个智能体与1个协作团队。
AI.result: 扫描-模型残差可直接引导几何修复，而语义类别与构造关系的推断需几何、视觉与工程联合推理，智能体难以落地与校验。最强智能体在5cm内覆盖率达96%，但mIoU仅63%；无任何智能体在超过38%的场景上通过全部工程检查。覆盖率与工程一致性随场景规模下降；以协作团队形式运行较小模型可在三项指标上全面提升，且在大场景上覆盖率增益更大。
AI.conclusion: 表面拟合与语义/工程一致性之间存在显著鸿沟，场景级Scan-to-BIM的关键瓶颈在于语义与构造约束的可验证推理；并行异步协作是一种有效的性能提升路径，尤其利于大尺度场景。

title: Adversarial Attacks Expose Path-Dependent Failures in Discrete Medical Image Tokenizers
comment: 21 pages, 9 figures, 18 tables. Accepted at the GenAI4Health Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026, Sydney
summary: Discrete image tokenizers convert medical images into token sequences that downstream models either decode into an image for a classifier (the reconstruction path), classify directly (the token path), or feed to a generative multimodal model. We ask whether imperceptible input perturbations can break these systems through the tokenizer alone. We evaluate four tokenizers on three imaging modalities and extend the strongest attack to a deployed generative model. Our central finding is path-dependence: the same tokenizer fails in opposite ways depending on how its output is used. A supervised attack collapses diagnostic accuracy on the reconstruction path, with ROC AUC falling to $\leq 0.013$ at $ε=2/255$ on all four tokenizers, while sparing the token path. An unsupervised, label-free attack does the reverse; its damage concentrates in the multi-codebook tokenizers, worst in MedITok, whose token-path AUC falls from 0.919 to 0.239. The same label-free attack transfers to LLaVA-Med, a frozen medical vision-language model built on MedITok, making it report proliferative diabetic retinopathy in a healthy retina or call a malignant lesion benign, without access to the question, answer, or language-model gradients. Harm is driven by how far the attack moves the tokenizer's internal representation, not by how many tokens change: on the learned-codebook tokenizers, a control attack that changes nearly all tokens but moves the representation less leaves every path and answer intact. Domain-specific pretraining does not provide robustness: MedITok has the best clean accuracy yet is the most fragile, more so than UniTok, its general-domain counterpart. None of six candidate defenses repairs every failure mode, and several fail once the attacker optimizes against the defense directly. Medical tokenizer robustness must therefore be evaluated per downstream path, against an adaptive adversary.

AI.tldr: 本文研究离散图像分词器（discrete image tokenizer）对不可感知扰动的脆弱性，核心发现是"路径依赖性"：同一分词器在重建路径（reconstruction path）与token路径（token path）上表现出相反的失效模式，且标签无关攻击可迁移至基于MedITok的冻结医疗视觉语言模型LLaVA-Med。
AI.motivation: 医疗图像被离散分词器转换为token序列后，下游模型可通过三种方式使用：解码回图像再分类（重建路径）、直接基于token分类（token路径）、或输入生成式多模态模型。作者提出疑问：仅通过分词器本身，不可感知的输入扰动能否破坏这些系统？现有工作缺乏对不同下游使用路径下分词器鲁棒性的系统性、分路径评估。
AI.method: 在三种影像模态上评估四种分词器。设计两类攻击：(1) 有监督攻击（利用标签）；(2) 无监督、无标签攻击。并将最强攻击迁移至部署中的生成式模型LLaVA-Med（基于MedITok的冻结医疗视觉语言模型）。同时设置对照实验：一个改变近乎全部token但内部表示位移较小的控制攻击；以及六种候选防御，并考虑针对防御自适应的攻击者。
AI.result: 有监督攻击在重建路径上使诊断准确率崩塌，四个分词器在ε=2/255时ROC AUC均降至≤0.013，但基本不损伤token路径；无监督无标签攻击则相反，损害集中于多码本（multi-codebook）分词器，最严重的是MedITok，其token路径AUC从0.919降至0.239。该无标签攻击可迁移至LLaVA-Med，在无法访问问题、答案或语言模型梯度的情况下，使其将健康视网膜报告为增殖性糖尿病视网膜病变，或将恶性病变判为良性。损害由攻击对分词器内部表示的位移幅度驱动，而非token改变数量：改变近乎所有token但表示位移较小的控制攻击未造成任何路径或答案的破坏。领域特定预训练未带来鲁棒性：MedITok干净准确率最高却最脆弱，甚至劣于其通用域对应模型UniTok。六种候选防御均无法修复所有失效模式，且数种在攻击者针对防御直接优化后失效。
AI.conclusion: 医疗分词器的鲁棒性必须按下游路径分别评估，并应针对自适应攻击者进行测试；领域特定预训练不等同于鲁棒性，token层面的变化量不能作为损害的有效代理指标。

title: The Cross-Context Threshold Test: Detecting Discrimination Under Environmental Shifts
summary: We study how threshold tests for detecting discrimination under environmental shifts, focusing on the Veil-of-Darkness (VoD) setting where visibility changes between daylight and darkness. We show that standard threshold tests, when applied separately to daylight and darkness data, violate key assumptions: risk distributions drift across contexts and thresholds fluctuate arbitrarily. We propose a cross-context threshold test that enforces distributional invariance and monotonic threshold decay. Using New York City stop-and-frisk data and synthetic experiments, we demonstrate that this model yields more reliable thresholds, improves bias detection, and aligns with the counterfactual logic of the VoD test. Our framework generalizes to fairness auditing whenever environmental context influences decisions.

AI.tldr: 研究环境变化（可见度在日间/夜间切换的"黑暗之幕"VoD场景）下歧视检测的阈值检验问题。指出现有分别对日间与夜间数据做阈值检验违反风险分布漂移与阈值稳定假设，提出跨情境阈值检验（分布不变性+阈值单调衰减），在纽约市拦截搜身数据与合成实验上获得更可靠阈值、更优偏差检测，并推广至一般性公平审计。
AI.motivation: Veil-of-Darkness设定通过比较白天（可见种族）与夜间（不可见种族）的决策差异来识别歧视，但标准阈值检验在跨情境应用时依赖的风险分布不漂移、阈值不随意波动等假设在环境变化下难以成立，导致检测结果不可靠。
AI.method: 提出跨情境阈值检验：施加分布不变性约束，并对阈值随情境的衰减施加单调性约束，使日间与夜间共享结构化的阈值关系而非各自独立估计；在纽约市stop-and-frisk数据与合成实验上评估，并与分别拟合的标准阈值检验对比。
AI.result: 该模型给出更可靠的阈值估计、提升了偏差检测表现，且结果与VoD检验的反事实逻辑一致；合成实验验证了方法在分布漂移下的稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 环境情境影响决策时，阈值检验需显式建模跨情境的结构约束；所提框架可推广到更广泛的公平性审计场景。

title: Neural Fidelity Calibration for Informative Sim-to-Real Adaptation
comment: The code and demonstration videos are available at https://www.youwei-yu.com/nfc/
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) can transfer agile robot skills from simulation to the real world, but closing the sim-to-real gap by domain randomization requires expert physics knowledge, and simulator calibration from real data typically targets a few hand-picked parameters. Even then, simulators miss real-world effects, and environments reconstructed from onboard perception inherit sensing errors that limit policy improvement. We propose Neural Fidelity Calibration (NFC), which uses conditional flow matching to calibrate simulator physical parameters and residual fidelity domains online during deployment. Residual fidelity captures sim-to-real dynamics discrepancies and perception-induced environment uncertainty. NFC operates in a latent space so that realistic environments can be sampled from the inferred posterior for real-to-sim policy fine-tuning. The framework is informative: the pretrained policy is fine-tuned only when an anomaly is detected, sequential NFC seeds its proposal from the simulation-pretrained estimator, and a hallucination policy modulates posterior uncertainty following optimism in the face of uncertainty. NFC attains the most accurate posteriors among established simulation-based inference methods on five robots with up to 39 physical parameters and a 128x128 residual terrain. On a wheeled robot with a broken wheel axle deployed on snow, mud, and wet grass, NFC raises success on rough terrain from 26% to 70% and reduces orientation jerk by 88%. Code and videos will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出神经保真度校准（NFC），用条件流匹配在部署中在线校准仿真器物理参数与残差保真域，实现真实到仿真的策略微调，显著提升轮式机器人在复杂地形上的成功率并降低姿态抖动。
AI.motivation: 仿真到现实的迁移存在落差：域随机化依赖专家物理知识，基于真实数据的仿真器标定通常只针对少数手工挑选参数；仿真器仍会遗漏真实世界效应，而基于机载感知重建的环境又会继承传感误差，从而限制策略改进。
AI.method: 采用条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）在部署过程中在线校准仿真器物理参数与残差保真域；残差保真域用于刻画仿真到现实的动力学差异以及感知引起的环境不确定性。NFC 在潜空间中进行推断，可从推断得到的后验中采样逼真环境用于真实到仿真的策略微调。框架具备信息性：仅在检测到异常时才微调预训练策略；序列式 NFC 以仿真预训练估计器作为提议分布种子；并引入幻觉策略（hallucination policy）依据"面对不确定性时的乐观主义"调节后验不确定性。
AI.result: 在 5 个机器人（最多 39 个物理参数及 128×128 残差地形）上，NFC 得到比现有基于仿真的推断方法更准确的后验。在一台轮轴断裂、部署于雪地、泥地与湿草地上的轮式机器人上，NFC 将崎岖地形成功率从 26% 提升至 70%，并将姿态抖动降低 88%。
AI.conclusion: NFC 通过在线、潜空间的条件流匹配校准，将物理参数与残差不确定性联合建模，实现了高效的真实到仿真策略微调；结果表明显著提升了跨域鲁棒性与运动平滑性，代码与视频将在论文发表后公开。

title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
summary: Multimodal foundation models can play video games well when the game waits for them, but often fail when it keeps running. We find that much of this gap lies in the harness, which decides what the model sees, what it remembers, and how its outputs become actions over time. Existing harnesses such as VISTA improve the first two, yet turn each model call into at most one action, so the agent acts only as often as its model thinks. We introduce AutoPILOT, which changes the third: in each model call, the model can send a primitive action, start an open-loop macro, or write a closed-loop controller that keeps playing from the screen without further model calls until it hands control back. To evaluate agents in real-time games, we build AFK-Bench, 120 diverse browser games grouped by how they respond to inaction and playable in real time or with the clock paused. With GPT-6.1 Sol under the same budgets, AutoPILOT reaches 68.6% real-time success against 38.3% for VISTA, and on GameWorld it keeps 80.0% in real time while VISTA drops from 84.1% to 42.9%. Its gains hold across models, and it reaches VISTA's final success rate at a fifth of its API cost. Our results suggest that how a harness turns model outputs into actions over time is a central yet underexplored part of agent design, and we hope AutoPILOT and AFK-Bench will serve as a foundation for agents in a world that does not wait.

AI.tldr: 提出 AutoPILOT 执行框架与 AFK-Bench 实时游戏基准，将模型单次调用扩展为可下发原语动作、开环宏或闭环控制器，使智能体在不等人的实时游戏中显著提升成功率并降低 API 成本。
AI.motivation: 多模态基础模型在"游戏等待模型"的回合制场景表现良好，但在持续运行的实时游戏中常失败。作者认为该差距很大程度上源于 harness（执行框架）：它决定模型看到什么、记住什么，以及输出如何随时间转化为动作。VISTA 等现有框架优化了前两点，却限制每次模型调用至多产生一个动作，导致智能体的行动频率受限于模型思考频率。
AI.method: 提出 AutoPILOT，重点改造第三环节——输出的动作化方式：每次模型调用中，模型可（1）发送一个原语动作，（2）启动开环宏，（3）编写闭环控制器，在无额外模型调用的情况下持续依据屏幕画面游戏，直至交还控制权。同时构建 AFK-Bench：120 款多样化浏览器游戏，按对"无动作"的响应方式分组，支持实时与暂停时钟两种模式进行评测。
AI.result: 在相同预算下使用 GPT-6.1 Sol，AutoPILOT 实时成功率达 68.6%，VISTA 为 38.3%；在 GameWorld 上 AutoPILOT 保持 80.0%，而 VISTA 从 84.1% 降至 42.9%。增益在多个模型上均成立，且 AutoPILOT 以约五分之一的 API 成本达到 VISTA 的最终成功率。
AI.conclusion: harness 如何将模型输出随时间转化为动作，是智能体设计中核心但探索不足的环节；AutoPILOT 与 AFK-Bench 可为面向"不等待的世界"的智能体研究提供基础。

title: Vision-Language Truck Driving Advisories Grounded in Provincial Rules and Forecast Risks
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. This manuscript has been submitted to the 38th IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IV 2027)
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can generate context-aware driving advisories, but their outputs may conflict with road conditions or traffic rules, and they typically address a hazard only once it is visible. This matters for long-haul trucking, where heavy trucks need long stopping distances and a single trip may cross several jurisdictions with different traffic regulations. This paper proposes a data generation and distillation framework that integrates structured scene understanding, risk forecasting, and traffic-rule retrieval to generate truck driving decisions and natural-language advisories, with a consistency check on every record. The records, written by an 8B teacher, are then used to distill a 3B-parameter student model for onboard deployment. We also introduce a dashcam dataset covering four Canadian provinces, comprising 11,142 annotated lane-marking frames and 9,494 driving segments. On held-out driving data across all four provinces, the student passes the consistency check in 94.6% of the segments, against 20.2% for the untuned 8B teacher, and announces 26.2% of the risks in the next 10 to 30 seconds before they appear. Of the generated advisories, 97.7% conform to the provincial traffic rules and guidance. These findings suggest that the framework can produce rule-conforming training data for compact driving advisory models.

AI.tldr: 提出数据生成与蒸馏框架：融合结构化场景理解、风险预测与交通规则检索生成卡车驾驶决策与自然语言提示，并用8B教师生成带一致性校验的数据，蒸馏出3B车载学生模型；同时发布加拿大四省行车记录仪数据集（11,142帧车道线标注、9,494个驾驶片段）。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM生成的驾驶建议可能与道路状况或交通规则冲突，且往往在危险已可见后才作出反应；长途重卡制动距离长、单程跨多个司法辖区，规则差异使问题更突出，同时车载端需要小模型部署。
AI.method: 构建数据生成与蒸馏框架：整合结构化场景理解、风险预测与交通规则检索，生成卡车驾驶决策和自然语言提示，并对每条记录做一致性校验；由8B教师模型撰写记录，蒸馏3B学生模型用于车载部署；另构建覆盖加拿大四省的行车记录仪数据集。
AI.result: 在四省留出驾驶数据上，学生模型94.6%的片段通过一致性校验（未调优8B教师为20.2%）；在风险出现前10–30秒提前播报26.2%的风险；97.7%的生成提示符合省级交通规则与指引。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可为紧凑型驾驶提示模型生成合规、可用的训练数据，说明检索增强与一致性校验结合蒸馏可有效提升小车载模型的规则遵循性与前瞻风险提示能力。

title: FoGConcept: Identifying Interpretable Movement Concepts for Freezing-of-Gait Detection from Multi-Scale IMU Signals
summary: Freezing of gait (FoG) is a disabling motor symptom of Parkinson's disease, characterized by an episodic inability to initiate or sustain effective stepping. Current inertial measurement unit (IMU)-based models can detect FoG accurately, but they fail to explain their predictions in terms of human-understandable movement concepts. A major contribution of this work is to identify nine human-understandable movement concepts encoded by a multi-scale FoG model, including gait initiation, rhythmic bilateral gait, trembling in place, shuffling steps, and pivot turns. These concepts recur across subjects, are functionally linked to the model's FoG decisions, and exhibit emergent specialization across short and long temporal contexts. Repeating the concept-discovery procedure on a new FoG dataset, wider temporal contexts, and a deeper backbone recovers the same comparatively stable set of movement concepts. Accordingly, we propose FoGConcept, a mechanism-based interpretability framework for learning movement concepts from multi-scale IMU signals. Domain experts independently recognize 88.9% of the identified concepts, while the proposed model achieves an F1 score of 94.2% for FoG detection. Our findings show that accurate FoG detection can be understood through human-recognizable movement patterns, providing new insight into what a detection model learns to distinguish FoG from non-FoG movement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FoGConcept，一种从多尺度IMU信号中学习"可理解运动概念"的机制式可解释性框架，识别出九类人类可懂的运动概念（如步态启动、节律性双侧步态、原地颤抖、拖步步态、轴转等），这些概念跨被试复现、与模型FoG决策功能关联、并呈现短/长时域上的涌现专门化；领域专家独立识别出88.9%的概念，模型FoG检测F1达94.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于IMU的冻结步态（FoG）检测模型虽准确，却无法用人类可理解的运动概念解释其预测，缺乏机制层面的可解释性。
AI.method: 在冻结步态多尺度模型上开展概念发现，识别九类由模型编码的可理解运动概念；在不同FoG数据集、更宽时间上下文和更深骨干网络上重复概念发现流程以验证稳定性；据此提出FoGConcept机制式可解释性框架，并由领域专家对概念进行独立识别评估。
AI.result: 概念跨被试复现、与FoG决策功能相关、在短长时域上呈现涌现专门化；在新数据集、更宽时域与更深骨干下均可稳定复现同一概念集；专家独立识别率88.9%，FoG检测F1为94.2%。
AI.conclusion: 准确的FoG检测可通过人类可识别的运动模式加以理解，揭示了检测模型区分FoG与非FoG运动的所学表征，为机制式可解释性提供了新思路。

title: Intervention-Robust VLA: Diverse Demonstrations for Robot Deployment with Safety Filters
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have shown strong potential for learning complex robotic behaviors from demonstrations. However, learning safe behavior directly from data requires extensive coverage of safety-critical situations, which is often impractical in real-world settings. Test-time safety filters provide an alternative by correcting unsafe actions during deployment, but these interventions can drive the robot into states poorly covered by the training data, thereby degrading task performance. We introduce InteR-VLA, an intervention-robust framework for VLAs that leverages diverse task-completing demonstrations to broaden task-relevant state coverage and maintain competence under safety interventions. By better aligning the training distribution with safety-filtered deployment under the same data budget, our approach mitigates intervention-induced distribution shift while preserving task performance. Real-world experiments across in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings show that InteR-VLA maintains safety, increases Safe Success Rate up to 90% from 0% for nominal policies, and consistently outperforms nominal-data training on both evaluated VLAs.

AI.tldr: 提出InteR-VLA，一种干预鲁棒的VLA训练框架，利用多样化完成任务演示扩大任务相关状态覆盖，使训练分布与安全过滤后的部署分布对齐，从而在安全干预下保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: 从数据中直接学习安全行为需要大量覆盖安全关键场景，现实中不切实际；测试时安全过滤器虽可在部署阶段纠正不安全动作，但干预会把机器人带入训练数据覆盖不足的状态，造成分布偏移并降低任务性能。
AI.method: 在相同数据预算下，利用多样化的任务完成演示扩展任务相关状态覆盖，并通过对齐训练分布与经过安全过滤的部署分布，缓解干预引起的分布偏移，同时保留任务能力。
AI.result: 在分布内与分布外设置的真实世界实验中，InteR-VLA保持安全性，将安全成功率从标称策略的0%提升至最高90%，并在两种评测VLA模型上均稳定优于仅用标称数据训练的方法。
AI.conclusion: 安全过滤器与策略训练之间的分布错配是VLA部署的关键瓶颈；通过干预鲁棒的训练设计可在不增加数据预算的前提下兼顾安全性与任务成功率。

title: FinEvo: Recursive Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Financial Modeling
summary: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have expanded their role in high-value productivity tasks, including financial analysis and modeling, while enabling models to play an increasingly active role in their own improvement. This motivates two complementary lines of inquiry: can financial modeling capabilities provide a foundation for model self-evolution, and can self-evolution, in turn, advance financial capabilities? We introduce FinEvo, a self-evolution framework that integrates autonomous experience construction with financial capability improvement. FinEvo prepares financial models, iteratively evolves challenges through self-play, and learns from the resulting interactions using executable rewards, relying on the same model throughout. An end-to-end execution with Qwen3.6-27B shows that solving feedback supports both increasing reasoning demands and identifying specification issues that executable checks can miss. Learning from these experiences raises whole-task success from 22.73 to 29.09 on held-out within-source tasks and from 13.13 to 19.19 on SpreadsheetBench 2 Financial. Comparable gains across task sources and evaluation settings, together with improvement on a task category absent from training, suggest that FinEvo strengthens underlying financial modeling capabilities shared across tasks. These findings support self-evolution as a path toward broader financial competence, advancing the empirical exploration of recursive self-improvement (RSI) in professional domains. Code is available at https://github.com/pcj-sudo/FinEvo.

AI.tldr: FinEvo是一个自我进化框架，将自主经验构建与金融能力提升结合：通过自博弈迭代生成挑战、以可执行奖励学习交互经验，同一模型全程参与。Qwen3.6-27B实验中，阈值内任务成功率由22.73升至29.09，SpreadsheetBench 2 Financial由13.13升至19.19，并泛化到训练中未出现的任务类别。
AI.motivation: LLM已进入金融分析建模等高价值生产力任务，并越来越多地参与自身改进。作者由此提出双向问题：金融建模能力能否为模型自我进化提供基础，自我进化又能否反过来提升金融能力——即检验递归自我改进（RSI）在专业领域的可行性。
AI.method: 提出FinEvo自进化框架：(1) 先准备/初始化金融模型；(2) 通过自博弈（self-play）迭代演化挑战任务；(3) 利用可执行奖励（executable rewards）从产生的交互中学习，全程依赖同一模型完成挑战生成、求解与学习闭环。
AI.result: 端到端实验（Qwen3.6-27B）显示：求解反馈既能提升推理需求强度，也能识别可执行校验难以发现的规格（specification）问题。学习这些经验后，阈值内留出任务整任务成功率由22.73提升至29.09，SpreadsheetBench 2 Financial由13.13提升至19.19；不同任务来源与评测设置下增益相当，且在训练中缺失的任务类别上亦有提升。
AI.conclusion: 跨任务来源、评测设置及未见任务类别的一致增益表明，FinEvo强化了跨任务共享的底层金融建模能力；自我进化可成为通向更广泛金融能力的路径，为专业领域RSI的实证探索提供支持。代码已开源。

title: Multimodal Violence Understanding and Temporal Retrieval in Movies with Adaptive Audio-Visual Fusion
summary: Violence in films and streaming media remains a concern for audience protection and creates substantial workload for manual content classification. Existing violence-detection methods often rely on limited modalities or short video clips, making it difficult to capture complementary evidence and localise violent events in long, untrimmed videos. In this study, we develop a framework for multimodal video understanding that classifies violence severity, predicts multiple violence types, and locates violent events in time. We combine temporally aligned visual and audio features extracted using pretrained encoders through attention-based adaptive fusion, followed by Transformer-based temporal modelling. Our framework supports three complementary tasks: video-level violence-severity classification, multi-label violence-type prediction, and temporal localisation of violent events. We evaluate the framework on the XD-Violence benchmark and examine its cross-domain performance using AIRTLab. On XD-Violence, our multimodal model achieves 93.27\% severity-classification accuracy and a micro-F1 score of 88.60\% for multi-label violence-type prediction, outperforming the corresponding unimodal configurations. We achieve a mean temporal intersection-over-union (tIoU) of 0.5075 for temporal localisation. Our cross-domain experiments reveal performance degradation under different recording conditions, while our movie case studies demonstrate the framework's potential to retrieve potentially violent scenes for further review. Our results highlight the practical value of multimodal intelligent systems in supporting human reviewers with the identification, classification, and temporal retrieval of violent content in films and streaming media.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多模态视频理解框架，通过注意力自适应融合时序对齐的视觉与音频特征并结合Transformer时序建模，在XD-Violence上实现暴力严重程度分类、暴力类型多标签预测与暴力事件时间定位三项任务；严重程度分类准确率93.27%、多标签micro-F1为88.60%、时间定位平均tIoU为0.5075，跨域（AIRTLab）性能下降，电影案例显示其可辅助人工复审。
AI.motivation: 影视与流媒体中的暴力内容既涉及受众保护，也带来大量人工内容审核负担。现有暴力检测方法多依赖单一模态或短片段，难以获取互补证据，也难以在长且未剪辑的视频中定位暴力事件。
AI.method: 采用预训练编码器提取时序对齐的视觉与音频特征，经基于注意力的自适应融合后，使用Transformer进行时序建模；统一框架支持三个互补任务：视频级暴力严重程度分类、暴力类型多标签预测、暴力事件时间定位。在XD-Violence基准上评估，并用AIRTLab考察跨域表现。
AI.result: XD-Violence上多模态模型严重程度分类准确率93.27%，多标签暴力类型预测micro-F1为88.60%，优于相应单模态配置；时间定位平均tIoU为0.5075。跨域实验显示不同录制条件下性能下降；电影案例研究表明框架能检索潜在暴力场景以供进一步复审。
AI.conclusion: 多模态智能系统在辅助人工审核者对影视及流媒体暴力内容进行识别、分类与时间检索方面具有实际价值。

title: Failure Modes and Data-Efficient Remedies for Transformer-Based Prediction of Viscoplastic Flows
summary: Fast and accurate prediction of viscoplastic flows remains a challenge in computational rheology due to yield surfaces, discontinuous gradients, and strongly nonlinear transitions between yielded and unyielded regions. Transformer-based neural operators such as RheOFormer have recently shown strong potential for surrogate modeling of non-Newtonian flows. However, their applicability to viscoplastic systems and their efficacy in recovering realistic flows remain poorly understood. In this work, we present the first systematic investigation of RheOFormer applied to steady Bingham channel flow. By isolating the problem to a simple geometry and constitutive model, we examine how dataset structure, numerical value range, and input representation govern the model's ability to interpolate and extrapolate within the parameter space. The data regimes in which RheOFormer remains accurate and those in which errors emerge are identified, particularly for plug-dominated flows and for conditions outside the velocity scales or flow structures represented during training. Upon identifying these failure modes, targeted enhancements to the input representation and loss formulation are introduced to better predict low-gradient plug regions. Logarithmic velocity representations and gradient-aware loss formulations substantially improve accuracy in challenging regimes where the baseline formulation fails. In addition, extrapolation errors are reduced by augmenting the training set with only a few strategically selected cases spanning the missing physical regimes. Finally, a single partially developed snapshot suffices for an accurate steady-state prediction, and the model outperforms simply copying its input throughout flow development. These results highlight the importance of appropriate field representation and parameter-space coverage for data-efficient neural-operator prediction of viscoplastic flows.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估 Transformer 型神经算子 RheOFormer 在稳态 Bingham 通道流中的适用性，识别其失效模式，并通过对数速度表示、梯度感知损失与少量补充算例显著提升精度。
AI.motivation: 黏塑性流动存在屈服面、梯度不连续以及屈服/未屈服区之间的强非线性过渡，传统数值方法代价高；而基于 Transformer 的神经算子虽在非牛顿流代理建模中展现潜力，但其对黏塑性系统的适用性与能否还原真实流动仍缺乏认识。
AI.method: 将问题限定为简单几何与本构（稳态 Bingham 通道流），系统考察数据集结构、数值取值范围与输入表示对参数空间内插与外推能力的影响；在识别失效模式（塞流主导区、超出训练速度尺度或流型的条件）后，引入对数速度表示与梯度感知损失函数，并用少量策略性选取、覆盖缺失物理区域的算例增强训练集。
AI.result: 明确了 RheOFormer 保持精确的数据区间及误差出现的区间；对数速度表示与梯度感知损失显著改善了基线失效的困难工况（低梯度塞流区）精度；仅补充少量跨区域算例即可降低外推误差；单个部分发展流场快照即可给出准确稳态预测，且优于"直接复制输入"的基线策略。
AI.conclusion: 合适的场表示形式与参数空间覆盖对数据高效的神经算子黏塑性流动预测至关重要，为屈服应力流体的代理建模提供了可操作的改进方向。

title: Probing Invisible Actuation Shifts for Test-time Calibration of Visuomotor Policies
summary: Visuomotor policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world action models (WAMs) are increasingly deployed on robots whose cameras and controllers differ from those used to collect their training data. Such deployment introduces two kinds of shifts. Visual shifts, such as a moved camera, change the observed images; actuation shifts, such as a retuned controller, latency or an added payload, change only how commanded actions translate into robot motion. Invisible to the policy, actuation shifts sharply degrade its success, even under domain randomization. In this work, we propose PEA, a test-time calibration method that identifies actuation shifts through active probing before task execution. Specifically, before each episode, the robot executes a short probe that moves one arm axis at a time with known commands, so that gain, delay and drift leave separable traces. A closed-form identifier estimates them from the response, and PEA compensates every subsequent command so that the robot executes the motion the policy intends. The identifier requires no policy training and thus applies to any frozen visuomotor policy. Since visual shifts remain visible to the policy, PEA further adapts the frozen policy with a removable low-rank adapter, addressing coupled visual and actuation shifts. Experiments on LIBERO with a WAM and a VLA show that, without any policy training, the identifier of PEA recovers most of the success lost to actuation shifts and generalizes to shifts unseen during training (e.g., from 61.0% to 89.7% on LIBERO-Spatial with Cosmos-Policy).

AI.tldr: PEA 是一种测试时校准方法：在每个回合执行前用短促主动探针辨识执行（actuation）偏移（增益、延迟、漂移），以闭式解估计并补偿后续指令；并用可移除的低秩适配器应对视觉偏移，无需训练策略即可提升冻结视觉运动策略在部署偏移下的成功率。
AI.motivation: 视觉运动策略（VLA、WAM）常被部署到与训练数据采集时相机与控制器不同的机器人上，带来两类偏移：视觉偏移改变观测图像，执行偏移（控制器重调、延迟、负载变化）只改变指令到运动的映射。执行偏移对策略不可见，即使在域随机化下也会显著降低成功率，而现有方法缺乏无需训练策略即可应对的手段。
AI.method: 提出 PEA（测试时校准）：1）每回合前执行短探针，每次只驱动一个手臂轴、施加已知指令，使增益、延迟、漂移三者在响应中留下可分离的痕迹；2）用闭式辨识器从响应中估计这些参数，并对之后每条指令进行补偿，使机器人执行策略意图的运动；3）辨识不依赖策略训练，适用于任意冻结策略；4）对视觉偏移，用可移除的低秩适配器对冻结策略做适配，以处理视觉与执行耦合偏移。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 上使用一个 WAM 与一个 VLA 进行实验，无任何策略训练情况下，PEA 的辨识器恢复了执行偏移造成的多数性能损失，并能泛化到训练中未见过的偏移，例如 LIBERO-Spatial 上 Cosmos-Policy 从 61.0% 提升到 89.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过主动探针加闭式辨识的运行前校准，可有效补偿对策略不可见的执行偏移；配合轻量低秩适配器还可缓解视觉偏移。该方法与具体策略解耦、无需策略训练、适配器可移除，为视觉运动策略的跨平台部署提供了一种实用的测试时校准方案。

title: Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness: How Context and Skills Shape Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Autoresearch agents, which autonomously design, run, and refine experiments, are accelerating scientific progress, particularly in AI research. However, existing agents rely on harnesses that combine multiple mechanisms, making it difficult to determine how individual components contribute to performance. We systematically study harness design for long-horizon, self-evolving autoresearch agents along two dimensions: context management, which determines what an agent retains from its past attempts, and skill management, which governs how it stores and reuses lessons from those attempts. Across MLE-Bench and KernelBench with gpt-oss-120b, gpt-6-luna, and gpt-6-sol, we isolate the effects of individual harness design choices by evaluating each against a recency-truncation baseline within a shared agent framework. For context management, we find that preserving individually accessible records of past attempts is more effective than maintaining a rolling summary, with context folding performing best across all six settings and improving upon the baseline by up to 19.2%. For skill management, selectively discarding persistently unused lessons is more effective on average than consolidating them or promoting them to standing rules. Building on these findings, we combine context folding and skill deletion in MLEvolver, which achieves a 72.7% medal rate on MLE-Bench Lite and a 94% $\mathrm{fast}_1$ score on KernelBench Level 3, substantially outperforming AIDE and OpenEvolve under the same inference budget. Overall, our study distills design principles for preserving experimental history and curating reusable lessons in autoresearch harnesses, paving the way for agents that turn accumulated experience into sustained progress.

AI.tldr: 该文系统拆解自动科研智能体的harness设计，从上下文管理与技能管理两个维度做消融实验，发现"上下文折叠"与"删除长期未用技能"最有效，并据此构建MLEvolver，在MLE-Bench Lite与KernelBench Level 3上显著超越AIDE和OpenEvolve。
AI.motivation: 现有自动科研智能体（autoresearch agents）的harness由多种机制叠加而成，导致无法判断各组件对性能的独立贡献，缺乏对harness设计的系统性认识。
AI.method: 沿两个维度系统研究长时程、自进化智能体的harness设计：上下文管理（智能体保留哪些历史尝试信息）与技能管理（如何存储与复用过往经验教训）。在MLE-Bench与KernelBench上，使用gpt-oss-120b、gpt-6-luna、gpt-6-sol三个模型，在统一智能体框架内以"近期截断"为基线逐一评估单个设计选择的效果。
AI.result: 上下文管理方面，保留可单独访问的历史尝试记录优于滚动摘要，其中context folding在全部六个设置中表现最佳，相对基线最高提升19.2%；技能管理方面，选择性丢弃长期未被使用的经验平均优于合并或将其提升为常驻规则。将context folding与skill deletion组合而成的MLEvolver在MLE-Bench Lite上达到72.7%奖牌率，在KernelBench Level 3上达到94%的fast1分数，在同等推理预算下大幅超越AIDE与OpenEvolve。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提炼出自动科研harness中"保留实验历史"与"精选可复用经验"的设计原则，为让智能体将累积经验转化为持续进展奠定基础。

title: BehaviorICL: Task-Conditioned Decoder States for Visual In-Context Learning
summary: The usefulness of an in-context demonstration for a vision-language model (VLM) depends on both the query image and the task posed about it. We study whether the frozen target VLM's own decoder states, read before answer generation, can select such demonstrations. BehaviorICL represents each image and task by a task-conditioned processing signature, the hidden states at the final input position across all decoder layers. Its training-free variant, BehaviorICL-Raw, averages cosine similarities between corresponding layer states and passes the retrieved examples with their reference answers to the same VLM. When the same NICO++ images are asked about their object or their context, Raw retrieves largely different demonstrations for the two questions and outperforms an image retriever given task-matched demonstrations on both VLMs. Across two VLMs and eight classification and visual question answering datasets, Raw gives the highest average accuracy among training-free retrievers on both VLMs and exceeds RICES with a CLIP ViT-L/14 encoder by 3.83 points on Qwen and 1.85 on InternVL. A lightweight shared projection, BehaviorICL-Proj, brings further gains on classification. Analyses of extraction text, decoder depth and bank answers help explain these gains, and attention analysis describes how the task text shifts attention at the extraction position toward the classified object. These results support the target VLM's internal states as a practical basis for visual in-context learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BehaviorICL，利用冻结的 VLM 自身解码器在答案生成前最后输入位置的隐藏状态（跨层构成"任务条件化处理签名"）来检索上下文示例；无需训练的 BehaviorICL-Raw 在两种 VLM、八个数据集上取得最高平均准确率，超过基于 CLIP ViT-L/14 的 RICES（Qwen +3.83，InternVL +1.85），轻量投影版 BehaviorICL-Proj 在分类任务上进一步提升。
AI.motivation: 上下文示例（ICL demonstration）对视觉语言模型的有效性同时取决于查询图像和所提任务，仅按图像相似度检索无法兼顾任务差异。作者希望验证：目标 VLM 自身在答案生成前的解码器内部状态，能否作为选择示例的实用依据。
AI.method: 提出 BehaviorICL：以所有解码器层在最终输入位置（答案生成前）的隐藏状态作为图像+任务的"任务条件化处理签名"。BehaviorICL-Raw 为免训练变体，对对应层状态计算余弦相似度并取平均作为检索相似度，将检索到的示例连同参考答案拼入同一 VLM 的提示中。BehaviorICL-Proj 则学习一个轻量共享投影以提升分类性能。另通过提取文本、解码深度、示例库答案与注意力分析进行机理探究。
AI.result: 对同一批 NICO++ 图像分别询问物体或语境时，Raw 检索出的示例差异显著，且在两款 VLM 上均优于给定任务匹配示例的图像检索器。跨两种 VLM、八个分类与 VQA 数据集，Raw 在免训练检索器中平均准确率最高，较 RICES（CLIP ViT-L/14 编码器）在 Qwen 上高 3.83 分、InternVL 上高 1.85 分；BehaviorICL-Proj 在分类任务上进一步增益。
AI.conclusion: 任务文本会改变提取位置上对目标物体的注意力分配，验证了签名的任务条件性。结果支持将目标 VLM 自身内部状态作为视觉上下文学习示例检索的实用基础。

title: SONATI: Spatio-temporal ocean neighbourhood asymmetric transformer for imputation of sparse, tabular data with uncertainty
summary: Missing value imputation is often a prerequisite for downstream analyses. In oceanography, observational data are frequently structured in a tabular manner, highly sparse and exhibit spatio-temporal structures that classical imputers such as k-nearest neighbours or MissForest are not suited to exploit. We present the Spatio-temporal Ocean Neighbourhood Asymmetric Transformer for Imputation (SONATI), a masked, factorised time-space transformer operating on pre-computed, local time and space neighbourhoods, which reduces computational complexity compared to global attention. SONATI is designed to work with tabular data and is thus in principle able to work on both gridded and unstructured data, though evaluation here was performed on gridded North Atlantic data only. It provides aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties through a negative log-likelihood loss and multiple forward passes with Monte Carlo dropout. Systematic ablations on attention type and masking strategies guided the final architecture design. The results showed that SONATI outperformed classical and transformer-based methods by at least 12.5% in terms of root mean squared error (RMSE) on a large observational oceanographic dataset with key biogeochemical and physical parameters in the North Atlantic (potential temperature, salinity, oxygen, nitrate, silicate and phosphate). Attention type and masking strategy strongly affected imputation accuracy and smoothness of the produced oceanographic fields. Best results were achieved by factorised time-space attention and combined geographic and per-sample masking. The combined masking strategy reduced the imputation error by 14.3% compared to per-sample masking only. Uncertainties were moderately well calibrated (miscalibration area at observed locations $0.074\pm0.012$) and moderately correlated with the imputation error.

AI.tldr: 提出SONATI——一种面向表格型海洋数据的掩码、因子化时空Transformer插补器，在局部时空邻域上运算，通过负对数似然损失与MC dropout给出偶然/认知不确定性；在北大西洋数据集上RMSE较经典与Transformer基线至少降低12.5%。
AI.motivation: 海洋观测数据常以表格形式组织、高度稀疏并具有时空结构，而kNN、MissForest等经典插补器无法利用这种时空结构，全局注意力的Transformer又计算代价过高。
AI.method: SONATI在预计算的局部时间与空间邻域上做因子化（时间-空间分离）注意力以降低复杂度；采用掩码建模，支持网格与非结构化表格数据；用负对数似然损失刻画偶然不确定性、MC dropout多次前向刻画认知不确定性；并通过关于注意力类型与掩码策略的系统消融确定架构设计。
AI.result: 在北大西洋含潜在温度、盐度、氧、硝酸盐、硅酸盐、磷酸盐等生化和物理参数的大型观测数据集上，RMSE比经典及Transformer方法至少改善12.5%；因子化时空注意力＋地理与逐样本联合掩码效果最佳，联合掩码较仅逐样本掩码降低误差14.3%；不确定性中等程度校准（观测位置miscalibration area 0.074±0.012）并与插补误差中度相关。
AI.conclusion: 注意力类型与掩码策略显著影响插补精度及生成海洋场的平滑性；局部时空邻域注意力配合因子化结构和联合掩码是可扩展且有效的海洋稀疏数据插补方案，但不确定性校准仅为中等水平，且目前仅在网格化北大西洋数据上验证。

title: Learning a Food World Model That Predicts the Next State from Production Data
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables: a 4-page paper with appendices. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Food assembly robots pick ingredients from a pan, and every pick must deliver a target weight. We learn a world model of food picking from 61,773 production picks, labeled automatically by a camera and a scale (self-supervised learning). From the pre-pick heightmap of the pan on a 2.5 mm grid, the commanded pick action, the food and the utensil, the model predicts the post-pick heightmap and the picked mass with uncertainty. We evaluate the mass prediction on 12,294 held-out picks of nine foods. The production controller keeps each pick near its commanded target. The model's root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 10.93 g is 9% lower than that of the commanded target or of a per-food mean. This RMSE is 24% lower than that of the controller's internal mass estimate. Gradient-boosted trees on 20 hand-crafted features have a 0.2 g lower RMSE, but they predict only the mass, not the next state that planning and policy learning need. Using the predicted uncertainty, we decline the most uncertain picks and answer 89.4% of picks with an RMSE of 10.28 g. The prediction barely responds to the commanded volume and depth, because they vary little in closed-loop production. The model also fails without warning at target weights not seen in training. Future directions include action-primitive conditioning and a more general model across foods and utensils. We give recommendations for learning world models from production data.

AI.tldr: 本文利用61,773次生产中的取食数据，以自监督方式学习食物分拣的世界模型：从取食前锅面高度图、指令动作、食物与餐具预测取食后高度图与取食质量及其不确定性；在9种食物12,294次留出取食上质量预测RMSE为10.93 g，优于指令目标、按食物均值与控制器的内部分质量估计，并可用不确定性拒答不确定样本，但模型对闭环生产中变化很小的指令体积与深度不敏感，且在训练未见的目标准量上会无预警失效。
AI.motivation: 食物装配机器人每次从锅中取料都必须达到目标准量，因此需要一个能预测取食结果（下一状态与质量）的世界模型，以支撑规划与策略学习，而不仅是质量回归。
AI.method: 用相机与秤自动标注61,773次生产取食（自监督）。输入为2.5 mm网格的取食前锅面高度图、指令取食动作、食物与餐具，输出为取食后高度图与取食质量及其预测不确定性；在9种食物12,294次留出取食上评估，并与指令目标、按食物均值、控制器内部分质量估计及20个手工特征的梯度提升树对比；同时用预测不确定性拒答最不确定的取食。
AI.result: 质量预测RMSE为10.93 g，比指令目标或按食物均值低9%，比控制器内部分质量估计低24%；手工特征梯度提升树RMSE再低0.2 g，但只预测质量、不给规划所需的下一状态；按不确定性拒答后，可对89.4%的取食给出RMSE 10.28 g的预测。
AI.conclusion: 从生产数据学习食物取食世界模型可行，且能提供质量与下一状态；但模型对闭环生产中变化极小的指令体积/深度几乎无响应，并在训练未见的目标准量上无预警失效。未来方向包括动作基元条件化与跨食物/餐具的通用模型，并给出从生产数据学习世界模型的建议。

title: A Nepali-Accented English Evaluation Dataset for Automatic Speech Recognition
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems perform strongly on native-English benchmarks, yet their accuracy degrades sharply when the input speech comes from under represented non-native accents. Nepali-accented English is particularly under-served: existing resources either focus on native Nepali speech, cover broader multi-accent settings without dedicated Nepali evaluation, or provide only limited Nepali-accent coverage. This paper presents a Nepali-accented English evaluation dataset designed to support robust ASR benchmarking under accent mismatch. The corpus was collected through a web-based platform that did not collect directly identifying metadata and contains recordings from 57 speakers. Each session follows a fixed 22-prompt protocol consisting of 11 phonetic prompts, 10 domain prompts, and 1 spontaneous prompt, providing complementary coverage of pronunciation, topical vocabulary, and natural speaking style. In addition to transcribed speech, the dataset includes participant metadata for coarse exploratory subgroup analysis and speaker-level manual recording-quality labels. Manual quality assessment shows that 50.9% of sessions are clean and 42.1% contain only mild noise. As a descriptive reference, open-source ASR baselines are substantially worse on this corpus than the corresponding LibriSpeech test-clean values reported in official model cards, reaching 38.15-55.00% WER on the collected set versus reported 2-4% WER on LibriSpeech test-clean. These baseline results position the corpus as a practical held-out resource for evaluating accent robustness and out-of-distribution generalization on Nepali-accented English.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个尼泊尔口音英语的ASR评测数据集，含57名说话人、固定22条提示词的会话协议，并给出开源ASR基线的显著退化结果（WER 38.15–55.00%）。
AI.motivation: 现有ASR系统在native-English基准上表现优异，但在代表性不足的非母语口音（尤其是尼泊尔口音英语）上准确率急剧下降；已有资源或聚焦尼泊尔语母语语音、或覆盖多口音但缺乏专门尼泊尔口音评测、或尼泊尔口音覆盖有限，因此缺乏专门的口音失配评测资源。
AI.method: 通过基于网页的平台采集数据，不收集直接身份识别元数据；共57名说话人，每场会话遵循固定22条提示词协议（11条音素提示、10条领域提示、1条自发语音提示），覆盖发音、主题词汇与自然语体；数据包含转写文本、用于粗略探索性子组分析的部分参与者元数据，以及说话人级人工录音质量标签。
AI.result: 人工质量评估显示50.9%的会话为干净、42.1%仅含轻微噪声；作为描述性参照，开源ASR基线在该语料上WER为38.15–55.00%，远差于官方模型卡中LibriSpeech test-clean报告的2–4%。
AI.conclusion: 该语料可作为评估尼泊尔口音英语口音鲁棒性与分布外泛化能力的实用留出（held-out）资源。

title: OSLA: Observation-Aware Local Alignment and Cross-Scene Relation Learning for Any-Scenario Person Re-Identification
summary: Any-Scenario Person Re-Identification (AS-ReID) aims to retrieve identities across spectral modalities and aerial-ground viewpoints using a unified model. However, changes in viewpoint and spectrum can make local correspondences unreliable, while conventional sampling may omit cross-camera positive relations needed for training. To address these challenges, we propose OSLA, an observation-aware framework built on supervised CLIP-ReID that combines Local Identity Alignment (LIA) and Cross-Scene Relation Learning (CSR). Specifically, LIA uses historical identity observations and competing-identity information to select reliable cross-scene local correspondences while allowing unmatched regions. Local-to-global distillation transfers identity knowledge from correctly classified historical local features into the global representation. CSR couples observed-cell sampling with spectrum-grouped ranking to jointly organize and optimize cross-camera relations. Sampling across two cameras and two spectra provides same- and cross-spectrum positives, while ranking constrains positive-negative scores separately by gallery spectrum on the final retrieval descriptor. Both modules operate only during training, preserving the original visual encoder and retrieval descriptor at inference. Experiments on WHU-MARS-1000 and WHU-MARS-2337 demonstrate that OSLA achieves absolute Rank-1 gains of 5.0% and 4.8% over UAD, respectively, under the AS-ReID protocol. The code will be available.

AI.tldr: OSLA：面向任意场景行人重识别（AS-ReID）的观测感知训练框架，在CLIP-ReID监督基线上结合局部身份对齐与跨场景关系学习，两个模块仅用于训练，推理时保持原编码器与检索描述子不变，在WHU-MARS-1000/2337上Rank-1分别绝对提升5.0%和4.8%。
AI.motivation: AS-ReID需用统一模型跨光谱模态与空地视角检索身份，但视角与光谱变化导致局部对应不可靠；且常规采样策略可能遗漏训练所需的跨相机正样本关系。
AI.method: 提出观测感知框架OSLA，构建于监督CLIP-ReID之上，含两模块：(1) 局部身份对齐LIA——利用历史身份观测与竞争身份信息筛选可靠的跨场景局部对应，并允许区域不匹配，再通过局部到全局蒸馏将正确分类的历史局部特征中的身份知识迁入全局表示；(2) 跨场景关系学习CSR——将观测单元采样与光谱分组排序耦合，双相机双光谱采样同时提供同谱与跨谱正样本，排序在最终检索描述子上按gallery光谱分别约束正负得分。
AI.result: 在AS-ReID协议下，于WHU-MARS-1000和WHU-MARS-2337数据集上相较UAD，Rank-1分别取得5.0%与4.8%的绝对提升。
AI.conclusion: LIA与CSR均为训练期模块，不改变推理时的视觉编码器与检索描述子，以较低部署代价显著提升统一模型的跨光谱、跨视角检索性能。

title: What Do Differentiable Rule Learners Need? FLARE: Fuzzy Rules with Additive Evidence
summary: Rule learners are used where transparency and accountability are required, because they give practitioners patterns they can read. Learning rules is a discrete problem, so neurosymbolic pipelines that use rules as explanations rely on relaxations such as the straight-through estimator. However, these differentiable rule learners often lag behind both classical rule learners and black-box classifiers in terms of performance. We study which parts of a rule-based classifier affect performance, and how well gradient-based training learns each of them. We found that most of the performance comes from how the rules are weighted: random rules with learned weights are already more accurate than every published differentiable rule learner we tested. Based on our results, we propose FLARE (Fuzzy Learned-Antecedent Rule Evidence), a differentiable rule learner that learns simple rules that combine to make the final decision. We also propose a learned encoding for variables with thousands of categories. We test FLARE on tabular data, using 42 datasets of OpenML-CC18 and the 38 classification tasks of TabArena. On CC18, FLARE exceeds the compared rule learners by 7.69 to 12.38 macro-F1 points and performs comparably to random forests, while remaining 1.00 to 1.11 points below tuned gradient-boosted trees. On TabArena it ranks at the same level as random forests and ahead of the other rule learners. As the concept-to-label head of a concept bottleneck model, FLARE is the best rule-based head in five of six settings. On graphs, it is competitive on PubMed and EMOGI but falls behind graph neural networks on Cora and Citeseer. Our code is available at https://github.com/Fuminides/FLARE

AI.tldr: 提出可微规则学习器FLARE，通过模糊学习前件规则与学习式权重，在表格数据上显著超越现有规则学习器并接近随机森林。
AI.motivation: 可微规则学习器虽满足透明与可问责需求，但性能普遍落后于经典规则学习器与黑箱分类器，因此需要厘清规则分类器各组成部分对性能的贡献及其可学习性。
AI.method: 通过消融分析发现性能主要来自规则加权；据此提出FLARE（Fuzzy Learned-Antecedent Rule Evidence），学习简单规则并以证据组合形成最终决策，同时提出面向数千类别变量的学习式编码。
AI.result: 在OpenML-CC18的42个数据集上比对比规则学习器高7.69–12.38个macro-F1点，与随机森林相当，低于调优梯度提升树1.00–1.11点；TabArena的38个任务上与随机森林同级并领先其他规则学习器；作为概念瓶颈模型的概念到标签头，在六种设置中的五种为最佳规则头；图数据上PubMed与EMOGI有竞争力，Cora与Citeseer落后于GNN。
AI.conclusion: 规则加权是性能关键，据此设计的FLARE可作为兼具透明度与竞争力的规则学习方案，但在部分图任务上仍不及专用GNN。

title: Defending Vision-Language-Action Models against Transferable Attacks via Visual-Proprioceptive Consistency
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in a wide range of robotic tasks. However, adversarial attacks in VLA models have shown strong transferability across robotic tasks, posing significant threats to robotic systems. Despite their different attack strategies, we observe that these transferable attacks share a common consequence: they disrupt the VLA model's perception towards the robot itself. Motivated by this observation, we propose a proprioception-grounded defense framework that leverages trusted proprioceptive information to detect and mitigate transferable adversarial attacks. Specifically, we utilize the robot's proprioceptive states to establish a trusted spatial reference, and compare it with the robot's perceived location inferred from visual features. Discrepancies between these two sources provide a reliable signal for detecting adversarial attacks. Extensive experiments demonstrate effective detection of transferable adversarial patches and improved closed-loop performance. Real-robot experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of our defense on real-world robotic tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种基于本体感知（proprioception）的可迁移对抗攻击防御框架：利用可信的机器人本体状态建立空间参考，与从视觉特征推断的感知位置比对，以差异作为攻击检测信号并加以缓解。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在机器人任务中表现出色，但对抗攻击在不同机器人任务间具有强可迁移性，对系统构成严重威胁。作者观察到，尽管各类可迁移攻击策略不同，其共同后果是扰乱VLA模型对机器人自身（本体位置）的感知。
AI.method: 构建信任锚定于本体感知的防御框架：用机器人本体感知状态建立可信的空间参考，再从视觉特征推断机器人感知位置，比较二者的空间不一致性作为可靠的攻击检测信号，据此检测并缓解可迁移对抗攻击。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该框架能有效检测可迁移对抗补丁，并提升闭环任务性能；真实机器人实验进一步验证了防御在真实世界机器人任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 利用本体感知与视觉感知之间的空间一致性校验，是对抗可迁移攻击的有效且实用的防御思路，且可迁移至真实机器人场景。

title: Temporal Logic Tensor Networks: Foundations of Temporal Reasoning in Neural Networks
summary: In dynamic scenes---football matches, traffic streams, surgery, or assembly---actions unfold at fundamentally different time scales: in football, a kick happens in milliseconds, a possession lasts seconds, and complex events such as a successful pass followed by a goal combine multiple atomic actions over extended durations. Models trained solely on visual data struggle to learn effectively across different time scales, lacking a principled way of reasoning across fine-grained instants and broader intervals. Neither point-wise nor purely interval semantics suffices: the former fragments events into frame-level snapshots lacking overall event identification; the latter treats intervals as atomic truth-values, ignoring state trajectories. We introduce Temporal Logic Tensor Networks (tLTN), a differentiable neuro-symbolic framework addressing this duality via a formal, multi-sorted logic where events and states are structurally interdependent. Extending Interval Logic Tensor Networks (ILTN), tLTN grounds state predicates as fuzzy truth-value paths over time points, while events are first-class entities with learnable trapezoidal fuzzy durations and differentiable Allen-style relations. A compositional semantics fuses static, event-structural, and state-dynamic satisfaction into a single differentiable LTN grounding. Crucially, the modalities constrain each other bidirectionally: the interval layer dictates where point-wise constraints (e.g., Until, Since) are evaluated, restricting them to event-defined spans; conversely, the point-wise layer validates interval relations, rejecting them if underlying state dynamics contradict the relation. Through controlled synthetic examples, we show when single-modality learning fails and how this localization reduces frame-level computational cost on long traces.

AI.tldr: 提出 tLTN（Temporal Logic Tensor Networks），一种可微神经符号框架，用多排序形式逻辑统一"事件"（含可学习梯形模糊时长与可微 Allen 区间关系）与"状态"（时间点上的模糊真值路径），并通过双向约束的复合语义在动态场景中跨时间尺度推理。
AI.motivation: 足球、交通流、手术、装配等动态场景中动作发生在根本不同的时间尺度上（毫秒级踢球、秒级控球、跨多原子动作的复合事件）。仅用视觉数据训练的模型难以跨尺度有效学习，缺乏在细粒度瞬间与更宽区间之间推理的原则性机制。纯逐点语义把事件碎片化为帧级快照、丢失整体事件识别；纯区间语义把区间当作原子真值、忽略状态轨迹。二者皆不充分。
AI.method: 扩展 Interval Logic Tensor Networks（ILTN），构建多排序逻辑：状态谓词被接地为时间点上的模糊真值路径；事件成为一等实体，具有可学习的梯形模糊时长和可微的 Allen 式关系；复合语义将静态、事件结构、状态动态三类满足度融合为单一可微 LTN grounding。关键在双向约束：区间层决定逐点约束（如 Until、Since）的求值范围，将其限制在事件定义的跨度内；逐点层则校验区间关系，若底层状态动态与该关系矛盾则拒绝之。
AI.result: 通过受控合成实验，展示了单模态学习在何种情形下失败，以及这种"局部化"如何在长轨迹上降低帧级计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 点式与区间语义的二分可通过多排序可微逻辑得到统一；事件与状态的双向互约束既能提供跨时间尺度的结构化推理能力，又能借助事件跨度定位降低长序列计算成本，为动态场景的神经符号时序推理提供了原则性框架。

title: ReSUL: Learning Regional Sensor Utility for Robust Multisensor Semantic Segmentation
summary: A corrupted sensor observation is not necessarily useless: misalignment can place informative scene structure at the wrong location. Robust multisensor segmentation must determine where to retain this evidence, where to exclude it, and where repair can recover its value.
