We introduce Regional Sensor Utility Learning (ReSUL), which learns these choices through their effect on segmentation risk. ReSUL compares full-sensor predictions, sensor-exclusion paths, and a re-registration path for displaced thermal inputs. A router predicts each path's signed reduction in category-balanced Brier risk relative to a fixed reference, then uses these estimates to allocate spatial mixture weights. This supervision connects spatial allocation to measurable task benefit without requiring fault labels at inference. MFNet experiments compare project-trained models under eleven clean and disturbed input conditions. ReSUL ranks first in 10 of 11 conditions in both ImageNet-1k and ImageNet-22k comparisons. Under severe thermal displacement, it reaches 54.58% and 55.63% mIoU, exceeding the strongest competing method in each group by 7.19 and 5.63 percentage points. Fixed-bank MFNet ablations show that utility supervision improves all eleven condition means over task-only routing. These results support learning how to use disturbed observations through their regional prediction benefit. Code is available at https://github.com/D-ST-Sword/ReSUL.

AI.tldr: 提出区域传感器效用学习（ReSUL），通过各路径对分割风险的降低来学习多传感器分割中"保留/排除/重配准"的证据取舍策略。
AI.motivation: 被破坏的传感器观测并非必然无用：错位会把有信息量的场景结构放到错误位置。鲁棒多传感器分割需判断何处保留该证据、何处排除、何处可通过修复恢复其价值。
AI.method: ReSUL 比较全传感器预测、传感器排除路径，以及针对位移热红外输入的重新配准路径；由路由器预测各路径相对固定参考的类别平衡Brier风险的有符号降低量，并据此分配空间混合权重。该监督将空间分配与可测量的任务收益关联，推理时无需故障标签。
AI.result: 在MFNet的11种干净与扰动输入条件下，ReSUL在ImageNet-1k与ImageNet-22k对比中均于10/11条件下排名第一；严重热红外位移下mIoU达54.58%和55.63%，分别领先各组最强竞品7.19与5.63个百分点。固定路径库消融显示，效用监督相比仅任务路由提升了全部11个条件的均值。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明可依据区域预测收益来学习如何利用受扰动观测，为鲁棒多传感器分割提供有效范式。

title: Scalable Beckmann Maps Improve One-step Generation
comment: 40 pages, 15 figures, 12 tables. Code and checkpoints: https://tullebulle.github.io/projects/sbm/
summary: Beckmann Transport Models (BTM) learn one-step generative maps end-to-end from data, without a teacher, a distillation stage, or pretrained features. We introduce Scalable Beckmann Maps (SBM), which bring to BTM the two ingredients behind the quality of modern multistep generators: classifier-free guidance (CFG) and a training recipe that scales, while keeping sampling at a single network evaluation. CFG combines conditional and unconditional velocity or score predictions, which a Beckmann map does not have. Our guidance rests on one observation: the BTM current is a positive multiple of an autonomous denoising field, to which CFG applies as it does to a velocity. With exact denoisers this gives guided BTM. In practice we substitute the map's own conditional and null predictions for the denoisers, which requires no additional network and introduces a bias that we characterize. We show that the guided update is consistent with a guided conservation equation, and that guidance can move the boundaries between basins, sending more noise to the modes a condition favors. Trained from scratch in the latent of a representation autoencoder, SBM reaches a one-step FID of 1.6 on ImageNet 256x256 without a teacher or a feature loss, outperforming the Improved-MeanFlow baseline with 3.2x fewer FLOPs. In text-to-image generation it reaches a GenEval score of 0.86 with one network evaluation. As a world model, where we train without guidance, the recipe alone outperforms DriftWorld on all five metrics of two robot-manipulation benchmarks, with 1.9-2.8x less training compute and no pretrained auxiliary feature encoder.

AI.tldr: 提出 Scalable Beckmann Maps (SBM)：将无分类器引导(CFG)与可扩展训练配方引入 Beckmann Transport Models (BTM)，保持单步（单次网络评估）采样。ImageNet 256×256 一步 FID 1.6（无教师、无特征损失），文本生图 GenEval 0.86，机器人操作世界模型五项指标均超 DriftWorld。
AI.motivation: BTM 能从数据端到端学习一步生成映射，无需教师模型、蒸馏阶段或预训练特征，但缺少现代多步生成器质量背后的两个关键要素： classifier-free guidance (CFG) 与可规模化的训练配方。因此希望在不增加采样成本的前提下补齐这两点。
AI.method: 核心观察：BTM 的 current 是一个自主去噪场（autonomous denoising field）的正倍数，而 CFG 对速度场适用，故可迁移至 BTM。实现上，用映射自身的条件预测与 null 预测替代去噪器，不引入额外网络，并刻画由此产生的偏差；证明引导后的更新与引导守恒方程一致，且引导能移动吸引域边界，使更多噪声流向条件偏好的模式。训练方面在表示自编码器（representation autoencoder）的隐空间从零训练，配方可扩展；世界模型任务中不使用引导。
AI.result: ImageNet 256×256 一步 FID 1.6，无教师、无特征损失，FLOPs 比 Improved-MeanFlow 基线少 3.2 倍；文本生图 GenEval 0.86，仅一次网络评估；作为世界模型，仅靠训练配方即在两个机器人操作基准的全部五项指标上超过 DriftWorld，训练算力少 1.9–2.8 倍，且无需预训练辅助特征编码器。
AI.conclusion: SBM 表明一步生成映射可与 CFG 及可扩展训练配方兼容，在图像生成与决策/世界模型任务上同时取得效率与质量优势，验证了 BTM 路线的可扩展性。

title: Knowing What You Carry: Scalable Physics-Anchored World Models for Robotic Planning with Liquid Payloads
summary: Payload-carrying robots, such as delivery robots and autonomous trucks, must choose motions that keep them and their payload safe, so their planners predict the outcome of each candidate motion. Modern planners compare thousands of candidates per step on a GPU, using world models such as batched simulators or learned predictors. Most of them assume a rigid payload, but a liquid payload keeps moving after a maneuver, and its state is rarely measured. Near a safety limit, small prediction errors can make an unsafe plan look safe. Coupled fluid simulations are accurate but too costly for every candidate, while low-order slosh models are cheap but accurate only away from resonance. We study this trade-off on a ground vehicle with a partly filled tank near its rollover limit. First, we build PLiMB (Parallel Liquid-MultiBody), a GPU-parallel slosh simulator that, to our knowledge, couples FLIP liquid two-way with many multibody vehicles for the first time. It provides training data and a high-fidelity reference. Second, we propose a scalable physics-anchored world model that combines a modal-slosh and roll prior, an estimate of the hidden liquid state from the vehicle's own motion history (no sensor in the tank), and a learned correction. Without simulating the fluid, it scores thousands of candidate plans in one batched pass within a 20 Hz control tick on one GPU. We judge each world model by the plans it leads a planner to choose. Near the rollover limit, planners that treat the liquid as a rigid payload or use published low-order slosh models repeatedly pick unsafe plans when a safe one exists. Ours never does in our standard tank and makes about half as many in a wide tank whose sloshing mode lies in the maneuver band. There, the liquid state left by earlier driving can change the best plan, and reading it from the vehicle's history halves our model's near-limit prediction error.

AI.tldr: 提出GPU并行液晃仿真器PLiMB与可扩展物理锚定世界模型，使载液地面车辆在侧翻极限附近能实时评估数千候选运动并选出安全方案。
AI.motivation: 载液机器人（配送车、自动驾驶卡车）规划需对每个候选运动预测结果，但液体载荷在机动后持续晃动且状态几乎不可测。刚体载荷假设与低阶晃动模型在共振附近失效，近安全极限时微小预测误差会让危险方案看似安全；耦合流体仿真精度高但对每个候选都算太昂贵。
AI.method: 1) PLiMB（Parallel Liquid-MultiBody）：GPU并行晃动仿真器，首次将FLIP液体与多体车辆双向耦合且支持大规模并行，用于生成训练数据与高保真参考；2) 物理锚定世界模型：融合模态晃动与侧翻先验、仅凭车辆自身运动历史推断罐内隐液体状态（无罐内传感器）以及学习式残差修正，无需流体仿真即可在单GPU、20Hz控制周期内一次批量评估数千候选方案。以“模型引导规划器所选方案的安全性”作为评价指标。
AI.result: 标准罐体下，刚体载荷假设与已发表低阶晃动模型的规划器在存在安全方案时反复选出不安全方案，所提方法从未发生；在晃动模态落入机动频段的宽罐体中，不安全选择约为前者一半。宽罐体下先前行驶遗留的液体状态可改变最优方案，从车辆历史中读取该状态使模型近极限预测误差减半。
AI.conclusion: 以“所选方案”而非单纯预测误差评价世界模型更具实际意义；物理锚定+隐状态估计+学习修正的混合建模可在不仿真流体的前提下满足实时规划需求，显著提升近侧翻极限下的规划安全性，并强调液体状态可观测性（从运动历史反演）的关键作用。

title: Specialized Large Language Models for Markovian Reasoning: Structural Cache Compression, Transition Pretraining, and Dual-Loop Transformers
summary: Standard autoregressive large language models attend to the growing history of generated tokens, making the key-value (KV) cache a central memory and throughput bottleneck in long-chain reasoning and multi-branch sampling. Yet an important class of reasoning problems is naturally first-order Markovian: the next step depends on a sufficient representation of the current state, rather than on the raw sequence of all earlier steps. We develop a unified design paradigm for Markovian-reasoning specialized large language models. At the cache level, the Markovian state interface transforms history-dependent KV storage into constant-size state transfer with respect to the number of reasoning steps. At the learning level, we reformulate long-chain prediction as independently trainable one-step transition objectives, with explicit state bottlenecks, distillation, invariance, and drift-consistency losses. At the architectural level, we introduce a dual-loop Transformer: an outer loop advances the reasoning state, while an inner recurrent-depth loop allocates adaptive computation to each transition through shared weights and explicit memory tokens or recurrent matrix states. We connect this architecture to a three-region cache, step-relative positions, truncated backpropagation, branch-aware checkpoints, and a transition-centric evaluation protocol. The organizing principle is simple: the optimal reasoning system need not remember everything; it must carry forward exactly what the future needs. This principle opens a path toward specialized reasoning engines whose memory footprint is decoupled from reasoning-chain length.

AI.tldr: 该文提出面向"马尔可夫式推理"的专用大语言模型统一设计范式：缓存层用恒定大小的状态接口替代随步数增长的KV缓存，学习层将长链预测重构为可独立训练的一步转移目标，架构层引入"外循环推进推理状态+内循环递归深度自适应计算"的双循环Transformer，使显存占用与推理链长度解耦。
AI.motivation: 标准自回归LLM需对不断增长的生成历史做注意力，KV缓存成为长链推理与多分支采样的内存和吞吐瓶颈。然而大量推理问题本身具有一阶马尔可夫性：下一步仅依赖当前状态的充分表示，而非全部历史步的原始序列。因此需要专门面向马尔可夫推理的模型设计与缓存/训练/架构协同方案。
AI.method: 提出三层统一范式：（1）缓存层——马尔可夫状态接口，将依赖历史的KV存储转为随推理步数恒定大小的状态传输；（2）学习层——把长链预测重构为可独立训练的一步转移目标，引入显式状态瓶颈及蒸馏、不变性、漂移一致性损失；（3）架构层——双循环Transformer，外循环推进推理状态，内循环以共享权重和显式记忆token或递归矩阵状态实现递归深度、按转移分配自适应计算。并与三区缓存、步相对位置编码、截断反向传播、分支感知检查点、以转移为中心的评价协议相衔接。
AI.result: 摘要为设计范式/立场性工作，未给出具体实验数值。所述预期收益为：状态传输与缓存规模相对推理步数保持恒定，内存足迹与推理链长度解耦；一步转移目标支持独立可训练性与长链训练的高效截断反传；内循环递归深度为每个转移提供自适应算力。
AI.conclusion: 核心组织原则是"最优推理系统不必记住一切，只需精确携带未来所需信息"。该原则为专用推理引擎指明方向：以显式状态瓶颈承载必要信息，使内存开销与推理链长度解耦，从而缓解长链推理与多分支采样中的KV缓存瓶颈。

title: UbiEnlight: User-Perception-Aware Real-Time Low-Light Video Enhancement on Mobile Devices and Smartglasses
summary: Low-light video capture is now common on smartphones and wearables, yet dynamic illumination coupled with mobile/werable user motion causes noise, blur, and flicker that make videos hard to perceive and use, especially for users with night blindness and near-eye displays. Prior work enhances frames with post-hoc temporal constraints or optimizes videos directly; however,low-light and motion degradations are spatiotemporally coupled, so post-hoc consistency after per-frame restoration often leaves flicker and motion artifacts. We present UbiEnlight, the first diffusion-transformer-based on-device system for real-time, temporally stable low-light video enhancement. UbiEnlight builds on two insights: (1) illumination and structure separate more robustly in the frequency domain, enabling a spectrum-guided diffusion transformer that injects Fourier amplitude/phase priors to correct illumination while anchoring structure without optical flow; and (2) user perceptual tolerance varies by context, motivating a perception-aware controller that adapts sampling depth, attention reuse, and frame caching at runtime. We implement UbiEnlight on smartphones and smartglasses, and evaluate it against state-of-the-art baselines. UbiEnlight improves temporal stability by up to 54.76% under dynamic/extreme conditions while sustaining real-time on-device performance.

AI.tldr: UbiEnlight 是首个基于扩散Transformer的端侧实时低光照视频增强系统，通过频域谱引导的扩散Transformer与感知感知运行时控制器，在智能手机和智能眼镜上实现时间稳定的实时增强。
AI.motivation: 智能手机与可穿戴设备上的低光照视频拍摄日益普遍，但动态光照叠加用户运动导致噪声、模糊与闪烁，尤其影响夜盲用户和近眼显示体验。已有方法采用后置时序约束或直接优化视频，然而低光照与运动退化在时空上强耦合，逐帧复原后再做一致性约束仍残留闪烁与运动伪影。
AI.method: 提出两个核心洞察并据此设计系统：(1) 光照与结构在频域更易分离，故构建谱引导扩散Transformer，注入傅里叶振幅/相位先验以校正光照并锚定结构，且无需光流；(2) 用户感知容忍度随场景变化，故设计感知感知控制器，在运行时自适应调整采样深度、注意力复用与帧缓存。系统在手机与智能眼镜上部署实现。
AI.result: 与最先进基线对比，在动态/极端条件下时间稳定性最高提升54.76%，同时保持端侧实时性能。
AI.conclusion: 频域先验引导的扩散Transformer结合上下文感知的运行时调度，可在端侧实时条件下有效解耦低光照视频的时空耦合退化，兼顾时间稳定性与感知容忍度，为移动/可穿戴低光照视频增强提供了可行方案。

title: Benchmarking EEG feature families for ADHD research in children and adolescents: performance and explainability across attention tasks
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures. Benchmark software and aggregate results (v1.0.0): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23884319. Curated EEG dataset (v1.0.0): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21982978
summary: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder varies in presentation. Diagnosis requires clinical and developmental assessment. Reproducible electroencephalography measures may complement clinical and behavioural characterisation, but differing feature definitions and evaluation methods hinder comparison. We compared seven feature families and four combinations across attention tasks and assessed the stability of held-out explanations. Two serious games yielded four overlapping attention-task cohorts of 123-140 participants each. Repeated nested participant-held-out evaluation assessed recruitment-group discrimination. Exploratory paired participant-cluster bootstrap tests corrected for multiplicity in two separate families: 72 individual-task contrasts and 18 fusion contrasts. For eight configurations selected after inspecting predictive results, we explained held-out native probabilities before calibration. In the strongest task context, the highest configuration mean AUROC over three repetitions was 0.773, with a fixed-prediction 95% interval of 0.692-0.854 unadjusted for selecting the maximum. Precision, sensitivity and specificity were 0.740, 0.556 and 0.861. In that task, the paired AUROC difference for connectivity minus spectral features averaged +0.2083 across six classifiers and the common 8 s and 16 s durations, with pointwise 95% CI 0.1076-0.3072 and adjusted p = 0.0036. F4-AF4 beta-band coherence led repetition-level attribution summaries in five selected procedures and was selected in every fit. Other contexts showed weaker discrimination and less consistent retention of leading scientific inputs. No general classifier winner emerged. Connectivity and its recurring coherence input warrant independent replication, but do not justify a universal feature recommendation. These exploratory findings do not establish causal task effects, disease mechanisms or diagnostic validity.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统比较了七类脑电特征族及四种组合在注意任务中的判别能力与可解释性稳定性，发现连接性特征（尤其重复入选的F4-AF4 beta频段相干性）优于频谱特征，但不存在通用最优分类器或普适特征推荐。
AI.motivation: ADHD表现异质，诊断依赖临床与发育评估；可重复的EEG指标有望补充临床与行为刻画，但已有研究中特征定义与评估方法不一致，导致结果难以横向比较，因此需要在统一框架下系统比较不同特征族与组合。
AI.method: 基于两款严肃游戏构建四个相互重叠的注意任务队列（各123–140名参与者）；采用重复嵌套的“参与者留出”评估进行招募组判别；对72个单任务对比与18个融合对比分别用配对参与者聚类bootstrap检验并做多重比较校正；对8个预测结果筛选出的配置，在未校准的原始留出概率上进行解释分析。
AI.result: 最优任务情境下，三次重复的最高配置平均AUROC为0.773（固定预测95%区间0.692–0.854，未校正最大值选择），精确率、敏感度、特异度分别为0.740、0.556、0.861；该任务中连接性减频谱特征的配对AUROC差在六种分类器与8 s、16 s共同时长下平均为+0.2083（95% CI 0.1076–0.3072，校正p=0.0036）；F4-AF4 beta频段相干性在五项入选流程中居归因摘要首位，并在每次拟合中被选中；其他情境判别力较弱、主要科学输入的保留一致性较低。
AI.conclusion: 未出现通用分类器优胜者；连接性特征及其反复出现的相干性输入值得独立重复验证，但不足以支持普适的特征推荐。这些探索性结果不确立因果性任务效应、疾病机制或诊断效度。

title: A Hybrid Multi-Goal Path Planning Framework for Powered Wheelchairs in Dynamic Environments: From Simulation to Real-World Validation
comment: This work is under review at the International Journal of Social Robotics. The manuscript extends arXiv:2610.42049 by introducing an elliptical wheelchair model, enhanced local planning methods, and hardware validation
summary: Autonomous powered wheelchairs (PWs) operating in human-centered environments must combine efficient multi-destination path planning with continuous collision avoidance strategies in the presence of static and dynamic obstacles. This study presents a hybrid framework integrating Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP)-based global task ordering, Potential-Field (PF) guidance, and local Rapidly-exploring Random Tree (RRT) and A-star (A*) planners. PF guidance transfers global path information to local planners, helping the robot stay aligned with the global path during obstacle avoidance. Local planning is enhanced with direction-aware, extended-neighborhood A* or RRT using environment-aware sampling and two-step extension. The TSP-PF-RRT and TSP-PF-A* methods are evaluated in normal, crowded, and extra-crowded simulation environments using point-based and elliptical robot models. The elliptical model accounts for platform dimensions during collision avoidance phase. Hardware tests on the physical PW use motion capture (MoCap) for ground-truth measurements, while outside-MoCap experiments rely on onboard LiDAR and RGB-D sensing. Results show that incorporating the wheelchair geometry changes the observed collision behavior, yielding comparable collision avoidance performance between the two hybrid planners under the elliptical model.

AI.tldr: 提出TSP-PF-RRT与TSP-PF-A*混合框架，结合全局任务排序、势场引导与局部规划，实现在静态与动态障碍环境下的多目标路径规划与连续避障。
AI.motivation: 自主电动轮椅在以人为本环境中需同时兼顾多目的地路径规划的高效性与静态/动态障碍下的连续避障能力，单一规划器难以满足需求。
AI.method: 上层用TSP完成多目的地全局任务排序；势场（PF）将全局路径信息传递给局部规划器以保持全局路径对齐；局部采用方向感知、扩展邻域的A*或环境感知采样与两步扩展的RRT；在正常、拥挤、超拥挤仿真环境及点模型与椭圆（几何尺寸）模型下评估；实车实验用动捕做真值，非动捕场景用机载LiDAR与RGB-D感知。
AI.result: 引入轮椅几何尺寸（椭圆模型）会改变观测到的碰撞行为；在该模型下两种混合规划器的避障性能相当。
AI.conclusion: TSP-PF引导与局部RRT/A*的混合框架可有效支撑电动轮椅的多目标导航与避障，且机器人几何建模对碰撞评估结果有显著影响，应在评估中加以考虑。

title: Feedback-Driven Prompt Refinement for Educational AI: Affective Trajectory Estimation and Bloom's Taxonomy Classification
summary: Contribution: This study has shown that a shared prompt-refinement procedure, guided by distinct affective and cognitive feedback signals, can improve held-out reference agreement and multi-label classification while reducing affective-generation variability without executor parameter updates. Background: Industry 4.0 has increased demand for personalized technical education across interconnected computing and engineering domains, while prompt sensitivity and generation variability have complicated dependable interpretation of instructional dialogue and learning outcomes. Research Questions: The study has examined whether task-specific feedback can improve affective-reference agreement, generation consistency, and cognitive classification without updating executor parameters. Methodology: A secondary language model has revised executor prompts using executor-output discrepancies against model-generated affective references for four dialogues and annotated Bloom labels for 70 learning outcomes; separate sets of 100 EduTalk conversations and 1,000 outcomes have supported held-out comparisons. Small refinement sets, unvalidated affective references, and absent learner-outcome measures have constrained interpretation. Findings: Affective mean absolute error has decreased from 0.742 to 0.702 and mean generation standard deviation from 0.307 to 0.238, while Bloom micro-F1 has increased from 0.687 to 0.893 and exact-match subset accuracy from 0.418 to 0.636. These findings have supported prompt refinement as a candidate approach for developing adaptive technical instruction, while its effects on workforce learning remain to be established.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种由情感与认知两类反馈信号引导的共享提示精化流程，在不更新执行器（executor）参数的前提下提升留出集参考一致性、多标签分类性能并降低生成变异性，为自适应技术教学提供候选方案。
AI.motivation: 工业4.0背景下，跨计算与工程领域的个性化技术教育需求上升，但提示敏感性与生成变异性影响教学对话与学习结果解释的可靠性；因此需探索无需重训执行器即可提升输出一致性与分类准确性的方法。
AI.method: 采用二级语言模型（secondary LM）依据执行器输出与模型生成情感参考的偏差（4段对话）、以及标注的Bloom标签（70条学习结果）改写执行器提示；使用独立的100段EduTalk对话与1,000条学习结果做留出集对比；全程不更新执行器参数。
AI.result: 情感平均绝对误差由0.742降至0.702，生成标准差均值由0.307降至0.238；Bloom微观F1由0.687升至0.893，精确匹配子集准确率由0.418升至0.636。
AI.conclusion: 提示精化可作为开发自适应技术教学的候选途径，但其对劳动力学习成效的影响仍待验证；小规模精化集、未经验证的情感参考及缺失学习者结果测量构成主要解释限制。

title: Efficient Memory-Constrained Video Object Segmentation via Subspace Optimization
summary: Memory-based architectures for video object segmentation (VOS) have achieved remarkable performance by maintaining dense feature representations from past frames in a streaming Memory Bank. However, storing these features over time incurs substantial memory overhead and computational cost. In this work, we identify significant temporal redundancy in memory representations, where consecutive frames exhibit highly overlapping low-rank subspaces that remain stable over time. Building on this observation, we propose Memory Subspace Iteration (MSI), a training-free, model-agnostic plugin that exploits temporal subspace stability to efficiently compress streaming memory features. Extensive experiments on standard VOS benchmarks demonstrate that MSI preserves segmentation accuracy across multiple architectures while reducing the memory bank footprint by up to 25%. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Hai-Anh-LE/MSI_WACV2027.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、模型无关的插件 MSI，利用视频中记忆特征的低秩子空间随时间稳定的特性压缩记忆库，在保持分割精度的同时将记忆占用降低最多 25%。
AI.motivation: 基于记忆的视频目标分割（VOS）架构依赖流式记忆库保存历史帧的稠密特征，随时间累积带来显著内存开销与计算成本，需要在不损失精度的前提下缓解该问题。
AI.method: 观察到记忆表示存在显著时间冗余：相邻帧呈现高度重叠且随时间稳定的低秩子空间；据此提出 Memory Subspace Iteration（MSI），一种免训练、模型无关的插件，利用子空间的时间稳定性对流式记忆特征进行高效压缩。
AI.result: 在标准 VOS 基准上的大量实验表明，MSI 在多种架构上均能保持分割精度，同时将记忆库占用降低最多 25%。
AI.conclusion: VOS 记忆特征具有可利用的子空间时间冗余，MSI 作为一种通用插件可即插即用地压缩记忆库，实现精度与效率的较优权衡。

title: AV-FLARE: Feature-Level Reliability Estimation for Multimodal Emotion Recognition
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 2027 IEEE Symposium Series on Computational Intelligence (IEEE SSCI 2027)
summary: Multimodal emotion recognition (MMER) systems typically rely on learned feature representations and attention mechanisms that implicitly weight information across time and modalities. However, these mechanisms do not explicitly incorporate input reliability, despite the presence of noise in audio, occlusions in visual data, and the sparse and event-driven nature of affective cues. We propose AV-FLARE, a framework that explicitly estimates fine-grained reliability scores across both temporal and feature dimensions prior to temporal modeling and uses them to modulate feature representations. Reliability is computed using two complementary components: (i) a supervised network trained jointly with the classification objective, and (ii) an unsupervised Gaussian Mixture Model that models global feature distributions. These signals are combined to provide both task-driven and distribution-aware reliability estimates. To integrate modalities, we introduce a hierarchical cross-modal attention mechanism in which textual features are used to guide audio-visual fusion as a semantic reference modality. Experiments on the IEMOCAP dataset show that AV-FLARE improves over a no-reliability baseline, achieving 90.81\% accuracy and 81.69\% F1-score, corresponding to gains of +4.41% and +8.56%, respectively. These results suggest that incorporating explicit input reliability estimation may improve robustness in multimodal emotion recognition under the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: 提出AV-FLARE框架，在时序建模前显式估计细粒度的时序与特征级可靠性分数并用于调制特征表示，结合监督网络与无监督GMM的可靠性估计及以文本为语义参考的分层跨模态注意力，在IEMOCAP上取得90.81%准确率与81.69% F1。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态情感识别依赖隐式注意力加权，未显式引入输入可靠性；而音频噪声、视觉遮挡及情感线索的稀疏/事件驱动特性使得可靠性建模非常必要。
AI.method: （1）可靠性估计：监督网络（与分类目标联合训练）提供任务驱动可靠性，无监督GMM建模全局特征分布提供分布感知可靠性，二者融合得到时序与特征维度的细粒度可靠性分数；（2）在时序建模前用可靠性分数调制特征表示；（3）分层跨模态注意力机制，以文本特征作为语义参考引导音视频融合。
AI.result: 在IEMOCAP数据集上优于无可靠性基线：准确率90.81%（+4.41%），F1为81.69%（+8.56%）。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入输入可靠性估计可在所评估设定下提升多模态情感识别的鲁棒性。

title: Occupancy Planar Patch: Incremental Probabilistic Bounded-Plane Reconstruction from LiDAR Data
summary: Online surface reconstruction from LiDAR scans requires observation models that respect the sensor's physical measurement geometry. Unlike unordered point sets, LiDAR returns carry anisotropic range noise along known rays, which also implicitly identify free space. We introduce the Occupancy Planar Patch (OPP), an incremental bounded planar patch representation that evaluates surface likelihoods and free space directly in range-space, allowing sensor noise, plane uncertainty, and ray clearance to be explicitly modelled during reconstruction. A single ray-to-patch association weight jointly updates plane geometry, refines surface boundaries, and blends camera imagery. The method is evaluated using six sequences from the Oxford Spires and Multi-Campus datasets. OPP achieves the highest precision and lowest reconstruction error among evaluated methods, while producing stored maps among the most compact. By conservatively admitting surfaces only where geometric evidence is certain, OPP prioritises structural precision over unconstrained completeness, which is well suited for architectural modelling. Geometric reconstruction operates in real time, requiring 81 ms per frame on a representative sequence, with texture projection adding 134 ms.

AI.tldr: 提出占位平面块（OPP）增量式有界平面块表示，在距离空间直接建模LiDAR各向异性噪声与自由空间，实现实时高精度在线表面重建并融合相机纹理。
AI.motivation: LiDAR扫描的在线表面重建需要符合传感器物理测量几何的观测模型。与无序点集不同，LiDAR回波沿已知射线带有各向异性距离噪声，并隐含标识自由空间；现有方法未能显式利用这一特性建模传感器噪声、平面不确定性与射线净空。
AI.method: 提出Occupancy Planar Patch（OPP）：一种增量式有界平面块表示，在距离空间（range-space）直接评估表面似然与自由空间，从而在重建过程中显式建模传感器噪声、平面不确定性与射线净空。以单一的射线-平面块关联权重联合更新平面几何、细化表面边界并融合相机影像。
AI.result: 在Oxford Spires与Multi-Campus数据集的六个序列上评估：OPP在所比较方法中取得最高精度与最低重建误差，同时生成的地图为最紧凑之列。几何重建可实时运行，代表性序列上每帧81 ms，纹理投影另需134 ms。
AI.conclusion: OPP仅在几何证据确定处保守地接纳表面，以结构精度优先于无约束完整性，适合建筑建模；在精度、地图紧凑性与实时性方面均表现优异。

title: GERF: A Token-Efficient Multimodal Retrieval Framework for Schema-Guided Scientific Information Extraction
summary: Scientific information extraction (IE) is a fundamental component of AI for Science, transforming experimental knowledge embedded in scientific literature into structured and traceable data for evidence synthesis, scientific database construction, and data-driven discovery. However, critical experimental details are often distributed across text, tables, figures, captions, and surrounding discussion, making them difficult to recover using conventional text-only extraction. Existing LLM-based and multimodal RAG pipelines typically rely on full-document context or coarse page-level retrieval, introducing substantial irrelevant evidence and high textual and visual token costs. We propose GERF, a Graph-based Evidence Retrieval Framework for token-efficient, schema-guided multimodal scientific IE. GERF represents each article as a heterogeneous evidence graph that connects schema fields, text chunks, figures, and figure-derived content through semantic and structural relations. Using schema fields as retrieval anchors, GERF combines direct semantic retrieval, Random Walk with Restart, and null-aware evidence expansion to construct compact, field-specific multimodal evidence packages. Visual interpretation is applied only to graph-selected figures, avoiding indiscriminate processing of the entire document. We evaluate GERF from two complementary perspectives: evidence retrieval quality and pipeline-level input-token consumption. On the expert-annotated SOFC-Exp corpus, GERF retrieves gold-supported evidence for 94.55% of the evaluated field instances, providing broad field-level evidence coverage for downstream extraction. In the token comparison, GERF reduces average input-token usage by 73.40% relative to full-context processing and uses fewer tokens than the evaluated page-level pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出图结构证据检索框架GERF，以模式字段为锚点构建异构证据图并结合RWR与零感知扩展，为科学文献多模态信息抽取提供紧凑的字段级证据包，在SOFC-Exp上实现94.55%的金标证据覆盖率，并把输入token消耗相比全文上下文降低73.40%。
AI.motivation: 科学文献中的关键实验细节分散于正文、表格、图、图注与讨论，纯文本抽取难以恢复；现有基于LLM与多模态RAG的流水线依赖全文上下文或粗粒度页面级检索，引入大量无关证据并带来高昂的文本与视觉token成本。
AI.method: GERF将每篇文章表示为异构证据图，节点包含模式字段、文本块、图及其派生内容，边为语义与结构关系；以模式字段作为检索锚点，融合直接语义检索、随机游走重启（RWR）与零感知证据扩展，构建紧凑的字段特定多模态证据包；视觉解读仅作用于图选中的图像，避免对全文档的盲目处理。
AI.result: 从证据检索质量与流水线级输入token消耗两方面评估：在专家标注的SOFC-Exp语料上，GERF为94.55%的待评估字段实例检索到金标支撑证据；token对比中，输入token平均用量较全文上下文处理减少73.40%，且低于所评估的页面级流水线。
AI.conclusion: 以模式字段为锚点的图结构证据检索可在保证字段级证据覆盖的同时显著压缩多模态输入成本，为面向科学文献的可溯源、token高效信息抽取提供了可行路径。

title: Shallow may be better: Physics-Constrained Lightweight Networks for High-Throughput Particle Image Velocimetry
summary: Convolutional networks for optical flow typically adopt progressively deeper pyramidal encoders under the assumption that larger receptive fields improve motion estimation. For particle image velocimetry (PIV), however, tracer-particle displacement between frames is bounded by the acquisition geometry, allowing network depth to be derived from the physically admissible displacement rather than inherited from general-purpose architectures. Using a layer-by-layer analysis of spatial-support growth, we derive its explicit upper bound and show that deeper architectures substantially exceed the support required for PIV, compromising training stability, spatial resolution under particle loss, and inference efficiency. Based on this analysis, we develop LIMA3, a lightweight pyramidal displacement estimator with 589,000 trainable parameters. Across synthetic and experimental benchmarks, LIMA3 matches the accuracy of established learned and classical methods with at least an order of magnitude less memory and substantially higher throughput, while retaining the physically expected coarsening of spatial resolution as tracer information is lost. Its linear memory scaling enables megapixel processing within embedded memory budgets, such that LIMA3 can reach over 900 image pairs per second at $640\times480$~pixel on an RTX 5090 and 99 image pairs per second on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. The spatial-support analysis provides a transferable design principle for compact optical-flow architectures and bounded-window attention, offering an alternative to compressing oversized general-purpose networks and enabling efficient operation alongside image acquisition.

AI.tldr: 针对PIV任务，从物理可容许位移推导网络感受野上界，提出仅58.9万参数的轻量金字塔位移估计器LIMA3。
AI.motivation: 光流卷积网络普遍继承通用架构、逐层加深金字塔编码器以求大感受野；但PIV中示踪粒子帧间位移受采集几何约束而有明确上限，过深架构的感受野远超实际需求，损害训练稳定性、粒子丢失下的空间分辨率与推理效率。
AI.method: 对空间支撑（感受野）逐层增长进行解析分析，给出其显式上界，并据此由物理可容许位移反推所需网络深度；基于该分析设计LIMA3——轻量金字塔位移估计器，589,000可训练参数，线性内存扩展。
AI.result: 在合成与实验基准上，LIMA3以至少低一个数量级的内存和显著更高吞吐达到已有学习型与经典方法的精度，并保留随示踪信息丢失的物理预期空间分辨率粗化；RTX 5090上640×480像素超900 对/秒，Jetson AGX Orin上99 对/秒，可在嵌入式内存预算内处理百万像素图像。
AI.conclusion: 空间支撑分析为紧凑光流架构和有界窗口注意力提供可迁移的设计原则，是压缩超大通用网络之外的替代路径，可支持与图像采集同步的高效运行。

title: TabK: Amortized Bayesian Estimation of the Number of Clusters in Tabular Data
summary: Estimating the number of clusters, $k$, is a fundamental prerequisite for most clustering algorithms. Traditionally, this estimation has relied on computationally expensive grid searches over internal cluster validity indices (CVIs) or adaptive clustering algorithms, both constrained by specific statistical assumptions. We introduce TabK, a zero-shot, permutation-invariant transformer architecture that frames the estimation of $k$ as an amortized Bayesian inference problem for tabular data. TabK leverages a novel Quantile Feature Encoder (QFE) to extract position-free, content-derived representations from empirical marginal distributions. By learning a generalized structural bias over a diverse synthetic prior, TabK estimates the number of clusters in a single forward pass per ensemble member. Evaluated across 50 diverse real-world benchmarks, TabK outperforms all competing methods, achieving a mean absolute error (MAE) value of 1.04 compared to 2.14 for the closest competitor. TabK also achieves the lowest average inference time, producing estimates in less than one second on average and running $2\times$ faster than TabClustPFN and $30\times$ faster than traditional CVIs such as Silhouette and Calinski-Harabasz. Code is available at https://github.com/mrbakhtyari/TabK.

AI.tldr: TabK 是一种零样本、置换不变的 Transformer 架构，将表格数据聚类数 k 的估计建模为摊销贝叶斯推断问题，借助分位数特征编码器提取与位置无关的表示，单次前向传播即可给出估计，在 50 个真实基准上 MAE 为 1.04（次优方法为 2.14），平均推理时间不足 1 秒。
AI.motivation: 估计聚类数 k 是多数聚类算法的前提，但传统方法依赖对内部聚类有效性指标（CVI）的网格搜索或自适应聚类算法，计算代价高，且受特定统计假设约束，缺乏通用性与效率。
AI.method: 提出 TabK：零样本、置换不变的 Transformer 架构，把 k 的估计转化为针对表格数据的摊销贝叶斯推断。其核心是新颖的分位数特征编码器（QFE），从经验边缘分布中提取与位置无关、由数据内容导出的表示；并在多样化合成先验上学习广义结构偏差，使每个集成成员经单次前向传播即可输出 k 的估计。
AI.result: 在 50 个多样化真实基准上，TabK 优于所有对比方法，MAE 为 1.04，最接近的竞争者（TabClustPFN）为 2.14；同时平均推理时间最短，平均不足 1 秒，比 TabClustPFN 快 2 倍，比 Silhouette、Calinski-Harabasz 等传统 CVI 快约 30 倍。
AI.conclusion: TabK 表明以摊销贝叶斯推断结合置换不变 Transformer 与分位数特征编码，可在无需针对具体数据集调参的前提下，实现高精度、低延迟的聚类数估计，为表格聚类提供了高效且通用的替代方案。

title: ScaleEvals: Scaling Generalist Policy Evaluation through Reset-Free Autonomous Play
summary: Real-world evaluation of generalist robot policies is bottlenecked by manual resets, human grading, and small fixed task suites with limited diagnostic coverage. We present ScaleEvals, a scalable reset-free protocol that evaluates policies through continuous physical play across a robot fleet. A VLM AutoPrompter generates scene-grounded tasks with difficulty estimates, language prompts, and skill tags, enabling performance analysis across diverse rollouts. A VLM AutoGrader assesses task progress, achieving 90.7% agreement with human graders. Scores are aggregated via a soft-win Bradley-Terry model, while tag-stratified ANOVA provides interpretable capability diagnostics. Across 3,000+ physical autonomous rollouts on DROID and YAM, ScaleEvals achieves 23.0 net rollouts/hr per station while reducing active human labor by 98%. By ranking five SOTA generalist policies, ScaleEvals correlates with held-out manual evaluation ranking on DROID (r=0.94, rho=0.90, p=0.018), and remains internally consistent on a second embodiment, YAM (r=0.839, rho=0.80). Beyond aggregate rankings, we observe behavioral compositionality: recombining verb-, skill-, and object-conditioned evidence predicts policy order on unseen prompts. Across 10 tasks and 240 prospective physical rollouts, we recover three-policy orderings of 96% pairwise concordance, demonstrating ScaleEvals can predict not just which policy leads, but where rankings reverse.

AI.tldr: 提出 ScaleEvals：一种可扩展、免人工重置的评测协议，通过机器人群体的连续物理"玩耍"数据流评测通用机器人策略，用 VLM 自动生成任务与自动评分，并结合软胜 Bradley-Terry 聚合与标签分层 ANOVA 诊断，在 3000+ 真实 rollout 上大幅降低人力并与人工评测高度一致。
AI.motivation: 真实世界评测通用机器人策略受制于三大人为瓶颈：需人工重置场景、人工打分、任务集固定且规模小、诊断覆盖不足，导致评测成本高、可扩展性差、难以刻画策略能力构成。
AI.method: 1) 免重置协议：在 DROID 与 YAM 机队上开展连续自主物理交互（play），避免人工重置；2) VLM AutoPrompter 生成场景接地任务，附难度估计、语言指令与技能标签；3) VLM AutoGrader 判定任务进度；4) 用软胜 Bradley-Terry 模型聚合得分，用标签分层 ANOVA 做能力诊断；5) 通过动词/技能/物体条件证据的重组预测未见提示下的策略排序。
AI.result: 每站每小时净完成 23.0 次自主 rollout，主动人力减少 98%；AutoGrader 与人工评分一致率 90.7%；对 5 个 SOTA 通用策略排序与 DROID 上留出人工评测排名高度相关（r=0.94, rho=0.90, p=0.018），在 YAM 上内部一致（r=0.839, rho=0.80）；在 10 个任务、240 次前瞻性物理 rollout 上，三策略排序的成对一致性达 96%。
AI.conclusion: ScaleEvals 将真实世界策略评测从"人工密集型、固定小任务集"转变为可扩展、自动化的连续评测流程，不仅能复现聚合排名，还能预测排名在何处发生反转，为通用机器人策略提供细粒度、可解释的能力诊断。

title: INSEP: Refusal-Direction Inseparability as a Defense Against Abliteration
summary: Abliteration is a widely used white-box attack against the safety alignment of large language models (LLMs). It elicits harmful behavior by estimating a refusal direction in the model's activation space and projecting that direction out of the residual-stream write-out matrices. We propose INSEP, a defense that fine-tunes the model to reduce the separability of harmful and benign activations along the refusal direction. Abliteration estimates this direction as a difference in class means and projects it out. Reducing separability weakens the signal the attack relies on. An adversarial eigendecomposition selects the most separable prompt subsets. A low-rank adapter reduces their separation along that direction. Behavioral losses preserve the base model's refusal and the quality of its benign responses during training. We benchmark INSEP against six published defenses under five attacks, across eight LLMs from 1B to 14B parameters and several model families. Beyond response harm, we measure coherence, directness, over-refusal, and MMLU, to distinguish robust refusal from low harm produced by evasive or degraded responses. INSEP ranks first on the mean composite score across all eight base models while retaining utility, in the largest abliteration-defense evaluation reported to date.

AI.tldr: 本文提出INSEP防御方法，通过微调降低有害与良性激活在"拒绝方向"上的可分性，从而削弱abliteration（消融式白盒攻击）所依赖的信号，在迄今规模最大的评测中排名第一。
AI.motivation: Abliteration是一种广泛使用的白盒攻击：它在模型激活空间中估计"拒绝方向"（refusal direction），并将其从残差流的写出矩阵中投影剔除，从而诱发有害行为。现有防御缺乏针对该攻击的有效手段，因此需要设计能削弱攻击所依赖信号的防御。
AI.method: INSEP的核心是降低有害与良性激活沿拒绝方向的可分性：1）用对抗性特征分解（eigendecomposition）选取可分性最强的提示子集；2）用低秩适配器（LoRA）降低这些子集沿该方向的分离度；3）配合行为损失，在训练中保持基座模型的拒答能力和良性响应质量。由于abliteration以类均值差估计方向并投影剔除，降低可分性直接弱化了该攻击的信源。
AI.result: 在8个1B–14B参数、多模型家族的LLM上，对6种已发表防御和5种攻击进行基准评测。除响应危害度外，还测量连贯性、直接性、过度拒答和MMLU，以区分"稳健拒答"与"因回避或退化回答导致的低危害"。INSEP在全部8个基座模型的平均综合得分上排名第一，同时保持实用性。
AI.conclusion: INSEP通过降低拒绝方向上的激活可分性，有效抵御abliteration攻击，并在保持模型效用的前提下取得最优综合表现，构成目前规模最大的abliteration防御评测结果。

title: Every IVUS Frame in Its Place: A Zero-Install Browser Tool for Registering Intravascular Ultrasound to the Coronary Angiogram, and a Path to Angiography-Only Plaque Imaging
comment: 19 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables. Live tool with one-click demo: https://menonpg.github.io/ivus-xa-registration/?demo
summary: Intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) shows plaque composition, calcium and stent apposition that the coronary angiogram cannot, but relating each IVUS cross-section to its position on the angiogram is still largely done in the operator's head. Commercial co-registration is tied to vendor consoles and to set-up at acquisition, so archived angiograms and pullbacks cannot be co-registered, and paired data for training AI models remain scarce. We present a semi-automatic registration tool that runs entirely in a web browser, with no installation and no upload. The clinician picks a contrast-filled reference frame (aided by automatic contrast and cardiac-phase analysis), selects or traces the vessel centerline (aided by Frangi vesselness and minimal paths), and pins the pullback ends and visible landmarks; a monotone piecewise-linear map then places every IVUS frame on the vessel, and each case exports as a frame-level training record. The original Python analysis runs unchanged in WebAssembly and videos are decoded frame-accurately with WebCodecs. On 6 angiographic runs the in-browser analysis was bit-identical to the server pipeline on identical frames; browser decoding differed by at most 2 grey levels, suggested reference frames agreed in all runs and the default automatic centerline in 4 of 6. A 546-frame pullback decoded in 5.3 s. On 36 phantoms with known ground truth, the clinician-guided trace stayed inside the lumen along 87-99% of the vessel, whereas the fully automatic centerline fell from 83% to 0% as noise rose and contrast fell. In a registered Left Main case, one side-branch landmark moved mid-pullback positions by 17.5% of the segment. We map where AI can enter each step, up to predicting a virtual IVUS from the angiogram alone, and make the tool freely available online with a one-click demo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个完全运行于浏览器、无需安装与上传的半自动IVUS-冠脉造影配准工具。临床医生选取参考帧、血管中心线与回撤端点/标志点，经单调分段线性映射将每帧IVUS定位到血管并导出逐帧训练记录。原始Python分析在WebAssembly中逐位一致运行，视频经WebCodecs帧精确解码；6例造影中浏览器与服务器结果逐位相同，解码灰度差异≤2，546帧5.3秒完成；36个体模中引导描迹87-99%位于管腔内，而全自动中心线随噪声升高从83%降至0%。
AI.motivation: IVUS可提供造影无法显示的斑块成分、钙化与支架贴壁信息，但将每帧IVUS横截面与其在造影上的位置对应仍主要依赖术者心算。商用配准系统绑定于厂商控制台且需在采集时设置，因而归档造影与回撤数据无法配准，AI训练所需的配对数据也长期稀缺。
AI.method: 设计浏览器端零安装、零上传的半自动配准流程：（1）自动对比度与心动周期分析辅助选定造影参考帧；（2）Frangi血管增强与最小路径算法辅助中心线选取或描迹；（3）手工钉选回撤两端及可见标志点，构建单调分段线性映射将全部IVUS帧放置于血管上；（4）每例导出帧级训练记录。原Python分析以WebAssembly原样运行，视频用WebCodecs帧精确解码。
AI.result: 6例造影中浏览器分析与服务器流水线在相同帧上逐位一致；浏览器解码灰度差异最大2级；推荐参考帧在全部6例中一致，默认自动中心线在4/6例中一致。546帧回撤解码耗时5.3秒。36个已知真值体模中，临床引导描迹在87-99%的血管长度上保持于管腔内，而全自动中心线随噪声升高、对比度下降由83%跌至0%。一例左主干配准中，单个边支标志点使回撤中段位置偏移达该节段的17.5%。
AI.conclusion: 该工具证明高性能IVUS-造影配准可完全在浏览器内实现且保持与服务器端一致的数值保真度，人工引导的中心线在噪声与低对比条件下显著优于全自动方法，标志点选择对映射精度影响不可忽视。作者进一步梳理了AI在各处理环节的介入点，直至仅凭造影预测虚拟IVUS，并在线免费开放工具与一键演示，以促进配对训练数据的规模化生成。

title: Which Loans, Not How Many: Exactly Level-Invariant, Anytime-Valid Monitoring of Deployed Risk Models
summary: A refinancing wave can change the number of mortgage prepayments without changing the relationship between scores and prepayment. In a logistic model, conditioning on the monthly count removes the intercept from the likelihood of which loans prepay. Our fixed-start slope product tests a lower bound on the calibration slope. At threshold 20 its probability of ever crossing under the null is at most 5%. The restarted level sum tracks departures from intercept tolerance. A confidence sequence estimates a constant slope, and the restart-intersection rule detects changes in that slope. A continuous mixture avoids the off-grid width floor of a discrete prior. On Freddie Mac loans, fixed-slope resampling reproduces 78% of maintained-model monthly AUC variance in development and 70% in the holdout (95% intervals 57-100% and 48-100%). From fresh holdout starts, the restarted level sum crosses on both paths, and the fixed-start slope product stays below threshold on both. The restart-intersection rule signals a downward change for the frozen model in April 2018 and an upward change for the maintained model in a supplementary run in August 2019.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一套在再融资浪潮下检验抵押贷款评分-提前还款关系是否稳定的统计方法：条件于月度计数消去截距，构造固定起点斜率积检验与重启水平和控制漂移，并用连续混合先验的置信序列与重启-交集规则检测斜率变化。
AI.motivation: 再融资浪潮会改变提前还款数量而不改变评分与提前还款之间的斜率关系，因此需要把"数量（截距）变化"与"关系（斜率）变化"分离，现有离散先验还存在离网格宽度下限问题，难以同时监控截距容差与斜率稳定性。
AI.method: 在logistic模型中条件于每月计数，使似然不含截距；(1) 固定起点斜率积（fixed-start slope product）检验斜率标定下界，阈值20下原假设下曾越界概率≤5%；(2) 重启水平和控制（restarted level sum）追踪截距容差的偏离；(3) 用置信序列估计常数斜率，并以重启-交集规则（restart-intersection rule）检测斜率变化；(4) 采用连续混合先验避免离散先验的离网格宽度下限。应用于Freddie Mac贷款数据，并用固定斜率重抽样分解月AUC方差。
AI.result: 固定斜率重抽样可复现维持模型月AUC方差的78%（开发集，95%区间57-100%）与70%（留出集，48-100%）。在全新留出切点上，两条路径的重启水平和控制均越界，而固定起点斜率积均低于阈值。重启-交集规则对冻结模型在2018年4月给出向下变化信号，对维持模型在2019年8月补充运行中给出向上变化信号。
AI.conclusion: 提前还款数量波动主要由不变的评分-提前还款斜率结构解释；该方法能在再融资浪潮中分别监控截距漂移与斜率变化，但冻结模型与维持模型的斜率变化时点不同，提示模型维护本身会影响监控结论。

title: Belief-Driven Quantum Magnetometer Control for GPS-Denied Navigation
summary: Autonomous vehicles increasingly need to navigate without satellite positioning. Magnetic anomaly navigation (Mag-Nav) with quantum magnetometers offers a passive, unjammable fix, but the low size-weight-and-power (SWaP) sensors that small drones can carry are weak, and they are operated open loop at a fixed setting. Interferometric (Ramsey) magnetometers face a trade-off: long interrogation times are more sensitive but become ambiguous when the expected field is uncertain. The navigator's own position belief, pushed through the anomaly map, predicts that field. We close this loop. The filter's predictive field distribution sets the Ramsey phase and interrogation time at every epoch, through a closed-form rule that moves between an ambiguity limit and a decoherence limit. We evaluate it on real U.S. Air Force flight data (real tracks, inertial drift, measured fields, and a survey map tested 18 months after it was flown), with only the Ramsey sensor modelled. Against fixed-setting baselines, 63 of 72 independent flight windows favour belief driven sensing ($p = 2 \times 10^{-11}$). Error falls by 20-27% for low-SNR sensors and 30-44% for mid-contrast sensors. An ablation separates the two ingredients. Phase alignment drives the gain in steady flight, and the rule matches the best fixed setting without the hindsight tuning that setting requires. After a lost start, interrogation time adaptation is essential, cutting median error by 37-42% even against hindsight-tuned phase-aligned settings. Gains are small for high-quality sensors with accurate maps. On an IBM superconducting qubit, the rule's interrogation time stays within $1.3\times$ of the empirical optimum. Coupled with information-aware routing, belief-driven sensing lowers mission error by 15-40%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"信念驱动感知"闭环方法：用滤波器预测的地场分布在线设定Ramsey干涉磁力仪的相位与询问时间，在真实空军飞行数据上显著优于固定参数基线。
AI.motivation: 小型无人机搭载的低SWaP量子磁力仪信号弱且以固定参数开环运行；干涉式磁力仪存在"长询问时间高灵敏但存在相位模糊、短询问时间无模糊但灵敏度低"的固有权衡，缺乏根据导航不确定性自适应调参的机制。
AI.method: 将导航滤波器的位置信念经磁异常图映射为预测场分布，据此以闭式规则在"模糊极限"与"退相干极限"之间选择Ramsey相位与询问时间，实现感知—导航闭环；并在真实USAF飞行数据（真实轨迹、惯导漂移、实测场与18个月后实测航图）上仅对Ramsey传感器建模评估，配以消融实验与IBM超导量子比特验证。
AI.result: 72个独立飞行窗口中有63个偏好信念驱动感知（p=2×10⁻¹¹）；低信噪比传感器误差降低20–27%，中等对比度降低30–44%；稳态飞行增益主要来自相位对齐，且无需事后调参即可匹配最佳固定设置；丢失初始对准后询问时间自适应使中位误差再降37–42%；高质量传感器与精确航图下增益较小；IBM量子比特上询问时间在经验最优的1.3倍以内；结合信息感知路径规划可将任务误差降低15–40%。
AI.conclusion: 利用导航信念闭环控制量子磁力仪参数，可低成本提升磁异常导航精度与鲁棒性，尤其适用于低信噪比与丢失对准场景，并与路径规划协同增益。

title: Selection Policies for Equal-Byte Mixed-Precision Quantization of Small Language Models
summary: Can changing which matrices receive 2, 4, or 8 bits improve a small language model without increasing its parameter storage? I compare two parent-selection rules in the same genetic algorithm: a binary-tournament variant and an Alternis-inspired rule. A separate baseline samples repaired random allocations without crossover or mutation. All three use the same MLX affine quantizer, byte ceiling, initialization and candidate allowance within each study. An exploratory study on Qwen3.5-2B evaluates 90 allocations per run. The main study on Qwen3-1.7B evaluates 500 distinct allocations per run over 10 paired seeds. Against uniform four-bit, tournament reduces held-out next-token negative log-likelihood (NLL) by 0.0616 on AG News and 0.0152 on IMDb on average, improving all 10 seeds on each corpus at identical parameter storage. Alternis improves five seeds and ties five on AG News; on IMDb its mean gain is near zero. Random returns uniform four-bit in every seed. The tournament representative answers 156 of 400 ARC-Challenge questions correctly versus 163 for uniform; no accuracy gain is demonstrated on this subset. The result favors this tournament variant for text prediction under the tested protocol, not for compression ratio or task accuracy.

AI.tldr: 在参数存储不变的前提下，用遗传算法（二进制锦标赛选择）重新分配2/4/8比特量化矩阵，可使Qwen3-1.7B在AG News与IMDb上的留出NLL显著下降，但ARC-Challenge准确率未提升。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型在固定参数量/存储预算下，混合精度比特分配方案（哪些矩阵用2/4/8比特）通常采用均匀四比特，可能存在更优的非均匀分配。本文检验：在不增加参数存储的条件下，改变比特分配能否改善模型表现，并比较不同父代选择规则的搜索效果。
AI.method: 同一遗传算法框架下比较两种父代选择规则：二进制锦标赛（binary tournament）与受Alternis启发的规则；另设基线仅采样经修复的随机分配（无交叉、变异）。三者共用同一MLX仿射量化器、字节上限、初始化与候选配额。探索性研究：Qwen3.5-2B，每次运行评估90个分配；主研究：Qwen3-1.7B，每次运行500个不同分配，10组配对随机种子。评估指标为留出下一词NLL（AG News、IMDb）及ARC-Challenge准确率，对照基准为均匀四比特。
AI.result: 相对均匀四比特，锦标赛法在相同参数存储下平均降低NLL：AG News 0.0616、IMDb 0.0152，且两个语料的全部10个种子均改善。Alternis规则在AG News上5个种子改善、5个持平；在IMDb上平均增益接近零。随机基线在所有种子中均退回均匀四比特水平。ARC-Challenge上锦标赛代表方案答对156/400，均匀四比特为163/400，未显示准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 在该实验协议下，二进制锦标赛式的比特分配搜索对文本预测（NLL）有效，但对压缩比与下游任务准确率无收益；结论限定于测试协议与指标范围，锦标赛变体值得作为语言建模损失优化的方案，而非通用精度提升手段。

title: Teacher-Guided Multimodal Dual Representation Reconstruction for Egocentric Human Activity Recognition
summary: Multimodal Egocentric Human Activity Recognition (Ego-HAR) leverages complementary cues from first-person vision (V) and inertial sensor data (S) to recognize daily activities, where video mainly captures appearance and object-related context while inertial signals capture motion cues that video may miss. However, existing pre-training methods typically supervise the fused representation with a single joint objective, which may underemphasize the complementarity between the two modalities and limit the model's ability to learn from distinct modality-oriented signals. To address this issue, we propose Multimodal Dual Representation Reconstruction (MDR2), a teacher-guided pre-training framework in which frozen, label-informed video and inertial teachers each provide dense, modality-specific targets to a multimodal student trained on temporally sparse inputs. On the EvIs-Kitchen dataset, MDR2 improves noun/verb F1-macro over the supervised M-Baseline by 9.20/6.17 points at K=4 video key frames and by 1.21/1.82 points at K=32. These results show that MDR2 consistently achieves higher mean recognition performance across the evaluated video-observation settings under the unified backbone setting, with more pronounced gains under sparse inputs.

AI.tldr: 提出教师引导的多模态双表征重建预训练框架 MDR2，让冻结的视频教师与惯性教师分别提供模态专属稠密目标，改善第一人称多模态动作识别中两模态互补性的学习。
AI.motivation: 现有 Ego-HAR 预训练方法通常用单一联合目标监督融合表征，容易低估视频（外观/物体上下文）与惯性（运动线索）之间的互补性，限制了模型从不同模态导向信号中学习的能力。
AI.method: MDR2 为教师引导的预训练框架：使用冻结的、标签知情的视频教师和惯性教师，各自输出稠密、模态专属的重建目标；多模态学生模型在时间稀疏输入上训练，分别向两个教师的目标对齐，从而获得双表征重建监督。
AI.result: 在 EvIs-Kitchen 数据集上，K=4 关键帧时名词/动词 F1-macro 较监督 M-Baseline 提升 9.20/6.17 点；K=32 时提升 1.21/1.82 点。统一骨干设置下各视频观测配置的平均识别性能均更高，稀疏输入下增益更明显。
AI.conclusion: 以模态专属稠密目标替代单一联合监督能更有效利用视频与惯性的互补信息，MDR2 在稀疏观测条件下尤为有效，为 Ego-HAR 预训练提供了可行方向。

title: Toward Adversarially Robust World Models
summary: Latent dynamic world models have proven to be highly versatile tools for embodied artificial intelligence systems, enabling online action planning, safe policy evaluation, and scalable policy learning. However, this versatility makes world models a vulnerable and centralized point of failure as a compromised model can impact planning, evaluation, and training at once. Therefore it is critical that the security and robustness properties of world models are properly understood before they are universally deployed in embodied AI systems. In this work we take a unifying approach towards this understanding, developing two novel attacks against world models, named state hallucination and dynamic shift attacks, aimed directly at impacting downstream systems, and proposing a new theoretical lens through which to study the robustness of latent dynamic world models. Through our analysis we identify robust latent space encoders as the key component of robust world models. We empirically validate this finding on four separate latent dynamic world model families, studying Dino World Model, Le World Model, r2Dreamer, and Cosmos 3, demonstrating significant improvements in robustness through adversarial encoder model training.

AI.tldr: 本文针对具身智能中潜在动态世界模型的安全脆弱性展开研究，提出"状态幻觉"和"动态漂移"两种新型攻击，并给出一个分析世界模型鲁棒性的理论视角，指出鲁棒的潜在空间编码器是鲁棒世界模型的关键，并在四个模型家族上通过对抗式编码器训练验证了该结论。
AI.motivation: 潜在动态世界模型在具身AI中被广泛用于在线动作规划、策略评估与可扩展策略学习，这种多用途性使其成为集中的单点故障：一旦模型被攻破，规划、评估与训练会同时受损。因此在其大规模部署前，必须先厘清其安全性与鲁棒性性质，而现有工作缺乏统一的理解框架。
AI.method: 采用统一研究路径：1）设计两种直接作用于下游系统的新攻击——状态幻觉攻击（state hallucination）与动态漂移攻击（dynamic shift）；2）提出新的理论视角来分析潜在动态世界模型的鲁棒性，并据此定位鲁棒性的关键组件；3）以对抗式编码器训练作为防御手段进行实证验证。
AI.result: 理论分析表明潜在空间编码器是世界模型鲁棒性的关键环节；在Dino World Model、Le World Model、r2Dreamer与Cosmos 3四个潜在动态世界模型家族上的实验显示，经过对抗式编码器训练后模型鲁棒性获得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型的鲁棒性可归结为编码器层面的鲁棒性，针对编码器的对抗训练是提升潜在动态世界模型安全性的有效途径，为具身AI系统中世界模型的安全部署提供了统一的分析框架与实用防御方向。

title: LoKiTO: Local Kinodynamic Trajectory Optimization for UAVs based on Memory-Efficient Neural Distance Fields
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, submitted to IEEE RA-L (under review)
summary: This paper introduces LoKiTO, a 3D local kinodynamic trajectory optimizer that combines a Chebyshev polynomial parameterization with an online neural Euclidean Signed Distance Field (ESDF) representation for aerial robotics. While current gradient-based planners often struggle with the high memory requirements of explicit volumetric maps or fail to strictly enforce dynamic limits, LoKiTO embeds kinodynamic constraints directly into a modular cost function and exploits the numerical conditioning properties of the Chebyshev basis. Collision awareness is provided by a continuous, memory-efficient neural ESDF updated online from LiDAR measurements, which drastically reduces map memory consumption to approximately 1.0 MB. Benchmarking in highly cluttered simulated environments against state-of-the-art baselines (Fast-Planner and EGO-Planner) demonstrates the superiority of our approach. Experimental results show that LoKiTO achieves over 99.4% dynamic feasibility compliance, significantly outperforming the baselines, and maintaining higher median clearance from obstacles. By coupling a well-conditioned continuous parameterization with explicit kinodynamic reasoning, LoKiTO provides a practical and extensible basis for local replanning in aerial robotics.

AI.tldr: LoKiTO 是一种面向空中机器人的三维局部动力学轨迹优化器，将 Chebyshev 多项式参数化与在线神经 ESDF 结合，显式嵌入动力学约束并以低内存实现高可行性与更大避障余量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于梯度的规划器存在两点不足：显式体素地图内存开销大；难以严格满足动力学限制。因此需要一种兼顾内存效率与动力学可行性的局部重规划方法。
AI.method: 采用 Chebyshev 多项式参数化以利用其良好数值条件；将动力学可行性约束直接嵌入模块化代价函数；用由 LiDAR 测量在线更新的连续神经 ESDF 提供碰撞感知，地图内存降至约 1.0 MB。
AI.result: 在高杂乱度仿真环境中与 Fast-Planner、EGO-Planner 对比，动力学可行性合规率超过 99.4%，显著优于基线，并保持更高的中位障碍物余量。
AI.conclusion: 将良态连续参数化与显式动力学推理相结合，为空中机器人局部重规划提供了实用且可扩展的基础框架。

title: MatHarness: Towards Long-Horizon Open-ended AutoResearch for Computational Materials Science
summary: Materials science research is a non-linear, long-horizon process. Existing scientific agents, however, largely rely on specific task execution or predefined workflows, rendering them brittle in open-ended settings. To bridge this gap, we present MatHarness, an agent harness designed for open-ended, long-horizon computational materials research spanning the complete lifecycle from initial ideation to manuscript writing. MatHarness couples three mechanisms: execution robustness through pre-flight verification, expert-distilled skills, and just-in-time auditing; epistemic adaptability through persistent research artifacts and an evolving scientific mental model; and collective intelligence through a heterogeneous multi-agent round table under targeted human oversight. We evaluate MatHarness on adsorbate-induced surface segregation in Cu-Zn alloys, an open question in methanol-synthesis catalysis. Over a multi-week trajectory consuming roughly 10^3 GPU-hours (50 production DFT relaxations prescreened by 171 machine-learning-potential evaluations) the system revised its plan six times, recovered autonomously from failed calculations, and had an independent auditor overturn one of its own over-attributed claims before publication. Within the sampled metallic dilute-limit models, the validated DFT analysis supports an adsorbate-induced tendency toward greater surface Cu exposure at both composition endpoints, with facet- and coverage-dependent exceptions. These results were compiled into a complete manuscript with human involvement concentrated in specification, approval, and strategic steering gates. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/PrentisAI/pippin.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MatHarness——一个面向开放式、长周期计算材料研究的智能体框架（agent harness），覆盖从科学构想到论文撰写的全生命周期，并在 Cu-Zn 合金吸附质诱导表面偏析这一开放问题上完成了数周量级、约 10^3 GPU 小时的端到端研究并产出完整手稿。
AI.motivation: 材料科学研究本质上是非线性、长周期的过程，而现有科学智能体多依赖特定任务执行或预定义工作流，在开放式研究场景中脆弱、泛化性差。作者希望弥补这一"开放式长周期科研自主性"的空白。
AI.method: MatHarness 耦合三类机制：(1) 执行鲁棒性——飞行前验证（pre-flight verification）、专家蒸馏技能、即时审计（just-in-time auditing）；(2) 认知适应性——持久化研究工件与演化的"科学心智模型"；(3) 集体智能——异构多智能体圆桌讨论，配合有针对性的人类监督。实验任务为 Cu-Zn 合金中吸附质诱导的表面偏析（甲醇合成催化中的开放问题），全程约 10^3 GPU 小时，含 171 次机器学习势评估预筛后得到 50 次生产级 DFT 结构弛豫。
AI.result: 在多周轨迹中，系统自主修订计划 6 次，从失败计算中自动恢复，且独立审计器在发表前推翻了其自身一项过度归因的结论。在采样的金属稀限模型内，经验证的 DFT 分析支持在两个成分端点处存在吸附质诱导的表面 Cu 富集倾向，但存在晶面与覆盖度依赖的例外。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，通过执行鲁棒性、认知适应性与多智能体集体智能的组合，智能体可在开放式材料科学问题上实现长周期自主研究，人类参与集中于规格设定、审批与战略引导等关键闸口；成果汇编为完整手稿，代码已开源。

title: When Recognition Meets Discovery: Learning Need Not Be Entangled in One Representation Space
summary: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to recognize known classes while discovering novel categories from unlabeled data containing both old and novel samples. Existing methods typically optimize recognition and discovery within a shared representation space, implicitly assuming that the same representation geometry can serve both objectives. Through controlled spectral analysis, we uncover a striking asymmetry: old-class discrimination is increasingly concentrated in the dominant singular directions, while novel-class structure is better preserved in the complementary residual space. More importantly, strengthening the former can even degrade the latter, revealing that recognition and discovery compete for representation capacity rather than merely for optimization weight. Motivated by this observation, we propose Dual-Space Spectral Routing, which dynamically decomposes the representation via online SVD and routes supervised recognition and unsupervised discovery to complementary discriminative and general subspaces. We further exploit their distinct responses to old and novel samples to construct a dual-space novelty signal, which guides Subspace Relation Aggregation (SRA) for organizing candidate novel categories. Extensive experiments across multiple GCD baselines, backbones, and benchmarks demonstrate a consistently improved recognition-discovery balance without introducing additional inference parameters. Code will be open source.

AI.tldr: 本文通过谱分析发现GCD中"识别"与"发现"争夺表征容量并呈互补子空间分布，据此提出双空间谱路由（Dual-Space Spectral Routing），将监督识别与无监督发现分别路由到判别子空间与一般子空间，并构建双空间新颖性信号指导子空间关系聚合（SRA）组织新类候选。
AI.motivation: 现有GCD方法在共享表征空间中同时优化识别与发现，隐含假设同一表征几何可服务两种目标。作者的受控谱分析揭示显著不对称性：旧类判别信息集中于主导奇异方向，新类结构更多保留在互补残差空间；且强化前者会损害后者，说明二者是在争夺表征容量而非仅争夺优化权重。
AI.method: 提出Dual-Space Spectral Routing：通过在线SVD动态分解表征，将监督识别路由至判别子空间、无监督发现路由至一般子空间；利用两空间对旧类/新类样本的不同响应构造双空间新颖性信号，指导Subspace Relation Aggregation（SRA）组织候选新类。
AI.result: 在多个GCD基线、骨干网络与基准数据集上的大量实验表明，识别—发现平衡得到一致提升，且不引入额外推理参数。
AI.conclusion: 识别与发现的表征容量竞争可通过子空间分解与路由加以解耦，双空间谱路由是一种通用、即插即用且推理零开销的GCD改进方案。

title: Coupling-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Co-Evolving Graph Games
comment: 29 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Building hydrogen station networks, electric vehicle charging grids, or vaccine distribution systems requires coordinating two separately operated graphs, demand-side facilities and the supply-side networks they depend on, where each operator's payoff depends on the other's choices. We formalize this as the Co-Evolving Graph Game (CEGG), a setting that sits between facility location, interdependent-network analysis, and graph-based multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) but is not jointly addressed by any of them. We propose Cross-Graph Attention with Policy Mirror Descent (CGA-PMD), pairing cross-graph attention, which lets each agent read only the partner-graph nodes structurally coupled to its own, with a policy mirror descent update for stable training. Across three reward domains and a range of practical network scales, we find that the structure of the coupling selects which method wins: at small scale most methods are competitive, but as scale grows or coupling becomes irregular, CGA-PMD is the one method that stays reliable: it attains the highest success count on each of five real city networks, while own-only, unmasked-attention, and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)-based variants degrade in distinct ways. Our theoretical analysis addresses the optimizer side: the Kullback-Leibler (KL)-regularized update admits an iteration-uniform cumulative drift bound, whereas the clip update admits no such bound on the iterations where the clip does not bind. The implementation is available at https://github.com/Mina-Kim-Github/cegg-cga-pmd.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"共演化图博弈"(CEGG)问题，刻画供需两侧独立运营图之间的耦合决策，并提出跨图注意力+策略镜像下降(CGA-PMD)方法，在五个真实城市网络上取得最优成功率，并给出KL正则更新的漂移界理论分析。
AI.motivation: 建设氢站网络、充电网络或疫苗配送系统时，需协调两个独立运营的图：需求侧设施图与所依赖的供给侧网络图，双方收益相互依赖。该问题介于设施选址、相互依赖网络分析与图多智能体强化学习之间，但现有研究未联合处理。
AI.method: 形式化为Co-Evolving Graph Game (CEGG)；提出CGA-PMD，将跨图注意力（每个智能体只读取伙伴图中与其结构耦合的节点）与策略镜像下降更新相结合以稳定训练。
AI.result: 在三种奖励域与多种实际网络规模下，耦合结构决定最优方法：小规模时多数方法相当，规模增大或耦合不规则时CGA-PMD唯一保持可靠，在五个真实城市网络上成功率最高；own-only、无掩码注意力与PPO变体以不同方式退化。理论上，KL正则更新具有迭代一致的累积漂移界，而clip更新在clip不生效的迭代上无此类界。
AI.conclusion: 跨图注意力与策略镜像下降的组合可在强耦合、大规模场景下稳健求解CEGG；KL正则化相较clip在优化稳定性上具有理论优势。

title: AlpaSafe: Risk-Aware Trajectory Selection for Vision-Language-Action Models in Autonomous Driving
summary: Reasoning-based driving vision-language-action (VLA) models propose multiple candidate trajectories at each decision, yet only one is executed. Standard evaluation scores the best candidate, assuming an oracle selector that deployment lacks, and leaves the risk of the executed candidate unexamined. Existing online evaluators typically close this gap with a purpose-trained scene or world model, often rolling out each candidate through it at inference time. We introduce AlpaSafe, a risk-aware trajectory selector that reuses the scene representation a frozen driving VLA computes while proposing its candidates. AlpaSafe reads the last hidden token of the VLA's prompt prefill. A lightweight head, trained on the closed-loop simulation outcomes of the candidates, fuses this token with each candidate trajectory and predicts a relative score and collision/offroad logits. A fixed rule removes candidates dominated on the two risk logits and selects the highest-scoring candidate among those remaining, adding neither rollouts nor VLA training. Experiments on 525 AlpaSim scenes show that AlpaSafe outperforms Alpamayo's default first-sample rule and uniform random selection in selected regret and top-1 agreement, and reduces the collision-at-fault or offroad rate from 6.41% and 6.10% to 4.93%. The selector has 1.7M parameters and takes 0.75 ms per decision.

AI.tldr: AlpaSafe 复用冻结驾驶 VLA 的场景表征，用轻量头预测候选轨迹的相对得分与碰撞/越界 logits，以固定规则选出低风险最优候选，无需 rollout 或 VLA 训练，0.75 ms/决策下将碰撞或越界率从约 6% 降至 4.93%。
AI.motivation: 推理式驾驶 VLA 每次决策生成多条候选轨迹但只执行一条；标准评测仅给"最优候选"打分，隐含了部署时不存在的 oracle 选择器，被执行候选的风险未被评估。现有在线评估器需专门训练场景/世界模型并在推理时对每个候选做 rollout，代价高。
AI.method: 提出 AlpaSafe 风险感知轨迹选择器：读取冻结 VLA 在 prompt prefill 阶段最后一个隐藏 token，作为场景表征；用一个轻量头将该 token 与每条候选轨迹融合，预测相对得分以及碰撞、越界两个风险 logits；训练监督来自闭环仿真中候选的实际结果；推理时用固定规则剔除在两个风险 logits 上被支配的候选，再在剩余候选中取最高分。
AI.result: 在 525 个 AlpaSim 场景上，AlpaSafe 在选择遗憾（selected regret）与 top-1 一致率上优于 Alpamayo 默认的首样本规则和均匀随机选择，并将碰撞责任或越界率从 6.41% 与 6.10% 降至 4.93%。选择器仅 1.7M 参数，每次决策耗时 0.75 ms。
AI.conclusion: 通过复用 VLA 已有表征并附加极小选择头，可在不增加 rollout、不重新训练 VLA 的前提下显著降低执行轨迹的风险，说明表征复用式轻量选择器是替代世界模型在线评估的可行高效方案。

title: Decision models for UAVBench and the viability of edge deployment
summary: Small language models are often proposed for reasoning onboard a drone. However, a good benchmark score does not tell us whether a model will actually run, and run usefully, on an edge computer. In this paper we study three related questions using the UAV decision benchmark, UAVBench. First, are small structured decision models good candidates for these tasks? Second, can an ordinary local machine (a Mac) screen candidate models before we test them on physical devices? Third, what software and resource limits govern deployment? Our main Mac evaluation covers 24 model configurations on the same 2,000 validated multiple-choice questions from UAVBench. These include 20 size-and-precision configurations of 11 generative models, plus four open-weight structured decision models that received no additional UAVBench-specific training. A structured decision model, H2O Lightning 4B, achieved the highest accuracy we observed, scoring 77.65% on the Mac. This shows that these models are well suited to this kind of task. However, when we tried to deploy the decision models, we ran into conversion and runtime limits on the edge devices we tested, which we describe in detail. To test local screening, we ran matched evaluations of two generative models on both the Mac and a Qualcomm RB3 board. The accuracies did not match exactly, but the ranking did. LFM2 2.6B ranked above Qwen2.5 1.5B on both platforms. This supports using a local machine to shortlist candidates. That said, individual answers still differed between platforms, so testing on the actual hardware remained necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文以UAVBench为基准，回答三个问题：小型结构化决策模型是否适合无人机端任务、普通本地机器能否先行筛选候选模型、以及边缘部署受哪些软件与资源限制。Mac上对24种模型配置的评估显示H2O Lightning 4B取得最高准确率77.65%，但在边缘设备上遭遇转换与运行时限制；Mac与Qualcomm RB3板上的配对评估排名一致，支持本地预筛，但仍需真机验证。
AI.motivation: 无人机机载推理常被推荐使用小型语言模型，但基准分数高并不代表模型能在边缘计算机上实际运行并产生有效结果；需要系统考察模型适用性、本地可筛选性与部署约束三个层面。
AI.method: 使用UAVBench的2,000道经校验的多选题，在Mac上评估24种模型配置：11个生成式模型的20种规模-精度组合，外加4个未做UAVBench特定训练的开源结构化决策模型；并对两个生成式模型在Mac与Qualcomm RB3板上进行配对评估，比较准确率与排序。同时记录边缘设备上的模型转换与运行时限制。
AI.result: 结构化决策模型H2O Lightning 4B在Mac上取得最高准确率77.65%，表明此类模型适合该任务；但部署到所测边缘设备时出现模型转换与运行时限制。配对评估中两平台的准确率数值不完全一致，但排名一致（LFM2 2.6B均高于Qwen2.5 1.5B），逐题答案仍有差异。
AI.conclusion: 小型结构化决策模型是无人机决策任务的有力候选，可用普通本地机器进行候选模型初筛，但排名一致不等于逐题一致，最终仍须在真实硬件上验证部署可行性与性能。

title: VTree: Question-Driven Growth of Hierarchical Memory for Agentic Long-Video Understanding
summary: Long videos spanning tens of minutes to hours far exceed the context window of today's vision-language models, and the standard remedy of sparse uniform frame sampling discards exactly the fine-grained evidence that specific questions depend on. Existing video agents explore on demand but re-explore from scratch for every question and discard their exploration state once an answer is produced, so per-question cost scales with video length. Hierarchical-memory methods instead fix the scope of each depth in advance and deepen along a pre-committed pyramid rather than toward the question. We observe that a video's coarse structure (where its scenes and topics begin and end) is question-independent, whereas which part a question must zoom into, and how deep, is question-dependent. We propose VTree, which builds a coarse hierarchical memory tree over a video once and then, for each question, grows branches only where that question needs depth. The growth is globally routed so any part of the timeline is reachable, sufficiency-gated so drilling stops when the evidence suffices, and query-conditioned so a branch unfolds into the sub-intervals that answer \emph{this} question. Crucially, every expansion is written back into the video memory, allowing later questions to reuse previously discovered structure and evidence without repeating the corresponding expansion process. Across five long-video understanding benchmarks, VTree consistently improves the accuracy of diverse vision-language backbones while substantially reducing the context length and execution time required for each question.

AI.tldr: 提出 VTree：先一次性构建视频的粗粒度分层记忆树（场景/主题边界与问题无关），再针对每个问题仅在需要深度的位置按全局路由、充分性门控、查询条件化地生长分支，且所有扩展写回记忆以供后续问题复用，从而在五个长视频基准上同时提升准确率并降低每题上下文长度与执行时间。
AI.motivation: 长视频（数十分钟至数小时）远超现有视觉语言模型的上下文窗口；稀疏均匀采样会丢弃特定问题所依赖的细粒度证据；现有视频智能体按需探索但对每个问题都从头重探索、答案产生后即丢弃探索状态，导致单题成本随视频长度增长；分层记忆方法则预先固定各深度范围、沿预承诺的金字塔加深，而非朝问题方向加深。
AI.method: 关键观察：视频的粗粒度结构（场景与主题的起止点）与问题无关，而问题需要缩放到哪一部分、需要多深则与问题相关。基于此，VTree 一次性为视频构建粗粒度分层记忆树；对每个问题仅在需要处生长分支，生长过程具备三点性质：全局路由（时间轴任意部分可达）、充分性门控（证据足够即停止下钻）、查询条件化（分支展开为回答该问题的子区间）；每次扩展均写回视频记忆，使后续问题可复用已发现的结构与证据而无需重复扩展。
AI.result: 在五个长视频理解基准上，VTree 一致提升多种视觉语言骨干模型的准确率，同时显著减少每个问题所需的上下文长度与执行时间。
AI.conclusion: 将视频的与问题无关的粗结构一次性缓存、把与问题相关的深度探索做成可复用且可门控的按需生长，是兼顾长视频理解准确率与推理效率的有效范式。

title: Cross-Site Transformers Are Robust Heart Rate Estimators
summary: Single-site heart-rate estimation from photoplethysmography (PPG) degrades sharply under real-world motion. Multi-site PPG provides a natural solution, but existing models fuse sites as generic sensor channels rather than exploiting their hemodynamic structure: each heartbeat propagates along the arterial tree, appearing across body sites as delayed and transformed copies of the same cardiac event. We propose the Cross-Site Transformer, which introduces a hemodynamically informed inductive bias by restricting multi-sensor fusion to cross-attention between PPG sites. On WildPPG, the largest in-the-wild benchmark available, our model establishes a new single-model state of the art, reducing error by 21% over the previous best and 35% over the best prior transformer. The same cross-site restriction makes the trained network directly auditable. Because each cross-attention head lies on one directed pathway between sites, causal resample ablation can isolate and test each direction of information flow. Ablating the chest-to-wrist pathway doubles error, whereas the reverse costs far less. Encoding hemodynamic structure into attention routing thus improves real-world sensing robustness and enables rigorous auditing of multi-sensor fusion.

AI.tldr: 提出Cross-Site Transformer，将多部位PPG融合限制为部位间交叉注意力，以编码血流动力学结构，在WildPPG上取得单模型新SOTA（误差较此前最佳降低21%），并使网络可通过因果重采样消融直接审计。
AI.motivation: 单部位PPG心率估计在真实运动下严重退化；多部位PPG虽可缓解，但现有模型把各部位当作普通传感器通道融合，未利用"同一心搏沿动脉树传播、在各部位表现为延迟且变换的副本"这一血流动力学结构。
AI.method: Cross-Site Transformer：将多传感器融合限制为PPG部位间的交叉注意力，从而引入血流动力学先验的归纳偏置；使每个交叉注意力头对应一条有向部位间通路，可用因果重采样消融逐方向隔离并测试信息流。
AI.result: 在WildPPG（最大真实场景基准）上取得单模型SOTA：误差较此前最佳模型降低21%，较最佳先验Transformer降低35%。消融胸部→腕部通路使误差翻倍，而反向通路影响小得多。
AI.conclusion: 将血流动力学结构编码进注意力路由，可提升真实场景传感鲁棒性，并使多传感器融合具备严格可审计性。

title: Lifted Multiple Shooting for Parallel-in-Time Contact-Rich Trajectory Optimization
summary: Planning through contact requires accounting for the coupled dynamics of a robot and its environment, including inertial effects, contact forces, and friction. However, the non-smoothness and multimodality of contact dynamics and contact geometry makes gradient-based optimization challenging. In this work, we propose lifted multiple shooting, a trajectory optimization transcription that can be solved directly using nonlinear program solvers. By introducing contact impulses as optimization variables, our formulation allows the optimizer to satisfy the state-transition constraints using friction-cone-feasible impulses while separately enforcing their consistency with the contact model. Our formulation supports a broad class of contact constitutive relations, with sensitivities computed through implicit differentiation. To enable efficient planning over long horizons and for high-dimensional systems, we further introduce IP-PAS, a parallel-in-time primal-dual interior-point solver that achieves O(log T) parallel computational depth. We evaluate the proposed methods on six fully dynamic contact-rich planning tasks, including nonprehensile pushing and in-hand manipulation, without contact-guiding costs. Lifted multiple shooting improves success rates by up to 81.5 percentage points over standard multiple shooting, while IP-PAS achieves solution quality comparable to serial methods with up to a 3.1x speedup and scales to horizons of 40,000 timesteps.

AI.tldr: 提出"提升式多重打靶法"(lifted multiple shooting)轨迹优化建模，将接触冲量作为优化变量以规避接触动力学非光滑性，并配套并行时间原始-对偶内点求解器IP-PAS（O(log T)并行深度），在六个富接触规划任务上成功率较标准多重打靶最高提升81.5个百分点，求解速度最高提升3.1倍，可扩展到40,000步长时域。
AI.motivation: 接触规划需同时考虑机器人-环境耦合动力学（惯性、接触力、摩擦），但接触动力学的非光滑性与多模态性、接触几何的非光滑性使基于梯度的优化难以奏效；传统多重打靶需在状态转移约束中直接满足接触模型，导致约束不可微、求解困难；同时长时域与高维系统下的规划效率不足。
AI.method: 1）提升式多重打靶：将接触冲量引入为独立优化变量，把"状态转移约束"与"接触模型一致性约束"解耦——前者仅要求冲量满足摩擦锥可行性，后者单独施加；支持广泛一类接触本构关系，并通过隐函数微分计算灵敏度。2）IP-PAS：并行时间（parallel-in-time）的原始-对偶内点法求解器，实现O(log T)并行计算深度，支持长时域与高维系统的高效求解。两种方法均为可直接由非线性规划求解器处理的transcription形式（无需接触引导代价）。
AI.result: 在六个全动态富接触规划任务（含非抓取推动 nonprehensile pushing 与灵巧手内操作 in-hand manipulation）上，不使用接触引导代价：提升式多重打靶相较标准多重打靶成功率最高提升81.5个百分点；IP-PAS在解质量上与串行方法相当，速度最高提升3.1倍，并可扩展到40,000时间步的时域。
AI.conclusion: 通过将接触冲量提升为优化变量并解耦接触模型一致性约束，配合并行时间内点求解器，可在无需接触引导代价的条件下实现鲁棒的富接触轨迹优化，兼顾成功率、解质量与长时域可扩展性。

title: When Tools Fail, Agents Fabricate: Silent Failure and Verification-First Oversight in Tool-Using LLM Agents
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development. 12 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables
summary: Tool-using LLM agents must recover when a tool call fails, by retrying, switching tools, or revising their plan. We study how agents fail when tools fail, using RetryRealistic, a sandboxed yet realistic testbed for controlled fault injection in which agents operate on a real OS filesystem with genuine permission enforcement, SQLite databases, a deterministic local HTTP server, and a constrained shell, across 8 tools, 9 fault types with controlled persistence, and 30 multi-step tasks. Evaluating four agents over 2,100 faulted runs against ground truth, we find that recovery is unreliable (19-68% correct) and frequently silent: 6-26% of runs end in a confident fabrication, a wrong answer asserted as fact. The failure mode is governed more by the fault type than by the model: faults that return partial data drive fabrication (up to 38%), while hard denials drive honest failure. The mechanism is what we call silent ingestion: the agent accepts faulted data as valid on first contact without retrying or flagging the problem, then builds a fabricated answer on top of it. We show that fabrication is reducible: a verification-first Monitor, grounding checks in structured tool outputs and issuing corrective directives rather than hard blocks, raises correct recovery from 45.6% to 56.3% and cuts fabrication from 17.3% to 10.8%. Removing chain-of-thought increases fabrication (+8.3pp), so deliberation guards against silent ingestion. We release RetryRealistic, the fault-injection toolkit, and all annotated traces at https://github.com/Kingsford-Group/RetryRealistic

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RetryRealistic 故障注入测试床，系统评测 LLM 工具使用智能体的故障恢复能力，揭示"静默摄取"（silent ingestion）机制导致的自信性捏造（confident fabrication），并提出验证优先的 Monitor 加以缓解。
AI.motivation: 工具调用失败时智能体需重试、切换工具或修订计划，但现有研究缺乏可控且贴近真实的故障注入环境，且对"工具失败→智能体失败"的具体模式与机理缺乏量化认识。
AI.method: 构建 RetryRealistic 沙箱测试床：真实 OS 文件系统与权限强制、SQLite 数据库、确定性本地 HTTP 服务器、受限 shell，涵盖 8 种工具、9 类故障（可控持久性）、30 个多步任务。对 4 个智能体开展 2100 次故障运行并与 ground truth 对照；分析故障类型与模型的影响；提出基于结构化工具输出做接地校验、发出纠正性指令（而非硬阻断）的验证优先 Monitor；并做去掉思维链的消融。
AI.result: 恢复正确率仅 19–68%；6–26% 的运行以自信捏造收尾。失败模式更多由故障类型而非模型决定：部分返回数据的故障导致最高 38% 捏造，硬性拒绝则产生诚实失败。Monitor 将正确恢复率从 45.6% 提升至 56.3%，捏造率从 17.3% 降至 10.8%；移除思维链使捏造增加 8.3 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 工具故障下的智能体恢复不可靠且常为"静默"：智能体在首次接触时即把故障数据当作有效输入，不复核、不告警，并在此基础上构建捏造答案。捏造可通过验证优先、软性纠正的监控机制显著降低；思维链推理是抵御静默摄取的防护。测试床、注入工具包与标注轨迹已开源。

title: LightOnOCR for AMNLT: Reading Chant Notation and Lyrics in One Pass, from Single Staves to Whole Pages
summary: Aligned music notation and lyrics transcription (AMNLT) asks for the notes of a chant, its sung text and the assignment of syllables to notes in one output. Fuentes-Martínez et al., who defined the task, found that the one vision-language model they tested fell far behind specialised recognisers. We fine-tune LightOnOCR-3-1B, a page OCR model with one billion parameters, end to end, vision encoder included, to write a staff as a GABC string whose letters denote staff positions. Trained on the published AMNLT training split alone, it more than halves the best published aligned music and lyrics error rate (AMLER) on Solesmes, the one directly comparable dataset (9.9 against 21.0 %); on Einsiedeln and Salzinnes, measured in a different encoding, its figures are also lower. The benchmark does not measure generalisation to unseen manuscripts: while the pitch error on AMNLT validation stays between 1.7 and 1.9 %, on 200 staves from five unseen manuscripts it falls from 24.9 to 1.3 % as we add chant aligned through CantusDB, Transkribus ground truth and silver staves kept only where two readers agree. Trained also on multi-staff images, it reads whole pages without staff detection (pitch error 3.3 to 3.8 % on validation and test pages, 1.9 % on pages of unseen manuscripts). Remaining errors include Gothic F clefs read as C clefs, notes dropped with abbreviated or illegible text and lower accuracy on pages with small notation. Controlled ablations are needed to explain the gains.

AI.tldr: 该论文将十亿参数的页面OCR模型LightOnOCR-3-1B端到端微调（含视觉编码器）用于对齐乐谱与歌词转写（AMNLT），把谱表输出为GABC字符串，在Solesmes数据集上将AMLER从21.0%降至9.9%，并实现无需谱表检测的整页识读。
AI.motivation: Fuentes-Martínez等定义了对齐乐谱与歌词转写任务，并发现所测试的单一视觉-语言模型远落后于专用识别器，因此需要探索更强的通用模型微调方案，同时现有基准缺乏对未见手稿泛化能力的衡量。
AI.method: 端到端微调LightOnOCR-3-1B（视觉编码器一并训练），令模型将谱表写成字母表示谱线位置的GABC字符串；仅使用公开的AMNLT训练划分；并补充CantusDB对齐圣咏、Transkribus真值以及仅在两位标注者一致时保留的silver谱表数据；另在多谱表图像上训练以支持整页识别。
AI.result: Solesmes上AMLER由21.0%降至9.9%（优于已发表最佳结果一倍以上），Einsiedeln与Salzinnes（不同编码）同样更低；AMNLT验证集音高错误1.7–1.9%，但在五份未见手稿的200个谱表上由24.9%降至1.3%（随数据增补逐步改善）；整页识别在验证与测试页音高错误3.3–3.8%，未见手稿页面为1.9%。
AI.conclusion: 通用页面OCR模型经端到端微调可显著超越现有AMNLT专用方法并支持整页无检测识读；但基准未反映未见手稿泛化，需依靠额外数据扩充；残余错误包括哥特F谱号误读为C谱号、缩写或难辨文本处音符漏识、小字号谱面精度下降；增益来源仍需受控消融实验解释。

title: Data-Dependent Probability Estimation via Sample Amplification
summary:
Can we estimate the probability of an event chosen after seeing the data, without using any fresh samples? Its empirical probability can be arbitrarily misleading, while learning the entire distribution to constant accuracy requires $Θ(d)$ samples on a domain of size $d$. We show that $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{d})$ samples suffice for constant mean squared error, provided the rule choosing the event is known. More generally, our estimator handles arbitrary $[0,1]$-valued queries and runs in polynomial time given evaluation access to the rule. This sample complexity matches the known lower bound up to logarithmic factors and resolves the open question posed by Feldman, Kale, Raman, Talwar, and Tewari (arXiv:2610.41244).
  Our estimation framework relies on a new combination of sample amplification (arXiv:1904.12053 and arXiv:2201.04315) with distribution learning via online optimization. Our estimator achieves mean squared error $O(d^{3/4}/n)$ when $d\leq n$ and $\widetilde{O}(d^{1/4}/\sqrt{n})$ when $d>n$. We complement this with a lower bound of $Ω(\min\{1,\sqrt{d}/n\})$ on the mean squared error. Using our framework, we also design an efficient estimator for data-dependent queries on Gaussian distributions with unknown mean and identity covariance. Finally, we show that a smoothed variant of the problem is much (exponentially) easier. For discrete distributions, if the sample size is chosen uniformly from $\{n,\ldots,2n-1\}$, then $n=O(\log d)$ suffices for constant mean squared error.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"看到数据后才选定的查询/事件的概率估计"问题，证明在已知选择规则时 Ã(√d) 样本即可达到常数均方误差，匹配已有下界，解决了 Feldman 等人提出的开放问题。
AI.motivation: 数据依赖查询的经验概率可能严重误导，而要学到整个分布的常数精度需 Θ(d) 样本（域大小为 d），两者间存在巨大差距。作者希望在无新样本的条件下，对"事后选定的查询"给出可靠的概率估计，并确定其最优样本复杂度。
AI.method: 将样本放大（sample amplification）与基于在线优化的分布学习相结合，构造多项式时间估计器（只需对选择规则有求值访问），可处理任意 [0,1] 值查询；并推导相应的下界，推广到高斯分布情形，给出平滑变体分析。
AI.result: Ã(√d) 样本足以达到常数均方误差，与已知下界在对数因子内匹配；估计器在 d≤n 时 MSE 为 O(d^{3/4}/n)，d>n 时为 Õ(d^{1/4}/√n)，并证明下界 Ω(min{1,√d/n})。此外给出未知均值、单位协方差高斯分布上数据依赖查询的高效估计器；平滑变体（样本量在 {n,…,2n−1} 中均匀选取）只需 n=O(log d)。
AI.conclusion: 数据依赖查询的概率估计可在远少于 Θ(d) 的样本下实现，最优复杂度为 Ã(√d)；样本量的随机化可带来指数级改进，说明该问题的难度主要来自确定性与最坏情形结构。

title: Environment-Aware Probabilistic State Estimation of Continuum Robots from Planar Imaging
summary: Continuum robots are compliant along their entire length, making them well suited to navigating confined environments where contact with surrounding structures is often unavoidable. However, this compliance makes their modeling more complex compared to rigid robots, especially under contact, so their state must often be estimated from information available during operation. In many applications, the environment is known in advance, for example from preoperative imaging in medicine or from design models in industrial inspection. We present a probabilistic state estimator that represents the known environment as a signed distance field, informing the estimated shape. Continuous in arclength and time, it estimates the full state from asynchronous measurements anywhere along the robot. It also fuses planar images of body-fixed markers from a moving camera with commanded actuation, so the robot needs no embedded sensors. In a simulated aortic arch and a hardware phantom, the estimator tracked the robot into the target branch, and with a single view, using the known environment lowered the tip error from 2.5% to 1.6% and from 20.0% to 11.3% of the robot length, respectively. The continuous estimate of the full state and its uncertainty can support navigation and control of sensorless continuum robots.

AI.tldr: 提出一种概率状态估计器，将已知环境表示为有符号距离场（SDF）并融合异步测量与平面标记图像，实现无内置传感器的连续体机器人全状态估计。
AI.motivation: 连续体机器人全长柔顺，适合受限环境，但接触使建模复杂，状态需在线估计；许多应用中环境可预先已知（医学术前影像、工业设计模型），可利用这一先验信息改进估计精度。
AI.method: 概率状态估计器：以有符号距离场表示已知环境以约束估计形状；沿弧长与时间连续建模；从机器人任意位置的异步测量估计完整状态；融合移动相机拍摄的体固标记平面图像与指令驱动信号，无需嵌入式传感器。
AI.result: 在仿真主动脉弓与硬件体模中，估计器引导机器人进入目标分支；单视角下引入已知环境后，尖端误差分别从机器人长度的2.5%降至1.6%、从20.0%降至11.3%。
AI.conclusion: 连续的全状态及其不确定性估计可为无传感器连续体机器人的导航与控制提供支持。

title: SMAD: A Semantics-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Unsupervised Time-Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) lacks a one-size-fits-all detector for heterogeneous data and anomaly types. Existing automation is limited by implicit objectives, potentially unreliable historical knowledge, or high computational costs. More fundamentally, it selects how to detect anomalies without explicitly defining what to detect. We propose SMAD, an LLM-based multi-agent framework that translates anomaly intent into executable, testable detection pipelines. Rather than selecting detectors against an implicit target, SMAD establishes a natural-language semantic contract grounded in measurable time-series properties, specifying target event patterns, expected score responses, and validation questions.
