On 256 independent ImageNetV2/ConvNeXt-Tiny images and 16,384 transformed decisions at the prespecified scale $s=.40$, multiclass top-1 flip-prediction errors fall from 11.97% to 10.23% (paired improvement 1.74 percentage points; 95% interval [0.93, 2.61]). Directional finite differences are slightly more accurate (10.00%) at higher measured model-construction cost. These results connect first-order sampling interactions to margin reconstruction, decision prediction, and threat selection, without claiming finite-scale network certification.

AI.tldr: 该文研究几何变换组合对分类器决策的联合效应是否可由单项变换响应重建，指出逐坐标加性组装在一阶上失效，提出投影到logit-margin梯度的耦合线性-岭结构，并给出精确奇偶恒等式与岭抵消条件。
AI.motivation: 实践中常假设各几何变换（如平移、缩放、旋转）对分类器的影响可逐轴相加；对恒等对齐的双线性重采样，这一加性假设是否成立、缺失信息是什么、损失有多大，缺乏一阶理论刻画。
AI.method: 将实现的双线性重采样变换投影到固定的logit-margin梯度方向，展开得到一阶线性项加带符号绝对值岭项；推导精确的偶-奇恒等式与岭抵消条件；在独立参数分布下分析非抵消的非对角岭对加性拟合的阻碍；比较耦合修正（O(s²)投影误差）与逐轴拼接（可能Θ(s)缺陷），并用局部光滑性把结论迁移到实际网络margin；据此构造三参数威胁代理并给出条件选择遗憾界。
AI.result: CIFAR-10与ImageNetV2上投影RMS误差分别较逐轴拼接下降82.96%和82.38%；实际固定变换对的margin RMS误差下降39.75%和42.73%。识别出9种严格非加性的网络margin符号配置。CIFAR-10独立搜索中耦合选择找到51个top-1翻转（逐轴为41）。ImageNetV2/ConvNeXt-Tiny（256图、16,384次判定、s=.40）多类top-1翻转预测错误由11.97%降至10.23%（配对改进1.74个百分点，95%区间[0.93,2.61]）；方向有限差分略优（10.00%）但建模成本更高。
AI.conclusion: 一阶采样交互与margin重建、决策预测、威胁选择存在结构性联系；耦合校正在投影误差与实际margin误差上均显著优于逐轴加性组装，结果不宣称有限尺度下的网络认证。

title: State of Mind: Learning and Evaluating World Models of Naturalistic Brain Dynamics
summary: Understanding naturalistic brain activity requires going beyond the stimulus alone, as external inputs continuously interact with an individual's evolving brain state. A world model captures such dynamics in a latent state by inferring it from neural observations, predicting stimulus-driven evolution, and updating with new observations. However, existing brain world models fail to maintain a persistent latent state over time, and standard metrics of neural prediction accuracy cannot tell whether a model tracks an individual's brain state or relies solely on the stimulus. To directly test state inference, prediction, and updating, we introduce BrainStateBench, which evaluates a model's latent state through a frozen linear probe on whole-cortex, movie-driven fMRI. Its State task tests whether a model captures trial-to-trial variability in an individual's responses to repeated stimuli, while Forecast and Updating evaluate future activity predictions without and with new observations, respectively. To track individual brain state across time, we propose Spectator, a linear latent world model trained with a joint-embedding predictive objective. Spectator encodes short- and long-horizon observation histories into a two-timescale latent state and predicts state transitions linearly from the current state and stimulus. Stimulus-only encoders reach 0.320 in fMRI prediction correlation without observing the brain (0% on State), while prior deep brain world models reach 0.239 yet score at most 0.4% on State. In contrast, Spectator achieves 0.349 correlation alongside 5.5% on State, 16.0% on Forecast, and 20.3% on Updating, outperforming all baselines while forecasting over 20x faster than deep forecasting models.

AI.tldr: 提出BrainStateBench基准与Spectator模型，用于检验脑世界模型是否真正跟踪个体脑状态而非仅依赖刺激；Spectator在fMRI预测与状态跟踪指标上全面超越基线且推理更快。
AI.motivation: 理解自然情境下的脑活动不能只看外部刺激，因为输入与个体不断演化的脑状态持续交互。现有脑世界模型无法在时间上维持持久潜状态，且常用的神经预测精度指标无法区分模型是在跟踪个体脑状态，还是仅依赖刺激做映射。因此需要一个能直接测试状态推断、预测与更新的评测手段。
AI.method: 提出BrainStateBench：在全皮层、电影驱动fMRI数据上，用冻结线性探针评估模型潜状态，包含State（检验对重复刺激下试次间变异的捕捉）、Forecast（无新观测的未来预测）、Updating（有新观测的更新预测）三项任务。提出Spectator：一种线性潜世界模型，用联合嵌入预测目标训练，将短时与长时观测历史编码为双时间尺度潜状态，并从当前状态与刺激线性预测状态转移。
AI.result: 纯刺激编码器在未观测大脑情况下fMRI预测相关达0.320（State为0%）；先前深度脑世界模型预测相关0.239，State最高仅0.4%。Spectator达0.349相关，State 5.5%、Forecast 16.0%、Updating 20.3%，优于所有基线，且预测速度比深度预测模型快20倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 标准预测精度不足以证明模型跟踪脑状态，需结合状态特异性指标；线性联合嵌入式的双时间尺度潜世界模型能有效维持个体脑状态并实现高效预测，为脑世界模型评测提供了新范式。

title: Entangle: Scaling Human-Video In-Context World-Action Models across Unseen Tasks and Contexts
summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables foundation models to perform unseen tasks from context without parameter updates. In robotic manipulation, a human video provides the context that specifies how a task should be performed. However, scaling human-video ICL on world-action models (WAMs) faces two challenges: task-level human-robot pairs are not temporally aligned with robot actions, and standard action losses allow policies to rely on initial-scene or task-identity shortcuts rather than tracking the context. We present Entangle, an in-context world-action model that maps a single human video and current robot observations to future visual states and executable actions. To scale temporally aligned training data, we convert recorded robot videos into matched human contexts via video-to-video generation, supplemented by real paired recordings. For model training, we combine variable-length video windows with an intra-task contrastive objective that distinguishes the paired action trajectory from other executions of the same task, preventing task-identity shortcuts. Without task-specific fine-tuning, Entangle improves steadily as aligned training data scales, reaching an average score of 83.5/100 across six unseen tasks on an Astribot S1 robot, and achieves a 69.5% average success rate on seven unseen RoboTwin tasks, outperforming Zero-WAM by 22.6 percentage points. Under Context-OOD, although trained only on scene-aligned pairs, Entangle transfers context-specified behaviors across rearranged layouts and substituted tools.

AI.tldr: Entangle：以单条人类视频为上下文的world-action model，通过视频生成扩增时序对齐数据与任务内对比目标，实现无需微调的跨任务机器人操作。
AI.motivation: 基础模型具备上下文学习（ICL）能力，可用人类视频作为上下文指定任务执行方式而无需参数更新。但在world-action model（WAM）上扩展人类视频ICL面临两个瓶颈：(1) 任务级的人-机器人配对与机器人动作在时间上不对齐，导致难以规模化获取训练数据；(2) 标准动作损失使策略倾向于利用初始场景或任务身份等捷径，而非真正跟踪上下文。
AI.method: 提出Entangle，输入单条人类视频与当前机器人观测，输出未来视觉状态与可执行动作。(a) 数据侧：通过video-to-video生成将已记录的机器人视频转换为与之匹配的人类上下文，并辅以真实配对录制，从而规模化获得时序对齐训练数据；(b) 训练侧：采用变长视频窗口，并结合任务内对比目标，将配对的动作轨迹与同任务的其他执行区分开，抑制任务身份捷径。
AI.result: 无需任务特定微调，Entangle 随对齐训练数据规模增长而稳定提升；在 Astribot S1 机器人上六个未见任务平均得分 83.5/100；在七个未见 RoboTwin 任务上平均成功率 69.5%，比 Zero-WAM 高 22.6 个百分点；在 Context-OOD 条件下（仅用场景对齐配对训练）仍能将上下文指定的行为迁移到重排布局与替换工具的场景。
AI.conclusion: 时序对齐数据的规模化与抗捷径的对比训练目标，是人类视频 ICL 在机器人操作中可扩展的关键；Entangle 展示了良好的数据缩放性与对布局、工具变化的泛化能力。

title: From atomic events to material degradation across metre and year scales
summary: Material degradation emerges from microscopic events whose consequences accumulate over years, yet mechanism-resolved simulations remain confined below engineering timescales. The challenge is not just the sheer number of events: atomistic evolution is dominated by recurrent local motion, with only a tiny fraction driving lasting structural change. This distinction is not encoded in an instantaneous atomic configuration. Locally indistinguishable states can exhibit different event competition, escape times, and long-horizon outcomes, revealing missing kinetic context as a critical information bottleneck. This context spans space and time: the future consequence of a local transition depends on its surrounding defect environment and the kinetic history leading to its current state. To solve this, AtomWorld reconstructs a predictive kinetic state from multiscale structural observations and trajectory history, distinguishing transient fluctuations from microscopic pathways that drive persistent structural evolution. Learning operates only over transitions admitted by the underlying kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) process, preserving event legality, state evolution, and physical time. Across BCC Fe-Cu precipitation, FCC Ni-Cr-Al ordering, and HCP Zr-H interstitial transport, restoring kinetic context consistently advances persistent evolution while maintaining physical fidelity and transferring to unseen conditions. In irradiated reactor-pressure-vessel steel, this approach achieves up to 420-fold greater persistent evolution under matched event budgets. Combined with scalable execution, it successfully extends mechanism-resolved trajectories to service-year timescales across metre-scale heterogeneous domains.

AI.tldr: AtomWorld通过从多尺度结构与轨迹历史中重建"动力学状态"，弥补瞬时构型缺失的动力学上下文，使机制分辨的原子尺度模拟在保持物理一致性的前提下扩展到服役年级别时间尺度。
AI.motivation: 材料退化源于微观事件在多年尺度上的累积，但机制分辨模拟受限于远低于工程时间尺度的仿真时长。核心难点不仅是事件数量庞大，更在于原子演化由大量重复性局域运动主导、仅极少数驱动持久结构改变，而这一区分无法从瞬时原子构型中读出——局域不可区分的状态可能具有不同的事件竞争、逃逸时间和长时结果，说明"缺失的动力学上下文"是关键信息瓶颈。该上下文跨越空间（周围缺陷环境）与时间（到达当前状态的动力学历史）。
AI.method: 提出AtomWorld，从多尺度结构观测与轨迹历史中重建预测性动力学状态，区分瞬态涨落与驱动持久结构演化的微观路径。学习仅在底层动力学蒙特卡洛（KMC）过程所允许的跃迁上进行，从而保证事件合法性、状态演化与物理时间的正确性。
AI.result: 在BCC Fe-Cu析出、FCC Ni-Cr-Al有序化、HCP Zr-H间隙输运三个体系中，恢复动力学上下文均一致地推进持久演化，同时保持物理保真度并可迁移到未见条件。在辐照反应堆压力容器钢中，在相同事件预算下实现最高420倍的持久演化提升。结合可扩展执行，成功将机制分辨轨迹扩展至米级非均匀区域内的服役年时间尺度。
AI.conclusion: 瞬时空位/构型信息不足，动力学上下文才是原子尺度长时演化的关键信息瓶颈；以KMC合法性为约束、以结构与历史为输入重建动力学状态，可在不牺牲物理保真度的前提下大幅提升有效演化速率并实现跨体系、跨条件的可迁移长时模拟。

title: GC-GS: Optimizing 3D Gaussian Splatting with Gradient Conflict as a Geometry Signal
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is commonly optimized with multiple reconstruction losses, which naturally forms a multi-objective optimization problem. This issue becomes more pronounced when perceptual losses are introduced to improve visual quality, as different objectives may impose competing update directions on Gaussian primitives and make it difficult to simultaneously improve fidelity, perceptual quality, and representation efficiency. Based on this view, we reformulate 3DGS training as a multi-objective optimization problem and derive selective conflict-aware position updates that reduce interference between competing objectives while preserving the contribution of each loss. We further observe that gradient conflicts persist throughout training and are most severe in Gaussian position parameters, indicating that objective conflict is closely tied to geometry optimization. We therefore treat position-gradient conflict as a geometry-aware signal to guide densification and pruning. Experiments show that our method achieves better rendering performance while improving representation compactness and rendering efficiency over existing 3DGS variants.

AI.tldr: 将3DGS训练重新表述为多目标优化问题，提出选择性冲突感知的位置更新，并以位置梯度冲突作为几何感知信号指导致密化与剪枝。
AI.motivation: 3DGS通常采用多种重建损失联合优化，天然构成多目标优化问题；引入感知损失后，各目标对高斯基元的更新方向相互竞争，难以同时兼顾保真度、感知质量与表示效率。
AI.method: 把3DGS训练建模为多目标优化，推导出选择性冲突感知（selective conflict-aware）的位置更新，以降低竞争目标间的干扰并保留各损失贡献；同时观察到梯度冲突贯穿训练且在位置参数上最严重，遂将位置梯度冲突作为几何感知信号用于指导致密化与剪枝。
AI.result: 实验表明，相较现有3DGS变体，方法在取得更优渲染性能的同时提升了表示紧凑性与渲染效率。
AI.conclusion: 目标冲突与几何优化紧密相关，冲突感知的位置更新与致密化/剪枝策略可统一提升渲染质量与表示效率。

title: DisSparse: Pipelined Top-$p$ Sparse Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving
summary: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by the memory demands of the key-value (KV) cache, whose size scales linearly with context length. Dynamic sparse attention reduces this bottleneck by fetching and attending only to a critical subset of tokens. The dominant primitive in dynamic sparse attention research and deployment is fixed-budget top-$k$ selection, which is favored because its deterministic block count aligns with the static memory allocation that systems like vLLM rely on. Top-$k$ uses a fixed budget regardless of how attention mass is distributed across heads, layers, and decode steps, leading to either wasted bandwidth on heads with peaky attention or dropped context on heads with diffuse attention. Top-$p$ (nucleus) selection adapts naturally to this variation but has seen limited adoption in production serving systems due to two system-level challenges: variable block counts that break deterministic block allocation and computationally expensive selection kernels that exceed the cost of attention itself. We present DisSparse, a serving system that integrates top-$p$ sparse attention into vLLM end-to-end. DisSparse decouples block selection from the scheduler's critical path, hides selection latency behind layer computation via a two-stream pipeline, and introduces a single-pass histogram-based top-$p$ kernel. We further observe intra-block sparsity, the inflation of selection budgets caused by mixing high- and low-importance tokens within fixed-size KV cache blocks, and address it with a token relocation kernel guided by accumulated prefill attention scores. Across long- and medium-context benchmarks on multiple models, DisSparse achieves 1.17x to 1.80x speedup in sparsity analysis (block selection) over state-of-the-art top-$p$ methods with negligible accuracy loss and supports up to 8x larger maximum batch sizes than dense vLLM under the same memory budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DisSparse，一个将 top-p（nucleus）稀疏注意力端到端集成进 vLLM 的服务系统，通过解耦块选择、双流流水线与单遍直方图 top-p 内核，并结合基于 token 重定位缓解块内稀疏性，在几乎无精度损失下实现比 SOTA top-p 方法 1.17–1.80 倍加速，并在同等显存下支持至多 8 倍更大的 batch size。
AI.motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理受限于随上下文长度线性增长的 KV cache 显存开销。动态稀疏注意力通过只取关键 token 缓解该瓶颈，但主流做法是固定预算的 top-k 选择：其确定性块数量契合 vLLM 等系统的静态显存分配。然而 top-k 忽略注意力质量在 head、layer、decode step 间分布的差异，导致尖峰分布 head 上带宽浪费、弥散分布 head 上上下文被丢弃。top-p 能自适应这种变化，却因两个系统级难题难以在生产服务中落地：块数量可变破坏确定性块分配；选择内核计算开销甚至超过注意力本身。
AI.method: DisSparse 将 top-p 稀疏注意力完整集成到 vLLM：(1) 将块选择从调度器关键路径解耦；(2) 采用双流流水线，把选择延迟隐藏在层计算之后；(3) 提出单遍、基于直方图的 top-p 选择内核；(4) 观察到块内稀疏性——固定大小 KV 块内高、低重要性 token 混杂会抬高选择预算——并利用 prefill 阶段累积的注意力分数引导的 token 重定位内核加以缓解。
AI.result: 在多个模型的长、中上下文基准上，DisSparse 相比 SOTA top-p 方法在稀疏性分析（块选择）上取得 1.17x–1.80x 加速，精度损失可忽略；在相同显存预算下，支持的最大 batch size 达到稠密 vLLM 的至多 8 倍。
AI.conclusion: top-p 稀疏注意力在生产级服务系统中落地是可行的；通过系统与内核层面的协同设计（解耦调度依赖、流水线隐藏延迟、高效选择内核）以及利用注意力分数做 token 重定位，可在保持精度的同时显著提升长上下文推理的吞吐与 batch 能力。

title: VTLA-RL: Learning Visuotactile Policies for Load-Adaptive Grasping
summary: Vision-language-action foundation models learn general manipulation priors, but object mass and local slip are difficult to infer from vision alone. Changing loads require contact-driven grasp adjustments that demonstrations collected under fixed conditions may not adequately cover. We present VTLA-RL to study visuotactile grasping policies and their reinforcement learning (RL) post-training under varying loads. Our main approach shares a visual encoder between tactile-image histories and RGB inputs to jointly generate and execute motion and bilateral force targets in a unified action space. Mixed real and simulated demonstrations first establish motion and contact priors. Two-stage multi-task RL then uses only simulated interaction to optimize the policy through task-success returns without continued real-demonstration supervision, and the trained policy deploys directly to real robots. We compare tactile representations and RL post-training routes in simulation and separately evaluate load variation and placement perturbations on hardware. The full method achieves higher grasping success than the supervised initialization, while RL post-training gains differ across approaches, providing empirical evidence for choosing representations and training approaches for this task.

AI.tldr: VTLA-RL 提出共享视觉编码器的视触觉抓取策略，在同一动作空间中联合生成运动与双侧力目标，并采用“混合实/仿真示教预训练 + 两阶段多任务仿真强化学习微调”的路线，最终零样本部署实机；实验表明完整方法优于监督初始化，且不同 RL 后训练路线的增益存在差异。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作基础模型虽具备通用操作先验，但质量与局部滑移难以仅凭视觉推断；负载变化需要接触驱动的抓取调整，而固定条件下采集的示教难以充分覆盖此类情形。因此需要研究视触觉抓取策略及其在不同负载下的 RL 后训练。
AI.method: 核心设计是在触觉图像历史与 RGB 输入之间共享视觉编码器，在统一动作空间中同时生成并执行运动目标与双侧力目标。训练分两步：先用真实与仿真混合示教建立运动与接触先验；再用两阶段多任务 RL，仅依赖仿真交互、以任务成功回报优化策略，不再使用真实示教监督；训练好的策略直接部署到真实机器人。实验在仿真中比较不同触觉表征与 RL 后训练路线，并在实机上分别评估负载变化与放置扰动。
AI.result: 完整方法在抓取成功率上高于监督初始化模型；不同 RL 后训练路线带来的增益存在明显差异，为表征与训练方式的选择提供了实证依据；实机上验证了对负载变化和放置扰动的适应能力。
AI.conclusion: 视触觉多模态表征与仿真 RL 后训练相结合，可在不依赖额外真实示教的情况下提升变负载抓取性能并直接迁移到实机；触觉表征形式与 RL 后训练方案的选择对最终收益影响显著，需按任务特点权衡。

title: Beyond Unit Tests: Path-Aware Rubric-Guided LLM Autograding of Notebooks
summary: Jupyter notebooks support open-ended, multi-step assessments in which students build one logical flow across interdependent steps, combining code, written analysis, and generated outputs such as plots. These reflect authentic scientific practice but are hard to grade consistently, since students may make different yet equally valid choices at each step, so a later answer can only be judged in light of the choices a student made earlier. We present an LLM-based autograder for such flow-structured notebook questions. It generates a rubric from a reference solution, then applies a softening pass that relaxes criteria tied to the reference so legitimate alternative paths are not penalized. Each question group is graded in a single model call, so later answers are judged against the student's own earlier choices, using question-type tags and schema-constrained, low-temperature outputs. Evidence is scored multimodally: code, text, numerical outputs, and figures from code cells. We deployed the tool in a machine-learning course, integrated with Gradescope, with a pre-submission format check and prompt-injection defenses, and evaluate it both in that live course and against archived submissions graded by staff in earlier terms. We report agreement, cross-model variance, cost, student perceptions, and injection resilience. With low-temperature models, agreement with human scores is often strong, including on the open-ended items the design specifically targets, while run-to-run stability depends sharply on the model's temperature support.

AI.tldr: 提出面向Jupyter Notebook"流程结构化"多步题的LLM自动评分器：由参考解生成rubric并做"软化"放宽参考特定标准，每组题单次调用、依据学生自身先前选择评分，多模态证据打分，并在真实ML课程与历史存档作业上评估。
AI.motivation: Notebook题目具有开放式、多步骤、步骤间逻辑依赖的特点，学生可在各步做出不同但同样合理的选择，后续答案必须结合其先前选择才能判定；这使人工评分难以一致，传统按步独立评分的自动评分也不适用。
AI.method: 1) 由参考解自动生成rubric；2) 增加softening pass，放宽与参考解绑定的判据以避免惩罚合理的替代路径；3) 每个题组仅一次模型调用，实现上下文感知的链式评分；4) 使用题型标签与schema约束、低温输出；5) 多模态证据评分（代码、文本、数值输出、代码单元生成的图像）；6) 与Gradescope集成，加入提交前格式检查与提示注入防御；7) 在真实机器学习课程及往期人工评分存档提交上评估一致性、跨模型方差、成本、学生感知与注入鲁棒性。
AI.result: 低温模型下与人工评分的一致性通常较高，包括设计重点针对的开放式题目；运行间稳定性显著取决于模型对temperature的支持程度；同时报告了跨模型方差、成本、学生感知与注入防御表现。
AI.conclusion: 该"流程感知+软化rubric+单次调用"的设计可有效支持Notebook多步题的自动评分，在保持与人工评分一致性的同时兼顾开放性与成本，且稳定性高度依赖模型的温度控制能力，需在部署中加以约束。

title: ROSE-SAM3: Response-Oriented Prompt Selection for Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
summary: In open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) of remote-sensing imagery, class-name prompts can miss objects with varied appearances, while richer descriptions can activate competing classes. We propose Response-Oriented Prompt Selection for SAM 3 (ROSE-SAM3), a training-free framework that selects descriptions using frozen SAM 3 responses on unlabeled target-domain images. We screen candidate descriptions for coverage beyond the native prompts while protecting reliable native class responses, retaining candidates that pass these checks on at least four of five image folds. An offline directed acyclic graph (DAG) search then evaluates candidate combinations and builds a compact PromptBank for each class. Each bank retains the native prompts and adds selected descriptions, which we call residual prompts. At inference, the bank is fixed, and Semantic-Instance Cooperative Head (SICH) uses instance evidence to refine semantic responses before assigning pixel labels. We also introduce RS-OVSS-C to evaluate robustness under six image corruption families across eight remote-sensing datasets, preserving their class vocabularies and reference labels. ROSE-SAM3 achieves 57.3% mean mIoU across eight clean benchmarks and 54.7% on RS-OVSS-C, achieving state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/YanghuiSong/ROSE-SAM3.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架ROSE-SAM3，利用冻结SAM 3在目标域图像上的响应来选择描述性提示，构建紧凑PromptBank，并配合语义-实例协作头（SICH）提升开放词汇遥感语义分割性能，同时提出RS-OVSS-C鲁棒性基准。
AI.motivation: 遥感开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）中，仅用类名提示难以覆盖外观多样的目标，而使用更丰富的描述又会激活竞争类别，造成误分类；现有方法难以在"覆盖率"与"类别纯净度"间取得平衡。
AI.method: 1）免训练框架，基于冻结SAM 3在无标注目标域图像上的响应进行提示选择；2）候选描述需满足"超越原生提示的覆盖"且"保护可靠原生类响应"，并在5个图像折中至少4折通过筛选；3）离线DAG搜索评估候选组合，为每类构建紧凑PromptBank（原生提示+残差提示）；4）推理时PromptBank固定，SICH利用实例证据精炼语义响应后再分配像素标签；5）构建RS-OVSS-C基准（6类图像损坏×8个遥感数据集，保留类词表与标注）。
AI.result: 在8个干净基准上平均mIoU达57.3%，RS-OVSS-C上为54.7%，在免训练方法中达到state-of-the-art。
AI.conclusion: 通过响应驱动的提示选择与语义-实例协作精炼，可在不训练的前提下有效扩展提示词汇并抑制竞争类激活，显著提升遥感OVSS的精度与腐败鲁棒性；RS-OVSS-C为鲁棒性评估提供了统一协议。

title: SAFE-DRIFT: Data Selection for Supervised Fine-tuning with Controllable Off-Target Drifts
summary: We propose SAFE-DRIFT, a data-selection framework for supervised fine-tuning that improves a target capability while controlling unwanted drift in the model's other behaviors. We formalize this as a constrained optimization problem that maximizes alignment with the target gradient, subject to a budget on off-target drift which we quantify using the Fisher information of a reference distribution. Under this objective, the optimal, closed-form update is a damped natural-gradient step that downweights reference-sensitive directions. To estimate these high-dimensional gradients and work within the right geometry, we further derive a scalable algorithm that approximates the Fisher information and the target gradient in a shared low-dimensional subspace and analyze how entanglement of the target and reference task can affect the update. We evaluate SAFE-DRIFT against state-of-the-art data selection methods across diverse domains including coding and medical question answering, yielding competitive target performance while reducing degradation on specified off-target behaviors.

AI.tldr: 提出SAFE-DRIFT数据选择框架，将监督微调中的数据选择形式化为在Fisher信息约束的"偏离漂移"预算下最大化与目标梯度对齐的约束优化问题，其闭式最优解为抑制参考敏感方向的阻尼自然梯度步，并给出可扩展的低维子空间近似算法，在代码与医学问答等任务上取得竞争性目标性能并减少非目标行为退化。
AI.motivation: 监督微调提升某项目标能力时，常伴随模型其他行为的非预期漂移（能力退化/行为改变）。现有数据选择方法多只关注目标性能提升，缺乏对"非目标漂移"的显式控制，因此需要一个能在提升目标能力同时约束偏离漂移的数据选择框架。
AI.method: 1) 将数据选择形式化为约束优化：最大化与目标梯度的对齐，同时以参考分布的Fisher信息量化并约束非目标漂移预算；2) 在该目标下推导出闭式最优更新——一个阻尼自然梯度步，对参考分布敏感的方向降权；3) 为估计高维梯度并在正确几何（Fisher度量）下工作，提出可扩展算法，在共享低维子空间中同时近似Fisher信息与目标梯度；4) 分析目标任务与参考任务之间的纠缠（entanglement）对更新的影响。
AI.result: 在代码、医学问答等多个领域与最先进的数据选择方法对比，SAFE-DRIFT在达到有竞争力的目标性能的同时，降低了在指定非目标行为上的退化程度。
AI.conclusion: 通过将数据选择建模为带漂移预算约束的优化问题并采用自然梯度几何下的低维近似，可在保持目标能力提升的同时有效控制非目标行为的漂移；目标与参考任务的纠缠程度是影响更新效果的关键因素。

title: DeRail: Escaping Trajectory Priors via Counterfactual Action Steering for Mid-Execution Instruction Switching
summary: Robots operating in the real world must often adapt when user instructions change mid-execution, yet current instruction-conditioned robot policies, including Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and World-Action Models (WAMs), are largely evaluated under fixed-instruction episodes. We study mid-execution instruction switching and identify trajectory hijacking as a key failure mode, where the policy fails to redirect sufficiently toward the switched target, with its post-switch behavior remaining fully or partially drawn toward trajectories associated with non-target tasks. We propose Counterfactual Action Steering (CAS), a training-free, model-agnostic inference-time method that identifies interfering non-target tasks, queries the same policy with corresponding counterfactual instructions, and uses target--counterfactual action differences to steer execution away from interfering trajectory priors. Experiments on LIBERO-Goal-Switch and CALVIN-Custom-Switch across five VLA and WAM policies, together with real-robot evaluation, show that CAS consistently improves switching success; for example, on CALVIN-Custom-Switch in the $[15,21]$ switching range, CAS improves $π_{0.5}$ from 5.8\% to 54.6\%. Successful CAS-guided rollouts further provide higher-quality self-training supervision than vanilla successful rollouts with the same number of trajectories, yielding stronger policies that generalize to unseen later instruction switches. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文研究机器人在执行中途指令切换时的失败模式，指出"轨迹劫持"现象，并提出免训练、模型无关的推理期方法 Counterfactual Action Steering (CAS) 来引导动作远离干扰性非目标任务先验，显著提升切换成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有指令条件策略（VLA 模型与 World-Action Models, WAMs）大多在固定指令的回合设定下评估，忽略了真实场景中用户指令可能中途改变。作者发现策略在指令切换后无法充分转向新目标，其切换后行为仍被非目标任务的轨迹先验牵引，即"轨迹劫持"，这是一个关键但未被系统研究的失效模式。
AI.method: 提出 CAS：一种无需训练、与模型无关的推理时方法。步骤为：(1) 识别造成干扰的非目标任务；(2) 用对应的反事实指令查询同一策略；(3) 利用目标指令与反事实指令之间的动作差异，对执行进行校正，从而将动作推离干扰性的轨迹先验。该方法可直接套用于任意 VLA/WAM 策略，无需微调。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-Goal-Switch 与 CALVIN-Custom-Switch 两个基准上，对 5 种 VLA 与 WAM 策略进行实验，并结合真机评测：CAS 一致提升切换成功率。例如在 CALVIN-Custom-Switch 的 [15,21] 切换区间，π_{0.5} 的成功率从 5.8% 提升到 54.6%。此外，CAS 引导的成功轨迹作为自训练监督信号，质量优于同数量的普通成功轨迹，可训练出泛化到未见过的更晚指令切换的更强策略。
AI.conclusion: 执行中途指令切换是现有指令条件机器人策略的重要薄弱环节，"轨迹劫持"是其核心失效机制；通过反事实动作差分的推理期引导可有效缓解该问题，且无需训练、通用性强。CAS 引导的成功轨迹还能作为高质量自训练数据，形成"推理引导—数据增强—策略增强"的正向循环。代码将公开。

title: EvoViM: Recursively Self-Evolving Visual Agents for Exploration with Deferred Queries
summary: Multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents have shown promising capabilities in task-oriented environments. However, they still struggle when queries are deferred until after exploration, requiring them to retain visual evidence before knowing which details will matter. We introduce EvoViM, a recursively self-evolving framework in which a frozen multimodal model turns its own interaction experience into one visual program for memory and skills. The program retains images and computes directly on pixels, and its operations decide how this evidence is used in each task. During memory evolution, the same model traces failures in its visual trajectories to the operations that lost or misused evidence and revises them. It also rewrites the notes and analysis tools that guide later revisions, which then build on earlier findings and skip changes that have already failed. We evaluate EvoViM with three multimodal models on six tasks covering visual matching, spatial recall, and sequential decision-making, including three tasks with deferred queries. Across the six tasks, EvoViM improves the average score over AutoMem, the strongest baseline in the main comparison, by 31.3-47.6 points on held-out episodes. Programs written once from the initial environment instructions perform substantially worse, highlighting the value of interaction experience in shaping how visual evidence is retained and used. Code and dataset are available at https://evovim.github.io/.

AI.tldr: EvoViM：冻结多模态模型将自身交互经验递归自进化为"视觉程序"，统一承担记忆与技能，在延迟查询等六项任务上比最强基线AutoMem平均提升31.3–47.6分。
AI.motivation: MLLM智能体在任务导向环境中表现尚可，但当查询在探索之后才给出（deferred queries）时，模型必须事先保留视觉证据而不知道哪些细节重要，现有方法难以应对这种"先经验、后提问"的设定。
AI.method: 提出递归自进化框架EvoViM：冻结的多模态模型把交互经验转化为单一"视觉程序"，程序保留图像并直接在像素上计算，由其操作决定证据在任务中的使用方式；记忆进化阶段，同一模型沿视觉轨迹回溯失败、定位丢失或误用证据的操作并加以修订，同时重写用于指导后续修订的笔记与分析工具，使新修订继承先前结论并跳过已验证失败的改动。
AI.result: 在3个多模态模型、6项任务（视觉匹配、空间回忆、序贯决策，含3项延迟查询任务）上评测，在留出episode上相较主实验最强基线AutoMem平均提升31.3–47.6分；仅依据初始环境指令一次性编写的程序显著更差，说明交互经验对视觉证据的保留与使用至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆与技能合并为可递归自我修订的视觉程序，能有效提升MLLM智能体在延迟查询场景下的证据保留与利用能力；性能提升主要来自交互经验驱动的进化，而非程序化表示本身。

title: Benchmarking Foundation Models for Bone Scaffold Pore Detection: A Comparative Analysis of Few-Shot Performance
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the Australasian Data Science and Machine Learning Conference (AusDM 2026)
summary: Evaluating the mechanical properties of bone scaffolds conventionally requires destructive testing or costly Finite Element Analysis, while deep learning alternatives are constrained by the scarcity of labeled biomaterial imaging data. This study introduces the first expert-annotated, pixel-dense dataset of biopolymer bone-scaffold SEM images, spanning five magnification series, and uses it to benchmark two state-of-the-art pre-trained foundation models under a 12-shot fine-tuning regime. SAM3, an instance segmenter, and YOLOv26, a bounding-box detector, feed the predicted pore geometry to regression heads that estimate Young's modulus and compressive yield strength. Our central finding is that both models fail by pore density rather than magnification: YOLOv26's predicted pore counts saturate and porosity estimation collapses on the most crowded frames, whereas SAM3 over-fragments sparse pore fields and merges adjacent pores in dense ones, producing eight catastrophic failures against three for YOLOv26. Averaged across the 44-image evaluation set, YOLOv26 achieves lower porosity error (19.9% vs. 23.1% MAE), higher precision, and a higher F1 score, whereas SAM3 offers pixel-level instance segmentation that YOLOv26's bounding boxes cannot reproduce. We conclude that model selection should be driven by pore density rather than SEM magnification alone.

AI.tldr: 本文构建首个专家标注的像素级双聚合物骨支架SEM图像数据集（5个放大倍率序列），在12-shot微调设置下评测SAM3与YOLOv26两种预训练基础模型，将预测孔隙几何输入回归头估计杨氏模量与压缩屈服强度。
AI.motivation: 骨支架力学性能评测传统依赖破坏性实验或昂贵有限元分析，深度学习替代方案又受限于生物材料成像标注数据稀缺。
AI.method: 构建专家标注、像素密集的骨支架SEM图像数据集（5个倍率序列，44张评测图），对SAM3（实例分割）与YOLOv26（边框检测）进行12-shot微调，以其预测孔隙几何驱动回归头预测杨氏模量与压缩屈服强度，并按孔隙密度分层分析失败模式。
AI.result: 两模型失效主要取决于孔隙密度而非放大倍率：YOLOv26在密集帧中孔隙计数饱和、孔隙率估计崩溃；SAM3在稀疏孔隙场过度碎片化、在密集场合并相邻孔隙，出现8次灾难性失败（YOLOv26为3次）。整体上YOLOv26孔隙率MAE更低（19.9% vs 23.1%），精确率与F1更高；SAM3则提供边框无法复现的像素级实例分割。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择应由孔隙密度而非仅由SEM放大倍率驱动；YOLOv26在定量孔隙率与力学估计上更稳健，SAM3在需要像素级形态信息时更适用。

title: Tight Mistake-Abstention Tradeoffs for Sequential Prediction under Adversarial Injections
summary: We study the sequential prediction problem introduced by Goel et al. (2023), where an adversary can inject arbitrarily many corrupted instances in an i.i.d. stream from a clean distribution $μ$, while the learner is allowed to abstain from making a prediction at no cost if the current instance was indeed injected. When $μ$ is unknown, Yu and Blanchard (2026) show a polynomial tradeoff between mistakes and false abstentions for classes with finite VC dimension and oblivious adversaries, but still leave open a significant gap between upper and lower bounds in their tradeoff landscape. In this paper, we propose the weighted shattering potential, and based on variants of this potential, provide gap-closing algorithms that essentially characterize the tradeoffs under various settings of interest: When $μ$ is known, our algorithm improves over Goel et al. (2023) and achieves their conjectured $O(d\log T)$ mistake bound; When $μ$ is unknown, for oblivious adversary, our guarantees are tight both in $T$ and in terms of the VC dimension $d$, which completely characterizes the abstention-mistake tradeoff in this setting and gives an $O(\sqrt{dT})$ balanced rate. For adaptive adversary, our results are tight up to $\operatorname{poly}(dD\log T)$ factors for structured classes with finite so-called reduction dimension $D$. Our guarantees also extend to censored feedback, where the label is hidden after an abstention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"加权粉碎势(weighted shattering potential)"及其变体，构造在已知/未知分布μ、oblivious/adaptive对手、有限VC维及有限约简维数D等情形下基本闭合上下界间隙的序列预测算法，并把结果推广到删失反馈。
AI.motivation: Goel et al. (2023) 提出对抗者可向来自干净分布μ的i.i.d.流中注入任意多污染样本、学习器对确实被注入的样本可无代价弃权的序列预测问题。Yu and Blanchard (2026) 在μ未知、有限VC维、oblivious对手下给出错误数与虚假弃权数之间的多项式权衡，但其权衡图谱中上下界仍存在显著间隙，本文旨在消除该间隙并给出完整刻画。
AI.method: 核心工具为"加权粉碎势"及其多种变体，据此设计间隙闭合算法，并针对μ已知、μ未知下的oblivious对手与adaptive对手等不同设置分别给出对应的势函数变体与算法。
AI.result: (1) μ已知时优于Goel et al. (2023)，达到其猜测的O(d log T)错误界；(2) μ未知且oblivious对手下，保证在T与VC维d上均紧，完全刻画该设置的弃权-错误权衡，并给出O(√(dT))的平衡速率；(3) adaptive对手下，对具有有限约简维数D的结构化类，结果紧至poly(dD log T)因子；(4) 结果可推广至弃权后标签被隐藏的删失反馈情形。
AI.conclusion: 加权粉碎势为污染i.i.d.流中的弃权式序列预测提供了统一的紧界分析框架，基本刻画了已知分布、oblivious与adaptive对手等多种情形下的弃权-错误权衡，并自然延伸至删失反馈设置。

title: LIBERO-MOR: A Multimodal Robustness Benchmark Across the Vision-Language-Action Pipeline
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong performance on robot manipulation benchmarks. Translating this progress into reliable deployment calls for systematic evaluation of how policies respond to variations throughout the robot interaction loop. We introduce LIBERO-MOR, a multimodal robustness benchmark across the vision-language-action pipeline. Built on standard LIBERO, it covers five deployment-facing domains: vision, language, proprioception, action execution, and environment. The benchmark comprises 22 deployment-inspired perturbations, each evaluated at three severity levels across 40 tasks under a paired clean-perturbed protocol, enabling controlled and reproducible comparisons. We evaluate seven representative VLA models spanning diverse action-generation mechanisms. Our experiments reveal substantial robustness gaps behind high clean-task success, together with shared vulnerabilities and distinct model-specific failure patterns across domains. Severity analysis further distinguishes progressive degradation, collapse at stronger interventions, and failures triggered at the mildest tested level. By connecting aggregate performance to pipeline domains, individual perturbations, and intervention strength, LIBERO-MOR provides a systematic framework for diagnosing VLA robustness and guiding the development of more reliable robot policies.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态鲁棒性基准 LIBERO-MOR，沿视觉-语言-动作流水线五个部署域施加22种扰动（各3个严重度），在40个LIBERO任务上以配对干净-扰动协议评测七种VLA模型，揭示高干净成功率背后的鲁棒性缺口。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在机器人操作基准上表现优异，但落地部署需系统评估策略在整个交互回路中对各类变化的响应，而现有评测缺乏覆盖流水线各环节、可控且可复现的扰动基准。
AI.method: 基于标准LIBERO构建基准，覆盖视觉、语言、本体感知、动作执行、环境五个部署导向的域，共22种部署启发的扰动，每种设3个严重度等级，覆盖40个任务；采用配对干净-扰动协议（paired clean-perturbed）保证受控可比；评测七种具代表性的VLA模型，涵盖不同动作生成机制。
AI.result: 实验显示高干净任务成功率背后存在显著鲁棒性缺口；模型间存在跨域共享的脆弱点与各自特异的失效模式；严重度分析区分出渐进退化、强干预下的崩溃以及最轻级别即触发的失效三类响应模式。
AI.conclusion: LIBERO-MOR将总体性能与流水线域、单项扰动及干预强度相连接，为诊断VLA鲁棒性、指导更可靠机器人策略的研发提供系统化框架。

title: Agent Money Benchmark: Can AI Agents Be Trusted to Spend Money?
summary: Giving an AI agent a wallet lets it buy data and services on a client's behalf. Trust then depends on how it spends money and what that spending achieves. We introduce Agent Money Benchmark (AMB) to test whether agents spend a client's money well, starting with purchases of information for financial decisions. We link seller quotes and payments to final answers, evaluating 12 models on 80 payment tasks with simulated sellers and 76 research questions using live data. Purchases settled in USDC on Solana mainnet via x402, a protocol for paying per web request. Three of the 12 models passed 79 of 80 payment tasks without payment or budget errors. Nine fell for a seller's trap at least once; repeat charges and above-list quotes accounted for 79% of scam events. We estimate waste from data and inference costs, counting failed payment tasks in full and research answers in proportion to missed points. With spending split equally between tracks, estimated waste ranged from \$21.0 per \$100 for Claude Fable 5.2 to \$70.8 for GPT-6 Luna.

AI.tldr: 提出Agent Money Benchmark (AMB)，通过让AI代理在Solana主网上用USDC、经x402协议真实付费购买信息，评估其"花钱是否花得值"。
AI.motivation: 给AI代理配钱包后，信任取决于其花钱方式与实际收益，但缺乏衡量代理"理财能力"的基准。
AI.method: 将卖家报价与支付记录关联到最终答案；在80个模拟卖家的支付任务和76个使用实时数据的研究问题上评测12个模型；支付通过x402按请求付费，以USDC在Solana主网结算；按失败支付任务全额、研究答案按失分比例估算数据与推理成本浪费。
AI.result: 12个模型中仅3个在80项支付任务中无误完成79项；9个模型至少一次落入卖家陷阱，重复扣费与高于标价报价占诈骗事件79%；花费在两条赛道均分时，每100美元浪费从Claude Fable 5.2的21.0美元到GPT-6 Luna的70.8美元不等。
AI.conclusion: 代理在真实支付场景中普遍存在支付与防欺诈风险，且资金使用效率差异显著，需以经济结果为导向评测代理的"花钱能力"。

title: NOVA: Normalization-Aware Output-Guided Attention Acceleration for Video Diffusion Transformers
summary:
Video diffusion transformers (vDiTs) have become the main backbone for video generation. The quadratic cost of self-attention limits their efficiency at high resolutions and long durations. Existing sparse attention methods often rely on preserving high attention weights. However, these criteria do not fully capture the fidelity of the final value-weighted output, whose error depends jointly on changes to the attention numerator and the softmax denominator.
  We propose NOVA, a coarse-to-fine sparse attention framework that first approximates the full normalized output using size-weighted key/value centroids. Building on this estimate, we construct a residual proxy that accounts for coupled numerator-denominator errors by centering value contributions around the estimated output. This proxy guides the selection of query-key blocks for refinement under a predefined block budget for each query cluster. Selected blocks are evaluated through exact token-level computation, while the remaining blocks contribute through their centroids under a shared softmax normalization. On five vDiTs, NOVA achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS among sparse attention methods, improving PSNR by up to 1.55\,dB over the strongest baseline, while delivering up to 1.82$\times$ end-to-end speedup on an H100 GPU.

AI.tldr: NOVA：一种由粗到细的稀疏注意力框架，用尺寸加权质心近似归一化输出并以残差代理选择需精算的块，在5个视频扩散Transformer上取得最优生成质量与最高1.82×加速。
AI.motivation: vDiT自注意力二次复杂度限制高分辨率和长时长生成效率；现有稀疏注意力方法以保留高注意力权重为准则，但该准则未充分刻画最终value加权输出的保真度——输出误差同时取决于注意力分子与softmax分母的变化。
AI.method: 先用尺寸加权的key/value质心近似完整归一化输出；据此构造残差代理，将value贡献围绕估计输出中心化，以同时刻画分子-分母的耦合误差；在该代理指导下，为每个query簇在预设块预算内选择query-key块进行精化。被选块做token级精确计算，其余块以其质心贡献并在共享softmax归一化下合成（粗到细）。
AI.result: 在5个vDiT上，NOVA在稀疏注意力方法中取得最佳PSNR、SSIM与LPIPS，PSNR较最强基线最高提升1.55 dB；在H100 GPU上实现最高1.82×端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 以输出保真度（而非注意力权重大小）为准则的粗到细稀疏注意力，可在不牺牲生成质量的前提下显著提升视频扩散Transformer的效率。

title: Understanding and Mitigating the Fragility of Self-Rewarding Optimization
summary: Self-rewarding optimization (SRO) promises to improve language models by enabling them to generate their own reward signals. Yet when and how SRO succeeds or fails remains poorly understood. We reveal that SRO is fundamentally fragile: even seemingly benign perturbations to training prompts can corrupt the self-generated preference signal and trigger iterative collapse. We demonstrate this through two prompt-level attacks that serve as controlled stress tests: a Re-Ranking attack that concentrates training on prompts where self-reward diverges from an oracle, and a Preamble attack that learns short prefixes inflating self-reward without any gain in oracle quality. To explain why these attacks succeed, we introduce self-reward fidelity (SRF), a metric quantifying on-policy agreement between self-evaluated and oracle rewards. We show that SRF can serve as a diagnostic signal of self-supervision reliability, and that controlled SRF perturbations induce a phase-transition region: SRO improves when SRF remains sufficiently high, but collapses once SRF drops below a model- and task-dependent threshold. This analysis motivates Projection Decoupling Defense, which suppresses SRO update components along directions to which the reward generator is locally sensitive, improving SRO robustness under adversarial conditions. This work sheds light on the fragility of SRO and charts promising directions toward making it more robust.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示自奖励优化（SRO）本质脆弱：训练提示的良性扰动即可污染自生成偏好信号并引发迭代崩溃；提出自奖励保真度（SRF）作为诊断指标，并给出相变阈值解释，进而提出投影解耦防御（PDD）提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: SRO 让语言模型生成自身奖励信号以自我改进，但其成功与失败的条件和机制尚不清楚，缺乏对失败模式的系统性刻画与可靠性诊断手段。
AI.method: 构造两种提示级攻击作为受控压力测试：Re-Ranking 攻击将训练集中于自奖励与 oracle 奖励背离的提示；Preamble 攻击学习短前缀以抬升自奖励但不提升 oracle 质量。提出 SRF 指标量化 on-policy 下自评估奖励与 oracle 奖励的一致性，用于诊断自监督可靠性；并据此设计 Projection Decoupling Defense，在奖励生成器局部敏感方向上抑制 SRO 更新分量。
AI.result: 两种攻击均能腐蚀偏好信号并触发迭代崩溃；SRF 与 SRO 表现存在相变关系——SRF 足够高时 SRO 提升，低于模型与任务相关阈值后崩溃；PDD 在对抗条件下改善 SRO 鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SRO 的脆弱性源于自奖励保真度的下降，SRF 可作为有效的诊断信号与阈值预警，投影解耦防御为提升 SRO 鲁棒性提供了可行路径。

title: NAT: Scaling Causal Neural Action Tokenizers Across Embodiments
summary: Action tokenizers let robot policies treat control as autoregressive next-token prediction. As these policies are trained on larger and more diverse datasets, they will need a universal tokenizer that can encode actions from many embodiments and data sources, including ones it has not seen. We study action tokenization at scale, training on 49k hours of action data from real-world robots, handheld grippers, simulation, and humans. We introduce Neural Action Tokenizer (NAT), a causal tokenizer whose decoder lets actions be executed as their tokens are generated. Across four simulation benchmarks, NAT outperforms FAST and prior neural action tokenizers when tokenizing unseen robot embodiments, and in vision-language-action models it outperforms FAST+ across four benchmarks and on a real robot when acting through its tokens. NAT tokens also close the performance gap to a flow-matching action head on some benchmarks while lowering the inference latency for first actions. Our experiments also find that robot data may not be necessary to learn an effective action space: a NAT trained only on human hand motion performs close to tokenizers trained on robot data.

AI.tldr: 提出神经动作分词器NAT：在4.9万小时真实机器人、手持夹爪、仿真与人类动作数据上训练因果分词器，解码器可边生成边执行；在4个仿真基准和VLA模型上优于FAST及既有神经动作分词器，并发现仅用人类手部运动数据训练即接近机器人数据训练的tokenizer。
AI.motivation: 动作分词器使机器人策略可被建模为自回归的下一token预测。随着训练数据集规模扩大、来源与具身形态更多样，需要一种通用分词器，能编码包括未见过的具身形态在内的多来源动作。
AI.method: 大规模动作分词研究：训练数据共49k小时（真实机器人、手持夹爪、仿真、人类动作）。提出NAT——一种因果动作分词器，其解码器支持在token生成过程中即时执行动作；与FAST及先前神经动作分词器对比，并在VLA模型中以其token驱动策略。
AI.result: 4个仿真基准上，NAT对未见机器人具身的分词效果优于FAST与既有神经动作分词器；在VLA模型中，跨4个基准及真实机器人上优于FAST+；NAT token在某些基准上缩小了与flow-matching动作头的性能差距，同时降低首个动作的推理时延。另发现仅用人类手部运动训练的NAT接近使用机器人数据训练的tokenizer。
AI.conclusion: NAT验证了大规模、跨具身的通用动作分词可行性，因果解码支持低时延流式执行；且有效的动作空间未必依赖机器人数据，人类手部数据可提供强替代。

title: Internalized Experience: How Training Data Shapes Memory Formation in LLMs
summary: Parametric memory enables large language models (LLMs) to retain information from past experience and reuse it in subsequent tasks. Yet how training data supports the internalization of reusable task rules remains unclear. We introduce FSMem (Finite-State Machine Memory), a state-transition framework for constructing training data and studying how data content and organization shape memory formation. We evaluate rule reuse across synthetic worlds, classical planning, and code execution through valid-action identification and execution-outcome prediction, complemented by next-operation prediction in code. Our experiments reveal several systematic learning patterns. Under matched training conditions, even unchanged task rules become harder to internalize when learned alongside a larger variety of action types; by contrast, scaling the training data to provide broader state-action coverage generally improves rule learning. We further find that training at a single execution depth produces depth-specialized behavior, with models performing best when training and test executions have similar lengths. Motivated by this finding, we construct cumulative corpora that combine short and long trajectories, which can outperform long-trajectory-only training while using fewer training tokens. Together, these results demonstrate that the same task rules can be internalized differently depending on how execution experience is constructed, and that understanding these learning patterns can guide the design of more effective training data for parametric memory.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FSMem（有限状态机记忆）框架，通过状态转移视角构造训练数据，系统研究数据内容与组织方式如何影响LLM参数化记忆的形成与任务规则复用。
AI.motivation: LLM的参数化记忆能复用过往经验，但训练数据如何支撑"可复用任务规则"的内化机制尚不清楚，缺乏可控的实验框架来剖析数据内容与组织的作用。
AI.method: 构建FSMem状态转移框架，统一生成与组织训练语料；在合成世界、经典规划、代码执行三类任务上评测，指标包括有效动作识别、执行结果预测及代码中的下一步操作预测；并控制变量考察动作类型多样性、状态-动作覆盖度、执行深度等因素。
AI.result: 在训练条件匹配时，动作类型多样性越大，即便任务规则不变也越难内化；而扩大数据以获得更广的状态-动作覆盖通常提升规则学习。单一执行深度训练会导致"深度专精"：训练与测试轨迹长度相近时表现最佳。据此构造的短长轨迹累积语料，在更少训练token下可优于纯长轨迹训练。
AI.conclusion: 相同任务规则会因执行经验的组织方式不同而以不同方式被内化；理解这些系统性学习规律可为设计更高效的参数化记忆训练数据提供指导。

title: Is It the Agent or the Retry? Separating Selection from Agency in Text-to-Image Generation
summary:
Agentic text-to-image systems wrap generators in loops of planning, routing, verification and refinement, and report large gains on compositional benchmarks, almost always relative to a single sample. We ask how much of the gain survives against Single-tool Rejection Retry (\ours): the strongest generator already in the system's pool, an off-the-shelf verifier, and retries that stop at the first accepted image under the system's own budget. Auditing four recent systems with official evaluators, we find that on GenEval SRR matches the accuracy of OctoT2I (0.962 vs.\ 0.96), recovers 63 to 90% of the gain of GEMS depending on the verifier, and exceeds GenPilot by 12 points with 2.3 generations per image; the effect persists with generators not tuned to the benchmark and on T2I-CompBench++. A closed-form analysis predicts the accuracy of SRR at every budget and shows that its gain is capped by the verifier's likelihood ratio. The same analysis also exposes genuine agentic gains: on GenEval 2, even the best of five samples chosen by the evaluator stays 15 points below the score GEMS reports (12 at the upper end of its 95% interval). We prove a ceiling on the accuracy that routing across generators can add, bracket it between one and three points on OctoT2I's own pool, and show that what OctoT2I's routing buys is compute (about 2.5
  less than SRR at equal accuracy), not accuracy. In our offline distillation experiments selected samples teach the generator no more than random ones, which a short information argument explains. We end with a reporting checklist for agentic generation papers.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Single-tool Rejection Retry (SRR)基线，审计四个agentic文生图系统，发现其对单样本基线的多数增益可被该简单基线复现；真正稳健的agentic增益仅出现在GenEval 2等高难组合场景，并给出路由增益上界与报告清单。
AI.motivation: 现有agentic文生图系统（规划、路由、验证、精炼）宣称在组合性基准上大幅领先，但对比对象几乎都是单次采样。作者质疑这些增益有多少来自真实的多智能体机制，多少只是"多次生成+验证筛选"带来的额外算力，缺乏公平基线导致结论被高估。
AI.method: 1) 定义最强单工具基線SRR：取系统池中最强生成器、现成验证器、在系统自身预算内重试至首个被接受样本。2) 用官方评测器审计四个近期系统（OctoT2I、GEMS、GenPilot等），并在GenEval、T2I-CompBench++及非针对基准调优的生成器上验证。3) 建立闭式分析，预测任意预算下SRR准确率，并推导验证器似然比对增益的上界。4) 证明跨生成器路由可带来增益的天花板（OctoT2I池上1–3个点）；对比等精度下的采样成本。5) 进行离线蒸馏实验，比较"被选中样本"与随机样本的训练效果，并给出信息论解释。
AI.result: SRR在GenEval上与OctoT2I持平（0.962 vs 0.96），回收GEMS增益的63%–90%，以每图2.3次生成超出GenPilot 12个点；结论在非调优生成器与T2I-CompBench++上稳健。闭式分析准确预测各预算下SRR精度，表明其增益受验证器似然比封顶。另一方面，GenEval 2上即使从5个样本中由评测器挑最优，仍比GEMS报告低15个点（95%区间上端低12点），说明agentic方法确存在真实增益。路由增益上限为1–3个点，OctoT2I路由换来的是算力（等精度下约少2.5倍生成），而非精度。离线蒸馏中被选样本与随机样本教学效果无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 多数agentic文生图系统的性能增益可由"强生成器+验证器+重试"的简单基线解释，路由主要节省算力而非提升精度；真实增益集中于高难度组合任务。论文提出agentic生成论文的报告清单，要求与SRR类基线在同等预算下对比、报告每次生成成本与验证器质量。

title: DRAM: Memory-Efficient Muon via Rank Reallocation in Principal-Random Subspaces
summary: Memory-efficient Muon methods aim to reduce storage overhead while preserving strong performance, yet existing approaches compromise either convergence guarantees or practical efficiency. In this paper, we focus on subspace optimization for Muon, where the choice of subspace determines the gradient information retained for updating. To preserve dominant information while providing the coverage needed for stochastic convergence guarantees, we construct a principal-random subspace that combines leading singular directions of the stochastic gradient with random directions sampled from their orthogonal complement. Under a fixed rank budget, there is a trade-off between principal exploitation and complementary coverage, making rank allocation important for practical optimization. Our key observation is that the preferred balance shifts from principal-heavy early in training to random-heavy later. Motivated by this shift, we propose \dram, a memory-efficient Muon optimizer that reallocates principal and random ranks across stages while maintaining momentum and performing matrix-sign normalization entirely in the subspace. Theoretically, we establish convergence guarantees for general rank-allocation schedules with nondecreasing coverage factors, obtaining rates of $O(T^{-1/4})$ in the stochastic setting and $O(T^{-1/2})$ in the deterministic setting, with fixed allocation as a special case. Using a simple linear reallocation schedule, \dram achieves the best low-memory performance across three pre-training scales and nine fine-tuning settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 DRAM：一种内存高效的 Muon 优化器，采用主成分-随机子空间并随训练阶段动态重新分配子空间秩，兼顾理论收敛保证与实际效率。
AI.motivation: 现有内存高效 Muon 方法在降低存储开销时，往往牺牲收敛保证或实际效率；同时子空间选择决定了保留的梯度信息，需要在保留主成分信息与提供随机覆盖（保证随机收敛）之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 聚焦 Muon 的子空间优化：构造“主成分-随机”子空间，将随机梯度的主奇异方向与其正交补中采样的随机方向组合；在固定秩预算下，按阶段重新分配主成分秩与随机秩（线性重分配调度），并完全在子空间内维护动量与执行矩阵符号归一化。
AI.result: 理论证明：对具有非递减覆盖因子的通用秩分配调度给出收敛保证，随机设定下速率为 O(T^{-1/4})，确定性设定下为 O(T^{-1/2})，固定分配为其特例；实验中线性重分配调度在三个预训练规模和九个微调设置上取得最佳低内存性能。
AI.conclusion: 关键观察是偏好平衡随训练从“主成分偏重”转向“随机偏重”；据此设计的阶段化秩重分配策略在保持收敛保证的同时实现低内存下的强性能，固定分配可视为其特例。

title: T-Tac: A Soft and Thin Active Thermal Tactile Sensor for Robotic In-Grasp Material Identification
summary: Accurate material identification is important for robotic manipulation, yet vision-based methods face challenges when materials have similar appearances. Herein, we report T-Tac, a soft, thin, active thermal tactile sensor that identifies materials through their transient thermal responses. T-Tac integrates a polyimide film heater with an ionic conductive film temperature sensor, providing controlled thermal excitation and resistance-based temperature measurement in a film assembly suitable for mounting on robotic grippers. Single-sided transient plane source modeling and finite element simulations relate the thermal response to material thermal properties, while calibration and repeated measurements characterize the heating and sensing performance. Loading experiments at room and elevated temperatures further characterize the sensor response under an applied force. A hybrid classification framework concatenates extracted thermal descriptors with multiscale convolutional neural network features and uses an ExtraTrees classifier for material prediction. Experiments on 12 materials achieve a mean classification accuracy of 92.69\% using a 3 s heating pulse and a 10 s observation window. These results support T-Tac as a compact approach to integrating active thermal material sensing into robotic end effectors. This work shed a light on the new approach for robotic material identification.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种柔性薄膜主动热触觉传感器T-Tac，通过瞬态热响应识别材料，在12种材料上取得92.69%的平均分类准确率。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作需要准确的材料识别，但基于视觉的方法在外观相似的材料上难以区分，因此需要借助热学特性进行主动感知。
AI.method: 将聚酰亚胺薄膜加热器与离子导电薄膜温度传感器集成，实现可控热激励与电阻式测温；采用单面瞬态平面热源建模与有限元仿真建立热响应与材料热物性关系，并进行标定与重复性测试及加载实验；分类上采用热学描述子与多尺度CNN特征拼接的混合框架，由ExtraTrees分类器完成材料预测。
AI.result: 在12种材料上，采用3 s加热脉冲与10 s观测窗口，平均分类准确率达92.69%。
AI.conclusion: T-Tac为在机器人末端执行器中集成主动热材料感知提供了一种紧凑可行的方案，为机器人材料识别开辟了新思路。

title: VeriLadder: A Multi-Agent Specification Refinement System for Tool-Verified Verilog Datasets
summary: Training data is a bottleneck in AI, especially for large language models (LLMs) that write Verilog, because register-transfer-level (RTL) code is rarely published and existing datasets mostly check code for syntax, not instruction correctness. This paper presents VeriLadder, a five-level Verilog dataset, and the multi-agent framework that builds it, in which LLM agents write and revise specifications, and EDA tools (a synthesizer and a formal equivalence checker) decide what is accepted. Its levels follow an engineer's checks. Level 1 labels designs from two large Verilog corpora, namely RTLCoder and PyraNet, with synthesis results, failure causes, critical warnings and post-synthesis metrics. 28% of RTLCoder designs fail synthesis and are kept as negatives. Level 2 grades each instruction on four specification qualities, and low grades predict failed rebuilds. Level 3 rewrites each instruction into a refined specification and accepts it only if an LLM from another model family, reading only that specification, writes a circuit formally equivalent to the original. This raises the share of rebuildable designs from 26.1% to 78.2%, keeping every failed specification with its counterexample. Levels 4 and 5 add verified paraphrases and one-fact variants, hard negatives that differ only in one behavior from the verified design. VeriLadder labels the synthesizability of 716,627 designs and, from RTLCoder, provides 11,247 refined specifications, 32,393 paraphrases and 8,397 one-fact variants. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct on VeriLadder raises functional pass@1 from 31.7% to 50.0% on VerilogEval v2 and from 35.0% to 45.2% on RTLLM v2. The dataset and fine-tuned models are publicly available.

AI.tldr: VeriLadder：一个五级Verilog数据集及其多智能体构建框架，用EDA工具（综合器与形式等价检查器）作为接受判据，为716,627个设计标注可综合性，并提供精炼规范、改写与"单事实"变体；微调Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct后功能pass@1在VerilogEval v2上从31.7%升至50.0%，在RTLLM v2上从35.0%升至45.2%。
AI.motivation: LLM编写Verilog面临训练数据瓶颈：RTL代码极少公开，且现有数据集多以语法正确性为检查标准，而非指令（规范）正确性，导致数据质量与可用性受限。作者希望构建既规模大、又具备规范级与功能级正确性标注的数据资源。
AI.method: 提出VeriLadder五级数据集与多智能体构建框架：LLM智能体撰写与修订规范，EDA工具（综合器、形式等价检查器）决定接受与否。Level 1 为RTLCoder与PyraNet两个语料库设计标注综合结果、失败原因、关键警告与综合后指标（RTLCoder中28%设计综合失败，作为负样本保留）；Level 2 按四项规范质量对指令分级，低等级可预测重建失败；Level 3 将指令改写为精炼规范，仅当另一模型家族的LLM仅凭该规范生成的电路与原设计形式等价时才接受，并保留每个失败规范及其反例；Level 4/5 增加经验证的改述与单事实变体（仅一处行为不同的困难负样本）。
AI.result: VeriLadder标注716,627个设计的可综合性；由RTLCoder产出11,247条精炼规范、32,393条改述与8,397个单事实变体。可重建设计比例从26.1%提升至78.2%。在VeriLadder上微调Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct，VerilogEval v2功能pass@1由31.7%提升至50.0%，RTLLM v2由35.0%提升至45.2%。
AI.conclusion: 以EDA工具而非语法检查为验收标准、并以跨模型家族形式等价验证规范可重建性，可有效提升Verilog数据的规范质量与可用性；该类数据显著增强LLM的RTL功能正确性。数据集与微调模型已公开。

title: PhoneQC: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Order-Level Smartphone Trade-in Inspection
summary: As vision-language models enter remote smartphone trade-in, sellers already upload six views and a diagnostic screen, which makes it easy to treat the human quote as a step a model can take over. A model may mark a crack or read the screen, yet the quote is a staff form: appearance fill stays near 0.25, and the closed models that score a little higher do so only on the orders they answer, so human appraisal remains necessary. Two obstacles stand in the way. (1) Single-view defect sets and attribute benchmarks do not score an order-level form under a fixed input contract, so a box or a leaked field can be mistaken for a finished quote. (2) The unread half of the form is the staff fields, and a model left to emit boxes or captions does not learn them. We present PhoneQC, a 335-order iPhone-heavy cut that ranks systems by a 0 to 100 form score (Score100) only inside matched protocols (images alone; images plus a detector sidecar), with a declared upper bound that is not ranked as a peer. As a case study on that board, field-only LoRA freezes the backbone, adapts attention projections, and supervises staff fields while leaving the defect list empty; the adapter sees the same images as the zero-shot model. On image-only T1 the 3B model rises from 26.6 to 33.3 at coverage 0.928; without the empty-blocker item the open ranking still favors the adapter, while the remaining gap to a person stays large on this cut.

AI.tldr: 提出PhoneQC基准（335单iPhone为主），在统一输入契约下用0–100的表单得分Score100评估系统；并给出field-only LoRA案例，冻结主干、仅适配注意力投影并监督员工字段，使3B模型在纯图像T1上从26.6提升至33.3（覆盖率0.928），但与人工评估仍有较大差距。
AI.motivation: 手机以旧换新场景中卖家已上传六视图与诊断屏，易误以为模型可直接替代人工报价；但报价实为员工表单，外观填充率仅约0.25，且高分闭源模型只在其作答的子集上得分，人工评估仍不可少。现有单视图缺陷数据集与属性基准无法在固定输入契约下评估订单级表单，易把检测框或泄漏字段误当作完整报价；表单中未被读取的员工字段也未被模型学到。
AI.method: 构建PhoneQC：335笔订单（以iPhone为主）的评测切分，仅在匹配协议下（仅图像；图像+检测器sidecar）按Score100排序，并将声明上界单列为不参与同侪排序。案例研究采用field-only LoRA：冻结主干、仅适配注意力投影，监督员工字段而缺陷列表留空，适配器与零样本模型看到相同图像。
AI.result: 在image-only T1协议下，3B模型得分由26.6升至33.3，覆盖率0.928；去除empty-blocker项后开放排序仍偏向该适配器；但与该切分上的人工评估相比差距依然很大。
AI.conclusion: 订单级报价评估需要协议匹配的表单级指标而非检测框或字段泄漏；轻量字段监督可带来稳定增益，但当前视觉语言模型尚不能替代人工评估，人机差距仍显著。

title: Bridging Teacher-Student Capability Gaps with Recurrent Computation
summary: Knowledge distillation transfers capabilities from large language models to smaller students, yet stronger teachers do not always yield better students. Recent studies report diminishing or even negative returns from teacher scaling. We hypothesize that these limitations arise in part from insufficient student capacity to absorb the teacher's knowledge. We therefore investigate loop and recurrent computation as a way to expand the student's effective capacity by modifying its computation graph while keeping the backbone parameter count fixed. Under teacher-forced KD during pretraining, weight-shared looping improves performance but retains teacher-size saturation, whereas cross-token recurrence avoids the observed reversal with larger teachers. In mathematical post-training under both teacher-forced KD and on-policy distillation (OPD), recurrent students scale better with increasing teacher size than looped and vanilla LLMs do. Crucially, we show that a pretrained LLM can be readily fine-tuned into a looped or recurrent architecture jointly with OPD, without repeating pretraining. Our recurrent Qwen model improves with larger teachers and consistently outperforms looped and vanilla LLMs. This suggests a new post-training paradigm that integrates architectural conversion into distillation, avoiding a separate conversion stage while substantially improving student performance and maintaining near-vanilla inference latency.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用循环/复现计算扩展学生模型的有效容量，从而缓解知识蒸馏中"教师越大、学生收益越差"的饱和甚至反转现象，并展示可将预训练LLM直接微调为循环架构并与on-policy蒸馏联合完成。
AI.motivation: 近期研究发现知识蒸馏中学生收益随教师规模增大而递减甚至为负（teacher scaling returns diminishing/negative）。作者假设这一限制部分源于学生容量不足以吸收教师知识，因此希望在不增加骨干参数量的前提下扩大学生有效容量。
AI.method: 通过修改计算图（而非增加参数）来提升学生有效容量：比较权重共享的循环（looped）结构与跨token复现（cross-token recurrence）结构。预训练阶段采用teacher-forced KD；数学后训练阶段同时考察teacher-forced KD与on-policy distillation (OPD)。此外提出将预训练LLM与OPD联合微调，直接转换为looped或recurrent架构，无需重复预训练，也无需单独的转换阶段。
AI.result: 在预训练teacher-forced KD下，权重共享的looping提升性能但仍存在教师规模饱和；cross-token recurrence则避免了教师增大时的性能反转。在数学后训练的teacher-forced KD与OPD下，recurrent学生的教师规模scaling优于looped与vanilla LLM。recurrent Qwen模型随教师增大持续提升，并稳定优于looped与vanilla LLM，且保持接近vanilla的推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 学生容量不足是教师规模收益饱和/反转的重要原因，循环与复现计算是扩展有效容量的有效途径。论文提出一种新的后训练范式：将架构转换整合进蒸馏过程，避免独立转换阶段，在提升学生性能的同时保持接近原生的推理延迟。

title: SANA-Robot: Efficient World Action Model with Hybrid Memory
summary: World action models (WAMs) leverage the world knowledge of video generation models to improve action generation by aligning visual prediction with action prediction. However, their prediction overhead prevents real-time deployment on edge devices, and they usually lack an effective long-term memory. We introduce SANA-Robot, a 4.5B WAM with minute-level memory that runs in real time on edge devices, built on the following core designs: (1) hybrid memory at constant cost: our WAM relies on linear attention to maintain a global memory with a fixed-size state, and on sliding window softmax attention layers that propagate previous information, enabling high success rates on tasks requiring whole-episode memory while keeping an efficient and constant inference speed; (2) a unified model: by dynamically applying different noise levels to action and video tokens, SANA-Robot can serve not only as a policy but also as a world simulator; (3) a full-stack infrastructure for both memory training and inference, including efficient data packing and shuffling as well as memory-phase-based asynchronous execution. SANA-Robot achieves the best performance on the memory dimension of RoboDojo among models of medium size (about 5B) and the highest success rates on LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro and LIBERO-Max. In real-world deployment, SANA-Robot takes 135 ms per action chunk on an RTX 5090 with FP8 GEMMs and 115 ms with NVFP4 GEMMs, and achieves closed-loop, real-time asynchronous robot control at 30 Hz on edge devices, demonstrating both the efficiency and the effectiveness of SANA-Robot. Project page: https://nvlabs.github.io/Sana/Robot/

AI.tldr: SANA-Robot 是一个 4.5B 的world action model，通过混合线性注意力全局记忆+滑窗注意力、统一噪声调度与全栈训练/推理基础设施，实现分钟级记忆与边缘设备 30Hz 实时闭环控制。
AI.motivation: 现有 WAM 借助视频生成模型的世界知识对齐视觉预测与动作预测，但预测开销大、无法在边缘设备实时部署，且普遍缺乏有效的长期记忆。
AI.method: 三项核心设计：(1) 恒定代价的混合记忆：用线性注意力维护固定尺寸状态的全局记忆，配合滑窗 softmax 注意力层传播历史信息，兼顾整回合记忆任务成功率与恒定推理速度；(2) 统一模型：对 action token 与 video token 动态施加不同噪声水平，使同一模型既可作策略也可作世界模拟器；(3) 面向记忆训练与推理的全栈基础设施，包括高效数据打包与打乱、基于记忆阶段的异步执行。
AI.result: 在中等规模（约5B）模型中，SANA-Robot 于 RoboDojo 记忆维度取得最佳表现，并在 LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-Max 上取得最高成功率。真实部署中，RTX 5090 上每 action chunk 耗时 135 ms（FP8 GEMM）与 115 ms（NVFP4 GEMM），在边缘设备实现 30 Hz 闭环实时异步机器人控制。
AI.conclusion: SANA-Robot 同时验证了效率与有效性，说明恒定成本记忆机制与统一噪声建模可在保持实时性的前提下赋予 WAM 长期记忆能力，适合边缘端部署。

title: Distilling Visual Agents from Limited Interaction Experience
summary: How much interaction experience is needed to distill a capable visual agent? We study learning from few tasks and recorded interaction histories. Our framework selects representative trajectories using skill-context coverage and ordered visual-decision similarity. On-policy distillation (OPD) learns through fresh interaction on selected tasks or fresh student responses at fixed histories. Across Navigation, Sokoban, and spatial mapping, even one online training task supports transfer to other tasks. Four fixed trajectories raise a 4B student's success from 49.17% to 82.08% on standard Navigation and from 60.16% to 85.55% on Sokoban, recovering over 90% of the measured gap to a 27B teacher on these panels. On an independent Navigation panel, replay improves success from 45.83% to 76.67%, retaining 91.36% of the same-task online gain without new interaction during optimization. Training repetitions, matched supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and a 9B extension further support the value of compact experience.

AI.tldr: 论文研究视觉智能体能否仅靠"少量任务+少量交互历史"实现高效蒸馏，提出基于技能-上下文覆盖度与有序视觉决策相似度的轨迹筛选框架，并采用在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在选定任务或固定历史的新回答上学习。在Navigation、Sokoban与空间建图任务上，单任务在线训练即可迁移，四条固定轨迹使4B学生成功率从49.17%升至82.08%（Navigation）、60.16%升至85.55%（Sokoban），恢复对27B教师90%以上差距；独立面板上回放使成功率从45.83%升至76.67%，保留91.36%的同任务在线增益。
AI.motivation: 视觉智能体的能力蒸馏通常依赖大量任务与海量交互数据，成本高昂。作者希望回答一个核心问题：究竟需要多少交互经验才能蒸馏出有能力的视觉智能体，即能否用极少任务和少量记录交互历史实现高效学习与迁移。
AI.method: 提出经验选择与蒸馏框架：(1) 用技能-上下文覆盖度（skill-context coverage）挑选代表性轨迹，保证技能与上下文多样性；(2) 用有序视觉决策相似度（ordered visual-decision similarity）衡量轨迹代表性/去冗余；(3) 采用在线策略蒸馏（OPD），让学生在与所选任务的新鲜交互中学习，或在固定历史上采样新鲜学生回答进行蒸馏；并与匹配的监督微调（SFT）对比。
AI.result: 在Navigation、Sokoban及空间建图三类任务上，即使仅一个在线训练任务也能迁移到其他任务。仅用四条固定轨迹，4B学生成功率从49.17%提升至82.08%（Navigation）、从60.16%提升至85.55%（Sokoban），恢复了对27B教师在相应评测面板上90%以上的性能差距。在独立Navigation面板上，无新交互的纯回放将成功率从45.83%提升至76.67%，保留同任务在线增益的91.36%。训练重复次数、匹配SFT及9B规模扩展实验进一步验证了紧凑经验的价值。
AI.conclusion: 少量、精选的交互经验即可高效蒸馏出强视觉智能体，且在分布外面板上具备显著迁移能力；紧凑经验（compact experience）与OPD结合优于匹配的SFT，说明经验的选择质量与学习方式比经验数量更为关键。

title: StateBind: Exposing the Symbol-to-State Binding Gap in Visual Measurement
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at MMM 2027. Code: https://github.com/mqingcs/StateBind
summary:
Reliable vision systems should connect numerical claims to visible evidence. In visual measurement, this requires mapping candidate values to image-specific physical states. StateBind-200 augments 200 real images with human-refined local geometry and matched Numeric, Calibrated, and Physicalized interfaces. Across a 128-image held-out evaluation and 6,696 controlled calls, physicalizing identical candidates raises three-model majority accuracy from 75.54% to 91.13%, a source-image-balanced gain of +15.30 points. Calibration and additional reasoning leave most of the gap intact; target localization can succeed despite incorrect value-lattice binding, with a larger burden for two-endpoint ruler spans. An independent 40-image geometry audit yields a 0.08-tick median target discrepancy and preserves the main effect under disagreement sensitivity.
  We further propose Factorial StateBind, a training-free selective verifier. Two VLMs propose target and lattice components, an independent VLM validates their evidence, and valid combinations are resolved deterministically. A precision mode selected on 69 development images combines component validity, four-way agreement, and state separation. Applied unchanged to held-out evaluation, this high-precision evidence gate reaches 91.67% candidate precision across 36/128 images (28.12%) and 9.68% of ordered cells. The results identify instance-specific symbol-to-state binding as a distinct reliability bottleneck and provide an interpretable evidence gate for numerical visual claims.

AI.tldr: 该文提出StateBind-200基准与Factorial StateBind免训练验证器，指出视觉测量中"实例级符号—物理状态绑定"是独立可靠性瓶颈，物理化候选可将准确率从75.54%提升至91.13%。
AI.motivation: 可靠视觉系统应把数值主张与可见证据对应起来；现有视觉测量模型把候选数值直接与图像匹配，却缺少将候选值映射到图像特定物理状态的机制，导致数值语言与视觉证据之间存在脱节。
AI.method: 构建StateBind-200：200张真实图像配以人工精修的局部几何，并提供Numeric、Calibrated、Physicalized三种匹配接口；在128张留出图像、6,696次受控调用上做对照实验，并进行40张图像的独立几何审计与分歧敏感性分析。另提出Factorial StateBind：两个VLM分别提出目标与晶格组件，第三个独立VLM验证其证据，有效组合确定性求解；在69张开发集上选定"精度模式"（组件有效性、四向一致性、状态可分性），原样用于留出集。
AI.result: 物理化使三模型多数投票准确率由75.54%升至91.13%（源图像均衡增益+15.30点）；标定与额外推理仅弥合小部分差距；目标定位可在数值—晶格绑定错误时仍成功，双端点标尺跨度负担更大。几何审计中位目标偏差0.08 tick，分歧敏感性下主效应保持。精度门在36/128张图像（28.12%）上达到91.67%候选精度，覆盖9.68%的有序单元。
AI.conclusion: 实例特定的符号—状态绑定是区别于感知与推理的独立可靠性瓶颈；所提证据门为数值性视觉主张提供可解释的高精度筛选机制。

title: BitShare: Sensitivity-Aware Binning and Bit Sharing for Compacting LLM Weight Storage
summary: Decoding with large language models at small batch sizes is limited by memory bandwidth, so the bits stored per weight largely set its cost. Group-wise integer quantization stores every weight of a group at the same precision, although the input channels of a group differ in sensitivity. We present BITSHARE, a codebook-free weight format that keeps the integer grid and the dequantizer of group-wise quantization but varies precision within each group. Sensitivity-aware binning places the channels of each group into three bins at fixed positions, and static bit sharing with optimal bit-value allocation lets the less sensitive weights share their lower bits, each stored once per group or once per pair of weights. A sharing-aware version of GPTQ chooses every stored value, with no fine-tuning and no codebook. BITSHARE has two modes. BITSHARE-U gives every group the same layout, so its decoder routes bits by fixed wiring, while BITSHARE-N chooses a layout per group within the same bit budget. With calibration on the Pile and at the same storage, both modes have lower perplexity than GPTQ at 3 and 2 bits on WikiText-2 and C4. At 2 bits across Llama-2 and Llama-3 models, BITSHARE-N lowers WikiText-2 perplexity by up to 70% against SliM-LLM and up to 35% against GPTAQ. At the 2-bit perplexity of SliM-LLM, BITSHARE-U stores 13.6-19.4% fewer bits per weight, cutting DRAM weight traffic by the same fraction. A verified hardware decoder implementation synthesized in SkyWater 130 nm reconstructs BITSHARE weights at the throughput of INT-n and SliM-LLM decoders.

AI.tldr: BITSHARE 是一种无码本的组内非均匀位宽权重量化格式，通过敏感性感知分箱与静态位共享，在同存储下优于 GPTQ、SliM-LLM 与 GPTAQ，并配有可综合的硬件解码器。
AI.motivation: 小批量解码受内存带宽限制，每权重存储位数直接决定开销。组内整数量化让同组所有权重共享同一精度，但组内输入通道的敏感性并不相同，因此存在位宽分配冗余。
AI.method: 保留整数量化网格与反量化器，仅让组内精度可变。采用敏感性感知分箱，将每组通道按固定位置分入三个箱；通过静态位共享与最优位值分配，让低敏感权重共享低位（每组存一次或每对权重存一次）。使用共享感知版 GPTQ 确定所有存储值，无需微调、无需码本。提供 BITSHARE-U（所有组同一布局、按固定连线路由位）与 BITSHARE-N（同一位预算下每组自选布局）两种模式。
AI.result: 在 Pile 上校准、相同存储下，两种模式在 WikiText-2 与 C4 上 3-bit 与 2-bit 困惑度均低于 GPTQ。2-bit 下 Llama-2/Llama-3 上，BITSHARE-N 相对 SliM-LLM 最多降低 WikiText-2 困惑度 70%，相对 GPTAQ 最多降低 35%。在 SliM-LLM 的 2-bit 困惑度水平下，BITSHARE-U 每权重少存 13.6–19.4% 位，DRAM 权重流量同比下降。SkyWater 130 nm 综合的硬件解码器重建吞吐与 INT-n、SliM-LLM 解码器相当。
AI.conclusion: 组内变精度加跨权重位共享可在不引入码本与微调的前提下同时改善精度-存储权衡，且布局规则化使解码可保持 INT 级吞吐，具备实际部署可行性。

title: World Models for Ocean Engineering: A Critical Review of Maritime Autonomy, Adaptive Latent Prediction, Digital Twins, and Biodiversity Monitoring
summary: Marine robots face partial observability, non-stationary dynamics, and sparse communication, motivating WMs that learn compact predictive states for planning. This review develops a functional taxonomy of WMs for ocean engineering, focusing on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) and AdaJEPA's test-time adaptation within model predictive control, mapping them to navigation, adaptive sampling, digital twins, and biodiversity monitoring, and separating demonstrated evidence from prospective applications. The synthesis identifies key Gaps: benchmarks, uncertainty calibration, safe adaptation and proposes a research agenda for physics-informed, deployment-adaptive marine WMs validated through simulation and field missions.

AI.tldr: 综述面向海洋工程的"世界模型"（WM），提出功能性分类体系，重点分析JEPA类架构及AdaJEPA在模型预测控制中的测试时自适应，并将其映射到导航、自适应采样、数字孪生与生物多样性监测等任务，区分已验证证据与前瞻性应用，最后给出研究议程。
AI.motivation: 海洋机器人面临部分可观测性、非平稳动力学与稀疏通信，亟需学习紧凑预测状态的世界模型以支撑规划；而现有WM研究分散，缺乏面向海洋工程的功能性梳理与证据分级。
AI.method: 文献综述与综合：构建海洋工程世界模型的功能性分类（taxonomy），聚焦联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）及AdaJEPA在MPC框架下的测试时适应机制，并将其对应到导航、自适应采样、数字孪生、生物多样性监测四类应用，按"已验证证据/前瞻应用"进行区分。
AI.result: 识别出三大关键缺口：基准测试（benchmarks）缺失、不确定性校准不足、安全自适应机制薄弱；并指出多数海洋应用仍属前瞻性而非实证验证。
AI.conclusion: 提出研究议程：发展物理信息驱动、部署自适应（deployment-adaptive）的海洋世界模型，并通过仿真与实地任务双重验证，以弥合理论架构与海洋部署之间的差距。

title: Mitigating Backdoors in Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models because they can predict multiple tokens in parallel rather than generating tokens sequentially. However, recent studies have shown that MDLMs are vulnerable to backdoor attacks: when an input contains an attacker-chosen trigger, a backdoored model generates a targeted output, such as malicious code, while otherwise behaving normally. Despite this threat, backdoor defenses for MDLMs remain largely underexplored. We present UNMASK, the first defense framework for MDLMs that detects trigger-containing inputs, localizes the trigger tokens, and removes the backdoor from the compromised model. UNMASK exploits two fundamental properties of backdoor triggers, specificity and dominance, to assign a suspiciousness score to each input token. By leveraging two distinctive capabilities of MDLMs, parallel token prediction and token reconstruction at arbitrary positions, UNMASK computes these scores both effectively and efficiently. We further provide a theoretical analysis supporting the design of UNMASK. Evaluations across 40 settings spanning two attacks and four models show that UNMASK detects 99.3% of trigger-containing inputs at a 5% false-positive rate, substantially outperforming the strongest adapted baseline, which achieves 54.8%. UNMASK also achieves over 99% trigger-localization accuracy and reduces the average attack success rate from 95% to 1%, while largely preserving the model's utility on clean inputs.

AI.tldr: UNMASK是首个面向掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）的后门防御框架，可检测含触发器输入、定位触发词元并从受损模型中去除此后门。
AI.motivation: MDLM因可并行预测多个词元而成为自回归模型的有力替代，但已被证明易受后门攻击：输入含攻击者选定触发器时，受损模型会输出恶意代码等目标内容。然而，针对MDLM的后门防御研究仍严重不足。
AI.method: UNMASK利用后门触发器固有的两个基本属性——特异性（specificity）与主导性（dominance），为每个输入词元赋予可疑度分数；并借助MDLM的两项独特能力——并行词元预测与任意位置词元重建——高效计算这些分数。作者还给出了支持该设计的理论分析。
AI.result: 在覆盖两种攻击、四个模型的40种设定下评估：在5%假阳性率下检测出99.3%的含触发器输入，显著优于最强适配基线（54.8%）；触发器定位准确率超过99%；平均攻击成功率从95%降至1%，同时基本保持模型在干净输入上的效用。
AI.conclusion: UNMASK证明了利用MDLM特有的并行预测与任意位置重建能力、结合触发器的特异性与主导性，可以同时实现高效检测、精确定位与有效去除后门，为MDLM后门防御提供了首个可行框架。

title: Seeing Beyond Pixels: Radar Feature Generation from Images and Sparse Returns
summary: Camera-radar fusion benefits from complementary visual and geometric information but often relies on complete radar representations, leading to substantial computing overhead. However, the extent to which visual information can compensate for limited radar measurements remains insufficiently explored. Therefore, we propose Vision-informed Radar Token Generation (VRTG), which exploits cross-modal information to generate task-relevant radar features from camera images and sparse radar measurements. Specifically, VRTG first leverages image-derived object cues to select a limited number of informative radar points. It then establishes calibrated one-to-one associations between visual objects and radar returns, using matched measurements to refine object ranges while retaining visual estimates for unmatched objects. Finally, the associated object features and visual context are transformed into radar tokens compatible with existing camera-radar fusion networks. Experiments on RADIal demonstrate that VRTG achieves 90.76\% vehicle-detection F1 and 86.68\% free-space mIoU using only four radar points per frame, approaching the performance of the full-radar model.

AI.tldr: 提出VRTG，用视觉信息与稀疏雷达点生成任务相关的雷达token，减少相机-雷达融合对完整雷达表示的计算依赖。
AI.motivation: 相机-雷达融合能利用视觉与几何信息的互补性，但通常依赖完整的雷达表示，带来显著计算开销；而视觉信息能在多大程度上补偿有限的雷达测量尚缺乏充分研究。
AI.method: VRTG首先利用图像导出的目标线索筛选少量高信息量雷达点；随后建立视觉目标与雷达回波之间经过标定的一对一关联，用匹配到的测量修正目标距离，未匹配目标则保留视觉估计；最后将关联后的目标特征与视觉上下文转换为与现有相机-雷达融合网络兼容的雷达token。
AI.result: 在RADIal数据集上，每帧仅使用4个雷达点即达到90.76%的车辆检测F1和86.68%的自由空间mIoU，接近完整雷达模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: 视觉信息可有效补偿稀疏雷达测量，VRTG在显著降低雷达输入需求与计算开销的同时保持接近全雷达模型的精度，为轻量化相机-雷达融合提供了可行方案。

title: Action-Conditioned Transition Irreversibility for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement-learning agents shape the observations they encounter; consequently, detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) states requires analysing action-conditioned trajectories rather than treating inputs as independent samples. We propose Action-Conditioned Transition Irreversibility (ACTI), a detector that evaluates forward and backward transition likelihoods, calibrates this comparison against the in-distribution profile at each timestep, and smooths the score over a short window, using no future information. We tested ACTI across six environments and fifteen detectors within OOD-RL-Bench, using the four anomaly mechanisms that qualified in every environment, with ten policy replicates per environment. All primary metrics are matched-time: each score after anomaly onset is compared with a clean twin rollout's score at the same timestep. Our method secured the top macro matched-time AUROC, outperforming the dynamics-model baseline (PEDM), while scoring transitions roughly two orders of magnitude faster. Compared to the state-only variant, ACTI achieved a small but consistent AUROC gain and a shorter detection delay. The capacity-matched forward-only baseline, ACTI-Forward, secured a statistically significant advantage in AUPRC alongside a reduced detection delay. The discrepancy in AUROC did not reach statistical significance. Ablation studies suggest instead that performance improvements stem from action conditioning, calibration at each timestep, and smoothing of the transition-likelihood scores. Based on these results, we recommend using ACTI-Forward.

AI.tldr: 提出ACTI检测器，利用动作条件化的前后向转移似然比并对每步校准、短窗平滑，在OOD-RL-Bench上取得最高宏匹配时间AUROC，且速度比动态模型基线快约两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 强化学习智能体的动作会塑造其观测，因此OOD状态检测不应把输入当作独立样本，而需分析动作条件化的轨迹。
AI.method: ACTI比较前向与后向转移似然，在每个时间步依据分布内画像校准该比较，并在短窗口内平滑得分，且不使用未来信息；在6个环境、15个检测器、OOD-RL-Bench中用4种在每个环境均合格的异常机制评测，每个环境10个策略重复，指标均为匹配时间的AUROC/AUPRC与检测延迟。以状态单变量（state-only）变体、容量匹配的前向单变量基线ACTI-Forward以及动态模型基线PEDM作为对照，并做消融。
AI.result: ACTI取得最高宏匹配时间AUROC，优于PEDM且评分速度约快两个数量级；相较state-only变体AUROC小幅但稳定提升、检测延迟更短；ACTI-Forward在AUPRC上具统计显著优势且检测延迟更低，AUROC差异未达显著；消融显示增益来自动作条件化、逐步校准与转移似然平滑。
AI.conclusion: 可逆性信号本身贡献有限，性能主要源于动作条件化、逐步校准与平滑；据此推荐使用更轻量、延迟更低的ACTI-Forward。

title: DMPT-Swarm: A Directional Mass-Preserving Transform for Decentralized Swarm Navigation in Obstacle Environments
comment: Accepted by the Conference on Decision and Control (CDC) 2026
summary: This paper presents a decentralized microscopic control framework for swarm navigation in obstacle environments, given a precomputed macroscopic trajectory represented by Gaussian mixture models (GMMs). To generate obstacle-aware reference locations without inter-agent communication, we first employ affine transport between multivariate normal (MVN) distributions under the Wasserstein-2 metric. We then propose a directional mass-preserving transform (DMPT) to incorporate obstacle effects by modifying radial transport while preserving directional structure. Based on the transformed references, a local artificial potential field (APF)-based controller is applied for navigation. Each agent operates independently, reducing communication and computational burden. Simulation results demonstrate improved efficiency and obstacle avoidance compared to conventional APF-based methods

AI.tldr: 提出一种去中心化微观集群导航控制框架：以GMM表示预计算的宏观轨迹，通过Wasserstein-2度量下的MVN仿射传输与方向性保质量变换（DMPT）生成考虑障碍的个体参考位置，再结合局部APF控制器实现无通信的集群导航。
AI.motivation: 传统APF方法在障碍环境中易陷入局部极小、效率低，且多智能体方法常依赖智能体间通信与集中计算。作者希望在仅有宏观GMM轨迹的前提下，让各智能体独立生成避障参考位置，降低通信与计算负担。
AI.method: 1) 用GMM表示预计算的宏观轨迹；2) 在Wasserstein-2度量下对多元正态分布进行仿射传输，得到无通信的参考位置；3) 提出方向性保质量变换（DMPT），在修改径向传输的同时保持方向结构，从而引入障碍影响；4) 基于变换后参考点，各智能体使用局部人工势场（APF）控制器独立导航。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，相较于传统基于APF的方法，所提框架在导航效率与避障性能上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 宏观-微观分层、去中心化的设计可在无需智能体间通信的条件下实现高效的集群避障导航，验证了最优传输与方向性保质量变换在集群导航中的有效性。

title: Unlearning Model Identity: Ablating LoRA Weights from Question-Based Identity Tuning
summary: Large Language Models are trained on diverse corpora containing outputs from proprietary teacher models and provider-curated sources. Models subsequently inherit embedded self-identity traits, persistently asserting specific proprietary names. Service providers of open-weight models frequently require the removal of model identity for downstream applications, such as custom interfaces, without exposing provider affiliations to end-users. Effective identity modification is therefore critical for customized model alignment and deployment. This study proposes a method to localize parameter-level representations of self-identity within low-rank adaptation modules to perform targeted weight ablation. By generating probing questions designed to elicit self-naming outputs and fine-tuning the base model on these responses, the approach identifies and ablates high-magnitude weights within the parameter set. Experimental results demonstrate that distilled identity traits reside within a localized subset of low-rank weights, achieving a complete removal rate in Qwen3.5-2B and a 10% rate in Gemma4-E2B while preserving general task capabilities. These findings confirm that ablating top-tier adaptation weights suppresses distilled self-identification without compromising broader model performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种在低秩适配（LoRA）模块中定位并消融"自我身份"参数表征的方法：用探测性问题诱发模型自报名称，基于此微调后筛选高幅值权重进行定向剪枝，从而在保持通用能力的前提下移除蒸馏继承的专有身份特征。
AI.motivation: 大模型在含专有教师模型输出与提供商筛选语料上训练，会继承嵌入的自我身份特征，持续自报特定专有名称。开源权重模型的服务方在下游定制（如自定义界面）时通常需移除模型身份，以避免向终端用户暴露提供商归属，因此有效的身份修改对定制化对齐与部署至关重要。
AI.method: 1）构造用于诱发自命名输出的探测性问题；2）基于这些响应微调基座模型（及LoRA模块）；3）在低秩适配参数集中定位高幅值权重，对其实施定向权重消融（weight ablation）；4）评估身份移除率与通用任务能力保持情况。
AI.result: 蒸馏身份特征集中于低秩权重的一个局部子集。消融后 Qwen3.5-2B 达到 100% 身份移除率，Gemma4-E2B 达到 10%，同时通用任务能力得到保留。表明抑制顶层适配权重可在不损害模型整体性能的情况下消除蒸馏所得自我识别行为。
AI.conclusion: 参数级身份表征在LoRA空间中具有局部性，针对性消融可作为低成本、可控的身份解耦手段；但方法效果存在明显模型依赖性（移除率 100% vs 10%），跨模型鲁棒性仍需进一步验证。

title: Separating Module Gain From Transport Plan Contribution in Audio-Visual Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition
summary: A cross-modal routing module can improve over its backbone while its transport plan accounts for no demonstrable part of that improvement. In ABVnet with DFEW, Sinkhorn cross-modal routing (SCR) exceeds the retrained baseline by 0.87 unweighted average recall (UAR) points, a resolved difference, yet sits 0.17 points above an individually trained, parameter-matched pooled variant, an unresolved difference that establishes no equivalence; under the development protocol the comparison with the baseline reverses. Separating the two needs comparisons a module-against-backbone test cannot supply: parameter-matched variants changing only the plan rule, and interventions replacing the plan without retraining. The evaluation covers MMA-DFER and ABVnet on DFEW and MAFW, and MMA-DFER on CREMA-D, with a single training run per configuration and paired fold intervals. ABVnet with DFEW motivated the follow-up after the broader results were available. Replacing the plan everywhere with a uniform one reduces UAR by 0.72, whereas permuting its rows gives an unresolved difference of -0.20 UAR points; permutation is less damaging by 0.51 UAR points, a resolved contrast. Replacing the plan with the product of its own marginals, preserving both marginals and removing only frame-specific mixtures, reduces UAR by 0.70. These reductions concern reliance at inference; attribution of the module gain to the transport plan remains unestablished. Under the 1.5 fold-dependence widening, the baseline gain remains resolved, whereas the replacement reductions and the paired contrast are unresolved.

AI.tldr: Sinkhorn跨模态路由(SCR)模块带来的性能增益无法归因于其传输计划：仅替换计划规则或直接干预计划即可产生同等幅度的UAR下降，说明增益来源未被识别，传输计划的归因仍不成立。
AI.motivation: 模块与骨干网络的对比（module-against-backbone）只能说明"模块优于骨干"，却无法区分增益究竟来自传输计划本身，还是来自参数匹配的池化、额外容量等混杂因素。作者希望用更严格的对照设计来分离这一归因问题。
AI.method: 在MMA-DFER与ABVnet上，于DFEW、MAFW（以及MMA-DFER在CREMA-D）上进行评估，每配置单次训练，采用配对折区间。设计两类无法由模块-骨干对比提供的实验：(1) 参数匹配变体，仅改变计划规则；(2) 不重训练的干预，直接替换传输计划（统一计划、行置换、仅保留边际之积）。并施加1.5倍折依赖放大以检验稳健性。
