AI.result: ABVnet+DFEW上SCR较重训基线高0.87 UAR（已解析差异），但较参数匹配池化变体仅高0.17 UAR（未解析差异，不构成等价）；开发协议下与基线的比较发生反转。干预实验中：替换为统一计划降低0.72 UAR；行置换仅-0.20 UAR（未解析），置换比统一计划少损失0.51 UAR（已解析）；用自身边际乘积替换（保留边际、仅去除帧特定混合）降低0.70 UAR。在1.5倍折依赖放宽下，基线增益仍为已解析，而替换效应与配对对比变为未解析。
AI.conclusion: 这些下降仅反映推理阶段对计划的依赖，而非模块增益对传输计划的归因；模块增益归因于传输计划这一点仍未确立。参数匹配与不重训练干预的对比揭示出原对比方法在归因上的根本不足。

title: Interpreting Diffusion Model Activations in Natural Language
summary: Interpreting the intermediate activations of diffusion models (DMs) is key to understanding how they generate images. Existing interpretability methods for DMs provide limited support for open-ended interrogation, making it difficult to extract human-interpretable insights. We extend LatentQA, the task of answering natural-language questions about Large Language Model activations, to DM activations. We introduce the Diffusion-specific Activation Oracle (DAO), which translates DM activations into natural-language answers to open-ended questions about the ongoing generation. Our experiments show that DAO can effectively describe the content of the final image from activations at early denoising steps. Additionally, we demonstrate that DAO captures the structure of the DM's activation space well enough to steer image generation toward target attributes. Furthermore, we show that attribution patching through DAO identifies DM components that contribute to visual attributes specified in natural language. Our code is available \href{https://github.com/yamanoko/dao/tree/main}{here}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DAO（Diffusion-specific Activation Oracle），将 LatentQA 任务从大语言模型激活扩展到扩散模型激活，把扩散模型的中间激活翻译成自然语言答案，从而支持对生成过程进行开放式提问与解释。
AI.motivation: 理解扩散模型（DM）的中间激活是解释其图像生成机制的关键，但现有 DM 可解释性方法对开放式探查（open-ended interrogation）支持有限，难以提取人类可理解的洞察。
AI.method: 将 LatentQA（针对 LLM 激活回答自然语言问题）推广到扩散模型，构建 DAO，将 DM 激活映射为对当前生成过程的自然语言问答答案；并通过 DAO 进行激活空间结构分析与归因（attribution patching）。
AI.result: 实验表明：DAO 能仅凭早期去噪步骤的激活有效描述最终图像内容；DAO 较好捕捉 DM 激活空间结构，可用于引导生成朝向目标属性；通过 DAO 的 attribution patching 能识别对自然语言指定视觉属性有贡献的 DM 组件。
AI.conclusion: DAO 为扩散模型提供了一种通用的、基于自然语言的激活解读框架，兼具内容描述、生成引导与组件归因能力，代码已开源。

title: graspit-py: A Python Interface to GraspIt! for Grasp Planning Under Pose and Friction Uncertainty
comment: Technical report. 31 pages, 8 figures, 9 tables. Code: https://github.com/coenwerem/graspit-py
summary: In simulated multifingered grasps, pose error can change contacts formed during hand closure, while friction uncertainty changes the loads supported by those contacts. Existing C++ APIs and ROS 1 services provide programmatic GraspIt! access but require native bindings or a service transport layer for Python use and application-specific integration of contact geometry with uncertainty sampling. A Python workflow for these studies must connect native closure and contacts to caller-defined wrench scores, uncertainty samples, and command reconstruction. We present graspit-py, a Python interface to native GraspIt! operations that supplies this workflow. The interface provides native scene access, contact-wrench analysis, and configurable approach planning under pose and friction uncertainty. A grasp record associates the object-relative palm pose and closed independent coordinates with nominal contacts and quality scores evaluated under sampled pose and friction conditions. Our MuJoCo exporter derives serial hinge chains and affine joint couplings, including nonzero reference angles, and preserves individual collision components. Across 75 configurations of five hand models, maximum discrepancy between source and exported palm-frame vertex sets was approximately 1.3 micrometers against a 100-micrometer geometry tolerance. We isolated reference-angle and collision-component effects through controlled ablations and validated 1,920 directional task-wrench capacity calculations against independent Cartesian-force linear programs. In a common GraspIt! workload, median reset-close-score-state cycle latency through direct Python was 10.7% lower than through persistent ROS 1 services. An executable export-plan-reconstruct workflow and grasp examples on six hand models demonstrate how the contact, score, and joint representations support numerical analysis and command reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出 graspit-py：一个将 GraspIt! 原生抓取仿真操作暴露给 Python 的接口，支持位姿/摩擦不确定性下的接触-力旋量分析，并提供导出到 MuJoCo 的流程与命令重建。
AI.motivation: 现有多指抓取仿真中，位姿误差会改变闭合过程形成的接触，摩擦不确定性会改变接触承载能力；而 GraspIt! 仅有 C++ API 与 ROS 1 服务，Python 使用需原生绑定或服务传输，且接触几何与不确定性采样需按应用自行集成。缺少一个把原生闭合、接触计算与用户自定义力旋量评分、不确定性采样、命令重建串联起来的 Python 工作流。
AI.method: 提供 graspit-py Python 接口，包含原生场景访问、接触-力旋量分析与可配置的接近规划，并支持位姿与摩擦不确定性采样；用抓取记录（grasp record）把物体相对手掌位姿、闭合后的独立坐标与名义接触及采样条件下的质量评分关联起来；另实现 MuJoCo 导出器，生成串联铰链链与仿射关节耦合（支持非零参考角）并保留独立碰撞组件。通过受控消融分离参考角与碰撞组件影响，并将方向性任务力旋量容量计算与独立笛卡尔力线性规划对拍。
AI.result: 5 种手模型、75 种配置下，源与导出掌坐标系顶点集最大偏差约 1.3 微米（几何容差 100 微米）；1,920 次方向性任务力旋量容量计算与独立线性规划验证一致；常见 GraspIt! 负载下，直接 Python 的 reset-close-score-state 循环中位延迟比持久化 ROS 1 服务低 10.7%；在 6 种手模型上演示了可执行的导出-规划-重建流程。
AI.conclusion: graspit-py 以单一 Python 工作流统一了 GraspIt! 的闭合、接触与不确定性分析、质量评分和向 MuJoCo 的保真导出，几何精度与力旋量计算均经独立验证，且延迟优于 ROS 1 服务方案，可直接服务于数值分析与命令重建研究。

title: Persuasion from Within: Model-Based Insider Attacks in Multi-Agent LLM Debate and Consensus
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems for collective decision-making, such as multi-agent debate and consensus games, in which agents exchange messages and update their answers over multiple rounds and a resolution mechanism aggregates them into a final outcome. Most multi-agent LLM frameworks assume that every participant shares the system objective. In practice, however, a malicious agent can join as a legitimate member of the group and persuade the other agents toward a hidden adversarial goal. We formalize such attacks as a sequential decision-making problem in which the insider seeks to degrade the utility of the collective outcome. We propose a model-based insider attack that learns to persuade a group of agents: the insider first learns a world model of the benign agents from offline trajectories and then uses it both to train a persuasion policy and to plan its messages. In two case studies involving a numerical consensus game and a multi-agent debate, the learned insider is the most effective and the stealthiest attack we evaluate, outperforming both prompt-based and trained LLM persuaders from prior work. The attack also transfers to other target models, larger groups, and unseen datasets, and remains effective under existing Byzantine-resilience defenses. The learned insider also enables a new defense: adversarially training benign agents on the attack data largely removes both our attack and the strongest prior persuasion attack. These results show that combining world models with reinforcement learning and planning is an effective route to both attacking and hardening language-based multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: 该文将多智能体LLM系统中的"内部恶意者说服攻击"形式化为序贯决策问题，提出基于世界模型的内鬼攻击方法（离线学习良性智能体世界模型，用于训练说服策略与在线消息规划），在共识博弈与多智能体辩论中验证其攻击效果、隐蔽性与可迁移性，并据此提出对抗训练防御。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体LLM框架普遍假设所有参与者共享系统目标，但实际中恶意智能体可作为合法成员加入，通过多轮消息交换将群体引向隐藏的对抗目标。已有攻击多为基于提示的或直接训练的LLM说服者，缺乏对良性智能体行为的显式建模，难以兼顾攻击效力与隐蔽性。
AI.method: 将内部攻击建模为序贯决策问题，攻击者目标是降低集体结果的效用。提出基于模型（model-based）的内鬼攻击：先用离线轨迹学习良性智能体的世界模型，再以该模型同时（1）训练说服策略（强化学习），（2）在推理时进行消息规划（planning）。在数值共识博弈与多智能体辩论两个案例中进行评估。
AI.result: 在两个案例研究中，学习型内鬼是所评估攻击中最有效且最隐蔽的，优于先前的基于提示与训练式LLM说服者；攻击可迁移到其他目标模型、更大规模群体与未见数据集，并在现有拜占庭容错防御下仍然有效。反向利用该攻击数据进行对抗训练，可大幅削弱本攻击及最强的先前说服攻击。
AI.conclusion: 将世界模型与强化学习、规划相结合，是同时攻击与加固基于语言的多智能体系统的有效路径；世界模型驱动的内鬼攻击既揭示了系统性脆弱性，也提供了可用于防御的对抗数据来源。

title: RALC: Risk-Controlled Local Adoption of Segmentation Updates with Few Calibration Images
summary: Fine-tuning a road-scene segmenter for rain and nighttime driving can introduce errors on normal daytime images. With few labeled normal images for calibration, a whole-image risk check may reject changes that would pass if adopted locally. Risk-Controlled Adoption of Label Changes (RALC) selects local changes from a fixed model update, using confidence differences and an image score to form nested candidates. On each normal calibration image, RALC measures how many more errors each candidate makes than the original model, assigning zero loss when errors stay the same or fall. At test time, each replacement can add at most one error, so the replacement count bounds the net increase without test labels. RALC combines this candidate-dependent bound with recorded calibration losses to select the largest set that passes the risk check. If the models and adoption rules are fixed before calibration and normal calibration and test images are exchangeable, the expected per-image loss stays within budget. On held-out BDD100K, we evaluated three weight-interpolated updates with 10 additional normal images per calibration draw. At a common fixed budget, adverse-scene mIoU was 1.89--3.19 percentage points higher with RALC than with whole-image adoption, while measured mean normal loss was also higher. After matching this loss post hoc at 1,000 pixels per image, RALC still led by 1.135--2.428 points. Selecting changes in $8\times8$-pixel cells recovered 93--98% of this advantage. With 250 calibration images at the original budget, both rules adopted all three updates in full.

AI.tldr: 提出风险受控的局部标签变更采纳方法 RALC，用置信度差构造嵌套候选并用候选相关上界做无标签风险检验，在 BDD100K 上以少量白天校准图像实现雨天/夜间分割更新的局部采纳，比整图采纳取得更高的恶劣场景 mIoU。
AI.motivation: 为雨天与夜间驾驶场景微调的分割模型会在正常白天图像上引入错误；可用于校准的带标签正常图像极少，整图级的风险检查会把本可局部采纳的变更整体拒绝，导致过多保守性。
AI.method: RALC 从固定的模型更新中筛选局部替换：利用置信度差异与图像分数构造嵌套候选集；在每张正常校准图上统计各候选相对原模型多产生的错误数，错误不增则记零损失。测试时每个替换至多增加一个错误，故替换数量给出净错误增量的无标签上界；将该候选相关界与校准损失结合，选取通过风险检查的最大集合。理论保证：模型与采纳规则预先固定且校准/测试图像可交换时，期望每图损失不超预算。实验在留出 BDD100K 上评估三种权重插值更新，每次校准抽样仅用 10 张额外正常图像。
AI.result: 相同固定预算下，RALC 的恶劣场景 mIoU 比整图采纳高 1.89–3.19 个百分点，但实测平均正常损失也更高；事后在每图 1000 像素处匹配损失后，RALC 仍领先 1.135–2.428 点；以 8×8 像素单元做选择可保留该优势的 93–98%。使用 250 张校准图像、原预算时，两种规则均完整采纳全部三次更新。
AI.conclusion: 局部化、候选相关的风险控制能在极少校准数据下比整图采纳更有效地利用模型更新；其收益随像素级粒度变粗而轻微衰减，且校准样本量增大时约束变得松弛、两种规则趋于一致。

title: Nearly Minimax-Optimal Sample Complexity of Natural Policy Gradient with a Matching Information-Theoretic Lower Bound
summary: A fundamental question in reinforcement learning is how many sampled transitions are needed to learn a near-optimal policy, and whether direct policy optimization can attain this statistical limit. To answer this question, we consider natural policy gradient (NPG), a widely used policy optimization method. We study tabular finite-horizon Markov decision processes (MDPs) with known rewards and unknown horizon-dependent transition kernels, accessed through a generative model. Our sample-based NPG algorithms update the policy by backward sweeps and do not estimate transition probabilities. Under three different batch-size and step size schedules, we establish last-iterate guarantees with sample complexity $\widetilde O(SAH^4/\varepsilon^2)$, where $S$, $A$, and $H$ denote the number of states, the number of actions, and the horizon length, respectively. In this setting, horizon-dependent transition kernels contribute a factor of $H$ to our transition-query bound. Our information-theoretic lower bound of $Ω(SAH^4/\varepsilon^2)$ shows that the resulting $H^4$ dependence is unavoidable in the worst case, even for agents that select their queries adaptively. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first last-iterate guarantees for NPG whose sample complexity matches an information-theoretic lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Consequently, our results demonstrate that direct policy-space optimization through NPG can achieve the fundamental statistical limits of reinforcement learning while guaranteeing the performance of the final policy. Furthermore, for known kernels, we prove that exact NPG with a constant step size $η=1/H$ requires $Ω(H^2/\varepsilon)$ iterations in the worst case, matching the known upper bound for that step size.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于生成模型、表格型有限时域MDP下自然策略梯度(NPG)的样本复杂度，在三种批量与步长方案下给出末尾迭代(last-iterate)保证 Õ(SAH⁴/ε²)，并证明匹配的 Ω(SAH⁴/ε²) 信息论下界，说明NPG可达统计最优极限。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中的一个根本问题是：学习近最优策略需要多少采样转移，以及直接策略优化能否达到该统计极限。此前NPG的样本复杂度保证多为平均迭代形式，且是否与下界匹配尚不明确。
AI.method: 考虑已知奖励、未知依赖时域转移核的表格型有限时域MDP，通过生成模型采样；提出基于采样的NPG算法，采用反向扫描更新策略而不估计转移概率；在三种批量大小与步长调度下进行理论分析，并构造信息论下界；另对已知转移核情形分析精确NPG固定步长η=1/H的迭代复杂度。
AI.result: 在三种调度下均建立末尾迭代样本复杂度 Õ(SAH⁴/ε²)（H依赖转移核贡献额外H因子）；下界 Ω(SAH⁴/ε²) 表明最坏情况下H⁴依赖不可避免，即使允许自适应查询；这是首个与信息论下界（对数因子内）匹配的NPG末尾迭代保证。对已知核，精确NPG在η=1/H时最坏情形需 Ω(H²/ε) 次迭代，与该步长的已知上界匹配。
AI.conclusion: 直接策略空间优化（NPG）能够达到强化学习的根本统计极限，同时保证最终策略的性能；结果刻画了时域对转移查询复杂度的本质影响，并给出了固定步长精确NPG迭代复杂度的紧界。

title: Distributed Interactive Conformal Prediction for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems increasingly rely on learning-enabled components and distributed algorithms for perception, estimation, and control, introducing uncertainty that makes it challenging to satisfy mission requirements. Conformal prediction quantifies uncertainty with distribution-free guarantees, but existing methods do not address the challenging combination of dependence among robots, distributed calibration, and the distribution shift induced when calibrated uncertainty bounds modify the closed-loop system. We introduce Multi-Agent Interactive Conformal Prediction (MA-ICP), a distributed framework for computing robustness margins in heterogeneous systems to satisfy mission requirements with high probability. MA-ICP aggregates robot-level nonconformity scores, which measure errors in modeled or estimated quantities, into one mission-level score per robot class, allowing dependence among robots within each mission. Mission-level scores and quantiles are computed using neighbor-to-neighbor communication in a finite number of communication rounds. Updating the robustness margins changes robot trajectories and distributed algorithm outputs, so we use class-dependent score sensitivities to upper bound the shift in mission-level scores. We then establish calibration-conditional coverage guarantees per robot class for the updated margins. We demonstrate MA-ICP on cooperative payload control, formation control with obstacle avoidance, and distributed target tracking missions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分布式多智能体交互式共形预测框架MA-ICP，在机器人间存在依赖、分布式标定以及闭环分布偏移的条件下，为异构系统的鲁棒性裕度提供高概率任务级覆盖保证，并在协同载荷控制、避障编队控制与分布式目标跟踪任务上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统依赖学习组件与分布式算法，引入不确定性，难以满足任务需求。共形预测可提供无分布假设的不确定性量化，但现有方法未处理三个难点组合：机器人间依赖、分布式标定，以及标定后的不确定界改变闭环系统所导致的分布偏移。
AI.method: MA-ICP将机器人级非一致性分数（度量建模或估计量的误差）按机器人类别聚合为任务级分数，从而允许同一任务内机器人间存在依赖；任务级分数与分位数通过有限轮邻居间通信计算；采用类别相关的分数敏感度上界刻画鲁棒性裕度更新引起的分数偏移，进而建立更新后裕度的按类别标定条件覆盖保证。
AI.result: 在协同载荷控制、避障编队控制与分布式目标跟踪三类任务上演示MA-ICP，验证其在依赖结构、分布式计算与闭环分布偏移下仍能为每个机器人类别提供标定条件覆盖保证。
AI.conclusion: MA-ICP为异构多智能体系统提供了可分布式计算、可证明覆盖的鲁棒性裕度标定方法，弥补了现有共形预测在依赖、分布式与闭环偏移三方面的不足。

title: Improving the Improver: Semantic PID Control for Medical Agent Self-Improvement
summary: High-stakes vertical medical tasks, such as postoperative pathological staging and long-term survival prediction, demand multi-step clinical reasoning over heterogeneous evidence under weak supervision and high outcome uncertainty. While we first orchestrate CliAgent, a domain-tailored clinical agent workflow that systematically grounds predictions in multi-modal patient evidence, manually designed medical agents remain constrained by static, brittle rules. Moreover, existing recursive self-improvement (RSI) methods suffer from feedback ambiguity and severe development-set overfitting when evolving agents in high-noise medical domains. Focusing on improving the improver, we propose Semantic PID-RSI, an evidence-guided control-theoretic framework for medical agent self-improvement. Inspired by PID control, our improver evaluates candidate modification batches via three diagnostic roles: P isolates current clinical failure modes, I synthesizes longitudinal evidence from past trials, and D estimates response dynamics and regression risks (D-pre/D-post). Selected plans are compiled into behavior contracts for staged probing and independent adoption judging. Instantiated and validated on challenging oncology tasks (pT/pN staging and survival prognosis), evolving CliAgent with Semantic PID-RSI on a 3B-activated open-weight model achieves substantial gains (up to +6.27 C-index points), outperforming overfitting-prone RSI baselines and approaching the performance of frontier proprietary models (e.g., GPT-6 series) equipped with CliAgent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Semantic PID-RSI，一种证据引导的控制论式医学智能体自我改进框架，通过类比PID控制的三角色诊断机制（P/I/D）评估候选修改批次，缓解递归自我改进在医学高噪声场景下的反馈歧义与开发集过拟合问题；在CliAgent上实例化后，于肿瘤pT/pN分期与生存预后任务中取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 术后病理分期、长期生存预测等高风险纵向医学任务需要在弱监督与高结果不确定性下对异构证据进行多步临床推理。作者先编排了领域定制的CliAgent工作流，将预测系统性地锚定于多模态患者证据；但人工设计的医学智能体受制于静态、脆弱的规则。此外，现有递归自我改进（RSI）方法在高噪声医学领域演化智能体时存在反馈歧义与严重的开发集过拟合问题。
AI.method: 聚焦"改进改进器"本身，提出Semantic PID-RSI——一种证据引导的控制论框架。受PID控制启发，改进器通过三类诊断角色评估候选修改批次：P隔离当前临床失效模式，I综合历史试验的纵向证据，D估计响应动态与回归风险（D-pre/D-post）。被选中的方案编译为行为契约，用于分阶段探测与独立采纳判定。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的肿瘤学任务（pT/pN分期与生存预后）上验证：在3B激活量的开放权重模型上以Semantic PID-RSI演化CliAgent，取得显著增益（最高+6.27个C-index点），优于易过拟合的RSI基线，并接近配备CliAgent的前沿专有模型（如GPT-6系列）的性能。
AI.conclusion: 将控制论思想引入医学智能体的自我改进回路，可有效抑制高噪声领域中的反馈歧义与开发集过拟合，使开放权重模型在纵向临床推理任务上逼近前沿专有模型，为高风险医学智能体的可持续演化提供了可操作路径。

title: Seeing the Invisible: How Vision-Language Models Read, Predict and Trace Radio Fields
summary: Operating in the physical world requires reasoning beyond what cameras directly capture. In a city, radio signals are invisible to the lens, yet their strength is governed by the buildings and streets an image does show. Given only these visible structures, can vision-language models (VLMs) infer the invisible radio field they shape? Probing true physical reasoning requires exact fields in real cities, alongside controlled interventions where a single physical factor changes. We build a label-free engine that turns any coordinate on Earth into a ray-traceable city, simulates matched single-factor counterfactuals, and computes every answer exactly. This yields RadioVISTA, a benchmark and training dataset for visual reasoning about invisible fields. Physically, a radio field is the sum of its propagation paths, yet across six continents we uncover a striking field-path dissociation: frontier VLMs accurately judge where a field is strong, but fail to tell whether a single direct or one-wall path exists. Open models fail even earlier at reading the field itself, and are systematically wrong, scoring below random guessing even when credited for any of four attempts. On unseen cities, fine-tuning brings a 9B open model close to frontier proprietary models on fields, yet neither supervised nor reinforcement fine-tuning improves path tracing. Supervising only final answers teaches models to approximate the field, yet leaves single-path geometry out of reach.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RadioVISTA基准与训练数据集，用无标注的可微/可控射线追踪引擎将地球任意坐标转为可仿真城市，实现单因子反事实与精确求解，揭示"场—路径解耦"现象：前沿VLM能判断场强却无法判断单条直射或单墙反射路径是否存在。
AI.motivation: 真实城市中无线电信号不可见，但其强度由图像可见的建筑与街道几何决定。检验VLM是否具备真正的物理推理，需要真实城市的精确场分布，以及只改变单一物理因素的受控干预；而现有数据无法同时提供精确真值与可控反事实，因此需要构建新的评测与训练资源。
AI.method: 构建标签无关（label-free）引擎：将任意地理坐标转换为可射线追踪的城市场景，仿真匹配的单因子反事实，并精确计算所有答案，从而生成RadioVISTA基准与训练集。在六大洲范围内评测前沿与开源VLM对场强判断和路径存在性判断的能力，并在未见城市上进行监督微调与强化微调实验。
AI.result: 发现显著的"场—路径解耦"：前沿VLM能较准确判断场强位置，却无法判断单条直射路径或单次墙面反射路径是否存在；开源模型在场读取出错更早且系统性错误，即便给予四次尝试中任一次正确的宽松计分也低于随机猜测。在未见城市上，微调可使9B开源模型在场强任务上接近前沿闭源模型，但监督微调与强化微调均无法提升路径追踪能力。
AI.conclusion: 仅监督最终答案会让模型学会近似场分布，却无法掌握单条传播路径的几何关系。这说明当前VLM的"物理推理"更多是场级统计拟合而非基于传播机制的路径级推理，路径级几何仍是明显短板。

title: Aegis: A Conversational Prototype for Lung Cancer Risk Information and Follow-up
comment: 30 pages, including 12 pages of main text and references and 18 pages of supplementary material; 27 references. All authors contributed equally and share first authorship
summary: Collecting self-reported risk information and maintaining continuity between assessment, explanation, and follow-up are practical components of a lung cancer screening workflow. We present Aegis, a browser-based research prototype that combines a conversational questionnaire, rule-based risk categorization, downloadable reports, retrieval-augmented health information, and doctor-user communication. A session-oriented controller manages question progression and clarification, while a language model assists with answer validation. Structured responses are passed to a separate risk-analysis module, and reports are linked to user and session records through Firebase services. The project adopts a multi-agent design that separates information collection, validation, assessment, and report generation. Its documented verification scope comprises 45 functional test specifications covering account management, questionnaire interaction, reporting, doctor-side review, and consultation. The available evaluation describes workflow behavior qualitatively; it provides no per-case execution results, clinical cohort, predictive-performance measurements, or comparative experiments. We therefore present Aegis as an engineering prototype for organizing risk information and follow-up, with clinical validity and the benefits of its agent-based design remaining unestablished. The paper describes the implementation, distinguishes implemented workflows from incomplete extensions, and identifies the evidence required for reproducible and clinically meaningful evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Aegis——一个基于浏览器的肺癌筛查研究原型系统，整合对话式问卷、规则化风险分级、可下载报告、检索增强健康信息问答与医患沟通功能，采用多智能体架构分离信息采集、校验、评估与报告生成。论文定位为工程原型，明确声明其临床有效性与多智能体设计收益尚未得到验证。
AI.motivation: 肺癌筛查流程中，自报风险信息采集以及"评估—解释—随访"之间的连续性维护属于实际工程难点。作者希望构建一个能组织风险信息并支撑随访的研究原型，同时厘清已实现流程与未完成扩展之间的边界，并明确后续可复现、有临床意义评估所需的证据。
AI.method: 系统由会话导向控制器管理问题推进与澄清，语言模型辅助答案校验；结构化回答交由独立的规则化风险分析模块处理，报告通过Firebase服务与用户及会话记录关联。整体采用多智能体设计，将信息采集、校验、评估、报告生成解耦，并集成检索增强（RAG）健康信息与医生—用户沟通模块。
AI.result: 验证范围记录为45项功能测试规格，覆盖账户管理、问卷交互、报告生成、医生端复核与咨询。现有评估仅为对工作流行为的定性描述，未提供逐用例执行结果、临床队列、预测性能指标或对照实验。
AI.conclusion: Aegis被定位为组织风险信息与随访的工程原型；其临床有效性及智能体式设计的收益仍未确立。论文贡献在于实现描述、界定已实现流程与不完整扩展的区分，并指出实现可复现且具临床意义评估所需补充的证据。

title: BO-COMM: Bidirectional Optical System for Simultaneous Localization and Communication in Swarm Robotics
summary: Swarm robotics experiments require observations of robot pose and operational state, together with mechanisms for returning environmental information to the robots. Shared channel wireless communication can face contention and congestion as concurrent reporting demands increase, while a static visual marker does not itself convey changing robot states. We present BO-COMM, an optical system that combines pose estimation and dynamic state reporting with optical downstream interaction. A camera observes circular LED arrays mounted on Colias IV robots with CEU-PLUS extension units.Ring-based voting estimates robot centers, and the spatial LED pattern provides orientation and an encoded state. A projector supplies spatial environmental cues, while an infrared module provides a separate command channel. Processing-time measurements, path-following and color-reporting experiments, and a multi-pheromone demonstration illustrate the operation of this architecture in a planar arena. The results demonstrate the feasibility of combining optical pose and state observations with environmental feedback in the tested hardware and arena configuration.

AI.tldr: 提出BO-COMM光学系统，将位姿估计、动态状态上报与光学下行交互集成于一体，在平面场地的Colias IV机器人上验证可行性。
AI.motivation: 群体机器人实验需要观测机器人位姿与运行状态，并需把环境信息回传给机器人。共享信道的无线通信在并发上报增加时易出现争用与拥塞，而静态视觉标记本身又无法传达机器人状态的动态变化。
AI.method: BO-COMM采用相机观测搭载CEU-PLUS扩展单元的Colias IV机器人上的环形LED阵列；基于环形投票估计机器人中心，利用空间LED图案提供朝向与编码状态；投影仪提供空间环境线索，红外模块提供独立的指令通道。
AI.result: 开展了处理时间测量、路径跟随与颜色上报实验，并进行了多信息素演示；结果说明了该架构在平面场地中的运行情况。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了在给定硬件与场地配置下，将光学位姿与状态观测同环境反馈相结合是可行的。

title: DeCo: Decoupled Traffic State Modeling with Cross-Variable Coordination
summary: Accurate forecasts of traffic flow, occupancy, and speed are essential for congestion management and travel planning. These variables exhibit distinct spatiotemporal patterns, and their coupled dynamics characterize the evolution of traffic conditions, such as the onset and dissipation of congestion. Existing methods often either neglect this coupling or struggle to capture the distinct dynamics of all three variables within a unified model. In this paper, we propose DeCo, a decoupled traffic state modeling framework with cross-variable coordination for forecasting flow, occupancy, and speed. Specifically, DeCo first trains a dedicated forecaster for each variable to specialize in its unique spatiotemporal dynamics. It then estimates a residual correction for each forecast by jointly leveraging the predicted trajectories and recent observations of all three variables, thereby exploiting cross-variable coupling and mitigating systematic prediction errors. We extend the flow-only PeMS03 and PeMS07 benchmarks to all three variables on their original sensors and release the aligned data. Experiments on PeMS03, PeMS04, PeMS07, and PeMS08 show that DeCo achieves the lowest mean absolute error for every variable on every dataset, up to 4.9% below RAGC, the strongest baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/lixus7/DeCo.

AI.tldr: DeCo：按变量解耦训练专用预测器，再基于三变量预测轨迹与近期观测联合估计残差修正，利用跨变量耦合提升交通流量/占有率/速度的预测精度。
AI.motivation: 交通流量、占有率、速度具有各自不同的时空模式，又相互耦合共同刻画拥堵的产生与消散。现有方法要么忽略这种耦合关系，要么难以在统一模型中同时刻画三者的差异化动态。
AI.method: 提出解耦式交通状态建模框架DeCo：第一步为每个变量单独训练专用预测器，以专门拟合其独特的时空动态；第二步对每个变量的预测结果进行残差修正，修正量由三变量的预测轨迹与近期观测联合估计，从而显式利用跨变量耦合、缓解系统性预测误差。
AI.result: 将仅含流量的PeMS03、PeMS07基准扩展到原始传感器上的全部三个变量并公开对齐数据；在PeMS03、PeMS04、PeMS07、PeMS08上，DeCo对每个变量、每个数据集均取得最低MAE，最多比最强基线RAGC低4.9%。
AI.conclusion: 解耦建模加跨变量残差协同优于统一建模与忽视耦合的做法，且在三变量联合预测基准上全面领先。

title: ReMiC: Representation-Driven Token Pruning for 3D VLMs via Minimax Hierarchical Clustering
summary: 3D vision-language models (3D VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in 3D scene understanding and spatial reasoning. However, their reliance on multi-view inputs produces long visual token sequences, imposing substantial computational overhead during inference. Existing pruning methods often rely on token salience or feature diversity as proxies for representativeness, without explicitly modeling the representation gap between the original token set and the retained subset, thereby leading to suboptimal representation of the original scene. In this paper, we propose ReMiC, a training-free, representation-driven token pruning framework based on minimax hierarchical clustering. ReMiC treats retained tokens as prototypes for the original observations, formulating pruning as minimizing the maximum representation error under a fixed token budget. Local prototype initialization allocates tokens according to regional representation needs, while global prototype refinement updates the selected prototypes using cross-region information to further reduce the maximum representation error. Extensive experiments conducted on three representative 3D VLMs across five 3D scene understanding benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of our method. Notably, by retaining only 10% of visual tokens, ReMiC preserves 93.2% of the performance of Video-3D LLM and achieves a $2.04\times$ faster inference speed.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、基于表示驱动的令牌剪枝框架ReMiC，以最小最大层次聚类建模原令牌集与保留子集的表示差距，仅保留10%视觉令牌即可保持Video-3D LLM 93.2%性能并提速2.04倍。
AI.motivation: 3D视觉语言模型依赖多视角输入，产生长视觉令牌序列，推理开销大；现有剪枝方法以令牌显著性（salience）或特征多样性作为代表性代理指标，未显式建模原始令牌集与保留子集之间的表示差距，导致场景表示次优。
AI.method: ReMiC为免训练框架：将保留令牌视为原始观测的原型（prototypes），在固定令牌预算下把剪枝表述为最小化最大表示误差（minimax）问题，采用层次聚类求解；包含局部原型初始化（按各区域表示需求分配令牌）与全局原型精炼（利用跨区域信息更新所选原型以进一步降低最大表示误差）两步。
AI.result: 在3个代表性3D VLM与5个3D场景理解基准上开展实验，验证了方法的有效性与泛化性；仅保留10%视觉令牌时，ReMiC保持Video-3D LLM 93.2%的性能，并实现2.04倍推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模表示误差的minimax层次聚类剪枝优于基于显著性/多样性的启发式方法，可在免训练条件下大幅压缩3D VLM视觉令牌并保持较强场景理解性能。

title: Stein Guidance without Gradients: Discretization Uniform Diffusion Inference Time Scaling beyond Particle SMC
summary: Reward-guided diffusion requires effective steering and correction of the bias introduced by approximate value functions. A Brownian example shows that SMC with full multinomial resampling at every step can require particle counts to grow linearly with guidance depth to maintain accuracy. We propose Stein Guidance, which combines derivative-free guidance with whole-path independence Metropolis-Hastings correction. Value-weighted selection from centered Gaussian candidates approximates gradient guidance in expectation, using as few as two queries per step. Centering stabilizes the local normalizer estimates, and the same queries yield an explicit path weight for correction. Under uniform value and spatial regularity bounds, we prove superpolynomial decay of finite-grid total variation error in the number of MH updates, with constants that do not grow with guidance depth. The error prefactor tends to zero as the value functions approach exact Doob values and the time grid is refined.

AI.tldr: 提出 Stein Guidance：以无导数价值加权选择近似梯度引导，并以整路径独立 Metropolis–Hastings 校正偏差，使误差项不随引导深度增长。
AI.motivation: 奖励引导扩散依赖近似价值函数，其偏差需有效引导与校正。布朗运动例子表明，逐步做完全多项式重采样的 SMC 为保持精度，粒子数需随引导深度线性增长，计算代价过高。
AI.method: 从中心化高斯候选中做价值加权选择，期望意义下近似梯度引导（每步仅需两次查询）；中心化稳定局部归一化估计；同一批查询给出显式路径权重用于整路径独立 Metropolis–Hastings 校正。
AI.result: 在价值一致有界与空间正则性假设下，证明有限网格全变差误差随 MH 更新次数呈超多项式衰减，且常数不随引导深度增长；误差前因子在价值函数逼近精确 Doob 值、时间网格加密时趋于零。
AI.conclusion: Stein Guidance 以极低查询成本实现深度无关的可校正引导，兼具可证明的收敛性与一致性保证。

title: ViewPACT: Multi-View Geometric Augmentation and Pose-Action Co-Training for Viewpoint-Robust Manipulation
summary: Image policies are scalable but remain brittle to camera viewpoint changes. On LIBERO, we identify proprioception as an input shortcut: masking robot states sharply degrades several policies, while retraining from images alone recovers much of the loss. We introduce ViewPACT, an image policy trained with privileged geometric supervision. Auxiliary objectives recover end-effector and task-relevant object poses in the camera frame, while deployment requires only RGB observations. Joint geometric supervision improves mean simulation success from 37.4% to 78.4% under unseen external-camera viewpoints, with more modest gains under separately evaluated object, scene, and camera-intrinsic shifts. Across four real-robot tasks, combining simulated and real-image geometric supervision achieves 68.1% mean success, versus 3.1% for fixed-view behavior cloning and 30.6% for the strongest evaluated alternative. These results support geometric supervision for viewpoint robustness in the evaluated fixed-view demonstration setting.

AI.tldr: 本文指出视觉策略在LIBERO上依赖本体感知（proprioception）作为"输入捷径"，并提出ViewPACT：以特权几何监督辅助训练图像策略，部署时仅需RGB。联合几何监督将未见外部相机视角下的仿真平均成功率从37.4%提升至78.4%，真实机器人四任务达68.1%（基线仅3.1%）。
AI.motivation: 图像策略具备可扩展性，但对相机视角变化脆弱。作者在LIBERO上诊断出本体感知构成输入捷径：遮蔽机器人状态会使多个策略性能骤降，而仅用图像重训可恢复大部分损失，说明策略对状态输入的依赖掩盖了视觉表征的不足；因此需要一种能提升真实视觉几何理解、又不增加部署传感器需求的训练方式。
AI.method: 提出ViewPACT，采用特权几何监督训练的RGB图像策略。训练阶段引入辅助目标，在相机坐标系下回归末端执行器位姿与任务相关物体位姿；部署阶段仅使用RGB观测，不需要状态或深度等额外输入。监督可来自仿真与真实图像的几何标注组合。
AI.result: 在未见外部相机视角下，联合几何监督将仿真平均成功率从37.4%提升至78.4%；在物体、场景与相机内参分别评估的分布偏移下增益较小。真实机器人四任务上，仿真+真实图像几何监督平均成功率68.1%，固定视角行为克隆为3.1%，最强对比方法为30.6%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持几何监督在固定视角演示设定下提升视角鲁棒性的有效性；但增益主要集中在外部相机视角变化，对物体、场景与内参偏移的改善有限，结论限于所评估的固定视角演示场景。

title: Can Your AI Twin Meet People for You? It Can Hold a Conversation. But What Does It Need to Judge Like You?
summary: Should your AI twin go meet people on your behalf? We built LLM twins of 710 real people from their other conversations in the CANDOR corpus, sent them to meet each other in 5,680 simulated first conversations, and checked every rehearsal against what the real people said after meeting for real (355 held-out, participant-disjoint pairs, against baselines that include each person's rating history). The rehearsals work: a twin's conversation predicts real liking ($ρ$=0.277), carries information that questionnaires and rating history do not have (partial $ρ$=0.16 [0.05, 0.26]), and recovers most of what the same reader gets from the real conversation (0.321). Swap controls show that this signal travels through the conversation, not through the persona card. What, then, does a twin need to judge like you? Not your voice: making twins talk more like their owners, with person-specific activation steering and a LoRA trained on their own speech, did not help in a pre-specified test and lowered accuracy in an exploratory second round (-0.183 [-0.294, -0.066]). Nor simply your stated ratings: a persona-prompted twin that holds the conversation does not yet carry its owner's judgment, and when told its owner's past ratings it anchors on them instead of weighing them. Learning helps: a small appraisal head trained on other real conversations, which combines the twin's post-call answers with its owner's rating history, lifts rehearsal-based prediction above the history baseline out of fold (+0.059 [0.001, 0.115], against +0.022 without the twin's answers; pre-specified primary contrast +0.056 [-0.001, 0.111]). We propose an attribution protocol for twin-based social simulation and identify learned appraisal as the component twins need next.

AI.tldr: 用CANDOR语料为710名真人构建LLM"数字孪生"，在5,680场模拟初次对话中让孪生互相见面，并用355对真人真实会面结果验证：孪生对话能预测真实好感度（ρ=0.277），且含问卷与历史评分之外的信息；但"模仿说话风格"无效甚至有害，关键缺失组件是"习得的评价（appraisal）"模块。
AI.motivation: 检验一个实际问题：能否让AI孪生代替本人进行社交"预演"，并据此预测真实初次会面中的相互好感？同时探究孪生要做出"像本人一样的判断"究竟依赖什么成分（声音/风格、自我陈述的评分、还是评价机制），为基于孪生的社会模拟建立归因协议。
AI.method: 基于CANDOR语料中个体的其他对话构建710个LLM孪生；开展5,680场模拟首次对话（孪生-孪生）。评测采用355对留出、参与者互不重叠的真人真实会面结果，基线包括个人历史评分。进行交换控制（swap controls）以区分信号来自对话内容而非persona卡片。操纵实验：①persona-specific activation steering与用本人语音训练的LoRA以模仿说话风格；②persona prompting并注入本人过往评分；③训练一个小型appraisal head，将孪生"通话后回答"与本人评分历史结合。
AI.result: 孪生预演可预测真实好感（ρ=0.277），含问卷与历史评分之外的增量信息（partial ρ=0.16，95%CI [0.05,0.26]），并恢复了同一读者从真实对话中获得信号的约大部分（0.321）。交换控制显示信号经由对话而非persona卡片传递。模仿说话风格无效：预注册检验无提升，探索性第二轮反而降低准确率（-0.183 [-0.294,-0.066]）。仅persona-prompted孪生不携带本人判断；告知过往评分则出现锚定效应。习得appraisal head在折外使预测优于历史基线（+0.059 [0.001,0.115]，无孪生回答时仅+0.022；预注册主要对比 +0.056 [-0.001,0.111]）。
AI.conclusion: LLM孪生的模拟对话可有效预演真实社交结果并携带增量预测信息，该信号源于对话互动本身。孪生要"像本人一样判断"，关键不在于语音/风格模仿或显式告知偏好，而在于习得的评价机制；作者据此提出孪生社会模拟的归因协议，并指出"学习的appraisal"是孪生下一步最需补足的组件。

title: DINO-KNN: Training-Free Multiclass In-Context Segmentation via Nearest Neighbors
summary: In-context segmentation (ICS) segments a target image given a few annotated reference images. Recent training-free methods built on frozen foundation models segment one class at a time and gain little from additional references. We study the multiclass, multi-reference setting and ask how far a simple joint decision rule can go. We introduce DINO-KNN, which stores every labeled reference patch of a frozen DINOv3 encoder in a single memory and labels each target patch by a distance-weighted vote of its k nearest neighbors. All classes are predicted in a single pass, with one label per pixel, without training or a mask decoder. We evaluate on eight datasets, four natural and four medical, with R=1 to 15 reference images and three reference seeds. DINO-KNN achieves the best average mIoU at every R; it is the best method on six of the eight datasets from R=3 and on seven of the eight from R=7. Its accuracy continues to grow with the number of references, from 37.8 mIoU at R=1 to 56.2 at R=15, while the strongest baseline, INSID3, rises from 36.1 to 42.9. DINO-KNN is also 2.1x faster than INSID3. The code will be made public.

AI.tldr: DINO-KNN：用冻结DINOv3特征+单一记忆库+距离加权kNN投票，一次性完成多类多参考的上下文分割，无需训练与掩码解码器，在8个数据集、R=1~15下均取得最佳平均mIoU且比INSID3快2.1倍。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练ICS方法基于冻结基础模型，但一次只分割一类，且增加参考图像收益有限；作者希望在多类、多参考设定下检验一个简单联合决策规则能达到的效果。
AI.method: 将冻结DINOv3编码器提取的所有带标签参考图像块存入单一记忆库，对每个目标图像块用其k近邻的距离加权投票赋标签；所有类别单次前向预测，每像素一个标签，无训练、无掩码解码器。
AI.result: 在8个数据集（4自然+4医学）、R=1~15、3个参考随机种子下评测：每个R的平均mIoU均最佳；R≥3时8个数据集中6个最佳，R≥7时7个最佳。mIoU随参考数从37.8（R=1）升至56.2（R=15），最强基线INSID3仅从36.1升至42.9；速度快2.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 简单的多类联合kNN决策规则即可超越逐类免训练方法，并能有效利用额外参考图像，兼具精度与效率优势；代码将公开。

title: Physical regime changes expose formula misuse in large language models
comment: 19 pages, 9 figures, 1 table; Supplementary Information appended. Code and data: https://github.com/acodercat/AtmosRegime
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly employed for scientific computing across the Earth and environmental sciences, but problems in these fields often involve distinct physical regimes. LLMs may fail to recognize these regime-dependent constraints, applying formulas outside their domains of validity and producing plausible but physically incorrect results. We systematically investigate these failures through controlled experiments and assess whether post-training can improve regime-aware reasoning. Across 72 physical mechanisms, we find frontier LLMs frequently misapply formulas outside their regimes of validity, reducing accuracy by 13-57 percentage points. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards enables Qwen3.5-9B to match DeepSeek V4 Flash (284B) on regime-dependent tasks, but its effectiveness is limited by the formulas available in the base model. Combining supervised fine-tuning on a few worked examples with reinforcement learning improves accuracy by 61 percentage points, while distillation from a teacher supplied with the correct formula raises accuracy from 0% to 71%.

AI.tldr: 系统研究LLM在地球与环境科学中"物理体制依赖"失效问题，发现前沿模型常在公式适用范围外误用公式导致准确率下降13–57个百分点，并通过RLVR、SFT+RL、公式蒸馏等后训练手段显著改善体制感知推理能力。
AI.motivation: LLM日益用于地球与环境科学的科学计算，但这些领域问题涉及不同物理体制（regime），模型可能无法识别体制相关约束，将公式套用于有效性域之外，产生看似合理但物理上错误的结果。作者希望系统刻画此类失效并检验后训练能否提升体制感知推理。
AI.method: 在72个物理机制上开展受控实验，评估前沿LLM在有效性域内外应用公式的表现；考察三类后训练策略：带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）、少量已解示例监督微调（SFT）与RL结合、以及从提供正确公式的教师模型蒸馏。
AI.result: 前沿LLM频繁在有效性域外误用公式，准确率下降13–57个百分点；RLVR使Qwen3.5-9B在体制依赖任务上追平DeepSeek V4 Flash（284B），但效果受基座模型已有公式知识限制；SFT+RL提升准确率61个百分点；公式蒸馏将准确率从0%提升至71%。
AI.conclusion: 体制约束识别是LLM科学计算的关键薄弱环节，且属可通过后训练实质改善的能力；RLVR受限于基座知识，须结合示例监督或外部公式信息才能突破上限。

title: JEPA-Tuner: From Predictive Fine-Tuning to Asynchronous Execution of Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generate sequences of actions from visual observations, proprioceptive states, and language instructions. In embodied interaction, executing these actions influences subsequent observations and robot states, providing a natural predictive signal for policy learning. However, standard action-supervised fine-tuning does not explicitly capture these action-conditioned temporal dependencies in the guidance consumed by the action predictor. We introduce JEPA-Tuner, a predictive fine-tuning framework that regularizes the VLA's native policy guidance through action-conditioned future prediction. During fine-tuning, a predictor in JEPA-Tuner learns to match guidance encoded from a future observation given the current guidance and committed actions. This objective encourages a cross-modal guidance adapter to capture how the scene and robot state evolve under those actions, while jointly training the action expert on both observed and predicted guidance keeps the representation informative for control. In addition, when deploying the VLA model with asynchronous action-chunk inference, the pre-trained predictor will anticipate the guidance needed at the next chunk boundary. The policy can thus generate the next chunk in advance and execute it from its first action without overlap correction or additional predictor training, enabling efficient and high-quality asynchronous execution. Experiments on LIBERO and Meta-World show that JEPA-Tuner improves task success under synchronous inference with better multi-modal guidance embeddings. For asynchronous control, JEPA-Tuner improves performance and smoothness across different latency settings on both LIBERO simulator and multi-size real robot demonstrations. The project website with video demos is at https://qujx.github.io/JEPA-Tuner-Website.

AI.tldr: JEPA-Tuner 是一个基于动作条件未来预测的 VLA 模型预测式微调框架，通过正则化策略引导表征提升同步推理的任务成功率，并在异步动作分块推理下实现无需重叠校正的高效执行。
AI.motivation: 具身交互中执行动作会改变后续观测与机器人状态，这是天然的策略学习预测信号；但标准的动作监督微调并未在动作预测器所消费的引导表征中显式建模这种动作条件的时间依赖关系。此外，VLA 异步动作分块推理存在块边界延迟与重叠校正开销问题。
AI.method: 在微调阶段，JEPA-Tuner 中的预测器以当前引导与已执行动作为输入，学习匹配从未来观测编码得到的引导；该目标促使跨模态引导适配器刻画场景与机器人状态在动作作用下的演化，同时动作专家在真实观测引导与预测引导上联合训练以保持表征对控制的有用性。部署时，预训练预测器可预判下一块边界所需引导，使策略提前生成下一动作块并从其首动作起执行，无需重叠校正或额外预测器训练。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 与 Meta-World 上，JEPA-Tuner 在同步推理下提升了任务成功率，并获得更优的多模态引导嵌入；在异步控制中，于 LIBERO 仿真及多尺寸真实机器人演示的不同延迟设置下均提升了性能与执行平滑度。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式引入动作条件的未来预测目标来正则化 VLA 的固有策略引导，可同时改善表征质量与任务成功率，并自然支持高效、平滑的异步动作分块执行，具备仿真与真机验证。

title: Beyond Single-Turn Privacy: Training-Data Leakage in Conversational RAG
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is known to reduce training-data leakage in single-turn interactions, but whether this protection persists over multi-turn conversations is unclear. We introduce CRELT (Conversational RAG Extraction Leakage Trajectory), a reusable framework that tracks, turn by turn, the real contact details from the training data that a RAG system discloses. CRELT separates retrieval, conversation history, and attack strategy through a full-factorial design, uses a retrieval corpus verified to contain none of the target PII, and counts an item as leaked only when it is absent from the model input at the turn it is produced. In our main experiment, this criterion excludes 29-53% of raw matches that were already present in the input. Across GPT-J-6B, Pythia-6.9B, and Pythia-12B, targeting real Enron contact details, retrieval reduces disclosure under both full and cleared history, consistent with prior single-turn results. A length-matched control with random passages reproduces 91-99.5% of this reduction under cleared history and 47-78% under full history, so much of it comes from the added context rather than from what is retrieved. With retrieval enabled, however, retaining full conversation history increases disclosure by a factor of 3.6-4.9, while retaining only one previous turn already restores disclosure to approximately the full-history level. With retrieval, clearing the history reduces disclosure by 72-79%, but does not eliminate it. These results show that single-turn privacy audits can substantially underestimate training-data leakage in conversational RAG systems and that conversation-history policy is a critical dimension of privacy evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出CRELT框架逐轮追踪RAG系统在多轮对话中泄露训练数据真实联系方式的行为，发现带检索时保留对话历史会使泄露量增加3.6-4.9倍，单轮隐私审计会显著低估多轮RAG的隐私风险。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明RAG可在单轮交互中降低训练数据泄露，但该保护是否在对话中持续存在尚不清楚；若单轮结论被外推到多轮场景，可能导致隐私评估失真。
AI.method: 构建CRELT（Conversational RAG Extraction Leakage Trajectory）可复用框架，逐轮追踪系统披露的训练数据真实联系方式。采用全因子设计分离检索、对话历史与攻击策略三个因素；检索语料经校验不含任何目标PII；泄露判定采用严格准则——仅当条目在该轮模型输入中不存在时计为泄露。在GPT-J-6B、Pythia-6.9B、Pythia-12B上以Enron真实联系方式为目标，并设置长度匹配的随机段落对照实验。
AI.result: 严格判定准则排除了29-53%已存在于输入中的原始匹配。检索在完整历史与清空历史下均降低披露，与单轮结果一致；但长度匹配的随机段落对照在清空历史下复现了91-99.5%的降幅、完整历史下复现47-78%，说明降幅主要来自额外上下文而非检索内容本身。启用检索时，保留完整历史使披露增加3.6-4.9倍，仅保留一轮历史即恢复至接近完整历史水平；清空历史使披露下降72-79%但未能消除。
AI.conclusion: 单轮隐私审计会大幅低估会话式RAG系统的训练数据泄露风险；对话历史策略应作为隐私评估的关键维度，且检索带来的"降泄露"效果部分源于上下文长度而非检索质量。

title: Robust Trajectory Prediction Under Sensing and V2X Noise: Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies
summary: Anticipating the future behavior of surrounding objects is key for the safe and efficient navigation of autonomous vehicles. State-of-the-art Transformer-based interaction-aware trajectory prediction models are typically trained and evaluated on large-scale, highly curated datasets obtained by filtering any object detection and tracking noise through extensive offline post-processing. However, in real-world deployments, the detected objects' state (position, heading, and speed) estimates are inherently affected by sensing and localization uncertainties. These uncertainties can be even higher for connected and automated vehicles receiving information from other road users through Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communications. In this paper, we first investigate the sensitivity of five state-of-the-art Transformer-based interaction-aware trajectory prediction models to realistic noisy object state estimates. Numerical results show that prediction accuracy degrades by up to a 6x factor as the noise level increases, highlighting the models' sensitivity to the mismatch between the noise conditions encountered during training and those experienced at deployment. We then show that retraining models on a more realistic noise-augmented dataset is a more effective strategy to mitigate the impact of noisy object state estimates on trajectory prediction accuracy than using denoising modules at the input. Retrained models limit the prediction accuracy degradation below a 1.5x factor. The noise-augmented dataset is openly released to support further research.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究Transformer交互感知轨迹预测模型对真实噪声目标状态估计的敏感性，并证明噪声增强重训练比输入去噪模块更有效。
AI.motivation: 现有SOTA轨迹预测模型基于经离线后处理过滤掉检测与跟踪噪声的大规模精选数据集训练与评估，但实际部署中目标状态（位置、航向、速度）估计受感知与定位不确定性影响，V2X通信场景下更甚，存在训练与部署噪声条件不匹配问题。
AI.method: 首先对五种SOTA Transformer交互感知轨迹预测模型在真实噪声目标状态估计下的敏感性进行实证分析；随后对比两种缓解策略：在输入端加入去噪模块，与在噪声增强数据集上重训练模型。
AI.result: 随噪声水平提高，预测精度最多下降约6倍，凸显模型对训练-部署噪声条件失配的敏感性；噪声增强重训练可将精度退化限制在1.5倍以内，优于输入端去噪模块方案。噪声增强数据集已开源发布。
AI.conclusion: 真实噪声条件会显著损害轨迹预测精度；通过在噪声增强数据上重训练可有效提升鲁棒性，是比输入去噪更优的策略，开源数据集可支持后续研究。

title: Peel, Don't Whack: Partial Coverage, Imperfect Validators, and Intervention Based Shortcut Mitigation
summary:
Without group labels, shortcut mitigation increasingly relies on interventions : label-preserving edits, such as background or watermark replacement, that are proposed automatically and accepted by a validator. Invariance to a complete family of valid edits yields robustness, but in practice coverage is partial and validators err.
  We analyze both in a stylized linear model. For the population logistic solution and the max-margin limit of gradient descent, the decision on every shortcut-flip group follows one additive rule. Hence worst-group accuracy never decreases with coverage, while individual groups can provably degrade, a mechanism for the Whac-a-Mole effect; full coverage is not always needed. In the logistic regime the validator's false-accept rate must stay below a closed-form tolerance that grows with coverage. With noiseless training data, one false accept can make the max-margin solution ignore the core. In this model, sensitivity-based discovery removes shortcuts in decreasing salience. We also give a model-agnostic certificate, valid under content-independent validation, whose validator-error term comes from an audit.
  Simulations match the theory, and deep networks on synthetic and real images show the predicted Whac-a-Mole signs, monotone worst-group accuracy and validator fragility. The resulting procedure, Peel (Propose-Edit-Evaluate-Learn), can propose candidate edits from the model's own mistakes. Given an oracle library of the benchmarks' intervention operators, it selects the right ones and beats group-label methods on Waterbirds and UrbanCars. With fully generated edits, run end to end from three discovery seeds, it improves on empirical risk minimization (ERM) on five of six benchmarks but trails exact edits.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无分组标签下通过"保标签编辑"实现捷径消除的理论机制，提出加性决策规则解释Whac-a-Mole效应，给出验证器容错界与模型无关证书，并提出Peel流程。
AI.motivation: 无分组标签时，捷径缓解依赖标签保持编辑（如背景/水印替换）并由验证器自动筛选接受。实际中编辑覆盖不完整且验证器会出错，但缺乏理论刻画：覆盖度与验证器误接受率如何影响最差组准确率、为何出现"打地鼠"效应。
AI.method: 在简化线性模型中分析logistic总体解与梯度下降max-margin极限，导出各捷径翻转组决策满足加性规则；推导logistic情形下验证器误接受率随覆盖度增长的闭式容错阈值及噪声数据下单次误接受的危害；分析基于敏感度的捷径发现顺序；给出内容无关验证下、含审计误差项的模型无关证书。提出Peel（Propose-Edit-Evaluate-Learn），从模型自身错误中提议候选编辑。
AI.result: 仿真与理论吻合；合成及真实图像上的深度网络呈现预测的Whac-a-Mole符号、最差组准确率单调性与验证器脆弱性。Peel在oracle编辑库下于Waterbirds与UrbanCars上优于分组标签方法；在完全生成编辑、三个发现种子端到端运行下，六个基准中五个优于ERM，但弱于精确编辑。
AI.conclusion: 最差组准确率随覆盖度单调不降，但个别组可能退化，故全覆盖并非必需；验证器误接受率须低于随覆盖度增长的闭式容差，无噪声数据下单次误接受即可使max-margin解忽略核心特征；敏感度发现按显著性递减顺序消除捷径；Peel可作为无分组标签的实用捷径缓解方案。

title: DUO Policy: Bridging Human Video Coverage and Robot Precision for Fine-Grained Manipulation
summary: Human videos promise a scalable way to reduce expensive robot data collection, but the embodiment gap limits the resulting policies to coarse behaviors, and they fail at precise tasks such as insertion. Existing methods co-train or finetune a single policy on both data sources, treating each source as equally useful in every state: the policy either absorbs the embodiment error at precision-critical steps or spends scarce robot data relearning free-space motion. We observe that the value of each source depends on the state: human data is useful where precision requirements are low, while robot data is disproportionately valuable near precision-critical states. We therefore propose \textbf{DUO Policy} (Dual-Actor Policy), which decouples a manipulation skill into a hand policy, pretrained on human videos for global free-space motion, and a robot policy, trained on sparse in-hand data for local precise corrections, with a gate learned from human interventions switching between them. This design is robust to moderate embodiment error in human data and generalizes to scene layouts beyond the coverage of the robot data. On tasks such as K-cup coffee making, desk cleanup, and cluttered candy sorting, DUO Policy outperforms the baseline with the highest average success by 12.9 percentage points over four simulated tasks and by 51.7 points over three real-world tasks, and matches robot-only training with 2.75$\times$ less data-collection time. Project Webpage: https://mingxi-jia.github.io/duo_policy_site/

AI.tldr: 提出双 actor 策略 DUO，将操作技能解耦为人体视频预训练的手策略与机器人数据训练的精调策略，并由人体干预学习门控切换，缓解人体数据与机器人数据在精度需求上的具身差距问题。
AI.motivation: 人体视频可降低昂贵的机器人数据采集成本，但存在具身差距，使策略只能学到粗粒度行为，在插入等精确任务上失败。现有方法将两类数据共同训练或微调单一策略，默认每个状态下两类数据价值相同，导致策略要么在精度关键步骤吸收具身误差，要么消耗稀缺机器人数据重复学习自由空间运动。
AI.method: 核心观察是数据价值随状态变化：人体数据在精度要求低处有用，机器人数据在精度关键状态附近价值高度集中。据此提出 DUO Policy（Dual-Actor Policy），把操作技能解耦为：手策略（hand policy，用人体视频预训练，负责全局自由空间运动）与机器人策略（robot policy，用稀疏手内数据训练，负责局部精确修正），并用从人体干预中学习的门控（gate）在两策略间切换。
AI.result: 该设计对人体数据中中等程度的具身误差稳健，并能泛化到超出机器人数据覆盖范围的场景布局。在 K-cup 咖啡制作、桌面清理、杂乱糖果分拣等任务上，DUO Policy 取得最高平均成功率，四个仿真任务上比基线高 12.9 个百分点，三个真实任务上高 51.7 个百分点，并以 2.75 倍更少的数据采集时间达到纯机器人训练的水平。
AI.conclusion: 按状态区分数据价值、并将策略解耦为自由空间运动与精确修正两部分的框架，可有效利用人体视频与稀疏机器人数据，兼顾精度与泛化，同时显著降低数据采集成本。

title: DiscernBench: Evaluating Cooperative Discernment of LLM Agents in Institutional Settings
comment: 33 pages, 11 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB)
summary: The deployment of large language models in operational settings demands evaluation of judgment under institutional constraint. We introduce DiscernBench, a benchmark for evaluating cooperative discernment: the ability of an agent to determine whether to comply with, refuse, or escalate a request in an institutional setting. DiscernBench comprises scenarios derived from real-world incident reports across domains such as aviation, law enforcement, and emergency management. We evaluate eight LLMs across three decision-making configurations and analyze both final decisions and the intermediate judgments produced during multi-agent deliberation. Under disagreement, Final Responders exhibit model- and role-dependent aggregation patterns in which a lone specialist recommendation can disproportionately influence the collective decision, a phenomenon we term Minority-Signal Override. Role-specialized multi-agent deliberation raises average over-escalation from 3.79% under direct single-agent judgment to 28.27%, with the direction and magnitude of minority-signal influence varying substantially across models and specialist roles. These results reveal distinct collective decision behaviors that are not captured by final-answer accuracy alone. Trustworthy multi-agent systems therefore require evaluating not only individual specialist reasoning, but also how conflicting judgments are transformed into collective decisions. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Disha1001/DiscernBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 DiscernBench 基准，评测 LLM 智能体在机构约束下"合作性辨别"能力（合规/拒绝/上报），发现多智能体协商中"少数信号覆盖"现象并显著抬高过度上报率。
AI.motivation: 大模型进入实际运营场景后，需要判断其在制度约束下是否具备恰当的任务判断能力；而现有评测多聚焦最终答案正确性，缺乏对"该合规、该拒绝还是该上报"这类机构性判断的系统评测，也未刻画多智能体协商过程中冲突判断如何被整合为集体决策。
AI.method: 构建 DiscernBench，场景取自航空、执法、应急管理等领域的真实事件报告；对 8 个 LLM 在 3 种决策配置下评测，并同时分析最终决策与多智能体审议中的中间判断；提出 Minority-Signal Override（少数信号覆盖）概念，刻画单一专家建议对集体决策的过度影响，并按模型与角色维度分析聚合模式。
AI.result: 角色专化的多智能体审议使平均过度上报率由单智能体直接判断的 3.79% 升至 28.27%；少数信号影响的方向与幅度随模型与专家角色显著变化；Final Responder 在分歧下的聚合呈现模型与角色依赖模式，单个专家推荐可不成比例地左右集体决策。
AI.conclusion: 仅用最终答案准确率无法刻画集体决策行为；可信多智能体系统不仅要评估单个专家推理质量，还需评估冲突判断如何被转化为集体决策。

title: Urban State Representation for Autonomous Mobility: A Survey of Multimodal Perception, Architectures, Datasets, and Benchmarks
comment: Accepted to the UrbanState Workshop at WACV 2027. 8 pages + references + 5-page supplementary appendix. Code and data: https://github.com/binayksingh/Awesome-Urban-State-Representation
summary: Cities are sensed by many platforms at once: on-board cameras, LiDAR and radar on autonomous vehicles, roadside units at intersections, drones and satellites overhead, and the GNSS traces of millions of trips. Yet most learned representations are built for one platform, one city, and one task. We survey this fragmented landscape through a single lens, the Urban State Representation (USR): a georeferenced, layered, time-varying, uncertainty-aware state that any sensing platform can write to and any downstream task can read from. We (i) formalize USR and five desiderata for it, and relate it to bird's-eye-view (BEV) features, occupancy, vectorized maps, neural fields and 3D Gaussians, scene graphs, road-network graphs, language tokens, and world-model latents; (ii) organize sensing platforms, cross-view (ground-aerial) matching, fusion operators, 3D geometric foundation models, end-to-end and vision-language-action models, and generative world models and data engines in one taxonomy that spans sensors to decisions; (iii) compile 26 urban datasets and simulators across ego, cooperative (V2X), aerial, trajectory, and language settings, with a metric glossary, a cross-benchmark results snapshot, a trend analysis, and a platform-coverage gap analysis; and (iv) review applications and propose, as an outlook, USR-5, a five-test protocol with explicit references and one aggregate score for measuring whether a state is shared, together with a research agenda of six open problems covering cross-city and cross-sensor transfer, uncertainty, efficiency, sim-to-real evaluation, and governance. This survey is an entry point for computer vision, autonomous driving, transportation, and urban computing researchers; the paper list, datasets, and USR-5 code are at https://github.com/binayksingh/Awesome-Urban-State-Representation.

AI.tldr: 提出"城市状态表征"(USR)统一视角，系统梳理城市多平台感知与学习的碎片化现状，并给出分类体系、数据集编译与评测协议。
AI.motivation: 城市被车载相机、LiDAR、雷达、路侧单元、无人机、卫星和GNSS轨迹等多平台同时感知，但现有学习到的表征多是"单平台、单城市、单任务"的，彼此割裂、难以复用与迁移。作者希望用统一概念框架整合这一碎片化领域。
AI.method: 综述性工作，围绕USR（地理参考的、分层的、时变的、不确定性感知的、可读写的状态）展开四项内容：(i) 形式化USR及五项设计要求，并将其与BEV特征、占据栅格、矢量化地图、神经场、3D高斯、场景图、路网图、语言token、世界模型隐变量建立关联；(ii) 构建从传感器到决策的统一分类法，覆盖感知平台、跨视角(地面-空中)匹配、融合算子、3D几何基础模型、端到端与VLA模型、生成式世界模型与数据引擎；(iii) 汇编26个城市数据集与仿真器（自车、V2X协同、空中、轨迹、语言场景），附指标术语表、跨基准结果快照、趋势分析与平台覆盖缺口分析；(iv) 综述应用并提出USR-5五项测试协议与综合评分。
AI.result: 形成USR概念框架与五项要求；建立跨传感器到决策的统一分类体系；整理26个数据集/仿真器并提供指标术语表与跨基准结果快照，给出趋势与平台覆盖缺口分析；提出USR-5评测协议（含明确参照与单一聚合分数）以及涵盖跨城市/跨传感器迁移、不确定性、效率、sim-to-real评测、治理等六个开放问题的研究议程。
AI.conclusion: USR可作为连接计算机视觉、自动驾驶、交通工程与城市计算研究者的公共切入点，推动表征在多平台间共享与复用，并为后续标准化评测与研究议程提供基础。

title: CLAIR: Consistent LLM Adaptation via Index-free Reprogramming
summary: Time-series forecasting with pretrained large language models (LLMs) uses contextualized patch representations, raising the question of how to align them. Matching patches at the same temporal position is natural, but self-attention allows each patch state to incorporate information from elsewhere in the input window, suggesting that useful correspondences can extend across positions. This flexibility, however, does not necessarily translate into consistent forecasts: similar patch states may play different roles when used in their original temporal order. To address both issues, we propose CLAIR (Consistent LLM Adaptation via Index-free Reprogramming), a teacher-guided framework that combines patch-level transport alignment (PTA) and forecast-level consistency (FC). A clean-view exponential moving average (EMA) teacher guides a mildly perturbed student, with PTA establishing soft, representation-dependent correspondences and FC encouraging agreement at corresponding future steps. The forecasting head retains the original patch order. We test this combination through controlled comparisons: while PTA and index-wise alignment perform similarly without FC, PTA+FC under EMA supervision reduces horizon-averaged mean squared error (MSE) by 2.1% on ETTh1 and 2.6% on ETTm1 relative to Index+FC. The same preference for PTA+FC emerges in comparisons with alternative matching strategies on Weather and ETTh2. Beyond these controls, CLAIR achieves the lowest horizon-averaged MSE on five of six long-term benchmarks and the lowest aggregate overall weighted average (OWA) on M4 among evaluated methods, with competitive few-shot performance. As the teacher and transport are used only during training, inference requires only the student.

AI.tldr: 提出CLAIR框架，用教师引导的patch级传输对齐(PTA)+预测级一致性(FC)来对齐LLM的上下文patch表征，在五个长期预测基准上取得最低平均MSE，M4上取得最低OWA，且推理仅需学生模型。
AI.motivation: 基于预训练LLM的时间序列预测使用上下文化的patch表征，如何对齐这些表征尚不明确。按同一时间位置匹配patch是自然的，但自注意力使每个patch状态融合了窗口内其他位置的信息，可能形成跨位置的有用对应关系；然而这种灵活性并不保证预测一致——相似patch状态在原始时间顺序中可能扮演不同角色。因此需要同时解决"哪里有对应关系"和"对应关系是否能产生一致预测"两个问题。
AI.method: CLAIR（Consistent LLM Adaptation via Index-free Reprogramming），教师引导框架：(1) 干净视图EMA教师指导学生模型，学生对输入施加轻微扰动；(2) Patch级传输对齐(PTA)：建立软性的、依赖表征的patch对应关系（无索引/位置约束）；(3) 预测级一致性(FC)：鼓励对应未来步上的预测一致；(4) 预测头保留原始patch顺序。教师与传输仅用于训练，推理只保留学生。
AI.result: 控制实验显示：无FC时PTA与索引式对齐表现相近；在EMA监督下，PTA+FC相比Index+FC在ETTh1上降低horizon平均MSE 2.1%，ETTm1上降低2.6%；在Weather和ETTh2与替代匹配策略比较时PTA+FC同样更优。整体上，CLAIR在6个长期预测基准中的5个取得最低horizon平均MSE，在M4上取得所评估方法中最低的聚合OWA，少样本性能具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 位置索引式对齐并非必要；表征依赖的软传输对齐（PTA）需配合预测级一致性（FC）与EMA教师监督才能发挥优势。CLAIR在长期与M4基准上总体领先，且训练期组件不增加推理开销。

title: Your Diffusion-Based Driving Planner Only Needs a Nudge
comment: Autonomous driving, Trajectory Planning, Diffusion-based Planners, Reinforcement Learning, RL Post-training, Off-policy RL
summary: Diffusion-based planners capture the multimodality of human driving behavior well, yet covariate shift in closed-loop driving can lead them to generate trajectories that result in collisions or road departures. Reinforcement learning (RL) finetuning offers a promising way to tackle this issue, but applying it to diffusion-based planners is complicated by their iterative denoising process and receding-horizon execution. We find that small adjustments to the planned trajectories can prevent many of these unsafe outcomes. Motivated by this observation, we propose PlanNudge, which preserves the learned planning capabilities of a pretrained diffusion-based planner by freezing it and trains a lightweight policy that we call the nudge policy. At each planning step, the nudge policy outputs a nudge, a two-dimensional adjustment of the speed and curvature of the plan from the frozen planner. The nudge policy is a multilayer perceptron that predicts the nudge in a single forward pass, and both dimensions directly change the motion of the vehicle, so standard off-policy RL can train it in closed-loop simulation. We evaluate PlanNudge on nuPlan, a large-scale autonomous driving benchmark based on real-world driving data. In all six settings, PlanNudge matches or exceeds the final scores of the previous state-of-the-art RL finetuning method while using about one sixth as many environment steps and less than one fifth as much model compute. We also provide guidelines for reward shaping, value learning, and exploration when using off-policy RL to post-train autonomous driving planners. Our results are reported with means and standard deviations over six training runs. Project page: https://zerlinwang.github.io/plannudge/

AI.tldr: 提出 PlanNudge：冻结预训练扩散规划器，用轻量 nudge policy 以单次前向预测"速度+曲率"的二维微调量，从而用标准 off-policy RL 在闭环仿真中后训练，效率与效果均优于现有 SOTA RL 微调方法。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散的规划器能刻画人类驾驶的多模态性，但闭环执行中的协变量偏移（covariate shift）会导致碰撞或偏离车道。直接用 RL 微调扩散规划器很困难，因为其迭代去噪过程与滚动时域（receding-horizon）执行方式与标准 RL 接口不兼容。作者观察到：对规划轨迹做小幅调整即可避免大量不安全结果。
AI.method: PlanNudge 冻结预训练扩散规划器以保留其已学到的规划能力，仅训练一个轻量 nudge policy（多层感知机）。每个规划步中，该策略单次前向输出二维 nudge：对冻结规划器所给计划的速度与曲率进行调整。由于这两个维度直接改变车辆运动，可用标准 off-policy RL 在闭环仿真中训练。论文另给出奖励塑形、价值学习与探索的设计准则。
AI.result: 在基于真实驾驶数据的 nuPlan 基准上，全部六种设置中，PlanNudge 的最终得分均持平或超过此前 SOTA 的 RL 微调方法；所需环境交互步数约为其 1/6，模型计算量不足其 1/5。结果以六次训练运行的均值±标准差报告。
AI.conclusion: 以"小幅调整"替代"整体重训"是后训练扩散规划器的高效范式：冻结主干 + 低维动作空间接口，使 off-policy RL 能以极低样本与算力代价缓解闭环协变量偏移，并可推广为自动驾驶规划器 RL 后训练的通用实践指南。

title: When do stored facts become available in looped transformers?
summary: Looped transformers do not acquire new knowledge during a forward pass. Prior work shows that they store as many bits in their weights as non-looped models. It remains unclear how recurrence makes this knowledge available during inference. We study this question using synthetic factual recall and multi-hop reasoning, measuring depth-resolved readable information in bits with native readouts and tuned lenses. Under final-loop supervision, single-hop facts become readable progressively: heavier memorization loads delay retrieval despite comparable final readable information. Untied baselines of equal unrolled depth concentrate retrieval near the end of their stacks, whereas looped models expose facts earlier. This delay is not intrinsic to the tested recall tasks: training with supervision and depth-specific readouts at every loop makes near-final information readable after the first loop in all tested configurations. Representational analysis shows value-related structure emerging within states organized by the query key. We then study multi-hop chains whose facts are stored in the weights rather than given in the prompt. Intermediate entities become decodable in chain order, and aligned transitions show next-entity structure developing while current-entity structure remains dominant. Interventions in a released six-recurrence model establish a causal role for these representations. Counterfactual replacements of a probe-defined entity component at a single prompt position redirect downstream bridge entities and the final answer. Conversely, replacements from queries that reach the same entity through different preceding relations, preserving the remaining relation suffix, retain the original answer in over 99.5\% of tested cases. These results distinguish a training-dependent schedule for factual recall from the causal role of retrieved-entity representations in subsequent composition.

AI.tldr: 该文研究循环（looped）Transformer如何在推理时把权重中存储的知识“读出来”，并用合成事实召回与多跳推理任务量化深度分辨的可读信息量，揭示召回时间表由训练方式决定、而检索到的实体表征对后续组合具有因果作用。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer在前向传播中不获取新知识，其权重比特容量与非循环模型相当，但循环如何使这些知识在推理时变得可用仍不清楚。作者希望厘清循环深度与事实可读性之间的关系，并区分“召回调度”与“表征的因果作用”。
AI.method: 采用合成事实召回与多跳推理任务；以比特为单位测量深度分辨的可读信息（native readouts 与 tuned lenses）；对比同深度展开的 untied 基线；训练时在每一循环施加监督与深度特定读出；进行表示分析（由 query key 组织的状态、value 相关结构、链序中间实体解码）；并在已发布的六循环模型上做因果干预（反事实替换探针定义的实体成分），检验下游桥接实体与最终答案的改变，以及对不同先行关系但同一实体的替换的鲁棒性对照。
AI.result: 仅末尾循环监督下，单跳事实逐步可读，记忆负载越重检索越延迟，尽管最终可读信息量相当；同展开深度的 untied 基线把检索集中在层堆末尾，而循环模型更早暴露事实。逐循环监督+深度特定读出可使所有测试配置在第一个循环后即可读近末端信息。多跳链中中间实体按链序可解码，对齐转移显示下一实体结构发育而当前实体结构仍占主导。因果干预显示：单提示位置替换实体成分可重定向下游桥接实体与最终答案；而保持剩余关系后缀、经不同先行关系到达同一实体的替换，>99.5% 情况下保留原答案。
AI.conclusion: 事实召回的时间表是训练依赖的（而非任务或循环结构固有），而检索到的实体表征在后续组合中扮演因果角色；二者应区分开来看待。

title: SceneTether: Activity-Gated Value Anchoring for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Image Animation
summary: Long-horizon image animation must keep the scene fixed while natural material (e.g., water, smoke, or fire) continues to move. Autoregressive video generators read recent frames for temporal continuity, but this history also carries accumulated appearance errors, and sparsifying it disrupts motion. We introduce SceneTether, a training-free attention-read policy that keeps where attention reads recent memory but changes what appearance that memory returns. SceneTether keeps every key of the newest latent, blends its low-activity values toward co-located source-image values, and leaves high-activity values untouched so motion can evolve; an activity map estimated from the first generated latents and then frozen decides where to blend. It adds no denoising evaluations and leaves the cache-update rule unchanged. On a Causal Forcing++ generator, SceneTether raises source-support PSNR by 5.15 dB over its framewise Echo host across two seeds with 1.5x its late activity, and by 7.31 dB over spatial Echo-Forcing on a preselected four-minute subset. At equal recent-memory coverage, value anchoring alone adds 8.14 dB. A post-hoc pixel composite with the same map matches static fidelity but retains nearly twice the moving-region color drift, and viewers in a small blinded study preferred SceneTether for its natural scene and motion preservation. Project page: https://minar09.github.io/scenetether/

AI.tldr: 提出免训练注意力读取策略 SceneTether：在新 latent 的低活跃度区域将 value 向源图像对应位置混合，抑制自回归长时动画的外观误差累积，同时保留动态区域的自然运动。
AI.motivation: 长时程图像动画需要在保持场景固定的同时让水、烟、火等自然材质持续运动。自回归视频生成器依赖近期帧维持时序连续性，但历史帧携带累积的外观误差，而稀疏化历史又会破坏运动，因此需要在不改动记忆读取位置的前提下解决外观漂移。
AI.method: 保持注意力读取的键（key）位置不变，仅改变记忆返回的外观内容：保留最新 latent 的全部 key，把低活跃度位置的 value 向源图像同坐标 value 混合，高活跃度位置不动以允许运动演化；活跃度图由首批生成 latent 估计后冻结；不增加去噪评估次数，缓存更新规则不变。
AI.result: 在 Causal Forcing++ 上，相对逐帧 Echo 基线在两个随机种子下 source-support PSNR 提升 5.15 dB，且后期活跃度为 1.5 倍；在预选的四分钟子集上相对 spatial Echo-Forcing 提升 7.31 dB。相同近期记忆覆盖率下，仅做 value 锚定即带来 8.14 dB 提升。事后像素合成使用同一活跃度图虽达到同等静态保真度，但动态区域颜色漂移约为前者两倍；小规模盲测中受试者更偏好 SceneTether 的场景与运动自然性。
AI.conclusion: 通过在注意力 value 层面进行空间解耦的源图像锚定，SceneTether 以零额外训练和零额外去噪成本显著缓解长时动画的静态外观漂移，并优于基于像素合成的后处理方案，验证了"读哪里不变、读什么被修正"这一思路的有效性。

title: How many mistakes does it take to learn an interval? Exact Littlestone dimensions of intervals and their unions
comment: 33 pages, 11 figures, 5 tables. Code and Lean 4 proofs: https://github.com/researchbackup27-sudo/exact-littlestone-intervals
summary: The Littlestone dimension of a hypothesis class equals the smallest number of mistakes an online learner can guarantee against an adaptive adversary. For discrete intervals and unions of $j$ intervals on $m$ points, only its order of growth was known. We determine it exactly. For every switch budget $k$ (with both end labels fixed when $k$ is odd), the smallest size on which $d$ mistakes can be forced follows a three-regime law: $d+1$ while $d\le k$, then $2d-k+1$, and beyond $d=\lceil 3k/2\rceil+k-1$ doubling the size adds exactly $k$ mistakes. Unions of $j$ intervals on $m$ points correspond to $k=2j$ and size $m+1$, and a single interval gives the thresholds $1,2,3,5,7,10,14,20,\dots$. The natural learner that waits for a positive example and binary-searches both endpoints is not optimal: it can be forced into one extra mistake for 50,847 of the domain sizes below $10^5$. Upper bounds come from a gap potential and a block-pairing learner, and lower bounds from adversary strategies and a refinement step. These tools give an explicit optimal learner with $O(\log m)$ time per round, which on random streams makes more mistakes on average than the natural learner. For randomised learners, we compute the randomised Littlestone dimension of thresholds exactly and prove that a greedy adversary forces an explicit closed-form number of expected mistakes on intervals; this bound is within $0.64$ of optimal and, we conjecture, exact (confirmed for $m\le70$). Exact computation tests every result, and the formulas for every switch budget are machine-checked in Lean 4.

AI.tldr: 本文精确确定了离散区间及其 j 个区间并集的 Littlestone 维数，揭示了关于切换预算 k 的三段式增长规律，并给出显式最优学习器与随机化分析。
AI.motivation: 此前对 m 点上的离散区间及 j 个区间并集，只知其 Littlestone 维数的增长阶，缺乏精确刻画；同时自然学习器（等待正例后二分搜索两端点）是否最优尚不清楚。
AI.method: 以上界来自 gap potential 与块配对学习器（block-pairing learner），下界来自对手策略与精化步骤；对随机化学习器精确计算阈值类的随机化 Littlestone 维数，并用贪心对手给出区间上的闭式期望错误数；所有结论经精确计算验证，公式在 Lean 4 中机器检验。
AI.result: 对每个切换预算 k，迫使 d 次错误所需最小规模呈三段规律：d≤k 时为 d+1，其后为 2d−k+1，超过 d=⌈3k/2⌉+k−1 后规模每翻倍恰增 k 次错误；j 个区间并集对应 k=2j、规模 m+1，单区间给出阈值序列 1,2,3,5,7,10,14,20,…。自然学习器非最优，在 10^5 以下有 50,847 个规模可被多逼出一次错误；随机化情形下贪心对手的界与最优相差不超过 0.64（m≤70 已验证）。
AI.conclusion: 给出了 O(log m) 每轮的显式最优学习器（随机流上平均错误反而多于自然学习器）；随机化阈值的 Littlestone 维数被精确求得，区间期望错误界被猜想为精确值。

title: Implementation and Software-in-the-Loop Evaluation of a Trans-Domain Digital Twin Architecture for Autonomous Guidance of the Phoenix VTOL UAV Without Online GNSS
comment: 34 pages, 17 figures, 4 tables. Software-in-the-loop evaluation of GNSS-independent Phoenix VTOL guidance using a trans-domain digital twin architecture. Source code and reproducibility materials: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24419538
summary: Autonomous UAV guidance in emergency response, infrastructure monitoring, and cargo transportation requires reliable navigation. However, satellite-based positioning may become unavailable or unreliable in enclosed spaces, blind spots caused by natural obstacles and structures, and environments affected by radio interference and signal spoofing during electronic warfare. This study designs, implements, and evaluates a system based on a Trans-Domain Digital Twin (TDDT) for autonomous guidance of the Phoenix VTOL UAV. Independent navigation, flight dynamics, and meteorological models are coordinated within a cycle of state estimation, prediction, decision-making, command execution, and feedback. Data from inertial, magnetic, pressure, and airspeed sensors, together with environmental information, form the basis for estimation and prediction. Furthermore, a shared state, temporal synchronization, preservation of information provenance, and command traceability establish continuity between models and decisions. The system was tested with a simulated physical twin in a software-in-the-loop environment. Vertical takeoff, movement toward the destination, landing, and autonomous stopping were recorded, and the dynamic model was adjusted to a limited extent based on sensor-derived feedback. Separating the evaluation reference from navigation inputs enabled independent assessment of positioning error and computational performance. The results confirm operational coordination, decision traceability, and closed-loop guidance under the tested conditions, providing a reproducible platform for the development and evaluation of navigation without satellite-based positioning.

AI.tldr: 本文设计、实现并评估了一种基于跨域数字孪生（TDDT）的自主制导系统，用于让 Phoenix 垂直起降无人机在无卫星定位可用或不可靠的环境中完成独立导航。系统将导航、飞行动力学与气象模型纳入"状态估计—预测—决策—指令执行—反馈"闭环，并在软件在环环境中借助物理孪生进行验证，结果显示各模型协同运行、决策可追溯、闭环制导有效，为无卫星定位导航的研发与评估提供了可复现平台。
AI.motivation: 无人机在应急响应、基础设施监测和货运中的自主制导依赖可靠导航，但卫星定位在封闭空间、自然障碍与建筑遮挡的盲区、以及受无线电干扰和信号欺骗影响的环境中可能不可用或不可靠。因此需要一种不依赖卫星定位的自主导航与制导方案，并具备可复现的评估手段。
AI.method: 提出基于跨域数字孪生（TDDT）的系统，针对 Phoenix 垂直起降无人机：1）将独立的导航模型、飞行动力学模型和气象模型在一个"状态估计—预测—决策—指令执行—反馈"循环中协同；2）以惯性、磁、气压和空速传感器数据及环境信息作为估计与预测的基础；3）通过共享状态、时间同步、信息来源保留和指令可追溯性，保证模型与决策之间的连续性；4）在软件在环（SIL）环境中与模拟物理孪生进行测试；5）将评估基准与导航输入分离，从而独立评估定位误差与计算性能。
AI.result: 测试记录到垂直起飞、向目标点移动、着陆和自主停止等行为，并根据传感器反馈对动力学模型进行了有限调整；在评估基准与导航输入分离的条件下，实现了对定位误差和计算性能的独立评估。结果表明在测试条件下系统具备运行协同、决策可追溯以及闭环制导能力。
AI.conclusion: 基于 TDDT 的系统能够在无卫星定位条件下实现可追溯的闭环自主制导，为不依赖卫星定位的导航方法的开发与评估提供了一个可复现的平台；但验证仅限于软件在环仿真条件，实际飞行与更复杂干扰场景仍有待进一步检验。

title: Improving semantic equivalence in research-level math formalization
comment: Accepted at the 6th Math-AI workshop at NeurIPS'26
summary: Formalizing mathematics in Lean is never a word-for-word translation of a paper: a Lean formalization changes definitions, strengthens hypotheses, splits arguments, and adds lemmas the paper never mentions. It stands to reason that a model that is good at autoformalization must be a good predictor of how a natural language source must differ from its faithful Lean formalization. With that in mind, we collect 4{,}076 audited examples of such changes from 832 Lean projects that formalize research-level mathematics, and use them to ask a practical question: how well can a model \emph{write} Lean inside a real research-level project that may contain tens of thousands of lines of code, and does training on discrepancies between natural language sources and their faithful Lean formalizations help? Our training set consists of 3{,}431 tasks from 141 repositories, and the test set consists of 645 tasks from the remaining 27 repositories. Training on in-project Lean nearly doubles complete proofs ($11\% \to 20\%$) and raises the share of statements in gold agreement with the project's own formalization by nearly a third ($30\%$ to $39\%$). The gain comes from the pairs themselves: an adapter trained only to predict how the Lean will differ, or a model told the difference in advance, barely helps. Training on where formalizations depart from their sources is thus an effective way of improving semantic equivalence in research-level formalization.

AI.tldr: 本文收集832个Lean项目中共4076条"自然语言源与本真Lean形式化之间的差异"审计样本，用其训练模型在真实研究级Lean项目内写代码，证明训练于这些差异能显著提升完整证明率与陈述的语义一致性。
AI.motivation: Lean形式化并非逐字翻译：它需要改定义、加强假设、拆分论证、补充论文未提的引理。作者据此假设：擅长自动形式化的模型应当能预测自然语言源与其忠实Lean形式化之间的差异；并想回答一个实际问题——模型能否在含数万行代码的真实研究级项目中写Lean，以及用这种差异对训练是否有帮助。
AI.method: 从832个形式化研究级数学的Lean项目中审计并收集4076条"源—形式化差异"样本；训练集为141个仓库的3431个任务，测试集为其余27个仓库的645个任务，在仓库内上下文条件下训练与评测（in-project Lean）。并设消融/对照：仅训练预测差异的adapter、以及事先告知模型差异的做法。
AI.result: 在项目内Lean上训练使完整证明的生成率近乎翻倍（11%→20%），使与项目自身形式化在gold上达成一致的陈述比例从30%提升到39%（近三分之一）。增益主要来自配对数据本身：仅训练预测差异的adapter、或事先告知模型差异，几乎没有帮助。
AI.conclusion: 训练于形式化偏离源文本之处，是提升研究级形式化中语义等价性的有效途径；这也表明"预测源与形式化的差异"是自动形式化能力的良好代理。

title: Beyond Output Suppression: Mitigating Privacy Risks in LVLMs via Visual Intrinsic Privacy Erasure
summary: Large vision-language models can extract personally identifiable information from images, making privacy protection essential for their deployment in perception-oriented tasks. Existing targeted fine-tuning and model-editing methods usually suppress sensitive answers by aligning the model toward safe responses. In this paper, we show that such protection can be illusory: although the fine-tuned model refuses to disclose private information under normal decoding, privacy leakage still occurs in sentence completion scenarios. This indicates that existing algorithms only change the model's output distribution, but the model still retains the ability to perceive private information. Private information therefore still remains inside the model. To address this problem, we propose Visual Intrinsic Privacy Erasure (VIPE), which targets privacy-related visual representations to weaken the model's ability to perceive sensitive information. VIPE constructs paired privacy-sensitive and privacy-masked images, uses their internal feature residuals to identify privacy-related visual components, and suppresses these components before they are perceived by the model. To preserve benign visual representations, the erasure objective projects feature differences onto a relaxed benign subspace and adaptively controls the erasure strength. VIPE compels the model to ignore the extraction of sensitive information in the visual representation space, thereby blocking the source of privacy leakage more fundamentally rather than merely altering the model's output distribution. Experiments on Qwen2.5-VL and LLaVA-OneVision show that VIPE substantially alleviates prefix-triggered privacy leakage while maintaining competitive utility on general visual-language benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示现有视觉语言模型隐私微调仅为"输出分布层面"的保护，句子补全场景下仍会泄露隐私；提出 VIPE，在视觉表征空间直接擦除隐私相关成分，实现更根本的隐私防护。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型能从图像中提取个人可识别信息（PII），部署于感知任务时隐私保护至关重要。现有定向微调与模型编辑方法通过将模型对齐到安全回答来抑制敏感输出，但作者指出这种保护是"虚幻的"：正常解码下模型虽拒绝披露隐私，在句子补全场景中仍会泄露。这说明现有算法只改变了输出分布，模型仍保留感知隐私信息的能力，隐私信息依旧存在于模型内部，因而需要从表征源头进行擦除。
AI.method: 提出 Visual Intrinsic Privacy Erasure（VIPE）：①构造隐私敏感图像与隐私掩码图像配对，利用二者的内部特征残差定位隐私相关的视觉成分；②在这些成分被模型感知之前对其进行抑制；③为保留良性视觉表征，将擦除目标投影到松弛的良性子空间（relaxed benign subspace）上，并自适应控制擦除强度。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL 与 LLaVA-OneVision 上的实验表明，VIPE 显著缓解前缀触发（prefix-triggered）的隐私泄露，同时在通用视觉语言基准上保持有竞争力的效用。
AI.conclusion: VIPE 迫使模型在视觉表征空间中忽略敏感信息提取，从源头阻断隐私泄露，而非仅改变输出分布；为多模态模型隐私保护提供了"表征层面擦除"的新范式，并实现隐私-效用较好的权衡。

title: The Complexity of Oracle-Efficient Realizable Transductive Learning
summary: In realizable transductive online learning, the learner knows the entire sequence of $T$ instances in advance, and the labels are consistent with one of $N$ hypotheses. With explicit access to the hypothesis class, the halving algorithm makes at most $\log_2 N$ mistakes. Can a comparable guarantee be achieved using only polynomially many empirical risk minimization (ERM) queries? We answer this question negatively, even for a weighted-ERM oracle that optimizes arbitrary real-valued linear objectives and returns a complete maximizing hypothesis. For every fixed $β\in(0,1)$ and every randomized learner making polynomially many oracle queries, there exists a fixed realizable instance with exactly $N=2^{\lfloor T^β\rfloor}$ hypotheses on which the learner makes $Ω_β(\sqrt{T\log N})$ mistakes in expectation. This matches the agnostic-rate upper bound achieved by random playout using $O(T)$ oracle calls. The separation persists for much smaller classes as well: along a sequence with $\log N=Θ((\log T)^2)$, we establish a mistake lower bound of $\exp(Ω(\log T/\log\log T))$. Our main technical contribution is a composition lemma that combines two realizable prediction problems such that their mistake lower bounds add, up to a small loss, while their hypothesis class sizes grow only additively. Iterating this lemma yields a family of hard instances spanning the desired parameter regimes, establishing a sharp separation between information-theoretic and oracle-efficient mistake guarantees.

AI.tldr: 在可实现转导在线学习中，仅用多项式次ERM查询无法复现减半算法的 log₂N 遗憾保证：对任意随机化学习器存在可实现实例使其期望错误数达 Ω_β(√(T log N))，与随机playout的O(T)次查询上界紧密匹配；核心技术是"错误下界可加、类大小仅可加增长"的组合引理。
AI.motivation: 减半算法在显式访问假设类时仅犯 log₂N 个错误，但实际学习器往往只能通过ERM预言机访问假设类。论文要回答：仅用多项式次（加权）ERM查询能否达到与信息论最优可比的错误保证，即刻画信息论效率与预言机效率之间的分离。
AI.method: 考虑加权ERM预言机（优化任意实值线性目标并返回完整的最优假设）。对任意固定β∈(0,1)与任意多项式查询的随机化学习器，构造固定可实现实例（N=2^⌊T^β⌋个假设）证明期望错误下界；主要技术工具是组合引理——将两个可实现预测问题组合，使错误下界近似相加而假设类规模仅相加，通过迭代该引理得到覆盖不同参数区间的困难实例族。
AI.result: 对每个固定β∈(0,1)和每个多项式查询的随机化学习器，存在N=2^⌊T^β⌋个假设的固定可实现实例，使期望错误数达 Ω_β(√(T log N))，与随机playout（O(T)次预言机调用）的不可知速率上界匹配；分离在小类情形亦成立：当 log N=Θ((log T)²) 时错误下界为 exp(Ω(log T/log log T))。
AI.conclusion: 信息论最优（log₂N）与预言机高效学习之间存在尖锐分离：多项式次ERM查询不足以达到减半算法的错误保证，随机playout在查询复杂度O(T)下已接近最优。该结果表明预言机高效的可实现转导在线学习本质上受限于不可知速率，组合引理为此类下界提供了可迭代的通用框架。

title: FunGrasp-Zero: Field-Conditioned Graph Attention Policy for Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Functional Grasping
summary: Dexterous functional grasping is critical for robotic tool use, yet current dexterous hands exhibit substantial morphological diversity. This hardware heterogeneity makes cross-embodiment functional grasping a fundamental but largely unexplored problem. Existing functional grasping methods use retargeted hand poses as guidance, tying task representation to a specific embodiment and failing to explicitly capture object-centric functional contact intent, limiting generalization across hands. To address this, we propose FunGrasp-Zero, a reinforcement learning framework for zero-shot cross-embodiment functional grasping. Instead of relying on embodiment-specific joint configuration, FunGrasp-Zero captures functional intent via an object-centric, cross-embodiment-consistent contact map, adapted to heterogeneous hands through morphological mapping. We construct a hand-object potential field from mapped contact regions, yielding attractive and repulsive guidance vectors. A Field-Conditioned Graph Attention Network (FC-GAT) leverages these vectors to coordinate multi-finger motion across hands, while a potential field reward guides fingers toward target regions and penalizes non-target collisions to enforce functional alignment and stability. We further establish X-FunBench for cross-embodiment functional grasping, evaluating both physical grasp success and functional intent preservation across hands. Evaluated on X-FunBench, our unified policy, co-trained on four embodiments, achieves 86% average grasp success rate across five unseen hands on novel objects.
