Deployed on four unseen physical hands (Leap, Inspire, Sharpa, Wuji) for novel object grasping, the policy achieves 80% average success rate without fine-tuning. To our knowledge, FunGrasp-Zero is the first RL-based framework to achieve zero-shot cross-embodiment functional grasping across unseen hands in both simulation and the real world.

AI.tldr: 提出FunGrasp-Zero强化学习框架，以物体中心的跨本体一致接触图表达功能意图，实现零样本跨本体功能性抓取，并建立X-FunBench基准。
AI.motivation: 灵巧手形态差异大，现有功能性抓取方法以重定向手部姿态为引导，将任务表示绑定于特定本体，无法显式刻画物体中心的功能性接触意图，跨手泛化受限；跨本体功能性抓取问题基本未被探索。
AI.method: 以物体中心、跨本体一致的接触图表示功能意图，并通过形态映射适配异构手；由映射接触区域构造手-物体势场，产生吸引/排斥引导向量；提出Field-Conditioned Graph Attention Network（FC-GAT）利用该向量协调多指运动；设计势场奖励引导手指趋向目标区域并惩罚非目标碰撞；构建X-FunBench评测基准，联合训练四本体统一策略。
AI.result: 在X-FunBench上，四本体共训的单一策略对五种未见手、新物体平均抓取成功率86%；在Leap、Inspire、Sharpa、Wuji四种未见真实手上无需微调平均成功率80%。
AI.conclusion: FunGrasp-Zero为首个在仿真与真实环境中均实现跨未见手零样本功能性抓取的RL框架，验证了以物体中心接触意图作为本体无关表示的可行性。

title: Does a Frontier Large Language Model Know What It Can Solve? A 100-Conjecture Calibration Study
comment: Accepted at the 6th AI-Math Workshop at NeurIPS'26
summary: How does confidence correlate with actual performance in large language models, when attacking open research-level math problems? We address this question by studying the performance of ChatGPT 5.6 Sol Ultra on a set of 100 open conjectures in geometric analysis. By construction, the model first selected open problems in geometric analysis that it assessed that it had at least a 50\% chance of proving or disproving, and then assigned a probability of success to each question. 13 questions were then excluded after an audit, and the model was asked to resolve the remaining 87 problems. Its mean stated resolution probability was $0.617$, versus an observed rate of $0.103$ (Brier score $0.351$, ECE $0.513$), thereby demonstrating that the model was systematically over-confident in its self-assessment. However, the scores retained ranking signal (AUROC $0.714$). The model was highly overconfident in probability magnitude but did more often than not assign a high probability of success to the problems that it did resolve, than the problems that it did not. Hence, its probabilities were numerically mis-calibrated but directionally correct. All proofs have been formalized in Lean, thereby verifying correctness, and have been run through a semantic equivalence pipeline to ensure semantic equivalence between the formalized and informal statements. These are exploratory campaign outcomes, not fixed-budget success probabilities. The certificates prove formal statements; for a couple of questions, some geometric inputs are assumed in the lean proofs.

AI.tldr: 研究让大模型在100个几何分析公开猜想上先自评成功率再作答，发现模型严重过度自信（平均自评0.617 vs 实际解决率0.103），但预测概率仍具排序信号（AUROC 0.714），即"数值失准、方向正确"。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型在面对开放研究级数学问题（而非有标准答案的基准题）时，其自报置信度与实际解题表现是否一致，即模型校准性（calibration）问题。
AI.method: 以 ChatGPT 5.6 Sol Ultra 为对象，构建100个几何分析公开猜想集合：模型先自行筛选其认为至少50%概率可证明或证伪的问题，并为每题给出成功概率；经审计剔除13题，对剩余87题实际求解。用 Brier 分数与 ECE 衡量校准，用 AUROC 衡量排序能力。所有证明在 Lean 中形式化验证，并经语义等价流水线确保形式化陈述与原陈述一致。
AI.result: 平均自评成功率0.617，实际解决率仅0.103；Brier 分数0.351，ECE 0.513，显示系统性过度自信。但 AUROC 达0.714，说明概率仍具有效的区分/排序信号：被解决的问题更常获得高概率评估。
AI.conclusion: 模型的概率输出在数值幅度上严重高估但方向正确——属"数值失准、方向可用"。作者强调这是探索性实验活动的观测结果，而非固定预算下的成功率估计；Lean 证书证明的是形式化命题，且少数问题在形式化证明中假设了部分几何输入。

title: ENGRAM: Reliability-Weighted Latent Fusion and Occlusion-Aware Layered Readout for Video World Models
summary: Camera-conditioned video world models aim to generate 3D-consistent videos from a single image along specified camera trajectories. However, set-union updates in latent spatial memory leave repeated observations unconsolidated, while frontmost-only readout limits simultaneous access to stored evidence at different depths. To address these limitations, we present ENGRAM, a latent spatial memory framework combining reliability-weighted latent fusion and occlusion-aware layered readout. Specifically, recursive fusion integrates geometrically and visually compatible observations in a channel-normalized latent space, consolidating repeated evidence into a shared scene representation. Layered readout exposes multiple depth-ordered latent candidates with their reliability and availability at each target cell. This gives the generator access to information from multiple surfaces as visibility changes. Explicit camera rays provide viewpoint information independently of memory coverage, while geometric consistency constraints guide memory updates. Memory retrieval uses a single projection at latent resolution, avoiding intermediate RGB rendering and VAE re-encoding. We adapt a pretrained video generator using only 256 training scenes. On 100 RealEstate10K test scenes, ENGRAM improves novel-view-synthesis and closed-loop PSNRs over Spatia by 0.82 and 4.48 dB, respectively. On a 200-case WorldScore evaluation subset, it achieves an average score of 67.78, exceeding Spatia by 3.31 points. Project page: https://wchkoutian.github.io/engram-website/.

AI.tldr: ENGRAM：面向相机条件视频世界模型的潜在空间记忆框架，用可靠性加权递归融合替代集合并更新、用遮挡感知分层读出替代仅最前层读出，仅用256个训练场景即在新视角合成与闭环生成上显著超越Spatia。
AI.motivation: 现有相机条件视频世界模型在潜在空间记忆中采用“集合并”式更新，导致重复观测无法被整合；同时读出仅取最前层，无法同时访问不同深度的已存证据，限制了多表面可见性变化时的信息利用。
AI.method: 提出ENGRAM，包含两部分：(1) 可靠性加权潜在融合——在通道归一化的潜在空间中递归融合几何与视觉兼容的观测，将重复证据整合为共享场景表示；(2) 遮挡感知分层读出——在每个目标单元暴露多个按深度排序的潜在候选及其可靠性与可用性。此外，显式相机射线独立于记忆覆盖范围提供视角信息，几何一致性约束指导记忆更新；检索在潜在分辨率上单次投影完成，无需中间RGB渲染与VAE重编码。基于预训练视频生成器，仅用256个场景适配训练。
AI.result: 在100个RealEstate10K测试场景上，新视角合成与闭环PSNR分别较Spatia提升0.82 dB和4.48 dB；在200例WorldScore子集上平均得分67.78，高出Spatia 3.31分。
AI.conclusion: 通过将潜在空间记忆的写入与读取分别重构为可靠性加权融合和遮挡感知分层访问，并以显式相机射线解耦视角信息，可在极少训练数据下显著提升相机条件视频世界模型的3D一致性与生成质量，且避免了RGB渲染与重编码开销。

title: Operating-Condition Normalization in C-MAPSS: Matched Historical Baselines, Multi-Seed Robustness, and Prognostic-Score Trade-offs
summary: Operating-state changes can obscure turbofan degradation signals, but a reduction in remaining-useful-life (RUL) error after condition-wise standardization may reflect weaknesses of the comparison features instead of a unique benefit of normalization. A controlled retrospective audit examines NASA C-MAPSS FD002 and FD004 with engine-disjoint folds, raw condition identifiers, two constructions of causal history, early-life baselines, and continuous operating-setting correction. Ridge regression, random forests and XGBoost are compared under explicit training-engine-only fitting rules. The previously reported XGBoost FD004 terminal RMSE decreased from 30.38 to 29.08 cycles following six-condition standardization; however, raw sensor values accompanied by condition-matched histories and condition identifiers achieved 28.09 cycles, reversing the naive point estimate ranking, although the paired-engine interval spans zero. For FD002, normalized XGBoost reduced terminal RMSE yet increased the asymmetric NASA score (12,616 to 13,289). Additional model-seed, condition count, RUL-cap, grouped-validation and explanation checks test sensitivity rather than postulating a universally optimal representation. The six clusters reproduce known simulator operating regimes; no new condition discovery algorithm, causal diagnostic method, or field ready prognostic system is claimed. Since the official test endpoints were also used in earlier exploratory comparisons, all newly examined alternatives are reported as retrospective benchmark evidence, not as results from a pristine confirmatory holdout.

AI.tldr: 本文对C-MAPSS FD002/FD004做回顾性审计：条件标准化带来的RUL误差下降可能源于对比特征缺陷而非归一化本身独特优势。
AI.motivation: 工况变化会掩盖涡扇发动机退化信号，通常用工况标准化提升RUL预测；但误差下降未必证明归一化有效，可能只是对比基线特征较弱。作者因此要区分"归一化收益"与"对比构造收益"。
AI.method: 采用引擎不重叠（engine-disjoint）折、原始工况标识、两种因果历史构造、早期寿命基线和连续工况设置校正；在仅用训练引擎拟合的显式规则下比较Ridge、随机森林与XGBoost；辅以模型种子、条件簇数量、RUL上限、分组验证与解释性检查的敏感性分析。
AI.result: FD004上XGBoost经六条件标准化后终端RMSE由30.38降至29.08周期；但原始传感器值配合工况匹配历史与工况标识达28.09周期，逆转朴素点估计排序（配对引擎区间跨零）。FD002上标准化XGBoost虽降低终端RMSE，却使非对称NASA评分从12,616升至13,289。六个簇复现已知模拟器运行区间。
AI.conclusion: 工况标准化无普遍最优性；误差改善依赖于对比特征构造，评价应兼顾非对称评分与不确定性。未提出新工况发现算法、因果诊断方法或现场可用预测系统；因官方测试端点曾被用于早期探索性比较，新考察的替代方案仅作为回顾性基准证据，而非纯净确证性留出集结果。

title: DriveTTO: Understanding Search and Selection in Test-Time Trajectory Optimization for End-to-End Driving
comment: 20 pages, including supplementary material. Project page: https://rtwotwo.github.io/DriveTTO/ Code: https://github.com/Rtwotwo/DriveTTO
summary: In difficult driving scenes, a learned scorer can select a poor trajectory from a fixed pool even when a better candidate is available. Nearby vehicles and road boundaries can also leave only a narrow range of high-scoring maneuvers. These constraints vary with the scene and are difficult to cover exhaustively during training. We introduce DriveTTO, a training-free method that searches around native proposals and checks each proposed refinement against a retained trajectory. A frozen scorer evaluates completed paths at the endpoints they actually reach, guiding resampling in progressively smaller neighborhoods. From a shared reference, one branch draws on planner proposals and another perturbs vehicle controls. DriveTTO blends their poses at matching times and accepts a branch or fusion update only when both frozen scorers predict a gain. On Navtest, DriveTTO recovers nonzero predictive driver model scores (PDMS) in 51.35% of native zero-score cases on average. Accounting for new failures, the zero-score rate falls from 1.63% to 1.13%. Benchmark-specific configurations achieve 95.54 PDMS and 92.30 extended PDMS (EPDMS) on Navtest, 57.10 EPDMS on Navhard, and 40.1 HD-Score on HUGSIM under observed commands. With a single frozen scorer, DriveTTO-S improves all six evaluated planners on both Navtest and Navhard.

AI.tldr: DriveTTO是一种免训练方法，通过在原生候选轨迹附近进行渐进式邻域搜索与双分支（规划器提议/控制扰动）融合，利用冻结评分器筛选并仅在两个评分器均预测提升时接受更新，从而缓解固定候选池选不出好轨迹的问题。
AI.motivation: 在困难驾驶场景中，学习的评分器可能从固定候选池中选出较差轨迹，即使存在更优候选；邻近车辆与道路边界又使高分手势范围狭窄，且这些约束随场景变化、训练时难以穷尽覆盖。
AI.method: 训练自由的DriveTTO：以原生提议为中心进行搜索，每个细化提议与保留轨迹比对；冻结评分器在轨迹实际到达的端点评估完整路径，引导在逐步缩小的邻域内重采样。从共享参考出发，一支分支利用规划器提议，另一支扰动车辆控制量，按匹配时刻混合位姿；仅当两个冻结评分器均预测增益时才接受分支或融合更新。另有单评分器版本DriveTTO-S。
AI.result: Navtest上平均在51.35%的原生零分案例中恢复出非零PDMS；计入新增失败后零分率由1.63%降至1.13%。基准专用配置在Navtest达95.54 PDMS、92.30 EPDMS，Navhard达57.10 EPDMS，HUGSIM观测指令下HD-Score为40.1。单冻结评分器的DriveTTO-S在Navtest与Navhard上均提升全部六个被评估规划器。
AI.conclusion: 通过免训练的邻域细化与双评分器门控融合，DriveTTO可即插即用地改进现有规划器，显著降低零分案例并提升多种基准与多个规划器的性能。

title: EA-Bench: Measuring information and action efficiency under imperfect instructions
summary: Personal agents help users complete everyday work across digital applications. Many standard benchmarks assume that users provide sufficient information to solve a task. However, agents often encounter incomplete, distracting, or inconsistent information in practice. To systematically study agent inefficiency under such imperfect information, we introduce Efficient Action (EA)-Bench, which evaluates both tool calls and user interactions in work-related tasks. To our knowledge, it is the first benchmark to jointly evaluate tool-call efficiency and user-interaction efficiency under controlled missing, redundant, and conflicting information. We construct 63 base-task instances adapted from existing work-related benchmarks. To guide perturbation design and quantify task requirements, we represent workflows as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) and examine node-level dependencies to identify where information can be withheld, contradicted, or supplemented with distractors. We use a two-stage validation process combining AI-assisted checks with expert screening to select 232 conditions from 792 initial candidates. We organize these tasks into Easy and Hard tracks by task complexity. Experiments show that imperfect information can reduce accuracy and increase tool-use and user-interaction costs. More concerning, several models obtain apparently correct outcomes by guessing user-specific values without confirmation, revealing potential execution unreliability in current models under imperfect user information.

AI.tldr: 提出EA-Bench，首个在受控缺失、冗余、冲突信息下同时评估工具调用效率与用户交互效率的基准，基于DAG建模任务依赖并构建232个评测条件。
AI.motivation: 现有标准基准普遍假设用户提供充分信息，而实际场景中智能体常面对不完整、干扰或不一致的信息，导致执行效率低下，缺乏系统性评测手段。
AI.method: 将工作流表示为有向无环图（DAG），通过节点级依赖分析确定信息可被隐藏、矛盾化或补充干扰项的位置；从现有工作类基准改编63个基础任务实例，初始792个候选条件经AI辅助检查与专家筛选的两阶段验证，保留232个条件，并按任务复杂度分为Easy与Hard两个赛道。
AI.result: 实验表明不完美信息会降低任务准确率，并增加工具使用成本与用户交互成本；更值得关注的是，部分模型未经确认即猜测用户特定取值而得到貌似正确的结果，暴露出执行可靠性隐患。
AI.conclusion: EA-Bench为不完美信息下的智能体效率与可靠性研究提供了受控评测平台，揭示当前模型在信息缺失时存在"猜测替代确认"的执行不可靠问题。

title: Choose What Returns: Object-Aware KV Memory for Selective Recall in Interactive Video Generation
summary: Interactive long-video generation lets users build a story through successive prompts and reuse earlier characters and settings under new instructions. Existing memory methods retain past content, yet they often fail at precise selective recall, returning the wrong appearance of a person, mixing different people, or keeping an unrequested background. Based on our analysis of memory form and retrieval, we introduce an object-aware key--value (KV) memory framework for a frozen autoregressive diffusion generator. It keeps the original KV of tracked object regions, selects background KV outside them by attention-scores, and links each memory with a readable record of its source scene and observed appearance. An LLM selects the requested records, and a memory integrator supplies their KV for generation under the current prompt. We also introduce a six-scene evaluation that tests selective attribute modification, time-specific appearance recall, and multi-object composition, in which each person's requested past appearance changes across requests. Experiments show that our framework more reliably preserves each person's identity while reproducing their requested past appearance than existing memory methods, under both explicit scene references and natural-language cues.

AI.tldr: 提出对象感知KV记忆框架，用于冻结的自回归扩散生成器的交互式长视频生成，实现精确的选择性记忆召回。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆方法虽能保留过去内容，但在精确选择性召回上失败：返回错误的人物外观、混合不同人物、或保留未请求的背景。
AI.method: 基于对记忆形式与检索的分析，构建对象感知的key-value记忆：保留被追踪对象区域的原始KV，以注意力分数选取区域外的背景KV，并为每条记忆链接可读的源场景与观察外观记录；由LLM选择所需记录，记忆整合器在当前提示下提供其KV用于生成。
AI.result: 提出六场景评测，考察选择性属性修改、特定时刻外观召回与多对象组合（各人物请求的过去外观随请求变化）；实验显示在显式场景引用和自然语言线索下，本框架比现有记忆方法更可靠地保持人物身份并复现其请求的过去外观。
AI.conclusion: 对象级KV记忆结合LLM检索可显著提升长视频生成中人物身份保持与选择性外观召回能力。

title: Pretraining Representation Lottery Determines Fine-tuning Generalization
summary: Large scale pretraining (PT) followed by fine-tuning (FT) is the central paradigm of modern deep learning, yet how PT shapes FT generalization remains poorly understood. We use a synthetic setup in which the ground-truth concept geometry of entities is known, as a controlled testbed to study how representational geometry affects model behavior and how PT representations determine FT generalization. We first show that models differing only in training seed can closely match in PT loss yet vary substantially in FT generalization. We hypothesize that a representational lottery underlies this phenomenon: the random seed dependent geometry formed during PT determines what FT can reach. We confirm this causally. First, injecting the ground-truth concept geometry into the model yields near-ceiling FT generalization, showing that good representations directly drive generalization. Then, distilling a lucky seed's learned representation into an unlucky seed unlocks FT generalization, while distilling the same model's behavior does not. Furthermore, representation distillation can merge entities that never interacted during PT, which FT alone cannot. Finally, we show that regularizing representational drift during FT enables naturalistic learning: only models with good representations learn the task, and they generalize, while models with poor representations fail to fit it. Under plain FT, by contrast, models with poor representations fit the training objective by reshaping their pretrained representations. We reproduce the distillation result in Pythia-160M and Pythia-410M, each pretrained multiple times with different random seeds, and show that the transferable representation lives in the deep layers at both scales. Overall, PT acts as a lottery over representations, and the representation a model draws determines how it adapts during FT in a way that behavior alone does not explain.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"表征彩票"假说：预训练随机种子决定的表征几何决定了下游微调的泛化能力，并通过合成实验因果性地验证了这一点。
AI.motivation: 大规模预训练（PT）+微调（FT）是现代深度学习核心范式，但PT如何塑造FT泛化仍缺乏理解。仅用PT损失或行为指标无法解释同损失模型间FT泛化的巨大差异，需要可控实验揭示表征几何的作用。
AI.method: 构建概念几何已知的合成数据作为受控测试台；比较仅种子不同的PT模型在FT泛化上的差异；通过注入真实概念几何、将"幸运种子"的表征蒸馏到"不幸种子"（对比行为蒸馏）进行因果验证；用FT阶段表征漂移正则化检验自然学习；并在不同随机种子多次预训练的Pythia-160M/410M上复现蒸馏结论，定位可迁移表征层。
AI.result: 同PT损失、不同种子的模型FT泛化差异显著；注入真值几何可达近满分泛化；表征蒸馏可解锁不幸种子的泛化，行为蒸馏不行，且能合并PT中从未交互的实体（FT单独做不到）；加入表征漂移正则后，只有好表征模型能学任务并泛化，差表征模型在普通FT下则靠重塑预训练表征去拟合训练目标；Pythia-160M/410M复现蒸馏收益，可迁移表征位于深层。
AI.conclusion: PT本质上是对表征的"抽签"，模型抽到的表征几何决定其FT如何适应，这一效应无法由行为或PT损失单独解释，提示评估与改进预训练应关注表征层面而非仅损失/行为。

title: Force2Act: A Force-Aware Visuomotor Policy for Generalizable Compliant Robot Manipulation
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires a robot to regulate the force it applies, not only where it moves. Existing force-aware policies learn this force from demonstrations and therefore reproduce the force levels they were trained on, which fails once the interaction demands more force than any demonstration. We present Force2Act, a hybrid force-position policy built on two complementary mechanisms. A global force policy plans the motion and the interaction force once per action chunk, with force represented relative to the measured interaction, so that the planned force scales with the load. Between planning steps, a reactive compliance policy, termed Mixture of Force Experts, identifies at every control step the force expert that governs the interaction and regulates the force through it, so that the contact holds when it changes within a chunk. We further introduce Force2Act-Bench, a simulation benchmark of five contact-rich tasks that gives the community a common and repeatable way to test force-aware policies and measure how well they regulate the interaction force. Force2Act achieves an overall success rate of 93.8%, compared with 77.0% for the strongest baseline, and its reactive regulation reduces the failures on block pivoting from 30 to 10 of 150 trials. On a real robot, Force2Act reaches an average success rate of 94.2% over four tasks, against at most 27.5% for the baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Force2Act，一种结合全局力规划与反应式顺应控制的混合力-位置策略，使机器人能在超出示范力水平的接触任务中调节作用力，并构建了Force2Act-Bench仿真基准。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富的操作任务不仅需要控制运动位置，还需要调节施加的力。现有力感知策略从示范中学习力，只能复现训练时的力水平，一旦交互所需的力超过任何示范值便会失败。
AI.method: 提出双机制混合力-位置策略：（1）全局力策略在每个动作块（action chunk）上一次性规划运动与交互力，且力以相对于实测交互量的形式表示，使规划的力随负载缩放；（2）在规划步之间，采用名为“力专家混合”（Mixture of Force Experts）的反应式顺应策略，在每个控制步识别主导交互的力专家并通过其调节力，从而在块内接触变化时保持稳定。同时构建Force2Act-Bench，包含五个接触丰富任务的仿真基准。
AI.result: 仿真中Force2Act总体成功率达93.8%，最强基线为77.0%；反应式调节将方块枢转任务的失败次数从150次试验中的30次降至10次。真机四个任务上平均成功率94.2%，基线最高仅27.5%。
AI.conclusion: 相对力表示与反应式力专家调节可有效突破示范力水平的限制，显著提升接触丰富任务的成功率，且Force2Act-Bench为力感知策略提供了统一可复现的评测方式。

title: Guarding with Judgment: Learning to Intervene for Multimodal Safety
summary: When visual context makes an ordinary request unsafe to answer as asked, a blanket refusal may leave the user's need unresolved. Choosing how to help requires distinguishing an established hazard from a condition that still needs verification, a distinction that binary safety labels leave unspecified. We formulate this decision through four actions: allow, warn, review, and refuse. To ground these decisions in verifiable evidence, we build a corpus of 20,126 training audits and the JudiBench benchmark, connecting each action to diagnostic judgments, source evidence, and controlled context changes. Our guard, JudiAct, separately states what the source establishes, what condition governs the help, and how the rules apply. It then checks these three brief review items against the original inputs to predict diagnostic labels and a handling action. Supervised training learns individual judgments while comparing label assignments across related cases. A second stage swaps one review item at a time, using the resulting audit feedback to refine review generation. On JudiBench, JudiAct improves request and answer Macro-F1 by more than 28 percentage points over its 4B backbone. Across nine public benchmarks, it outperforms state-of-the-art guards on the mean delivered-answer score in both pre-generation and post-generation settings, cutting MM-SafetyBench attack success from 40.78% to 25.30%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出四动作安全决策框架（allow/warn/review/refuse），构建20,126条训练审计数据和JudiBench基准，并提出守卫模型JudiAct，将决策分解为"来源确立的事实—约束条件—规则适用"三项审查条目并据此预测诊断标签与处理动作；在JudiBench上使请求与回答Macro-F1较4B骨干提升28个百分点以上，在九个公开基准的平均交付回答得分上超越SOTA守卫，并将MM-SafetyBench攻击成功率从40.78%降至25.30%。
AI.motivation: 当视觉上下文使一个普通请求变得不宜按原样回答时，一律拒绝会使用户需求悬而未决。要合理选择帮助方式，需区分"已确立的危害"与"仍需核实的条件"，而二元安全标签无法表达这一区别，因此需要更细粒度的决策动作与可验证的证据支撑。
AI.method: 将安全决策形式化为allow、warn、review、refuse四种动作；构建20,126条训练审计语料与JudiBench基准，把每个动作关联到诊断判断、来源证据和受控上下文变化。模型JudiAct分别陈述来源已确立的内容、支配该帮助的条件、规则如何适用，并将这三项审查条目与原始输入核对以预测诊断标签和处理动作。训练分两阶段：监督学习学习单项判断并在相关案例间比较标签分配；第二阶段逐项替换审查条目，利用审计反馈改进审查生成。
AI.result: 在JudiBench上，JudiAct的请求与回答Macro-F1较其4B骨干提升超过28个百分点；在九个公开基准上，其在生成前与生成后两种设定下的平均交付回答得分均优于现有SOTA守卫；MM-SafetyBench攻击成功率由40.78%降至25.30%。
AI.conclusion: 以"已确立危害 vs 待核实条件"为核心的细粒度动作决策优于二元安全判定；显式、可核验的审查条目结合对比式监督与条目替换反馈，能有效提升守卫模型的安全决策质量与实际可用性。

title: Dynamics-Guided Conditional MeanFlow from Regional Interaction to Internal Revision and Its Application to CT Imaging
summary: Conditional image enhancement requires spatially varying corrections, yet fixed-depth models allocate similar computational budgets regardless of where additional refinement is needed. Although one-step flow models reduce inference costs and iterative restoration methods introduce subsequent corrections, how predicted transformation dynamics can guide internal feature refinement remains underexplored. We introduce IRCMF, a dynamics-guided Conditional MeanFlow framework that combines regional interaction with recurrent internal revision. The decoder predicts signed interval velocity and a learned velocity-change cue. A soft-region graph aggregates contextual information for velocity estimation, while a dynamics-conditioned graph establishes regional relationships to guide recurrent bottleneck updates. The revised features are processed by the shared decoder to recompute velocity, establishing feedback between transformation dynamics and internal representations. An actor-critic policy controls regional updates and further revisions to balance enhancement quality and computational cost. We evaluate IRCMF on two computed tomography (CT) datasets, NLST for STANDARD-to-LUNG kernel enhancement and LDCT-and-Projection-data for simulated low-to-routine-dose enhancement. With nine decoder evaluations, IRCMF achieves slice-level PSNR of $36.24 \pm 3.49$ dB and SSIM of $0.97 \pm 0.01$ on NLST, and PSNR of $32.45 \pm 1.97$ dB and SSIM of $0.84 \pm 0.05$ on LDCT-and-Projection-data. The learned policy reduces average decoder evaluations to 4.42 and 3.45, respectively, lowering per-slice latency from 97.00 to 51.82 ms and from 97.12 to 41.95 ms, with PSNR reductions of only 0.20 and 0.06 dB.

AI.tldr: 提出IRCMF——动力学引导的条件平均流框架，将区域交互与循环式内部修正结合，用actor-critic策略自适应控制区域更新与修正次数，在CT核增强与低剂量CT增强任务上以更少解码器调用实现高质量增强。
AI.motivation: 条件图像增强需要空间变化的修正，但固定深度模型对所有区域分配相同计算预算，无法在真正需要细化的区域追加算力；一步流模型虽降低推理成本、迭代式复原可引入后续修正，但“预测的变换动力学如何引导内部特征精修”仍缺乏探索。
AI.method: 解码器预测带符号区间速度及可学习的速度变化线索；软区域图聚合上下文用于速度估计，动力学条件图建立区域关系以引导循环瓶颈特征更新；修正后特征经共享解码器重算速度，形成变换动力学与内部表征之间的反馈回路；由actor-critic策略控制区域更新与进一步修正，权衡增强质量与计算代价。
AI.result: 在NLST（STANDARD→LUNG核增强）与LDCT-and-Projection-data（模拟低剂量→常规剂量）上，9次解码器评估下切片级PSNR为36.24±3.49 dB、SSIM 0.97±0.01，以及32.45±1.97 dB、SSIM 0.84±0.05；学习策略将平均解码器评估次数降至4.42与3.45，单切片延迟由97.00 ms降至51.82 ms、97.12 ms降至41.95 ms，PSNR仅下降0.20与0.06 dB。
AI.conclusion: 动力学引导的循环内部修正与区域级自适应计算分配能显著降低推理开销，而质量损失极小，说明以变换动力学指导特征精修是条件图像增强的有效且高效范式。

title: Joint Client Scheduling and Resource Allocation for Optimal Federated Learning over Wireless Networks
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Revised author-prepared version of a paper accepted and presented at IEEE FLTA 2026
summary: Federated learning often relies on partial client participation because full participation is costly in cross-device wireless systems with limited uplink resources, heterogeneous channel conditions, energy constraints, and strict upload deadlines. However, partial participation introduces sampling variance, causing the sampled update to deviate from the full-participation update. Existing optimal client sampling methods reduce this variance but usually rely on simplified client-count budgets, while wireless-aware scheduling methods account for communication constraints but do not directly optimize sampling variance. This paper proposes resource-aware optimal client sampling (RAOCS), a unified variance-minimizing client scheduling framework under uplink resource-block, round deadline, update-information, and energy constraints. The resulting problem admits a capped water-filling solution that balances client update importance, wireless resource cost, and energy feasibility. Experimental results demonstrate that RAOCS achieves accuracy comparable to that of OCS while reducing the average upload time per iteration by more than a factor of 252.

AI.tldr: 提出资源感知最优客户端采样（RAOCS），在无线上行资源约束下统一最小化部分参与带来的采样方差，得到带容量上限的注水解，精度与OCS相当而每轮上传时间降低252倍以上。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习常采用部分客户端参与，但部分参与引入采样方差，使采样更新偏离全参与更新；现有最优客户端采样方法仅考虑简化的客户端数量预算，而无线感知调度方法虽考虑通信约束却不直接优化采样方差，二者割裂。
AI.method: 构建统一的方差最小化客户端调度框架RAOCS，联合考虑上行资源块、轮次截止时间、更新信息量与能量约束；对所得优化问题推导出带容量上限的注水解（capped water-filling），在客户端更新重要性、无线资源代价与能量可行性之间进行权衡。
AI.result: 实验表明RAOCS达到与OCS相当的精度，同时将每轮平均上传时间降低252倍以上。
AI.conclusion: RAOCS将采样方差优化与无线资源约束统一建模，为受限上行资源下的联邦学习客户端调度提供了可解析求解且通信高效的方案。

title: InfoField3D: Differentiable Information Field for Embodied Task-Oriented View Planning
summary: Effective task execution requires embodied agents to select observation positions that provide sufficient task-relevant information. Existing approaches typically predict viewpoints with learned models or score discrete candidates, but they either struggle to incorporate new constraints such as reachability or require extensive candidate evaluation to search. We introduce InfoField3D, which lifts geometry-bound information into a differentiable analytic field, whose value at each 3D observation position represents the task-required information accessible there. It uses low-order spherical harmonics to encode directional information responses and analytic line integrals of Gaussian occupancy functions to model occlusion along lines of sight. This formulation casts task-driven camera placement as a well-studied constrained continuous optimization problem, enabling both flexible incorporation of constraints through the feasible domain and efficient viewpoint search even in the presence of occlusion. Experiments show that InfoField3D compactly preserves the pointwise information landscape with high fidelity and generally recommends higher-quality, more robust viewpoints at lower search cost than the evaluated baselines. Controlled evaluations with a frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policy further suggest that the recommended views can improve downstream task performance under information-limited initial viewpoints.

AI.tldr: 提出 InfoField3D，将几何绑定的任务信息提升为可微解析标量场，用低阶球谐编码方向响应、用高斯占据函数的解析线积分建模遮挡，从而把任务驱动的相机位姿选择转化为带约束的连续优化问题，在保持信息景观高保真度的同时以更低搜索成本给出更鲁棒的视角。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体执行任务需要选择能提供充分任务相关信息的观测位置。现有方法要么用学习模型直接预测视点，难以纳入可达性等新约束；要么对离散候选打分，需要大量候选评估与搜索，效率低。因此需要一个既能灵活加入约束、又能高效搜索且能处理遮挡的视点选择框架。
AI.method: InfoField3D 将受几何约束的信息量提升为可微的解析场，场在任意3D观测位置上的取值表示该处可获取的任务所需信息：(1) 用低阶球谐函数编码方向性信息响应；(2) 用高斯占据函数的解析线积分建模沿视线的遮挡。由此把任务驱动的相机放置形式化为成熟的带约束连续优化问题，约束通过可行域灵活表达，并可高效求解遮挡下的视点搜索。
AI.result: 实验表明 InfoField3D 能紧凑且高保真地保持逐点信息景观；相比所评估的基线，通常以更低的搜索成本推荐更高质量、更鲁棒的视点。在冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略上进行的受控评估进一步表明，在初始视点信息受限的情况下，推荐视角可提升下游任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 将视点选择建模为解析可微信息场上的连续约束优化，是一种兼顾表达力（方向响应、遮挡）、约束灵活性与搜索效率的有效范式，并能通过下游VLA策略验证其实际收益。

title: FormaFin: Verifiable Financial Analysis with Solver-Guided Reinforcement Learning
summary: Formally verifying financial analyses generated by large language models (LLMs) remains challenging as financial rules are largely expressed in natural language and rarely have corresponding formal specifications. Training language models to formalize these rules is hindered by the scarcity of labeled data and reliable training signals, while confidential financial data favor small models that run locally. We introduce FormaFin, a framework that trains small open language models to translate financial rules into reusable SMT formulas. FormaFin integrates teacher distillation with reinforcement learning using an SMT solver to compute rewards from numerical thresholds stated in financial rules. We evaluate FormaFin on corporate loan monitoring, in which lenders check borrowers' financial figures against loan agreements. To evaluate our framework, we curate \bench{}, a benchmark containing 143 loan agreements and 2,527 questions covering compliance, earnings cushion, and debt capacity. Our results show that a 7B formalizer achieves 94.8\% accuracy, outperforming open LLMs up to ten times larger. Across three model families, accuracy ranges from 92.6 to 96.8\%. Our framework also detects 95.6 to 99.7\% of errors in other LLMs' financial analyses. We make FormaFin and \bench{} publicly available.

AI.tldr: FormaFin 通过教师蒸馏加 SMT 求解器奖励的强化学习，训练小型开源模型将金融规则（自然语言）转换为可复用的 SMT 公式，从而对 LLM 生成的财务分析进行形式化验证。
AI.motivation: 金融规则多以自然语言表述，缺少形式化规范，导致 LLM 生成的财务分析难以被形式化验证；同时标注数据稀缺、训练信号不可靠，且金融数据保密性要求模型能在本地运行（倾向小模型）。
AI.method: 提出 FormaFin 框架：以教师蒸馏结合强化学习训练小型开源语言模型，把金融规则翻译为可复用的 SMT 公式；奖励由 SMT 求解器基于规则中的数值阈值自动计算。任务场景为企业贷款监控（将借款人财务数据与贷款协议条款比对）。并构建基准 \bench{}，含 143 份贷款协议、2,527 个问题，覆盖合规性、盈利缓冲与债务容量三类。
AI.result: 7B 形式化模型达到 94.8% 准确率，优于体量至多十倍的开放 LLM；跨三个模型家族准确率为 92.6%–96.8%；框架可检出其他 LLM 财务分析中 95.6%–99.7% 的错误。
AI.conclusion: 小型开源模型结合求解器奖励的强化学习，可有效实现金融规则的形式化与财务分析的自动验证，在保证本地部署与数据隐私的前提下取得高准确率与强错误检出能力；FormaFin 与 \bench{} 已公开。

title: Close the Loop on the Retrievability Gap
summary: A frozen vision-language encoder now guides image restoration and later indexes what it produced. Over a fixed set of eighteen pansharpening systems on one WorldView-III test set, the fidelity index that ranks them, $Q2^n$ with a reference and HQNR without one, picks the less retrievable of two systems one time in three and one in two; the disagreement lies between the pixel-supervised and the language-conditioned family, and even the best system falls short of the reference, small objects first. We call this the retrievability gap and trace it to the area weighting of position-averaged losses. LEDGER closes the loop around the encoder: it indexes the input into a set of named concepts, generates, re-encodes the output alone with the same frozen encoder, and minimises a set-level soft-Jaccard loss on the coverage of that set, a label-free target available at test time, so that every present concept of a scale receives a gradient share independent of its area. Measured outside the loop by label-grounded probes, held-out retrievers, language-free evaluators, detectors and human raters, LEDGER matches or exceeds the strongest baselines in fidelity on four sensors, raises retrieval by seven to nine points within its vocabulary and two to five outside it, closes two thirds of the reduced-resolution gap to the reference, lifts extraction on raw SpaceNet imagery above the vendor product in each of four cities, and transfers to existing generators as a training-only loss at no inference cost.

AI.tldr: 论文诊断出全色锐化输出在冻结视觉-语言编码器下的"可检索性差距"（fidelity指标偏好的系统反而更难被检索），指出其源于位置平均损失的面积加权机制，并提出LEDGER：以集合级soft-Jaccard覆盖损失闭环约束概念覆盖，实现无标注、面积无关的梯度分配。
AI.motivation: 冻结视觉-语言编码器既用于引导图像复原，又用于索引其生成结果，二者目的不一致。在18个全色锐化系统的固定评测中，有参考的Q2^n与无参考的HQNR约1/3至1/2的情形下会选出"更难被检索"的系统；这种分歧集中在像素监督族与语言条件族之间，且即便最佳系统也劣于参考，小目标尤甚。作者将这一现象称为可检索性差距，并归因于位置平均损失中的面积加权——大目标占据主导梯度，小概念被淹没。
AI.method: LEDGER围绕冻结编码器构造闭环：先将输入索引为一组命名概念，生成输出后仅用同一冻结编码器重新编码输出，再在该概念集合的覆盖率上最小化集合级soft-Jaccard损失。该目标无需标签，测试时即可获得，使每个尺度上出现的概念获得与其面积无关的均等梯度份额。评测则置于闭环之外，采用基于标签的探针、留出检索器、无语言评测器、检测器与人工评分。
AI.result: LEDGER在四个传感器上保真度匹配或超过最强基线；词表内检索提升7–9个点，词表外提升2–5个点；弥合了相对参考的降分辨率差距的三分之二；在原始SpaceNet影像上，四个城市的目标提取均超过供应商产品；作为仅训练期损失可迁移到现有生成器，推理零额外开销。
AI.conclusion: 保真度指标与语言侧可检索性存在系统性错位，根源在面积加权的优化目标。以冻结编码器闭环、集合级soft-Jaccard覆盖损失替代逐像素面积加权，可在不引入标签与推理开销的前提下同时提升保真度与可检索性，并具备跨传感器、跨生成器的可迁移性。

title: ArrythML-II: An Optimized TinyML Framework for ECG Arrhythmia Detection and Multi-Class Beat Classification on Wearable Devices
summary: This paper presents ArrythML-II, an optimized TinyML framework for on-device ECG arrhythmia detection and multi-class beat classification on wearable platforms. A systematic hyperparameter optimization framework is developed to identify compact autoencoder architectures for binary ECG arrhythmia detection. A custom scoring mechanism jointly considers detection performance, reconstruction-error thresholds, and model size to guide architecture selection. The framework is further extended to six-class ECG beat classification using a lightweight classifier derived from the optimized autoencoder architecture. Both models are INT8 quantized and deployed using TensorFlow Lite Micro on a custom-developed, battery-operated, single-lead ECG device based on the PSoC~6 microcontroller. The deployed autoencoder and classifier have model sizes of approximately 44~KB and 22~KB, respectively, with end-to-end processing times of 5.1~ms and 4.7~ms per ECG segment. Model inference accounts for 3.95~ms and 1.38~ms of these processing times, respectively. In the refined arrhythmia detection evaluation using the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database, the autoencoder achieved an accuracy of 84.76\%, precision of 82.68\%, and recall of 77.99\%. The multi-class classifier achieved 82.29\% accuracy, weighted precision of 90.18\%, and weighted recall of 82.29\%. Beyond offline model evaluation, the wearable platform is validated using preloaded ECG segments, live ECG signals, and an ESP32-S3-based ECG emulator that replays annotated MIT-BIH recordings as analog waveforms. The results demonstrate the feasibility of integrating optimized TinyML models into wearable platforms for real-time ECG analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出ArrythML-II——面向可穿戴平台的TinyML心电心律失常检测与多类心搏分类优化框架：以系统化超参数搜索自动筛选紧凑自编码器架构，经INT8量化后部署于PSoC 6单导联心电设备，实现约44KB/22KB模型与毫秒级端到端推理。
AI.motivation: 在电池供电的可穿戴平台上实现实时心电分析，受限于内存、算力与功耗；现有TinyML方案往往缺乏系统化的架构选择依据，且多在离线环境评估，难以保证真机部署的可行性与实时性。
AI.method: 1) 构建系统化超参数优化框架，用于搜索紧凑自编码器架构；2) 设计自定义评分机制，联合考虑检测性能、重构误差阈值与模型规模以指导架构选择；3) 由优化后的自编码器结构派生轻量分类器，扩展至六类心搏分类；4) 两模型均INT8量化，经TensorFlow Lite Micro部署于基于PSoC 6 MCU的自研电池供电单导联心电设备；5) 通过预载心电片段、实时心电信号及基于ESP32-S3的心电模拟器（将MIT-BIH标注记录回放为模拟波形）进行平台验证。
AI.result: 自编码器约44KB、分类器约22KB；端到端处理时间分别为5.1ms与4.7ms/片段，其中推理占3.95ms与1.38ms。MIT-BIH数据库上，自编码器准确率84.76%、精确率82.68%、召回率77.99%；多类分类器准确率82.29%、加权精确率90.18%、加权召回率82.29%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，经优化与量化的TinyML模型可有效集成至可穿戴平台，实现实时心电分析与多类心搏分类，验证了端侧心律失常检测的工程可行性。

title: Tacinf: A Unified Tactile Infrastructure for Robot Manipulation
summary: Force-aware manipulation requires robots to infer appropriate interaction forces from task context and tactile feedback. We present Tacinf, a low-cost, modular infrastructure that enables policies to predict robot actions and fingertip forces from task language, vision, and touch. Task instructions can optionally specify the desired force level. Tacinf integrates simulation data synthesis and tactile benchmarking (Tabero), vision-tactile-language-action (VTLA) policy learning, handheld data collection using the same gripper as robot deployment (Tacumi), and task-aligned sim-to-real evaluation (Taco). Together, these components form an integrated workflow connecting data collection from multiple sources, foundation-model training, and hardware deployment. We validate each component, including the simulation data, benchmark, controller, and Tacumi, and are releasing the full stack as open source. A foundation model fine-tuned solely on tactile simulation data transfers zero-shot to different real-robot tasks. Across eight policy variants, mean task success rates are strongly correlated between simulation and the real robot (Pearson r=0.998, mean maximum rank violation MMRV=0.010). For the four policies with reported force measurements, mean grip force is higher under firm instructions than under gentle instructions on all three tasks in both domains. When both object positions and instances are randomized, a mixture of teleoperation, simulation, and Tacumi data raises mean real-robot task success from 20% with teleoperation alone to 60%.

AI.tldr: 提出 Tacinf：一套低成本、模块化的力感知操作基础设施，统一了仿真数据合成与触觉基准（Tabero）、视觉-触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）策略学习、与部署同构的手持采集夹爪（Tacumi）以及任务对齐的仿真到现实评估（Taco），并开源全栈。仅用触觉仿真数据微调的基础模型可零样本迁移到真实机器人任务。
AI.motivation: 力感知操作要求机器人从任务语境与触觉反馈中推断合适的交互力，但现有研究缺乏从数据采集、基准评测、策略训练到真机部署的端到端、低成本且模块化的工作流，且仿真训练策略能否可靠迁移到真机的力行为缺乏证据。
AI.method: 构建 Tacinf 集成工作流：1) Tabero 负责仿真数据合成与触觉基准；2) 学习直接从任务语言、视觉与触觉得出机器人动作与指尖力的 VTLA 策略（语言指令可指定期望力等级）；3) Tacumi 为与真机部署同构的夹爪手持采集设备；4) Taco 提供任务对齐的 sim-to-real 评估协议。分别对仿真数据、基准、控制器与 Tacumi 进行验证。
AI.result: 仅用触觉仿真数据微调的基础模型零样本迁移至多个真机任务；8 种策略变体的任务成功率在仿真与真机间高度相关（Pearson r=0.998，MMRV=0.010）；在报告力测量的 4 种策略中，三个任务、两个域上“用力”指令下的平均夹持力均高于“轻柔”指令；当物体位置与实例同时随机化时，遥操作、仿真与 Tacumi 数据混合将真机平均成功率由仅遥操作的 20% 提升至 60%。
AI.conclusion: Tacinf 以低成本模块化方式打通多源数据采集、基础模型训练与硬件部署，验证了仿真训练的策略在真实机器人上具备可靠的排序一致性与力级可控性，且多源数据混合显著提升泛化性能，全栈开源以支持后续力感知操作研究。

title: StudioBench: Benchmarking Agentic Multimodal Large Language Models for Productive Audiovisual Creation
comment: 27 pages, 14 figures. Project page: https://openraiser.github.io/StudioBench/ and code: https://github.com/openraiser/StudioBench . Equal contribution: Xinglong Xu, Yuxia Zhu. Corresponding authors: Asher Qin, Jingxuan Wei, Cheng Tan
summary: Video generators can now render convincing short clips, yet complete audiovisual works require coordinating visuals, sound, and editing across multiple stages. Existing benchmarks focus on individual generators or video agents under narrower production settings, leaving end-to-end creation by general multimodal large language models (MLLMs) underexplored. We introduce StudioBench, a benchmark comprising 160 tasks across eight video genres and five task types, spanning diverse audiovisual production requirements. Models produce minutes of finished audiovisual content using 33 atomic generation, editing, and inspection tools, without shell access or workflow templates. We evaluate the delivered films, while analyzing reconstructed workflow graphs to characterize production behavior and diagnose failures. Across seven MLLMs, explicit requirements are nearly saturated, yet production quality varies substantially in picture clarity and composition, object structure, motion, and lip sync. All models spontaneously organize multi-stage production workflows without predefined templates. However, higher-quality models exhibit more selective production workflows, whereas additional tool calls alone show little association with quality. These findings identify the missing quality loop of effective inspection, selection, and revision as a key bottleneck in productive audiovisual creation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 StudioBench 基准，用于评测通用多模态大模型（MLLM）端到端完成完整视听作品创作的能力，覆盖 160 个任务、8 种视频类型、5 种任务类型与 33 个原子工具，并发现"有效检查—筛选—修订"的质量闭环缺失是核心瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成基准多聚焦单一生成器或范围较窄的视频智能体，缺少对通用多模态大模型在无模板、无 shell 权限条件下进行端到端视听创作（画面、声音、剪辑多阶段协同）的系统评测。
AI.method: 构建 StudioBench：160 个任务，涵盖 8 种视频类型与 5 种任务类型；模型需仅借助 33 个原子生成、编辑与检查工具，在无 shell 访问与工作流模板约束下产出数分钟的成品视听内容；评测既针对交付成片质量，也通过重建的工作流图分析生产行为并诊断失败原因；共评测 7 个 MLLM。
AI.result: 显式要求几乎被满足，但成片质量在画面清晰度与构图、物体结构、运动以及口型同步等方面差异显著；所有模型均能自发组织多阶段生产流程；质量更高的模型呈现更具选择性的工作流，而单纯增加工具调用次数与质量关联甚微。
AI.conclusion: 端到端视听创作的关键瓶颈在于缺乏有效的检查、筛选与修订所形成的质量闭环，而非工具数量或调用频次；该结论为后续智能体式创作系统的设计指明方向。

title: VideoJSON: A Minimal Harness Beats Purpose-Built Memory for Ultra-Long Video Understanding
summary: Answering questions over days or weeks of video requires searching for scattered clues across long timelines. Existing video agents rely on complex memory graphs and fixed retrieval pipelines, which restrict how the agent can search. We propose VideoJSON, a minimal harness for ultra-long video understanding that keeps the memory simple and lets a coding agent write its own search programs. During indexing, a vision-language model turns each minute of video into a single JSON record containing a dense caption and structured fields such as events, entities, places, and speech transcripts. At query time, the agent writes Python or Bash programs in a sandboxed container to filter, link, and read these records over multiple steps, without task-specific training or raw video access. On four ultra-long video benchmarks, VideoJSON with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash outperforms MAGIC-Video by 7.0, 20.0, and 24.75 points on EgoLifeQA, Ego-R1-Bench, and MM-Lifelong Week, and beats the best prior EgoMemReason score by 12.6 points. Across four policy models of increasing capability, VideoJSON's average score rises by up to 11.58 points over the weakest model, compared with at most 5.50 points for MAGIC-Video. Ablations show that both agentic code search and the structured JSON records drive these gains, while adding hourly summaries, extra tools, or video access changes the average score by less than 1.5 points. In addition, fine-tuning Qwen-3.5-Flash on 64 VideoJSON trajectories from an unrelated 100-hour livestream improves its MM-Lifelong scores by up to 8.25 points. Code will be open-sourced after publication.

AI.tldr: VideoJSON：把超长视频压缩为逐分钟JSON记录（稠密字幕＋事件/实体/地点/语音文本等结构化字段），由编码智能体在沙箱中自写Python/Bash检索程序，实现极简记忆的跨时间线多步搜索，在四个超长视频基准上大幅领先既有方法。
AI.motivation: 超长视频（数天至数周）问答需要在长时跨度的分散线索间检索。现有视频智能体依赖复杂记忆图与固定检索管线，限制了搜索策略的灵活性与可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出最小化harness：索引阶段用VLM将每分钟视频转为一条JSON记录（稠密字幕＋事件、实体、地点、语音转写等结构化字段）；查询阶段智能体在沙箱容器中编写Python/Bash程序，对记录进行多步过滤、关联与读取，无需任务特定训练，也不直接访问原始视频。消融对比了代码检索、结构化JSON、小时级摘要、额外工具、视频访问等要素；并测试在无关100小时直播的64条轨迹上微调Qwen-3.5-Flash的迁移效果。
AI.result: 在四个超长视频基准上，VideoJSON＋DeepSeek V4.1 Flash于EgoLifeQA、Ego-R1-Bench、MM-Lifelong Week分别比MAGIC-Video高7.0、20.0、24.75分，并超过此前最佳EgoMemReason 12.6分。四个能力递增的策略模型上，VideoJSON均分提升最多达11.58分，MAGIC-Video最多仅5.50分。消融显示智能体代码搜索与结构化JSON记录均为增益来源，而小时级摘要、额外工具、视频访问对均分影响小于1.5分。微调Qwen-3.5-Flash可使MM-Lifelong提升最多8.25分。
AI.conclusion: 保持记忆简单、把搜索能力下放给可写代码的智能体，是超长视频理解的有效范式；性能增益来自代码化多步检索与结构化记录，而非更复杂的记忆结构或额外工具，且该范式具有良好的模型能力可扩展性与跨域可迁移性。

title: Synthetic EHR Generators Should Be Audited Like LLMs
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Generative AI for Health (GenAI4Health) Workshop
summary: Synthetic electronic health record (EHR) generation is increasingly adopting large autoregressive models, yet privacy evaluation has not kept pace, relying heavily on similarity-based heuristics and aggregate metrics that can obscure patient-specific memorisation. We argue that these models should additionally undergo LLM-style memorisation audits at the level of individual patient records. We support this position by comparing membership-inference evaluations across four prominent autoregressive EHR generators, highlighting inconsistent evaluation practices in patient representations and attack procedures. We evaluate trajectory reconstruction from partial context and introduce randomly assigned patient-level canaries to distinguish memorised associations from clinical generalisation. We examine these methods in a GPT-2-style model deliberately overfit to 1,000 MIMIC-IV patient trajectories, creating a controlled setting in which memorisation should be readily detectable. The model systematically recovers training patients' canaries, and their trajectory reconstruction approaches perfect accuracy with increasing context. Held-out patients show no systematic canary recovery, while reconstruction remains low and improves only marginally with additional context. These experiments establish a positive-control baseline for further evaluation of these methods in realistically trained models.

AI.tldr: 论文主张对合成EHR生成模型应补充"逐患者记录级"的LLM式记忆化审计，并在过拟合正对照设置中验证了canary恢复与轨迹重建可有效区分记忆化与临床泛化。
AI.motivation: 合成电子健康记录的生成日益采用大型自回归模型，但其隐私评估滞后：过度依赖相似度启发式与聚合指标，掩盖了患者个体层面的记忆化风险；同时现有成员推断评估在患者表示与攻击流程上做法不一致，缺乏可比性。
AI.method: 对比四个主流自回归EHR生成器的成员推断评估实践，指出其在患者表示与攻击流程上的不一致；采用部分上下文下的轨迹重建评估；引入随机分配的患者级canary以区分记忆化关联与临床泛化；在刻意过拟合1000条MIMIC-IV患者轨迹的GPT-2风格模型上构建可控正对照实验。
AI.result: 模型系统性地恢复出训练患者的canary，且随上下文增加轨迹重建准确率趋近完美；留出患者则无系统性canary恢复，重建准确率低且随上下文仅边际提升。
AI.conclusion: 患者级canary与轨迹重建能有效分离记忆化与泛化，该实验为在真实训练模型中进一步评估此类方法建立了正对照基线，并呼吁将LLM式记忆化审计纳入EHR生成模型的隐私评估标准。

title: $ζ_0$: A Framework for World Action Models with Joint Scene and Body Foresight in Humanoid Control
comment: 18 pages (including appendix), 10 figures, 12 tables. Project page: https://chenyizhi123.github.io/zeta0-project/ ; Code & Data: https://github.com/chenyizhi123/Zeta0
summary: World Action Models anticipate visual outcomes to guide robot actions, yet humanoid interaction also depends on how the robot's body responds. Visual foresight alone can miss body motion, while latent-distance losses do not directly supervise action responses. We present $ζ_0$, a framework that turns vision-language-action policies into World Action Models by foreseeing future visual features and measured joint trajectories in a shared latent representation. During training, a teacher conditioned on recorded futures provides a reference action response, and dual-response transfer trains the causal predictor to match it through the teacher and the executing policy. All components are trained jointly, and deployment uses only causally predicted futures. On seven HumanoidArena tasks, $ζ_0$ built on $Ψ_0$ and GR00T N1.7 reaches 63.6% and 79.5% mean success, 18.8 and 9.0 points above these bases. On six real-world tasks, it reaches 78.3% and 85.0%, gains of 16.7 and 10.0 points. On GR00T, its 79.5% tops all compared seven-task joint policies. Project page: https://chenyizhi123.github.io/zeta0-project/

AI.tldr: 提出 ζ₀ 框架，将 VLA 策略扩展为 World Action Models，在共享隐空间中同时预测未来视觉特征与实测关节轨迹，以因果预测的未来指导人形机器人动作，显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 World Action Models 主要依赖视觉前瞻引导动作，但人形机器人的交互还取决于机器人自身身体的响应；仅凭视觉前瞻会忽略身体运动，而隐空间距离损失又缺乏对动作响应的直接监督。
AI.method: ζ₀ 让 VLA 策略在共享隐表示中同时预见未来视觉特征与实测关节轨迹。训练时引入一个以记录的未来为条件的教师模型，提供参考动作响应；通过双响应迁移（dual-response transfer）让因果预测器经由教师与执行策略匹配该响应；所有组件联合训练，部署阶段仅使用因果预测的未来。
AI.result: 在 7 个 HumanoidArena 任务上，基于 Ψ₀ 与 GR00T N1.7 的 ζ₀ 平均成功率分别达 63.6% 与 79.5%，较各自基线提升 18.8 与 9.0 个百分点；在 6 个真实任务上分别达 78.3% 与 85.0%，提升 16.7 与 10.0 个百分点。在 GR00T 上 79.5% 的成绩超过所有对比的七任务联合策略。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉前瞻与本体关节轨迹预测统一在共享隐空间，并配合双响应迁移监督，可有效提升人形机器人操作的因果预测与执行性能，且部署阶段无需未来信息。

title: STRIDE: Strategy-to-Tactics Retrieval-Guided Skill Disclosure and Evolution for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Skill-augmented reinforcement learning enables LLM agents to reuse task-solving knowledge across episodes, but existing systems typically expose agents to a flat skill pool and update skills only from coarse, episode-level outcomes. This conflates two distinct uses of experience: a stable strategy that should frame the whole episode, and tactical know-how that should be retrieved only when the agent reaches a local execution gap. We propose STRIDE (Strategy-to-Tactics Retrieval-guided skIll Disclosure and Evolution), a framework that brings progressive skill disclosure into agentic reinforcement learning. STRIDE keeps the selected strategy visible as episode context, exposes a compact tactic menu, and loads full tactic content only after an explicit retrieval action. This interface turns each retrieval into an event-level credit unit: the same event provides process feedback for learning when to retrieve and supplies evidence for skill-bank evolution. On ALFWorld, STRIDE achieves a 92.7% average success rate with Qwen3-4B and a 94.9% average success rate with Qwen3-8B. On WebShop, it improves over the strongest reproduced skill-augmented baseline by 4.5 score points and 1.9 success-rate percentage points. These results show that skill reuse is most effective when persistent strategies preserve global task structure and tactics are disclosed only at local decision bottlenecks.

AI.tldr: 提出STRIDE框架，将渐进式技能披露引入智能体强化学习：区分“策略”与“战术”两类经验，策略作为全程可见的情景上下文，战术仅在检索动作触发后加载全文，并把每次检索转化为事件级信用单元，同时用于学习“何时检索”和演化技能库。
AI.motivation: 现有技能增强强化学习系统把技能池扁平化暴露给智能体，且仅依赖粗粒度的回合级结果更新技能，混淆了两种不同的经验用途：应框定整个回合的稳定策略，与仅在局部执行受阻时才需调用的战术性知识。
AI.method: STRIDE（Strategy-to-Tactics Retrieval-guided skIll Disclosure and Evolution）：1）所选策略持续作为回合上下文可见；2）暴露精简的战术菜单；3）仅在显式检索动作后才加载完整战术内容；4）该接口使每次检索成为事件级信用单元——同一事件既提供“何时检索”的过程反馈，又为技能库演化提供证据。
AI.result: ALFWorld上，Qwen3-4B平均成功率92.7%，Qwen3-8B平均成功率94.9%；WebShop上，相较最强复现技能增强基线提升4.5分（score）与1.9个百分点成功率。
AI.conclusion: 技能复用最有效的条件是：持久策略保持全局任务结构，而战术仅在局部决策瓶颈处被披露。

title: Med-Agentic: Distilling Agentic Medical Reasoning with Internalized Meta-Capabilities
summary: Large language models (LLMs) in expert domains face a trade-off between agentic tool use, which externalizes expertise behind brittle multi-turn runtimes, and end-to-end specialization, which internalizes expertise only implicitly at task-level granularity. We propose internalized meta-capabilities: atomic, parametrically internalized, and composable reasoning units that an LLM can select and combine within a single chain-of-thought (CoT). We instantiate this idea as Med-Agentic for medical visual diagnosis, where the model emits a capability-tagged structured CoT in one forward pass, turning capability invocation into tagged token generation rather than external tool calls. For training, Med-OPD performs multi-teacher on-policy distillation with token-level dual-factor teacher routing conditioned on both the image and the active capability tag, strictly generalizing per-prompt teacher routing. We show that this routing gives an unbiased estimator of the same expected teacher-KL gradient. Across public medical imaging datasets spanning nine anatomies and eight modalities, Med-Agentic consistently improves in-distribution and out-of-distribution diagnostic accuracy over the strong competitors.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"内化元能力"（internalized meta-capabilities）概念，并实例化为 Med-Agentic 医疗视觉诊断模型：在单次前向中以带能力标签的结构化思维链完成能力选择与组合；配套提出 Med-OPD 多教师 on-policy 蒸馏（图像+能力标签双因素 token 级路由），并在 9 个解剖部位、8 种模态的公开医学影像数据集上优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 专家领域 LLM 存在两难：agentic 工具使用把专业知识外置到脆弱的多轮运行时中；end-to-end 专精化只在任务粒度上隐式内化知识。二者都缺乏"原子化、可组合"的推理能力粒度，因此需要一种既内化又不失可组合性的方案。
AI.method: 1) 内化元能力：将能力定义为原子化、参数化内化、可组合的推理单元，模型在一条 CoT 内选择并组合，把能力调用转化为标签 token 生成而非外部工具调用。2) Med-Agentic：医疗视觉诊断实例，单次前向输出能力标签化的结构化 CoT。3) Med-OPD 训练：多教师 on-policy 蒸馏，采用 token 级双因素（图像 + 当前激活能力标签）教师路由，严格泛化逐 prompt 路由；理论上证明该路由是同一期望 teacher-KL 梯度的无偏估计。
AI.result: 在覆盖 9 个解剖部位、8 种模态的公开医学影像数据集上，Med-Agentic 在分布内与分布外诊断准确率上均持续优于强竞争方法。
AI.conclusion: 将专家能力以原子、可组合的元能力形式参数化内化于单条 CoT 中，可在避免多轮工具运行时的同时打破任务级粒度的隐式内化限制；token 级双因素教师路由为多教师蒸馏提供了有理论保证且更细粒度的监督信号。

title: RadAG: Reward-Adversarial Attention Guidance for Efficient Inference-Time Alignment of Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion and flow-based models have achieved remarkable success in generation, yet their samples often remain suboptimal in fidelity and text alignment. Two lines of inference-time methods address this: extrapolation guidance, such as classifier-free guidance (CFG) and its variants, and reward guidance, which aligns samples with reward models of human preference. Extrapolation guidance needs only forward passes, but it builds its reference by heuristic rules unrelated to the reward and therefore cannot steer sampling toward a given reward. Gradient-based reward guidance steers sampling directly toward a higher reward, but backpropagates through the entire generator at every step. This trade-off raises the question of whether extrapolation guidance can steer sampling toward a higher reward without a full backward pass. To answer this, we introduce Reward-Adversarial Attention Guidance (RadAG), which constructs the reference by perturbing the attention logits of a single block against their reward gradient and extrapolates away from it. We prove that this update increases the reward of the clean estimate to first order, while its backward pass stops at the perturbed block instead of traversing the entire generator. On FLUX.2-klein-4B and 9B with PickScore and aesthetic rewards, RadAG achieves the highest target reward in every setting with 30-65% less time than gradient-based and candidate-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 Reward-Adversarial Attention Guidance（RadAG）：通过对单个 block 的 attention logits 施加逆奖励梯度扰动构造参考点并做外推，从而在不做全反传的情况下把采样导向更高奖励。
AI.motivation: 扩散/流模型采样质量与文本对齐仍不理想。现有两类推理时方法各有权衡：外推式引导（如 CFG 及变体）只需前向、速度快，但参考点由启发式规则构造、与奖励无关，无法朝指定奖励引导；基于梯度的奖励引导能直接提升奖励，但每一步都要穿过整个生成器反传，代价高。因此本文追问：能否在不做完整反向传播的前提下，用外推式引导实现奖励提升。
AI.method: RadAG 仅对单个 block 的 attention logits 做扰动，扰动方向取自该 logits 对奖励的梯度（对抗式扰动），以扰动后的结果作为参考，再将干净估计从该参考点外推出去（extrapolation away）。理论上证明该更新在一阶意义上提升干净估计的奖励；反向传播只需到被扰动的 block 即终止，无需遍历整个生成器。
AI.result: 在 FLUX.2-klein-4B 与 9B 上，配合 PickScore 与 aesthetic 奖励，RadAG 在所有设置中取得最高目标奖励，且相比梯度式与候选采样式基线节省 30–65% 的耗时。
AI.conclusion: 奖励引导不必依赖全生成器反传：将奖励梯度限制在单 block 的 attention logits 上即足以提供有效方向，RadAG 在奖励最优性与计算效率之间取得更优的权衡，为推理时对齐提供了一种轻量、可证一阶有效的方案。

title: A2I-VLA: A Two-Stage Vision-Language-Action model with Semantic-Physical Alignment and Integration
summary: Force and tactile feedback provide essential information about physical interactions in contact-rich manipulation that visual observations alone cannot reliably capture.However, integrating these signals into vision-language-action (VLA) models remains challenging owing to the representational gap between visual-language semantics and physical measurements.To address this challenge, we propose A2I-VLA, a two-stage VLA framework that first learns semantically Aligned force-tactile representations and then Integrates them into a VLA model.In Stage I, a cross-modal alignment loss is introduced to promote correspondence between semantic and physical representations. The tactile and force feature streams are then integrated through a hierarchical multimodal fusion network, and the resulting representations are jointly supervised by future wrench and action prediction losses. The former encourages the model to anticipate physical responses, while the latter associates force-tactile observations with task-relevant manipulation behaviors.In Stage II, a gated cross-attention bridge module adaptively integrates the hierarchical physical features learned in Stage I into the VLA model to guide action generation.Real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed A2I-VLA significantly outperforms the baseline PI05 across three contact-rich manipulation tasks, improving the success rate from 70% to 95%.

AI.tldr: 提出A2I-VLA两阶段框架，先学习"语义对齐的力/触觉表征"，再将其集成进VLA模型，在三个接触密集操作任务上将成功率从70%提升到95%。
AI.motivation: 力与触觉反馈能提供视觉观测无法可靠捕获的物理交互信息，但视觉-语言语义与物理测量之间存在表征鸿沟，难以直接融入VLA模型。
AI.method: 两阶段框架。阶段I：引入跨模态对齐损失促使语义表征与物理表征对应；用分层多模态融合网络整合触觉与力特征流，并以未来wrench预测损失和动作预测损失联合监督。阶段II：设计门控交叉注意力桥接模块，将阶段I学到的分层物理特征自适应注入VLA模型以指导动作生成。
AI.result: 在三个接触密集的真实操作任务上显著优于基线PI05，成功率从70%提升至95%。
AI.conclusion: 语义对齐+两阶段集成能有效弥合力-触觉与视觉-语言间的表征鸿沟，为接触密集操作提供可靠的物理反馈利用方案。

title: When Do Better Visual World Models Make Better Plans? Decision-Aligned Selection for Latent Planning
comment: Supplementary material will be included in the next version
summary: Visual world models enable goal-conditioned planning by predicting the outcomes of candidate actions in latent space. However, planning depends on how well a model ranks candidates, whereas training optimizes how accurately it predicts each one. We identify the Decision-Relevant Residual (DRR), the part of the cost error that can reorder candidates, and show that the more training reduces the DRR, the more it improves selection (Spearman $ρ= 0.82$, vs. $0.61$ for prediction error). Building on this insight, we introduce Decision-Aligned Selection (DAS), a plug-in selection rule that scores candidates by the standardized consensus of several independently trained checkpoints, which averages out their checkpoint-specific residuals. Across two model families (LeWorldModel and DINO-WM) and five tasks, DAS selects better actions than single checkpoints in 12 of 18 configurations and outperforms training one model three times longer in 14 of 18. In closed loop, DAS improves success over single checkpoints in 6 of 9 pre-registered LeWM comparisons.

AI.tldr: 论文识别出影响候选动作排序的"决策相关残差"(DRR)，并提出即插即用的"决策对齐选择"(DAS)规则：用多个独立训练检查点的标准化共识评分来平均掉各检查点特有的残差，从而提升视觉世界模型的目标条件规划选择质量。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界模型通过在潜空间预测候选动作结果来做目标条件规划，但规划性能取决于模型对候选的"排序"能力，而训练目标优化的是对每个候选的"预测精度"，二者存在错位。作者希望刻画并缓解这一训练—决策失配问题。
AI.method: 1) 定义 Decision-Relevant Residual (DRR)，即代价误差中能改变候选排序的那部分；2) 通过相关性分析验证 DRR 与选择质量的关系（Spearman ρ=0.82，而预测误差仅 0.61）；3) 提出 Decision-Aligned Selection (DAS)：对多个独立训练的检查点给出候选评分，取标准化后的共识分数进行选择，以抵消检查点特有的残差。
AI.result: 在 LeWorldModel 与 DINO-WM 两个模型族、五个任务、共 18 种配置上评估：DAS 在 12/18 配置中选出优于单检查点的动作，在 14/18 配置中优于将单模型训练三倍时长；闭环实验中，在 9 项预注册的 LeWM 比较中有 6 项成功率优于单检查点。
AI.conclusion: 排序相关的残差（DRR）比整体预测误差更能解释并预测规划表现；通过对多检查点评分做标准化共识聚合的 DAS，可在不改变训练流程的前提下即插即用地提升候选选择与闭环成功率，说明决策对齐的评估/选择准则对世界模型规划至关重要。

title: Don't Test Where You Trained: Geographic Overlap Inflates End-to-End Driving Scores
summary: In NAVSIMv1, the standard benchmark for end-to-end driving, $89.6\%$ of the test scenes lie within 4m of a training scene. We show that this geographic overlap inflates the reported scores. We propose a geographically disjoint split of NAVSIMv1 and an evaluation that compares models trained on either split on the same scenes, which neither has seen in training. All sensor-based models we test, DiffusionDrive, Latent TransFuser, and DrivoR, lose 3.4 to 6.1 PDMS points on these scenes, mainly by leaving the road and coming close to other objects, against 1.5 points for a baseline without sensors. The loss concentrates where a training drive of the original split passed the same place. At all other places, models trained on the original split are no better than those trained on the geographic split. Models trained on the original split predict road geometry that no camera can see. The gap persists when the auxiliary map loss is removed, so the models memorize locations even without being supervised to. On nuScenes, the geographic split cuts SparseDrive's mapping accuracy by $59\%$ and also degrades its planning. Driving scores on logged scenes thus partly measure how well a model remembers the test locations. We release the split to evaluate generalization to new places.

AI.tldr: 本文指出NAVSIMv1测试集有89.6%场景位于训练场景4米范围内，存在严重的地理重叠，导致端到端驾驶评测分数被高估。作者提出地理不相交（geographically disjoint）的数据划分，并对两个划分的模型在同一批双方均未见过的场景上比较，发现所有基于传感器的模型PDMS下降3.4–6.1分，主要因偏离道路和接近他物，而无传感器基线仅下降1.5分；损失集中在原划分训练轨迹经过的地点，在其余地点两个划分训练的模型无差异；模型甚至能预测相机不可见的道路几何，去掉辅助地图损失后差距仍存在，说明模型在无监督下也记忆了位置。nuScenes上该划分使SparseDrive建图精度下降59%并损害规划。结论：驾驶评分部分衡量的是对测试地点的记忆，作者公开该划分以评估对新地点的泛化。
AI.motivation: NAVSIMv1作为端到端驾驶的标准基准，其测试场景与训练场景高度地理重叠（89.6%在4m内），使报告的分数被虚高，无法真实衡量模型对新地点的泛化能力；现有评测缺乏对地理分布偏移的隔离与控制。
AI.method: 构造NAVSIMv1的地理不相交划分；设计对照评测：将分别在原始划分与地理划分上训练的模型放到同一批“双方均未在训练中见过”的场景上比较；对DiffusionDrive、Latent TransFuser、DrivoR及无传感器基线进行对比，按场景与训练轨迹经过地点的关系做归因分析；消融辅助地图损失；并在nuScenes上以SparseDrive验证建图与规划影响。
AI.result: 所有基于传感器的模型在未见场景上损失3.4–6.1 PDMS，主要表现为驶出道路与逼近他物，无传感器基线仅1.5；损失集中于原划分训练轨迹曾经过的地点，其余地点两划分模型无差异；模型能预测相机不可见的道路几何，移除辅助地图损失后差距依旧；nuScenes上SparseDrive建图精度下降59%，规划性能亦下降。
AI.conclusion: 标准基准上的驾驶分数部分反映的是对测试地点的记忆而非驾驶能力；地理重叠会系统性抬高评测结果，需用地理不相交划分评估新地点泛化；作者公开该划分作为新地点泛化评测工具。

title: Pixel Auto-Encoder: Reconstructing Language Model Activations Through Pixel Art
summary: Interpreting the high-dimensional internal representations of large language models (LLMs) remains a challenging problem. Recent approaches have explored translating these representations into human-understandable forms, particularly natural language. In this work, we explore the use of images as an alternative target modality for interpreting LLM activations. As a first step toward this goal, we introduce Pixel Auto-Encoder, which converts intermediate LLM activations into $32 \times 32$, 32-color pixel art and reconstructs them for subsequent computation within the model. By encouraging the intermediate representations to resemble predefined concept images, we investigate whether LLM activations can be expressed visually while preserving the model's language capabilities. We find that the model can produce target-aligned images for some concepts, and that replacing pixel representations with concept images can influence next-token predictions. However, we also observe a trade-off between visual alignment and language-model performance, as well as sensitivity to pixel-level changes that are difficult to interpret visually. These findings demonstrate the feasibility and limitations of image-based representations of LLM activations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Pixel Auto-Encoder，将大语言模型中间层激活编码为 32×32、32 色的像素图并解码回原空间以保留语言能力，初步验证了用图像作为解释 LLM 表征的替代模态的可行性与局限。
AI.motivation: LLM 高维内部表征难以解释，现有工作多将其翻译为自然语言；作者希望探索"图像"作为另一种更直观的解释目标模态，检验激活能否被视觉化表达而不损害模型的语言能力。
AI.method: 设计 Pixel Auto-Encoder：把 LLM 中间层激活映射为 32×32、32 色像素图，再从中重建激活供后续前向计算使用；通过约束中间表征逼近预定义的概念图像（target-aligned），并测试以概念图替换像素表征对下一 token 预测的影响。
AI.result: 对部分概念，模型能生成与目标对齐的图像；将像素表征替换为概念图像可影响下一 token 预测。但视觉对齐与语言模型性能之间存在权衡，且模型对视觉上难以解释的像素级改动敏感。
AI.conclusion: 基于图像的 LLM 激活表征在原理上可行，但存在对齐—性能权衡与像素敏感性等明显局限，说明该方向具备研究价值但仍需改进。

title: RSLaA: Self-Reconfiguring Roadside LiDARs as Agents for 3D Traffic Perception
summary: Cooperative perception with roadside LiDARs (RSLs) extends the sensing range of autonomous vehicles and resolves onboard-sensor occlusions, particularly at curves and intersections. Because infrastructure deployment is costly, existing work optimizes RSL configurations once, against road geometry and aggregated traffic statistics, and treats them as fixed thereafter. Traffic flow, however, is inherently dynamic, and a placement optimal on average can be far from optimal at any given moment. We introduce RSLaA (Roadside LiDARs as Agents), a framework in which each RSL adaptively adjusts its pose to the evolving traffic scene over decision-time windows. Since ground truth is unavailable at decision time, the framework centers on surrogate metrics computed solely from a probabilistic occupancy grid of historical observations, which predicts the next-window perception performance of candidate poses. We construct a co-simulation benchmark pairing five candidate surrogates with detector-agnostic ground-truth perception labels at every decision window, identifying the multi-view coverage metric J_mv as the most reliable predictor. Upon this validated surrogate we build two adaptive configuration methods, a receding-horizon (MPC) optimizer and a lightweight MAPPO-based multi-agent reinforcement learning scheme with centralized training and decentralized execution. Across 10 sites and 89 six-hour traffic scenarios (890 evaluation runs), adaptive configuration consistently improves the composite perception score over static deployment. Our results indicate that RSLs could be benefitted from being treated as agents.

AI.tldr: 提出RSLaA框架，将路侧激光雷达（RSL）视为可主动调整位姿的智能体，基于历史观测的概率占据栅格构建代理指标预测下一时间窗感知性能，并用MPC与MAPPO两种方法实现自适应配置，在890次评测中一致优于静态部署。
AI.motivation: 路侧激光雷达协同感知可扩展自动驾驶车辆的感知范围并缓解车载传感器遮挡（尤其在弯道与交叉口），但基础设施部署成本高。现有工作仅依据道路几何与聚合交通统计一次性优化RSL配置并视为固定不变；然而交通流本质动态，平均意义下的最优布站在任一具体时刻可能远非最优。
AI.method: 提出RSLaA（Roadside LiDARs as Agents）框架，每个RSL在决策时间窗内自适应调整位姿。由于决策时刻无真值，框架以仅由历史观测的概率占据栅格计算出的代理指标为核心，预测候选位姿在下一时间窗的感知性能。构建协同仿真基准，在每一决策窗将五种候选代理指标与检测器无关的真值感知标签配对，识别出多视角覆盖指标 J_mv 为最可靠预测器。在该经校验的代理指标上实现两种自适应配置方法：滚动时域（MPC）优化器，以及轻量级MAPPO多智能体强化学习方案（集中训练、分散执行）。
AI.result: 在10个站点、89个六小时交通场景（共890次评测运行）中，自适应配置相比静态部署持续提升综合感知评分；J_mv在多候选代理指标中预测可靠性最高。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将路侧激光雷达作为智能体（而非一次性固定的静态设施）进行动态位姿配置，可为协同感知带来实际收益。

title: OmniDecisionBench: Evaluating and Benchmarking the Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models
summary: Multimodal System One models answer visual tasks with typed decisions and native probabilities, yet no holistic evaluation compares them with general VLMs or maps either class's capability boundaries. We introduce OmniDecisionBench, a holistic benchmark of multimodal System One models. Its main evaluation assigns 45 datasets (192,975 records) to five capability families and twelve primary angles across four typed interfaces, scoring accuracy and candidate-probability calibration. A validation layer adds three single-factor diagnostics varying visual presentation, textual evidence sufficiency, and target dataset. Across three System One models and two general VLMs, three regularities emerge. First, strengths depend on angle and metric: System One models lead discrete tasks overall with lower ECE15 on most perception, reading, and reasoning angles (Jev 1.14: 80.14% accuracy, 4.50% ECE15), while general VLMs lead ordinal grading and outperform Jev 1.14 among the three models tested on direct Box grounding. Second, multi-image and abstract reasoning bound every model, where confidence rather than accuracy separates them. Third, reliability shifts with the input: rendering only options nearly triples Jev 1.14's selective risk at nearly flat mean signed bias, and donor risk cutoffs often exceed target risk across unseen datasets and task families. OmniDecisionBench thus maps which model class suits each angle and where reliability ends. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/Glax147/OmniDecisionBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OmniDecisionBench，一个面向多模态 System One 模型的全景评测基准，在 45 个数据集（192,975 条记录）、五类能力族、十二个主角度和四种类型化接口上同时评估准确率与候选概率校准，并与通用 VLM 进行对比，从而刻画两类模型的能力边界与可靠性边界。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态 System One 模型以类型化决策和原生概率输出回答视觉任务，但缺乏与通用 VLM 的整体性评估，也缺少对两类模型能力边界的系统刻画；单一角度的评测无法回答"哪类模型适合哪类任务、可靠性在何处失效"这一问题。
AI.method: 构建 OmniDecisionBench：主评测将 45 个数据集（192,975 条记录）映射到五个能力族与十二个主角度，覆盖四种类型化接口，同时统计准确率与候选概率校准（如 ECE15）；另设验证层，包含三项单因子诊断，分别扰动视觉呈现形式、文本证据充分性与目标数据集；共评测三个 System One 模型与两个通用 VLM。
AI.result: 呈现三条规律：(1) 优势依角度与指标而异——System One 模型在离散任务整体领先，在多数感知、阅读与推理角度上 ECE15 更低（Jev 1.14 达 80.14% 准确率、4.50% ECE15），而通用 VLM 在序数评分上领先，并在三个被测模型中于直接 Box 定位上优于 Jev 1.14；(2) 多图与抽象推理对全部模型构成瓶颈，此时区分模型的是置信度而非准确率；(3) 可靠性随输入变化——仅渲染选项会使 Jev 1.14 的选择性风险近乎增至三倍而平均带符号偏差几乎不变，且跨未见数据集与任务族时源域风险阈值常高于目标域风险。
AI.conclusion: OmniDecisionBench 系统性刻画了各模型类别在不同评测角度上的适配性及可靠性失效边界，说明准确率与校准需联合评估、置信度行为是区分模型的关键维度；代码与数据集将开源。

title: BReD: BEV Residual Diffusion for Feed-Forward Road Gaussian Reconstruction
summary: Accurate road surface reconstruction is essential for autonomous-driving mapping and simulation, but existing methods trade reconstruction quality for cross-scene inference. Optimization-based methods recover detailed surfaces through costly per-scene optimization, while feed-forward methods lack road-specific constraints and often produce large elevation errors. We propose \textbf{BReD}, a feed-forward framework for reconstructing road elevation, appearance, and semantics from calibrated six-camera sequences. BReD first estimates coarse elevation through LiDAR-supervised depth learning and BEV lifting, using only cameras at inference. A lightweight BEV residual diffusion model then conditions elevation refinement on a camera-derived depth--elevation discrepancy and elevation-aware image features. Diffusion-indexed perturbations expose the model to different discrepancy corruption levels during training, while inference performs one deterministic refinement from the clean discrepancy. The refined elevations are temporally aggregated to anchor road-aligned Gaussians, whose attributes are predicted by a geometry-prior-guided decoder without test-time optimization. On four held-out nuScenes scenes, BReD achieves 7.34 cm elevation RMSE and 90.92\% semantic mIoU, compared with 14.43 cm for RoGS without test-time LiDAR and 8.88 cm for its test-time-LiDAR-assisted variant; both RoGS variants require per-scene optimization.

AI.tldr: BReD：一种前馈式路面重建框架，仅用六路相机即可同时输出高程、外观与语义，在nuScenes上高程RMSE达7.34 cm、语义mIoU 90.92%，优于需逐场景优化的RoGS。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶建图与仿真需要高精度路面重建，但现有方法在重建质量与跨场景推理之间存在权衡：基于优化的方法依赖昂贵的逐场景优化才能获得细节表面，前馈方法缺乏路面特定约束、高程误差大。
AI.method: BReD由三部分组成：(1) 借助LiDAR监督的深度学习与BEV提升获得粗高程，推理阶段仅用相机；(2) 轻量级BEV残差扩散模型，以相机导出的深度—高程差异和含高程感知的图像特征为条件细化高程，训练时用扩散索引扰动模拟不同差异破坏程度，推理时从干净差异出发做一次确定性细化；(3) 时序聚合精化高程以锚定路面高斯，其属性由几何先验引导的解码器预测，无需测试时优化。
AI.result: 在四个留出的nuScenes场景上，BReD高程RMSE为7.34 cm、语义mIoU为90.92%；对比RoGS无测试时LiDAR为14.43 cm、测试时LiDAR辅助变体为8.88 cm，且两种RoGS变体均需逐场景优化。
AI.conclusion: 通过LiDAR监督的深度学习、扩散式残差高程细化与几何先验引导的高斯属性解码，BReD在保持前馈跨场景推理的同时达到优于逐场景优化方法的重建精度，验证了显式路面约束与扩散细化对消除高程误差的有效性。

title: Hidden Sensitivity in LLM Pre-training: A Dynamic System View
summary: In Large Language Model (LLM) pre-training, loss curves can conceal substantial instability, i.e., even small perturbations may lead to dramatically different predictions while leaving loss nearly unchanged. To investigate this phenomenon and reveal the underlying mechanisms, we first formulate LLM pre-training as a non-autonomous dynamical system that jointly evolves model weights and Adam optimizer states. Based on this formulation, we introduce a normalized sensitivity score in optimizer-relative coordinates to identify sensitive training checkpoints. At one such checkpoint, a weight perturbation of only 10^(-5) leads to 35.7% disagreement in top-1 predictions and 16.2% disagreement in benchmark answers after 200 training steps, with only 0.8% of greedy generations remaining identical despite similar validation losses. Furthermore, we find that perturbations to Adam's first and second moments induce comparably large effects, with similar sensitivity patterns observed in OLMo-1B. Finally, guided by our diagnostic, targeted stabilization reduces top-1 disagreement to 0.83% and increases generation exact match to 88.3%, at the cost of a 0.11-nat increase in validation loss. Our findings reveal a hidden form of optimizer-state-dependent sensitivity in LLM pre-training that conventional loss-based evaluations may overlook, while demonstrating its potential for diagnosis and mitigation.

AI.tldr: 该文将LLM预训练建模为联合演化权重与Adam状态的自治动力系统，提出优化器相对坐标下的归一化敏感度分数以定位脆弱检查点，并据此实施定向稳定化，在几乎不影响验证损失的前提下显著降低扰动敏感性。
AI.motivation: 预训练损失曲线平稳会掩盖严重的不稳定性：微小扰动即可大幅改变预测，而loss几乎不变。作者希望刻画并揭示这种"隐藏敏感性"的机制，并说明仅凭loss评估模型/检查点的局限。
AI.method: 将预训练形式化为同时演化模型权重与Adam一阶、二阶矩的非自治动力系统；在此框架下定义优化器相对坐标中的归一化敏感度分数，用于识别敏感检查点；在敏感检查点施加10^-5量级权重扰动并跟踪200步训练后的top-1预测一致性、基准答案一致性与贪心生成一致率；并分析对Adam一、二阶矩施加扰动的效应，在OLMo-1B上验证模式的迁移性；最后依据诊断结果进行定向稳定化。
AI.result: 在识别出的敏感检查点上，10^-5的权重扰动经200步训练后导致top-1预测不一致率35.7%、基准答案不一致率16.2%，贪心生成仅0.8%保持相同，而验证损失相近。对Adam一阶、二阶矩的扰动产生同等量级影响，OLMo-1B呈现相似敏感模式。定向稳定化后top-1不一致率降至0.83%，生成精确匹配率提升至88.3%，验证损失仅增加0.11 nat。
AI.conclusion: LLM预训练中存在一种依赖于优化器状态的隐藏敏感性，传统基于loss的评估会将其忽略；该现象可被诊断，并可通过定向稳定化加以缓解。

title: A Glimpse of Training VLMs as Foundation Models for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Recently, GPT-6 Astra demonstrates strong generalization in robot control, yet limited disclosure of its training leaves open how such capabilities can be reproduced. We introduce nanoAstra, an approach to training vision-language models (VLMs) for generalizable manipulation that combines semantic action modeling with capability-preserving supervised fine-tuning (CP-SFT). nanoAstra represents robot behavior as semantic steps composed of reusable, parameterized action primitives, guided by explicit progress descriptions. Meanwhile, CP-SFT uses an explicit robot-specific system prompt to constrain manipulation outputs to a structured action space, aiming to focus adaptation on robot-specific contexts and promote specialization while minimizing interference with broader pretrained capabilities. With this formulation, we train nanoAstra on more than 5,000 hours of robot data together with general VQA data. On RoboTwin 2.0's randomized benchmark, nanoAstra-9B achieves a 17.8% zero-shot success rate, substantially outperforming advanced VLA and WAM baselines as well as similarly sized VLMs. With inference faster than the corresponding motion execution on a single H20 GPU, our model supports action-chunk-like streaming execution that overlaps inference with motion, reducing the robot's idle time from 35.0% to 6.9%.

AI.tldr: 提出 nanoAstra：将机器人行为表示为“进度描述引导的语义步骤+可复用参数化动作原语”，并结合能力保持式监督微调（CP-SFT），用机器人专用系统提示把输出约束到结构化动作空间，实现可泛化的VLM操作策略；nanoAstra-9B 在 RoboTwin 2.0 随机化基准上零样本成功率 17.8%，且支持类动作分块的流式执行，将机器人空闲时间从 35.0% 降至 6.9%。
AI.motivation: GPT-6 Astra 在机器人控制上泛化能力强，但其训练细节未公开，难以复现。作者希望给出一种可复现、可开源的 VLM 机器人操作训练方案，同时解决“机器人适配”与“通用预训练能力保持”之间的矛盾（避免灾难性遗忘）。
AI.method: 1) 语义动作建模：把机器人行为分解为语义步骤，每步由可复用、参数化的动作原语组成，并由显式进度描述引导；2) CP-SFT：引入显式的机器人专用系统提示，将操作输出约束到结构化动作空间，使适配聚焦于机器人特定上下文，在实现专门化的同时尽量减少对预训练通用能力的干扰；3) 训练数据：超过 5,000 小时机器人数据 + 通用 VQA 数据联合训练；4) 部署：单张 H20 GPU 上推理快于对应动作执行，实现类动作分块（action-chunk-like）的推理—运动重叠流式执行。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 随机化基准上，nanoAstra-9B 取得 17.8% 零样本成功率，显著优于先进 VLA、WAM 基线及同规模 VLM；推理速度超过对应运动执行速度，流式执行将机器人空闲时间由 35.0% 降至 6.9%。
AI.conclusion: 将语义动作建模与能力保持式 SFT 结合，可在通用 VLM 上以可复现方式获得较强零样本操作泛化，并兼顾部署效率；该工作为“通用 VLM → 机器人策略”的低遗忘、可流式化适配提供了可行范式。

title: STEdgeFormer: MCU and NPU Deployable Transformer Architecture
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, Neurips 2026 workshop- SLM Agents
summary: Transformer-based sequence models have achieved strong performance in language and time-series modeling, but self-attention remains computationally and memory intensive for deployment on resource-constrained edge accelerators. We propose STEdgeFormer, a lightweight, hardware-aware sequence architecture designed for efficient execution on embedded neural accelerators. STEdgeFormer combines polynomial mixture layers and DyT normalization with an accelerator-aware causal memory block, replacing pairwise self-attention with compact causal aggregation. On TinyStories, the fully NPU-supported STEdgeFormer (MW) achieves a perplexity of 7.39 with 4.12M parameters and 6.51 MB RAM, with an end-to-end latency of 40 ms. In comparison, the standard 4.12M-parameter configuration achieves a lower perplexity of 6.79 but requires CPU fallback for unsupported operators, resulting in 1450 ms latency. Vanilla Transformer, on the other hand, achieves a perplexity score of 5.71 using a 4.40M-parameter model, but it cannot be deployed on the hardware. On downstream tasks, STEdgeFormer achieves 94% accuracy on ECG5000 and 93% accuracy on Speech Commands with 1.39M parameters. These results demonstrate that hardware-aware architectural choices and operator compatibility can have a substantial impact on practical inference latency, beyond model size and task accuracy alone. Rather than targeting state-of-the-art accuracy on individual benchmarks, STEdgeFormer is designed to provide a deployable sequence modeling architecture under the memory, computational, and operator constraints of embedded neural accelerators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 STEdgeFormer，一种面向嵌入式神经加速器的轻量级、硬件感知序列架构，用多项式混合层、DyT 归一化与加速器感知因果记忆块替代成对自注意力，在 TinyStories 上实现 40 ms 端到端延迟（PPL 7.39，4.12M 参数，6.51 MB RAM），并在 ECG5000 与 Speech Commands 上达到 94%/93% 准确率。
AI.motivation: Transformer 序列模型性能强，但自注意力计算与内存开销大，难以部署在资源受限的边缘加速器上；且部分算子不被 NPU 支持而导致 CPU 回退，实际延迟远超模型规模所暗示的水平。作者不追求单项基准的 SOTA 精度，而是要在嵌入式加速器的内存、算力与算子约束下提供可部署的序列建模架构。
AI.method: 提出 STEdgeFormer：以多项式混合层（polynomial mixture layers）、DyT 归一化（无统计量的动态范围归一化）与加速器感知的因果记忆块（causal memory block）组合，用紧凑的因果聚合替代成对自注意力；设计上强调算子与 NPU 的兼容性，避免不支持的算子。同时对比了"标准配置"（含不受支持算子、需 CPU 回退）与纯 NPU 支持版本（MW）。
AI.result: TinyStories 上：全 NPU 支持的 STEdgeFormer(MW) PPL 7.39，4.12M 参数，6.51 MB RAM，端到端延迟 40 ms；同规模（4.12M）标准配置 PPL 更低为 6.79，但因算子不支持触发 CPU 回退，延迟达 1450 ms；原生 Transformer 用 4.40M 参数取得 PPL 5.71，但无法在该硬件上部署。下游任务上，1.39M 参数模型在 ECG5000 上准确率 94%、Speech Commands 上 93%。
AI.conclusion: 硬件感知的架构选择与算子兼容性对实际推理延迟的影响可超过模型规模与任务精度本身；STEdgeFormer 在嵌入式加速器的内存、计算与算子约束下提供了可部署的序列建模方案，其价值在于可部署性而非基准精度最优。

title: FastD4RT: Training-Free Acceleration of Dynamic 4D Reconstruction and Tracking
summary: Query-based 4D reconstruction models such as D4RT encode a video once into a global scene representation and obtain outputs by decoding independent point queries. However, inference is often influenced by dense outputs and long videos. Although D4RT separates encoding from decoding, a dense output still requires one decoder query for every pixel of every frame, and a long video is still encoded as many overlapping segments. In this work, we analyze the inference cost of D4RT and show that a large part of it is redundant. In particular, we find that the later decoder blocks attend to a small set of tokens shared by all queries. Based on these findings, we propose FastD4RT, a training-free framework that accelerates D4RT. By exploiting the smoothness of the outputs over time and across pixels, FastD4RT encodes and decodes only at sparse anchors and recovers the remaining outputs via interpolation. It decodes the remaining queries against a shared token set selected once per segment. We further characterize the errors introduced by both components. Experimental results show that FastD4RT accelerates D4RT by about 5 times on average across all its tasks with competitive accuracy, and further improves accuracy on long videos. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lycheemeng/fastd4rt.

AI.tldr: FastD4RT 是一个免训练加速框架，通过稀疏锚点编解码加插值、以及按段共享 token 集合，将 D4RT 的 4D 重建推理加速约 5 倍且精度具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: D4RT 类基于查询的 4D 重建模型虽将编码与解码分离，但稠密输出需为每帧每像素各做一次解码查询，长视频又被切成大量重叠片段编码，推理成本高。作者分析发现其中很大一部分计算是冗余的：后期解码器块只关注一小部分被所有查询共享的 token。
AI.method: 提出 FastD4RT 免训练框架：（1）利用输出在时间与像素上的平滑性，仅在稀疏锚点上进行编码与解码，其余输出通过插值恢复；（2）每个片段只选取一次共享 token 集合，让剩余查询针对该共享集合解码；（3）对两个组件引入的误差进行理论刻画。
AI.result: 在所有任务上平均加速约 5 倍，精度具有竞争力，且在长视频上精度进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: D4RT 推理存在显著冗余，稀疏锚点插值加共享 token 解码可在不改训练的前提下高效加速 4D 重建，并改善长视频表现。

title: AgriManager: A Framework and Benchmark for LLM-RL Generalization in Agricultural Management
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Track on Evaluations and Datasets
summary: Agricultural management is heterogeneous along two axes. The first is distributional shift within a fixed task interface: weather, crops, and prices vary across years and locations while sensors, actions, and objective stay fixed. The second is structural shift across interfaces: different farms expose different observed variables, available actions, and management objectives. We formalize the second axis as schema shift: variation in the policy-facing schema $Σ= (Σ_O, Σ_A, Σ_R)$ between training and deployment. We test whether LLM-RL generalizes across both axes with AgriManager, to our knowledge the first framework that trains LLM policies with RL across multiple process-based crop simulators, unifying DSSAT, WOFOST, and Cycles. We design a three-tier generalization ladder: Tier 1 within-schema distributional shift, Tier 2 single-axis schema shift along $Σ_O / Σ_A / Σ_R$, Tier 3 compositional schema shift across simulators, all scored on a frozen held-out test suite with three training seeds per method. Within fixed schemas, Qwen3-4B trained by RL with explicit reasoning exceeds neural-network PPO trained with the same interaction budget; without reasoning, training stalls near no-action where the reward penalizes input use. Under single-axis schema shift, $Σ_O$ transfer needs decision-critical state, $Σ_A$ results are consistent with joint action-menu coverage, and with reasoning a policy trained on yield alone transfers to unseen objectives. Under compositional schema shift, single-source training mostly hurts zero-shot transfer across simulators, and a unified policy trained only on other combinations of the same components recovers about 86% of the gain of a specialist trained on the target combination on DSSAT and stays below the specialists on the WOFOST and Cycles profit targets. Project page: https://agrimanager-framework.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出AgriManager框架，首次用强化学习跨DSSAT、WOFOST、Cycles多个过程式作物模拟器训练LLM策略，并设计三级泛化阶梯检验LLM-RL在分布偏移与模式（schema）偏移下的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 农业管理异质性有两轴：固定任务界面内的分布偏移（天气、作物、价格随年份地域变化），以及跨界面的结构性偏移（不同农场观测变量、可行动作、管理目标各异）。后者被形式化为模式偏移Σ=(Σ_O, Σ_A, Σ_R)，此前缺乏统一的训练与评测框架，也未知LLM-RL能否跨两轴泛化。
AI.method: 构建AgriManager，统一DSSAT、WOFOST、Cycles三个过程式作物模拟器；定义三级泛化阶梯：Tier 1同模式内分布偏移；Tier 2沿Σ_O/Σ_A/Σ_R的单轴模式偏移；Tier 3跨模拟器的组合式模式偏移。全部在冻结的留出测试集上评测，每种方法三个训练随机种子。基线为同交互预算的神经网络PPO，并对比带显式推理与不带推理的LLM-RL（Qwen3-4B）。
AI.result: 固定模式下，带显式推理、经RL训练的Qwen3-4B优于同等交互预算的NN-PPO；无推理时训练停滞在“不动作”附近（奖励惩罚投入品使用）。单轴偏移中，Σ_O迁移需保留决策关键状态，Σ_A结果与联合动作菜单覆盖一致，带推理时仅在产量目标上训练的策略可迁移至未见目标。组合式偏移中单源训练多损害跨模拟器零样本迁移；仅在相同组件其他组合上训练的统一策略在DSSAT上恢复约86%的专用策略增益，但在WOFOST与Cycles利润目标上仍低于专用策略。
