AI.conclusion: LLM-RL在农业管理中的泛化受模式结构约束：推理是固定模式性能与目标迁移的关键；观测轴迁移依赖决策关键状态保留；组合式模式迁移难以由单源训练获得，统一策略可部分逼近但未全面超越专用策略，说明结构偏移仍是开放挑战。

title: More Than Picturing the Future: Motion-Oriented Latent Reasoning for Generalizable Robot Manipulation
summary: Latent reasoning lets Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models deliberate at a fraction of the cost of explicit chain-of-thought, increasingly through visual foresight, which we show to be indispensable for predicting actions. Yet this paradigm is inherited from Vision-Language Models, where it serves understanding rather than action: each latent is aligned with an isolated future frame, often enriched with further modalities of that frame. We find that this binds the policy to the appearance of its training scenes, so that it degrades sharply once the scene changes. We argue that visual latents for action should capture not what a future frame looks like, but how the scene evolves toward the goal. We therefore propose Motion-Oriented Latent Reasoning, which redirects visual latents from the whole frame to the interaction that the action must bring about. Semantic latents, following the stages of embodied chain-of-thought, first establish what to accomplish and how. Conditioned on them, motion-oriented latents anticipate each future step from coarse to fine: from the global scene, to the interaction region spanned by the manipulated object and its destination, to the robot state. Relative to the state-of-the-art latent VLA LaST$_0$, our method raises the mean success rate on SimplerEnv-WidowX from 37.5% to 55.2% in distribution and from 22.4% to 30.2% under out-of-distribution shifts, and on an AgileX Piper dual-arm platform from 60.8% to 90.8% in training scenes and from 6.7% to 37.5% under environmental changes.

AI.tldr: 提出Motion-Oriented Latent Reasoning（MOLR），将VLA模型的视觉隐式推理从"预测未来帧外观"重定向为"预测场景如何向目标演化"，在分布内与分布外场景下均显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA的隐式推理范式沿用自VLM，其视觉隐式表征与孤立未来帧（乃至该帧的更多模态）对齐，服务于"理解"而非"动作"。这种设计使策略被绑定到训练场景的外观上，场景一旦变化性能急剧下降。作者据此主张：面向动作的视觉隐式表征应刻画场景如何朝目标演化，而非未来帧长什么样。
AI.method: 1）语义隐式：遵循具身思维链的阶段划分，先确定"做什么"与"怎么做"；2）以语义隐式为条件，运动导向隐式按由粗到细逐级预测未来步：全局场景 → 由被操作物体及其目标位置构成的交互区域 → 机器人自身状态。即将视觉隐式从整帧重定向到动作所必须引发的交互上。
AI.result: 相较SOTA隐式VLA模型LaST₀：SimplerEnv-WidowX上平均成功率由37.5%升至55.2%（分布内），分布外偏移下由22.4%升至30.2%；AgileX Piper双臂平台上训练场景由60.8%升至90.8%，环境变化下由6.7%升至37.5%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉隐式推理对动作预测不可或缺，但其表征目标须由"帧外观重建"转向"场景演化与交互预测"。运动导向的由粗到细隐式推理可显著缓解外观绑定导致的分布外性能衰减，并在真实双臂平台上验证了有效性。但OOD场景下成功率绝对值仍偏低（30.2%、37.5%），分布偏移鲁棒性仍是后续关键问题。

title: PruneNAS: Constraint Aware Neural Architecture Search based Pruning
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, British Machine Vision Conference, Lancaster, 2026
summary: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has achieved state-of-the-art performance across diverse tasks, but its high computational cost remains a major barrier. We introduce PruneNAS, a novel framework that integrates structured pruning into NAS to efficiently explore high-performing architectures while leveraging pretrained models. Unlike conventional NAS methods that train each candidate from scratch, PruneNAS generates a candidate pool by pruning pretrained networks at multiple granularity levels and formulates the selection as a global optimization problem using training-free importance metrics. This approach enables rapid evaluation of candidate architectures under strict resource constraints, dramatically reducing search time from hundreds of GPU hours to mere minutes. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that PruneNAS discovers compact, high-accuracy architectures that nearly halve the computational cost (MACs) of prior methods on ResNet-50, while also showing strong generalization on object detection tasks with YOLO. Our method bridges structured pruning and NAS, offering a practical solution for resource-constrained model deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出PruneNAS框架，将结构化剪枝与NAS结合，通过剪枝预训练网络构建候选池并用免训练重要性指标做全局优化选择，把搜索时间从数百GPU小时降至数分钟。
AI.motivation: 传统NAS需为每个候选架构从头训练，计算开销巨大，成为实用化的主要障碍；作者希望借助预训练模型避免重复训练，同时高效探索高性能架构。
AI.method: 在多个粒度层级上对预训练网络进行结构化剪枝以生成候选架构池；采用免训练的重要性指标，将候选选择建模为全局优化问题，在严格资源约束下快速评估候选架构。
AI.result: 在标准基准上发现紧凑且高精度的架构，在ResNet-50上将MACs相比先前方法近乎减半；在基于YOLO的目标检测任务上表现出良好泛化性；搜索时间从数百GPU小时降至数分钟。
AI.conclusion: PruneNAS弥合了结构化剪枝与NAS之间的鸿沟，为资源受限场景下的模型部署提供了实用解决方案。

title: Video-as-Weights: Compiling a Video Once into Parametric and Token Memory
summary:
Vision-language models (VLMs) represent videos as thousands of visual tokens, creating a large key-value cache whose memory grows with video length. At the same time, small VLMs that fit on limited hardware understand video far worse than large models. Existing compression methods shorten visual tokens into a brief prompt to save memory, yet the small model still processes them through fixed weights and cannot close this capability gap.
  To address both challenges, we introduce Video-as-Weights (VaW), which compiles a video once without seeing any question into the parametric and token memory of a frozen interpreter VLM. Specifically, a compiler VLM watches the video, and a single weight decoder jointly generates the interpreter's LoRA weights and optional prefix tokens from every compiler layer, enabling both same-model compilation and strong-to-weak transfer across model sizes and depths.
  Across six video QA benchmarks, a 0.8B interpreter beats full in-context reading by 1.7 points when compiled by itself and by 4.3 points with a 9B compiler, reducing context from up to 8,192 visual tokens to 64 prefix tokens while using 5.5x less memory than the video's key-value cache. Generated weights add 3.9 points over token compression alone, and all-layer decoding outperforms layer-wise generation by 2.9 points. Mechanistic analysis shows that with prefix tokens, the weights mainly alter attention queries and MLP down projections to guide retrieval and store a baseline summary, whereas without tokens, they shift to attention output projections to write video content directly into the residual stream.

AI.tldr: 提出 Video-as-Weights (VaW)，将视频一次性“编译”为冻结解释器 VLM 的 LoRA 权重与少量前缀 token，用参数记忆替代数千视觉 token 的 KV 缓存，使 0.8B 小模型在六个视频问答基准上超越全上下文读取，并可从 9B 编译器迁移。
AI.motivation: VLM 将视频表示为数千视觉 token，KV 缓存内存随视频长度线性增长；而适配有限硬件的小型 VLM 视频理解能力远逊于大模型。现有视觉 token 压缩方法只把 token 缩短为简短提示，但小模型仍以固定权重处理这些 token，无法弥合能力差距。因此需要同时解决内存效率与能力差距两个问题。
AI.method: VaW 在不看任何问题的情况下将视频编译一次：由编译器 VLM 观看视频，一个单一的权重解码器联合地从编译器每一层生成解释器 VLM 的 LoRA 权重以及可选前缀 token；解释器保持冻结。该设计支持同模型自我编译，也支持跨模型规模与深度的强到弱迁移。文中还对比了全层解码与逐层生成，并进行机制分析。
AI.result: 六个视频问答基准上，0.8B 解释器自我编译时比全上下文读取高 1.7 分，由 9B 编译器编译时高 4.3 分；上下文从最多 8,192 个视觉 token 压缩到 64 个前缀 token，内存占用比视频 KV 缓存低 5.5 倍。生成权重在纯 token 压缩基础上额外提升 3.9 分；全层解码比逐层生成高 2.9 分。机制分析显示：有前缀 token 时，权重主要改变注意力 query 与 MLP down projection，用于引导检索并存储基线摘要；无 token 时，权重转向注意力输出投影，将视频内容直接写入残差流。
AI.conclusion: 视频信息可作为参数（LoRA 权重与前缀 token）编译进冻结的小型解释器模型，在显著降低显存与上下文长度的同时缩小大小模型的能力差距，并实现跨规模迁移；权重的作用位点随是否使用前缀 token 而系统性转移。

title: Dynamic Model Merging with Multi-Layer Aggregated Routing Evidence
summary: Dynamic model merging aims to retain the efficiency of a unified model while better preserving task-specific expertise through input-dependent routing at both the task and head levels. However, even the routing components of the state-of-the-art approach remain limited: the task routing is highly sensitive to the choice of routing layer, whereas the head routing relies on simple max-logit competition. To address these limitations, we propose multi-layer aggregated routing evidence (MATE) as a unified mechanism for improving both task and head routing. Specifically, we first introduce a metric to quantify task routing separability across different layers. Empirical analysis of this metric reveals that different layers provide complementary evidence for identifying the tasks relevant to an input. Motivated by this observation, MATE selects multiple informative layers according to their routing separability and aggregates their layer-wise routing scores to produce a more robust signal that can be directly used for task selection. Moreover, we observe that this signal also encodes useful information about the suitability of the corresponding classification heads. This motivates us to further combine the MATE signal with the max-logit score to guide classification head selection. Extensive experiments on vision benchmarks demonstrate that MATE consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出多层聚合路由证据（MATE）机制，通过选择路由可分性高的多个层并聚合其路由分数，统一改进动态模型合并中的任务路由与分类头路由。
AI.motivation: 现有动态模型合并（SOTA）的路由组件存在局限：任务路由对路由层选择高度敏感，头路由仅依赖简单的max-logit竞争，导致任务专业知识的保留不够稳健。
AI.method: 1）引入量化不同层任务路由可分性的指标；2）实证发现不同层提供互补的路由证据；3）MATE依据可分性挑选多个信息量高的层，聚合其逐层路由分数，形成更稳健的任务选择信号；4）观察到该信号同时编码了分类头适配性信息，故将MATE信号与max-logit分数结合以指导分类头选择。
AI.result: 在多个视觉基准上的大量实验表明，MATE持续取得SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 多层聚合路由证据是一种统一、有效的路由改进机制，可同时提升任务级与头级路由的稳健性与准确性。

title: Specification-Aware Sparse Differentiation: Planning under Signal Temporal Logic with Sparsemax Robustness
summary: Gradient-based optimal control under a Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specification involves solving a nonlinear program whose constraints are smoothed robustness functions of the trajectory, and automatic differentiation without knowledge of sparsity computes the Jacobian and the Hessian that its solver needs in full. This often renders the problem computationally intractable. The dynamics and the specification prescribe a sparsity pattern through the STL syntax, the windows of the temporal operators and the variables that the predicates read. Standard tools such as CasADi recover this pattern by structural detection. In this work, we propose a method to prescribe such a pattern directly from the task specification. We show that our method allows us to exploit SparseMax, a recently proposed smooth robustness operator that is certifiably sparse and sound. Its derivative is exactly zero at every operand at or below a data-dependent threshold, which structural detection cannot see. We derive the patterns that expose this trajectory-dependent sparsity to sparse automatic differentiation, with a margin test for their reuse and Hessians confined to the variables of each constraint's support. We demonstrate the method on a dual-arm coordination task in which two arms share a hand-off zone divided into cells and one until constraint per scheduled visit keeps the other arm out of a cell until the visitor has left it. The two scenes are a zone of five cells and a circle of 64 cells, with single solves and closed-loop re-planning on a rigid-body simulation. Our exact-Hessian interior-point solves are up to 27 times faster than those with the sound log-sum-exp robustness in CasADi and IPOPT.

AI.tldr: 提出从STL任务规范直接推导稀疏模式的方法，以利用可证明稀疏的SparseMax鲁棒性算子，实现稀疏自动微分与精确Hessian，在内点法求解中比基于log-sum-exp的基线快至多27倍。
AI.motivation: 基于梯度的STL最优控制需对平滑鲁棒性函数求解非线性规划，而无稀疏性感知的自动微分会计算完整Jacobian与Hessian，常使问题计算上不可解。CasADi等工具依靠结构检测恢复稀疏，但无法识别SparseMax在数据相关阈值处导数为零所产生的"轨迹相关稀疏性"。
AI.method: 从任务规范直接指定稀疏模式：利用STL语法、时序算子窗口及谓词读取的变量确定结构；推导能向稀疏自动微分暴露轨迹相关稀疏性的模式，引入边际检验以复用模式，并将Hessian限制于各约束支撑集内的变量。
AI.result: 在双臂协作任务（共享交接区划分为单元，每次调度访问对应一个until约束）上验证，场景含5单元区域与64单元圆环，覆盖单次求解与刚体仿真闭环重规划；精确Hessian内点法求解比CasADi与IPOPT中使用sound log-sum-exp鲁棒性快至多27倍。
AI.conclusion: 由规范驱动的稀疏模式可有效利用SparseMax的零导数稀疏性，显著提升STL最优控制求解效率，且边际检验保证模式复用的正确性。

title: When Wrong Answers Remain Unsettled: Failure Dynamics in Recurrent Reasoners
summary: When a recurrent reasoner returns a wrong answer, is its computation finished or merely stopped? We test this on a trained Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM; 27M parameters, Sudoku-Extreme) by running the recurrence for one more inference budget and comparing with an unperturbed control. Solved answers persist (0.95 of 512 endpoints). Wrong answers mostly do not: 0.42 of near-miss answers (n=170) and 0.18 of all 512 wrong endpoints keep their answer. Perturbations from 0.05x to 20x the terminal-update scale barely change these rates, so the measurement reflects continued recurrence, not noise sensitivity. The solved-above-wrong ordering also holds in five further settings (a second seed, TRM, Maze, GRAM-guided TRM, N-Queens), but a fixed 1/2 persistence threshold does not, and neither do HRM's endpoint-spectrum and fast-versus-slow predictability patterns, which are not universal diagnostics. Perturb-and-reselect (known from prior work) is consistent with this: frozen noise gains 4.8 accuracy points (197 gained, 2 lost), but compute-matched extended depth gains 5.6 and Sudoku symmetry augmentation 34.6, so noise is not the best use of the budget. Conclusions are limited to finite horizons and one primary HRM checkpoint; they do not exclude asymptotic attractors.

AI.tldr: 用"额外推理预算"实验区分循环推理模型的错误答案是"计算完成"还是"仅被停止"：正确答案高度持续，错误答案大多不持续，但固定阈值与HRM特有的诊断模式并不普适。
AI.motivation: 当循环推理器（recurrent reasoner）给出错误答案时，其计算究竟是真正收敛终止，还是仅因推理预算耗尽而被"截断"？这一区别关系到对模型推理过程的理解与测试时计算的用法。
AI.method: 在已训练的HRM（27M参数，Sudoku-Extreme）上，给定一个额外推理预算继续运行循环，并与未扰动对照组比较答案持续性；扰动幅度取终端更新尺度的0.05x–20x以排除噪声敏感性；另在5个设置（第二随机种子、TRM、Maze、GRAM引导的TRM、N-Queens）上检验结论稳健性；并对比扰动-重选、等算力加深循环、Sudoku对称性增强三种预算用法。
AI.result: 正确解持续率高（512个端点中0.95保持）；错误答案大多不持续：近失错误（n=170）仅0.42保持，全部512个错误端点仅0.18保持；扰动幅度几乎不改变这些比率。"正确持久性高于错误"的排序在五个额外设置中均成立，但固定1/2持续性阈值、HRM的端点谱与快慢可预测性模式并不普适。冻结噪声带来+4.8准确率（197增2损），等算力加深循环+5.6，Sudoku对称性增强+34.6。
AI.conclusion: 错误答案多是"被停止"而非"已完成"，而正确答案是稳定收敛点；但持续性作为诊断工具需依赖相对排序而非绝对阈值，且HRM的端点谱/快慢模式非通用诊断。噪声扰动并非预算的最佳用法（不及加深循环与对称性增强）。结论限于有限时域与单一主HRM检查点，未排除渐近吸引子。

title: A Closed-Form Temporal Readout for Surgical Triplet Recognition
summary: Surgical triplet recognition requires identifying which instrument performs which action on which anatomical target, and following these interactions as they unfold over time. The task is challenging because several triplets can occur at once, their components span very different durations, and the evidence for an interaction is rarely complete in a single frame. We introduce STRIDE, a post-hoc temporal readout that adds temporal context to any trained recogniser. It averages the recogniser's features and logits over a few fixed temporal windows and combines them with the current frame through ridge regression, solved in closed form on a CPU. Applied as a plug-and-play readout to nine existing methods, STRIDE improves $AP_{IVT}$ in 24 of 27 method-dataset pairs, by up to 7.4 points. Moreover, we propose a simple pipeline consisting of an adapted foundation vision encoder with a linear classifier and STRIDE. Across thirteen encoders, STRIDE improves 37 of 39 encoder-dataset pairs by up to 7.2 points. STRIDE reduces false alarms by 41%, at the cost of a slower response at interaction boundaries. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出STRIDE，一种即插即用的后处理时序读出模块，通过多尺度时间窗特征/逻辑值平均与岭回归融合当前帧，在CPU上闭式求解，显著提升手术三元组识别性能并降低误报。
AI.motivation: 手术三元组识别需要判断"哪个器械对哪个解剖目标执行何种动作"并跟踪其时序演变。难点在于：多个三元组同时发生、各组分持续时间差异极大、单帧证据往往不完整。现有识别器缺乏时序上下文建模。
AI.method: 提出STRIDE（后置时序读出）：对任意已训练识别器的特征与logits在若干固定时间窗上做平均，再与当前帧通过岭回归融合，在CPU上以闭式解求解；同时给出由适配的视觉基础编码器+线性分类器+STRIDE组成的简洁流水线。
AI.result: 作为即插即用读出模块应用于9种现有方法，27个方法-数据集组合中24个提升AP_IVT，最高提升7.4点；在13个编码器的线性探针实验中，39个编码器-数据集组合中37个提升，最高7.2点；误报减少41%，代价是交互边界处响应变慢。
AI.conclusion: 轻量、通用的后置时序融合能有效补充现有手术三元组识别器的时序上下文，泛化性强且易部署；主要局限为边界响应延迟。

title: PhyMind: Physics-Informed Masked Autoencoding for EEG Foundation Models
summary: EEG foundation models are pre-trained almost exclusively with masked reconstruction through a free-form decoder, sometimes with hand-crafted spectral targets added, as in MANAS-2. We study what happens when that decoder is replaced by a generative forward model of EEG. PhyMind keeps a standard masked transformer encoder, but its decoder must explain the masked signal through 68 cortical regions, each driven by damped stochastic oscillators and an aperiodic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process, projected to the recording's own montage by a fixed boundary-element lead field evaluated per derivation. Training combines masked reconstruction with a Whittle spectral likelihood, an oscillator-dynamics residual, a minimum-norm source prior and a penalised neural residual. In a controlled comparison (same encoder, data, steps and seed), the physics decoder produces encoder tokens whose spectral content is far more linearly decodable than with a masked-autoencoder decoder or with the MANAS-2 objective: mean R^2 on a token-level spectral probe with amplitude-normalised targets is 0.67/0.77/0.77 on three datasets, against 0.24/0.50/0.50 (MAE) and 0.48/0.67/0.66 (MANAS-2 objective), approaching the released 92.8M-parameter MANAS-2 (0.71/0.81/0.80). Downstream gains in the controlled setting are small (four-task mean balanced accuracy 56.6 vs. 53.8 for MAE frozen, 63.8 vs. 62.7 fine-tuned). Region-level features from the physics decoder raise frozen four-class motor-imagery accuracy by 7-14 points, so a 7.2M-parameter model pre-trained on 3k hours of open EEG is comparable to the released MANAS-2 with frozen features (63.0 vs. 61.6). After full fine-tuning, MANAS-2 remains better (66.8 vs. 65.4 for our best model). The inferred sources do not reproduce the lateralisation that a classical inverse solution finds in motor imagery, so we do not claim anatomical interpretability. Code and weights are released.

AI.tldr: 提出PhyMind：用EEG生成式前向模型（68个皮层区域×阻尼随机振子+非周期OU过程，经固定BEM导联场投影到记录montage）替代free-form解码器，使掩码transformer编码器的token频谱线性可解码性显著提升，小模型冻结特征可逼近MANAS-2，但下游微调增益有限且未获解剖可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG基础模型几乎只用掩码重建+自由形式解码器（MANAS-2仅附手工谱目标），缺乏对EEG物理生成机制的归纳偏置；作者想探究把解码器换成EEG生成式前向模型后，编码器表征会发生什么变化。
AI.method: 保留标准掩码transformer编码器，解码器需通过68个皮层区域解释被掩码信号：每区域由阻尼随机振子+非周期Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程驱动，经逐导联（per derivation）计算的固定边界元导联场投影到记录自身montage。训练目标为掩码重建+Whittle谱似然+振子动力学残差+最小范数源先验+惩罚项神经残差；与MAE解码器、MANAS-2目标在相同编码器、数据、步数、种子下受控对比。
AI.result: token级谱探针（幅度归一化目标）平均R²为0.67/0.77/0.77（三数据集），优于MAE（0.24/0.50/0.50）与MANAS-2目标（0.48/0.67/0.66），接近已发布的9280万参数MANAS-2（0.71/0.81/0.80）。受控设置下四任务平均平衡准确率56.6 vs 53.8（MAE冻结）、63.8 vs 62.7（微调）。区域级特征使冻结四类运动想象准确率提升7–14点；720万参数、3k小时开放EEG预训练模型冻结特征63.0 vs MANAS-2 61.6；全微调后MANAS-2更优（66.8 vs 65.4）。推断源未复现经典逆解在运动想象中的偏侧化。
AI.conclusion: 物理生成式解码器能显著改善编码器token的频谱可解码性，并以小得多的参数量在冻结特征下接近MANAS-2，但下游微调收益有限；无法声称解剖可解释性。代码与权重已开源。

title: Contact Harness: Enabling VLM Agents to Perform Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Agents built on pretrained VLMs have demonstrated zero-shot control of real robots, but vision alone is often insufficient for reliable contact-state assessment in contact-rich manipulation. Force and tactile feedback provide complementary information, but their semantic ambiguity makes them difficult for agents to use directly. These signals must be interpreted according to their physical meaning, together with task phase and visual evidence. We propose Contact Harness, which uses reusable, optimized skills to guide a VLM agent in assessing contact states from multimodal feedback and selecting subsequent actions. A compliant execution mechanism regulates in-contact motions using real-time force feedback. The framework requires no model fine-tuning, task demonstrations, or simulation training. We conduct zero-shot real-robot evaluations using GPT-6 Astra on Rokae and Franka robots. With a single prompt skill, Contact Harness achieves a full-insertion rate of 90.7% across 15 connector types, with further evaluations on a real PC under variations in lighting, background, and position. Across four additional contact-rich tasks, including whiteboard wiping, writing, peeling, and pivoting, Contact Harness achieves an average success rate of 100%. On six simulated tasks, Contact Harness reaches 96.7% success, compared with at most 68.3% for pretrained VLA baselines fine-tuned on task demonstrations, showing the potential of agent-based manipulation for contact-rich real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出 Contact Harness 框架，用可复用的优化技能引导 VLM 智能体融合力/触觉、任务阶段与视觉信息判断接触状态并选动作，配合基于实时力反馈的柔顺执行机制，无需微调、示范或仿真训练，即在真实机器人零样本完成高成功率接触丰富操作。
AI.motivation: 基于预训练 VLM 的智能体已能零样本控制真实机器人，但纯视觉在接触丰富操作中难以可靠判断接触状态；力与触觉信号虽提供互补信息，却存在语义歧义，智能体难以直接使用，需结合物理含义、任务阶段与视觉证据进行解读。
AI.method: Contact Harness：以可复用、经优化的"提示技能"（prompt skill）引导 VLM 智能体依据多模态反馈评估接触状态并选择后续动作；同时引入柔顺执行机制，利用实时力反馈调节接触中的运动。整个框架不依赖模型微调、任务示范或仿真训练。
AI.result: 在 Rokae 与 Franka 机器人上用 GPT-6 Astra 进行零样本真机评测：单条提示技能下，15 种连接器类型的完全插入率达 90.7%，并在真实 PC 上验证了光照、背景与位置变化下的鲁棒性；在擦白板、书写、剥离、支点旋转四项接触丰富任务上平均成功率 100%；六项仿真任务成功率 96.7%，而经任务示范微调的预训练 VLA 基线最高仅 68.3%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将可复用优化技能与多模态接触状态推理结合、并以柔顺控制兜底，可在零样本条件下实现高可靠接触丰富操作，显著优于示范微调的 VLA 基线，展示了智能体式操作在真实世界部署中的潜力。

title: Learning from Another Angle: Rotation-Based Test-Time Training for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on vision-language tasks but often remain vulnerable to distribution shifts due to their fixed parameters during inference. While Test-Time Training (TTT) offers a pathway for dynamic adaptation, existing approaches suffer from prohibitive computational overhead due to multiple sampling and the risk of error reinforcement from biased self-generated supervision. In light of this view, we propose RoTTT (Rotation-based Test-Time Training), a simple and efficient TTT approach that enables instance-specific refinement at inference time. For each test instance, RoTTT performs a small number of gradient updates by predicting the rotation angle of the input image. The known rotation angles naturally serve as a reliable self-supervised signal, enabling lightweight and stable adaptation without requiring additional annotations. Extensive experiments across multiple vision-language benchmarks demonstrate that RoTTT consistently improves performance across different MLLMs, providing a practical and efficient paradigm for on-the-fly MLLM adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出RoTTT：一种基于图像旋转角度预测的测试时训练方法，以极少的梯度更新实现MLLM的实例级自适应，计算开销低且自监督信号可靠。
AI.motivation: MLLM推理阶段参数固定，对分布偏移鲁棒性不足；现有测试时训练方法因多次采样导致计算开销巨大，且自生成伪标签存在偏差、易引发错误累积强化。
AI.method: RoTTT对每个测试实例执行少量梯度更新，训练任务是预测输入图像的旋转角度；真实旋转角度作为天然可靠的自监督信号，无需额外标注，实现轻量、稳定的在线自适应。
AI.result: 在多个视觉-语言基准上，RoTTT在不同MLLM上均能一致提升性能，验证其有效性与效率。
AI.conclusion: RoTTT为MLLM提供了一种实用、高效的即时自适应范式，兼顾低开销与稳定性，可作为通用的测试时增强方案。

title: DeFlowCritic: Dense Latent Reward Alignment for Text-to-Image Flow Matching Models
summary: Online reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for aligning text-to-image flow matching models with complex user intent. However, existing methods typically rely on sparse rewards computed only from final decoded images. This delays credit assignment across the denoising trajectory and makes training computationally expensive. Moreover, simply combining multiple rewards does not reliably produce a Pareto trade-off, where gains in compositional accuracy often degrade aesthetic quality. In this work, we propose DeFlowCritic, an efficient online RL framework based on Dense Latent Reward Alignment. Unlike prior work, our method provides dense supervision on intermediate latents, enabling early-stage guidance for the denoising trajectory. To achieve this, we introduce an internal critic that evaluates noisy latents using features extracted directly from the diffusion model, a representation inherently better suited for latent-space reward estimation than standard image encoders. We construct a high-quality reward-modeling dataset with continuous scores for critic training, capturing compositional correctness on high-quality reference images. The resulting dense reward enables efficient online RL training and inference-time scaling. Experiments show that our method achieves a superior balance between prompt faithfulness and visual quality on GenEval2 and T2I-CompBench++ benchmarks. The approach also generalizes across text-to-image flow matching models, including SD3.5-Medium, SD3.5-Large, and FLUX.1-dev.

AI.tldr: 提出DeFlowCritic——基于密集隐空间奖励对齐的高效在线强化学习框架，通过在中间隐变量上提供密集监督并构建内部critic，实现更优的提示词忠实度与视觉质量权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有在线RL方法仅依赖最终解码图像的稀疏奖励，导致去噪轨迹上的信用分配延迟且训练开销大；同时简单叠加多个奖励无法可靠获得Pareto权衡，构图准确性提升往往牺牲美学质量。
AI.method: (1) 在中间隐变量上提供密集监督，实现去噪轨迹的早期引导；(2) 引入内部critic，直接利用扩散模型自身的特征评估带噪隐变量，该表征比标准图像编码器更适合隐空间奖励估计；(3) 构建带连续分数的高质量奖励建模数据集训练critic，捕捉高质量参考图像上的构图正确性；(4) 所得密集奖励同时支持高效在线RL训练与推理时扩展。
AI.result: 在GenEval2与T2I-CompBench++基准上，方法在提示词忠实度与视觉质量之间取得更优平衡，并泛化至SD3.5-Medium、SD3.5-Large与FLUX.1-dev等多种文本到图像流匹配模型。
AI.conclusion: 以扩散模型特征为内部critic的密集隐空间奖励对齐，可有效解决稀疏奖励导致的信用分配延迟与多奖励权衡问题，是一种高效且可跨模型迁移的在线RL对齐方案。

title: Interaction Retention and Output-Likelihood Training in Parallel Sampling
comment: 44 pages (35-page paper followed by a 9-page online appendix), 3 figures. Submitted to the Journal of Machine Learning Research
summary: Parallel samplers such as masked diffusion language models generate several coordinates per step from conditional marginals and randomize which coordinates are generated together, so even exact conditionals return a distorted distribution. We give an exact local account of this distortion. Around any full-support product law, the Gram operator of the sampler's response is diagonal in the interaction decomposition, and its eigenvalues are retention probabilities: the probability that an interaction has a unique latest-revealed coordinate. This retention spectrum determines the exact frontier between output accuracy and conditional calibration, its regularization path, and the population response of finite-mixture likelihood training. For pairwise interactions it yields a sharp dichotomy. Under homogeneous retention, output-likelihood training is equivalent to a single context gain; heterogeneous retention opens correction directions beyond any scalar, with an advantage bounded by an explicit heterogeneity gap. On binarized digits and MNIST, output-likelihood training within a heterogeneous schedule library lowers calibrated test negative log-likelihood in all twelve paired comparisons, and the gain survives pair-specific recalibration and a stronger path optimizer. For a frozen 169.6-million-parameter masked diffusion language model, serially normalized context gains are 1.070 and 1.056 at 8 and 16 rounds, against the predicted values 1.134 and 1.058.

AI.tldr: 论文从理论上精确刻画了并行采样器（如掩码扩散语言模型）因同时生成多个坐标并随机化分组而产生的分布扭曲：在全支撑乘积律附近，采样器响应的Gram算子在交互分解下对角化，其特征值为"保留概率"（某交互拥有唯一最晚被揭示坐标的概率）。该保留谱精确决定了输出精度与条件校准之间的边界、其正则化路径以及有限混合似然训练的总体响应。
AI.motivation: 并行采样器每步依据条件边缘生成多个坐标，并随机化哪些坐标被一起生成，因此即便条件分布精确，输出分布仍被扭曲。已有工作缺乏对这种扭曲的精确、局部化的理论刻画，难以为训练与校准提供原则性指导。
AI.method: 在任意全支撑乘积律附近进行局部展开，利用交互分解（interaction decomposition）证明采样器响应的Gram算子对角化，其特征值解释为交互的保留概率，从而提出"保留谱"框架；据此分析输出精度与条件校准的精确边界、正则化路径，以及有限混合似然训练的总体响应。进一步对成对交互情形做分类分析，区分同质与异质保留。实验在二值化数字与MNIST上比较输出似然训练，并考察成对特定重校准与更强路径优化器；另在冻结的1.696亿参数掩码扩散语言模型上验证串行归一化上下文增益。
AI.result: 对成对交互得到清晰二分：同质保留下，输出似然训练等价于单一上下文增益（context gain）；异质保留下则打开超出任何标量的修正方向，其收益受显式的异质性间隙上界约束。实验中，在同质/异质调度库内进行输出似然训练，在全部十二组成对比较中均降低了校准测试负对数似然，且增益在成对特定重校准和更强路径优化器下依然存在。冻结的1.696亿参数掩码扩散模型上，8轮与16轮的串行归一化上下文增益分别为1.070与1.056，与预测值1.134与1.058相符。
AI.conclusion: 保留谱为并行采样器的分布扭曲提供了精确的局部理论，统一解释了校准—精度权衡、正则化与混合似然训练的响应，并在成对交互层面给出标量修正是否充分的判据；实验验证了理论预测的上下文增益与实际训练收益，说明基于保留异质性的校准修正具有实用价值。

title: Self-Refining VLA Sampling
comment: Accepted to the CoRL 2026 Learn@Deploy Workshop
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models typically use flow-based generative modeling to learn a rich, often multimodal, distribution of robot actions. Generating samples from flow-based methods involves iteratively updating random noise, and distinct noise samples from the same state can result in distinct trajectories and task outcomes. Existing test-time scaling methods improve action chunk generation via selection, aggregation, or correction, but commonly require the generation of large ensembles of candidates or the training of an external corrector. We adapt Predict-and-Perturb (P&P), a self-refinement procedure for flow-based models originally used for mode-seeking in video generation, to the robotics domain. We find that applying P&P to VLA models requires modifications to the refinement process used in video generation due to differences in the underlying structure of the data. Across 400 episodes of LIBERO evaluated using SmolVLA, P&P improves upon the stock baseline by 5.3 percentage points. Further, episode-level P\&P uncertainty correlates strongly with task failure (AUC 0.851).

AI.tldr: 将视频生成中的Predict-and-Perturb（P&P）自精炼方法适配到VLA机械臂动作生成，改造后可在不训练外部修正器的情况下提升SmolVLA在LIBERO上的成功率，并给出与失败强相关的不确定性指标。
AI.motivation: VLA模型多用flow-based生成建模动作分布，采样需迭代去噪，同一状态不同噪声样本会产生不同轨迹与任务结果，存在多模态退化与结果不稳定的问题。现有测试时扩展方法（选择、聚合、修正）依赖大规模候选集成或额外训练修正器，成本高。
AI.method: 把原本用于视频生成中mode-seeking的Predict-and-Perturb自精炼流程迁移至机器人领域；由于动作数据与视频数据底层结构不同，对精炼过程作出针对性修改；在SmolVLA+LIBERO上做评测，并统计episode级P&P不确定性。
AI.result: 400个LIBERO episode上，P&P相对标准基线提升5.3个百分点；episode级P&P不确定性与任务失败的AUC为0.851，表明其可作为失败预测信号。
AI.conclusion: P&P是一种无需外部修正器、无需大候选集的动作生成自精炼方案，可同时带来性能提升与可用的不确定性估计；但实验规模限于单一模型（SmolVLA）与单一基准（LIBERO），跨模型与真实机器人泛化性仍待验证。

title: Do You Even Know What I Want? Improving LLMs Ability to Detect Hidden User Intent
summary: As with conventional AI agents, a common source of misalignment between Large Language Models (LLMs) and their human users is misspecified goals. Often, this happens when the human has skewed beliefs about the system's model and provides it with information that causes behavior different from what they expected, with potentially unwanted side effects. To ensure goal alignment, one solution would be for the LLM to ask the human questions about their objectives. However, it has been well-documented that LLMs most often provide default responses to user requests rather than try and ask questions to clarify their true intent. In this paper, we address these challenges by adapting a novel formulation for the objective misspecification problem to work with LLMs. We then test if LLMs that are prompted to ask questions about a user's true underlying objectives are better at identifying them compared to those that do not. We evaluate our method using four state-of-the-art LLMs tested on five standard IPC domains, showing that for some domains, asking questions greatly improved model performance.

AI.tldr: 本文将目标设定错误问题重新形式化以适配大语言模型，并实验检验"主动提问"能否提升LLM对用户真实目标的识别能力；在五个标准IPC领域上测试四个先进LLM，部分领域提问显著提升表现。
AI.motivation: LLM与人类用户不对齐的常见根源是目标设定不当：当用户对系统模型持有偏差信念时，所给信息会导致系统产生非预期行为甚至不良副作用。理论上LLM应通过提问澄清用户意图来保证目标对齐，但已有文献表明LLM倾向于对用户请求给出默认式回应，而非主动提问澄清真实意图。
AI.method: 作者将一种新的目标误设定问题形式化方法改造为适用于LLM的版本，据此构建实验：提示部分LLM就用户真实潜在目标进行提问，并与不提问的基线模型对比，评估其对真实目标的识别效果。实验在五个标准IPC规划领域上进行，覆盖四个当前最先进的LLM。
AI.result: 实验显示，在部分领域中，主动提问大幅提升了模型性能，说明提问机制对目标识别有效；但在另一些领域提升并不明显，表明效果具有领域依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 将目标误设定形式化引入LLM可行，主动提问是缓解目标不对齐的有效手段之一，但其收益随领域而异，尚非普适性解决方案；LLM默认应答而非提问的倾向仍是需要克服的核心障碍。

title: eSPG: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Event Speckle Plethysmography
summary: Non-contact measurement of vital signs such as heart rate (HR) is valuable for patient monitoring and rescue operations. However, existing methods struggle with ambient illumination and motion, and have been demonstrated only at distances of tens of meters. Here we introduce event speckle plethysmography (eSPG), which illuminates a body part with a low-power (0.5-5 mW) laser and captures the resulting dynamic speckle pattern using an event camera. Event cameras, with their high dynamic range, temporal resolution, and sensitivity to intensity changes, are well-suited to capturing rapid speckle fluctuations that encode the physiological signal, even under challenging illumination and imaging conditions. We demonstrate HR estimation at 1 km with a mean absolute error of 5 beats per minute, and 90% of estimates satisfy an AAMI-defined HR estimation criterion. This distance exceeds previous remote plethysmography demonstrations by an order of magnitude and previous speckle plethysmography demonstrations by over three orders of magnitude. We also study and characterize robustness to motion and ambient illumination. Our theoretical analysis and experimental results demonstrate that resolving dynamic speckle fluctuations enables accurate heart rate estimation even at kilometer-scale distances, establishing a new direction toward robust, non-contact physiological monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出事件散斑体积描记术（eSPG）：用低功率激光照射身体部位并以事件相机捕捉动态散斑，在1 km 距离实现心率估计，MAE 5 bpm，90% 估计满足AAMI标准。
AI.motivation: 非接触生命体征（如心率）测量对病人监护与救援有价值，但现有方法受环境光照与运动干扰，且仅在数十米距离上验证，远距离鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 用低功率（0.5–5 mW）激光照射身体部位，产生动态散斑图案；采用事件相机（高动态范围、高时间分辨率、对强度变化敏感）捕捉编码生理信号的快速散斑波动，并结合理论分析刻画对运动和环境光照的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在1 km距离实现心率估计，平均绝对误差5 bpm，90%的估计满足AAMI心率估计准则；测距较以往远程体积描记提升一个数量级，较散斑体积描记提升三个数量级以上；实验与理论共同验证了对运动和光照的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 解析动态散斑波动可在千米级距离上实现准确心率估计，为鲁棒、非接触生理监测开辟新方向。

title: MolReJev: Decision Models Are In-Context Molecular Predictors
summary: Molecular prediction helps prioritize compounds for screening. Specialized predictors are trained for a fixed set of tasks, limiting cross-task generalization. Language models can condition on task descriptions and have recently shown promise in molecular prediction. However, generating answers token by token adds inference cost, and general-purpose models often lack task-specific molecular knowledge. We thus propose MolReJev, which combines Jev-style candidate scoring with in-context learning (ICL) on a language model. MolReJev retrieves similar labeled examples from existing task data and scores candidate labels jointly in one forward pass. ICL improves predictions from the released general-purpose Kev checkpoint and the separately trained MolReJev. For the trained model, gains span all evaluation groups, including held-out tasks, and extend to compounds absent from training. MolReJev generally outperforms MolecularGPT on matched evaluations and nearest-neighbor prediction with the same examples. With four examples, MolReJev and a trained text baseline achieve similar ROC-AUC, with higher measured throughput for MolReJev. These results show that decision models can serve as in-context molecular predictors for compounds, drug pairs, and reactions.

AI.tldr: 提出MolReJev：将候选标签联合打分机制与上下文学习（ICL）结合，实现可就任务描述泛化的分子预测器。
AI.motivation: 专用预测器受限于固定任务集合，难以跨任务泛化；语言模型逐token生成推理成本高，且通用模型缺乏任务特定分子知识。
AI.method: MolReJev在语言模型上以ICL方式从已有任务数据中检索相似标注示例，并在一次前向传播中对候选标签进行联合打分（Jev式候选评分），而非逐token生成答案。
AI.result: ICL提升了通用Kev检查点与单独训练的MolReJev的预测；训练模型在全部评估组（含留出任务）上均有增益，并泛化到训练中未出现的化合物；在匹配评估上总体优于MolecularGPT与同示例的最近邻预测；四示例设置下ROC-AUC与训练文本基线相当，但实测吞吐更高。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型可作为化合物、药物对与化学反应的上下文分子预测器。

title: Phase-Conditioned Action Contracts for Auditable Microsurgical Control
summary: Staged robotic procedures may reuse a fixed-dimensional policy output even though the admissible motions and physical meanings of its coordinates change across phases. We call this action-semantic shift. To address it, we propose a phase-conditioned executable policy that separates learned action proposal from deterministic command formation. Phase-specific heads generate proposals, while an action contract removes inadmissible components, enforces state-dependent bounds, and decodes the remaining action into phase-dependent task-space commands. We further introduce failure-focused local repair and a read-only provenance trace for exact command replay and rule-level auditing. Across three held-out retinal-injection evaluation blocks, our method achieves $94.27\pm0.64\%$ procedural completion and $64.40\pm2.43\%$ success within $35\,μ\mathrm{m}$, with no hard violations. Applying the contract and decoder to the same frozen Correction network raises completion from $12.27\%$ to $90.47\%$. The trace exactly reconstructs 96,350 commands, and all 1,996 binding interventions follow their declared effects. These results show the importance of explicit executable action semantics for auditable staged microsurgical control.

AI.tldr: 提出阶段条件可执行策略，将动作提议与确定性指令生成解耦，通过"动作契约"消除阶段间动作语义漂移，实现可审计的分阶段视网膜注射机器人控制。
AI.motivation: 分阶段机器人手术中，固定维度的策略输出在各阶段被复用，但可允许的运动与坐标物理含义随阶段变化，作者称之为"动作语义漂移"（action-semantic shift），直接复用会导致不可执行或不安全指令。
AI.method: 将学习式动作提议与确定性指令构造分离：阶段专用头生成动作提议，动作契约模块剔除不可允许分量、施加状态相关边界约束，并将剩余动作解码为阶段相关的任务空间指令；辅以面向失败的局部修复与只读溯源轨迹（支持指令精确回放与规则级审计）。
AI.result: 在三个留出的视网膜注射评估块上，流程完成率94.27±0.64%，35 μm内成功率64.40±2.43%，无硬性违规；将契约与解码器接至同一冻结的Correction网络，完成率由12.27%升至90.47%；轨迹精确重建96,350条指令，1,996次约束性干预均符合声明效果。
AI.conclusion: 显式可执行动作语义对可审计的分阶段显微外科控制至关重要，解耦式契约设计能显著提升安全性与完成率并提供可回放审计能力。

title: The Retry Tax: Why Static Same-Task Retries Can Cost More per Completion
summary: Retrying an agent after failure can complete more tasks while increasing the cost per completion. We study a static policy that stops at verified success or an attempt cap and otherwise resets the original prompt and workspace without passing feedback to the next request. Under stationary task success probabilities, independent attempts conditional on the task, and a common attempt cost, easier tasks tend to succeed earlier. When task success probabilities differ, the unresolved mix shifts toward harder tasks. Specializing classical survivor selection, we show that cost per completion is at least as high as in one-shot serving and that marginal cost per additional completion is nondecreasing wherever the completion increments are positive. These are different quantities: one averages spending over all completions, while the other prices the completions added by another attempt. We then arrange each task's existing benchmark runs in different orders, stop each sequence at verified success or the attempt cap, and average the resulting completion and spending at each supported cap. For one OpenHands configuration, replay estimates completion of 59.7 percent with one attempt and 70.0 percent with four, while cost per completion rises from about USD 0.70 to USD 1.32. The recorded trade-off describes fixed configurations on the available tasks. Choosing a cap requires comparing the additional spending with the application's value for the additional completions.

AI.tldr: 论文研究智能体失败后"重置原始提示与工作区、不传递反馈"的静态重试策略，证明重试会提高每次完成的成本，且边际成本随重试次数非递减，并用OpenHands基准数据回放量化了完成率与成本的权衡。
AI.motivation: 重试失败任务能提升任务完成量，但也会增加成本。作者希望厘清"每次完成成本"与"额外完成量的边际成本"这两个不同量的性质，为设定尝试上限（attempt cap）提供依据。
AI.method: 在任务成功概率平稳、给定任务下各次尝试独立、单次尝试成本相同的假设下，建立静态策略模型（成功验证即停止，或达到尝试上限即停止，否则重置提示与工作区、不传反馈）；借用并特化经典survivor selection理论分析未完成任务池向难任务漂移的现象；再利用基准中已有运行记录，对不同排列顺序回放并按各上限平均统计完成率与花费。
AI.result: 成本分析表明每次完成成本不低于一次性服务（one-shot serving），且在完成量增量为正的区间内，额外完成的边际成本非递减；二者含义不同：前者对所有完成量平均花费，后者为多一次尝试新增完成量的定价。OpenHands某配置回放显示：1次尝试完成率59.7%、每次完成约0.70美元；4次尝试完成率70.0%、每次完成约1.32美元。
AI.conclusion: 所记录的权衡仅描述固定配置在现有任务上的表现；确定尝试上限需将额外支出与应用对额外完成量的价值进行比较，而不能仅依据平均成本。

title: Learning a Rule Bank to Revise 3D CT Reports with Independent Evidence
summary: Vision--language models can generate fluent radiology reports from 3D chest CT scans, yet they may still omit abnormalities or misstate findings. Independent image analysis using models separate from the report model provides additional observations, but acting on uncertain evidence may introduce new errors. We propose an agent system that learns a revision policy represented as an executable rule bank for each report model. Inspired by experience banks, the agent proposes and refines rules using revision outcomes across development cases. During inference, the retained rules guide local edits using independent classifier predictions and quantitative image measurements without retraining the report model. Unedited sentences are preserved, and each change is linked to the rule that triggered it. On CT-RATE, revision increases CE-F1 by 11.5 points for SelfCue-KD and 0.9 points for NV-Reason-CT, with gains across five draft-sampling seeds. SelfCue-KD's CT-FineBench score also increases by 15.2 points. Draft-only rule learning yields limited gains, while the two image-evidence sources provide complementary benefits for abnormality detection. Measurements also supply numerical details missing from the drafts. These results support learning model-specific rules to control how independent image evidence informs report revision. Code is available at https://github.com/renjie-liang/CT-RuleBank.

AI.tldr: 提出一种智能体系统，为每个报告模型学习可执行规则库形式的修订策略，在推理时利用独立图像证据（分类器预测与定量测量）指导局部编辑，无需重训报告模型，在CT-RATE上显著提升CE-F1与CT-FineBench分数。
AI.motivation: 3D胸部CT的视觉-语言模型虽能生成流畅的放射报告，但可能遗漏异常或错误陈述发现。引入独立于报告模型的图像分析可提供额外观察，但盲目依据不确定证据反而引入新错误，因此需要一种能控制外部证据如何影响报告修订的机制。
AI.method: 提出智能体系统，类似经验库（experience bank），在开发集病例上通过修订结果反馈迭代地提出与精炼规则，最终形成每个报告模型专属的可执行规则库。推理阶段，保留的规则结合独立分类器预测与定量图像测量来指导局部编辑；未编辑句子保持原样，每处修改均链接到触发的规则，且无需重新训练报告模型。
AI.result: 在CT-RATE上，修订使SelfCue-KD的CE-F1提升11.5点、NV-Reason-CT提升0.9点，且在五个草稿采样种子上均有增益；SelfCue-KD的CT-FineBench分数提升15.2点。仅用草稿进行规则学习收益有限，而两种图像证据来源在异常检测上提供互补效益，测量还补充了草稿缺失的数值细节。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，学习模型专属规则可有效控制独立图像证据如何影响报告修订，兼顾纠错收益与避免引入新错误；两类图像证据相互补充，验证了外部证据受控纳入框架的有效性。

title: Global Stability and Loss Convergence in Matrix Factorization
summary: We study the matrix factorization objective $\mathcal L(X,Y)=f(XY)$ for convex, twice continuously differentiable output losses with bounded and Lipschitz gradient and a minimizing set that is compact modulo specified input and output invariances. This includes the well-known cross entropy loss. We prove that a positive learning-rate threshold guarantees bounded parameters, summability of squared gradients, and convergence of the loss from every finite initialization. The proof constructs a quantity from the imbalance between parameter matrices that decreases over every step of the gradient descent trajectory.

AI.tldr: 研究矩阵分解目标 L(X,Y)=f(XY)（f 为凸、二阶连续可微、梯度有界且 Lipschitz、极小集在输入输出不变性下紧），证明存在正的学习率阈值，保证梯度下降参数有界、平方梯度可和、损失收敛。
AI.motivation: 矩阵分解（如深度线性网络、交叉熵损失下的分解形式）在非凸优化中广泛出现，但其梯度下降的全局收敛性缺少一般性保证；本文旨在给出适用于一整类输出损失（含交叉熵）的收敛条件。
AI.method: 对 L(X,Y)=f(XY) 的梯度下降轨迹进行分析：利用极小集在输入/输出不变性（如正交/尺度变换）下紧的假设，构造一个刻画 X 与 Y 之间"不平衡度"(imbalance) 的量，并证明该量在每一步梯度下降中单调不增，从而导出参数有界性与平方梯度可和性。
AI.result: 证明存在正的学习率阈值：只要学习率不超过该阈值，从任意有限初值出发，参数保持有界、平方梯度序列可和、损失函数收敛；结论对交叉熵损失等凸光滑输出损失成立。
AI.conclusion: 为矩阵分解类非凸问题的梯度下降提供了统一的收敛性刻画，其核心是不平衡度单调递减这一 Lyapunov 型论证；后续工作可据此分析收敛速率与更一般的分解结构。

title: What Test-Time Training Corrects in Latent World Models? A Slow-Fast Approach
summary: Latent world models plan toward a goal by predicting the outcomes of candidate actions, but under the distribution shift, prediction errors can lead the planner astray. Test-time training using executed actions helps, yet what it corrects and whether its updates should persist across episodes remains unclear. We address both by analyzing the world model's prediction error. On PushObj, an object-pushing task, we probe multiple actions from the same state and decompose the error into an offset shared across actions and an action-dependent component. The offset effectively shifts the planner's goal, and AdaJEPA mainly tracks it: the common shift alone recovers 91% of its planning gain. Part of the offset is episode-specific, so carrying its correction into the next episode does not help and may even hurt. The remaining offset recurs across episodes and action-dependent error can be or needs to be learned and retained from many episodes. Our sft-JEPA therefore uses two learners on different timescales: a fast learner that tracks the offset and resets each episode, and a slow LoRA learner that accumulates recurring knowledge across episodes. Across PushObj, PointMaze, zero-shot planning on RoboCasa (with DINO-WM), and OGBench (with LeWAM), sft-JEPA leads all benchmark averages, improving planning success over AdaJEPA by up to 22 points.

AI.tldr: 论文通过分解世界模型预测误差（跨动作共享偏移 + 动作相关成分），指出偏移才是AdaJEPA测试时训练的主要收益来源，且部分偏移情节特异地不应跨episode保留；据此提出sft-JEPA，用快速学习器（每episode重置、追踪偏移）与慢速LoRA学习器（跨episode累积知识）双时间尺度校正。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型通过预测候选动作结果来规划，但分布偏移下预测误差会使规划器偏离目标。基于执行动作的测试时训练虽有效，却缺乏分析：它究竟纠正了什么、其更新是否应跨episode持久化，均不清楚。
AI.method: 在PushObj推物任务上，对同一状态探测多组动作，将预测误差分解为跨动作共享的offset与动作相关成分，并考察其情节特异性。据此设计sft-JEPA：快速学习器追踪offset并在每个episode重置，慢速LoRA学习器跨episode累积可复现的offset与动作相关误差知识。
AI.result: 共享偏移单独即可恢复AdaJEPA约91%的规划增益；偏移中情节特异部分跨episode迁移无益甚至有害，而可复现偏移与动作相关误差需长期学习保留。在PushObj、PointMaze、RoboCasa零样本规划（DINO-WM）与OGBench（LeWAM）上，sft-JEPA在各项基准平均上均领先，规划成功率较AdaJEPA最高提升22个点。
AI.conclusion: 测试时世界模型校正应按时间尺度分离：情节特异的偏移需快速跟踪并重置，可复现的知识则需缓慢累积；sft-JEPA的双学习器框架验证了这一原则并在多基准与多世界模型上取得一致提升。

title: MVAgent: Per-Video Agents under Global Coordination for Multi-Video Understanding
summary: Multi-video understanding requires systems to combine evidence from different videos for cross-video reasoning. Answering such questions involves two kinds of decisions. Observation decisions must adapt to each video's content, whereas cross-video judgments require relating evidence from different videos based on the question. Most existing agents make both kinds of decisions in one controller, whose context accumulates observations from every video. We separate them in MVAgent, a training-free Multi-Video Understanding Agent framework with one LocalAgent per video. Each LocalAgent plans observations of its own video and keeps a private observation history. A GlobalAgent coordinates cross-video reasoning by instructing the LocalAgents and combining their reports with joint observation. We evaluate MVAgent on CVBench, MVU-Eval, and CrossVid, using three Qwen3.5 models of different sizes and GPT-6-sol. With Qwen3.5, our framework improves aggregate benchmark scores by 5.1 points on average over Single-pass inference with the same model and by 5.0 points over the strongest prior agent using the same model. With GPT-6-sol, the average gain over Single-pass inference with the same model is 4.3 points. On the same hardware, MVAgent also runs 1.8-2.7 times faster than prior agents of comparable size.

AI.tldr: MVAgent 是一个免训练的多视频理解智能体框架，将"单视频观测决策"与"跨视频判断决策"解耦：每个视频配一个维护私有观测历史的 LocalAgent，另设 GlobalAgent 负责跨视频协调与证据整合。在 CVBench、MVU-Eval、CrossVid 上，用 Qwen3.5 系列模型平均比同模型单次推理高 5.1 分、比最强先前智能体高 5.0 分；用 GPT-6-sol 平均增益 4.3 分；同等硬件下速度为先前进阶智能体的 1.8–2.7 倍。
AI.motivation: 多视频理解需要系统整合来自不同视频的证据进行跨视频推理，此类问题包含两类决策：观测决策需随各视频内容自适应，跨视频判断则需依问题关联不同视频的证据。现有智能体通常把两类决策放在同一个控制器中，导致其上下文不断累积所有视频的观测，造成上下文膨胀与干扰。作者据此提出将两类决策分离的动机。
AI.method: 提出 MVAgent：免训练的多视频理解智能体框架。为每个视频配置一个 LocalAgent，独立规划本视频的观测并保留私有的观测历史；由一个 GlobalAgent 通过向各 LocalAgent 下达指令、并结合联合观测汇总它们的报告，来协调跨视频推理。即"局部观测规划 + 全局协调整合"的两级架构。
AI.result: 在 CVBench、MVU-Eval、CrossVid 三个基准上，以三种不同规模的 Qwen3.5 模型及 GPT-6-sol 评估。使用 Qwen3.5 时，框架总分平均较同模型单次推理提升 5.1 分，较同模型下最强先前智能体提升 5.0 分；使用 GPT-6-sol 时，较同模型单次推理平均提升 4.3 分。相同硬件下，MVAgent 运行速度为先前进阶同类智能体的 1.8–2.7 倍。
AI.conclusion: 把观测决策与跨视频判断解耦、以每视频独立 LocalAgent 加全局协调者的设计，无需训练即可在多视频理解任务上同时取得更高准确率与更高效率，说明上下文隔离与分层协调是提升多视频推理性能的关键因素。

title: HandXFM: Semantic-Structural Distillation for Hand Radiograph Foundation Models
summary: Hand radiographs support diverse clinical tasks, including skeletal maturity assessment, rheumatoid arthritis scoring, abnormality screening, and anatomical localization, yet existing models are typically trained separately for each task and dataset. We present HandXFM, a domain-specific foundation model that leverages cross-modality knowledge for comprehensive hand X-ray understanding. HandXFM distills semantic priors from BiomedCLIP and structural cues from a chest X-ray Vision Transformer (ViT) through a unified alignment framework, integrating complementary medical knowledge in an interpretable way. After pretraining, HandXFM can be adapted to a range of musculoskeletal tasks, including bone age estimation, SvH score prediction, abnormality detection, joint localization, bone segmentation, and visual question answering. It consistently outperforms task-specific and single-expert baselines, achieving up to 0.11 improvement in Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) for bone age prediction and a 12\% accuracy gain in abnormality classification. Moreover, HandXFM generalizes to unseen datasets and yields cross-attention maps linking clinical terms to anatomical regions. These results demonstrate that multi-expert distillation effectively unifies semantic and structural supervision within a single pretrained model, establishing HandXFM as an interpretable and generalizable foundation model for hand radiograph analysis.

AI.tldr: HandXFM是一个面向手部X光片的领域专用基础模型，通过统一对齐框架从BiomedCLIP蒸馏语义先验、从胸部X光ViT蒸馏结构线索，单一预训练模型可适配多种肌骨任务并超越任务专用与单专家基线。
AI.motivation: 手部X光片支持骨龄评估、类风湿关节炎评分、异常筛查、解剖定位等多种临床任务，但现有模型通常针对每个任务和数据集分别训练，缺少统一、可迁移的手部影像基础模型。
AI.method: 提出HandXFM：在统一对齐框架中同时蒸馏BiomedCLIP的语义先验（图文知识）与胸部X光ViT的结构线索，以可解释的方式融合互补医学知识进行预训练；随后迁移至骨龄估计、SvH评分预测、异常检测、关节定位、骨骼分割和视觉问答等任务。
AI.result: 在各任务上一致优于任务专用与单专家基线；骨龄预测的皮尔逊相关系数（PCC）最高提升0.11，异常分类准确率提升12%；可泛化到未见数据集，并能生成将临床术语与解剖区域关联的交叉注意力图。
AI.conclusion: 多专家蒸馏能够将语义监督与结构监督统一到单一预训练模型中，使HandXFM成为可解释、可泛化的手部X光片分析基础模型。

title: Stochastic non-metric MDS for noisy high-dimensional data
summary: Multidimensional scaling (MDS) constructs low-dimensional embeddings that approximate pairwise distances in a high-dimensional dataset. MDS exists in several flavors, with metric MDS approximating distances directly and non-metric MDS additionally optimizing for an arbitrary monotonic transformation of the high-dimensional distances. Empirically, metric MDS is known to suffer from the curse of dimensionality. Here we extend prior theoretical results for metric MDS on fully uninformative data to a more general case of finite, high-dimensional data with concentrated distances. We show that the metric MDS embeddings of such datasets stay distributionally close to the data-independent limit case. We then show that non-metric MDS is more robust to high-dimensional noise and can yield informative embeddings of such data. While existing implementations of non-metric MDS are slow, we develop a fast implementation using stochastic gradient descent in PyTorch. Using our implementation, we conduct an empirical study using multiple simulated and real-world datasets, including population-genomic and scRNA-seq data, and show that non-metric MDS can strongly outperform other methods in terms of global structure preservation.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上刻画metric MDS在有限高维"距离集中"数据上的失效，证明其嵌入趋于与数据无关的极限情形；同时指出non-metric MDS对高维噪声更稳健，并给出基于PyTorch随机梯度下降的快速实现，在模拟与真实数据（群体基因组、scRNA-seq）上展示其在全局结构保持上的优势。
AI.motivation: metric MDS在经验上受"维数灾难"困扰，但已有理论结果多局限于完全无信息数据这一极端情形。作者希望将结论推广到更一般的有限高维、距离集中的实际数据，并探究non-metric MDS是否能规避这一问题；同时现有non-metric MDS实现过慢，限制了其应用。
AI.method: 理论上，将metric MDS在完全无信息数据上的既有结果推广到有限高维且距离集中的数据，证明其嵌入在分布意义上接近与数据无关的极限解；进而分析non-metric MDS（对高维距离施加任意单调变换进行优化）在高维噪声下的稳健性。算法上，用PyTorch实现基于随机梯度下降的non-metric MDS快速版本，并在多组合成数据与真实数据（群体基因组学、单细胞RNA测序）上开展实证比较。
AI.result: 理论上证明：对距离集中的有限高维数据，metric MDS的嵌入在分布上仍接近数据无关的极限情形，即难以反映数据真实结构；non-metric MDS则对高维噪声更稳健，可获得有信息量的嵌入。实证上，新实现显著快于现有实现，且non-metric MDS在全局结构保持方面明显优于其他方法。
AI.conclusion: metric MDS在高维距离集中数据上存在本质性失效，而non-metric MDS通过单调变换优化可有效缓解该问题；配合高效的SGD实现，non-metric MDS可作为高维数据全局结构可视化的优选工具。

title: MobileNeTTT: a Lightweight DNN-based Time-To-Transit Estimator for Visual Navigation
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures. Under review at IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Time-to-Transit (TTT) is a perceptual cue, proxy for depth, that can be computed in the visual cortex, allowing animals to estimate the time remaining to move past features in the environment. We show how TTT can be estimated and used for bio-inspired navigation of a mobile robot equipped with a monocular camera. The paper describes a lightweight neural network estimation method, named MobileNeTTT, that (1) uses the full field of view and provides a rich array of visual feature TTT estimates; (2) is relatively insensitive to camera rotation; and (3) automatically adjusts to the geometry of the path and the presence of obstacles. Because TTT is a coarse visual cue, it is far simpler to use for robot navigation than current large visual depth foundation models. Our navigation model uses a 1.95M-parameter network that is two to three orders of magnitude smaller than well-known large vision foundation models, making it able to run in real time on edge hardware. Simulation and actual laboratory experiments validate the proposed approach in dynamic and spatially complex environments. Code, data, and video are available.

AI.tldr: 提出生物启发的单目视觉导航方法：用时距（TTT）作为深度替代线索，MobileNeTTT轻量网络在全视场估计视觉特征TTT并对相机旋转鲁棒，仅1.95M参数即可在边缘硬件实时导航。
AI.motivation: 动物可基于视觉皮层可计算的时距（Time-to-Transit, TTT）感知线索估计距离与运动剩余时间，而现有大型视觉深度基础模型参数量大、难以在移动机器人边缘平台上实时运行，因此需要一种更简单、轻量的生物启发导航方案。
AI.method: (1) 设计轻量神经网络MobileNeTTT，利用相机全视场输出丰富的视觉特征TTT估计；(2) 通过设计使估计对相机旋转不敏感；(3) 自动适应路径几何与障碍物分布；(4) 在此基础上构建导航模型，总参数量1.95M，比典型大型视觉基础模型小2–3个数量级，并可在边缘硬件实时推理。
AI.result: 在动态且空间复杂的场景中，通过仿真实验与实车实验室实验验证了方法的有效性，导航性能得到验证，且计算开销远低于大型视觉深度基础模型；代码、数据与视频已公开。
AI.conclusion: TTT作为粗略视觉线索足以支撑机器人导航，其实现复杂度远低于大模型方案；轻量化生物启发范式可在边缘设备上实时完成单目视觉导航，为资源受限平台的深度/导航估计提供可行替代路径。

title: GameAnything: From Any Inspirations to Playable Game Worlds
summary: AI-driven game development holds the potential to transform diverse human inspirations into interactive experiences. However, existing systems and benchmarks primarily focus on explicit development specifications, with limited support for adapting multimodal references and evaluating actual gameplay experiences. We introduce GameAnything, an open-source agentic platform that transforms multimodal inspirations into playable extensions of existing games through iterative development. GameAnything integrates coding agents with an independent playtesting critic, persistent development state, and reusable experience memory to support continuous refinement. We further present GameAnything-Bench, a benchmark spanning diverse reference modalities, game creation objectives, and gaming environments, with exploratory gameplay testing to assess both functional correctness and gameplay quality. Evaluations of nine coding agent configurations reveal that current agents can adapt reference content but still struggle with playable interactions and precise modifications. Moreover, multimodal references improve content fidelity, while iterative refinement yields substantial but varying improvements across agents. These findings highlight both the potential and remaining challenges of inspiration-driven game development.

AI.tldr: GameAnything：一个开源智能体平台，将多模态灵感转化为既有游戏的可玩扩展；配套 GameAnything-Bench 基准，用于评测功能正确性与游戏可玩质量。
AI.motivation: AI 驱动游戏开发有望把多样化的人类灵感转化为交互体验，但现有系统与基准主要面向显式开发规范，对多模态参考的适配支持不足，且缺乏对实际游玩体验的评估。
AI.method: 提出 GameAnything 平台，将编码智能体与独立的“试玩评审”（playtesting critic）结合，并引入持久化开发状态与可复用的经验记忆以支撑持续迭代；同时构建 GameAnything-Bench，覆盖多种参考模态、游戏创作目标与游戏环境，采用探索式游玩测试，同时评估功能正确性与游戏质量。
AI.result: 对九种编码智能体配置的评测显示：当前智能体能适配参考内容，但在可玩交互与精确修改方面仍存在困难；多模态参考提升了内容保真度；迭代精化带来显著但智能体间差异较大的改进。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了“灵感驱动游戏开发”的潜力与尚存挑战，并为后续智能体系统设计与基准建设提供了平台与评测基础。

title: When Video Verifier Scores Mislead: Capability Assessment and Verifier Selection
summary: Video verifiers judge whether a candidate answer or trajectory agrees with a video, and are themselves chosen by a score. We show that this score depends on two choices in the test, the type of negative and the judgment interface, strongly enough to reverse conclusions about what a model can do and which verifier to deploy. We separate the two with controlled constructions that have exact truth conditions: endpoint-matched negatives, wrong only in their internal states, and a truth-switch test, in which the same two candidates swap correctness between two videos. Under direct judgment, where the verdict is read from answer scores, models that reject a visibly wrong start fall to near chance against endpoint-matched negatives. When the frames disclose each event, writing out reasoning before the answer lifts three of four models from under 10% to 70-100% on the truth-switch test, and staged inputs trace the direct failure to one step, composing events into states. But when the event must first be found, on human-validated natural video, the same change brings no significant gain under a protocol common to all models and can lower accuracy if one candidate denies that the event occurs. The negative type also changes which verifier is selected: one chosen on event-denial negatives is 8.9 points less accurate against negatives that keep the event and change a detail, the errors a generator mostly makes, and recovers about half as much accuracy when it reranks that generator's answers. A verifier should be evaluated on the errors it will face, and neither a low direct score nor a gain from reasoning should be read as a property of the model alone.

AI.tldr: 视频验证器的测试分数强烈依赖于负样本类型与判断接口两项设计选择，足以反转"模型能做什么"与"该部署哪个验证器"的结论；二者均由测试构造而非模型能力决定。
AI.motivation: 视频验证器（judge候选答案/轨迹是否与视频一致）通常靠一个分数来挑选和评价，但该分数的含义未被拆解。作者希望说明：分数并非模型的固有属性，而同时受"负样本类型"和"判断接口"影响，因此不应把直接判断得分低、或推理带来的提升，读作模型本身的能力。
AI.method: 用具有精确真值的受控构造把两个因素分离：(1) endpoint-matched negatives——起点相同、仅内部状态错误；(2) truth-switch test——同一对候选在两个视频间互换正确性。对比两种接口：直接判断（从答案得分读出结论）与先写推理再作答；并用分阶段输入定位失败步骤。另在经人工验证的自然视频上验证，采用所有模型统一的协议。
AI.result: 直接判断下，能拒绝明显错误起点的模型在endpoint-matched negatives上近乎跌到随机水平；当逐帧披露每个事件时，先写推理使四个模型中的三个在truth-switch测试上从<10%提升到70–100%；分阶段输入把直接判断的失败定位到单一步骤——把事件组合成状态。但在事件需先被检索的自然视频上，同一改动在统一协议下无显著增益，且当某候选否认事件发生时反而降低准确率。负样本类型还改变验证器选择：在event-denial negatives上选出的验证器，面对"保留事件、改动细节"的负样本（生成器最常见的错误）准确率低8.9个点，重排序时恢复的准确率仅约一半。
AI.conclusion: 验证器应在其实际会遇到的错误类型上评估；低直接分与推理增益都不能被解读为模型本身的属性，而是测试选择（负样本类型、判断接口）的产物。

title: S$^2$LMR: Supervised Sequential Long-Context Multi-Step Retriever
summary: Multi-step retrieval over long contexts is a key capability for retrieval-augmented generation, but strong existing approaches are costly and complex to train. Supervised retrievers are far simpler and cheaper, yet they fall well behind in this setting. We show that this gap stems not from supervised training itself, but from three misalignments between training and inference: easy training negatives, noisy retrieval prefixes, and position-agnostic scoring. Guided by this analysis, we introduce S$^2$LMR, a simple yet effective supervised sequential retriever that models multi-step retrieval as the evolution of an explicit textual state encoded by a single shared Transformer. On long-context reasoning, multi-hop QA, and needle-in-a-haystack benchmarks with context lengths ranging from 4K to 10M tokens, S$^2$LMR achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods, substantially outperforming prior supervised retrievers. Notably, it requires only $\sim$2 hours of training on a single A6000 for contexts of up to 10M tokens, while remaining robust across a wide range of hyperparameter settings.

AI.tldr: 提出监督式序列检索器S²LMR，将多步检索建模为显式文本状态的演化，训练成本极低（单卡A6000约2小时可支持10M token上下文），性能媲美SOTA方法并显著超越既有监督检索器。
AI.motivation: 长上下文多步检索是RAG的关键能力，但现有强方法训练昂贵且复杂；监督检索器简单便宜却在多步检索场景下明显落后。作者指出这一差距并非源于监督训练本身，而源于训练与推理之间的三处错配：训练负样本过于简单、检索前缀含噪、打分与位置无关。
AI.method: 基于上述失配分析，设计S²LMR：将多步检索形式化为一个显式文本状态的演化过程，由单个共享Transformer对这些状态进行编码与更新，配合针对负样本难度、前缀噪声与位置感知打分的对齐改进，实现简洁的监督式顺序检索训练。
AI.result: 在长上下文推理、多跳QA与大海捞针（needle-in-a-haystack）基准上（上下文长度4K至10M token），性能与SOTA方法相当，并大幅优于先前监督检索器；训练仅需单张A6000约2小时即可覆盖至10M token上下文，且对超参数设置具有较强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 监督式检索器在多步长上下文检索中的落后可通过纠正训练-推理错配来消除，无需依赖昂贵复杂的训练范式；S²LMR以极低训练成本达到SOTA级效果，凸显训练-推理对齐设计的重要性。

title: Representation Alignment Is Only as Good as the Teacher's Behavioral Structure
comment: 25 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Recent works align the intermediate features of vision-language-action (VLA) models with frozen vision encoders during fine-tuning, hoping to inject additional priors such as 3D awareness or affordances. Unlike in image generation, where teachers for representation alignment (REPA) are assessed with encoder-intrinsic metrics, teachers for VLAs are still chosen largely by heuristics. We show that this practice is unreliable: across 14 teachers and 16 manipulation tasks, under matched training budgets, no off-the-shelf vision encoder improves the clean success rate of $π_{0.5}$ by more than 1 point, and all of them reduce its success rate under perturbations by 10 to 39 points. Neither global semantics nor spatial structure, the criteria used in image generation, predicts which teachers help. We therefore propose the behavioral structure metric (BSM), which measures whether states that are close in a teacher's feature space are followed by similar expert actions within the same task. BSM correlates strongly with success rate under perturbations ($r=0.87$), and every off-the-shelf vision encoder scores below $π_{0.5}$ itself. Based on it, we introduce Behavior-Aware VLA Alignment (BAVA), a general VLA alignment protocol that favors vision encoders whose BSM exceeds the student's and stops alignment early according to the student's BSM during training. On SmolVLA, BAVA matches continuous alignment with one third of the alignment budget, and improves the average success rate by 4.6 points over unaligned fine-tuning. Our results suggest that representation alignment benefits VLAs only when the teacher encodes rich behaviorally relevant structure.

AI.tldr: 现有VLA表征对齐中教师选择依赖启发式；作者提出行为结构度量BSM，并提出BAVA对齐协议，仅在教师BSM优于学生时分阶段对齐，提升扰动下鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: VLA微调时常将中间特征对齐到冻结视觉编码器以注入3D感知、可供性等先验；但图像生成领域的REPA有编码器内在指标来评价教师，VLA教师却主要靠启发式挑选。作者实证表明该做法不可靠：14个教师×16个操作任务、同等训练预算下，没有现成视觉编码器能把π_{0.5}的干净成功率提升超过1个点，且全部使扰动下的成功率下降10–39个点。图像生成中使用的全局语义与空间结构两类准则也无法预测哪些教师有用。
AI.method: 提出行为结构度量（BSM）：衡量在教师特征空间中彼此接近的状态，在同一任务内是否对应相似的专家动作，即以行为一致性刻画教师表征的结构。基于BSM提出Behavior-Aware VLA Alignment（BAVA）通用对齐协议：优先选择BSM高于学生的视觉编码器作为教师，并依据训练过程中学生的BSM提前停止对齐。
AI.result: BSM与扰动下的成功率强相关（r=0.87），且所有现成视觉编码器的BSM均低于π_{0.5}自身。在SmolVLA上，BAVA以三分之一的同对预算达到与持续对齐相当的效果，相比未对齐微调平均成功率提升4.6个点。
AI.conclusion: 表征对齐只有在教师编码了丰富的、与行为相关的结构时才对VLA有益；BSM可作为教师筛选与对齐调度的可量化依据，取代启发式选择。

title: NoeVera: Can Knowledge Guide Experiments and Experiments Refine Knowledge?
summary: With the growing demand for large language model (LLM) services, optimizing LLM serving systems is becoming increasingly complex, and the bottleneck is no longer predicting how a given configuration will perform. The harder problem is deciding what to investigate: which mechanisms matter for a workload, which configurations are worth testing, and what evidence a decision still needs. In this work, we present NoeVera, an agentic Second Brain that goes beyond just one-shot retrieval by turning papers, code, benchmarks, and experimental results into a persistent, provenance-preserving knowledge base with three planes: source evidence, reusable synthesis, and agent memory. Decision-aware retrieval assembles compact evidence packs, role-specific agents reason over them and invoke a simulator (Vidur or GAUSS) whenever quantitative support is needed, and every finding is written back as a scoped evidence record, so knowledge guides experiments and experiments refine knowledge. In configuration search over four serving scenarios, NoeVera comes within 5% of the optimum in a median of 6-7 simulator calls, versus 9 for Bayesian optimization and 15 for a knowledge-free agent with the same tools; on A100 GPUs, its representative configurations deliver ~1.30x vLLM-default throughput and meet every scenario's latency objective. When reused, provenance-preserving evidence records over-generalize on only 8% of applicability traps, versus 28% for a general-purpose agent memory. On the held-out 48-task split of a 72-task benchmark, NoeVera scores 29% higher than an equally equipped agent and 36% higher than its single-call retrieval counterpart (0.80 vs. 0.62 and 0.59), and even when baselines receive NoeVera's own prompts, a statistically significant part of its evidence-evolution advantage remains.

AI.tldr: NoeVera：面向LLM服务系统优化的智能体式"第二大脑"，以来源证据/可复用综合/智能体记忆三层知识库支撑决策感知检索与仿真调用，用6-7次仿真调用即在四类服务场景中逼近最优（5%以内），并显著优于贝叶斯优化与无知识智能体。
AI.motivation: LLM服务系统优化日益复杂，真正的瓶颈已从"预测某配置的性能"转向"决定研究什么"：哪些机制对某负载关键、哪些配置值得测、决策还缺什么证据。一次性检索无法支撑这种持续、可追溯的知识积累与决策。
AI.method: 提出NoeVera智能体式第二大脑：将论文、代码、benchmark与实验结果构建为持久、保留来源（provenance-preserving）的知识库，分三个平面——源证据、可复用综合、智能体记忆。采用决策感知检索组装紧凑证据包；角色化智能体基于证据推理，并在需要量化支撑时调用仿真器（Vidur或GAUSS）；所有发现以带作用域的证据记录写回，形成"知识指导实验、实验精炼知识"的闭环。
AI.result: 四个服务场景的配置搜索中，NoeVera中位数6-7次仿真调用即达最优值5%以内，贝叶斯优化需9次、同工具的无知识智能体需15次；在A100上代表性配置达到vLLM默认吞吐约1.30倍并满足各场景时延目标。证据记录复用时仅在8%的适用性陷阱上过度泛化（通用智能体记忆为28%）。72任务基准的留存48任务划分上，得分比同等配置智能体高29%、比单次检索对照高36%（0.80 vs 0.62/0.59）；即使基线获得NoeVera的提示词，其证据演化优势仍有统计显著部分。
AI.conclusion: 将检索升级为持久、可追溯、可演化的证据知识体系，并把仿真器作为定量验证工具嵌入智能体决策循环，能显著提升LLM服务配置搜索的样本效率、泛化谨慎性与任务表现，且优势来自证据演化机制本身而非仅提示工程。

title: Task-Agnostic Incremental Vision-Language Object Detection via Prompt Augmentation and Distribution-Aware Fusion
summary: Incremental Vision-Language Object Detection (IVLOD) empowers pre-trained open-vocabulary detectors to continuously learn new visual concepts from sequential tasks without forgetting foundational knowledge. However, existing methods predominantly rely on oracle task identities during inference, severely limiting their open-world practicality. In this paper, we formalize Task-Agnostic IVLOD (TA-IVLOD), a more realistic setting where such priors are unavailable, requiring the model to simultaneously recognize classes from all learned tasks. This unconstrained setting exposes severe performance degradation due to cross-task semantic interference and parameter conflicts. To tackle these challenges, we propose TADA, a novel modular framework. Specifically, TADA introduces Stochastic Prompt Augmentation to mitigate semantic interference via training-time noise injection, and Test-Time Distribution-Aware Fusion to dynamically weight class-specific LoRA experts, effectively resolving parameter conflicts. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms baselines in standard IVLOD and yields substantial improvements in the rigorous TA-IVLOD setting on the ODinW-13 benchmark, while effectively preserving zero-shot generalization on the MS COCO dataset. The code is available at https://github.com/yonghanjiang/TADA.

AI.tldr: 提出更贴近真实应用的任务无关增量视觉-语言目标检测设定TA-IVLOD，并给出模块化框架TADA以缓解跨任务语义干扰与参数冲突。
AI.motivation: 现有增量视觉-语言目标检测（IVLOD）方法在推理时依赖oracle任务身份先验，无法在开放世界中真正使用；而取消该先验后，跨任务语义干扰和参数冲突会导致性能显著下降。
AI.method: TADA为模块化框架，包含两部分：1）随机提示增强（Stochastic Prompt Augmentation），通过训练期噪声注入缓解语义干扰；2）测试时分布感知融合（Test-Time Distribution-Aware Fusion），动态加权类特定的LoRA专家，以解决参数冲突。
AI.result: 在标准IVLOD设定下显著优于基线；在更严格的TA-IVLOD设定下于ODinW-13基准取得大幅提升，同时在MS COCO上有效保持零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TADA在无需任务身份先验的条件下实现多任务统一识别，兼顾增量学习性能与零样本泛化，代码已开源。

title: DoC: Learning to Defer or Commit for Timely, Accurate, and Stable Conversational Diagnosis Prediction
summary: Conversational diagnosis prediction requires accurate, early, and stable predictions from ongoing clinical dialogue, yet dialogue-level labels do not specify when to commit. We propose a two-phase framework for learning deferral and diagnosis decisions. First, iterative commitment-boundary estimation constructs Defer/diagnosis supervision without annotated commitment times. Second, Defer-aware supervised fine-tuning initializes a policy, refined through reinforcement learning with trajectory-level rewards for timeliness, first-commit accuracy, and post-commit stability. On EMSDialog and MediTOD, DoC commits early, achieving the highest first-commit accuracy among post-trained methods (76.7%/51.2%) and the lowest post-commit error overall (16.4%/48.3%).

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段框架DoC，在无承诺时点标注的情况下学习"延迟/诊断"决策，实现对话诊断预测的早期、准确、稳定承诺。
AI.motivation: 对话级诊断预测需要从进行中的临床对话里尽早、准确且稳定地给出预测，但对话级标签只标明最终诊断，并未说明应在何时做出承诺，缺乏承诺时点（commitment time）监督信号。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：（1）迭代式承诺边界估计，无需人工标注承诺时刻即可构造Defer/诊断监督信号；（2）Defer感知的监督微调初始化策略，再用强化学习精调，采用轨迹级奖励，同时考虑及时性、首次承诺准确率与承诺后稳定性。
AI.result: 在EMSDialog与MediTOD上，DoC能较早承诺；在后训练方法中首次承诺准确率最高（76.7%/51.2%），承诺后错误率整体最低（16.4%/48.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 将"何时承诺"显式建模为可学习的延迟决策，并通过两阶段监督+强化学习联合优化及时性、准确性与稳定性，可有效解决对话级标签无法提供承诺时点监督的问题。

title: MAWAM: Joint Imagination for Collaborative Robot Manipulation with a Multi-Agent World Action Model
summary: World action models (WAMs) excel at robot manipulation by imagining future observations and decoding actions from them, yet remain confined to a single embodied agent. In practice, manipulation often requires multiple robots to collaborate across disjoint workspaces, coupled timing, and heterogeneous embodiments. Such coordination demands both spatiotemporal alignment of future interactions and awareness of individual embodiment and role identities, whereas existing decentralized per-robot policies, flat centralized models, and multi-robot VLAs fail to unite both. To bridge this gap, we present MAWAM, a multi-agent world action model that jointly predicts the future observations of multiple embodiments and decodes each agent's actions from them for collaborative manipulation. Through an agent-axis curriculum, MAWAM expands a single-agent WAM along an agent dimension to coordinate teams under shared weights. Within one unified causal sequence, joint self-attention spans all agents to spatiotemporally align their imagined futures, while hierarchical language, identity encodings, and embodiment masks bind each stream to its role, identity, and embodiment. We further formalize multi-agent-necessary manipulation along three axes (why, when, and who) and develop MA-Task Harness, a coding-agent pipeline where mutually constraining generators and evaluators co-evolve customizable simulation-data and evaluation packages. Using this pipeline, we build MA-Bench across all axes with seven tasks, pairing joint success rate with role and collaboration scores for fine-grained analysis. On MA-Bench, MAWAM reaches 82.7% mean joint success, 30.7% above the strongest baseline, and achieves real-time closed-loop collaboration on a real heterogeneous robot team.

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体世界动作模型 MAWAM，将单智能体 WAM 沿"智能体维度"扩展，联合预测多具身未来观测并解码各自动作，实现异构机器人团队协同操作。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAM）擅长通过想象未来观测再解码动作来完成机器人操作，但局限于单一具身智能体。真实操作常需多机器人跨不相交工作空间协作，涉及时序耦合与异构具身；这类协调既要求对未来交互进行时空对齐，又要求感知各自身份、角色与具身差异。现有去中心化逐机器人策略、扁平集中式模型和多机器人 VLA 均无法同时满足这两点。
AI.method: 1）构建 MAWAM：在共享权重下联合预测多具身未来观测并解码各智能体动作；2）采用"智能体轴课程"（agent-axis curriculum）将单智能体 WAM 沿智能体维度扩展；3）在统一因果序列中用跨全部智能体的联合自注意力实现想象未来的时空对齐，并以分层语言指令、身份编码与具身掩码将各流绑定到对应角色、身份与具身；4）从 why/when/who 三轴形式化"多智能体必要性"操作，并构建 MA-Task Harness——由相互约束的生成器与评估器共同演化仿真数据与评测包的编码智能体流水线，据此构建覆盖三轴的七任务基准 MA-Bench，联合成功率与角色分、协作分。
AI.result: 在 MA-Bench 上，MAWAM 平均联合成功率达 82.7%，超最强基线 30.7 个百分点；并在真实异构机器人团队上实现实时闭环协作。
AI.conclusion: 以世界动作模型为统一骨干、沿智能体维度扩展，可在共享权重下同时实现多智能体时空对齐与身份/角色/具身感知，为异构多机器人协同操作提供有效范式；配套的 MA-Bench（why/when/who 三维度、细粒度角色与协作评分）为多智能体必要性操作提供了系统评测手段。

title: Neural Agent Compiler: Learning to Schedule Soft Dependencies
summary: Large language model agents accomplish complex tasks by coordinating multiple reasoning steps and tool operations, which form dependencies among their operations. Existing orchestration methods primarily consider hard dependencies that determine when an operation can legally begin, but overlook soft dependencies, i.e., information that is not required for execution but may improve an already executable operation. We identify soft-dependency scheduling as an important problem in agent execution. To this end, we introduce Neural Agent Compiler (NAC), a learned scheduler that predicts the task-quality and resource consequences of three execution modes and selects the highest-utility legal mode at a scheduling boundary. NAC represents the executable continuation, pending information event, and resource state in a shared memory, and uses a utility function to adapt the consequence predictions to different resource preferences. Across AppWorld, WebShop, and $τ^2$-bench, NAC achieves 276/417 AppWorld task completions, a 74.69 WebShop Task Score, and 59/100 $τ^2$-bench successes. Additional studies show that the learned scheduler reduces execution work, establishing soft-dependency scheduling as a promising solution for orchestrating tool-using agents.

AI.tldr: 论文识别出智能体编排中被忽视的"软依赖"调度问题，提出学习式调度器神经智能体编译器（NAC），在调度边界预测三种执行模式的任务质量与资源后果并选择效用最高的合法模式。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体编排方法只考虑"硬依赖"，即决定某个操作何时可以合法开始的信息依赖；却忽视了"软依赖"——并非执行所必需、但可以改善一个已可执行操作的信息。这类信息若被合理等待，可提升任务质量，因此软依赖调度是智能体执行中的重要问题。
AI.method: 提出神经智能体编译器（NAC）：一种学习式调度器，在调度边界处预测三种执行模式各自带来的任务质量与资源后果，并选择效用最高的合法模式。NAC 将可执行延续、待定信息事件和资源状态表示在共享内存中，并通过效用函数使后果预测适配不同的资源偏好。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 上完成 276/417 个任务；WebShop 任务得分 74.69；τ²-bench 上成功率 59/100。额外的研究显示，该学习式调度器能减少执行工作量。
AI.conclusion: 软依赖调度是编排工具使用型智能体的一种有前景的解决方案，NAC 通过学习式调度在多个基准上取得有效表现并降低执行开销。

title: Click and Count: Multimodal Prototype Adaptation for Class-Agnostic Object Counting
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 2027 IEEE Symposium Series on Computational Intelligence (IEEE SSCI 2027). Code: https://github.com/ameniifi/Click-and-Count
summary: We propose a multimodal, class-agnostic, density-based object counting framework that specifies the object of interest through visual exemplars, a text description, or both, within a single iterative refinement pipeline. Existing counters typically fall into two groups: methods that fuse two modalities, a hand-drawn bounding box and a text description, to specify the target object, and single-modality methods that rely on either a box exemplar or text alone. A few recent methods replace the box with a point or click. We expand a single click into a precise object mask via a frozen visual-prompt segmentation model, feeding an iterative prototype-refinement process that also fuses a text description at every refinement step. We make two contributions: first, a click-derived exemplar extraction module that removes the bounding-box requirement of prior exemplar-based counters; second, a per-step text-fusion mechanism that combines visual and textual prompts throughout refinement. Combined with text guidance, our model achieves state-of-the-art counting accuracy, outperforming prior click-based counting methods across all metrics and surpassing the box-exemplar base architecture in mean absolute error. The code is available at github.com/ameniifi/Click-and-Count.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态、类别无关、基于密度的目标计数框架，用点击生成掩码替代框exemplar，并在每步迭代精化中融合文本，实现免框exemplar计数并取得SOTA精度。
AI.motivation: 现有计数方法要么需融合手绘边界框与文本两类模态，要么仅依赖框exemplar或纯文本单模态，近期少数用点/点击替代框；框标注成本高，且视觉与文本提示未在精化全过程中协同使用。
AI.method: 构建单次迭代精化流水线：将单次点击经冻结的视觉提示分割模型扩展为精确目标掩码，送入迭代式原型精化过程，并在每个精化步骤融合文本描述。核心贡献为两点：(1) 点击驱动的exemplar提取模块，去除先前exemplar型计数器的边界框需求；(2) 逐步文本融合机制，在精化全程结合视觉与文本提示。
AI.result: 结合文本引导后达到SOTA计数精度：在所有指标上优于先前的点击型计数方法，并在平均绝对误差(MAE)上超过框exemplar基线架构。
AI.conclusion: 以点击掩码替代边界框exemplar并全程逐步融合文本，可在单一框架内支持视觉exemplar、文本描述或二者组合的类别无关密度计数，验证了免框exemplar与多模态逐步融合的有效性。

title: Mirrored Min-of-K Training
summary: Min-of-K (MoK) training is widely used to train models that produce diverse outputs from random noise. For each target, it draws K outputs from the model and backpropagates only through the one closest to the target. However, MoK generally does not make the generated distribution match the data distribution. In this paper, we analyze the MoK bias across all values of K and show that tuning K shifts between failure modes, from mode dropping at small K to distribution flattening at large K. We further prove that every nontrivial loss based only on target-candidate distances fails to recover some data distribution, since these distances do not reveal how the candidates are placed relative to each other. Based on these analyses, we propose mirrored MoK (MMoK), a drop-in modification of MoK training that draws one extra sample from the model, applies the closest-candidate selection rule against it, and subtracts the resulting distance. Since this distance is measured between samples of the model, it provides additional information about how the candidates are placed relative to each other. We prove that MMoK can in principle recover data distributions that MoK cannot. We empirically validate MMoK on five scenarios, namely synthetic mixtures, pedestrian and vehicle trajectory prediction, tropical cyclone forecasting, robotic policy learning, and ambiguous medical image segmentation. The results confirm the effectiveness and generality of MMoK in both distribution learning and task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了Min-of-K（MoK）训练在K取所有值时的偏差，指出仅基于目标-候选距离的损失无法恢复部分数据分布，并提出镜像MoK（MMoK）：额外采样一个模型输出并对其做最近候选选择、减去该距离，从理论上可使MoK无法恢复的分布变得可恢复，并在五个任务上验证有效。
AI.motivation: MoK训练广泛用于从随机噪声生成多样输出的模型，但MoK通常不能使生成分布与数据分布匹配；且作者要厘清MoK偏差随K变化的规律，并解释现有基于距离的损失族为何本质上有局限。
AI.method: 1）对MoK偏差在全部K值上做分析；2）证明任何仅依赖"目标-候选距离"的非平凡损失都会对某些数据分布失效，因为这些距离不反映候选之间的相对布局；3）提出MMoK：作为MoK的即插即用改动，额外从模型采一个样本，对该样本应用最近候选选择规则并减去相应距离，从而引入样本间相对位置信息。
AI.result: 理论证明MMoK原则上能恢复MoK无法恢复的数据分布；实验在五个场景（合成混合分布、行人与车辆轨迹预测、热带气旋预报、机器人策略学习、歧义医学图像分割）上验证了其在分布学习与任务性能上的有效性与通用性。
AI.conclusion: MMoK通过引入模型样本间的距离项，为MoK类训练提供了可行的偏差修正方案，兼具理论保证与跨任务实证支持。

title: A ROS2 based Human-In-The-Loop Framework for UAV Search and Rescue Operations
comment: 30 pages, 10 figures, Submitted to and under review in "International Journal of Intelligent Systems" of Wiley
summary: Existing Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) autonomy frameworks lack human contextual awareness, limiting real-time adaptability in unstructured Search and Rescue (SAR) environments. To address data availability, we propose a Robot Operating System (ROS2)-based human-in-the-loop (HITL) framework that translates human directional gestures (left/right) into UAV navigation commands using RGB-Depth (RGB-D) sensing and YOLOv11 (You Only Look Once). The deprecation of ROS1 necessitates migrating to ROS2, prioritising real-time communication, scalability, and long-term maintainability. Unlike approaches optimised for peak accuracy under ideal conditions, the proposed system prioritises robustness and real-time deployment in degraded SAR environments. Our system achieves 89% confidence in depth estimation under occlusion and varying environmental conditions in Gazebo-PX4 simulations. In foggy conditions, RGB-D fusion consistently provides more informative cues than RGB alone, with an average improvement of 46.7% across all scenarios and distances. The framework demonstrates superior occlusion handling (+15%), adaptive RGB-D fusion, temporal consistency modelling, and real-time deployment via a ROS2 data distribution service (DDS), with end-to-end latency below 50 ms. We evaluate the modified YOLOv11 and the depth-weighted pose estimation on a held-out simulated test set and on real people from the public UAV-GESTURE dataset, in clear air and in Koschmieder fog. Without retraining, the framework reads the gestures of real people with 80% accuracy, depth keeps 77% at a visibility of 10 m where RGB drops to 24%, and the modified YOLOv11 reaches 91% in simulation and 99% on held-out real people when trained on real data. The open-source ROS2 implementation eases the transition of SAR-UAV platforms from ROS1, enabling UAVs to act directly on operator gestures without complex path planning.

AI.tldr: 提出基于ROS2的人在环（HITL）框架，用RGB-D与改进YOLOv11将操作者左右手势实时转化为无人机导航指令，重点面向退化SAR环境下的鲁棒性与实时部署。
AI.motivation: 现有UAV自主框架缺乏人类上下文感知，难以在非结构化搜救环境实时适应；ROS1弃用也迫使迁移到ROS2。且多数方法追求理想条件下的峰值精度，而非退化场景下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 基于ROS2的人环框架：RGB-D感知+YOLOv11手势识别（左/右），引入深度加权位姿估计、自适应RGB-D融合与时序一致性建模；在Gazebo-PX4仿真及UAV-GESTURE真实数据（晴空与Koschmieder雾模型）上评测，采用DDS实现实时通信。
AI.result: 遮挡与变化条件下深度估计置信度89%；雾天RGB-D融合较纯RGB平均提升46.7%；遮挡处理提升15%；端到端时延<50 ms；不重训时真实手势准确率80%；10 m能见度下深度保持77%而RGB降至24%；改进YOLOv11仿真91%、真实留出集99%。
AI.conclusion: 开源ROS2实现降低SAR-UAV平台从ROS1迁移的门槛，使无人机可直接响应操作者手势而无需复杂路径规划，在退化环境下具备部署价值。

title: MetaSkill: Reusable Problem-Solving Methods for Adaptive Skill Orchestration in LLM Agents
comment: 16 pages, including appendices. The MetaSkill library is provided as ancillary material
summary: Reusable skills provide specialized procedures, but large language model (LLM) agents must still determine how to organize and adapt their use. We introduce MetaSkill, a two-layer framework for reusing problem-solving methods across tasks and domains. The method layer selects from 26 curated methods and binds abstract roles to task objects. The execution layer uses the instantiated method to identify intermediate objectives, coordinate native skills, and guide repair or method reselection. On 89 SkillsBench tasks and 995 ToolHop examples, MetaSkill outperforms the evaluated baselines in all six configurations, with accuracy gains of 3.51-13.48% over the strongest baseline. Ablations support explicit method-guided orchestration beyond direct method injection and further gains from method reselection.

AI.tldr: 提出两层框架MetaSkill，将可复用"方法"与技能执行分离，用于跨任务、跨领域组织与适配LLM智能体的技能使用。
AI.motivation: 可复用技能只提供专门化的过程知识，LLM智能体仍缺少关于"如何组织、如何适配"这些技能使用的指导，导致技能难以跨任务与跨领域迁移。
AI.method: MetaSkill分两层：方法层从26个精选方法中选取，并将抽象角色绑定到任务对象上；执行层用实例化后的方法确定中间目标、协调原生技能，并引导修复或方法重选。
AI.result: 在89个SkillsBench任务与995个ToolHop样例、六种配置下均优于所评估的基线，相对最强基线准确率提升3.51–13.48%；消融实验表明显式方法引导的编排优于直接注入方法，且方法重选带来进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式的方法层编排是技能复用的关键，抽象方法经角色绑定实例化后可跨领域指导技能协调，且修复与方法重选机制对性能有实质贡献。

title: GlaucomaMarker - Biomarker-Grounded Glaucoma Vision-Language Model
