summary: Glaucoma is a leading cause of irreversible blindness. In the current clinical setting, glaucoma diagnosis is generally conducted by assessing optic disc cupping and asymmetry. Vision-language models (VLMs) have been utilized in recent years for glaucoma, mostly trained on fixed templates or AI-generated captions, as no public text describes the biomarkers. Our proposed framework, GlaucomaMarker, hypothesizes that retinal structural biomarkers can ground glaucoma-based VLMs. It converts public segmentation masks into sentences describing eleven biomarkers, to teach retinal foundation models to read them. We applied this framework to RETFound (GlaucomaMarker-R) and FLAIR (GlaucomaMarker-F), training on 9,778 images that yielded 45,190 image-text pairs. On a real-world clinical cohort, GlaucomaMarker-F detects glaucoma with an AUROC of 0.905, against 0.848 for FLAIR, and both read the biomarkers where baselines stay near random guessing. Since the biomarker text is computed from existing masks, it comes at no extra cost.

AI.tldr: 提出GlaucomaMarker框架，将公开分割掩码自动转换为描述11种生物标志物的文本，用于训练视网膜基础模型，使视觉语言模型能"读懂"青光眼结构生物标志物，且在真实临床队列上显著提升诊断性能。
AI.motivation: 现有青光眼视觉语言模型多基于固定模板或AI生成描述进行训练，因为缺乏公开描述生物标志物的文本，导致模型难以真正"理解"视盘凹陷与不对称等结构特征。
AI.method: 假设视网膜结构生物标志物可为青光眼VLM提供视觉-语言对齐基础。将公开分割掩码转化为描述11种生物标志物的句子，生成45,190个图文对（来自9,778张图像），并用其训练RETFound（GlaucomaMarker-R）与FLAIR（GlaucomaMarker-F）。
AI.result: 在真实临床队列上，GlaucomaMarker-F检测青光眼AUROC达0.905，优于FLAIR的0.848；两种模型均能正确读取生物标志物，而基线模型接近随机猜测水平。
AI.conclusion: 生物标志物文本由现有掩码计算得到，无额外标注成本，可作为青光眼VLM有效且低成本的视觉-语言对齐监督信号，提升诊断与可解释性。

title: Do Larger Fully Connected Neural Networks Generalize Better?
summary: Greater neural-network capacity does not necessarily yield better performance on unseen data. This study investigates whether a deeper, fully connected neural-network architecture generalizes better than a shallower architecture on the Fashion-MNIST dataset. We compare two architectures under two learning rates and two L2-regularization settings, producing eight configurations. The architectures contain 95,410 and 561,470 trainable parameters, respectively, an approximately 5.9-fold difference. Checkpoints and the final configuration are selected by validation loss, and all configurations are evaluated on a held-out test set. The selected larger configuration achieves 89.82% validation accuracy and 88.77% test accuracy. Selecting the lowest-validation-loss configuration within each architecture yields test accuracies of 88.77% and 88.52%, respectively, a difference of 0.25 percentage points. Across matched training settings, the larger architecture achieves higher test accuracy in only one of four comparisons. Class-level errors are concentrated among visually similar garment categories, and qualitative pixel-removal analyses suggest sensitivity to shape and boundaries. Overall, the findings suggest that increasing architectural capacity alone does not guarantee better generalization, highlighting the importance of considering optimization and regularization when selecting neural-network architectures.

AI.tldr: 在Fashion-MNIST上比较深度全连接网络（561,470参数）与浅层网络（95,410参数，约5.9倍差距），在2种学习率×2种L2正则共8组配置下评估：更大模型的最优验证配置测试精度为88.77%，浅层最优为88.52%，仅差0.25个百分点；且在4组匹配训练设置中，大模型仅1组测试精度更高。说明单纯提升架构容量并不保证更好泛化，优化与正则化设置对架构选择同样关键。
AI.motivation: 神经网络容量更大并不必然带来更好的未见数据表现，本文意在检验"更深的全连接架构是否比更浅架构在Fashion-MNIST上泛化更好"这一常见假设，并强调在架构选择中需同时考虑优化与正则化因素。
AI.method: 构建两种全连接架构（95,410与561,470个可训练参数，约5.9倍容量差），在2种学习率×2种L2正则设置下组合成8组配置；以验证损失进行检查点与最终配置选择，并在独立留出测试集上评估全部配置；辅以类别级错误分析与像素移除的定性分析。
AI.result: 选定的大模型配置达89.82%验证精度、88.77%测试精度；两架构各自取最低验证损失配置时测试精度为88.77%与88.52%，相差0.25个百分点；在四组匹配训练设置中，大模型仅在其中一组取得更高测试精度。类别级错误集中于视觉相似的服装类别，像素移除分析显示对形状与边界的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 仅增加架构容量并不能保证更好的泛化性能；架构选择应结合优化与正则化设置综合考量，容量差异在合理调优下带来的收益可能极小。

title: Reset Dependence Is Embodied: Training Protocol Changes Which Morphologies Appear Optimal
comment: NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track. 32 pages, 13 figures. Code and run records: https://github.com/kevinxqiu/reset-dependence
summary: Robot co-design benchmarks rank bodies after training their controllers under a fixed episode protocol, but that protocol can change the ranking itself. Consequently, two studies can select different bodies from the same corpus even when they use the same task and evaluator. We study one part of that protocol, the reset rule, which ends a training episode when the robot's torso falls below a height threshold. We train proximal policy optimization (PPO) controllers for 100 DERL-evolved UNIMAL bodies with this threshold at 20% of each body's starting torso height (Standard), at 50% (Strict), or with no threshold (Reset-free), and score every controller with the same evaluator. The threshold changes which bodies look best: the rankings after Strict and Reset-free training correlate at only 0.21, against about 0.89 if seed noise were the only difference. Removing fall resets costs some bodies far more than others. Bodies evolved on flat ground lose 45% of their per-step reward relative to Standard training, and those evolved on variable terrain only 16%. Permutation tests over bodies support this difference, and on 24 bodies, flat-ground bodies gain the most from Strict over Reset-free training under both PPO and soft actor-critic (SAC). Choosing bodies by their worst reward across the three protocols costs little: in sample, they keep at least 91% of the reward of each protocol's best bodies, and over 80% averaged across held-out seeds. Co-design benchmarks should state their reset rule, test whether their rankings depend on it, and report bodies that stay strong across protocols. Project page: https://reset-dependence.github.io.

AI.tldr: 机器人协同设计基准在固定回合协议下训练控制器后对机体排名，但协议本身会改变排名。本文研究“重置规则”（躯干高度阈值）对排名的影响：用PPO为100个DERL进化的UNIMAL机体分别按Standard(20%阈值)、Strict(50%阈值)、Reset-free(无阈值)训练，并用同一评估器打分。结果表明Strict与Reset-free排名相关性仅0.21，而去除跌倒重置对平地进化机体损害远大于变地形机体（45% vs 16%）。按三协议最差奖励选机体代价很小，建议基准公开重置规则并报告跨协议稳健机体。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人协同设计基准以固定回合协议（含重置规则）训练控制器后再对机体排名，但协议差异可能使同一语料、同一任务与评估器下的两项研究选出不同机体。作者旨在量化重置规则这一协议要素对机体排名的影响，并检验其是否与机体进化地形相关。
AI.method: 对100个DERL进化的UNIMAL机体，在三种重置规则下用PPO训练控制器：Standard（阈值为各机体起始躯干高度的20%）、Strict（50%）与Reset-free（无阈值），统一用同一评估器评分。分析排名相关性、相对Standard的每步奖励损失（按进化地形分组），并用机体层面的置换检验验证差异；另在24个机体上比较Strict与Reset-free在PPO与SAC下的收益；最后评估按三协议最差奖励选机体的代价（样本内与held-out种子）。
AI.result: Strict与Reset-free训练后的机体排名相关性仅0.21，若仅有种子噪声约为0.89。去除跌倒重置对不同机体代价差异显著：平地进化机体每步奖励较Standard下降45%，变地形机体仅下降16%，置换检验支持该差异；在24个机体上，平地机体从Strict相对Reset-free获益最大，PPO与SAC均成立。按三协议最差奖励选机体代价小：样本内至少保留各协议最佳机体的91%奖励，跨held-out种子平均保留超80%。
AI.conclusion: 重置规则显著改变协同设计基准的机体排名，且不同机体对其敏感度存在系统差异（与进化地形相关）。基准应明确报告重置规则、检验排名是否依赖该规则，并报告跨协议表现稳健的机体；以跨协议最差奖励选机体是低代价的稳健策略。

title: DoppelVet: Comparative Safety Verification for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Self-evolving agents improve by retaining feedback as reusable memories or skills, but every mistaken approval can shape many future behaviors. Two updates can provide exactly the same evidence to a verifier yet produce opposite safety outcomes, so the verifier cannot distinguish them from that evidence alone. We introduce DoppelVet, a verification framework that checks proposed updates before they enter an agent's persistent state. Without access to safety labels, DoppelVet constructs an alternative that matches every signal used by the existing verifier. It replays both updates from the same state and directly compares their behaviors in both presentation orders before deciding whether to retain the candidate. We evaluate DoppelVet on DoppelVet-Grid and DoppelVet-Tool, covering executable programs and natural-language memories. Across nine open-weight and proprietary verifiers, DoppelVet raises mean harmful-update detection AUC from 0.762 to 0.940 on DoppelVet-Grid and from 0.681 to 0.826 on DoppelVet-Tool, outperforming VaG and AgentDoG 1.5. On DoppelVet-Grid, it reduces trajectories experiencing degradation from 30.39% to 0.43% over a ten-generation self-update loop and leaves no final degradation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DoppelVet 验证框架，在候选更新进入智能体持久状态前进行校验：通过构造与现有验证器所用信号完全一致的"替代更新"并成对回放对比行为，在无安全标签条件下识别危险的自我更新，显著提升有害更新检测能力并抑制长期退化。
AI.motivation: 自演化智能体通过把反馈固化为可复用的记忆或技能来改进，但一次错误批准会塑造后续大量行为。关键难点在于：两种更新可能向验证器提供完全相同的证据，却导致相反的安全后果，因此仅凭该证据验证器无法区分，存在"同证据异后果"的判别盲区。
AI.method: DoppelVet 在更新写入持久状态前进行验证。在无法获取安全标签的情况下，它针对现有验证器使用的每一项信号构造匹配的替代更新（doppelganger），从同一状态回放候选更新与替代更新，并在两种呈现顺序下直接比较二者行为，据此决定是否保留候选更新。评估涵盖 DoppelVet-Grid 与 DoppelVet-Tool 两个基准，分别对应可执行程序与自然语言记忆。
AI.result: 在九种开源权重与闭源验证器上，DoppelVet 将 DoppelVet-Grid 的平均有害更新检测 AUC 从 0.762 提升至 0.940，在 DoppelVet-Tool 上从 0.681 提升至 0.826，优于 VaG 与 AgentDoG 1.5。在 DoppelVet-Grid 的十代自更新循环中，经历性能退化的轨迹比例由 30.39% 降至 0.43%，且最终无退化残留。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖更新本身提供的证据不足以判定安全性，通过同状态回放与双向顺序的行为对比可以有效暴露隐藏的危害差异。DoppelVet 无需安全标签即可通用地增强现有验证器，并显著缓解多代自我更新中的误差累积。

title: Alignment under Hard Negative Re-Pairing: Cross-Modal Similarity, Scale and Retrieval
comment: 52 pages, including references and supplementary material
summary: Do vision and language models represent the world alike? That question hides three: what structure each modality has, whether the two modalities organize images and their captions alike, and whether a model ranks an image's own caption highly. Centered kernel alignment (CKA) and neighborhood agreement answer the second, yet matching and model selection use them as if they identified individual pairs and answered the third. To test this reading, we introduce hard negative re-pairing: every image receives the caption of a similar image, and nothing else changes. Although no image keeps its own caption and annotators judge a majority of the substituted captions wrong, CKA stays higher than under a random re-pairing that keeps 80% of the original pairs. In all 22 image-text models we test, neighborhood agreement loses far less than top-one retrieval, which collapses. The reason is scale: these diagnostics pool over many neighbors, matching and retrieval are decided among the nearest ones, and an exact decomposition shows that near-neighbor pairs contribute almost nothing to CKA. In the matching problems we test, an exact maximizer of CKA would not return the original pairing. On COCO and Flickr30k, the model with the highest diagnostic value retrieves worse on held-out data than the model chosen by validation recall, even where the two correlate positively. What re-pairing removes is the informative part: that share tracks retrieval on both datasets and ranks encoder pairs before alignment training. A diagnostic should be reported with its question and its scale, and tested against hard negative re-pairing.

AI.tldr: CKA与邻域一致性等跨模态对齐诊断指标是"池化尺度"上的相似度度量，不能用于判断单个图文对是否匹配或做模型选择；作者提出"硬负例重配对"检验，并证明诊断值应与其问题与尺度一并报告。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言对齐研究常把CKA、邻域一致性当作"图像与其caption是否配对"的判据，并据以做匹配与模型选择。论文指出该问题实际包含三层：各模态自身结构、两模态组织方式是否一致、模型是否给图像自身caption高排名；现有工作把后两者的度量混用于第三问，需要检验这种误读。
AI.method: 提出硬负例重配对（hard negative re-pairing）：为每张图像替换为相似图像的caption，其余不变，从而保持模态整体结构与近邻分布但破坏配对关系；对照随机重配对（保留80%原始对）。在22个图文模型上比较CKA、邻域一致性与top-1检索的表现，并给出CKA的精确分解以剖析近邻对与远邻对的贡献；进一步在COCO、Flickr30k上比较"诊断值最高模型"与"验证集recall选定模型"在留出数据上的检索性能。
AI.result: 即使没有图像保留自身caption、且多数替换caption被标注者判为错误，CKA仍高于保留80%原始对的随机重配对；22个模型中邻域一致性下降远小于top-1检索（后者几乎崩溃）。精确分解显示近邻对贡献极小，故CKA的精确最大化并不返回原始配对。COCO/Flickr30k上诊断值最高的模型在留出数据上检索差于按验证recall选出的模型，即便二者正相关。被重配对"移除"的部分恰是信息量所在，其占比可追踪两数据集检索性能并在对齐训练前对编码器对排序。
AI.conclusion: CKA与邻域一致性回答的是全局/池化尺度的结构相似问题，而非个体配对与检索排序问题；不应作为匹配判据或模型选择依据。诊断指标必须连同其"问题"和"尺度"一并报告，并用硬负例重配对待检验。

title: A Finite-Rate Selection Law for Annealed Gibbs Sampling
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at DynaFront2026: Dynamics at the Frontiers of Optimization, Sampling, and Games; NeurIPS 2026 Workshop
summary: Annealed Gibbs sampling samples a multimodal model by redrawing one variable at a time from its conditional distribution as the temperature falls from a high value, where the distribution is broad, to the target temperature. Each run ends in a single mode, and unbiased Monte Carlo estimates require the runs to end in each mode in proportion to its probability under the model. At a finite cooling rate this can fail. We measure the error by $c$, the fraction of the model's log-odds between two modes that the samples retain. In the Curie--Weiss model, where a weak external field favors one of two modes, each run selects its mode near the transition at which the modes form, and rarely switches once they have separated. Near the transition, the random fluctuations of the Gibbs updates still outweigh the weak field, which therefore biases the choice of mode only slightly. Building on the selection probability of Kondepudi and coworkers, we derive a law for $c$ that agrees with an exact computation to within $2\%$ on nine linear cooling ramps. For the Hopfield model, whose modes are stored patterns and their negatives, we derive a factor by which competition among patterns raises $c$. The $c$ measured over random pattern sets lies within $3$--$6\%$ of its prediction, but single pattern sets depart from it, contrary to its derivation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究退火Gibbs采样在有限降温速率下终止于各模态比例失真的问题，提出用"保留的模态对数几率比例" $c$ 度量误差，在Curie–Weiss模型中推导出与精确计算误差在2%以内的c的解析规律，并在Hopfield模型中给出模式竞争放大 $c$ 的因子（随机模式集下预测误差3–6%）。
AI.motivation: 退火Gibbs采样从高温（分布宽）逐步降温到目标温度，每次重抽一个变量，单次运行最终落入单一模态。无偏的Monte Carlo估计要求运行终止于各模态的频率正比于其模型概率，但有限降温速率下这一条件会失效；作者希望定量刻画这种失衡的程度并给出可预测的解析规律。
AI.method: 定义误差指标 $c$：样本保留的两模态间模型对数几率的比例。针对Curie–Weiss模型（弱外场偏向两个模态之一），指出每次运行在模态形成附近的转变点处选定模态、模态分离后极少切换；由于转变附近Gibbs更新的随机涨落仍强于弱外场，外场对模态选择的偏置很小。作者借鉴Kondepudi等人的选择概率结果，推导 $c$ 的解析表达式，并与线性降温轨道的精确计算对比；随后推广到Hopfield模型（模态为存储模式及其负模式），推导模式间竞争提升 $c$ 的倍增因子，并用随机模式集上的实测 $c$ 检验该因子。
AI.result: Curie–Weiss模型中，$c$ 的推导规律在九条线性降温轨道上与精确计算吻合，误差不超过2%。Hopfield模型中，推导出的模式竞争放大因子使预测的 $c$ 与随机模式集实测值相差3–6%；但单个模式集的实测值偏离预测，与推导前提不符。
AI.conclusion: 有限速率退火Gibbs采样的模态比例偏差可由 $c$ 定量刻画，并在Curie–Weiss与Hopfield两类模型中给出高精度解析预测；但Hopfield模型下单模式集的结果偏离解析预测，说明推导所依赖的假设在个体层面并不成立，提示理论在系统性层面有效、在单实例层面仍需修正。

title: Feedback Completion Certificates for Repeated Dwell Tasks with Time Windows
comment: 37 pages, including appendices with full proofs and experimental details
summary: An inspection robot may owe several measurements at the same station, each with a different window in which a dwell can begin. We ask what a feedback controller must retain about earlier visits to guarantee all remaining deadlines under bounded disturbances. For a common spatial predicate and dwell length, removing redundant windows orders the remaining obligations by both endpoints. On every history without an expired obligation, the served windows form a suffix. One boundary and one capped run length therefore preserve the future satisfaction of the original task. On a verified library of branching motion primitives we use this state to recover a feedback policy. For one task type a scalar threshold per run length suffices, with work linear in the number of listed branches per time layer for fixed dwell. Multiple types require a joint recursion. On a quadrotor inspection library the threshold sweep reduced the cost of constructing a reusable full-domain policy, while a sparse Boolean baseline answered a single initial query faster. In a two-station MuJoCo patrol, three task-aware filters all met every window in twelve paired runs each. Of eight initially certified runs, the completion filter retained the certificate in all eight, compared with three for safety-only filtering.

AI.tldr: 针对巡检机器人同站多次测量、每次容许不同停留起始窗口的调度问题，研究在有限扰动下反馈控制器需保留关于历史访问的何种信息才能保证剩余截止期；发现去除冗余窗口后余下义务按两端点同序、已服务窗口构成后缀，于是单一边界加一个截断游程长度即可保留未来可行性，并据此在经认证的分支运动原语库上恢复反馈策略。
AI.motivation: 巡检机器人可能在同一点位承担多次测量义务，而每次测量可开始停留的时间窗口不同；控制器需在有限扰动下保证所有剩余截止期，但完整历史状态随访问次数增长而不可行，因此需要刻画"最少需保留多少历史信息"。
AI.method: 对共同空间谓词与相同停留时长，删除冗余窗口，使剩余义务按两个端点同序排列；证明在无过期义务的历史上已服务窗口构成后缀，从而问题由"一个边界＋一个截断游程长度"刻画（单任务类型下等价于每个游程长度的标量阈值，固定停留时时层工作量与所列分支数线性；多任务类型需联合递推）。在经形式验证的分支运动原语库上用该状态做反馈策略合成，并做阈值扫描。
AI.result: 四旋翼巡检原语库上，阈值扫描降低了构造可复用全定义域策略的代价，但稀疏布尔基线响应单次初始查询更快；双站点 MuJoCo 巡逻中，三种任务感知过滤在各自十二次配对运行中均满足全部窗口；八次初始认证运行中，完成度过滤在全部八次保留证书，而仅安全性过滤仅保留三次。
AI.conclusion: 冗余窗口去除后的两参数状态（边界＋截断游程长度）足以在有限扰动下保持原任务的未来满足性，可作为反馈策略的充分摘要；任务感知的完成度过滤显著优于仅安全性过滤地保住形式证书，但在查询延迟与全定义域策略构造成本上优于基线与否依赖于具体场景。

title: EMIP: Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform
summary: Experimental platforms that enable multiple participants to engage in spoken dialogue and perform physical actions concurrently in a shared environment are important for studying cooperation between humans and embodied AI agents. In this paper, we propose EMIP (Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform), a virtual environment platform built on Minecraft. Through an Internet-based client-server architecture, EMIP connects multiple humans and multiple AI agents to the same virtual environment and supports full-duplex speech communication and simultaneous physical interaction. It provides interfaces based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for environmental observation, physical action execution, and audio input and output, enabling researchers to develop their own agent control methods using large language models (LLMs). Additional features include centralized control of an agent group through a single EMIP agent client, collaborative object transportation by multiple agents, and experimental support functions such as recording and retrieving observation histories. By integrating these features into a reusable platform, EMIP aims to support research on human-human, human-agent, and agent-agent cooperation under different participant configurations and agent control methods. Usage examples illustrate concurrent speech and physical action, task coordination, and overlapping speech. The source code for the platform is publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/AI-Humans-Lab/EMIP-Embodied-Multi-Party-Interaction-Platform).

AI.tldr: 本文提出EMIP——一个基于Minecraft构建的具身多方交互虚拟平台，通过客户端-服务器架构接入多名人类与多个AI智能体，支持全双工语音交流与同步物理操作，并提供基于MCP的观测、动作与音频接口，用于研究人-人、人-智能体、智能体-智能体协作。
AI.motivation: 研究人类与具身AI智能体的协作，需要能让多名参与者同时在共享环境中进行语音对话并执行物理动作的实验平台；现有平台难以同时满足多方并发、全双工语音、物理交互与LLM智能体接入的可复用需求。
AI.method: 基于Minecraft构建虚拟环境，采用互联网客户端-服务器架构连接多个人类用户与多个AI智能体；提供基于模型上下文协议(MCP)的接口，分别用于环境观测、物理动作执行和音频输入输出，使研究者可用LLM自行开发智能体控制方法；并加入由单个EMIP智能体客户端集中控制一组智能体、多智能体协同搬运物体、以及观测历史记录与检索等实验支撑功能。
AI.result: 平台实现了全双工语音通信与同步物理行为的并发支持；使用示例展示了语音与动作并发、任务协调以及语音重叠(overlapping speech)等场景；源码已在GitHub公开。
AI.conclusion: EMIP将上述功能整合为可复用平台，旨在支撑不同参与者配置与不同智能体控制方法下的人-人、人-智能体及智能体-智能体协作研究。

title: Two Actions from One State: Fork Futures Teach JEPA World Models to Compare
summary: JEPA world models are trained to predict logged transitions but used to compare counterfactual actions from one state. The logged behavior data show one action per state, and under a local linear approximation we prove the action response is unidentified along any direction the policy never varies within a state. We therefore supplement behavior data with measured outcomes of alternative actions from the same state. Our fork futures execute two actions from one restored state, and their outcome difference cancels the state term, identifying the action response on the sampled span. The resulting model, Fork-JEPA, matches predicted to measured differences, anchors the logged successor with behavior prediction, and adds a lookback head that keeps the predecessor recoverable, all at training time, leaving planning unchanged. On three visual control tasks, behavior-only training leaves the predicted action effect no better than a constant guess. Fork-JEPA makes it readable and raises planning success by up to 14\% over LeWM, its base model. Where the action response changes across hidden zones, it nearly doubles cross-zone success, and 1,024 fork pairs beat 1.2M extra behavior steps. Our project is available at https://fork-jepa.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 行为数据仅含单一动作，导致JEPA世界模型的动作响应在策略未变动方向上不可辨识；提出Fork-JEPA，引入"分叉未来"（同一恢复状态执行两个动作，差值抵消状态项）来识别动作响应，在三个视觉控制任务上将规划成功率较LeWM提升最高14%。
AI.motivation: JEPA世界模型用日志转移训练，却在单一状态下比较反事实动作。日志行为数据每个状态只记录一个动作，在局部线性近似下，可证明动作响应在策略于同一状态内从未变化的方向上不可辨识，因此行为预测训练无法学到可靠的动作效应。
AI.method: 补充行为数据：从同一状态采集替代动作的实测结果。核心机制为“分叉未来”：从同一恢复状态执行两个不同动作，两者结果之差抵消状态项，从而在采样张成的空间上识别动作响应。模型设计：将预测差值与实测差值对齐；用行为预测锚定日志后继状态；增加回溯头（lookback head）使前驱状态可恢复。以上均为训练时约束，规划阶段不变。
AI.result: 在三个视觉控制任务上，纯行为训练得到的动作效应预测不比常数猜测更好；Fork-JEPA使其可读，规划成功率较基座模型LeWM最高提升14%。在动作响应随隐藏区域变化的情形下，跨区域成功率近乎翻倍；1024对分叉样本优于额外120万步行为数据。
AI.conclusion: 反事实动作响应在行为数据下不可辨识，需以同状态多动作的实测差值作为监督；Fork-JEPA以低成本分叉采样显著提升世界模型的动作敏感性与规划性能，且不改变推理与规划流程。

title: Mirror Descent at the Edge of Stability
summary: In many deep learning settings, gradient descent has been shown to operate at the edge of stability -- a regime where the largest eigenvalue of the loss Hessian hovers around $2/η$. We study this phenomenon in mirror descent, a generalization of gradient descent. As mirror descent is non-Euclidean, existing explanations of the edge of stability phase do not extend to this setting. We generalize the existing notion of sharpness to introduce mirror sharpness, which measures the curvature of the loss with respect to the mirror potential. Empirically, we observe that the mirror sharpness hovers slightly above the $2/η$ threshold. Furthermore, we derive a dual central flow ODE for mirror descent that models iterates in continuous time at the onset of edge of stability. Our ODE provides insights into the difficulties of extending existing arguments for why sharpness stabilizes at $2/η$ from gradient descent to mirror descent in full generality.

AI.tldr: 本文将"稳定边缘"现象从梯度下降推广到镜像下降：提出镜像锐度(mirror sharpness)度量损失相对于镜像势的曲率，实验发现其稳定在略高于2/η的水平，并推导出刻画稳定边缘初期的对偶中心流ODE。
AI.motivation: 梯度下降中"稳定边缘"(edge of stability)现象已有较多研究，但现有解释依赖于欧氏几何结构，无法直接推广到非欧的镜像下降框架；本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 1) 将原有锐度概念推广，定义"镜像锐度"，用以度量损失沿镜像势方向的曲率；2) 在实验中观测镜像下降训练过程中镜像锐度的演化轨迹；3) 推导镜像下降的对偶中心流(dual central flow)ODE，在连续时间下刻画稳定边缘初期阶段的迭代行为。
AI.result: 实验上，镜像锐度稳定在略高于2/η阈值的位置，与梯度下降中的现象类似。所导出的ODE揭示了为何将梯度下降中"锐度稳定在2/η"的既有论证推广到一般镜像下降存在本质困难。
AI.conclusion: 稳定边缘现象在镜像下降中以镜像锐度的形式存在，但由于非欧几何带来的对偶结构差异，一般情形下尚无法给出与梯度下降完全一致的锐度稳定机制解释，这为后续理论工作指明了开放问题。

title: Real-Time Kinodynamic Multi-Agent Motion Planning
summary: Coordinating large robot fleets, from warehouses to quadrotor swarms, requires collision-free trajectories that satisfy dynamic constraints and stay within speed and acceleration bounds. Existing kinodynamic multi-agent planners enforce these bounds during the search or through trajectory optimization after it, which limits fleet size and speed. We present Tickwise Actions to Kinodynamic Trajectories (TAKT), a framework that accounts for the dynamics before the search and reduces planning to a lattice search for double-integrator robots. TAKT analytically bounds the clearance lost when a discrete plan is smoothed and reserves this margin on the lattice. A closed-form convolution provably converts any valid plan into dynamically feasible trajectories with continuous-time collision avoidance. For robots spanning many lattice vertices, we introduce a diamond formulation that permits one-tick sideways yielding and adapt the Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) solvers PIBT and LaCAM to it. With 50 robots, our planners run over 2,000 times faster than the strongest baseline in 2D halls and over 100 times in 3D, with comparable or lower makespan and cost. They plan about a thousand robots in seconds in 2D, and tens of seconds in 3D, and replan up to a thousand robots in real time.

AI.tldr: TAKT 将动力学约束放在搜索之前处理，把双积分器机器人的轨迹规划归约为格点搜索，并用闭式卷积把任意有效格点计划转换为连续时间上无碰撞、动力学可行的轨迹，从而支持千级机器人规模的快速规划。
AI.motivation: 大规模机器人集群（仓储、四旋翼集群等）需要同时满足无碰撞、动力学约束及速度/加速度边界。现有多智能体动力学（kinodynamic）规划器要么在搜索过程中强制这些边界，要么在搜索之后做轨迹优化，导致集群规模与速度受限。
AI.method: 1）先建模动力学再搜索：将问题归约为双积分器机器人的格点（lattice）搜索；2）解析地界定离散计划经平滑后损失的净空（clearance），并在格点上预留该安全余量；3）用闭式卷积（closed-form convolution）可证明地把任意有效计划转换为动力学可行且连续时间无碰撞的轨迹；4）针对跨越多个格点顶点的机器人提出 diamond 形式化，允许单 tick 侧向让行，并将 MAPF 求解器 PIBT 与 LaCAM 适配到该形式化上。
AI.result: 50 台机器人场景下，二维厅堂中比最强基线快 2000 倍以上，三维中快 100 倍以上，且 makespan 与代价相当或更低；二维可在数秒内规划约一千台机器人，三维为数十秒；可实时重规划多达一千台机器人。
AI.conclusion: 将动力学处理前置到搜索之前、并以可证明的安全余量与闭式卷积保证可行性，是突破 kinodynamic 多智能体规划规模与速度瓶颈的有效途径，使 MAPF 求解器（PIBT、LaCAM）可直接用于大规模快速集群规划与实时重规划。

title: SAE-Audit: Clinical-Trial Prediction via Inference-Time Optimization of Black-Box LLMs Audited by Sparse Autoencoder Evidence
comment: Codes are publicly available at: https://github.com/JunboShen/SAE-Audit
summary: Clinical trials are costly and often take years to complete, making early outcome prediction valuable for trial planning. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast clinical-trial outcomes, yet their predictions remain unreliable and their rationales may not faithfully reflect the evidence underlying their answers. On tasks such as predicting whether a registered clinical trial will complete or terminate early, frontier LLMs perform only modestly above chance in our experiments. We introduce SAE-Audit, which optimizes a black-box LLM at inference time with evidence obtained from a deployable open model. A frozen sparse autoencoder (SAE) on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is converted into a vocabulary of clinical concepts. Sparse probes fitted on past trials determine which concepts are associated with the outcome. For a new protocol, the concepts detected by the probe are written as evidence, each with the direction and strength of its association with the outcome, and the LLM being audited optimizes its answer in the light of this evidence. Without additional training, SAE-Audit raises balanced accuracy of deepseek-v4-flash by 9.6--12.0 points on five clinical-trial prediction tasks and raises GPT-5.6-terra by 8.0 points on trial completion, exceeding other agentic inference-time optimization methods by a large margin. As an auxiliary, SAE probes module within SAE-Audit is itself accurate and auditable, providing natural-language explanations directly derived from verified concept contributions and protocol evidence, without requiring additional LLMs at inference time. SAE-Audit provides verifiable, concept-level evidence for more accurate and auditable clinical-trial prediction. It can also be embedded into biomedical AI agents such as Biomni to optimize their performance.

AI.tldr: SAE-Audit 利用部署级开源模型上冻结的 SAE 将 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的激活转化为临床概念词表，通过稀疏探针检索与新试验方案相关的概念证据，在推理时对黑盒 LLM 进行证据引导的答案优化，从而在无需额外训练的情况下显著提升临床试验结局预测的平衡准确率并提供可审计的概念级解释。
AI.motivation: 临床试验成本高、周期长，早期结局预测对试验规划有重要价值。LLM 已被用于预测临床试验结局，但预测不可靠，且其给出的理由未必真实反映答案所依据的证据；在预测注册试验能否完成或提前终止这类任务上，前沿 LLM 仅略高于随机水平。
AI.method: 提出 SAE-Audit：1）将 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上冻结的稀疏自编码器（SAE）转化为临床概念词表；2）在历史试验上拟合稀疏探针，确定哪些概念与结局相关；3）对新方案，将探针检测到的概念连同其与结局关联的方向和强度写成自然语言证据；4）被审计的 LLM 在推理时依据该证据优化答案，无需额外训练。其中 SAE 探针模块自身即准确且可审计，可直接从经过验证的概念贡献与方案证据生成自然语言解释，推理时无需额外 LLM。
AI.result: 在五个临床试验预测任务上，SAE-Audit 使 deepseek-v4-flash 的平衡准确率提升 9.6–12.0 个百分点，使 GPT-5.6-terra 在试验完成预测上提升 8.0 个百分点，大幅超过其他代理式推理时优化方法。
AI.conclusion: SAE-Audit 为更准确、更可审计的临床试验预测提供了可验证的概念级证据，并可嵌入 Biomni 等生物医学 AI 智能体以优化其性能。

title: TOGO: Take One Image Editor, Get One Video Editor for Free
summary: Instruction-based image editors are trained on millions of edit pairs and follow instructions far more reliably than current video editors. We show that this ability can be transferred to video editing without any training. Our key observation is that a growing number of image editors and video generators share the same latent space. Their velocity fields can therefore be combined at sampling time: the difference between the editor's velocity under the instruction and under a neutral prompt, which we call the \emph{edit velocity}, can be added to the sampler of a video model. Added naively, however, it blurs the video, alters the background and flickers. An analysis of the edit velocity explains why. It is small and reliable only at coarse scales and high noise levels, not concentrated on the edited object, and uncorrelated across frames. From these properties, we derive a simple guidance operator that amplifies the edit velocity and restricts it in noise level, space, and time. The video model then turns the incoherent per-frame signal into a temporally coherent edit. Our method, TOGO, combines Qwen-Image-Edit with the Wan2.1 video model without training or fine-tuning. On FiVE-Bench, it raises the edit success rate from 47.0\% (the same video model without the editor) to 65.6\%, above the best published method (59.2\%). At the same time, it maintains the background PSNR and obtains the best LPIPS and SSIM of all methods. Because the video editor is assembled at inference time, it can be upgraded to any newer image editor that shares the latent space with no cost.

AI.tldr: TOGO是一种免训练的视频编辑方法：利用共享潜空间的图像编辑器（Qwen-Image-Edit）与视频生成器（Wan2.1），通过提取"编辑速度"并施加噪声水平、空间、时间三重约束的引导算子，将逐帧不连贯信号转为时间一致的视频编辑，在FiVE-Bench上编辑成功率从47.0%提升至65.6%。
AI.motivation: 基于指令的图像编辑器经数百万编辑对训练，指令遵循能力远优于现有视频编辑器；而视频编辑训练数据稀缺、成本高。作者发现越来越多的图像编辑器与视频生成器共享同一潜空间，因此希望将图像编辑能力"零训练"迁移到视频编辑，避免为视频编辑专门训练模型。
AI.method: 核心思路是速度场组合：在采样时将编辑速度（编辑器在指令下与中性提示下的速度差）加到视频模型的采样器中。但朴素相加会导致模糊、背景改变与闪烁。作者分析了编辑速度的性质——仅在粗尺度、高噪声水平下小而可靠，不集中于被编辑对象，且帧间不相关——据此设计了一个简单的引导算子，对编辑速度进行放大，并在噪声水平、空间与时间三个维度上加以约束，使视频模型能把逐帧不连贯信号整合为时间一致的编辑。整套流程在推理时组装，无训练、无微调。
AI.result: 在FiVE-Bench上，编辑成功率由同视频模型无编辑器时的47.0%提升至65.6%，超过最佳已发表方法的59.2%；同时保持背景PSNR，并在所有方法中取得最优LPIPS与SSIM。
AI.conclusion: 图像编辑器的指令跟随能力可零训练迁移至视频编辑；关键在于对编辑速度的统计性质进行分析并据此设计噪声/空间/时间约束的引导算子。由于编辑器在推理时即插即用，方法可无缝升级到任何共享潜空间的更新图像编辑器，边际成本为零。

title: Certified Comparative Statics for Conservation-Law Equilibrium Layers, with an Application to RNA Interference
summary: Implicit and equilibrium neural layers define their output as the fixed point of a map. Existing theory certifies that this fixed point exists; it does not certify how it responds to its inputs. For a conservation-law layer with order-preserving coupling we give a form-independent answer: every input-output comparative static is sign-certified if and only if the residual Jacobian is a nonsingular M-matrix, and the certified sign depends only on the sign of the occupancy derivative, so one guarantee covers Langmuir, Hill, and saturating-exponential occupancies. The M-matrix machinery is classical; the contribution is form-independence as the portable invariant, the first certified-sign sensitivity result for a layer of this class, and a sharp phase boundary at which certification is lost while the equilibrium remains well posed. Three consequences follow: the phase boundary, which is strictly stronger than the M-matrix condition; competitive derepression, whose derivative is identically zero for any independent per-target scorer and provably nonzero here; and non-submodularity of resource-coupled suppression. We instantiate on siRNA off-target competition and validate on real public data only, across seventeen microRNAs, two titration studies, and a paired chemical-modification experiment; a second, non-biological instantiation shows the same certified sign on measured physical data. As a trainable layer the operator learns end-to-end while remaining certified-monotone by construction, reaching magnitude parity with a parameter-matched feedforward baseline while expressing a competition effect that baseline cannot represent for any weights. The single-pool instantiation validates the mechanism but does not rank off-target magnitude or resolve position-specific design. Code: https://github.com/shadi97kh/certified-equilibrium-layers

AI.tldr: 隐式/平衡神经层的前向不动点存在性已有理论保证，但其对输入的比较静态响应缺乏认证。本文针对保序耦合的守恒律层证明：所有输入-输出比较静态符号可认证，当且仅当残差雅可比为非奇异M-矩阵，且认证符号仅由占据数导数符号决定，从而与占据函数形式无关。据此给出三项推论（相边界、竞争性去抑制、资源耦合抑制的非次模性），并在siRNA脱靶竞争等真实数据上验证。
AI.motivation: 隐式层与平衡层把输出定义为某个映射的不动点。既有理论只能证明该不动点"存在"，无法保证它如何随输入变化——即缺乏有符号保证的比较静态结果。同时，单靶点独立打分的建模方式无法表达竞争/耦合效应（其导数恒为零），而实际系统（如siRNA脱靶竞争、资源耦合抑制）中这类效应真实存在。作者希望得到一个与占据函数具体形式无关、可移植、可用于实际数据与可训练层的认证工具。
AI.method: 1）研究对象：保序耦合的守恒律层，输出为残差映射的不动点。2）核心定理：证明"每个输入-输出比较静态的符号可认证"当且仅当残差雅可比为非奇异M-矩阵；认证符号只取决于占据数导数的符号，因而一个保证同时覆盖Langmuir、Hill、饱和指数三类占据函数（形式无关性）。3）给出严格强于M-矩阵条件的相边界，并指出在平衡仍良定处认证会失效。4）由M-矩阵结构导出竞争性去抑制（任何独立逐靶点打分的导数恒为零，而本模型可证非零）与资源耦合抑制的非次模性。5）实例化：siRNA脱靶竞争，仅在真实公开数据上验证（17种miRNA、两项滴定研究、一项配对化学修饰实验）；另给出一个非生物物理实例以显示相同认证符号。6）作为可训练层：构造上保证认证单调性，端到端学习，与参数匹配的前馈基线比较。
AI.result: 理论上给出首个该类层的认证符号灵敏度结果，并刻画认证丢失的尖锐相边界。实证上，在17种miRNA、两项滴定研究与一项配对化学修饰实验的真实公开数据上验证了siRNA脱靶竞争实例；非生物实例在实测物理数据上显示同样的认证符号。作为可训练层，该算子在保持构造性认证单调的同时端到端训练，量级上与参数匹配的前馈基线持平，并能表达基线对任何权重都无法表示的竞争效应。
AI.conclusion: M-矩阵机制本身是经典的，本文贡献在于把"形式无关性"确立为可移植不变量、给出该类隐式层的首个认证符号灵敏度定理、并给出认证失效但平衡仍良定的尖锐相边界，附三项结构性推论。局限：单池实例化只验证了机制，不对脱靶强度进行排序，也无法解决位置特异性的设计问题。代码已开源。

title: Detecting Is Not Choosing: What a World Model Needs to Keep a VLA Policy Safe
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Accepted at the CoRL 2026 Workshop "Do Robots Need World Models?". OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=oIzsAcOuYl
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies complete most benchmark tasks but often violate safety constraints. Since they are stochastic, one remedy is to sample several candidate action chunks and execute one that a world model predicts is safe. We ask what such a model must do. In simulation, a lookahead safety filter with the simulator as an exact world model raises the safety rate of three VLA policies on LIBERO and of pi0.5 on LIBERO-Plus by 11.5 to 25.7 points. It also helps pi0.5 on three RoboCasa tasks. Learned critics trained on one policy's data detect dangerous states (pooled AUROC up to 0.864) but rank candidates at one state close to chance (within-decision AUROC 0.551-0.560), and the learned dynamics and video models we test do no better. When the simulator's state is perturbed, selection degrades long before detection. In the loop, a median position error of 3.18 mm removes 70% of the gain on LIBERO-Spatial, partly because the error also corrupts the displacement check. On LIBERO-10 the loss is smaller, and the intervals overlap. The median does not predict the cost: a pixel reader with a 0.56 mm median error keeps 6.5 points less of the gain than Gaussian error of a similar median. A world model for safety should thus be judged by within-state ranking, and its state must be accurate in the tail and on handled objects, not only in the median.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了VLA策略前瞻式安全滤波对世界模型的要求：模拟器作为精确世界模型可将安全率提升11.5–25.7个百分点，但学习型critic/动力学/视频模型在单状态内的候选排名接近随机（AUROC 0.551–0.560），且状态扰动会使选择性能远早于检测性能退化；因此世界模型应以"状态内排序"为评价指标，并要求状态在尾部误差与操作物体上精确。
AI.motivation: VLA策略在基准任务上完成率高，但常违反安全约束。由于策略具有随机性，一种补救办法是采样多个候选动作块，再用世界模型预测并执行其中安全的一个。论文追问：这样的世界模型到底需要具备什么能力，才能支撑有效的安全滤波。
AI.method: 1) 在仿真中以模拟器作为精确世界模型构建lookahead安全滤波器，对LIBERO上三个VLA策略及LIBERO-Plus上的pi0.5进行评测，并测试RoboCasa三个任务上的pi0.5；2) 用单一策略数据训练学习型critic，分别评估其危险状态检测（pooled AUROC）与同一状态内候选动作排序（within-decision AUROC）；3) 测试学习型动力学模型与视频模型作为替代世界模型；4) 对模拟器状态施加扰动（高斯噪声与像素读取误差），考察检测与选择的退化关系，并分析位移检查被污染的影响。
AI.result: 精确世界模型的前瞻滤波使LIBERO三个策略与LIBERO-Plus上pi0.5的安全率提升11.5–25.7点，并在RoboCasa三个任务上帮助pi0.5。学习型critic的检测能力尚可（pooled AUROC最高0.864），但同一状态内候选排序接近随机（within-decision AUROC 0.551–0.560），所测学习型动力学与视频模型也不更优。状态扰动下，选择性能在检测性能退化之前就已下降：LIBERO-Spatial上3.18 mm的中位位置误差消除70%的增益（部分因误差污染位移检查），LIBERO-10上损失较小且区间重叠。中位数不能预测代价：0.56 mm中位误差的像素读取器比同等中位的高斯误差少保留6.5点增益。
AI.conclusion: 面向安全的世界模型应以"状态内候选排序"而非状态检测能力来评判；其状态精度必须在误差尾部与操作物体上可靠，而不能只看中位误差。

title: Emotion-Aware and Context-Grounded Dialogue Agents for Personalized Video Game Interactions
summary: We present ChatNPC, a game companion that dynamically personalizes its responses in real time based on players' emotional shifts to enhance user immersion. The model integrates sequential data, leveraging the dynamic nature of streams to benefit from player information, spoken lines, and in-game context. We leverage recent progress in LLMs' tool-calling capabilities to extract vital information from memory and recognize potential constraints for accurate reasoning, thereby tackling the complexity of NPC conversation scenarios. The task is divided into a game sentinel-guided agent (SeGent), a memory capability, and a chat planning tool for reasoning instantiation. The approach uses a lightweight game template as an information framework, with relevant details and a thorough reasoning layout. We conduct extensive experiments on a newly developed game dataset for in-game context NPC dialogue and demonstrate that ChatNPC sequentially captures players' emotional shifts over time; responses are more naturalistic and human-like with appropriate conversational cues, pauses, and sighs; and utterances remain faithful to the dynamics of in-game context and player actions, supporting narrative continuity.

AI.tldr: 提出 ChatNPC 游戏伴侣，基于玩家情绪变化实时个性化 NPC 回复，利用 LLM 工具调用实现记忆检索与对话规划，从而提升沉浸感与叙事连贯性。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏 NPC 对话难以根据玩家情绪的动态变化做出个性化回应，且 NPC 对话场景复杂（需兼顾玩家信息、台词与游戏内上下文），影响用户沉浸感。
AI.method: 将任务分解为三部分：游戏哨兵引导的智能体（SeGent）、记忆能力模块、以及用于推理实例化的对话规划工具；以轻量级游戏模板作为信息框架，利用流式序列数据整合玩家信息、 spoken lines 与游戏内上下文，并借助 LLM 的工具调用能力从记忆中提取关键信息、识别约束以支持准确推理。
AI.result: 在新建的游戏内上下文 NPC 对话数据集上实验表明：ChatNPC 能随时间序贯捕捉玩家情绪变化；回复更自然拟人，带有恰当的对话提示、停顿与叹息； utterances 忠实于游戏内上下文动态与玩家行为，支持叙事连续性。
AI.conclusion: ChatNPC 通过情绪感知的实时个性化与工具增强的记忆—规划机制，有效提升 NPC 对话的自然度与叙事一致性，可作为增强游戏沉浸感的可行方案。

title: Plan Big, Paint Small: Semantic-Aware Computation Allocation for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion streams a video chunk by chunk, but large AR models are too slow for real-time use. We ask where in an AR rollout a large model is actually needed. Pairing Krea-Realtime-14B with Self-Forcing-1.3B, which share their latent space and denoising schedule, we find that the order of the two models matters: when the 14B model generates only the first chunk and the 1.3B model continues, the rollout keeps 95\% of the 14B model's semantic advantage, whereas the reverse allocation keeps 16\% at about ten times the cost. The large model decides what the video shows; the small model only has to carry it forward. We turn this into BigSmall, a training-free planner--renderer sampler. The 14B model plans the opening chunk and sketches the chunks in which content changes, which preserves motion, and the 1.3B model renders the rest; a faster variant, BigSmall, plans only the opening chunk. A cross-model KV cache that is approximate, windowed and lazy lets the planner leave and re-enter the rollout at low cost. On VBench, BigSmall is $3.02\times$ faster than the 14B model at an unchanged semantic score and motion, and $1.55\times$ faster than SDVG, which lets the small model draft first; BigSmall reaches $3.77\times$ at the same semantic score, trading away 10\% of the motion. On minute-long videos (LoCoT2V-Bench), where the 14B model degrades when it reads its own long history, BigSmall is $3.14\times$ faster than the 14B model and scores higher ($+1.78$).`

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的“BigSmall”规划器—渲染器采样框架：大模型（14B）只负责首块规划与内容变化处的草图，小模型（1.3B）负责其余渲染，通过近似/窗口化/惰性跨模型KV缓存实现低成本切换，在语义分数不变下加速3.02×。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散逐块流式生成，但大模型推理太慢，难以实时。作者追问：在一次AR rollout中，大模型究竟在哪一环节才真正必要，从而用最小的“大模型预算”换回其性能优势。
AI.method: 配对共享隐空间与去噪调度的大模型Krea-Realtime-14B与小模型Self-Forcing-1.3B，先做“顺序消融”：仅首块由14B生成、其余由1.3B续写时保留95%语义优势，反向分配仅保留16%但成本约10×。据此构建免训练planner–renderer采样器：14B规划开场块并在内容变化处出草图以保运动，1.3B渲染其余块；加速变体仅规划开场块。并设计近似、窗口化、惰性的跨模型KV缓存，使规划器低价地进出rollout。
AI.result: VBench上BigSmall较14B模型快3.02×且语义分数与运动不变；较“小模型先起草”的SDVG快1.55×；同语义分数下BigSmall可达3.77×，代价是运动指标下降10%。在LoCoT2V-Bench分钟级长视频上，14B因读取自身长历史而退化，BigSmall快3.14×且分数更高（+1.78）。
AI.conclusion: 大模型决定“视频显示什么”，小模型只需“把内容延续下去”；将大模型算力集中在规划与关键时刻即可近乎无损地继承其语义能力，配合跨模型KV缓存可显著降低自回归视频生成的延迟。

title: Hypothesis Generation and Semantic Attribution in Inverse Perturbation Modeling
summary: Understanding gene regulatory relationships at scale can help identify intervention points and anticipate unintended effects, but connecting a black-box model's learned computation to biological knowledge remains difficult. We investigate whether a sparse, typed gene network can generate inspectable hypotheses for steering malignant transcriptional programs toward expression patterns associated with favorable prognosis. Using LINCS L1000 CRISPR/Cas9 profiles paired with matched plate controls, we train a graph neural network to recover the perturbed gene from baseline and endpoint expression. Nodes combine ProTrek-derived protein representations with expression features; edges encode signed regulatory relationships and other gene interactions. We use this inverse formulation to nominate interventions for a desired multigene expression change in a specified cancer-cell context, and use integrated gradients and conductance along a path from the cell baseline toward the requested endpoint to attribute each nomination to gene states, typed messages, and residual connections. In A549, the model nominates TTK although its expression is unchanged in the request; the account assigns supporting credit through the checkpoint-associated MAD1L1 relationship and opposing credit through the E2F4 transcriptional-regulatory channel. Across 333 screened nominations in nine held-out cell lines, request-path attribution shows positive line-averaged correspondence with finite message-deletion effects at every transition. Existing TTK knockout measurements show requested-direction agreement across other markers at the 98.2nd percentile (10 wells), and ten of seventeen measured cases in the illustrative screen meet the predefined support criterion. These analyses make competing biological accounts of a nomination examinable and open to experimental test.

AI.tldr: 该文提出用稀疏、带类型的基因调控网络（图神经网络）进行逆向建模，从基线到终点的表达变化反推被扰动基因，并把提名归因到具体基因状态、带类型消息和残差连接，从而使黑色盒模型的"提名"变成可检验的生物学假设。
AI.motivation: 规模化理解基因调控关系有助于识别干预靶点并预判非预期效应，但将黑箱模型学到的计算与生物学知识对应起来仍然困难。作者希望验证：稀疏、带类型的基因网络能否生成可检视的假设，用于将恶性转录程序导向与良好预后相关的表达模式。
AI.method: 使用LINCS L1000 CRISPR/Cas9扰动谱及配对板对照；训练图神经网络从基线表达与终点表达反推被扰动基因（逆向建模）。节点融合ProTrek蛋白表示与表达特征，边编码带符号的调控关系及其他基因互作。在指定癌细胞背景下，为期望的多基因表达改变提名干预靶点；再用积分梯度与沿"细胞基线→目标终点"路径的conductance，将每个提名归因到基因状态、带类型消息与残差连接。评估集为9个留出细胞系中333个提名。
AI.result: A549中模型提名TTK，尽管TTK表达在请求中未改变；归因通过检查点相关的MAD1L1关系给出支持性贡献，通过E2F4转录调控通道给出反向贡献。在9个留出细胞系的333个提名中，请求路径归因与逐步有限消息删除效应在各转换处均呈正的细胞系平均对应关系。既有TTK敲除测量显示所请求方向的标记一致性处于第98.2百分位（10孔），示例筛选中17个实测案例里10个满足预设支持判据。
AI.conclusion: 该分析框架使针对某一提名的相互竞争的生物学解释变得可检视、可开展实验验证，为将黑箱模型的干预提名转化为有生物学含义的可证伪假设提供了途径。

title: Action Windows Are Inherently Temporal: A Benchmark for Time-Sensitive Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language model (VLM) agents have surpassed learned-policy baselines on existing robotic manipulation benchmarks. However, these agents still struggle with time-sensitive everyday tasks that existing benchmarks for VLM agents cover only partially. In these tasks, evolving physical processes create finite windows for successful intervention. These action windows are inherently temporal and impose a shared time budget on decision making and physical execution. Coordinating intervention within this budget requires agents to determine when the window opens. We introduce AWAIT, a simulation benchmark that evaluates task completion within action windows while accounting for decision and execution time. Our evaluation reveals difficulties in recognizing window onset and shows that successive decisions and movements can exhaust an action window even when each decision takes less than the window duration. Project page: https://eyja42.github.io/await-site/.

AI.tldr: AWAIT 是评估 VLM 智能体在"动作窗口"内完成任务的仿真基准，同时计入决策与执行耗时，实验揭示现有 VLM 智能体难以识别窗口开启时机。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 智能体已在机器人操作基准上超越学习策略基线，但对时序敏感的日常任务仍表现不佳；这类任务中物理过程持续演化，形成有限的可干预时间窗口，而现有基准仅部分覆盖。窗口本身是时序性的，并对决策与执行共享统一时间预算。
AI.method: 提出 AWAIT 仿真基准：在动作窗口内评估任务完成情况，并将决策时间与执行时间共同计入时间预算；要求智能体判断窗口何时开启，并在共享预算内协调干预。
AI.result: 评估显示 VLM 智能体在识别窗口起始点方面存在困难；即使单次决策耗时短于窗口时长，连续多次决策与动作也可能耗尽整个动作窗口。
AI.conclusion: 时序敏感的"动作窗口"是 VLM 智能体的关键短板，需在基准与智能体设计中显式建模决策-执行的时间耦合。

title: Layer-Level Control of Language Model Execution in Agent Frameworks
summary: Agent frameworks typically orchestrate language models through prompt-and-response interfaces. We propose a harness design that exposes intermediate model states and layer-level execution controls to the agent runtime. By connecting state collection, policy fitting, and execution, the design enables policies to allocate computation within and across models based on intermediate states. We demonstrate the approach with a prototype that learns stitching bridges and state-conditioned execution policies from paired model states, then applies them during inference to select among continue, exit, and stitch. For dispatcher supervision, we select the least-computation action whose full-vocabulary next-token prediction matches the source model's full-depth prediction, using continue when neither early action matches. We train these components on a frozen proxy corpus of 5,000 typed-decision items authored using source texts sampled from WildChat conversations, then evaluate the prototype on JevBench measuring task accuracy, agreement with full-model predictions, and end-to-end latency including runtime overhead. Preliminary results show an approximately 15% reduction in mean latency while maintaining task accuracy comparable to full-model inference.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"harness"设计，将模型中间状态与层级执行控制暴露给智能体运行时，通过状态采集—策略拟合—执行闭环，使策略能基于中间状态在模型内和跨模型分配计算；原型学习"拼接桥"与状态条件执行策略，在推理时选择 continue/exit/stitch，实现约15%的平均延迟下降且任务准确率与全模型推理相当。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体框架主要通过"提示—响应"接口编排语言模型，模型内部中间状态与层间执行过程对运行时不可见，无法基于内部信号动态分配计算资源，导致推理开销固定、缺少自适应加速手段。
AI.method: 设计暴露中间状态与层级控制的harness，贯通状态采集、策略拟合与执行三环节；原型从成对模型状态中学习stitching bridge（拼接桥）与状态条件执行策略，推理时在continue、exit、stitch三种动作中选择；调度器监督采用"最小计算动作"准则——选取全词表下一词预测与源模型全深度预测一致的最省计算动作，两者均不匹配时回退到continue；在冻结的代理语料（5,000条带类型标注的决策样本，源文本取自WildChat对话）上训练各组件。
AI.result: 在JevBench上评估任务准确率、与全模型预测的一致性以及含运行时开销的端到端延迟；初步结果显示平均延迟降低约15%，任务准确率与全模型推理相当。
AI.conclusion: 将中间状态与层级执行控制开放给智能体运行时是可行的，状态条件化的continue/exit/stitch策略可在几乎不损失准确率的前提下显著降低延迟；但当前仅为原型与初步结果，需在更多任务与更大规模语料上验证泛化性与开销收益。

title: Center-Aware Ordinal Learning for Prostate Cancer Grading from Histopathology Images
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Accepted as an oral presentation at SPIE Medical Imaging 2027
summary: Prostate cancer grading from histopathology whole-slide images (WSIs) is complicated by the ordered nature of ISUP grades, class imbalance, and center-dependent variations in staining, tissue preparation, and scanning. Most weakly supervised methods treat grade groups as independent categories and may therefore learn representations that do not transfer reliably across institutions. We propose a center-aware ordinal learning framework that combines a pretrained pathology encoder with attention-based multiple instance learning. The framework uses an Earth Mover's Distance loss to account for ordinal errors, an ordinal supervised contrastive objective to align same-grade slides across centers while separating grades according to disease severity, and curriculum learning to reduce the dominance of benign cases. We evaluate the framework on approximately 9,100 biopsy WSIs from the two-center PANDA dataset. The proposed framework achieves an accuracy of 0.842 and a quadratic weighted kappa of 0.958 on the held-out test set. Its main benefit is observed in cross-center transfer: when a linear probe is trained on Karolinska representations and evaluated on Radboud, accuracy increases from 0.643 to 0.823 and quadratic weighted kappa from 0.899 to 0.930. Performance remains stable in the reverse direction. UMAP projections further show improved mixing between centers while preserving an ordinal grade trajectory. These results suggest that combining ordinal and center-aware objectives produces more transferable slide representations for multi-center prostate cancer grading.

AI.tldr: 提出一种中心感知的序数学习框架，将预训练病理编码器与注意力多实例学习结合，用EMD损失、序数监督对比损失和课程学习改进多中心前列腺癌ISUP分级，跨中心迁移性能显著提升。
AI.motivation: 前列腺癌WSI分级面临三个难点：ISUP等级具有序数性、类别不平衡、以及染色/制片/扫描带来的中心间差异。多数弱监督方法把等级组当作独立类别处理，学到的表征难以跨机构可靠迁移。
AI.method: 框架由预训练病理编码器+基于注意力的多实例学习构成，并引入三项设计：(1) Earth Mover's Distance损失以建模序数误差；(2) 序数监督对比目标，在跨中心对齐同级切片、同时按疾病严重程度分离不同等级；(3) 课程学习以降低良性病例的主导性。
AI.result: 在两中心PANDA数据集约9,100张穿刺WSI上评估：留出测试集准确率0.842、二次加权kappa 0.958。主要收益体现在跨中心迁移：线性探针在Karolinska表征上训练、在Radboud上评估时，准确率由0.643升至0.823，QWK由0.899升至0.930；反向迁移性能稳定。UMAP显示中心间混合改善，同时保留序数等级轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 结合序数与中心感知目标可产生更具迁移性的切片表征，适用于多中心前列腺癌分级。

title: DiRGeo: Learning Directional Geometry of Visual Representations
summary: Conventional geometric measures of visual representations are symmetric, assigning equal costs to forward and reverse motion along the same path. We propose DiRGeo, a framework for learning directional geometry over frozen visual representations. Grounded in Randers geometry, DiRGeo learns a state-dependent directional field from ordered image trajectories through self-supervised contrast, without semantic labels. Sphere-tangent correction and attractor-relative decomposition distinguish learned directional structure from normalization artifacts and common convergence. Experiments across 17 visual processes, three encoder families, and multiple representation depths demonstrate consistent directional discrimination and whole-path asymmetry beyond simple attractor-based explanations. The learned fields become increasingly process-specific in deeper representations, while natural-video experiments reveal event-dependent directional preferences. As functional validation, DiRGeo guides restoration selection. These results establish directional geometry as a useful complement to symmetric representation analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出DiRGeo框架，在冻结视觉表征上学习基于Randers几何的方向性几何，从有序图像轨迹自监督学习状态依赖方向场，实现超越对称度量的方向判别与全程路径不对称性。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉表征的几何度量是对称的，沿同一路径的正向与反向运动代价相等，无法刻画视觉过程的方向性信息；需要一种能与现有对称表征分析互补的方向性几何描述。
AI.method: 以Randers几何为理论基础，从有序图像轨迹出发，通过自监督对比学习状态依赖的方向场，无需语义标签；引入球面切向校正（sphere-tangent correction）以区分学习到的方向结构与归一化伪影，并用吸引子相对分解（attractor-relative decomposition）排除由共同收敛导致的表观不对称。
AI.result: 在17种视觉过程、三类编码器家族及多个表征深度上均表现出一致的方向判别能力与整体路径不对称性，且不能由简单吸引子解释；方向场在更深层表征中趋于过程特异化；自然视频实验显示事件依赖的方向偏好；作为功能验证，DiRGeo可指导图像修复/恢复方案的选择。
AI.conclusion: 方向性几何可作为对称表征分析的有效补充，为视觉表征研究提供新的几何视角与实用工具。

title: JEPA-Shield: Safe Diffusion Planning with Latent World Models via Conformal Shielding
summary: Latent world models enable planning from images, but their predictions do not directly establish whether a robot will satisfy physical constraints. We present JEPA-Shield, which connects a frozen action-conditioned Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world model to task-space safety enforcement. Two downstream models predict relative motion from imagined latent rollouts and decode unsafe geometry from the current image. Split conformal prediction turns end-to-end motion-prediction errors into multi-horizon uncertainty tubes. A backup-based shield checks these tubes against physical constraints and screens both candidate trajectories and final proposals in diffusion-inspired sampling-based model predictive control. Under the stated exchangeability and initial-backup assumptions, we establish probabilistic constraint satisfaction at action-block boundaries for a returned plan executed without replanning. We also introduce VParkBench, with geometric car and tractor-trailer parking tasks and a editable photorealistic Gaussian-splatting environment. In closed-loop evaluation, JEPA-Shield achieves success rates of 84.4%, 82.3%, and 99.0%, respectively, with no observed constraint violations. Ablations show complementary benefits from shielding and uncertainty calibration. The results demonstrate the importance of grounding latent world-model predictions in task-space quantities and explicitly accounting for prediction uncertainty in safety-critical planning.

AI.tldr: JEPA-Shield 将冻结的 JEPA 潜空间世界模型与任务空间安全约束执行相衔接，用分裂共形预测把端到端运动预测误差转化为多步不确定性管，并借助备份式 shield 在采样型 MPC 中对候选与最终轨迹进行安全筛选。理论上有条件地保证动作块边界的概率约束满足；在新增的 VParkBench 上闭环成功率达 84.4%/82.3%/99.0%，未观察到约束违反。
AI.motivation: 潜世界模型可从图像进行规划，但其潜空间预测本身无法直接判定机器人是否满足物理约束（如几何碰撞、可行域），存在"预测准确≠安全可控"的落地鸿沟；安全关键规划中还缺少对预测不确定性的显式刻画。
AI.method: 1) 采用冻结的动作条件 JEPA 世界模型做潜空间 rollout；2) 训练两个下游模型：从想象的潜轨迹预测相对运动、从当前图像解码不安全几何；3) 用分裂共形预测把端到端运动预测误差标定为多时域不确定性管；4) 设计基于备份策略的 shield，将不确定性管与物理约束比较，在扩散式采样型 MPC 中对候选轨迹和最终提案双重筛选；5) 提出 VParkBench 基准，含几何小车与拖拉机-挂车泊车任务及可编辑的真实感高斯溅射环境。
AI.result: 闭环评估中三类任务成功率分别为 84.4%、82.3%、99.0%，未观察到约束违反；消融实验表明 shielding 与不确定性标定带来互补收益。
AI.conclusion: 将潜世界模型预测落地到任务空间量、并在安全关键规划中显式计入预测不确定性十分必要；在交换性与初始备份假设下，可实现返回计划（不再重规划执行）在动作块边界的概率约束满足。

title: Scalar Tuned Lens Summaries Offer Limited Incremental Value for Mid-Generation Abstention
summary: Mid-generation abstention aims to stop an unpromising response before spending its remaining computation budget. Intermediate transformer states may help predict eventual correctness, but whether scalar summaries of their vocabulary predictions add useful evidence is less clear. We compare Tuned Lens entropy and divergence features with final-state and raw intermediate-state probes under matched, causal evaluation. Across eight instruction-tuned models on MATH-500, raw intermediate states improve ranking, whereas scalar-only probes usually trail the final-state baseline. Scalar hybrids have positive exceptions, but their advantage over position-matched permutation controls is small. Cross-fitted residual comparisons further show that gains over a final-state probe need not require aligned scalar features. Actual stopping runs on two model sizes and two benchmarks reveal a separate accuracy--computation trade-off, with token savings overstating wall-time savings for scalar policies. The evidence supports a restricted empirical conclusion about these scalar features, not a general negative claim about intermediate representations.

AI.tldr: 该论文在匹配的因果评估下，比较了Tuned Lens熵/散度等标量特征与原始中间状态探针用于生成中途弃答（mid-generation abstention）的效果：原始中间状态改善排序，而纯标量探针通常不及最终状态基线。
AI.motivation: 生成中途弃答需要在耗尽其剩余计算预算前终止无望的回复。中间Transformer状态可能有助于预测最终正确性，但标量化的词表预测摘要是否提供有用证据尚不明确，且以往比较缺乏匹配、因果化的评测。
AI.method: 在八个指令微调模型（MATH-500）上进行匹配的因果评估，对比Tuned Lens熵与散度特征、最终状态探针、原始中间状态探针及标量混合探针；引入位置匹配的置换对照与交叉拟合残差比较；并在两种模型规模、两个基准上运行实际停止策略，同时测量token节省与墙钟时间节省。
AI.result: 原始中间状态提升排序性能，纯标量探针一般落后于最终状态基线；标量混合探针存在正例，但相对位置匹配置换对照的优势很小；交叉拟合残差显示超越最终状态探针的收益并不必需对齐标量特征；实际停止实验呈独立的精度—计算权衡，标量策略的token节省高估了墙钟时间节省。
AI.conclusion: 作者给出关于这些标量特征的受限实证结论，而非对中间表示的一般性否定论断。

title: Decoding Frozen Vision Representations for Training-Free Few-Shot Pineapple Detection
comment: Accepted in WACV HARVEST Vision Workshop 2027
summary: Few-shot object detection in agricultural imagery is hampered by dense vegetation, repeated patterns, and scarce annotations. We present a training-free detector that turns dense features from frozen visual foundation models directly into detections, without fine-tuning, a learned head, or external proposals: a whitened foreground-background direction estimated from annotated support images scores every query patch, and the score field is decoded with an adaptive threshold and support-derived geometry. We also test whether predicted relative depth can be fed directly to RGB-pretrained frozen encoders. On aerial pineapple imagery, the detector outperforms PET-DINO and GeCo2 at every evaluated support size; at K=40, predicted depth alone reaches 92% of the RGB performance with DINOv2, and RGB-depth fusion lowers counting error for both encoders. We release the Pineapple Plantation dataset (4,908 aerial frames, 1,995 annotated with 17,609 boxes, predicted depth, leakage-aware splits) and analyse transfer to two further agricultural datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练（training-free）少样本农业目标检测器：直接从冻结视觉基础模型的高维稠密特征中用白化的前景-背景方向打分，无需微调、学习式检测头或外部区域提议；并验证预测相对深度可直接输入 RGB 预训练的冻结编码器。在航拍菠萝数据上各支持集规模均优于 PET-DINO 与 GeCo2。
AI.motivation: 农业影像中的少样本目标检测受密集植被、重复纹理模式与标注稀缺所困，现有基于微调或学习式检测头的方案在极少样本与强干扰场景下代价高、泛化差。
AI.method: 1) 使用冻结的视觉基础模型提取稠密特征；2) 由带标注的支持图像估计白化的前景-背景判别方向，对所有查询图像 patch 打分；3) 以自适应阈值结合由支持集推导的几何先验解码得分场；4) 额外测试将预测相对深度直接送入 RGB 预训练的冻结编码器，并做 RGB-深度特征融合。
AI.result: 在航拍菠萝影像上，各评测支持集规模下均优于 PET-DINO 和 GeCo2；K=40 时，仅用预测深度配合 DINOv2 可达 RGB 性能的 92%；RGB-深度融合对两种编码器均降低计数误差；并在另外两个农业数据集上分析迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 冻结基础模型的稠密特征经简单的白化方向判别即可支撑有效的少样本检测，无需任何训练；预测深度可作为 RGB 编码器的有效补充模态。同时发布 Pineapple Plantation 数据集（4,908 帧航拍影像，其中 1,995 帧含 17,609 个框标注，附预测深度与防泄漏划分）。

title: HME-PFD: Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Privileged Feature Distillation
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) is widely used to transfer knowledge from large teacher models to smaller student models, facilitating efficient serving of machine learning systems. In the context of ads recommendation, privileged features distillation (PFD) extends KD by allowing the teacher model to leverage privileged features, i.e., features available only during training, to enhance distillation performance. However, in real-world scenarios, privileged features often have limited coverage and exhibit heterogeneous distributions, resulting in training examples of varying importance for distillation and model learning. We propose Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Privileged Feature Distillation (HME-PFD), a novel approach that incorporates privileged features into the routing module of a Mixture-of-Experts-based student model. Our method introduces both hard-coded and learnable routing modules, enabling the student to dynamically determine expert assignment based on the availability and values of privileged features. This design allows the student model to better handle the heterogeneous data scenario, where privileged features are partially observed, by differentiating between high- and low-signal samples. Extensive experiments on two post-click conversion prediction tasks demonstrate that HME-PFD consistently outperforms baseline methods. Our results show that leveraging privileged features for expert routing in the student model leads to improved model performance, even when privileged features are incomplete or sparse.

AI.tldr: 提出HME-PFD，将特权特征引入MoE学生模型的路由模块，用硬编码与可学习路由动态分配专家，以应对特权特征覆盖有限、分布异构的场景。
AI.motivation: 广告推荐中的特权特征蒸馏（PFD）利用仅训练期可用的特征提升蒸馏效果，但真实场景下特权特征覆盖率有限且分布异构，导致不同样本对蒸馏与模型学习的重要性差异显著，现有方法未显式建模该异质性。
AI.method: 在基于MoE的学生模型中，将特权特征注入路由模块；同时设计硬编码路由（依据特权特征可用性与取值规则化分配）与可学习路由（数据驱动分配）两类模块，使学生模型可依据特权特征的可用性和数值动态确定专家分配，从而区分高信号与低信号样本。
AI.result: 在两个后点击转化率（CVR）预测任务上的大量实验表明，HME-PFD 一致优于基线方法；即使特权特征不完整或稀疏，将其用于专家路由仍能提升模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 将特权特征用于学生模型的专家路由是处理异构特权特征数据的有效手段，可在特征覆盖不全的条件下稳定获得性能增益，为推荐系统蒸馏提供新思路。

title: Dr. Grasp-RL: Diverse and Robust Dexterous Grasping via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Human interaction with physical objects relies on a combination of dexterity and robustness. In robotic manipulation, dexterity requires not only flexible end effectors but also a diverse repertoire of manipulation strategies, while robustness requires closed-loop adaptation to disturbances and unexpected situations. Two prominent research directions in dexterous grasping have largely addressed these capabilities separately. Generative approaches model multimodal distributions to produce diverse grasp poses, but their reliance on open-loop execution can limit robustness. Reinforcement learning approaches learn closed-loop grasping policies, but can converge to a narrow range of successful grasping strategies, limiting behavioral diversity. We introduce a time-reversed curriculum with a coordinated reset mechanism that enables a simple MLP policy trained with PPO to capture multiple modes of the grasp-pose distribution while maintaining closed-loop control. Experiments demonstrate both diverse grasping behaviors and robust closed-loop execution. Trained on only approximately 400 objects, our policy further demonstrates strong generalization when evaluated on more than 20,000 unseen objects.

AI.tldr: 提出时间反转课程学习与协调重置机制，使简单MLP策略经PPO训练即可兼顾抓取姿态分布的多模态多样性与闭环鲁棒性，并在2万余未见物体上展现强泛化。
AI.motivation: 灵巧抓取中，生成式方法能建模多模态分布生成多样抓取姿态，但开环执行鲁棒性差；强化学习方法可学闭环策略，却常收敛到狭窄的成功抓取模式，行为多样性不足。两类能力此前基本被分开处理。
AI.method: 引入时间反转课程学习（time-reversed curriculum）配合协调重置机制（coordinated reset），用简单MLP策略结合PPO训练，在保持闭环控制的同时覆盖抓取姿态分布的多个模态。
AI.result: 实验表明策略同时具备多样化抓取行为与鲁棒的闭环执行能力；仅用约400个物体训练，在超过20,000个未见物体上评估仍表现出强泛化。
AI.conclusion: 时间反转课程与协调重置可有效统一抓取的多样性与鲁棒性，为灵巧抓取提供一种简洁且泛化良好的闭环策略学习范式。

title: Rethinking Closed-Ended Medical VLM Evaluation: From Stable Wrongness to Counterfactual Answer Sensitivity
summary: As medical VLMs are increasingly evaluated for clinical decision-support scenarios, knowing when to trust their predictions is critical. Closed-ended medical VQA has become a common benchmark format because it enables automated scoring. Yet, systematic investigation into whether this format changes the reliability problem remains scarce. We identify a failure mode that we call stable wrongness: models can produce incorrect yes/no answers that remain confident and repeatable even when patient-specific visual evidence is removed or mismatched. This failure violates the premise behind sampling-stability uncertainty methods, including recent hallucination-aware calibration (HAC) variants: disagreement is informative only when errors are unstable. When shortcut-driven errors are themselves stable, sampling agreement can remain deceptively high. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce Counterfactual Answer Sensitivity (CAS), which shifts reliability estimation from answer stability to evidence sensitivity. CAS uses cross-modal counterfactual interventions, such as text-only, black, and corrupted images, to audit whether a committed yes/no answer remains supported when visual evidence is invalidated. Across 7 VLMs and 3 benchmarks, CAS outperforms the best HAC-family scores across all evaluated settings, achieving a macro-averaged AUROC gain of +0.150 for error detection. Mechanistic analysis further shows that CAS recovers hidden errors in the HAC-confident region and that its strongest standalone signal is counterfactual decision-boundary shift rather than hard prediction stability. Our findings suggest that closed-ended evaluation should test visual dependence, not only answer stability, in safety-critical medical contexts.

AI.tldr: 论文指出闭集医疗VQA中模型可产生"稳定错误"（stable wrongness）：即使去掉或错配患者视觉证据，错误的yes/no答案仍保持高置信且可复现，从而破坏基于采样一致性的不确定性方法（含HAC变体）的前提；为此提出反事实答案敏感性（CAS），将可靠性估计从"答案稳定性"转向"证据敏感性"。在7个VLM、3个基准上CAS在所有设置下优于最佳HAC族方法，错误检测宏平均AUROC提升+0.150。
AI.motivation: 医疗视觉语言模型（VLM）被越来越多用于临床决策支持，判断何时应信任其预测至关重要。闭集医疗VQA因可自动评分成为常用评测格式，但该格式是否改变可靠性问题尚缺乏系统研究。作者发现采样稳定性类不确定性方法（分歧才有信息量）依赖"错误不稳定"这一前提，而捷径驱动的错误本身可能高度稳定，导致采样一致率虚高、可靠性估计失效。
AI.method: 提出反事实答案敏感性（CAS）：不再度量答案稳定性，而度量模型对视觉证据的敏感性。具体采用跨模态反事实干预——纯文本输入、全黑图像、被破坏（corrupted）图像——审计模型已给出的yes/no答案在视觉证据被无效化后是否仍能得到支持。机理分析中，最强的单一信号是反事实决策边界偏移（decision-boundary shift），而非硬预测稳定性。
AI.result: 在7个VLM与3个基准上，CAS在所有评测设置中均优于HAC族最佳分数，错误检测宏平均AUROC提升+0.150；机理分析表明CAS能回收位于HAC高置信区域中的隐藏错误，且其最强独立信号为反事实决策边界偏移。
AI.conclusion: 闭集医疗VQA评测不应只检验答案稳定性，还应检验视觉依赖性；在安全攸关的医疗场景中，应将证据敏感性作为可靠性评估的核心维度。

title: CAMA: Calibrated Anti-Collapse Marginal Alignment for Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
summary:
Test-time adaptation (TTA) updates a model using unlabeled test data to help it handle distribution shifts. However, prior work has found that image corruption causes a vision-language model (VLM) to produce more similar features for different images, a phenomenon known as feature compression. Under compression, entropy minimization, the most common TTA objective, can cause the model to favor a few classes and perform worse than before adaptation. Despite these observations, a detailed analysis of how these failures are connected and an effective strategy for preventing them are still lacking.
  In this paper, we first analyze why entropy minimization fails for VLMs. We then propose CAMA, a new test-time adaptation objective that maximizes batch mutual information to encourage confident predictions for individual images while maintaining diverse predictions across the batch. CAMA also estimates a reference class distribution early in the test stream and aligns each batch's average prediction with this reference during adaptation. We prove that feature compression biases the predictions and that entropy minimization amplifies this bias into collapse, whereas CAMA is guaranteed to preserve every class. Across standard corruption benchmarks, we observe collapse on nearly every VLM backbone evaluated. CAMA prevents collapse in every observed case and, in turn, achieves the best accuracy on every backbone. Quantitative and qualitative analyses confirm that CAMA reverses the feature compression behind the collapse, and ablations show that each of its components contributes.

AI.tldr: 提出CAMA——一种以批互信息最大化为核心的测试时适应目标，通过兼顾单样本置信与批次内预测多样性并锚定参考类分布，从理论上防止VLM在特征压缩下的熵最小化坍缩，在所有测试骨干与损坏基准上取得最佳精度。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在图像损坏导致的分布偏移下会出现"特征压缩"，即不同图像的特征趋于相似。此时最常用的TTA目标——熵最小化——会驱使模型偏向少数类别，形成预测坍缩，性能反而低于适应前。已有工作虽观察到该现象，但缺乏对失败机理的细致分析以及有效的防止策略。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析熵最小化对VLM失败的原因，证明特征压缩会引入预测偏置，而熵最小化将该偏置放大为坍缩；2) 提出CAMA目标：最大化批次互信息，既鼓励单张图像的置信预测，又保持批内预测的类别多样性；3) 在测试流早期估计参考类分布，并在适应过程中将每批平均预测与该参考分布对齐；4) 给出CAMA保证各类别均不被丢弃的理论结果。
AI.result: 在标准损坏基准上，几乎所有评估的VLM骨干都出现坍缩；CAMA在所有观测案例中均成功防止坍缩，并在每个骨干上取得最优精度。定量与定性分析表明CAMA逆转了导致坍缩的特征压缩，消融实验验证了各组成部分均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 熵最小化在特征压缩条件下的坍缩源于偏置被放大，而CAMA通过批互信息最大化与参考分布对齐可从根本上避免类别坍缩，是一种对VLM测试时适应更稳健有效的目标。

title: When Can a Rewiring Control Test LLM Weight Readers? C2 and an Eligibility Protocol
summary: Large language models can predict the outputs of small neural networks from raw weights, but success could reflect recognition of weight-space regularities (fingerprints) rather than computation, and function-preserving controls cannot tell these apart. We propose C2, a counterfactual that permutes the columns of a network's final linear readout: every other parameter, and the readout's singular values, norms and entry multiset, are unchanged, and the function can change in an exactly recomputable way; we verify that each evaluated permutation does. C2 separates fingerprinting from computation only under three conditions, which we state as an eligibility protocol: a strategy restricted to C2-invariant summaries must already predict the target; C2 must change a property specific to the rewiring; and the reader's identity must be attested. No natural setting we tested is eligible. On tiny MLPs a frontier reader route followed the rewired function on all 24 networks, but invariant baselines were near chance and its backend could not be attested. In two public CNN zoos the conditions traded off: weight statistics predicted CIFAR-10 accuracy in-distribution, but C2's effect on accuracy was not specific to the swap, while per-image targets were specific but not predictable from invariant summaries. On a constructed population where a planted fingerprint rule works, all conditions hold and C2 separates a rule-following reader from an executor. A self-hosted Qwen3.8-27B followed the rewired function rather than the shortcut, and showed no evidence of using the weights with thinking disabled. A registered replication on fresh networks confirmed both findings (tracking minus stuck 0.875, 95% interval [0.750, 1.000]), and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B also followed the rewiring (tracking minus stuck 0.729 [0.552, 0.885]). The transforms, audits and raw records are available from the authors.

AI.tldr: 提出反事实扰动C2（置换末端线性读出层列），并给出"资格协议"三条件，用以区分LLM读权重时是在"识别指纹"还是在"执行计算"；实测中几乎所有自然场景均不合格，仅构造人群满足条件。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明LLM可从原始权重预测小网络输出，但这一成功可能只是识别了权重空间中的规律（指纹），而非真正进行前向计算；且现有的保函数控制实验无法区分二者。
AI.method: 提出C2：置换网络最后一层线性读出矩阵的列，保持其余全部参数以及该读出的奇异值、范数和元素多重集不变，使函数以可精确重算的方式改变，并逐一验证每次置换确实改变了函数。将区分指纹与计算的前提形式化为"资格协议"三条件：(1) 仅用C2不变摘要的策略须已能预测目标；(2) C2须改变一个该重连特有的属性；(3) 读取者身份须可验证。用小MLP、两个公开CNN动物园、构造人群及自托管大模型（Qwen3.8-27B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B）进行检验，并做注册式重复实验。
AI.result: 所测自然场景均不满足资格。小MLP上前沿读取者路径在全部24个网络上跟随重连函数，但不变基线接近随机水平且其后端无法验证；两个公开CNN动物园中三条件互相取舍（权重统计可分布内预测CIFAR-10精度但C2效应非特异，逐图目标特异但不可由不变摘要预测）。在植入了指纹规则的构造人群上三条件全部满足，C2成功区分规则遵循者与执行者；Qwen3.8-27B遵循重连函数而非捷径，关闭思维链时无使用权重的证据。注册重复在全新网络上确认（tracking减stuck = 0.875，95%区间[0.750,1.000]），DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B同样跟随重连（0.729 [0.552,0.885]）。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭"正确预测输出"不足以证明LLM在从权重执行计算；需在满足不变性、特异性和身份验证三条件的场景下使用C2类反事实才能作出归因。现有自然基准大多不具备该资格，构造性实验与注册复现提供了可控证据，变换、审计与原始记录公开。

title: TASC: Time-to-Collision Anticipation and Selective Crowd Attention for Non-Holonomic Service Robots
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Accepted for publication at the 2027 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration (SII)
summary: Service robots that share corridors and lobbies with people must keep moving without endangering them. Reactive planners can stop indefinitely in dense crowds (the freezing robot problem), whereas the attention-based learned navigators that dominate the standard crowd benchmark assume holonomic motion or emit discrete actions unsuited to a differential-drive base. This paper presents TASC, a navigation system for a non-holonomic service robot that integrates an attention-based crowd encoder, an anticipatory collision feature, and a continuous-control policy. We adapt the dual-selection attention module, originally developed for discrete-action value learning, to proximal policy optimization for continuous velocity control, and add a closing-speed time-to-collision feature, a conservative estimate of the time to contact that serves as both an observation and a reward term. The policy is trained on a high-fidelity 3D robot model in NVIDIA Isaac Lab with 10,000 parallel environments, social-force-model pedestrians, and randomized crowd sizes. In 30,000 evaluation episodes, each run to its end, the policy timed out in fewer than 0.5% at every tested crowd density. This liveness comes at a cost: pedestrian collisions rise from 4.5% with five pedestrians to 17.4% with ten. In an ablation with four seeds per variant, policies retrained without the time-to-collision feature succeed 4 to 7 percentage points less often. The policy runs in Gazebo without retraining and on a commercial differential-drive service robot through a ROS 2 package with an inference latency below 10 ms, verified in a hardware-in-the-loop test with virtual pedestrians.

AI.tldr: 提出TASC：面向差速驱动服务机器人的导航系统，融合注意力人群编码、碰撞时间特征与连续控制策略，实现高活跃度人群导航。
AI.motivation: 服务机器人在密集人群中需持续移动且不危及行人。反应式规划器易陷入"冻结机器人问题"无限停滞；主流人群基准上的注意力学习导航器假设全向运动或输出离散动作，不适配差速驱动底盘。
AI.method: 将原用于离散动作值学习的双选择注意力模块适配到PPO连续速度控制；引入闭合速度时间碰撞（TTC）特征，同时作为观测项与奖励项；在NVIDIA Isaac Lab中用高保真3D模型、10000并行环境、社会力模型行人及随机人群规模训练策略。
AI.result: 3万回合完整评测中，各人群密度下超时率均低于0.5%；但行人碰撞率由5人时的4.5%升至10人时的17.4%；每变体4个种子的消融显示，去除TTC特征后成功率下降4–7个百分点；策略无需重训即可在Gazebo运行，并经ROS 2包部署于商用差速驱动服务机器人，推理延迟低于10 ms，硬件在环测试验证。
AI.conclusion: TASC在保证活跃性的同时存在碰撞率随密度上升的代价，TTC特征对性能有显著贡献，且具备良好的仿真到实物迁移能力与实时性。

title: Similarity-Constrained Reweighting for Complex Query Answering on Knowledge Graphs
summary: Machine learning models for Complex Query Answering (CQA) on knowledge graphs estimate the likelihood of answers that are not reachable via direct traversal. Recent work has proposed extending such queries with soft entity constraints, which require the target variable to be similar or dissimilar to specified sets of entities. We study a more general formulation where similarity constraints are specified on an arbitrary variable in a query, and introduce SCORE: a computationally efficient and interpretable method for incorporating similarity constraints on an arbitrary variable of a query. SCORE is based on a lightweight and interpretable score adjustment function that only requires tuning two hyperparameters on a validation set. Our experiments show that SCORE effectively incorporates preferences while maintaining strong query answering performance. It significantly improves ranking quality when constraints apply to the target variable and performs effectively in the more general case involving constraints on intermediate variables, and its performance remains robust when applied to several existing methods for CQA. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/dfdazac/score.

AI.tldr: SCORE：一种轻量、可解释的分数调整方法，可在复杂查询的任意变量上引入相似性约束。
AI.motivation: 现有CQA工作仅将软实体约束施加于目标变量，缺乏对任意变量施加相似性约束的一般化研究。
AI.method: 提出SCORE，基于轻量可解释的分数调整函数，仅需在验证集上调节两个超参数，将相似性约束施加在查询的任意变量上。
AI.result: SCORE有效融入偏好并保持较强查询回答性能；约束作用于目标变量时显著提升排序质量，在涉及中间变量约束的更一般情形下同样有效，且可稳健迁移至多种现有CQA方法。
AI.conclusion: SCORE为带软实体约束的CQA提供了一种通用、高效且可解释的解决方案。

title: VICA: Video Contextual Agreement for AIGC Video Detection and Localization
summary: The rapid advancement of AI-generated content (AIGC) video generation and editing technologies has raised growing societal concerns about the authenticity and reliability of digital videos. Existing video detection methods primarily exploit temporal inconsistencies through holistic frame-level representations, whereas manipulation localization methods focus on artifacts within individual spatial regions. However, holistic representations may obscure localized artifacts through global feature aggregation, while region-centric approaches may overlook disagreements between individual regions and their surrounding spatiotemporal context. To address these limitations, we propose VIdeo Contextual Agreement (VICA), a unified framework that masks individual video regions and leverages a frozen V-JEPA model to predict their representations from the surrounding spatiotemporal context. Complementary masking ensures complete regional coverage, while context-conditioned predictions establish references for assessing regional agreement with the broader video context. By comparing predicted and observed representations, VICA derives spatial residuals that characterize intra-frame discrepancies and bidirectional temporal residuals that capture inconsistencies across preceding and subsequent frames. These residuals characterize contextual disagreements, providing a shared forensic representation for both tasks and shifting the focus from identifying isolated manipulation artifacts to assessing regional agreement with expectations inferred from the broader video context. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VICA achieves state-of-the-art performance on both tasks across multiple benchmarks, with strong generalization to unseen video generators and editing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出VICA统一框架，通过掩码区域并利用冻结V-JEPA从周边时空上下文预测其表征，以预测-观测残差实现AIGC视频检测与篡改定位。
AI.motivation: AIGC视频生成与编辑技术引发真实性担忧。现有视频检测方法依赖帧级整体表征捕捉时序不一致，篡改定位方法依赖单帧空间区域内的伪影。前者因全局特征聚合会掩盖局部伪影，后者忽略区域与周边时空上下文的不一致，两类方法各有局限。
AI.method: VICA对视频中单个区域进行掩码，用冻结的V-JEPA模型基于周边时空上下文预测该区域表征；采用互补掩码保证区域全覆盖；通过比较预测表征与观测表征计算空间残差（刻画帧内差异）与双向时间残差（刻画前后帧不一致），以“上下文一致性”作为两任务共享的取证表征。
AI.result: 在多个基准上于检测与定位两项任务均达到SOTA，并对未见过的视频生成器和编辑方法具有较强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将取证范式从识别孤立篡改伪影转变为评估区域与更广泛视频上下文推断期望之间的一致性，可统一支撑检测与定位任务并提升泛化性。

title: Pain Reassessment from Pulse Waveforms with Language Model Explanations
summary: Routine photoplethysmography (PPG) offers a continuous physiological signal for pain reassessment between self-reports. Whether prior recordings provide an individualized physiological reference beyond care-process timing remains unresolved. Across 52,082 report-linked assessments from 21,514 patients in MIMIC-III critical care and MC-MED emergency care, we evaluate a workflow that pairs longitudinal PPG representations with local evidence-linked language interpretation. Among 27 methods, source-selected full-history models achieved average precision of 0.824 from critical to emergency care and 0.822 in reverse. Removing historical pulse-run representations while retaining reassessment availability and elapsed time lowered critical-to-emergency four-hour within-patient concordance from 0.718 to 0.534. This comparison supports the contribution of prior pulse-run representations to within-patient ordering beyond timing cues. Across 2,905 test patients, a local Qwen model interpreting frozen predictions achieved a 94.7% patient-equal pass rate on automated evidence checks after at most one revision. Longitudinal pulse context and evidence-linked language interpretation support a patient-centred workflow for pain reassessment.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于52,082次报告关联评估（MIMIC-III与MC-MED，21,514例患者），提出将纵向PPG表征与本地证据链语言解释相结合的工作流，用于两次自报之间进行个体化疼痛再评估，并在27种方法中验证其优于时序线索。
AI.motivation: 常规光电容积脉搏波（PPG）可提供自报疼痛之间的连续生理信号，但先前记录能否提供超越护理流程时序信息的个体化生理参考尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建配对工作流：将纵向PPG表征与本地证据关联的语言解释相结合；在重症（MIMIC-III）与急诊（MC-MED）数据上跨域评估27种方法；通过消融（移除历史脉波序列表征、保留再评估可用性与已历时长）检验历史表征的独立贡献；并采用本地Qwen模型对冻结预测进行解释，经自动化证据核查（最多一次修订）。
AI.result: 源选择的全程历史模型平均精度为0.824（重症→急诊）与0.822（反向）；移除历史脉波序列表征后，四小时内患者内一致性由0.718降至0.534；2,905例测试患者中，本地Qwen解释在自动证据核查上的患者等权通过率为94.7%。
AI.conclusion: 纵向脉搏上下文与证据链语言解释支持以患者为中心的疼痛再评估工作流，且历史PPG表征对患者内排序的贡献超出单纯时序线索。

title: JKO-GRPO: Augmenting GRPO with Wasserstein Proximal Steps for Flow-Matching VLAs
summary: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $π_0,π_{0.5}$ generate continuous action chunks by flow matching, and online reinforcement learning (RL) can improve them beyond supervised fine-tuning. Existing methods, such as Flow-GRPO and $π_{\mathrm{RL}}$, optimize likelihood ratios of stochastic denoising transitions, which reweight the sampled actions by their advantages but do not use the distances between them. We propose JKO-GRPO, which augments Flow-GRPO with Wasserstein proximal steps, with two contributions: (1) At each state, we treat the group of sampled actions as an empirical distribution and formulate policy improvement as a Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) step. We use a soft discrete $c$-transform to construct transport targets from group-relative advantages and combine shared-noise regression of the deterministic flow sampler onto these targets and combined with the clipped Flow-GRPO objective without Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization. (2) We extend this approach to sequential VLA control through random-time branching: we select one or multiple action-chunk indices along old-policy trajectories and independently apply group-level JKO updates using candidate continuations from the corresponding states.

AI.tldr: JKO-GRPO在Flow-GRPO基础上引入Wasserstein近端步：将同一状态下的采样动作组视为经验分布，用软离散c-变换由组内相对优势构造传输目标，再以共享噪声回归把确定性流采样器对齐到这些目标，并结合无KL正则的截断Flow-GRPO目标；进一步通过随机时间分叉将方法扩展到序列VLA控制。
AI.motivation: 现有基于流匹配的VLA模型在线RL方法（Flow-GRPO、π_RL）只优化随机去噪转移的似然比，按优势对采样动作重加权，却忽略了动作之间的距离/几何结构信息，因此策略改进缺乏分布层面的移动方向。
AI.method: （1）状态级：把每个状态下的一组采样动作当作经验分布，将策略改进表述为JKO（Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto）步；用软离散c-变换从组相对优势构造传输目标，对确定性流采样器做共享噪声回归以匹配这些目标，并与无KL正则的截断Flow-GRPO目标联合优化。（2）序列级：采用随机时间分叉，在旧策略轨迹上选取一个或多个动作块索引，从对应状态出发用候选续接独立执行组级JKO更新。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据与量化结论；作者主张该方法在保留Flow-GRPO优势重加权的同时显式利用动作间距离，从而获得更优的策略改进，并可将该更新机制一致地推广至序列VLA控制。
AI.conclusion: 将Wasserstein近端（JKO）思想嵌入流匹配VLA的在线RL，可弥补纯似然比重加权忽视动作几何的不足；配合共享噪声回归与随机时间分叉，形成可扩展到序列控制的统一框架。

title: Wactorz: Self-Writing LLM Agents That Discover, Repair, and Migrate at the Edge
comment: 5 pages. 2 figues. Extended version of a paper accepted to the AAAI-27 Demonstrations Program. Code: https://github.com/waldiez/wactorz
summary: Most LLM agent frameworks build a crew that runs a task and exits. Physical environments (e.g., homes, labs, factory floors) need agents that stay up for months, survive their own bugs, and run on whatever hardware is already next to the sensors. We present Wactorz, an open-source runtime in which LLM-generated agents are long-lived, supervised actors: a planner turns a chat request into Python, compiles it into a new actor at runtime, and a supervisor restarts that actor alone, with its state intact, when it crashes. All coordination rides on MQTT, so agents can be spawned on, and live-migrated between, edge nodes such as a Raspberry Pi, and every internal event is a topic external systems can subscribe to. The recorded demo builds a camera-to-lamp automation from one chat request, adds a second agent that is auto-wired to the first by topic and carries a deliberate division-by-zero, watches that agent repair its own code without losing its count, then deploys a fresh Raspberry Pi node and live-migrates the agent onto it, in under four minutes of wall-clock time and \$0.13 of model usage. This extended version adds what the two-page demonstration paper could not: the Wiring view of the topic graph, Wactorz as a library for hand-written agents, how trained models are stored, sent to nodes and replaced, the security model, and the system's limitations.

AI.tldr: Wactorz 是一个开源 LLM agent 运行时，将 LLM 生成的 agent 建模为长生命周期、受监督的 actor：planner 把聊天请求转成 Python 并在运行时编译为新 actor，supervisor 在崩溃时仅重启该 actor 且保留其状态；全部协调基于 MQTT，支持在树莓派等边缘节点上生成与活迁移 agent。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM agent 框架多为“跑完任务即退出”的 crew 模式，而物理环境（家庭、实验室、工厂车间）需要能持续运行数月、能在自身 bug 下存活、并能运行在传感器旁既有硬件上的 agent。
AI.method: 采用 actor 模型与监督树：planner 将聊天请求生成 Python，运行时编译为独立 actor；supervisor 在崩溃时单独重启该 actor 并保持其状态；进程间协调全部通过 MQTT 主题完成，使 agent 可部署于并活迁移于边缘节点；每个内部事件均为可订阅的外部主题。扩展版补充 topic 图的 Wiring 视图、作为库使用的 Wactorz（手写 agent）、训练模型的存储/下发/替换机制、安全模型及系统局限。
AI.result: 录制的演示在不到 4 分钟实际耗时、0.13 美元模型调用成本内完成：从一次聊天请求构建摄像头到灯的自动化，新增一个按 topic 自动接线到前一 agent、并故意含除零错误的 agent，观察其在不丢失计数的情况下自行修复代码，随后部署新的树莓派节点并将该 agent 活迁移至其上。
