AI.conclusion: Wactorz 以“长生命周期受监督 actor + MQTT 全域协调”的方式弥补了短生命周期 crew 框架在物理环境中的不足，实现了低成本、可自愈、可迁移的边缘 LLM agent 部署；扩展版进一步给出可观测性、库化使用、模型分发与安全等工程细节及局限讨论。

title: Open Vision Banana: An Open Framework for Unified Visual Perception through Generation in RGB Space
summary: Vision Banana showed that a closed image generator, instruction-tuned to paint perception outputs as RGB images, becomes a generalist vision model. Does this carry over to \emph{open} generators, and if not, what fails? We answer with \textbf{Open Vision Banana (OVB)}, an open framework that adapts the 7B diffusion generator of Qwen-Image-2.1 into one instruction-driven model for metric depth, semantic, instance, and referring segmentation, using a single shared low-rank adapter and public data. Each task is a \emph{task contract} whose RGB encoder, instruction, and decoder share one specification and are checked before training. Studying 42 externally evaluated checkpoints from two 100k-update runs, six exact weight-space merges, and eight controlled shorter runs, we find that the gap to the closed system is specific and measurable. Geometry is learned early while absolute scale is not: median-aligned NYUv2 $δ_1$ stays at 0.89--0.93 throughout training as unaligned $δ_1$ wanders between 0.11 and 0.50. The scale is not committed by a single sample: a ten-seed ensemble lifts unaligned $δ_1$ from 0.348 to 0.516 without retraining. Depth and 2D segmentation compete for the shared adapter, and weight merging moves along this trade-off without escaping it. Finally, lower validation flow loss comes with lower Cityscapes accuracy (Spearman $ρ\approx-0.9$ between loss reduction and mIoU), so the loss cannot select checkpoints. We release code, contracts, training data, and all evaluation outputs.

AI.tldr: 开放框架OVB将Qwen-Image-2.1扩散生成器改造为统一视觉模型，并定位了与闭源系统的具体差距：深度尺度未收敛、任务间适配器竞争、流损失无法用于选点。
AI.motivation: 闭源方案Vision Banana证明"指令微调的图像生成器可胜任通用感知"，但该结论能否迁移到开放生成器尚不清楚，且失败模式未被量化。作者因此构建开放框架并系统诊断失败原因。
AI.method: 构建Open Vision Banana：以7B Qwen-Image-2.1扩散生成器为基座，用单一共享低秩适配器（LoRA）和公开数据训练，统一处理度量深度、语义/实例/指代分割。每个任务定义为"任务契约"，其RGB编码器、指令、解码器共享同一规范并在训练前校验。实验覆盖两次10万步训练产出的42个外部评估检查点、6次精确权重空间融合、8次受控短程训练，研究尺度误差、任务干扰与损失—指标关系。
AI.result: （1）几何可早期学到但绝对尺度不收敛：训练全程中位数对齐的NYUv2 δ₁稳定在0.89–0.93，而未对齐δ₁在0.11–0.50间波动；尺度不由单样本决定，十种子集成在无重训下将未对齐δ₁从0.348提升至0.516。（2）深度与2D分割争用共享适配器，权重融合沿该权衡移动但无法跳出。（3）验证流损失越低，Cityscapes精度越低（损失下降与mIoU的Spearman ρ≈−0.9），损失不能用于检查点选择。
AI.conclusion: 开放生成器可以复现闭源系统的通用感知能力，但差距具体且可测：尺度未承诺、共享容量竞争、生成损失与判别指标解耦。需显式尺度监督、任务容量分配与非似然式选点准则。作者开源代码、任务契约、训练数据与评估输出。

title: Towards Edge Artificial Intelligence for Predicting Antimicrobial Resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis
comment: Accepted and Presented at the 11th IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Computer Science and Data Engineering (IEEE CSDE 2026), 1-3 November 2026, Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh
summary: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB) poses a major challenge to global tuberculosis control, as multidrug-resistant strains limit available treatment options. Rapid and accurate prediction of drug resistance from genomic data could support timely treatment decisions and public health interventions. However, many existing computational approaches for genomic AMR prediction rely on computationally intensive pipelines, limiting their suitability for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. This limitation is particularly relevant in hospital settings in low- and middle-income countries, where computing infrastructure and access to high-performance computational resources may be limited. To address this challenge, we present a lightweight, novel machine learning (ML) approach suitable for running on edge devices that combines 4-mer frequency features derived from whole-genome sequences with a Random Forest classifier to predict antibiotic resistance in MTB. The proposed ML approach achieved an average area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.82 across 20 antibiotics on an independent test set.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向边缘设备的轻量级机器学习方法，将全基因组序列的4-mer频率特征与随机森林结合，用于预测结核分枝杆菌的抗生素耐药性，在20种抗生素上平均AUC达0.82。
AI.motivation: 结核分枝杆菌耐药性（AMR）威胁全球结核病防控，多药耐药菌株压缩了治疗选择，因此亟需从基因组数据快速准确预测耐药以支持临床决策与公共卫生干预。然而现有基因组AMR预测方法多依赖计算密集的流程，难以部署在算力受限的边缘设备上；这一问题在低收入和中等收入国家的医院场景中尤为突出，当地缺乏高性能计算资源。
AI.method: 方法为轻量级机器学习流程：（1）从全基因组序列中提取4-mer频率特征，避免复杂的比对与深度学习流程；（2）采用随机森林分类器进行耐药表型预测。
AI.result: 在独立测试集上，该方法针对20种抗生素取得平均ROC曲线下面积（AUC）0.82。
AI.conclusion: 简单特征（k-mer频率）加传统集成学习的组合可在保持可用预测性能的同时显著降低计算开销，具备在资源受限环境（如中低收入国家医院）边缘设备上部署的潜力；后续可进一步评估其在更大队列与更多药物上的泛化性及实际部署成本。

title: Grounded in Contact: Reducing Floating and Interpenetration Artifacts with Multimodal Skill-Effect Models
comment: Under review. Project page: https://grounded-in-contact.github.io/. The second and third authors contributed equally
summary: Learning to predict the effects of contact-rich manipulation skills requires models that represent distinct outcome modes rather than a single expected result. Even for basic skills such as pushing, picking, and placing, small variations in contact conditions or object geometry can produce qualitatively different object motions under nearly identical states and actions. Deterministic and Gaussian models tend to average over these alternatives or represent them as a single broad distribution, obscuring distinct modes such as sliding, toppling, and rotating. We study probabilistic skill-effect models that learn multimodal distributions over object pose changes given partial point clouds and actions. We instantiate this abstraction with three representative model classes: mixture density networks, state tokenization, and flow matching, each paired with latent dynamics for next-step prediction. Across diverse objects and skills, explicitly multimodal models predict which outcome occurs more accurately than deterministic and Gaussian baselines. In planning, flow matching significantly improves task success over the deterministic baseline on every skill and achieves the highest success on every multi-step sequence. On a real robot, probabilistic models succeed at pick about twice as often as the deterministic baseline, providing evidence that probabilistic skill effects offer a practical abstraction for reasoning and planning under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 该文研究接触丰富操作技能的概率化“技能效果模型”，在部分点云与动作条件下学习物体位姿变化的多峰分布，比较混合密度网络、状态分词与流匹配三类模型，并证明多峰建模在预测与规划上优于确定性/高斯基线。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富操作（推动、抓取、放置）中，接触条件或物体几何的微小变化会在几乎相同的状态与动作下产生定性不同的运动模式（滑动、翻倒、旋转）。确定性与高斯模型会把这些替代模式平均掉，或压缩为单一宽分布，从而掩盖真实的多峰结构，影响后续推理与规划。
AI.method: 将技能效果建模为条件于部分点云与动作的物体位姿变化多峰分布。实例化三类代表性模型：混合密度网络（MDN）、状态分词（state tokenization）、流匹配（flow matching），每类均搭配潜动力学模型用于下一步预测；并与确定性模型、高斯模型基线对比。评估涵盖多样物体与技能，包括预测精度、规划任务成功率、多步序列以及真机抓取实验。
AI.result: 在多样物体与技能上，显式多峰模型的“哪种结果发生”预测更准确，优于确定性与高斯基线；规划中流匹配在每一项技能上均显著提升成功率（相对确定性基线），并在每个多步序列上取得最高成功率；真机抓取中概率模型的成功次数约为确定性基线的两倍。
AI.conclusion: 概率化技能效果是面向不确定性推理与规划的一种实用抽象：显式多峰建模能保留滑移/翻倒/旋转等可区分的结果模式，其中流匹配在规划场景表现最佳，真机结果进一步支持其实际可用性。

title: Fin-RSI: A Unified Library of Financial Skills, Checks, and Self-Improvement for LLM Agents
summary: As large language models (LLMs) become more capable, financial agents need tools they can readily discover and use. Yet financial software is fragmented across libraries with different interfaces and conventions, making it difficult to build reliable agent workflows. We present Fin-RSI, a unified Python library of financial skills, checks, and self-improvement designed for LLM agents. It brings together tools for market analysis, forecasting, portfolio construction, and trading research through shared interfaces across models and agent frameworks. Agents can find suitable tools from natural-language requests, reuse tested implementations, and improve generated programs through checking and feedback. Developers can extend the library with new tools without rebuilding integrations for each model. Across 20 open-weight models on six trading-position tasks, tool discovery increased the proportion of episodes producing valid programs from 9.7% to 29.2%; for models with at least 14 billion parameters, it rose from 23.6% to 64.6%. We release the library and benchmark as a shared resource for the community and plan to expand its tools and task coverage as financial agents evolve.

AI.tldr: Fin-RSI是一个面向LLM金融智能体的统一Python金融技能库，集成工具发现、校验与自我改进机制，显著提升智能体生成有效程序的比例。
AI.motivation: 金融软件分散在不同库中，接口与约定各异，导致LLM智能体难以稳定发现并复用工具，构建可靠的智能体工作流困难。
AI.method: 构建统一的Python库，集合市场分析、预测、组合构建与交易研究等工具，提供跨模型与智能体框架的共享接口；支持从自然语言请求中检索合适工具、复用已验证实现，并通过检查与反馈改进生成程序；开发者可在无需为每个模型重建集成的情况下扩展工具。
AI.result: 在6个交易持仓任务、20个开放权重模型上，工具发现将产生有效程序的回合比例从9.7%提升至29.2%；在参数量≥140亿的模型上，该比例从23.6%提升至64.6%。
AI.conclusion: Fin-RSI有效缓解了金融工具碎片化问题，提升了LLM智能体的工具发现与程序生成可靠性；作者开源该库及基准作为社区共享资源，并计划随金融智能体发展扩展工具与任务覆盖范围。

title: Simple Baselines for Fetal Brain Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Bioinformatics and Biomedicine (BIBM)
summary: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) offers a promising approach to fetal brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) analysis, where pathological data are scarce. Existing methods rely mainly on brain age prediction or image reconstruction, but are limited by noisy gestational age (GA) labels, lack of lesion localization, or poor cross-domain generalization. We propose FetalBUAD, a UAD framework based on voxel-level brain age estimation. A joint multi-task network predicts global brain age, voxel-level brain age maps, and brain segmentation to establish an internal biological brain age reference, reducing reliance on clinically recorded GA. Uncertainty-aware voxel-level brain age gap maps are then used for anomaly localization. Experiments on 1,317 internal fetal brain MRI volumes and an external benchmark demonstrate state-of-the-art anomaly detection performance and improved cross-domain generalization. FetalBUAD also generates anatomically interpretable maps that localize diverse fetal brain abnormalities. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/birthlab/FetalBUAD.

AI.tldr: 提出基于体素级脑龄估计的无监督胎儿脑MRI异常检测框架FetalBUAD。
AI.motivation: 胎儿脑MRI病理数据稀缺，适合无监督异常检测（UAD）；现有方法依赖噪声较大的胎龄（GA）标签、仅做图像重建缺乏病灶定位，且跨域泛化差。
AI.method: 构建联合多任务网络，同时预测全局脑龄、体素级脑龄图与脑分割，建立内部生物学脑龄参考以减少对临床记录GA的依赖；据此生成不确定性感知的体素级脑龄差（brain age gap）图用于异常定位。
AI.result: 在1317例内部胎儿脑MRI体积及一个外部基准上取得最优异常检测性能，跨域泛化能力提升；生成具有解剖可解释性的图，可定位多种胎儿脑异常。
AI.conclusion: 体素级脑龄估计可作为有效UAD范式，兼顾检测性能、可解释定位与跨域泛化，代码已开源。

title: VeriLogic: Reinforcement Learning over Verifiable Logical Reasoning Traces
summary: Logical reasoning derives conclusions from premises through explicit intermediate inference steps, providing a natural basis for process-level verification and supervision. However, existing learning methods often rely on response-level outcome signals, which overlook heterogeneous correctness within the reasoning trace: a correct answer may contain invalid reasoning, while valid intermediate steps may also appear in an incorrect response. To address this issue, we introduce Reinforcement Learning on Verifiable Logical Reasoning (VeriLogic), which turns internal reasoning traces into explicit and verifiable learning objects. Rather than treating a response as an indivisible learning unit, VeriLogic decomposes logical reasoning into explicit intermediate judgments, proofs, and final decisions, and organizes them into a unified "Grounding - Optimization - Refinement" pipeline: (1) Verification-Grounded Reasoning Environment Construction grounds logical reasoning into explicit intermediate states and formally checkable proof obligations, making the internal reasoning process accessible to verification and learning; (2) Logical Structured Policy Optimization learns from verifier feedback through complementary global and local rewards, jointly optimizing the overall reasoning outcome while providing targeted optimization signals to different intermediate reasoning paths; and (3) Verifier-Guided Iterative Refinement acts on verifier feedback by leveraging proof states and error messages to iteratively diagnose and repair failed reasoning. Experiments on six logical reasoning benchmarks show consistent gains over strong baselines, with average improvements of 6.39% and 5.00% on Qwen3 and Llama-3.1. These results highlight the value of making logical reasoning traces verifiable, learnable, and refinable beyond final-answer supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出 VeriLogic，将逻辑推理轨迹转化为显式、可验证的学习对象，通过"接地—优化—精炼"三段式流程实现过程级奖励与迭代修复，在六个逻辑推理基准上平均提升 6.39%（Qwen3）与 5.00%（Llama-3.1）。
AI.motivation: 逻辑推理天然具有显式中间推理步骤，适合过程级验证与监督。但现有学习方法多依赖响应级结果信号，忽略了推理轨迹内部的异质正确性：正确答案可能包含无效推理步骤，而无效中间步骤也可能出现在错误答案中。这种结果级监督无法对中间推理路径给出针对性反馈。
AI.method: VeriLogic（Reinforcement Learning on Verifiable Logical Reasoning）将逻辑推理分解为显式中间判断、证明与最终决策，构成统一的三阶段流水线：(1) Verification-Grounded Reasoning Environment Construction：把推理接地到显式中间状态与形式化可检验的证明义务，使内部过程可被验证器访问；(2) Logical Structured Policy Optimization：利用全局奖励与局部奖励互补的验证器反馈进行策略优化，既优化整体结果，又为不同中间推理路径提供定向信号；(3) Verifier-Guided Iterative Refinement：利用证明状态与错误信息，迭代诊断并修复失败推理。
AI.result: 在六个逻辑推理基准上相对强基线取得一致提升，Qwen3 平均提升 6.39%，Llama-3.1 平均提升 5.00%。
AI.conclusion: 使逻辑推理轨迹可验证、可学习、可精炼，超越了仅依赖最终答案监督的范式，验证了过程级监督与验证器反馈在逻辑推理任务中的价值。

title: SparQ4D: Learning to Act through Sparse 4D Queries
summary: Successful manipulation requires a policy to understand where things are and how they will move, yet action demonstrations leave this spatiotemporal structure implicit. While explicit 4D supervision has proven effective, reducing the cost of dense 4D prediction remains challenging. This paper introduces \method, a lightweight yet expressive decoder that efficiently injects holistic 4D scene understanding into policies and improves success rates. At its core is a query-based decoder attached to a pretrained policy, which casts many spatialtemporal tasks into one unified interface (e.g. depth, 2D/3D point motion, multi-view correspondence, and hand-eye relations). This design enables efficient training and inference without sacrificing expressivity: the policy learns rich 4D structure from a small number of sampled queries during training, while the decoder can be removed at inference with zero additional overhead. Across multiple backbones, simulated environments, and real-world settings, \method achieves state-of-the-art manipulation performance, outperforming competing methods while training up to $5\times$ faster. Probing analyses further reveal that this 4D structure is recoverable from the policy.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量化解码器，将整体4D场景理解以查询方式注入策略，训练更快且在推理时可完全移除、零额外开销，实现SOTA操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 成功的操作任务要求策略理解物体的空间位置与运动方式，但动作示教数据只提供隐式的时空结构；显式4D监督虽有效，却难以降低稠密4D预测的成本。
AI.method: 在预训练策略上附加基于query的解码器，将深度、2D/3D点运动、多视角对应、手眼关系等多项时空任务统一到一个接口中；训练时仅用少量采样query学习丰富4D结构，推理时移除解码器，不增加额外开销。
AI.result: 在多种backbone、仿真环境与真实场景中取得SOTA操作性能，优于对比方法，训练速度最高提升5倍；探测分析表明4D结构可从策略中恢复。
AI.conclusion: 以低成本、可插拔的方式将4D表征注入策略是可行且高效的，为无需稠密4D标注的操作策略学习提供了新范式。

title: Reinforcement Learning from LLM-Generated (Suboptimal) Demonstrations
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved substantial progress across many domains, but training an agent \textit{tabula rasa} remains highly sample-inefficient. A common remedy is to initialize the agent using a neural network pretrained on demonstrations. However, collecting demonstrations is expensive, and the demonstrations themselves can be suboptimal. In this work, we use a large language model (LLM) to generate an advice policy that produces demonstration data with effectively no human cost. We use this data to warmstart a DQN agent, and use the advice policy itself to guide exploration during training. Because LLM-generated advice is often suboptimal, we further introduce a value warmstart method that initializes the agent to recognize promising states from the advice policy's behavior, without directly copying its actions. To characterize the robustness of this method, we systematically perturb individual sub-skills of an LLM-generated advice policy for a long-horizon, sparse-reward task. Degraded advice still meaningfully accelerates learning relative to unaided baselines. These results suggest that LLM-generated advice, though suboptimal, can be a cheap alternative to costly human demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 提出用大语言模型（LLM）生成"建议策略"来产生示范数据，以零人力成本热启动DQN，并引入价值热启动方法；在长时程稀疏奖励任务上验证了即使建议被系统性削弱，仍能显著加速学习。
AI.motivation: 强化学习从零训练样本效率低；常见补救是用示范数据预训练网络，但示范采集昂贵且本身可能次优。因此需要一种无人力成本、可替代人类示范的来源。
AI.method: 1）用LLM生成建议策略，由其产出示范数据，用于DQN的动作/策略热启动；2）训练中用该建议策略引导探索；3）针对LLM建议常次优的问题，提出价值热启动（value warmstart），让智能体从建议策略的行为中识别有前景状态，而非直接复制其动作；4）为刻画鲁棒性，对LLM建议策略的各个子技能进行系统性扰动。
AI.result: 在长时程、稀疏奖励任务上，即使建议被逐项削弱，退化后的建议仍相对无辅助基线显著加速学习；说明LLM建议虽次优但有效。
AI.conclusion: LLM生成的建议虽非最优，但可作为昂贵人类示范的低成本替代，用于RL热启动与探索引导；价值热启动使方法对建议质量退化具有鲁棒性。

title: VG3R: Video Generation Model for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
summary: Video generation models are widely used as 3D priors for novel view synthesis and 3D scene generation. Fine-tuned for perception, generation models also excel at dense prediction such as depth estimation. However, methods that apply video generation models to 3D reconstruction either predict depth without cameras or generate geometry and estimate cameras through many iterative denoising steps, which makes them slower. In this paper, we present $\textbf{VG3R}$, which turns a pretrained video generation model into a feed-forward 3D reconstruction model. Our key observation is that such a model already captures the depth and camera motion of a video, but not in the form required for reconstruction. We introduce two components: $\textit{clip-level shift prediction}$, which corrects depth distortion caused by the unknown shift in decoded inverse depth, and a $\textit{multi-layer camera head}$, which predicts per-frame cameras parameters by combining features across transformer blocks. Using Wan2.1 as its video backbone, VG3R reconstructs a scene and estimate the camera of every frame without iterative denoising. It achieves the lowest ATE and reconstruction errors among methods built on video generation models, runs about 4 and 14 times faster than Aether and Geo4D. VG3R also demonstrates competitive depth estimation and 3D reconstruction performance compared with geometry foundation models. Project page: https://github.com/KTH-RPL/VG3R

AI.tldr: VG3R将预训练视频生成模型改造为前馈3D重建模型，通过clip级shift预测与多层相机头，无需迭代去噪即可重建场景并估计每帧相机，速度快于Aether与Geo4D。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型蕴含深度与相机运动先验，但现有将其用于3D重建的方法要么只预测深度而不估计相机，要么依赖多次迭代去噪联合生成几何与相机，导致推理缓慢。作者希望挖掘模型内部已有的深度与相机信息，构建快速的前馈重建方案。
AI.method: 以Wan2.1为视频骨干，提出两个关键组件：(1) clip-level shift prediction，用于校正解码逆深度中未知shift导致的深度畸变；(2) multi-layer camera head，通过融合Transformer多个block的特征预测逐帧相机参数。整个流程为前馈式，不进行迭代去噪。
AI.result: 在基于视频生成模型的方法中取得最低的ATE与重建误差；相比Aether约快4倍、相比Geo4D约快14倍；深度估计与3D重建性能与几何基础模型相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 预训练视频生成模型中已隐含可用于重建的深度与相机信息，只需少量针对性设计即可转化为高效前馈3D重建器，兼顾精度与推理效率。

title: ARC: Adaptive Rollout Control for Efficient Synchronous LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Synchronous reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models proceeds through a repeated rollout--barrier--update loop. Each update must wait for a fixed number of complete, group-relative training samples, yet individual response lengths and reward outcomes vary widely and only emerge as generation progresses. Static admission and unconditional completion therefore leave accelerators idle in some steps, and waste computation generating samples that will never contribute to the current update. We present ARC, a closed-loop rollout architecture that governs synchronous RL rollout at group granularity. ARC uses \textit{Calibrated Streaming Backfill} to judge from partial observations whether a group is still worth completing, backfilling a fresh candidate immediately when it is not; \textit{Deferred Group Completion} to park an uncertain early stop and resume it later instead of discarding it outright, bounded by a resume-cycle limit that guarantees termination; and \textit{Adaptive Admission} and \textit{Pipelining} to order admitted samples by early-measured duration and to admit further candidates only while expected supply still falls short of the target number of accepted groups. Under online evaluation, ARC reduces rollout time by $37.4\%$, a $1.60\times$ speedup, and improves effective GRPO throughput by $50.1\%$ over existing baselines, while directly recovering 98.9\% of the training groups that would ultimately have been kept.

AI.tldr: 提出闭环 rollout 架构 ARC，以 group 为粒度调控同步 RL 的 rollout 过程，通过流式回填、延迟组完成、自适应准入与流水线调度减少算力空转与无效计算，实现 37.4% rollout 时间下降（1.60×加速）与 50.1% 的 GRPO 有效吞吐提升。
AI.motivation: 同步 RL（如 GRPO）采用 rollout—barrier—update 循环，每次更新须等待固定数量的完整组相对训练样本；但单条回复长度与奖励结果差异很大，且只有在生成过程中才逐步显现。静态准入与无条件完成导致某些步骤加速器空闲，并浪费算力生成最终不会进入本次更新的样本。
AI.method: ARC 在组粒度上做闭环调控，包含四个组件：(1) Calibrated Streaming Backfill：基于部分观测判断某组是否仍值得完成，若不值得则立即回填新候选；(2) Deferred Group Completion：将不确定的提前终止"挂起"以便稍后恢复，而非直接丢弃，并以 resume-cycle 上限保证算法终止；(3) Adaptive Admission：按早期测得的时长对已准入样本排序；(4) Pipelining：仅在期望供给仍低于目标已接受组数时继续准入候选。
AI.result: 在线评测中，ARC 相比现有基线将 rollout 时间缩短 37.4%（1.60× 加速），GRPO 有效吞吐提升 50.1%，同时直接找回 98.9% 最终本会被保留的训练组。
AI.conclusion: 以组为粒度的闭环 rollout 调控可有效消除同步 RL 中的空转与无效生成，在不显著损失有效训练样本的前提下显著提升 rollout 效率与训练吞吐，是一种可与 GRPO 类同步 RL 流程兼容的系统级优化方案。

title: Performance Evaluation of Nonlinear Model Predictive and Sliding Mode Controllers on a 4-Cable Spatial CSPR in Simscape
comment: 7 pages, 13 figures, 2 tables. Prepared for the 13th RSI International Conference on Robotics and Mechatronics (ICRoM 2025), Tehran, Iran
summary: This paper offers a comprehensive comparative study between Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) and Sliding Mode Control (SMC) applied to a spatial Cable-Suspended Parallel Robot (CSPR) actuated by four cables. The robot is modeled in two parallel ways: (i) via an analytical dynamic model with included cable elasticity and frictional losses, and (ii) in MATLAB Simscape Multibody, capturing realistic physical effects. Both controllers are implemented under identical reference trajectories, system constraints, and tuning strategies. Our results show that NMPC achieves superior tracking accuracy and stronger disturbance rejection compared to SMC, but at the cost of higher computational demand. Moreover, both controllers were tested on an analytical model of the robot and a Simscape model. The close agreement between the two, for both control schemes, confirms the accuracy of the analytical formulation and its consistency with the physics-based simulation. The study highlights the value of physics-based simulation as a complementary tool for validating advanced controllers under realistic conditions, and demonstrates that NMPC offers superior performance for the studied high-precision, constrained CSPR.

AI.tldr: 对四索驱动空间悬索并联机器人，分别在含绳索弹性与摩擦损失的解析动力学模型和Simscape Multibody物理模型中，对比NMPC与滑模控制的性能。
AI.motivation: 悬索并联机器人具有强耦合、欠约束与非线性特性，需在高精度轨迹跟踪与约束满足条件下选择合适的先进控制策略；同时需要验证解析模型的准确性与物理仿真的互补价值。
AI.method: 建立含绳索弹性和摩擦损失的解析动力学模型，并在MATLAB Simscape Multibody中搭建平行物理模型；在相同参考轨迹、系统约束与整定策略下分别实现NMPC与SMC，进行对比测试与交叉验证。
AI.result: NMPC的跟踪精度更高、抗扰能力更强，但计算负担更大；两种控制器在解析模型与Simscape模型上的表现高度一致，验证了解析建模的准确性及其与物理仿真的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 物理仿真可作为验证先进控制器在真实条件下性能的补充工具；对于所研究的高精度、带约束的悬索并联机器人，NMPC在性能上优于SMC。

title: Who Sent It or How It Moved? Sender Shortcuts in Cryptocurrency Anti-Money-Laundering Benchmarks, Audited on Elliptic2 and Elliptic++
summary: Two public benchmarks dominate graph-based anti-money-laundering (AML) research on Bitcoin: the transaction-level Elliptic dataset, extended as Elliptic++, and the subgraph-level Elliptic2. In both, a label is assigned according to the entity that sends the funds. We ask whether models trained on these benchmarks learn how laundering moves or merely who sent the money, and we propose a diagnostic protocol to tell the two apart: a sender lookup baseline, a novelty baseline, a sender-disjoint split with a leakage check, and a decomposition of performance into sender, receiver and intrinsic signal. On Elliptic2 the task largely reduces to classifying the sender. Under the standard random split, a no-learning lookup of sender history reaches a PR-AUC of 0.954, against 0.975 for gradient boosting on 456 features; our reimplementation of RevClassify reproduces its reported 0.97 and falls to 0.126 without sender information. When senders are held out, performance drops to 0.746, and the subgraph's own structure, transactions and receivers fall from 0.619 to 0.186. On Elliptic++ the same protocol finds the shortcut negligible: sender history reaches only 0.340 against 0.986 for the full model (3.5 against 10.1 times the test prevalence), adding it to the full model raises PR-AUC by less than 0.004 in every seed, and the transaction's own features keep 0.883 when sending addresses are held out. We trace the difference to the unit of sender identity: Elliptic2 senders are entity clusters that recur across many labeled subgraphs, whereas Elliptic++ senders are individual addresses, and fewer than half of test transactions have a sending address seen in training. A shared sender-based label rule thus produces a severe shortcut in one benchmark and a negligible one in the other, so the diagnostic must be run on each benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一套诊断协议，检验比特币反洗钱图基准上的模型学到的是"资金如何流动"还是"谁发出了资金"，发现Elliptic2存在严重的发送方身份捷径，而Elliptic++几乎不存在。
AI.motivation: Elliptic++（交易级）与Elliptic2（子图级）两大比特币AML基准均按"发送资金的实体"打标签。作者质疑模型可能只学到发送方身份而非洗钱资金流动模式，且需要判定这种捷径在不同基准上的严重程度。
AI.method: 提出诊断协议四要素：(1) 发送方历史查找基线（无学习）；(2) 新异性基线；(3) 发送方不相交划分及泄漏检查；(4) 将性能分解为发送方、接收方与内在信号三部分。在两个基准上分别执行。
AI.result: Elliptic2：随机划分下发送方查找基线PR-AUC达0.954，456特征梯度提升仅0.975；复现RevClassify报告值0.97，去除发送方信息后降至0.126；留出发送方后性能降至0.746，子图自身结构/交易/接收方由0.619降至0.186。Elliptic++：发送方历史仅0.340，全模型0.986（测试流行率的3.5与10.1倍），加入发送方信息各随机种子PR-AUC提升<0.004，留出发送地址后交易自身特征仍保持0.883。
AI.conclusion: 差异根源在于发送方身份粒度：Elliptic2的发送方是跨大量已标注子图重复出现的实体簇，Elliptic++的发送方是单个地址且不足半数测试交易的发件地址在训练中出现。同一标签规则在一个基准上形成严重捷径、在另一个上可忽略，故诊断须在各基准上单独运行。

title: Where the Image Sits: Vision-Text Order Bias in Jev
summary: Jev-style system-1 decision models read a choice from a single prefill. They restrict the next-token distribution to the supplied option labels and return a distribution over the options, with no generation and no parsing. Recent work shows that generative vision-language models are sensitive to the relative order of image and text tokens. We ask whether that sensitivity reaches this Jev-style readout. The answer is always read at the end of the prompt, so moving the image changes the distance from the visual evidence to the decision, but never the position at which the decision is read. Using four placements---prefix, pre-question, pre-options, and suffix---and holding the option listing fixed, we measure argmax flips, total variation, accuracy, calibration, and label marginals. Suffix placement flips 41.0% of decisions and lowers accuracy by 18.6 points. Averaged over the four slots, the curve is monotone, not U-shaped. That shape differs from prior results on generative vision-language models. The effect survives a battery of controls. We also introduce prefix--question averaging (P+Q), a two-forward readout that averages the prefix and pre-question distributions. It is at least as accurate as prefix and outperforms the prior baselines. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/Youzhi333/Visual_Tex_Order_Bias_Jev.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"Jev式"（Jev-style）系统1决策模型对图像与文本token相对顺序的敏感性：在固定选项列表的前提下，测量图像放在prefix、pre-question、pre-options、suffix四个位置时对答案的影响，并据此提出P+Q两前向读出方法。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明生成式视觉语言模型对图文token的相对顺序敏感，但这类模型需要生成与解析；作者想检验这种顺序敏感性是否同样存在于"单次prefill、无生成无解析"的Jev式系统1读出范式中，从而判断该读出方式是否稳健。
AI.method: 将下一token分布限制在给定选项标签上，直接得到选项分布。保持选项列举方式不变，仅改变图像放置位置（prefix、pre-question、pre-options、suffix），并测量argmax翻转率、总变差（TV）、准确率、校准与标签边际分布。另提出prefix–question averaging（P+Q）：做两次前向，分别取prefix与pre-question位置下的分布并求平均。
AI.result: 将图像放在suffix位置会使41.0%的决策发生argmax翻转，准确率下降18.6个百分点；四个位置平均来看，变化曲线呈单调趋势而非U型，与既有生成式VLM的结果不同；该效应通过了一系列控制实验验证。P+Q在准确率上不低于prefix，并优于既有基线。代码与数据已公开。
AI.conclusion: Jev式系统1读出同样受图文顺序影响，但其单调形态与生成式模型的U型曲线不同；图像位置通过改变视觉证据与决策读取点的距离而非读取位置本身产生影响；P+Q是一种低成本、可行的缓解方案。

title: What Makes Recurrence Generalize Across Lengths?
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AXIOM: Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning
summary: Multi-step reasoning requires models to preserve and update intermediate information as computation unfolds. State tracking captures this fundamental requirement, but models that succeed within a fixed range of state transitions may not generalize when substantially more updates are required. Recurrent Transformers offer a natural mechanism for addressing this challenge by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks, allowing computation to scale with problem length. We study when such recurrent computation generalizes beyond the training range in a controlled state-tracking task, varying operation representation, positional encoding, and recurrent capacity. We find that recurrence alone is insufficient: multi-token template representations and absolute positional encoding can severely limit extrapolation, whereas atomic operation representations enable substantially stronger length generalization. The effect of positional structure also varies with recurrent depth, with periodic positional encoding achieving the strongest mean performance at greater recurrent depth. Most importantly, scaling the recurrent operator extends the extrapolation horizon, reaching 35.1% exact-match accuracy on sequences of 20-40 operations after training only on 2-10, while substantially larger fixed-depth Transformers remain at 0%. Additional recurrent computation at test time can extend the range over which the model generalizes, but does not eliminate failure on much longer sequences. These results suggest that recurrent computation can support length-generalizable state tracking, but that its effectiveness depends critically on whether the learned computation remains reusable across sequence lengths.

AI.tldr: 本文在受控状态跟踪任务中研究循环Transformer的长度外推能力，发现仅有循环结构不足以泛化，算子表示、位置编码与循环容量的设计至关重要。
AI.motivation: 多步推理要求模型在计算过程中保持并更新中间信息，而模型若只在固定状态转移范围内成功，就难以在需要大量更新时泛化。作者希望验证循环Transformer（重复应用共享块）能否将计算与问题长度对齐，并弄清哪些设计因素决定其长度泛化。
AI.method: 在一个受控的状态跟踪任务上，系统改变三个因素：操作表示（多token模板 vs. 原子操作表示）、位置编码（绝对位置编码 vs. 周期位置编码）、循环容量（循环深度/循环算子规模），并比较这些设置下的长度外推表现；同时对比大规模固定深度Transformer，并考察测试时增加循环计算的效果。
AI.result: 多token模板表示与绝对位置编码严重限制外推，原子操作表示显著提升长度泛化；位置结构的作用随循环深度变化，较大循环深度下周期位置编码的平均表现最佳。最关键的发现是：增大循环算子可扩展外推范围——仅在2–10步操作上训练，即可在20–40步序列上达到35.1%精确匹配准确率，而更大的固定深度Transformer仍为0%。测试时增加循环计算能扩大泛化范围，但无法消除在更长序列上的失败。
AI.conclusion: 循环计算能够支撑长度可泛化的状态跟踪，但其有效性关键取决于所学计算是否在序列长度之间保持可复用；仅靠循环结构本身并不足够。

title: CarlHOI: Counterfactual Predictive Imagination for Generalizable Multi-Humanoid Object Interaction under Constrained Environments
summary: Recent advances in physics-based humanoid control enable teams of varying sizes to coordinate their movements and cooperatively transport shared objects. However, adapting learned cooperative behaviors to unseen environmental constraints remains challenging, particularly when obstacles require coordinated detours and changes in team configuration. We propose CarlHOI, a counterfactual predictive imagination framework built upon a counterfactual-anchored relational latent world model (CarlWM) for human-object interaction (HOI), enabling multi-humanoid teams to adapt to unseen environmental constraints without retraining their underlying cooperative control policies. CarlHOI explicitly represents the shared object, individual humanoids, and environmental obstacles as interacting entities. Trained offline using counterfactual simulator rollouts, the model imagines alternative collective futures under different shared waypoint commands, predicting how the coupled humanoid team and object would respond. By evaluating these imagined outcomes through predicted progress, failure, and contact risks, and long-horizon value estimates, CarlHOI selects adaptive guidance commands while preserving the pretrained cooperative controller. We introduce a benchmark comprising three challenging obstacle-constrained transport tasks to evaluate adaptation and generalization. Despite being trained exclusively with four humanoids, our model generalizes without retraining to teams of two to ten humanoids, unseen obstacle geometries and placements, unseen objects, and novel combinations of environmental constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved cooperative transport success over evaluated baselines across diverse configurations. Results highlight the potential of counterfactual predictive imagination to extend pretrained multi-humanoid cooperative skills beyond their original training conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出CarlHOI：基于反事实锚定关系潜世界模型（CarlWM）的反事实预测想象框架，通过想象不同航点指令下的集体未来来选取自适应引导命令，使预训练多类人机器人协作搬运策略无需重训练即可适应未见环境约束。
AI.motivation: 物理仿真下的人形机器人协作搬运已可实现，但学到的协作行为难以泛化到未见环境约束——尤其是需要协同绕行、改变团队构型的障碍场景，且通常需重训练底层协作控制策略。
AI.method: 1) CarlHOI将共享物体、个体人形机器人与环境障碍显式建模为交互实体；2) CarlWM为反事实锚定的关系潜世界模型，用反事实仿真器rollout离线训练；3) 在不同共享航点指令下想象替代性集体未来，预测人-物耦合团队响应；4) 以预测的前进度、失败与接触风险及长时程价值估计评估想象结果，选择自适应引导命令，同时保持预训练协作控制器不变；5) 提出含三个障碍约束搬运任务的基准。
AI.result: 仅用4个人形机器人训练，可零重训练泛化到2–10机器人团队、未见障碍几何与布局、未见物体及新颖约束组合；多配置下协作搬运成功率优于对比基线。
AI.conclusion: 反事实预测想象可将预训练多机器人协作技能扩展到原始训练条件之外，为无重训练的环境自适应提供可行路径。

title: Dimension Is Free, Horizon Is Not: When Evolution Strategies Rival Policy Gradients for LLM Fine-Tuning
summary: Policy gradient (PG) methods such as GRPO dominate LLM fine-tuning, yet recent work showed that Evolution Strategies (ES) also scale to fine-tuning models with billions of parameters. Which method needs fewer samples, and on which tasks, remains unclear. We view the two methods as estimators of the same gradient that differ in where they explore. Because ES perturbs parameters, its noise grows with the number of parameters, and because PG samples actions, its noise grows with the number of generated tokens. Only noise along the directions that change the reward slows learning. The cost of ES then depends on the effective dimension, the number of independent skills a task requires rather than its parameter count, while the cost of PG depends on the effective horizon, which counts only the tokens that share both credit and weights with the reward-carrying ones. We train both methods on a synthetic task where the number of skills and the effective horizon can be varied separately. PG is cheaper when the horizon is short, ES becomes cheaper once it is long enough, and this crossover moves to longer horizons as the number of skills grows. We then measure the effective horizons of 20 NLP, math reasoning, and agentic tasks and compare the two methods with Qwen2.5-7B. PG leads on short-horizon tasks, the two tie on the moderate-horizon math ones, and no task has a horizon in the regime where the theory predicts an ES advantage. Terminal-Bench has a far longer horizon. There, in a preliminary comparison with Qwen3.5-4B, ES without any credit assignment reaches a higher success rate than the PG checkpoint released with Tmax, as the theory predicts. ES should thus have the advantage on long-horizon tasks with few independent skills and a nonvanishing reward signal. Current benchmarks are only at the onset of this regime, so ES should become more competitive as agentic tasks grow longer.

AI.tldr: 论文从"同一梯度的两种估计器"视角统一分析PG与ES，提出ES成本取决于有效维度（独立技能数）、PG成本取决于有效horizon（与奖励共享信用与权重的token数），并用合成任务与20个NLP/数学/智能体任务的实测加以验证。
AI.motivation: GRPO等策略梯度方法主导LLM微调，但近期工作表明ES也能扩展到十亿参数级模型微调。然而"哪种方法更省样本、在哪类任务上更省"尚无定论，缺少可解释二者差异的理论框架与实证对照。
AI.method: 将PG与ES视为对同一梯度的不同估计器，区别在于探索发生的位置：ES扰动参数，噪声随参数数量增长；PG采样动作，噪声随生成token数增长。由于只有改变奖励方向上的噪声才拖慢学习，作者导出ES代价依赖有效维度（任务所需的独立技能数，而非参数规模），PG代价依赖有效horizon（仅计入与承载奖励token共享信用与权重的token）。随后构建可分别调节技能数与有效horizon的合成任务进行受控实验，并测量20个NLP、数学推理与智能体任务的有效horizon，用Qwen2.5-7B对两种方法做对比，另在Terminal-Bench上用Qwen3.5-4B做初步对照。
AI.result: 合成任务中，horizon较短时PG更省，horizon足够长后ES更省；且随技能数增加，交叉点移向更长horizon。真实任务测量显示：PG在短horizon任务上领先，中等horizon的数学任务上二者持平，没有任何任务落在理论预测ES占优的horizon区间；Terminal-Bench的horizon远长于此，初步对比中不做任何信用分配的ES取得比Tmax发布的PG检查点更高的成功率，与理论一致。
AI.conclusion: ES应在"长horizon、少量独立技能、奖励信号不消失"的任务上占优。现有基准仅处于该区间的起点，因此随着智能体任务变长，ES有望更具竞争力。

title: Centerline-Guided Multi-Class Road Surface Segmentation
summary: Road-surface extraction from satellite imagery supports geo- graphic mapping, but a binary mask leaves road axes, transverse extent, and junction structure implicit. Learning these proper- ties together is challenging because narrow corridors, merging roads, and occlusions require different geometric cues. We present a centerline-guided multi-class segmentation framework that makes these dependencies explicit. A hierarchical encoder sup- plies shared features, while predicted centerline features and soft probabilities condition specialized regular, intersection, and over- pass decoders. A two-component width branch supplies transverse geometry to regular-surface decoding, and learned feature fusion produces the complete road mask. Unlike independent prediction heads or a fixed union of component masks, this design exchanges geometric information during decoding while retaining separately inspectable outputs. Evaluation of the four-semantic-output con- figuration on CHN6-CUG achieves 65.53% complete-surface IoU, improving on a binary SegFormer-B4 baseline by 1.01 percentage points and reducing false-positive pixels by 11.94%. The results support geometry-aware surface refinement and a richer raster representation for road-map inspection.

AI.tldr: 提出中心线引导的多类道路分割框架，将路轴线、横向宽度与交叉口结构显式建模，通过几何信息在解码阶段交换实现更完整的路面提取。
AI.motivation: 卫星影像道路提取通常只输出二值掩膜，使道路轴线、横向范围与交叉口/立交结构隐含不显；而窄走廊、道路汇合与遮挡需要不同几何线索，难以同时学习。
AI.method: 采用分层编码器提供共享特征；由预测的中心线特征与软概率调节专用的规则路面、交叉口、高架桥三类解码器；双分量宽度分支向规则路面解码提供横向几何；通过学习式特征融合生成完整道路掩膜，各语义输出仍可单独检视。
AI.result: 在 CHN6-CUG 数据集上，四语义输出配置达到 65.53% 完整路面 IoU，较二值 SegFormer-B4 基线提升 1.01 个百分点，误检像素减少 11.94%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持几何感知的路面精化，并为道路地图检视提供更丰富的栅格表达。

title: On Adaptive Step Sizes for Eligibility Traces in Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Many deep reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms store agent-environment interactions in a replay buffer and later learn by sampling transitions from it. However, this approach can be memory-inefficient and can delay learning because the agent can learn from a transition only when the buffer samples it. Additionally, most of these methods use one-step or short multi-step temporal-difference (TD) updates, which are slow at credit assignment. An alternative approach is to learn from the stream of observations as they arrive without relying on a buffer. Eligibility-trace algorithms allow these incremental updates and can also assign credit over many steps. These algorithms were common with linear function approximation but have only recently been used in deep RL. Basic questions, such as how to use vector step sizes with eligibility traces in the deep RL setting, remain open. In this work, we first show that adaptive vector step sizes must be part of the eligibility trace to keep the equivalence between the forward and backward views. We then show that the step sizes of common optimizers, such as Adam, do not have an online backward view. We introduce a new optimizer, Function-Space Distance (FSD), that maintains the forward-backward equivalence. We test four eligibility-trace algorithms covering semi-gradient and gradient TD updates, as well as value-based and actor-critic methods. We show that FSD performs better than SGD or naively applied Adam. The resulting algorithms outperform or match other streaming methods and are comparable to or better than PPO, which uses a buffer, in most environments. Code available at https://github.com/esraaelelimy/ada_traces

AI.tldr: 提出FSD优化器，使深度RL中带资格迹的流式更新保持前向-后向等价，实现无回放缓冲的高效在线学习。
AI.motivation: 回放缓冲内存开销大且学习延迟（需被采样才学习），一步/短多步TD更新信用分配慢；资格迹算法可增量更新并长程分配信用，但在深度RL中如何结合向量步长等基本问题尚未解决。
AI.method: 理论分析表明自适应向量步长必须纳入资格迹才能保持前向与后向视图等价；进一步指出Adam等常见优化器缺乏在线后向视图，提出函数空间距离（FSD）优化器以维持前向-后向等价；在semi-gradient、gradient TD、value-based与actor-critic四类资格迹算法上验证。
AI.result: FSD优于SGD和朴素应用的Adam；所得算法在多数环境中优于或匹敌其他流式方法，并可与使用缓冲的PPO相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 自适应向量步长需嵌入资格迹以保持前后向等价，FSD为深度RL资格迹提供一致的在线优化方案，无需回放缓冲即可获得有竞争力的性能。

title: Into My Arms: Structured reinforcement learning for autonomous transport of objects and humans
summary: Whole-body humanoid manipulation remains bottlenecked by high-dimensional state-action spaces, contact-rich environments, and long task horizons. This trilemma is a challenge that state-of-the-art reinforcement learning (RL) methods are yet to resolve reliably. We address it with three contributions that add just enough structure to guide exploration: Sparse Interaction Edges (SIE) for whole-body manipulation, Interaction Gated Transport (IGT) for sustained transport over long horizons, and a Hinted Object Path (HOP) that resolves collision and search complexity bottlenecks. Across all three, the policy remains free to discover its own manipulation strategy. The method generalises from rigid object to human transport. As a flagship demonstration, we show, to our knowledge, the first bed-to-wheelchair transfer of a medical mannequin by a humanoid robot completed with no human intervention during execution. In the domain of human transfer, we show that a single policy can adapt across substantial variations in body mass, size, and random force perturbations, all while training on a single GPU in under an hour. Our approach offers a pathway to fully RL-driven humanoid manipulation, enabling assistive robots that can help humans. Website: https://elle-miller.github.io/into_my_arms

AI.tldr: 提出SIE、IGT、HOP三种结构化机制，用最小先验引导强化学习探索，实现人形机器人全身操作，并完成首个无人工干预的床到轮椅转运医疗假人的演示。
AI.motivation: 全身人形操作受制于三个难点：高维状态-动作空间、富接触环境、长任务时域。现有SOTA强化学习方法难以可靠解决这一"三难"问题，探索效率低、易陷入局部最优。
AI.method: 以"注入恰好足够的结构以引导探索"为原则，提出三项贡献：(1) Sparse Interaction Edges (SIE)，面向全身操作的稀疏交互边表示；(2) Interaction Gated Transport (IGT)，用于长时域持续搬运的交互门控机制；(3) Hinted Object Path (HOP)，通过提示式物体路径缓解碰撞与搜索复杂度瓶颈。三者均不限制策略自行发现操作策略，方法从刚体对象泛化到人体转运。
AI.result: 实现据称首个由人形机器人在执行过程中无人工干预完成的床到轮椅医疗假人转运；在人体转运场景中，单一策略可适应体重、体型的大幅变化及随机外力扰动；训练仅需单块GPU、一小时内完成。
AI.conclusion: 通过稀疏交互边、交互门控搬运与提示物体路径等轻量结构化设计，可在不约束策略自主性的前提下显著提升长时域富接触全身操作的RL可解性，为全RL驱动的人形辅助机器人操作提供可行路径。

title: Latent-Predisposition Personas for Heterogeneous and Reliable LLM Survey Simulation
summary: LLM personas are used to simulate survey publics, which should reproduce not only answer distributions but also within-person coherence and stability. Drawing on mass belief systems research, we show that persona-conditioned LLMs produce over-constrained publics. Across three model families and three U.S. surveys, opinions on unrelated issues are 1.6-4.6 times as correlated as among humans, and party identification explains 2.5-7.6 times as much answer variance. Common remedies (temperature, diversity instructions, backstories) weaken these correlations by making answers more random. On Qwen, their ten-day test-retest reliability falls to 33-59% of the human level, and when made consistent they lose correlation fit. We propose Latent-Predisposition Personas (LPP), whose persons differ stably, not randomly. Each persona receives political engagement, value priorities, and party-relative issue deviations that grow as engagement falls. Answers are sharpened and calibrated to toplines and party crosstabs. At selected operating points, LPP is never significantly worse than any baseline and far more reliable. At matched human-level reliability, it has the lowest correlation error in all six model-survey combinations, also at a lower target. Errors still exceed those between human samples, and gains on framing effects and a frontier closed model are partial.

AI.tldr: 指出人物设定型LLM生成的"公众"存在过度约束（意见相关性过高、党派解释力过强），常见补救措施只是把回答变得更随机；提出潜性倾向人物设定（LPP）方法，使个体稳定差异而非随机差异，在可靠性匹配人类水平时相关性误差最低。
AI.motivation: LLM人物设定（personas）被用于模拟调查公众，理想上应同时复现答案分布、个体内部一致性与跨时稳定性。但现有方法在"信念体系"层面存在系统性偏差：无关议题间的意见相关被过度约束，党派认同几乎解释一切，导致模拟出的公众不真实。
AI.method: 基于大众信念体系研究，先在3个模型家族×3项美国调查上诊断过度约束现象（无关议题相关是人类的1.6–4.6倍，党派解释方差是2.5–7.6倍）；检验温度调节、多样性指令、背景故事等常见补救措施；提出Latent-Predisposition Personas（LPP）：为每个人物赋予政治参与度、价值优先级，以及随参与度下降而增大的党内相对议题偏差；再对答案做锐化与校准（对齐总体边际分布与党派交叉表）。
AI.result: 常见补救措施虽降低相关性，但以更大随机性为代价——在Qwen上十天重测信度降至人类水平的33–59%，且一旦强制提高一致性便失去相关性拟合。LPP在选定操作点上从不显著劣于任何基线且可靠性远高；在六种模型—调查组合中，于匹配人类可靠性时相关性误差最低，并在更低可靠性目标下同样最优。但误差仍高于人类样本间差异，且在框架效应与某前沿闭源模型上的改进仅为部分。
AI.conclusion: LLM调查模拟的核心症结不是相关性过高或过低，而是个体差异缺乏"稳定的结构化来源"。LPP将人物差异建立在潜性倾向而非随机噪声上，可同时改善相关性拟合与重测信度，但尚不能达到人类样本间的一致性水平，框架效应与闭源前沿模型上的泛化仍有局限。

title: Reconstruction-Guided Dual-Branch Learning for LiDAR Anomalous Object Detection
summary: Detecting unexpected objects is essential for autonomous driving safety. Most existing LiDAR anomaly detectors rely on semantic discrimination, which primarily captures category-discriminative features but may overlook deviations from broader feature relationships in normal scenes. Reconstruction offers a complementary perspective by assessing consistency with learned normal patterns. However, pointwise reconstruction errors alone struggle to distinguish anomalies from normal variability in complex outdoor point clouds. We propose Structured Residual Reasoning (SRR) to extract additional anomaly evidence from residual structure across feature channels, time sequences, and geometric space. We further establish that semantic discrimination and normal-pattern reconstruction capture fundamentally different yet complementary anomaly evidence: category compatibility and consistency with learned normal patterns, respectively. At matched background false-positive rates, SRR recovers more objects missed entirely by the semantic branch while producing fewer false positives in normal-only scenes. Building on this finding, we propose Reconstruction-Guided Dual-Branch (RGDB) learning, in which SRR-derived normal-pattern consistency cues guide a semantic-conditioned anomaly decoder to complement reconstruction-based predictions during training. At inference, the two branches jointly exploit their complementary anomaly evidence. Experiments show that standalone SRR establishes a strong reconstruction-based baseline without semantic labels from the target-scene training data, while RGDB achieves state-of-the-art performance on the STU validation set.

AI.tldr: 提出结构化残差推理(SRR)从特征通道、时序与几何空间的残差结构中挖掘异常证据,并据此构建重建引导的双分支学习框架(RGDB),在STU验证集上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有LiDAR异常检测器多依赖语义判别,只捕获类别判别性特征,忽略与正常场景整体特征关系的偏离;而点级重建误差难以在复杂室外点云中区分异常与正常波动。因此需要挖掘互补的异常证据。
AI.method: SRR:在特征通道、时间序列、几何空间三个维度的残差结构上提取异常线索;并论证语义判别(类别兼容性)与正常模式重建(与学习到的正常模式的一致性)提供本质不同且互补的证据。RGDB:以SRR得到的正常模式一致性线索引导语义条件异常解码器,在训练中互补重建预测;推理时两分支联合利用互补证据。
AI.result: 在匹配背景误报率下,SRR比语义分支找回更多被完全漏检的目标,且在纯正常场景中误报更少;单独SRR在无目标场景语义标签下构成强重建基线;RGDB在STU验证集上达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 语义判别与重建一致性是互补的异常证据来源;结构化残差推理与双分支融合可有效提升LiDAR异常检测的召回与精度平衡。

title: Ziv Meets Sumcheck: Zero-Knowledge Proofs of Floating-Point LLM Inference
summary: Zero-knowledge proofs can show that a neural network produced a given output without revealing the network, but current systems for language models prove integer approximations of the model rather than the floating-point arithmetic that is actually deployed. Proving floating-point matrix multiplication has been regarded as hard, because rounding after every addition makes the result depend on the order of the additions. We avoid this obstacle by proving the correctly rounded product, in which every dot product is computed exactly and rounded once. This result is independent of the hardware and at least as accurate as standard kernels. We give an interactive proof for this relation whose cost is close to that of integer matrix multiplication, with roughly a thousand times fewer committed values than per-operation floating-point circuits need constraints, extend it to every layer of a transformer, and give a privacy construction for the complete argument whose zero knowledge we prove under explicit hypotheses. We implement the system and prove the full forward pass of GPT-2 small, including all twelve blocks and the output over the whole vocabulary, in 19 minutes on two processor cores; verification takes 21 seconds. The verifier rejects all 236 attacks we tested, and the model's outputs agree with high-precision inference at least as closely as standard 16-bit inference does.

AI.tldr: 提出针对"正确舍入"浮点矩阵乘法的交互式零知识证明，成本接近整数矩阵乘法，可覆盖Transformer全部层，并在2核上19分钟证完GPT-2 small完整前向传播，验证21秒。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型零知识证明系统只能证明模型的整数近似，而实际部署的是浮点运算，两者不一致。证明浮点矩阵乘法被认为困难，因为每次加法后的舍入使结果依赖加法顺序，导致需为每个操作单独设约束、开销巨大。
AI.method: 回避逐次舍入的顺序依赖：改为证明"正确舍入的乘积"——每个点积精确计算、只舍入一次，结果与硬件无关且至少与标准内核同样精确；据此构造成本接近整数矩阵乘法的交互式证明，承诺值数量比逐操作浮点电路少约千倍；将协议扩展到Transformer的每一层，并为完整论证给出隐私构造，其零知识性在明确假设下得到证明；实现系统并对GPT-2 small全程前向（含12个块与全词表输出）进行证明。
AI.result: 在双核处理器上证明GPT-2 small完整前向传播耗时19分钟，验证耗时21秒；验证者拒绝了全部236次测试攻击；模型输出与高精度推理的一致性至少与标准16位推理相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过"单次舍入"的语义选择，把浮点矩阵乘法的证明复杂度拉近整数情形，首次实现对真实部署的浮点Transformer的可实用零知识证明，兼顾正确性、抗攻击性与数值精度。

title: Generating Safety-Critical Driving Scenarios from Role-Typed Signal Temporal Logic Specifications Drafted by Large Language Models
comment: Manuscript submitted to IEEE OJ-ITS and is currently under review
summary: Safety-critical scenarios are rare in recorded driving and must be generated to test and train motion planners of automated vehicles. In guided diffusion models, each scenario type needs its own weighted objective, separate from the validity check. Optimized together with the attacker, the vehicle under test can cancel the attack or draw it toward itself. We state each scenario as a signal temporal logic specification with clauses typed by role. Every clause names the agent it may change and the agents it may read, and the vehicle under test reads the attacker only from the attack onset. A large language model drafts the specification from a description, and a type checker accepts it. A compiler derives the optimization: it edits a diffusion model's samples by the smallest change that satisfies the specification, each clause moves only its owner, the attacker is solved against the unreacted vehicle under test before its response, and the monitor of the same specification decides acceptance. On nuScenes and CommonRoad, judged independently of the specification, one parameter set produced valid scenarios at a rate 0.14 above a weighted objective tuned per scenario type, and descriptions yielded at least one valid scenario for 11 of the 16 pre-crash types expressible in the public data. Learned planners fail more often on the generated scenarios than on their seeds. Fine-tuning on them lowers a planner's failure rate on critical scenarios, and the time headway one clause of the label requires, not the generator, sets the size of the gain.

AI.tldr: 提出以带角色类型的信号时序逻辑（STL）规范描述安全关键驾驶场景，由LLM起草、类型检查器校验，再编译为扩散模型的受约束最小编辑优化，实现单套参数生成多类有效场景并提升规划器鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 录制的真实驾驶数据中安全关键场景稀少，需生成此类场景以测试和训练自动驾驶运动规划器。现有引导扩散方法存在两个问题：一是每类场景需各自设定加权目标并与有效性校验分离；二是攻击者与被测车辆联合优化时，被测车辆会抵消攻击或把攻击"吸"向自身，导致攻击失效。
AI.method: 将每个场景表述为按角色分型的STL子句规范：每个子句声明其可改动的智能体（owner）与可读取的智能体，被测车辆仅在攻击开始后才读取攻击者。由大语言模型从自然语言描述起草规范，类型检查器验收。编译器据此导出优化：对扩散模型样本做满足规范的最小改动，每个子句只移动其所属智能体；攻击者在被测车辆未反应状态下先行求解，再让其响应；由同一规范的监控器判定接受与否。
AI.result: 在nuScenes与CommonRoad上、独立于规范进行评判：单组参数的有效场景生成率比按场景类型逐类调优的加权目标高0.14；16种公共数据可表达的预碰撞类型中，有11种可由描述生成至少一个有效场景。学习型规划器在生成场景上的失败率高于其种子场景；在这些场景上微调可降低规划器在关键场景下的失败率，且收益幅度由标签中某一子句所要求的时间车头时距决定，而非由生成器决定。
AI.conclusion: 以类型化STL规范统一表达场景语义与有效性，并将其编译为受约束的扩散采样优化，可摆脱逐类加权调参、避免被测车辆与攻击者联合优化的自抵消问题，单套参数跨数据集跨场景类型通用；生成场景对规划器具有区分度与训练价值，且生成质量的关键取决于规范本身而非生成器。

title: Blind to What They Can Fix: A Detection Gap in Self-Improving Agents
summary: AI agents can write programs that carry out a task without calling a model at every step, so the task runs fast and its logic stays open to inspection. Agents improve these programs by running them, studying their failures, and revising the code, a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI). We ask whether this process also yields runtime checks that can be trusted. In five task domains, with up to seven author models, agents bring their programs to high scores. Yet when the environment changes, the checks they were told to write stay silent on half or more of the resulting failures in four domains. These failures can be detected and repaired: a monitor built from records of normal runs catches most of them in three domains, and the same agents usually repair them once called. The checks do not examine the recorded relations that reveal the failures, and the strongest agent writes checks that catch most of them once told that its checks are the only thing that calls it back. An unreported failure stays unrepaired, which limits what self-improvement is worth in autonomous operation. Evaluations of self-improvement should measure not only scores but also whether a system notices its own failures.

AI.tldr: 论文考察递归自我改进（RSI）生成的程序运行时检查是否可信：在五个任务域、最多七种作者模型下，智能体虽能把程序分数做高，但环境变化后其自写检查在四个域中对一半以上的失败"沉默"；这些失败可被检出与修复，但未被上报的失败不会被修复，因此自我改进评估应同时度量分数与自察能力。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体可生成无需每步调用模型的可执行程序，并通过运行—观察失败—改代码的循环实现递归自我改进。但自主运行的关键前提是系统能否相信自己写的运行时检查（runtime checks）。现有评估只看任务分数，未考察检查在分布/环境变化下是否仍能报出失败，因此本文提出该问题。
AI.method: 在五个任务域中，使用最多七个作者模型（author models）驱动智能体进行程序级 RSI，要求其同时编写运行时检查；随后改变环境以引入新的失败模式，测量检查的漏报率（silent on failures）。进一步做两类干预：(1) 用正常运行的记录构建监视器（monitor）以检测异常；(2) 告知智能体"检查是唯一能把失败反馈给你的机制"，观察其是否改进检查并把失败修复。
AI.result: 智能体在各域均取得高分，但环境变化后，四个域中自写检查对一半或以上的失败保持沉默。这些失败是可检测、可修复的：基于正常运行记录构建的监视器在三个域中捕获了大部分失败；被指出失败后，同一批智能体通常能完成修复。分析显示检查并未考察那些能揭示失败的记录关系（recorded relations）；当被告知检查是唯一反馈通道时，最强智能体的检查能捕获大部分失败。
AI.conclusion: 未被上报的失败不会被修复，这限制了自我改进在自主运行中的价值。自我改进的评估不应只报告任务分数，还应度量系统是否能够察觉自身失败。

title: Analyzing Atypical Local Features in Museum Artifacts using Generative Image Inpainting
summary: This study proposes a method for analyzing local visual features in museum artifacts that may appear atypical or unexpected. Objects in the same category often share a similar overall shape, while local details such as patterns, decorations, and facial expressions may reflect regional or cultural characteristics. We use the appearance distribution learned by an image generation model as a reference for what is generally expected within an artifact category. For each target region, we exclude images from that region and fine-tune a generative model using only images from the remaining regions. We then mask selected parts of artifact images from the target region and ask the region-excluded model to complete them. If the completed result differs greatly from the original image, the masked part may contain features that are difficult to predict from the appearance learned from other regions. We measure this difference using LPIPS and treat it as reconstruction difficulty for the generative model. We conduct experiments on images of kokeshi dolls, drums, and masks from the collection of the National Museum of Ethnology. For each category, we select several target regions, build region-excluded LoRA models, and perform inpainting on predefined local parts. The results show that typical shapes and simple decorations are often reconstructed consistently, whereas some region-specific colors, patterns, cord arrangements, and painted details are replaced with more common appearances. These results suggest that region-excluded inpainting can serve as an exploratory tool for finding region-specific local visual features in museum artifact images.

AI.tldr: 提出"区域排除式修补"方法：用去除目标地区图像后微调的LoRA生成模型对文物局部进行inpainting，以LPIPS重建难度作为区域特有局部视觉特征的指示，在民博藏小芥子偶、鼓、面具上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 同类文物整体形态相似，而纹样、装饰、面部表情等局部细节往往承载地区或文化特征。博物馆藏品中这些"非典型/出人意料"的局部特征难以靠人工系统地筛查，需要一种可扩展的探索性分析工具来定位地区特有的视觉元素。
AI.method: 以图像生成模型学到的外观分布作为"类别内常见样貌"的参照。对每个目标地区，剔除该地区图像，仅用其余地区图像微调生成模型（构建region-excluded LoRA）。随后对目标地区文物图像的预设局部区域做遮罩，令该模型完成修补；用LPIPS度量修补结果与原图的差异，作为生成模型的重建难度。对国立民族学博物馆的小芥子偶、鼓与面具三类藏品分别选取若干目标地区开展实验。
AI.result: 典型形态与简单装饰能被一致地重建；而部分地区特有的色彩、纹样、绳结排布与彩绘细节在被修补时被替换为更常见的外观，即这些部位的LPIPS重建难度显著偏高，提示其为区域特有特征。
AI.conclusion: region-excluded inpainting可作为发现博物馆文物图像中地区特有局部视觉特征的探索性工具；重建难度差异可作为该类特征的量化代理指标。

title: Direct Feedback Policy Optimization for AI Coding Agents
summary: AI coding agents generate, modify, and validate code through multi-turn interactions. Existing reinforcement learning methods often rely on sparse terminal rewards, making it difficult to assess how intermediate decisions affect task outcomes, and group-relative methods also require repeated sampling for each task. We propose Direct Feedback Policy Optimization (DFPO), a single-trajectory reinforcement learning algorithm that trains directly from a single trajectory. DFPO achieves higher task resolution rates than GSPO under matched base models and execution harnesses.

AI.tldr: 提出单轨迹强化学习算法DFPO，直接从单条交互轨迹训练AI编码智能体，避免稀疏终端奖励与组相对方法的高采样开销，在同等基座模型与执行环境下任务解决率高于GSPO。
AI.motivation: 现有AI编码智能体通过多轮交互生成、修改与验证代码，但强化学习方法多依赖稀疏的终端奖励，难以刻画中间决策对任务结果的影响；同时组相对方法（如GSPO）需对每个任务重复采样，采样成本高。
AI.method: 提出直接反馈策略优化（DFPO），一种单轨迹强化学习算法，仅基于单条轨迹进行训练，从而利用中间过程信息而非仅依赖稀疏终端奖励，并规避组相对方法的多次采样需求。
AI.result: 在基座模型与执行框架（execution harness）匹配的条件下，DFPO的任务解决率高于GSPO。
AI.conclusion: 单轨迹直接反馈优化可在降低采样成本的同时提升编码智能体的任务完成效果，为多轮代码交互场景提供更高效的强化学习方案。

title: Superellipse Function: A Powerful Geometric Tool for the Design and Deformation Modeling of Tendon-Driven Continuum Manipulators With Flexural Patterns Experiencing Tension Loss
summary: In this article, we feature the Superellipse function as a geometric and versatile tool for effective design and modeling of flexural patterns (FPs) in tendon-driven continuum manipulators (TD-CMs) with discontinuous cross section geometries. We also propose a unique complementary mathematical framework and solution algorithm for modeling the effects of distributed and concentrated friction forces- caused by partially-constrained tendons- on tension loss and deformation behavior of a TD-CM designed using a Superellipse function. Particularly, by employing this geometric function, we establish four intuitive functional mappings relating the manipulator's geometric parameters, kinematics, and deformation behavior. Thanks to the features of these intuitive mappings and Superellipse function, we then introduce the concepts of design space and design curve to facilitate intuitive design of a TD-CM with a generic FP geometry experiencing tendon tension loss. To thoroughly evaluate the performance of this novel framework and its aforementioned features, we performed various simulation and experimental studies on TD-CMs designed and fabricated based on a Superellipse function. Results were then analyzed and compared using different error metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文以超椭圆函数作为腱驱动连续体机器人（TD-CM）柔性图案（FP）的几何设计工具，并提出配套数学框架与求解算法，用于建模分布式与集中摩擦力导致的张力损失与变形行为，进而引入设计空间与设计曲线以支持直观设计。
AI.motivation: 针对截面几何不连续的腱驱动连续体机器人，需要一种几何通用且直观的柔性图案设计手段；同时部分约束腱产生的摩擦会引起张力损失，进而影响变形，缺乏与之匹配的建模框架。
AI.method: 采用超椭圆函数参数化柔性图案；构建互补的数学框架与求解算法，刻画分布式与集中摩擦力对张力损失及变形的影响；建立四个功能映射，关联几何参数、运动学与变形行为；据此提出设计空间与设计曲线的概念。
AI.result: 通过多组仿真与实验研究（基于超椭圆函数设计并制造的TD-CM）验证框架性能，并用多种误差指标对结果进行分析与比较。
AI.conclusion: 超椭圆函数可作为有效且通用的柔性图案几何工具，配合所提摩擦建模框架与设计空间/设计曲线，可实现考虑张力损失的TD-CM直观设计与性能评估。

title: Memphis: A Case Study in Seeding an Agent Task from a Model's Real-World Attempt
comment: 23 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Task, code, trials and data: https://github.com/ia03/memphis-task
summary: Agent benchmarks are usually made harder by scaling up the data their tasks are built from, yet models that do well on them still fail at real work. We propose building simulated tasks from a model's own attempt at an open-ended task in the real world, so that the model's failures in the simulation resemble its failures in reality. As a case study, we had GPT-6.1 Sol manage two human workers in Cairo over chat for five shifts, with a budget of 7,000 Egyptian pounds, to build as many USB desk lamps as it could. It built two. From the real-world attempt's transcript, we build Memphis, an evaluation in a model-simulated world. Memphis is hard: GPT-6.1 Sol delivers 1.0 lamp per trial on average and repeats its real-world mistakes, buying too few stands and giving up the search for them. With a one-page hint on where to buy parts and who can wire them, it delivers 9.2. Claude Opus 5.5 delivers 2.2 without the hint and 4.6 with it. We release the task, the trials, the audits, and a redacted record of the real-world evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出从模型自身在真实开放式任务中的失败记录构建仿真评测环境的思路，并以GPT-6.1 Sol管理开罗工人制作USB台灯为案例，构建Memphis基准，验证模型在仿真中会重现真实失败。
AI.motivation: 现有Agent基准主要通过扩大任务所依赖数据规模来提升难度，但在这些基准上表现良好的模型在真实工作中仍然失败，说明难度提升方式与真实失败模式脱节。
AI.method: 让GPT-6.1 Sol在真实世界中通过聊天管理两名开罗工人、预算7000埃及镑、历时五个班次，尽可能多地制作USB桌面台灯；再基于该真实尝试的对话记录构建模型仿真世界中的评测Memphis，并提供一页提示（购买零件渠道与接线人员）作为对照条件，同时评测Claude Opus 5.5。
AI.result: 真实尝试中仅做出2盏台灯。Memphis上GPT-6.1 Sol平均每轮交付1.0盏，并重现真实错误（购买支架过少、放弃继续寻找）；给出一页提示后提升至9.2盏。Claude Opus 5.5无提示为2.2盏，有提示为4.6盏。
AI.conclusion: 以模型自身真实失败轨迹构建仿真任务可复现其现实失败模式，是一种有效的难度提升与评测方式；提示信息对性能影响显著。作者发布任务、试验、审计记录及脱敏的真实世界评测记录。

title: WorldWeave: Rethinking Embodied Navigation through Cross-Task World Modeling
summary: Mobile embodied agents continuously alter their observations through their own motion, while external dynamics further shape future interactions. Different mobile embodied tasks therefore capture complementary patterns of state evolution, yet jointly learning world dynamics across such interactions remains less explored. We investigate this problem through Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) and Embodied Visual Tracking (EVT), which respectively involve navigation toward a stationary goal and interaction with a moving target. We propose WorldWeave, a cross-task world model that couples shared predictive dynamics with task-specific adaptation. Instead of conditioning state transitions on heterogeneous physical actions, WorldWeave learns latent actions from observed state changes via inverse-forward dynamics, establishing a shared transition representation across tasks. The resulting future-state predictions are adaptively integrated into task-specific representations for downstream decision making. Experiments across multiple VLN and EVT benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over specialized baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WorldWeave，一种跨任务世界模型，通过逆-前向动力学从状态变化中学习隐含动作，构建 VLN 与 EVT 共享的状态转移表示，并将预测的未来状态自适应融合到任务特定表示中，在多个基准上优于专用基线。
AI.motivation: 移动具身智能体的观测会因自身运动而改变，同时受外部动态影响。VLN（导航至静止目标）与 EVT（跟踪运动目标）分别刻画互补的状态演化模式，但跨此类交互联合学习世界动力学的研究仍较少。此外，不同任务的物理动作空间异构，难以直接用动作条件化统一建模。
AI.method: WorldWeave 采用逆-前向动力学：先从观测到的状态变化中反推隐含动作，再以该隐含动作做前向预测，从而绕开异构物理动作空间，建立跨任务共享的转移表示；同时保留任务特定适配模块，将预测的未来状态自适应地整合进各任务表示以支持下游决策。
AI.result: 在多个 VLN 与 EVT 基准上，WorldWeave 相对各自专用基线均取得一致性提升，说明共享动力学与任务特化结合的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 异构具身任务间可通过隐含动作空间实现世界动力学的共享学习，预测式世界模型能作为通用增益模块提升下游决策性能。

title: THETA: Heat Diffusion as a Structural Prior for Cross-Domain Transfer in Graph Foundation Models
summary: Graph foundation models (GFMs) aim to learn transferable representations across domains with heterogeneous node attributes and graph structures. However, relations inferred from node attributes can rely on domain-specific feature semantics, limiting their transferability to unseen graphs, particularly in low-label regimes. We propose THETA (Topology-aware HEat-based TrAnsfer), a graph foundation model that leverages Heat Kernel Signatures (HKS) as a topology-based structural prior for cross-domain transfer. By characterizing nodes' heat-return behavior across diffusion scales, HKS provides a common structural descriptor across graphs without requiring aligned attribute semantics, complementing feature-based relations with information about local and multiscale connectivity. THETA incorporates this prior into both pre-training and few-shot adaptation. During pre-training, it combines HKS with node attributes to construct refined graph views and trains a shared encoder via contrastive learning. During adaptation, it uses HKS to guide edge-weight adjustment and prototype refinement while keeping the encoder frozen and retaining the contribution of labeled support nodes. Through HKS, THETA uses structural information from heat diffusion to guide both representation learning and few-shot adaptation with unlabeled target-domain data. Extensive experiments across diverse graph domains demonstrate that THETA consistently outperforms existing baselines on downstream tasks, highlighting the value of heat diffusion as a structural prior for transferable graph representations.

AI.tldr: THETA 提出以热核签名（HKS）作为与属性语义无关的拓扑结构先验，将其注入图基础模型的预训练与少样本适配两个阶段，实现跨域迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有图基础模型（GFM）依赖节点属性推断关系，但属性特征语义具有领域特异性，导致在无标签或低标签的新图上迁移能力受限；因此需要一个不依赖属性语义对齐的通用结构描述符。
AI.method: 1) 以 HKS 刻画节点在不同扩散尺度下的"热回返"行为，提供跨图通用的多尺度连通性结构描述；2) 预训练阶段将 HKS 与节点属性结合构建精化图视图，用对比学习训练共享编码器；3) 适配阶段冻结编码器，利用 HKS 指导边权调整与原型精化，并保留有标签支持节点的贡献，从而在无标签目标域数据上进行少样本适配。
AI.result: 在多个不同图领域的广泛实验中，THETA 在下游任务上持续优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 热扩散结构先验可作为可迁移图表示的有效来源，弥补属性语义依赖带来的迁移瓶颈，为跨域少样本图学习提供新思路。

title: How Should a Home Robot Update Its Memories When Human Routines Change?
comment: Non-archival version presented at the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Continually Self-Improving Robots and the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Robot Memory. Code: https://github.com/nesl/memory-for-home-robots
summary: A home robot that helps with chores needs to know where objects are, but people move objects according to routines that change and later change back. The robot's memory must adapt to the new routine without erasing experience that may become useful again. One approach is to have a language model maintain written summaries of the home from the robot's own observations, but existing evaluations of such memories use static worlds. We explore simulated households where a resident gets sick, recovers, and later gets sick again. We compare a rule that keeps every room an object has been seen in, language-model memories that store only written summaries, and language-model memories that can also read the raw history of sightings. The rule outperforms every summary-only memory, and giving language models the sighting history closes the gap. Surprisingly, writing summaries on top of the history adds nothing we can measure. When the illness returns, methods that keep the history search better than they did the first time, while summary-only methods show no consistent improvement. Deleting the first illness from memory removes all of the rule's gain and part of theirs. The summaries recorded where objects went during the illness but rarely distinguished sick-day patterns from normal routines. Our findings suggest that common approaches to summarizing robot memories struggle to remember facts about a routine that might return, highlighting the need for future benchmarks to evaluate this aspect of long-term robot deployment.

AI.tldr: 在模拟家庭中（居民患病-康复-再患病）比较三种机器人物体记忆方案，发现"保留所有目击房间"的规则优于纯摘要式语言模型记忆，而给语言模型原始目击历史可弥合差距，且历史之上再写摘要没有可测增益。
AI.motivation: 家用机器人的记忆需适应人的习惯变化，且在习惯回归时不应丢失曾经有用的经验。现有对语言模型"书面摘要式"记忆的评估都基于静态世界，无法检验记忆对新旧常规交替的适应能力。
AI.method: 构建居民患病、康复、再度患病的模拟家庭环境；对比三类方法：(1) 记录物体所有曾被观测到的房间的规则；(2) 仅保存书面摘要的语言模型记忆；(3) 可读取原始目击历史的语言模型记忆；并做删除"第一次患病"记忆的消融实验与分析。
AI.result: 规则方法优于所有仅摘要式记忆；提供目击历史后语言模型追平规则；在历史之上再写摘要无可测增益。疾病复发时，保留历史的方法搜索表现优于首次，而仅摘要方法无一致提升。删除第一次患病记忆会消除规则的全部增益和部分摘要方法的增益。摘要记录了物品在患病期间的去向，但很少区分病日模式与正常常规。
AI.conclusion: 主流机器人记忆摘要方法难以记住"可能回归的常规"这类事实，说明长期部署评估需要专门基准来检验这一记忆维度。

title: Who Makes the Decision? Auditing an Agentic LLM Pipeline for Illicit Cryptocurrency Transaction Monitoring
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. Accepted to the 3rd Workshop on Big Data Analysis AND Illicit Trends (BANDIT) at IEEE BigData 2026
summary: Agentic pipelines that combine graph detectors, deterministic rules, retrieval-augmented generation and an LLM judge are being proposed to monitor illicit cryptocurrency flows and to write regulation-citing justifications for analysts. They are evaluated on end-to-end accuracy or on the quality of those justifications, and neither shows which component made a decision. We audit such a pipeline on the Elliptic++ Bitcoin dataset with decision-source attribution, a trace-level protocol with three layers: per-case actual causation, interventional Shapley credit, and mediation of upstream risk scores. A deterministic wallet-score override carries about 94% of the credit for flags, and a verification gate cancels most of the judge's own flags, which fall on licit transactions. Testing the judge alone over 76 evidence bundles, four backbones and two prompts, we find that it follows an injected risk score on the anonymous transaction features it is given, although stronger models decide correctly when the facts are explicit; that a context too short for the system prompt leaves it with no verdict at all; and that it cites regulatory clauses that do not apply, which a substring-based citation check accepts. Hiding the score does not fix the judge, because evidence gathered with the score visible still encodes it. For illicit-activity monitoring, an LLM's justification should therefore not be read as evidence of which component flagged a transaction.

AI.tldr: 本文对"图检测器+确定性规则+检索增强生成+LLM裁判"的反洗钱智能体流水线做决策来源归因审计，发现约94%的标记功劳来自确定性钱包评分覆盖规则，且LLM理由并不反映其决策来源。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体流水线以端到端准确率或理由质量为评价标准，二者都无法揭示究竟是哪个组件做出了决策，导致LLM生成的理由被误当作归因证据。
AI.method: 在Elliptic++比特币数据集上提出trace级"决策来源归因"协议，含三层：逐案例实际因果（actual causation）、干预式Shapley信用分配、上游风险分数的中介分析；并对LLM裁判单独开展实验（76个证据束、4个骨干模型、2种提示）。
AI.result: 确定性钱包评分覆盖承担约94%的标记信用；验证门取消了LLM裁判的大多数自有标记（这些标记多落在合法交易上）；裁判会跟随注入的匿名特征风险分数，仅强模型在事实明确时判断正确；上下文过短时无法给出结论；会引用不适用的监管条款，且基于子串的引用检查无法识别；隐藏分数无效，因可见分数时收集的证据已编码该信息。
AI.conclusion: 在非法活动监测中，LLM的论证理由不应被视为"哪个组件标记了交易"的证据。

title: LoopSight: Looped Vision Transformers with Gated Prediction Memory
summary: Looped vision transformers extend computation for visual reasoning by repeatedly applying a shared Transformer core. A challenge is to preserve useful prediction information across loop iterations while allowing the computation state to evolve. In this paper we introduce LoopSight, a looped vision transformer that uses Gated Prediction Memory (GPM) to maintain a persistent prediction state for readout, separate from the core's evolving computation state. At each iteration, a cross-attention gate uses the core's candidate features, the previous prediction state, and the current task state to control writes at the patch and channel level. The model decodes its prediction from the updated memory. We condition the shared core on the current iteration using asymptotic loop encoding and train the model by supervising its prediction at loop counts sampled from a truncated Gaussian distribution. LoopSight outperforms LoopViT across three model scales on ARC-AGI-1 and ARC-AGI-2. On ARC-AGI-1, LoopSight-Small achieves 67.4% pass@2, a gain of 6.6 percentage points over LoopViT-Small with comparable parameter counts and FLOPs. LoopSight also outperforms LoopViT on Visual Sudoku and ImageNet classification. Further analyses on ARC-AGI-1 show that LoopSight preserves more already-correct predictions and maintains more stable readout features as its computation state continues to evolve. The code will be released at https://github.com/feufhd/LoopSight.

AI.tldr: LoopSight 是一种循环视觉 Transformer，用门控预测记忆（GPM）在循环迭代间持久保存预测状态，与核心计算状态解耦，并结合渐近循环编码与截断高斯采样监督训练，在 ARC-AGI-1、ARC-AGI-2 等任务上超越 LoopViT。
AI.motivation: 循环视觉 Transformer 通过反复复用共享 Transformer 核心来扩展视觉推理的计算量，但存在一个关键矛盾：既要跨循环迭代保留有用的预测信息，又要允许计算状态持续演化。已有方法（如 LoopViT）将预测读出直接挂钩于不断变化的核心特征，易导致已正确的预测被破坏、读出特征不稳定。
AI.method: 提出 LoopSight，核心是门控预测记忆（GPM）：为读出维护一个持久的预测状态，与核心的演化计算状态相互分离。每次迭代中，交叉注意力门以核心的候选特征、上一轮预测状态和当前任务状态为输入，在 patch 级与通道级控制写入；预测从更新后的记忆解码。同时用渐近循环编码（asymptotic loop encoding）让共享核心感知当前迭代次数，并以截断高斯分布采样的循环次数进行预测监督训练。
AI.result: 在 ARC-AGI-1 与 ARC-AGI-2 的三个模型规模上均优于 LoopViT。ARC-AGI-1 上 LoopSight-Small 达到 67.4% pass@2，在参数量与 FLOPs 相当的情况下比 LoopViT-Small 高 6.6 个百分点；在 Visual Sudoku 与 ImageNet 分类上同样优于 LoopViT。分析表明 LoopSight 能保留更多已正确的预测，并在计算状态持续演化时维持更稳定的读出特征。
AI.conclusion: 通过将预测记忆与计算状态解耦，并以门控机制选择性写入，LoopSight 有效缓解了循环 Transformer 在迭代中遗忘/破坏已有正确预测的问题，在视觉推理任务上带来稳定且一致的性能提升；代码将开源。

title: NANO: Unifying Missingness and Input Uncertainty in Tabular Learning
summary: Missing values are common in tabular data, yet current approaches to handling them often overlook two dimensions. First, an observed value may be uncertain, while a Not-Observed (N.O.) value may still have a reasonable estimate. Inputs should therefore span a continuous spectrum from no evidence to a fully trusted observation. Second, Not-Applicable (N.A.) means that no meaningful value exists for a record, yet this semantic state often lacks explicit representation. To address both dimensions, we introduce NANO, a unified plug-in for input encoding that fits most token-based architectures. Guided by Bayesian evidence weighting, NANO adjusts the influence of a supplied value according to confidence, with all zero-confidence estimates mapped to the same N.O. representation. NANO accepts, but does not require, per-example confidence information during training or inference. For N.A., a separate representation enables models to encode inapplicability and its schema-defined reasons into context. Experiments across eleven datasets and nine backbones show that mixed-confidence training enables a single NANO model to generalize across inference confidence levels, remaining competitive without estimates and improving steadily as estimate reliability and confidence increase. The effectiveness of NANO's handling of N.A. is further demonstrated on three augmented datasets.

AI.tldr: NANO 是一种统一的输入编码插件，基于贝叶斯证据加权，将数值缺失处理扩展为"置信度连续谱"与"不适用（N.A.）"两个维度的显式表示，可插入多数基于 token 的表格模型。
AI.motivation: 现有表格数据缺失值方法忽视两点：(1) 观测值本身可能不确定，而"未观测（N.O.）"值也可能有合理估计，输入应覆盖从"无证据"到"完全可信观测"的连续谱；(2) "不适用（N.A.）"表示记录不存在有意义取值，这一语义状态通常未被显式建模。
AI.method: 提出 NANO 统一输入编码插件：以贝叶斯证据加权为指导，按置信度调节所给取值的影响，并将所有零置信度估计映射到同一 N.O. 表示；训练/推理中置信度信息为可选输入。针对 N.A. 设置独立表示，使模型能将不适用性及其由 schema 定义的原因编码进上下文。
AI.result: 在 11 个数据集、9 个骨干网络上验证：混合置信度训练使单一 NANO 模型可跨不同推理置信度水平泛化；在无估计值时保持竞争力，并随估计可靠性与置信度提升而稳定改善。在 3 个增强数据集上进一步验证了 N.A. 处理的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将缺失值从离散的"缺失/存在"二值视角，重构为"置信度连续谱 + 不适用语义"的双维表示，可获得通用、可插拔且对置信度信息鲁棒的性能收益。

title: Arcadian: Open-Source Humanoid Ecosystem for Accessible and Customizable Research and Education
summary: Reproducing and modifying a meter-scale humanoid remains challenging for research and teaching groups with limited fabrication resources and engineering support. This paper presents Arcadian, an open-source humanoid ecosystem that offers accessible and customizable humanoid hardware and software with community support. Arcadian aims to strike a balance among cost-effectiveness, structural durability, and full customizability, lowering the barrier to entry for research and education. Specifically, this meter-scale humanoid adopts metal-embedded 3D printing to achieve a high strength-to-cost ratio, eliminating the need for computer numerical control (CNC) machining while retaining design flexibility. Extensive simulation and hardware tests validate the design: a reinforcement-learning (RL) locomotion policy trained in simulation transfers to the hardware, and a virtual reality (VR) teleoperation interface drives both arms for simple manipulation tasks. The robot is around one meter tall and costs approximately $6,800 to build. All computer-aided design (CAD) models, the bill of materials, assembly documentation, and training and deployment code are publicly released, distributed through Tnkr.ai and MakerWorld and supported by a Discord server and a project forum through which community feedback informs design updates. The ecosystem resources are available at https://anonymous-humanoid.gitbook.io/docs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Arcadian——一个开源、可定制的米级人形机器人软硬件生态，采用金属嵌入3D打印以高强重/强价比替代CNC加工，成本约6800美元，并通过仿真训练RL步态策略实现sim-to-real迁移、VR遥操作完成简单操作任务，全部CAD、BOM、装配文档与训练部署代码公开，并依托社区论坛迭代设计。
AI.motivation: 科研与教学团队在制造资源和工程支持有限的情况下，复现并改造米级人形机器人仍十分困难；现有平台要么成本高、要么依赖CNC等重型加工，缺乏兼顾成本、结构耐久性与完全可定制性的可获取方案。
AI.method: 1) 硬件设计：采用金属嵌入3D打印（metal-embedded 3D printing）构建结构件，在保留设计自由度的同时获得高强重/强价比，免除CNC加工需求；2) 系统形态：约一米高、成本约6800美元的人形本体；3) 软件与验证：在仿真中训练强化学习（RL）运动策略并迁移至实机（sim-to-real），同时构建VR遥操作接口驱动双臂完成简单操作任务；4) 生态与开放：公开发布CAD模型、物料清单（BOM）、装配文档及训练与部署代码，通过Tnkr.ai、MakerWorld分发，并以Discord服务器与项目论坛收集社区反馈驱动设计迭代。
AI.result: 大量仿真与实物测试验证了设计有效性：仿真中训练的RL步态策略成功迁移至硬件平台；VR遥操作界面可驱动双臂完成基本操作任务。机器人高约1米，建造成本约6800美元，实现了低成本与结构强度的平衡。
AI.conclusion: Arcadian通过"金属嵌入3D打印+开源软硬件生态"的组合，在成本、耐久性与可定制性之间取得平衡，降低了人形机器人研究与教学的门槛；开放的文档、代码与社区机制有助于持续改进和推广复用。

title: MobileGrail: Learning Compact Guardrails for On-Device deployable Mobile GUI Agent Safety
summary: Runtime guardrails protect mobile GUI agents by assessing each proposed action before execution, but existing guardrails rely on cloud hosted large multimodal models, exposing every screen to a remote server, including private information such as payments, messages, and medical records. We propose MobileGrail, an on-device deployable model that addresses both. It maintains a recurrent task state that retains only the evidence subsequent safety decisions depend on, so that authorization and execution progress persist beyond the short context. To intervene early while keeping the safety boundary precise, it learns two labels, unsafe and block: unsafe marks the action that commits a violation, whereas block may be issued at any step of an intervention window, which spans from the first action that the user's authorization no longer explains to the committing action itself. To support training, we build an environment of 32 applications whose backends verify the effect of every action, supplying verified labels for supervision and rewards for reinforcement learning to calibrate intervention timing. We also build MobileVeto, an offline benchmark of unsafe trajectories largely on held-out applications, each paired with a benign counterpart. On MobileVeto, MobileGrail built on Qwen3.5-2B intercepts 76.2% of violations, up from 64.5% for its prompted backbone, while reducing premature intervention from 58.6% to 5.2%, outperforming the cloud-based OS-Sentinel on both. We further conduct online evaluation on GhostEIBench, where MobileGrail guarding a Qwen3.8-27B agent reduces fully successful attacks from 13 to 3 of 110 tasks while raising task completion from 48 to 58. Quantized to 4 bits, MobileGrail runs on a Snapdragon 8 Elite at a median latency of 4.7 s, comparable to the 5.1s of cloud-hosted Gemini 3.8 Flash.

AI.tldr: MobileGrail：可端侧部署的移动GUI智能体运行时护栏，通过循环任务状态与"unsafe/block"双标签实现早期且精准的干预，在自建MobileVeto基准上超越云端OS-Sentinel，4bit量化后可在骁龙8 Elite上以4.7s中位延迟运行。
AI.motivation: 现有移动GUI智能体的运行时护栏依赖云端大模型，需将屏幕内容（含支付、消息、医疗记录等隐私信息）上传至远程服务器，存在隐私泄露风险。因此需要一种可在设备端部署、同时保证安全判定准确性与干预及时性的方案。
AI.method: 1) 采用循环任务状态（recurrent task state），仅保留后续安全决策所依赖的证据，使授权与执行进度能跨越短上下文持续存在；2) 设计双标签：unsafe标注真正实施违规的动作，block可在干预窗口内任一步发出，窗口从用户授权不再能解释的首个动作延伸至实施动作；3) 构建32个应用的环境，后端验证每个动作效果，提供已验证标签监督与强化学习奖励以校准干预时机；4) 基于Qwen3.5-2B训练，并构建离线基准MobileVeto（含留出应用上的不安全轨迹及其良性对照）。
AI.result: 在MobileVeto上拦截76.2%的违规（提示词基线为64.5%），过早干预率从58.6%降至5.2%，两项均优于云端OS-Sentinel。在GhostEIBench在线评测中，守卫Qwen3.8-27B智能体时，110个任务中完全成功攻击由13降至3，任务完成数由48提升至58。4bit量化后于骁龙8 Elite上运行，中位延迟4.7s，与云端Gemini 3.8 Flash的5.1s相当。
AI.conclusion: MobileGrail证明端侧小模型护栏可在保护隐私的前提下同时兼顾高拦截率与低误干预，性能超过云端方案且延迟可接受，为移动GUI智能体的隐私安全部署提供了可行路径。

title: CLASP: Deciding Structure and Claims Before Decoding for Whole-Slide Pathology Report Generation
summary: Whole-slide pathology report generation has advanced through stronger slide encoders, retrieved knowledge, and, recently, slide-level multimodal LLMs. However, these generators leave every report-level choice to the decoder: how long the report is, how it is organised, and which findings it states and where. On the standard PathText-BRCA benchmark, we find that these choices dominate n-gram overlap, as reports from the query's hospital selected without learning approach the state of the art, while decoders under-generate and fall back to the most frequent findings. We present CLASP, a decide-then-decode generator that makes these choices explicitly, once per slide. Before decoding, an Exemplar Structure Prior (ESP) takes the sentence plan and length from reports of image-similar cases, a Calibrated Claim Decision (CCD) selects the findings from calibrated slide posteriors, and a Claim-to-Sentence Placement (CSP) assigns each finding to a planned sentence. A Plan-Conditioned Decoder (PCD), refined by structure-anchored sequence training, then writes the report under these decisions. With 35M parameters, CLASP outperforms retrained report generators and slide-level LLMs of up to 7B parameters, matches the strongest published results, and generalises to lung cancer from unseen hospitals.
