AI.method: AoG为分层框架，外层为随物理状态演化的规划器（evolving outer planner），依据观测新鲜度、剩余恢复窗口以及推理/恢复/后续执行所需时间进行控制权分配，使决策与物理时钟对齐；内层耦合循环（coupled inner loops）联合优化介入时机、恢复技能与交接条件。优化信号不限于局部纠错，而采用下游任务进展、失败重现、最终结果与资源消耗来同时改进恢复行为与调度。
AI.result: 在RoboDojo-Sim上成功率达50.57%、任务得分57.26，较最强基线分别提升11.22个百分点和10.68分；相较GPT-6 Astra智能体，端到端episode时延降低80.4%，在线token消耗降低85.1%。
AI.conclusion: 将智能体的临时性解决方案转化为可复用的协作能力，与冻结策略形成互补；验证了以物理时序为核心的调度与内层联合优化在策略-智能体协作中的有效性。

title: Context-Grounded Skill Internalization for Vision-Language Agents
comment: 30 pages, 13 figures, 23 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Skill internalization offers a way for agents to learn useful behaviors from skills and use them without explicit guidance in context at inference time. A common approach is to generate demonstration trajectories with the skill in context and then fine-tune the same model on its own trajectories with the skill removed. However, this leads to the problem that the model may learn to reference the removed skill, which we named as context misalignment (CoMi). In this work, we first analyze agent behaviors related to CoMi under this common pipeline. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ARC-AGI-1, skill-removed fine-tuning consistently results in CoMi: 12.2-46.0% of test trajectories reference the removed skill. To address this problem, we develop Context-Grounded Skill Internalization (CGSI). CGSI uses a sentence detector to identify unsupported references and then masks or rewrites the selected sentences before fine-tuning. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of CGSI and reveal two key findings. (i) Compared with directly fine-tuning with the skill removed, CGSI reduces CoMi at test time by 72.5-94.6% while preserving task success. (ii) Compared with existing reinforcement learning-based skill-internalization baselines, CGSI achieves comparable performance with substantially less training time. CGSI also significantly reduces processing costs compared with large-scale trajectory auditing and correction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"上下文错位"(CoMi)问题：在"带技能生成轨迹→去技能微调"的常见技能内化流程中，模型会学会引用已被移除的技能；作者提出 CGSI（基于句子检测识别无支撑引用，再掩码或重写）来缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 技能内化的常见做法是先在上下文中给出技能生成示范轨迹，再在去掉技能的情况下用模型自身轨迹微调。但模型可能学到对已移除技能的显式引用，导致推理时无技能上下文即失效，形成上下文错位(CoMi)，而现有工作未系统分析该现象。
AI.method: 先在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ARC-AGI-1 上分析去技能微调下的 CoMi 行为；随后提出 CGSI：用句子检测器定位缺乏上下文支撑的引用句，在微调前对这些句子进行掩码或改写，从而让训练数据与推理时的无技能上下文对齐。
AI.result: (1) 去技能微调在三个环境中稳定引发 CoMi，12.2%–46.0% 的测试轨迹引用被移除技能；(2) 相比直接去技能微调，CGSI 将测试期 CoMi 降低 72.5%–94.6%，同时保持任务成功率；(3) 相比强化学习型技能内化基线，CGSI 以显著更少训练时间达到相当性能；(4) 相比大规模轨迹审计与修正，CGSI 显著降低处理成本。
AI.conclusion: CoMi 是技能内化流程中被忽视的系统性问题；CGSI 以低成本、高效率的方式在保持任务表现的同时大幅抑制该问题，为技能内化提供了简洁有效的训练数据对齐方案。

title: Learning Continuous Scene Depth Representations via Cross-Modal Gaussian Rendering
summary: Depth super-resolution with color guidance is a fundamental problem in geometric scene understanding that aims to reconstruct high-resolution depth using structural cues from color images. In practical RGB-D systems, the resolution gap between depth and color images often varies, requiring flexible upsampling factors. However, many existing methods are designed for predefined integer scales. Although implicit methods support arbitrary-scale reconstruction, they typically rely on computationally demanding per-pixel neural decoding and may struggle to recover sharp depth boundaries and fine structures. To this end, we propose a cross-modal Gaussian rendering framework that learns continuous depth representations for arbitrary-scale depth super-resolution. Specifically, we first construct hierarchical Gaussian representations for progressive depth reconstruction, with explicit spatial support defined by learnable Gaussian primitives. Building on this representation, we design a Structure-Aware Gaussian Aggregation module that combines spatial weights with cross-modal feature affinities to reduce aggregation across depth discontinuities. We then develop a Scale-Adaptive Gaussian Rendering module that adapts Gaussian spatial kernels to the target pixel footprint. To further facilitate cross-modal learning, we propose a training strategy that gradually introduces higher-frequency guidance information during training. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method at both in-distribution and out-of-distribution upsampling scales.

AI.tldr: 提出跨模态高斯渲染框架，用可学习高斯基元学习连续深度表示，实现任意尺度彩色引导深度超分辨率。
AI.motivation: RGB-D系统中深度与彩色分辨率差距多变，需灵活上采样因子；现有方法多为预设整数尺度，隐式方法虽支持任意尺度但依赖逐像素神经解码、计算开销大，且难以恢复锐利深度边界与精细结构。
AI.method: ①构建分层高斯表示，以可学习高斯基元定义显式空间支撑，实现渐进式深度重建；②结构感知高斯聚合模块，将空间权重与跨模态特征亲和度结合，抑制跨深度不连续处的聚合；③尺度自适应高斯渲染模块，使高斯空间核适配目标像素足迹；④训练策略，训练中逐步引入更高频引导信息以促进跨模态学习。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，方法在分布内与分布外上采样尺度下均有效。
AI.conclusion: 基于高斯基元的连续深度表示可兼顾任意尺度灵活性与边界/细节保真度，并避免逐像素解码的高计算成本。

title: Optimal Bandits with Switching Costs: $(T/\log(T))^{2/3}$ Regret

AI.tldr: 该论文研究带切换代价的对抗性多臂老虎机，证明在 $K$ 臂、$T$ 轮、单位切换代价、$[0,1]$ 内 oblivious 损失下，极小极大遗憾为 $\Theta(\min\{T, K^{1/3}T^{2/3}/\log^{2/3}(2+T/K)\})$，表明简单分块策略次优，并给出达到该界的算法与匹配下界。
AI.motivation: 带切换代价的对抗性老虎机中，直接在每个 block 内固定玩一个臂（simple blocking）是自然做法，但作者希望确定其是否最优，并刻画真正的极小极大遗憾率，从而揭示切换代价与信息获取之间的本质权衡。
AI.method: 算法在每个 block 内于随机时刻进行常数次切换；核心思想是给切换时刻附近的观测更大权重，从而"每次切换榨取更多信息"。同时引入 detour 机制：学习器临时播放一个新采样的臂，观测损失越大则 detour 越可能发生；这些 detour 抵消分块引起的时间相关项，同时保留用于估计的观测。下界通过对改进的多尺度随机游走构造进行精细分析得到。
AI.result: 证明了极小极大遗憾为 $\Theta(\min\{T, K^{1/3}T^{2/3}/\log^{2/3}(2+T/K)\})$，显著优于简单分块的 $K^{1/3}T^{2/3}$ 量级（相差 $\log^{2/3}(2+T/K)$ 因子）；并给出与之匹配的下界，说明该率是紧的。
AI.conclusion: 简单分块在带切换代价的对抗性老虎机中并非最优；通过在 block 内随机切换、对切换时刻附近观测加权以及引入自适应 detour，可以突破分块限制并获得最优遗憾率，配合改进的多尺度随机游走下界构造，完整刻画了该问题的极小极大复杂度。

title: RoboThink: Let the Agent Think, Let the Policy Act
summary: Robot policies act in real time but fail without knowing why, whereas a reasoning agent that watches the robot can often tell what went wrong. Existing systems either hand the agent control, which takes minutes per episode, or let it send instructions. Yet a policy follows a new instruction only from a fresh start, since a half-finished task leaves it in states outside its training data. Nor can an instruction fix how the robot moves. If a drift keeps pulling the hand to the left, "push right, slightly" is not a task the policy has learned. We propose RoboThink, in which the agent thinks and the policy learns to act on the agent's guidance. An instruction channel tells the policy what to do. When the user says "the milk, not the butter" after the robot has started, the agent rewrites the instruction and the robot undoes its own motion, with no training. A feedback channel tells it how to move. It is taught from the agent alone with agent-labelled DAgger, role tokens and counterfactual feedback, and is read only by the policy's action module. On LIBERO, RoboThink with Claude Opus 5.5 raises success from 0.09 to 0.87 under an unknown constant drift and from 0.42 to 0.84 under a random one. It also completes misheard and changed requests in 0.91 to 1.00 of the episodes. Acting alone, GPT-6 Astra needs 2.1 min per success and over a million tokens per episode, whereas RoboThink needs 55 s and 8k tokens. The same recipe works across policies, for both vision-language-action models and world action models, and across robots, from one arm to two arms and a mobile manipulator. On all 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks with two arms, success rises from 0.12 to 0.74 under the constant drift and from 0.31 to 0.56 under the random one. Finally, the agent is a plug-in. A policy taught by one agent works with other agents, including open-weight ones, and grows stronger with a stronger agent, without retraining.

AI.tldr: RoboThink 提出"智能体思考、策略执行指导"的分工框架：通过指令通道与反馈通道，使机器人策略在无需重训的情况下纠正漂移、修正误听/变更的请求，显著提升成功率并大幅降低推理开销。
AI.motivation: 机器人策略实时执行但失败时"不知为何失败"；外部推理智能体能诊断问题，但现有方案要么让智能体直接接管控制（每回合耗时数分钟），要么仅发送指令——而策略只能从初始状态出发遵循新指令，半途任务状态落在训练分布外，指令也无法修正运动方式（如恒定向左漂移）。需要一种让智能体负责思考、策略负责在指导下跌代执行的协作机制。
AI.method: 提出 RoboThink，包含两个通道：(1) 指令通道——用户中途更正（如"要牛奶不要黄油"）时，智能体重写指令，策略可撤销自身动作，无需训练；(2) 反馈通道——告诉策略"如何运动"，由 agent-labelled DAgger、角色 token（role tokens）与反事实反馈仅从智能体标注中学习，且只被策略的动作模块读取。
AI.result: LIBERO 上，RoboThink 配合 Claude Opus 5.5 在未知恒定漂移下成功率由 0.09 提升至 0.87，随机漂移下由 0.42 提升至 0.84；误听与变更请求的完成率达 0.91–1.00。相比单独行动的 GPT-6 Astra（每次成功 2.1 分钟、单回合超百万 token），RoboThink 仅需 55 s 与 8k token。方法可跨策略（VLA 与世界动作模型）、跨机器人形态（单臂、双臂、移动机械臂）通用；RoboTwin 2.0 全部 50 个双臂任务上，恒定漂移下成功率 0.12→0.74，随机漂移下 0.31→0.56。
AI.conclusion: 智能体作为即插即用模块：由某一智能体训练出的策略可与其他智能体（含开放权重模型）配合，且在更强智能体下表现更强，无需重新训练。

title: Correlated by Construction: Endpoint Choice and the Validation of Protein Screening
summary: Machine learning for protein engineering depends on functional measurements collected at screening scale, but the designs those measurements rank are deployed in processes that run elsewhere. Whether a miniaturized assay remains informative under the conditions of use is usually assumed rather than demonstrated. We describe an automated production and screening platform and test the transfer of its solution-phase metal-affinity measurements to immobilized rare-earth separation. Primary pKd-derived separation factors tracked those measured on covalently immobilized protein across 82 protein-metal-pair measurements from 35 proteins, with pairwise Spearman correlations of 0.878 to 0.923 (pooled Pearson $r$ = 0.836; Spearman $ρ$ = 0.869). Separation factors at a fixed metal pair are insensitive to the ordering shared across the lanthanide series, so these coefficients report protein-specific correspondence directly; permutation of protein identity confirms it, giving a mean scrambled correlation of 0.003 and, for the 17 proteins measured on all three pairs, $r$ = 0.917 against 0.001 ($p \approx 0.001$). Profiles compared as profiles behave differently. An independent comparison against published LAMBS profiles for the same protein backbones (417 proteins, 5,212 paired measurements) reproduced normalized raw elution at $r$ = 0.870, but reassigning protein identity still reached 0.840. High profile-level agreement across assay formats is largely attributable to metal preferences shared across the series rather than to protein identity. Transfer can be demonstrated, but the endpoint decides whether a correlation shows it: a pairwise contrast removes the shared ordering; a normalized profile retains it, and needs a null that reassigns protein identity.

AI.tldr: 论文搭建了自动化生产与筛选平台，验证溶液相金属亲和测量能否迁移至固定化稀土分离场景。发现"成对分离因子"指标能真实反映蛋白特异性对应关系，而"归一化整体谱型"指标的高相关性主要来自整条镧系共有的金属偏好，需用重排蛋白身份的零模型判定迁移是否成立。
AI.motivation: 蛋白工程机器学习依赖筛选规模的功能测量，但这些被排序的设计最终在别处工艺中使用。微型化测定在使用条件下是否仍有信息量，通常被默认而非被证明。因此需要实证检验测定格式间的可迁移性（transfer）。
AI.method: 构建自动化蛋白生产与筛选平台，测量溶液相金属亲和（pKd 衍生的分离因子）。与共价固定化蛋白实测结果对比：82 组蛋白-金属对测量、35 个蛋白，用成对 Spearman 与合并 Pearson/Spearman 评估；并对蛋白身份进行置换（permutation）构造零模型。另与已发表 LAMBS 谱型做独立比较（417 蛋白、5,212 对测量），对比原始归一化洗脱与身份重排后的相关性。
AI.result: 成对分离因子与固定化测量高度一致：Spearman 0.878–0.923，合并 Pearson r=0.836、Spearman ρ=0.869；身份置换后均值相关仅 0.003，17 个在三种金属对均测的蛋白 r=0.917 对 0.001（p≈0.001）。而谱型比较中，归一化原始洗脱达 r=0.870，但身份重排仍达 0.840，说明高一致性主要来自序列共享的金属偏好而非蛋白身份。
AI.conclusion: 迁移性可以被证明，但取决于所取"端点"：成对对比消除了整条镧系的共有排序，直接报告蛋白特异性对应；归一化谱型保留了该共有排序，必须配合重排蛋白身份的零模型才能判断相关性是否真正体现迁移。

title: ViewAgent3D: A Training-Free Multi-View Pipeline for 3D Scene Understanding
summary: 3D scene understanding tasks are often approached by building explicit 3D scene representations or by training specialized multi-modal models over point clouds, voxels, or scene graphs. We take a complementary view: for many queries, the main bottleneck is not the absence of a stronger 3D representation but the selection of a small subset of multi-view RGB views that actually makes the query answerable. We present a training-free, query-conditioned multi-view pipeline that performs diverse tasks using only 2D images and a set of tools used purely for inference. Our method first decomposes each query into a set of concepts that identify unique attributes that assist with reasoning. This drives a coarse-to-fine evidence selection process: a coarse retrieval selects and scores all views, a diversity-aware selector reduces redundancy, and a reranking stage helps shortlist views by target visibility or answerability. The resulting evidence is optionally grounded for queries that benefit from explicit localization, and a self-verification step helps refine the final response, especially for open-ended cases. Despite using no task-specific training and no explicit 3D representations at inference time, our approach provides approximately 10% gain on 3D VQA and 5% gain on dense captioning and Embodied QA while being applicable across different scenarios. We further propose a unique judge-based evaluation system, motivating a judge who takes into account many semantically correct or partially correct answers, thereby improving holistic scene understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出一个免训练、查询条件化的多视图RGB证据选择流水线，仅用2D图像与推理期工具完成3D场景理解任务，在3D VQA上提升约10%，在稠密描述与具身问答上提升约5%。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景理解多依赖显式3D表示（点云、体素、场景图）或多模态专用模型训练。作者提出互补视角：对许多查询而言，瓶颈不是3D表示不够强，而是未选出真正使查询可回答的少量多视图RGB视角。
AI.method: 免训练的查询条件化多视图流程：1）将查询分解为若干概念，识别有助于推理的独特属性；2）粗到细证据选择：粗检索对所有视图打分，多样性感知选择器降低冗余，重排序阶段依据目标可见性或可回答性筛选候选视图；3）对需要显式定位的查询做可选grounding；4）自验证步骤精炼最终回答，尤其面向开放式问题。另提出基于裁判（judge）的评测体系，可容纳多个语义正确或部分正确的答案。
AI.result: 不使用任何任务特定训练、推理时不使用显式3D表示的情况下，3D VQA约提升10%，稠密描述与Embodied QA约提升5%，且可适用于不同场景。
AI.conclusion: 证据（视角）选择而非3D表示强度是3D场景理解的关键瓶颈；免训练的多视图流水线配合裁判式评测可提升整体场景理解，具备跨任务通用性。

title: RumiFold: Teaching an LLM to Natively Fold Proteins and Reason About Their Function
summary: Can we teach a general-purpose language model to fold proteins? And if so, what does learning to fold enable beyond structure prediction itself? We introduce RumiFold, a pretrained chat model that learns to predict protein structures directly from its own hidden states. RumiFold processes proteins through repeated folding passes, then uses these folded representations to answer questions in natural language. It achieves folding accuracy comparable to dedicated single-representation models such as SimpleFold, alongside state-of-the-art performance on Gene Ontology protein function prediction and free-text function description. We find that folding pretraining organizes the model's hidden states around protein function, creating an internal per-residue workspace that is biologically grounded. Causal interventions show that this folded workspace links structure and language when RumiFold predicts function, providing rich representations for biomolecular reasoning. We see RumiFold as a step toward native biomolecular intelligence: where protein-based computations and language-based reasoning become integrated capabilities of general-purpose language models. Code, data, and models are available at: https://rumifold.baulab.info

AI.tldr: 提出 RumiFold：一个预训练对话式通用语言模型，通过重复"折叠"过程直接从自身隐状态预测蛋白质结构，并将折叠表征用于自然语言功能问答。
AI.motivation: 探究通用语言模型能否学会折叠蛋白质，以及除结构预测之外，学习折叠还能带来什么（如功能预测与内部表征的组织方式）。
AI.method: RumiFold 在自身隐状态上进行多轮迭代的折叠通路处理蛋白质序列，获得折叠表征，再以自然语言方式回答问题；通过因果干预分析折叠工作空间与功能预测之间的关系。
AI.result: 折叠精度与 SimpleFold 等专用单表征模型相当；在 Gene Ontology 蛋白功能预测与自由文本功能描述任务上达到 state-of-the-art；折叠预训练使隐状态围绕蛋白功能组织，形成具有生物学意义的逐残基"工作空间"。
AI.conclusion: 折叠工作空间在功能预测时将结构与语言联系起来，为生物分子推理提供丰富表征，朝向将蛋白计算与语言推理整合的"原生生物分子智能"迈出一步。

title: Value function based Reward shaping for safety in quadrupeds
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has progressed from simple control tasks to complex real-world challenges with large state spaces. While RL excels in these tasks, training time remains a limitation. Reward shaping is a popular solution, but existing methods often rely on value functions, which face scalability issues. This paper presents a novel safety-oriented reward-shaping framework inspired by barrier functions, offering simplicity and ease of implementation across various environments and tasks. To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed reward formulations, we conduct simulation experiments on the Unitree Go1 quadruped robot in Isaacgym. The policy was better than the existing baselines and reduced safety violations from 27% to 0.1% without almost any compromise on the performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种受障碍函数（barrier function）启发的、面向安全的奖励塑形框架，仅依赖状态/约束项而无需价值函数，实现简单、易部署；在IsaacGym中对Unitree Go1四足机器人实验，安全违规率由27%降至0.1%，性能几乎无损。
AI.motivation: 强化学习已从简单控制任务扩展到状态空间庞大的复杂现实任务，但训练时间长仍是瓶颈。奖励塑形是常用加速手段，然而现有方法多基于价值函数（potential-based shaping），在复杂环境中面临可扩展性问题；同时安全性约束在真实机器人任务中至关重要，需要一种简单易用且兼顾安全的奖励塑形方案。
AI.method: 借鉴控制理论中障碍函数（barrier function）的思想，构造面向安全约束的奖励塑形项：将安全约束以类似障碍惩罚的形式纳入奖励函数，使策略在接近危险状态时获得惩罚信号，从而在不依赖价值函数估计的前提下引导学习。该方法结构简单、易于实现，可迁移到多种环境与任务；验证平台为IsaacGym中的Unitree Go1四足机器人仿真。
AI.result: 所提策略优于现有基线方法，安全违规率从27%降至0.1%，且性能（任务奖励/运动表现）几乎无损失。
AI.conclusion: 基于障碍函数的奖励塑形是一种无需价值函数、实现简便且可扩展的安全导向塑形方案，能在四足机器人仿真任务中显著提升安全性而保持性能，体现了其在复杂真实场景RL训练中的实用价值。

title: Post-Training Agents for Long-Document Reasoning
comment: Accepted at the Third Workshop on Long-Context Foundation Models (LCFM) at NeurIPS 2026. 14 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables
summary: Professional documents are a long-context workload that retrieval-style benchmarks do not capture. In a ten-domain enterprise collection, a task's evidence is spread across a source document of median length 27 pages (mean 48.8, maximum 873); a third of tasks rest mainly on charts, drawings, and maps; and 70.9% require two or more reasoning hops. We post-train Kimi-K2.7, an open-weight foundation model, at its full context window on 1,465 expert-authored tasks with atomic rubrics from that collection, training rank-32 adapters with one round of privileged-context on-policy self-distillation followed by two rounds of rubric-reward reinforcement learning. We render each PDF as text for training and as extracted text plus selected page images at evaluation. The smoothed RL training reward rises from 0.37 in the first tenth of the run to 0.67 in the last. On the 100-task GDP.pdf holdout, served in a 262,144-token window, strict pass (all rubric criteria met) more than doubles after the second round, from 11.0% to 24.5%, with gains across input lengths up to 240K tokens. Mean tokens generated stay flat (9,803 to 9,733), so the gain does not come from longer outputs. GPT-5.6 Sol's leaderboard strict pass is 30.7% at a measured 3,422 tokens. On 220 out-of-domain GDPval tasks, where the model runs as a long-horizon tool-using agent, mean rubric reward rises from 0.571 to 0.746 after the third round and zero-credit tasks fall from 54 to 10, while messages per task fall 18%, from 70.9 to 58.2. In paired trajectories, the third round replaces a context-thrashing retry loop with one up-front check of all sources, and verification extends from checking that files exist to checking what they contain. We argue that long-context evaluation of agents should report accuracy jointly with tokens and turns, and that datasets of long documents should ship text and image renderings alongside each PDF.

AI.tldr: 该文提出面向专业长文档工作负载的后训练方案：在Kimi-K2.7全上下文窗口上，用1,465条专家撰写任务（含原子评分表）依次进行一轮特权上下文在线自蒸馏与两轮rubric奖励强化学习，训练rank-32适配器。在100任务GDP.pdf留出集（262,144 token窗口）上严格通过率由11.0%提升至24.5%，且输出token数基本不变；在220个域外GDPval智能体任务上平均rubric奖励由0.571升至0.746。
AI.motivation: 现有检索式基准无法刻画专业文档这一长上下文真实工作负载：任务证据分散在长文档中（中位27页、最大873页），约三分之一任务主要依赖图表、工程图与地图，70.9%需要两步以上推理。同时，智能体评估通常只报告准确率，忽略token与交互轮次成本，长文档数据集也普遍缺少文本与图像双模态呈现。
AI.method: 构建十领域企业文档集合并据此设计1,465条专家标注任务及原子化rubric；在Kimi-K2.7的完整上下文窗口上训练rank-32适配器，流程为：一轮特权上下文（privileged-context）在线策略自蒸馏 + 两轮rubric奖励强化学习。训练时PDF渲染为纯文本，评估时使用抽取文本加选取的页面图像；在262,144 token服务窗口中评测，并在域外GDPval上以长时程工具型智能体方式运行。
AI.result: RL平滑奖励由训练前十分位的0.37升至末十分位的0.67。100任务GDP.pdf留出集严格通过率（满足全部rubric条目）在第二轮后由11.0%翻倍至24.5%，增益覆盖至240K token的输入长度；平均生成token基本持平（9,803→9,733），说明提升并非来自更长输出。对比GPT-5.6 Sol排行榜严格通过率30.7%（实测3,422 token）。域外GDPval上平均rubric奖励由0.571升至0.746，零分任务由54降至10，每任务消息数下降18%（70.9→58.2）。配对轨迹显示第三轮以一次性源文件全量核验取代了上下文反复失效的重试循环，验证行为从"文件是否存在"扩展到"内容是否正确"。
AI.conclusion: 高效的长文档后训练可在不增加输出长度的前提下显著提升严格通过率并改善智能体行为质量。作者主张：智能体长上下文评估应联合报告准确率、token数与交互轮次；长文档数据集应在每个PDF之外同时提供文本与图像渲染版本。

title: CHORD: Closed-loop Human-Object Rectified-flow Decomposition
summary: Text-driven 3D human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires synthesizing whole-body human and object motions that stay coupled through contact. Yet existing generators either entangle the core variables that govern an interaction (object pose, contacting regions, and limb posture) with dozens of subordinate joints, or plan only end-effectors or coarse trajectories. No stage of generation holds the interaction in a form that is both settled and observed, which leaves contact to external guidance, post-hoc refiners, or internal guidance without a surface measurement. We present CHORD, a two-stage rectified-flow framework that settles the interaction in a compact plan and observes that plan against the object surface while it is being generated. First, Draft uses twelve part tokens per temporal patch to jointly plan the 6-DoF object trajectory, contact states, and the end and middle joints of every kinematic chain. At each flow step, Draft decodes the expected interaction from the closed-form clean estimate, measures it against the object surface, and routes this feedback to the responsible part token with zero extra network evaluations. Second, Full keeps this plan unchanged and infills the remaining body and finger joints. On InterAct, CHORD reduces FID by 33% and lifts hand contact F1 from 0.730 to 0.834, while its feedback improves contact on unseen objects and transfers plug-and-play to existing HOI generators.

AI.tldr: CHORD是一个两阶段rectified-flow框架，先在紧凑的part token空间中联合规划交互（物体6-DoF轨迹、接触状态、链路端点与中间关节），并在生成过程中用闭式干净估计对物体表面做接触测量并把反馈路由到对应part token；第二阶段保持该计划不变，补齐其余身体与手指关节。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动HOI生成方法存在两点缺陷：一是把决定交互的核心变量（物体位姿、接触区域、肢体姿态）与大量从属关节纠缠在一起，二是只规划末端执行器或粗粒度轨迹。生成过程中没有任何阶段以"既已定型又可被观测"的形式持有交互，导致接触只能依赖外部引导、事后修正器，或无表面测量的内部引导。
AI.method: 提出CHORD两阶段rectified-flow框架。第一阶段Draft：每个时间patch使用12个part token，联合规划物体6-DoF轨迹、接触状态以及每条运动链的末端与中间关节；在每个flow步，从闭式干净估计中解码期望交互，与物体表面进行测量，并将反馈路由到负责的part token，且不增加额外网络评估。第二阶段Full：保持该计划不变，补齐剩余身体关节与手指关节。
AI.result: 在InterAct数据集上，FID降低33%，手部接触F1从0.730提升至0.834；该反馈机制能改善未见物体上的接触，并可即插即用地迁移到现有HOI生成器。
AI.conclusion: 以紧凑、可观测的计划为中心、并在生成中直接对物体表面测量接触，是提升文本驱动全身HOI生成接触质量的有效范式；该设计兼具泛化性与可迁移性。

title: Beyond Accuracy: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Hypothesis-Driven Experiment Planning in LLM Agents
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track. 41 pages, 6 figures. Project website: https://schwallergroup.github.io/beyond-accuracy/
summary: Evaluating large language model (LLM) agents on scientific tasks typically reduces to final-task accuracy, which obscures where reasoning succeeds or breaks down. We introduce a benchmark and diagnostic evaluation framework for hypothesis-driven adaptive experimental planning in closed-world system identification, instantiated in kinetic mechanism identification. The framework goes beyond final accuracy in two ways. First, we evaluate exploration behavior by quantifying the extent to which agents exhibit space-filling or corner-seeking patterns in the experimental design space. Second, we decompose the reasoning process into four interpretable steps: belief update, hypothesis discrimination, discriminative experiment design, and predictive reasoning under interventions, each scored separately on reasoning traces. Across ten LLM agents, we find that stronger agents outperform both adaptive (Bayesian optimization) and non-adaptive (Latin hypercube) baselines and exhibit exploration patterns inconsistent with naive heuristics. Decomposing reasoning reveals that the stronger agents score consistently well across all four steps, whereas weaker agents often succeed at belief update and hypothesis discrimination but are less reliable at translating them into actionable designs and sharp contrastive predictions. Independent expert annotations support predictive reasoning under our stated validation criteria, while evidence for discriminative experiment design is positive but less consistent. The results suggest a gap between recognizing plausible hypotheses and translating them into contrastive predictions, with more tentative evidence for a corresponding experiment-design bottleneck. The benchmark website is available at https://schwallergroup.github.io/beyond-accuracy/.

AI.tldr: 提出面向"假设驱动自适应实验设计"的诊断式基准框架，以动力学机理辨识为实例，突破仅看最终准确率的评价方式：量化探索行为（空间填充/角落寻优）并将推理分解为四步分别打分；发现强智能体优于贝叶斯优化与拉丁超立方基线，且强智能体四步均衡，弱智能体在"信念更新与假设区分"上尚可、但难以转化为可执行实验设计与鲜明对比预测。
AI.motivation: 当前对LLM智能体的科学任务评测多归结为最终任务准确率，掩盖了推理在何处成功、何处失效，无法定位能力瓶颈，也无法判断智能体是否具备真正的科学探究式推理（提出假设、设计判别性实验、更新信念）。
AI.method: 构建闭世界系统辨识（动力学机理辨识）基准与诊断式评测框架。两方面超越最终准确率：(1) 通过在设计空间中量化智能体的空间填充（space-filling）或角落寻优（corner-seeking）模式来评价探索行为；(2) 将推理轨迹分解为四个可解释步骤——信念更新、假设区分、判别性实验设计、干预下的预测推理——逐步单独评分。实验覆盖10个LLM智能体，并与自适应基线（贝叶斯优化）和非自适应基线（拉丁超立方）对比，辅以独立专家标注验证。
AI.result: 更强的智能体优于贝叶斯优化与拉丁超立方基线，其探索模式与朴素启发式不一致；分步评分显示强智能体四步均稳定得分，弱智能体在信念更新和假设区分上常成功，但在转化为可执行设计和鲜明对比预测上可靠性较低。专家标注支持预测推理项（在既定验证标准下），而对判别性实验设计的证据为正但不一致。
AI.conclusion: 识别假设与将其转化为对比性预测之间存在明显鸿沟，实验设计瓶颈亦有初步但不够一致的证据；表明仅凭最终准确率会高估智能体的科学推理能力，分步诊断评测对定位瓶颈必要。基准网站：https://schwallergroup.github.io/beyond-accuracy/。

title: LeadVLA: Learning Follower-Aware Route Execution for Robot Leading
summary: Robot leading requires executing a route while continuously adapting to a designated follower. Existing robot-leading systems often mediate follower understanding and physical route execution through explicit states, planners, or modular interfaces; directly learning this coupling through end-to-end trajectory prediction can instead entangle route execution with follower response. We introduce LeadVLA, a structured multimodal policy that preserves the route as an explicit Path reference while learning a Pace for route progress and a Residual for local follower- and scene-conditioned adaptation. To make this problem trainable and measurable, we develop LeadInfra, a configurable Unreal Engine-based closed-loop data-generation infrastructure from which we instantiate an approximately 4M-sample training corpus, and LeadBench, a standardized benchmark with 108 fully held-out closed-loop episodes. LeadVLA achieves the highest task success (39.6%) among evaluated robot policies on LeadBench while maintaining strong route fidelity and follower responsiveness, and transfers to unseen real-world environments without real-world policy fine-tuning. Project Page: https://louiszengCN.github.io/LeadVLA_PAGE/

AI.tldr: 提出LeadVLA，一种结构化多模态策略，将路线作为显式Path参考，并分别学习Pace（前进节奏）与Residual（局部自适应），实现机器人边执行路线边适配跟随者；配套构建LeadInfra数据生成设施与LeadBench基准。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人领航系统依赖显式状态、规划器或模块化接口来间接耦合“跟随者理解”与“物理路线执行”；而端到端轨迹预测直接学习该耦合会把路线执行与跟随者响应纠缠在一起，难以训练和评估，也缺乏标准化数据与基准。
AI.method: LeadVLA为结构化多模态策略，保留路线为显式Path参考，解耦学习Pace（路线推进速度）与Residual（顾及跟随者与场景的局部修正）；同时构建基于Unreal Engine的可配置闭环数据生成设施LeadInfra，实例化约400万样本训练语料，并提出含108条完全留出闭环片段的标准化基准LeadBench。
AI.result: 在LeadBench上，LeadVLA在评估的机器人策略中取得最高任务成功率39.6%，同时保持较强的路线保真度与跟随者响应性，并可在不进行真实世界策略微调的情况下迁移到未见过的真实环境。
AI.conclusion: 以显式Path参考加Pace/Residual分解的结构化策略，能有效解耦路线执行与跟随者适配，优于端到端纠缠式学习；LeadInfra与LeadBench为机器人领航任务提供了可训练、可度量的闭环基础设施，且具备零样本真机迁移能力。

title: Small data machine learning: the trilemma of low-sample tabular regimes
summary: Small tabular datasets leave few observations for choosing a model and assessing its predictions. We examine these competing demands in controlled simulations and on six public datasets, using SmallGBM and SmallMLP as fixed-configuration case studies. Three results illustrate why the choice of evaluation matters. First, at n = 100, five-fold cross-validation overstated the gain from tuning XGBoost by 0.063 ROC-AUC on random labels, while tuning improved independent-test ROC-AUC by 0.0078 on a Gaussian mixture. Second, when 20% of binary training labels were flipped, the median within-trial ROC-AUC loss was 0.0210 for SmallGBM and 0.0778 for a fixed 200-tree XGBoost configuration. A separate regression experiment showed the sensitivity of squared-error training to heavy-tailed responses. Third, in a heteroscedastic regression experiment, locally weighted SmallMLP intervals covered about one percentage point more test responses than ordinary split conformal intervals at both tested dimensions. Their mean widths also increased. On a Gaussian classification task with linear log odds, logistic regression achieved the highest mean ROC-AUC at all seven training sizes. These experiments identify settings in which a small-data model helps and quantify the cost of its assumptions.

AI.tldr: 该文通过受控模拟与六个公开数据集，以固定配置的SmallGBM和SmallMLP为案例，系统考察小表格数据下模型选择与评估之间的冲突，指出交叉验证在小样本下会高估调参收益，并量化了标签噪声、重尾分布与异方差等假设带来的代价。
AI.motivation: 小表格数据观测稀少，既要用于选择模型又要用于评估预测，二者争夺同一批样本，导致评估结论可能失真；作者希望说明"评估方式的选择为何重要"，并厘清小数据模型何时真正有益、其假设代价几何。
AI.method: 采用受控模拟加六个公开数据集的实验设计，以固定配置的SmallGBM与SmallMLP为案例。实验一比较五折交叉验证与独立测试集在n=100时的调参收益估计（随机标签与高斯混合任务）；实验二在20%二分类训练标签翻转下比较SmallGBM与固定200棵树XGBoost的ROC-AUC损失，并另做重尾回归实验；实验三在高斯分类线性对数几率任务上跨七个训练规模比较各模型平均ROC-AUC，同时以局部加权SmallMLP区间与普通分裂共形区间比较覆盖率与宽度。
AI.result: n=100时五折交叉验证在随机标签上把XGBoost调参收益高估0.063 ROC-AUC，而高斯混合任务上独立测试集的实际提升仅0.0078；20%标签翻转下组内ROC-AUC损失中位数SmallGBM为0.0210、固定200树XGBoost为0.0778；异方差回归中局部加权SmallMLP区间在两个测试维度上覆盖率均比普通分裂共形区间高约1个百分点，但平均宽度同时增加；线性对数几率的高斯分类任务中，逻辑回归在全部七个训练规模上取得最高平均ROC-AUC。
AI.conclusion: 评估方案本身显著左右小数据结论：交叉验证在极小样本下会夸大调参收益，应优先使用独立测试集；小数据模型对标签噪声、重尾响应与异方差等假设更稳健，但换来区间宽度增大等代价；在近似线性可分的任务上，简单线性模型仍是强基线。研究界定了小数据模型真正发挥作用的场景，并量化了其假设成本。

title: Rethinking Visual Token Retention in Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Autoregressive Large Vision-Language Models solve multimodal reasoning tasks by retaining hundreds or thousands of visual tokens, allowing every generated token to attend to the visual tokens at any time during the generation process. However, whether continuous access to these visual tokens is necessary remains poorly understood. In this work, we investigate how visual token influence evolves along two dimensions: generation time and transformer depth. Using long-form visual reasoning benchmarks and multiple model scales, we first analyze the attention dynamics across generation time and transformer depth. We identify a temporal and depth-wise structure in the use of visual information. Visual attention peaks during the initial generation steps and then rapidly declines as attention shifts toward previously generated reasoning tokens. Across depth, visual influence is concentrated in intermediate layers and becomes very weak in the final layers. We further verify these observations with causal intervention that removes all visual tokens across generation time and model depth. These interventions confirm that visual-token dependence in multimodal reasoning is neither temporally persistent nor uniformly distributed across transformer depth. Thus, retaining the complete visual context at every layer and decoding step may be unnecessary. Our experiments demonstrate that we can remove up to 59\% of tokens from the full input prompt across generation time and 11\% across all transformer layers, while incurring only a very small performance drop. On video benchmarks, up to 65\% of the input prompt tokens can be removed during generation without affecting performance.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究多模态推理中视觉token的作用如何随“生成时间”和“Transformer深度”演化，发现视觉依赖既非时间持续也非深度均匀，并据此提出可大量剪除视觉token而不显著掉点的策略。
AI.motivation: 自回归大型视觉语言模型在推理时保留成百上千个视觉token，使每个生成token都能随时关注视觉信息；但“持续访问完整视觉token是否必要”尚不清楚，存在显著的计算冗余疑点。
AI.method: 在长文本视觉推理基准与多模型规模上，先做注意力动力学分析，刻画视觉注意力随解码步与Transformer层的分布；再用因果干预（在不同生成步/不同层移除全部视觉token）验证依赖关系；最后依据结构规律实施跨生成时间和跨层的视觉token剪除实验，并在视频基准上验证。
AI.result: 视觉注意力在生成初期达到峰值，随后迅速下降并转向已生成的推理token；跨深度上视觉影响集中于中间层，末层很弱。因果干预证实依赖关系非时间持续、非深度均匀。实验中在生成过程中可移除完整输入提示中最多59%的token、跨所有Transformer层移除11%，性能仅轻微下降；视频基准上生成期间最多可移除65%的输入提示token而不影响性能。
AI.conclusion: 视觉token依赖具有明显的时间与深度结构，在每层、每步保留完整视觉上下文并非必要；据此进行选择性剪枝可在极小性能损失下显著降低视觉token开销，为高效多模态推理提供了实证依据。

title: OnCache: Learning Dynamic Caching Schedules for Efficient Diffusion Inference
summary: Diffusion models have revolutionized generative tasks but incur high inference latency due to iterative denoising. Cache-based strategies accelerate inference by reusing intermediate features, yet they largely rely on static, sample-agnostic schedules. Our empirical analysis reveals two factors that these schedules overlook. (i) denoising dynamics and computational requirements vary across prompts, motivating adaptive computation allocation. (ii) sensitivity to caching errors varies across timesteps, so static schedules may reuse features at error-sensitive steps or waste computation at less sensitive ones. We therefore propose OnCache, a dynamic caching framework that makes prompt-adaptive decisions online about how much computation to allocate and when to refresh cached features. A policy is trained offline on paired compute and cache continuations from identical denoising states, using differences in terminal fidelity and the number of function evaluations (NFE) to account for the downstream consequences of each decision. To further improve the generation quality, a neural corrector compensates for caching-induced errors and mitigates their accumulation throughout the denoising trajectory. Both components are lightweight and introduce negligible additional inference latency. On FLUX.1-dev, OnCache achieves a nearly $3\times$ generation speedup at $1024^2$ resolution, with LPIPS of $0.156$ and SSIM of $0.860$. We further extend OnCache to video generation on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, achieving state-of-the-art efficiency--quality trade-offs across both modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出 OnCache：一种在线动态缓存框架，按提示自适应决定计算分配与缓存刷新时机，并用轻量神经校正器补偿缓存误差，在 FLUX.1-dev 上实现约 3 倍加速且质量损失可控。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型因迭代去噪导致推理延迟高。现有基于缓存的加速方法依赖静态、与样本无关的调度策略，忽视了：不同提示的去噪动态与计算需求不同（需自适应计算分配）；不同时间步对缓存误差的敏感度不同（静态调度可能在敏感步复用特征、在非敏感步浪费计算）。
AI.method: OnCache 采用动态缓存框架：在线做出提示自适应的决策，决定分配多少计算以及何时刷新缓存特征。策略离线训练，数据为同一去噪状态下成对的"计算路径"与"缓存路径"续接结果，以终端保真度差异与函数评估次数（NFE）刻画每个决策的下游后果。此外引入神经校正器补偿缓存引入的误差并抑制其在轨迹中累积。两个组件均轻量，额外推理延迟可忽略。
AI.result: 在 FLUX.1-dev、1024² 分辨率下实现近 3 倍生成加速，LPIPS 0.156、SSIM 0.860；扩展到 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 视频生成，在图像与视频两种模态上均取得当前最优的效率—质量权衡。
AI.conclusion: 静态缓存调度存在样本无关与时间步敏感度失衡两大局限，改用在线提示自适应决策加神经误差校正，可在近 3 倍加速下保持较高保真度，并具备跨模态（图像、视频）的通用性。

title: Toward Open Room-Scale Scanning with Consumer LiDAR via Depth-Inertial Odometry
summary: Room scanning with consumer LiDAR today depends on ARKit, whose tracking and map update are a black box: an application receives depth and poses but cannot inspect how they were produced, so an error in a scan cannot be traced to its cause. This paper examines whether an open alternative, one whose every stage can be inspected, is feasible on the device. Mobile-LIO is a depth-inertial odometry pipeline that uses the phone's depth and inertial data and no ARKit poses. On seven ScanNet++ iPhone recordings it completed every scene with 0.2-2.0 m deviation from the ARKit-derived reference, where six open-source LiDAR-inertial estimators run as configured for dedicated scanners had at least 4.46 m in 41 of 42 runs (two of the six also failed a noise-free adapter check, and Mobile-LIO has a speed cap they lack; the comparison is not controlled and does not rone 15 Pro Max, a buildwith corrected phone code kept up with the sensor in 14 of 15 replay runs of three 7-13 s recordings; e estimator before thosecorrections. Laser-scanned meshes give the accuracy. Within 3 m, recorded depth differed from the m on three held-out scenes,maps fused with ARKit poses that the dataset scales and aligns to the mesh la a median 1.8-2.3 cm from 17 cm. Because thepipeline is open, the gap could be examined: in the scene with the largest error, noise-free renderefrom 1.97 m to 0.04 m, sorecorded depth, whose error reached 20-54 cm at 5-7 m, contributed alongside the estimator. An open de tracked on phone depth and kept up with the sensor in short phone replays, but it is not yet as accurate as ARKit-pose maps, whicheach only the coarsestUSIBD accuracy level (LOA10); its accuracy on the device was not measured.

AI.tldr: 本文提出开源可检查的深度-惯性里程计流水线 Mobile-LIO，在 iPhone 上完全不用 ARKit 位姿，7 段 ScanNet++ iPhone 录制全程完成且相对 ARKit 参考偏差 0.2–2.0 m；与之对照，6 个为专用激光扫描仪配置的开源 LiDAR-惯性估计器在 42 次运行中有 41 次偏差≥4.46 m。其精度尚不及基于 ARKit 位姿的地图，但因流水线开放，可将误差归因（噪声-free 渲染下误差由 1.97 m 降至 0.04 m，说明录制深度误差也参与贡献）。
AI.motivation: 消费级 LiDAR 房间扫描目前依赖 ARKit，其跟踪与建图为黑箱：应用只能拿到深度与位姿，无法了解其生成方式，扫描出错时无法溯源。作者因此探究一种每一阶段都可检视的开放替代方案在设备端是否可行。
AI.method: Mobile-LIO：使用手机深度与惯性数据、不使用 ARKit 位姿的深度-惯性里程计流水线。在 7 段 ScanNet++ iPhone 录制上评测，与 ARKit 导出的参考轨迹对比；与 6 个按专用扫描仪配置运行的开源 LiDAR-惯性估计器对比（作者声明该对比非受控）；另做噪声-free 适配检查、iPhone 15 Pro Max 上 15 次回放（3 段 7–13 s 录制）、基于激光扫描网格的精度评估与留出场景验证。
AI.result: 7 个场景全部完成，偏差 0.2–2.0 m；6 个开源估计器在 42 次运行中 41 次偏差≥4.46 m（其中 2 个未通过噪声-free 适配检查，且 Mobile-LIO 具备它们没有的速度上限）；15 次回放中 14 次能跟上传感器；激光扫描网格显示 3 m 内深度与网格的差异、3 个留出场景上与 ARKit 位姿融合的地图中位偏差 1.8–2.3 cm（由 17 cm 改善）；最大误差场景中，改用噪声-free 渲染后误差从 1.97 m 降至 0.04 m，表明录制深度误差（5–7 m 处达 20–54 cm）与估计器共同贡献。
AI.conclusion: 基于手机深度的开放里程计能在短时手机回放中跟踪并跟上传感器，但精度尚不及 ARKit 位姿地图；其误差可被逐级检视与归因是该开放方案的主要价值。此外，评估仅达 USIBD 最粗精度等级（LOA10），设备端实际精度尚未测量。

title: Could This BE Any More Wrong? Teaching VLMs to Know What They Don't Know in Document Extraction
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, 10 tables. Accepted at the AI4Finance Summit at ICAIF '26 (7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance), Milan, Italy. An extended version with a revised experimental protocol will follow
summary: Vision-Language Models can extract structured fields from scanned financial documents, yet they provide no indication of when a field might be wrong. We derive per-field confidence estimates from the token log-probabilities the model already produces, via a token-to-span alignment procedure that maps logprobs onto each extracted value within the structured JSON output. Evaluated on two benchmarks (CORD v2 receipts, Kleister NDA legal contracts) with three VLM families, the minimum token probability per field achieves Area Under the ROC Curve (AUROC) 0.74-0.91 for error detection, far exceeding verbalized confidence (0.53-0.56). The uncertain fields form a natural training curriculum: fine-tuning via Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) improves accuracy from 78.5% to 87.5% on CORD (67 examples) and from 70.7% to 75.1% on multi-page NDA contracts (259 examples), while substantially improving error detection on Kleister NDA (AUROC 0.70 to 0.85, Area Under the Accuracy-Rejection Curve (AUARC) 0.78 to 0.92). The loop requires no annotation beyond the training-split ground truth, demonstrating that confidence-guided curriculum selection transfers to complex multi-page documents when combined with native multi-image training. A frontier model (Claude Sonnet 4) used as a pseudo-label judge achieves ~92% reward agreement with ground truth on both benchmarks, suggesting this loop can operate without human annotation.

AI.tldr: 该论文从VLM已产生的token对数概率中提取逐字段置信度，用于错误检测、相关性排序与GRPO课程选择，在CORD与Kleister NDA上显著提升准确率与错误检测性能，且无需额外标注。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型虽能从扫描金融文档中抽取结构化字段，却不提供字段是否可能出错的信号；而现有"言语化置信度"（verbalized confidence）几乎无判别力。作者希望用模型自身已有的token logprob，低代价地获得可靠、可校准的逐字段置信度，并将其转化为训练信号。
AI.method: 提出token到span的对齐过程：将解码得到的token logprobs映射到结构化JSON输出中每个抽取值，从而得到逐字段置信度（以字段内最小token概率为主指标）。在两个基准（CORD v2收据、Kleister NDA法律合同）与三个VLM系列上评估错误检测（AUROC、AUARC）。进一步将不确定字段作为天然训练课程，用GRPO对模型微调，并采用Claude Sonnet 4作为伪标签评判器以替代人工标注。
AI.result: 错误检测上，字段级最小token概率取得AUROC 0.74–0.91，远超言语化置信度（0.53–0.56）。GRPO微调后CORD准确率78.5%→87.5%（67例），多页NDA合同70.7%→75.1%（259例）；Kleister NDA错误检测显著提升，AUROC 0.70→0.85，AUARC 0.78→0.92。前沿模型作为伪标签评判器与真值奖励一致率约92%。
AI.conclusion: token级logprob经span对齐后可提供有效的逐字段置信度，既可直接用于错误检测与选择性预测，也可指导课程式GRPO训练；结合原生多图像训练时，该置信度引导的课程选择可迁移到复杂多页文档。整个闭环除训练集真值外无需额外标注，且伪标签评判的高一致率表明该流程有望完全脱离人工标注运行。

title: CoopOcc: Cooperative 3D Semantic Occupancy Perception via Multi-Agent and Cross-Modal Fusion
summary: Semantic occupancy perception has emerged as a promising paradigm for jointly modeling 3D scene geometry and semantic information. However, this unified representation cannot compensate for missing information caused by occlusion and sensor coverage. Multi-agent cooperation alleviates this limitation, but information from different agents is not equally useful across spatial regions. Meanwhile, feature representations from each agent form the basis of reliable multi-agent fusion. Cross?modal fusion constructs such representations by integrating complementary semantic and geometric information. Despite this complementarity, jointly establishing reliable 3D correspondence across agents and preserving modality-specific structures remains challenging. To address these limitations, we propose CoopOcc, which performs cooperative 3D semantic occupancy perception through multi-agent and cross-modal fusion. CoopOcc uses ego?query cross-agent attention (EQCA) to selectively aggregate aligned features across agents, and anchor-based bidirectional feature interaction (ABFI) for cross-modal exchange at matched coordinates. We further construct SemanticVVSim, a simulation dataset, and establish a unified benchmark. For simulation-to-real transfer, we propose confidence-aware hierarchical occupancy and relational distillation (CHORD). CoopOcc performs best overall among ten evaluated methods on SemanticVVSim. On Occ3D-nuScenes, CHORD improves performance using knowledge from SemanticVVSim. The code is available at https://github.com/LOTEAT/CoopOcc.

AI.tldr: CoopOcc 通过多智能体与跨模态融合实现协同三维语义占据感知，并提出仿真数据集 SemanticVVSim 及仿真到真实的蒸馏方法 CHORD。
AI.motivation: 统一的三维语义占据表征无法弥补遮挡与传感器覆盖导致的缺失信息；多智能体协作可缓解该问题，但各智能体信息在不同空间区域的有用性不均；同时跨模态融合需在智能体间建立可靠三维对应并保留模态特有结构，二者兼顾仍具挑战。
AI.method: 提出 CoopOcc：采用 ego-query cross-agent attention（EQCA）选择性聚合跨智能体对齐特征；采用 anchor-based bidirectional feature interaction（ABFI）在匹配坐标处进行跨模态交互；构建仿真数据集 SemanticVVSim 并建立统一基准；提出 confidence-aware hierarchical occupancy and relational distillation（CHORD）实现仿真到真实迁移。
AI.result: 在 SemanticVVSim 上，CoopOcc 在十个评估方法中总体表现最优；在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上，CHORD 利用 SemanticVVSim 的知识带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体协作与跨模态融合相结合的三维语义占据感知框架有效，配合专用仿真数据集与置信度感知的层次化蒸馏，可正向迁移至真实场景。

title: Vanishing Initialization Turns Diagonal Tensor Gradient Flow into Greedy Matching
summary: We study gradient-flow (GF) learning of tensors from vanishing initialization in canonical polyadic (CP) factorization models. For tensors of order $ν\geq3$ whose targets are diagonal in mode-wise orthonormal bases, we prove that the limiting learning dynamics follows a simple greedy bipartite matching process. Each rank-one component of the model, called an atom, can potentially learn each rank-one component of the target, called a scalar sector. Every atom--sector pair has an initialization-dependent activation clock, representing the time at which the atom would grow to macroscopic size in that sector if the pair evolved in isolation. Processing these clocks in increasing order and selecting a pair whenever neither its atom nor its sector has been selected before determines the sequence of actual learning events. We prove that the GF trajectory converges to the corresponding staircase of learned target components. The task of learning modular addition by a CP model with complex weights falls exactly into this framework after Fourier diagonalization. Its activation clocks are independent and identically distributed, allowing us to combine the GF reduction with known random matching asymptotics and derive an explicit, distribution-free large-system loss curve after time reparametrization. We also obtain an asymptotic formula relating this curve to the original GF training time. For models with real weights, conjugate Fourier modes instead form two-dimensional blocks with richer internal structure. We characterize their rank and border-rank cascade and conjecture that the corresponding GF dynamics follows interleaved multi-stage learning processes.

AI.tldr: 该文研究CP张量分解模型在零初始化下梯度流学习张量目标的动力学：当目标在逐模正交基下对角时，极限学习动力学等价于一个贪心二分匹配过程，每对"原子-扇区"具有初始化决定的激活时钟，按钟值升序贪心选取即得学习事件序列，轨迹收敛到相应阶梯结构。将此框架用于模加法任务（复数权重复CP模型，经Fourier对角化），得到分布无关的大系统损失曲线及与原训练时间的渐近关系；实权重情形下共轭Fourier模式构成二维块，刻画其秩与边界秩级联，并猜想交织多阶段学习动力学。
AI.motivation: 理解张量分解/CP模型中零初始化梯度流为何能实现特征学习（而非停滞），并刻画学习过程的组合结构；特别是为模加法等具有明确算法结构的任务提供可解析的学习动力学描述，弥合"隐式特征学习"与随机匹配等经典概率工具之间的差距。
AI.method: 1) 考虑阶数ν≥3、目标在逐模正交基下对角的CP分解模型，从零初始化出发分析梯度流；2) 证明极限动力学由贪心二分匹配刻画：模型原子与目标标量扇区构成二分图，每对具有初始化决定的"激活时钟"（孤立演化时该原子在该扇区增长到宏观尺度的时间），按钟值从小到大处理并在原子与扇区均未被占用时配对，确定实际学习事件序列；3) 证明轨迹收敛到与匹配序列对应的目标分量阶梯；4) 将模加法任务（复权重、Fourier对角化）纳入该框架，利用激活时钟独立同分布性与随机匹配渐近理论，导出时间重参数化后分布无关的大系统损失曲线及与原GF训练时间的渐近公式；5) 实权重情形将共轭Fourier模式归并为二维块，刻画秩与边界秩级联结构。
AI.result: 证明了GF学习张量（ν≥3，目标逐模对角）的极限动力学是简单贪心二分匹配过程，轨迹收敛到被学习目标分量构成的阶梯结构；对复数权重的模加法CP模型给出显式、分布无关的大系统损失曲线（经时间重参数化）及关联该曲线与原始GF训练时间的渐近公式；实权重情形下识别出共轭模式二维块更丰富的内部结构，并刻画其秩与边界秩级联。
AI.conclusion: 零初始化梯度流在CP张量分解中具有可精确约简的组合式学习规律（贪心匹配+激活时钟），据此可在模加法任务上给出分布无关的解析损失曲线；实权重情形下动力学更复杂，作者猜想其由交织的多阶段学习过程主导，尚待严格证明。

title: Confidently Lost: Silent Failure and Edge Deployment of Dense Visual SLAM under Photon Starvation
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: Dense visual SLAM built on learned two-view geometry is evaluated in good light; in low light it fails silently. Two frames of 9-level quantized noise, no scene at all, give MASt3R-SLAM's network a cross-view geometric self-consistency of 0.936; a real dark frame pair gives 0.935. Starved of structure, the network invents the same geometry for both views and the system trusts the agreement: on a dark sequence it consumes 1,605 frames, emits 7 keyframes, rejects no factor-graph edges and reports full frame rate, while over 95% of the correspondences it accepts violate the ground-truth epipolar geometry. One inflated statistic is read by two subsystems against thresholds in opposite directions, so keyframing starves while relocalization accepts almost every candidate. The same statistic, read at keyframe-pair baselines, separates the confident collapse from working runs on the ETH3D dark sequences without ground truth or extra computation (in-sample). Low-light-adapted weights take tracked trajectories from 1/6 to 5/6, as does retuning two thresholds; neither yields accurate ones, because the adaptation withdraws confidence from wrong geometry rather than finding right geometry. Replayed on a Jetson AGX Orin carried by a legged robot, the mechanism's signature reproduces on the two darkest of four routes, and which of its faces appears varies with route geometry and sensor encoding. The network does not lose confidence in the dark; it manufactures it.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示低光环境下基于学习双视图几何的稠密视觉SLAM会"自信地崩塌"：网络在无结构场景中制造出虚高的跨视图几何自洽度，导致关键帧选取饥饿、重定位失效，且超过95%的被接受对应违反真值对极几何。
AI.motivation: 现有稠密视觉SLAM（如MASt3R-SLAM）主要在有良好光照条件下评测，低光失效问题被忽视。作者希望说明：低光下的失败并非简单的"跟踪丢失"或置信度下降，而是系统静默失败（silent failure）——系统仍报告满帧率、无异常，却输出错误几何。核心动机是定位该失败机制的根源，并检验常见修补手段（低光权重微调、阈值重调）能否真正解决问题。
AI.method: 1）构造极简探针实验：输入两帧9级量化噪声（无任何场景内容），测量MASt3R-SLAM网络的跨视图几何自洽度，并与真实暗帧对比较；2）暗序列端到端诊断：统计消耗帧数、关键帧数、被拒绝的因子图边数、帧率，并用量真值对极几何统计被接受对应中的违规比例；3）机制分析：说明同一虚高统计量被关键帧模块与重定位模块以相反方向阈值读取；4）提出无需真值、无额外计算的诊断指标——在关键帧对基线上读取该统计量，用于在ETH3D暗序列上区分"自信崩塌"与正常工作（in-sample）；5）干预实验：低光适配权重与两项阈值重调对轨迹精度的影响；6）实机部署：在足式机器人搭载的Jetson AGX Orin上，于四条路线中的两条最暗路线复现该机制特征。
AI.result: 纯噪声帧对的跨视图几何自洽度达0.936，真实暗帧对为0.935，几乎无差别，说明该统计量在无结构时被网络"制造"而非测得。暗序列上系统消耗1,605帧、仅产生7个关键帧、拒绝零条因子图边、报告满帧率，而被接受对应中超过95%违反真值对极几何。同一被膨胀的统计量被两个子系统按相反方向阈值解读，造成关键帧饥饿与重定位近乎全盘接受。所提基于关键帧对基线的统计量可在无真值、无额外计算条件下区分崩塌与正常（样本内）。低光适配权重使被跟踪轨迹从1/6提升至5/6，阈值重调效果相当，但二者均无法获得准确轨迹，因为适配只是从错误几何上"撤回置信"而非找到正确几何。实机在Jetson AGX Orin上，四条路线中最暗两条复现该机制特征，且呈现哪一种表现随路线几何与传感器编码变化。
AI.conclusion: 网络在黑暗中并非失去置信度，而是"制造"置信度：它成为自身错误的不知情证人。低光SLAM的失败是系统性、静默的几何幻觉，而非单纯的退化。简单的权重适配与阈值调参只能缓解表象（提高被跟踪比例），不能恢复几何准确性，因此需要针对置信度生成机制本身设计诊断与修复手段；所提关键帧对基线统计量提供了一种无需真值的在线检测途径。

title: When Does Optical Context Compression Pay Off? A Decode-Aware Cost Analysis of Reasoning VLMs
summary: Rendering long text as images lets a vision-language model (VLM) read a document with fewer input tokens, and evaluations often count mainly these prefill tokens. We show that for reasoning models this accounting is incomplete. Across five models and two long-context benchmarks, reading the rendered document makes the model think longer: decode length grows by 1.5-3.5x on the four general-purpose VLMs tested, and under typical output pricing this decode tax makes image input more expensive than text for two of the five models on QuALITY. Unrecoverable information loss is not sufficient to explain the tax at moderate compression: Qwen's OCR of the same images recovers 98.7% of words, and feeding Kimi-K3 its own transcription as text restores text-mode reasoning length and accuracy. Whether compression pays off reduces to an exchange rate, (1-1/c)/(r-1), that must exceed the workload's price-weighted ratio of output to input tokens; this accounting decomposition shows why Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash can benefit and Qwen and GLM cannot. None of the training-free signals we test predicts the tax before generation. As a practical heuristic, an image-first policy that sends only inputs with a per-input compression ratio of at least 1.6 to images and falls back to text once image-mode reasoning costs as much as the input's prefill saving cuts the bill by 6-14% on Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at an accuracy cost of 0.3-1.2 points; on QuALITY, asking for a reasoning budget on both paths is a stronger lever.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示"长文本渲染为图像"在推理模型上的隐性代价：解码长度增长1.5–3.5倍，形成"decode tax"，在典型输出定价下使图像输入对部分模型反而更贵；据此提出汇率式成本核算与实际图像优先策略，可降本6–14%。
AI.motivation: 现有研究只统计prefill token，认为把长文本渲染成图像能减少输入token、节省成本。但推理模型的输出（思考）长度受输入模态影响，仅算prefill会系统性低估图像输入的真实开销，因此需要重新审视压缩式输入的经济性。
AI.method: 1) 在5个模型、2个长上下文基准上对比文本输入与图像输入，测量prefill与decode长度及准确率；2) 用Qwen对同图做OCR（词恢复率98.7%）以及把Kimi-K3的自转录文本回灌，排查"信息损失"能否解释decode tax；3) 建立成本分解，导出压缩盈亏条件：(1-1/c)/(r-1) 须超过工作负载按价格加权的输出/输入token比；4) 测试多种免训练的生成前信号能否预测该税；5) 提出image-first策略（单样本压缩比≥1.6才走图像，且当图像模式推理成本等于其prefill节省量时回退文本）及推理预算控制。
AI.result: 四个通用VLM的decode长度增长1.5–3.5倍；在QuALITY上，按典型输出定价，5个模型中有2个图像输入比文本更贵。信息损失不是主因：OCR恢复98.7%词，且把Kimi-K3自己的转录作为文本输入可恢复文本模式的推理长度与准确率。汇率分析表明Kimi-K3与DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash可获益，Qwen与GLM不能。所有测试的免训练信号均无法在生成前预测该税。image-first策略在Kimi-K3与DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash上降本6–14%，准确率仅降0.3–1.2分；在QuALITY上，双路径均设推理预算效果更强。
AI.conclusion: 图像化长文本的成本评估必须计入decode tax，否则结论失真；是否划算取决于压缩带来的输入节省与输出膨胀的汇率关系。实践中建议按压缩比阈值与成本回退的image-first策略，并在长文档问答中优先用推理预算进行成本控制。

title: When Local Semantics Disagree: Learning to Detect Fake News through Weakly Supervised Cross-Modal Reasoning
summary: The rapid proliferation of multimodal social media content has made fake news detection a pressing challenge for the vision-language community. Most existing approaches rely on coarse global similarity between text and images, which overlooks subtle, uneven cross-modal inconsistencies -- such as sentiment-scene mismatches, object-level manipulations, or semantic dissonance between visual and textual cues. Moreover, these models treat all inconsistencies as equally informative, ignoring domain-specific variation in how such conflicts manifest, which limits both generalization and interpretability. To address these challenges, we propose DMIL, a dual-branch multiple instance learning framework that formulates multimodal fake news detection as a weakly supervised learning problem. Each news article is treated as a bag of visual and textual instances processed through two complementary branches: an embedding-space branch that aggregates global semantics via expert-guided modality fusion, and an instance-space branch that models cross-modal inconsistencies across local-to-global granularities. A retrieval-augmented, domain-adaptive router further contextualizes inconsistencies using retrieved domain exemplars and dynamically fuses multi-level cues. Extensive experiments on public misinformation benchmarks demonstrate that DMIL achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance and demonstrates strong discriminative capability against fake news across different domains.

AI.tldr: DMIL：将多模态假新闻检测建模为弱监督多示例学习，用双分支（嵌入空间+实例空间）捕捉细粒度跨模态不一致，并以检索增强的领域自适应路由器动态融合多层级线索。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖图文间的粗粒度全局相似度，忽略细微且不均衡的跨模态不一致（情感-场景错配、对象级篡改、语义失谐）；且将所有不一致视为同等重要，忽视领域差异下冲突表现方式的不同，限制了泛化性与可解释性。
AI.method: 提出DMIL双分支多示例学习框架：把每篇新闻视为由视觉与文本示例构成的包（bag）。分支一为嵌入空间分支，通过专家引导的模态融合聚合全局语义；分支二为实例空间分支，在局部到全局多粒度上建模跨模态不一致；并引入检索增强的领域自适应路由器，利用检索到的领域范例为不一致性提供上下文，动态融合多层级线索。
AI.result: 在公开虚假信息基准上取得有竞争力的SOTA性能，并展现出跨不同领域对假新闻的强判别能力。
AI.conclusion: 以弱监督多示例视角处理跨模态不一致、并结合领域自适应检索融合，可有效提升多模态假新闻检测的性能与跨域判别力。

title: Learning Global Probabilistic Explanations
summary:
Interpreting the predictions of complex black-box classifiers remains a central challenge in explainable artificial intelligence.
  While local explanations clarify individual predictions, there is a significant need for global probabilistic explanations that capture a model's overall behavior across the input distribution.
  Such an explanation is a small subset $K$ of features, whose relevance is measured by the expected probability, over a random input $\mathbf x$, that the classifier assigns the same label to $\mathbf x$ and to a random input agreeing with $\mathbf x$ on $K$.
  In this study, we investigate the task of identifying maximally relevant global explanations under a cardinality constraint, focusing on product distributions with full support on discrete feature spaces.
  We introduce a spectral explainer that leverages membership queries to the black-box classifier and employs Fourier-analytic, junta-learning methods to produce probably approximately correct (PAC) explanations.
  Our algorithm is fixed-parameter tractable with respect to the explanation size limit, maximum feature cardinality, and desired accuracy.
  Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets confirm the theoretical guarantees and show that the spectral explainer outperforms a greedy baseline as the explanation size increases.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在基数约束下寻找"最大相关"全局解释的问题，提出基于Fourier分析与junta学习的谱解释器，利用对黑盒分类器的成员查询给出PAC可证保证的全局解释，并在实验中优于贪心基线。
AI.motivation: 黑盒分类器的可解释性仍是XAI的核心难题：局部解释只能说明单个预测，缺乏刻画模型在输入分布上整体行为的全局概率解释。本文旨在形式化并求解"基数约束下最大化相关的全局特征子集"这一任务。
AI.method: 将全局解释定义为大小为K的特征子集，其相关性用随机输入x与在K上与x一致的随机输入被分类为同一标签的期望概率度量；在离散特征空间上全支撑的乘积分布假设下，提出谱解释器（spectral explainer），通过成员查询访问黑盒，结合Fourier分析与junta学习算法构造PAC解释；算法对解释规模上限、最大特征基数与目标精度为固定参数可处理（FPT）。
AI.result: 理论分析给出PAC式保证与FPT复杂度；在合成与真实数据集上的实验验证了理论保证，并显示随解释规模K增大，谱解释器优于贪心基线。
AI.conclusion: 谱解释器为全局概率解释提供了具备可证保证且计算可行的方法，在解释规模较大时较贪心策略更具优势；方法依赖乘积分布与成员查询等假设，属于理论驱动的解释框架。

title: Quantizing in the Loop: Drift-Aware Ultra-Low-Bit Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: The paper is currently under review. Code and models: https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/LoopQ
summary: Deploying large vision-language-action (VLA) models on resource-constrained robots demands extreme compression, yet existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods frequently collapse at ultra-low bit-widths ($\le$ 2 bits). We trace this failure to two mismatches in standard pipelines. First, calibrating on static offline demonstrations induces distribution shift: minor quantization perturbations drive the policy into unseen states where uncalibrated errors compound. Second, minimizing the layer-wise weight reconstruction error is a flawed proxy, as action generation depends only on the representations consumed by the action head. We present LoopQ, an on-policy ultra-low-bit quantization framework. LoopQ closes the loop by calibrating on states from the quantized policy's own rollouts. It then adds readout-aligned fine-tuning, which freezes the trellis codes and optimizes only lightweight lookup tables and scaling factors to align the backbone readout with the full-precision teacher. With all linear layers at 2 bits, LoopQ achieves a 60.4% success rate on LIBERO-Plus with GR00T N1.7, close to the 61.8% of full precision. Even at 1 bit per weight, $π_{0.5}$ still completes 80.0% of LIBERO tasks. With 8-bit activations, the 2-bit $π_{0.5}$ runs on integer kernels on an embedded NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor, with 4.1$\times$ smaller weights and 44% less memory. On a real AgileX Piper arm, it stays within one success of full precision on each of three tasks. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/LoopQ

AI.tldr: LoopQ是一个on-policy的超低比特量化框架，通过在量化策略自身rollout状态上校准并做读出对齐微调，使VLA模型在2比特/1比特下保持接近全精度性能并可在嵌入式设备部署。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限机器人上部署大型视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型需要极端压缩，但现有PTQ方法在≤2比特时频繁崩溃。作者将失败归因于两个失配：(1) 在静态离线演示上校准导致分布漂移——微小量化扰动使策略进入未见状态，未校准误差累积；(2) 逐层权重重建误差是错误代理，因为动作生成只依赖动作头所消费的表示。
AI.method: 提出LoopQ：(1) on-policy校准，使用量化策略自身rollout产生的状态进行校准，闭合分布回路；(2) readout-aligned微调，冻结trellis codes，仅优化轻量lookup tables与scaling factors，使骨干读出与全精度teacher对齐；配合8比特激活以支持整数内核。
AI.result: 所有线性层2比特时，GR00T N1.7在LIBERO-Plus上达60.4%成功率，接近全精度61.8%；1比特/权重下π0.5仍完成80.0% LIBERO任务；8比特激活+2比特权重π0.5可在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor整数内核运行，权重缩小4.1×、内存减少44%；真实AgileX Piper机械臂三项任务上均与全精度相差不超过一次成功。
AI.conclusion: 在校准状态分布与优化目标两处对齐任务需求，是超低比特VLA量化的关键；LoopQ在仿真与真实机器人上验证了其可行性与实用性。

title: iFeST: An Iterative Motion Correction Framework for Fetal Brain Diffusion MRI via Frequency-Spatial-Temporal Modeling
summary: Fetal brain diffusion magnetic resonance imaging (dMRI) is a pivotal non-invasive tool for assessing the development of brain connectivity and microstructure. However, the prolonged acquisition times and complex sampling requirements render dMRI highly susceptible to unpredictable fetal motion. Existing motion correction methods typically process each dMRI volume independently and focus on inter-slice motion. Such strategies fail to utilize the coherent information between dMRI volumes along different diffusion directions and lack the ability to restore the intra-slice corruption. To address these limitations, we proposed iFeST, an iterative framework that combines frequency (k-space), spatial, and temporal (inter-slice) modeling for fetal brain dMRI motion correction. At each iteration, iFeST integrates information across diffusion directions into fiber orientation distributions (FODs). These distributions encode local fiber orientations within each voxel and serve as microstructural priors for intra-slice restoration and inter-slice alignment in the next iteration. To train the framework, we developed a fetal brain dMRI motion simulator that synthesizes compound motion artifacts from FODs. Evaluation on simulated datasets demonstrated that iFeST outperformed four inter-slice networks in motion estimation and three intra-slice networks in image restoration. Further validation on a real-world dataset confirmed significantly better volume reconstruction and FOD estimation than conventional pipelines. Overall, iFeST provides a learning-based framework for fetal dMRI motion correction, restoring motion-corrupted data and improving microstructural reconstruction for downstream diagnostic applications.

AI.tldr: 提出iFeST——一种融合频域（k空间）、空间与时间（层间）建模的迭代框架，用于胎儿脑dMRI运动校正，利用跨扩散方向的FOD作为先验实现层内复原与层间对齐。
AI.motivation: 胎儿脑dMRI是非侵入性评估脑连接与微结构发育的重要工具，但采集时间长、采样要求复杂，极易受不可预测的胎儿运动影响。现有校正方法逐个体数据独立处理、仅关注层间运动，未利用不同扩散方向数据间的相关信息，也无法修复层内损坏。
AI.method: 提出iFeST迭代框架：每轮迭代将跨扩散方向信息整合为纤维取向分布（FOD），作为体素内局部纤维取向的微结构先验，用于下一轮的层内复原与层间对齐；同时开发胎儿脑dMRI运动仿真器，基于FOD合成复合运动伪影以支撑训练。
AI.result: 在仿真数据集上，iFeST在运动估计上优于四种层间网络，在图像复原上优于三种层内网络；在真实数据集上，其体数据重建与FOD估计显著优于传统流程。
AI.conclusion: iFeST为胎儿dMRI运动校正提供了基于学习的框架，可复原受运动污染的数据并改善微结构重建，服务于下游诊断应用。

title: Domain-Specific Self-Supervised Learning for Cuneiform Sign Representation
comment: Accepted at the VisionDocs Workshop at WACV 2027
summary: Recognizing cuneiform signs is challenging: sign shapes vary across historical periods, scribal practices, and preservation conditions, while expert annotations are scarce. We study whether domain-specific self-supervised pretraining yields better cuneiform sign representations than generic natural-image pretraining. We pretrain a masked autoencoder, CuneiMAE, on over 900K unlabeled sign crops and compare it with ImageNet-pretrained MAE, CLIP, and DINOv2 on a 218-class sign recognition benchmark. CuneiMAE learns substantially stronger frozen representations (43.7% linear-probe accuracy vs. 25.2% for ImageNet-MAE), with gains over ImageNet-MAE on cross-period transfer. Under fine-tuning, CuneiMAE outperforms ImageNet-pretrained baselines on our internal benchmark, with the largest gains when labels are scarce (+20.4 pp over ImageNet-MAE with 1% of labels). On an external benchmark, CuneiMAE reaches 69.9% top-1 accuracy after fine-tuning, about 8 pp above the ResNet-18 baseline from prior work. Explicit structural priors, such as edge-guided masking and part bottlenecks, do not improve over standard masked reconstruction. Overall, domain-specific self-supervision shows strong performance on cuneiform recognition tasks, particularly when labels are limited.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出在楔形文字符号数据上做领域自监督预训练（CuneiMAE），冻结表征与少标注微调均显著优于ImageNet预训练基线。
AI.motivation: 楔形文字符号识别面临符号形状随时代、书写习惯与保存状况变化，且专家标注稀缺的困境；作者希望验证领域特定的自监督预训练能否比通用自然图像预训练学到更优的符号表征。
AI.method: 在90余万张未标注符号裁片上预训练掩码自编码器CuneiMAE，并与ImageNet预训练的MAE、CLIP、DINOv2在218类符号识别基准上对比；考察冻结线性探测、跨时期迁移与不同标注量的微调表现；同时尝试边缘引导掩码与部件瓶颈等显式结构先验。
AI.result: 冻结表征线性探测准确率43.7%（ImageNet-MAE为25.2%）；跨时期迁移优于ImageNet-MAE；微调后内部基准全面领先，1%标注时较ImageNet-MAE提升20.4个百分点；外部基准微调后top-1达69.9%，较此前ResNet-18基线高约8个百分点；边缘引导掩码与部件瓶颈等结构先验未带来增益。
AI.conclusion: 领域特定自监督在楔形文字识别上表现强劲，尤其在标注有限时收益最大；而显式结构先验并不必要，标准掩码重建已足够。

title: CoHABIT: Complementary Evaluation of Furniture Layouts through Spatial Rules and Household Routines
summary: We introduce CoHABIT, a framework for evaluating furniture layouts through complementary spatial rules and household routines. Static assessment captures geometric validity, ergonomic access, functional organization, and configurable design preferences, including Feng Shui. Dynamic assessment uses learned resident policies to simulate everyday activities, resource sharing, coordination, and individual burdens in multi-agent households. Controlled comparisons show how spatial criteria and household behavior reveal distinct aspects of layout quality, while resident profiles and scheduling influence furnishing rankings. Independent verification of household needs grounds dynamic comparisons in observed outcomes, enabling interpretable assessments of how furnished environments serve different households.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoHABIT框架，将家具布局评估拆分为互补的两部分：静态空间规则评估（几何有效性、人机可达性、功能组织、可选设计偏好如风水）与基于学习居民策略的动态评估（模拟日常活动、资源共享、多智能体协调与个体负担），并结合独立核验的家庭需求进行可解释比较。
AI.motivation: 现有家具布局评估多依赖静态几何或设计准则，难以反映布局在真实家庭日常活动中如何影响不同住户的体验与负担，缺乏对多住户家庭行为层面的可解释评估。
AI.method: 构建CoHABIT框架：静态评估用互补空间规则检验几何有效性、人机工程可达性、功能组织及可配置设计偏好（含风水）；动态评估用学习得到的居民策略模拟多智能体家庭中的日常活动、资源共享、协调与个体负担；通过受控对比实验分析两类判据的差异，并引入对家庭需求的独立核验来锚定动态比较。
AI.result: 受控对比显示，空间规则与家庭行为揭示布局质量的不同侧面；居民画像与日程安排会影响家具配置的排序结果。
AI.conclusion: 空间规则与行为模拟互为补充，结合独立核验的家庭需求可实现可解释的布局评估，说明同一布局对不同家庭的适用性存在差异。

title: Trustworthy agentic lunar robotics: safety-constrained contingent planning with a foundation-model planner
summary: Sustained lunar-base operations require robots that restore equipment and deliver cargo under conditions unforeseen before deployment. Flown space autonomy executes pre-validated procedures and enters a safe hold outside their scope, whereas foundation models synthesize plans on site that cannot be verified before execution. We formulate these operations as safety-constrained contingent planning with irreversible actions, erroneous records, three-valued physical evidence, and costly, deadline-constrained sensing. We propose asymmetric knowledge-level replanning (AKR), which treats the planner as an untrusted black box: reversible actions run on the planner's assumptions, and irreversible actions run only after a minimum-cost sensing cover verifies every precondition. Under sound measurements, no irreversible action executes on a false precondition for any planner or record, the sensing cost before an irreversible action is bounded below for every sound knowledge-based policy, and execution with a complete planner ends in a verified goal or a certified hold. AKR executed no hazardous action in 21,000 Monte Carlo trials with sound observations or in 58 full-stack runs; the FF-Replan acting rule executed one in 7% of those trials. The median AKR run took 1.10 times the fastest run on the same mission, against 1.50 under the K-replanner acting rule. AKR completed 20 of 21 contingency and sequential-fault runs with an unchanged task model; the original PLEXIL and EUROPA$\rightarrow$PLEXIL procedures completed none.

AI.tldr: 论文提出非对称知识级重规划（AKR），将规划器视为不可信黑箱：可逆动作按规划器假设执行，不可逆动作仅在最小代价感知覆盖验证全部前置条件后执行，从而在月球基地运维中保证安全性且代价接近最优。
AI.motivation: 月球基地持续运维需要机器人在部署前未预见的条件下修复设备、运送货物。已飞行的空间自主软件只能执行预先验证的流程，超出范围即进入安全保持；而基础模型虽可现场生成计划，却无法在执行前验证，安全性无从保证。因此在不可逆动作、错误记录、三值物理证据与带截止时间的高代价感知条件下，需要一种兼顾安全与效率的应急规划方法。
AI.method: 将运维问题形式化为带安全约束的应急规划（contingent planning），包含不可逆动作、错误记录、三值物理证据和带截止时间的高代价感知。提出AKR：把规划器当作不可信黑盒，可逆动作直接按规划器假设执行；不可逆动作执行前必须先由最小代价感知覆盖验证其全部前置条件。
AI.result: 在测量可靠的前提下：对任意规划器与记录，不可逆动作不会在假前置条件下执行；不可逆动作前的感知代价对任意可靠的知识型策略存在下界；配以完备规划器时执行以已验证目标或经认证的安全保持告终。21,000次蒙特卡洛仿真（观测可靠）与58次全栈运行中AKR零危险动作，FF-Replan执行规则在7%的试验中出现危险动作；AKR中位运行时间为同任务最快运行的1.10倍，K-replanner规则为1.50倍；AKR在任务模型不变条件下完成21次应急与顺序故障运行中的20次，原PLEXIL与EUROPA→PLEXIL流程均完成0次。
AI.conclusion: 通过将可逆与不可逆动作在知识层面非对称处理，AKR无需修改任务模型、不依赖规划器可信，即可获得可证明的安全保证、最优量级的感知开销和接近最优的执行效率，显著优于传统流程重规划与FF-Replan类执行规则。

title: WASP: Continual Weight Adaptation for Streaming LLM Personalization
summary: Personalized large language models (LLMs) should continually adapt to users' evolving preferences. Yet extracting preference changes from noisy interaction histories while supporting inexpensive updates remains challenging. We introduce WASP (Weight Adaptation for Streaming Personalization), a recurrent framework that captures fine-grained preferences directly from raw user interactions and generates personalized LoRA adapters without expensive per-user optimization. Specifically, WASP achieves this by training a shared hypernetwork that maintains a compact user representation and outputs adapter weights in a single forward pass. As new interactions arrive, WASP updates this representation without reprocessing full interaction history, enabling continual adaptation with per-update costs independent of history length. Experiments on personalization benchmarks and chronological interaction streams show that WASP sustains high-quality personalization over long horizons under fixed compute and storage budgets. Together, these results support efficient streaming personalization and facilitate privacy-preserving on-device deployment.

AI.tldr: WASP 提出一种循环式框架，通过共享超网络从原始用户交互中直接生成个性化 LoRA 适配器，实现流式持续个性化，且单次更新代价与历史长度无关。
AI.motivation: 个性化 LLM 需持续适应用户偏好变化，但从噪声交互历史中提取偏好变化困难，且逐用户优化（per-user optimization）成本高昂、需反复处理完整历史，难以支持廉价增量更新。
AI.method: 训练一个共享超网络（hypernetwork），维护紧凑的用户表示（compact user representation），单次前向传播即输出 LoRA 适配器权重；新交互到来时仅更新该表示而不重算全部历史，形成循环（recurrent）流式更新机制。
AI.result: 在个性化基准与按时间顺序的交互流实验中，WASP 在固定算力与存储预算下，于长时序上保持高质量个性化效果。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持高效流式个性化，并有利于隐私保护的在端侧部署（on-device deployment）。

title: DynFlux: Learning to Dynamically Balance Consensus and Conflict in Multimodal Emotion Recognition
summary: Multimodal emotion recognition remains challenging due to the intrinsic heterogeneity of different modalities. Effectively leveraging both cross-modal consensus (consistency) and conflict (inconsistency) is essential, as they jointly provide complementary cues that enhance emotion understanding from diverse perspectives. Traditional multimodal methods often suffer from semantic ambiguity and rarely explicitly model the interplay between cross-modal consensus and conflict. Moreover, existing approaches struggle to capture and exploit the dynamic interactions between these two complementary factors. To overcome these limitations, we propose DynFlux, a model guided by a temporal heterogeneous graph that encodes both consensus and conflict relationships across modalities. DynFlux introduces a dedicated graph branch that explicitly captures cross-modal dependencies through sparse temporal graphs, and modulates the conventional multimodal emotion recognition pipeline at three hierarchical stages: adaptive feature modulation during feature extraction, guided aggregation modulation during feature integration, and fusion strategy modulation at the multimodal fusion stage. Through this design, DynFlux dynamically balances cross-modal consensus and conflict, enabling richer and more robust emotion understanding. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets confirm that DynFlux consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, and its generality is further validated on multimodal intent recognition and multimodal sarcasm detection tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出DynFlux，一种由时序异构图引导的多模态情感识别模型，显式建模跨模态一致性与冲突并在三个层级阶段动态调制特征提取、特征整合与融合策略。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感识别受模态异质性困扰；跨模态一致（共识）与冲突（不一致）共同提供互补线索，但传统方法存在语义歧义、很少显式建模二者交互，且难以捕捉其动态交互。
AI.method: DynFlux引入专门的图分支，通过稀疏时序图显式捕捉跨模态依赖，并在三个层级阶段调制常规多模态情感识别流程：特征提取阶段的自适应特征调制、特征整合阶段的引导聚合调制、多模态融合阶段的融合策略调制，从而动态平衡跨模态共识与冲突。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明DynFlux持续优于最先进方法，并在多模态意图识别与多模态讽刺检测任务上进一步验证了其泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并动态平衡跨模态共识与冲突可有效提升多模态情感理解的鲁棒性与性能，且该框架具有跨任务的通用性。

title: GeoFusion: An Uncertain Machine Learning Framework for Sensor Fusion
summary: High positioning precision is a critical requirement in many Global Positioning System (GPS) applications, yet achieving it with affordable smartphone sensors remains an open challenge. Existing approaches treat each GPS observation as an absolute point, discarding the uncertainty inherent in the measurement conditions and leaving the cooperative potential of multiple phones observing the same location untapped. In this work, we propose GeoFusion, a three-stage uncertain machine learning framework for cooperative sensor fusion. In the first stage, each GPS observation is modeled as an uncertain object using one of two proposed models: the volcano function, grounded in satellite geometry, and the empirically derived mountain function, built from the statistical structure of real smartphone data. In the second stage, uncertain objects are clustered by location event using partitional and graph-based algorithms. In the third stage, the cluster output is refined using filter-based and learning-based estimators. Experiments on the Google Smartphone Decimeter Challenge dataset show that uncertainty modeling is a primary driver of precision gains: the mountain function significantly outperforms the geometry-only volcano function, and uncertainty-aware UK-medoids significantly outperforms its certain counterpart, k-medoids. A post-clustering deep neural network further refines the cluster estimates, and the recommended configuration achieves a mean absolute error of 2.90 +/- 0.15 meters on held-out test drives, comparable to and on average below the best reported single-phone precision of approximately 3 meters, demonstrating the potential of cooperative uncertainty-aware fusion for affordable GPS sensors.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GeoFusion——一个三阶段"不确定性"机器学习框架，将GPS观测建模为不确定对象并进行协同聚类与融合，在Google Smartphone Decimeter Challenge数据集上取得2.90±0.15 m的MAE。
AI.motivation: 低成本智能手机GPS传感器难以达到高定位精度；现有方法把每条GPS观测视为绝对点，丢弃了测量条件固有的不确定性，也未利用多部手机观测同一位置的协同潜力。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：(1) 用两种不确定对象模型刻画单条观测——基于卫星几何的volcano函数与基于真实智能手机数据统计结构经验推导的mountain函数；(2) 按位置事件用划分式与图式算法对不确定对象聚类；(3) 用基于滤波与基于学习的估计器精化聚类输出。
AI.result: 在Google Smartphone Decimeter Challenge数据集上，不确定性建模是精度提升的主要来源：mountain函数显著优于仅依赖几何的volcano函数，不确定性感知的UK-medoids显著优于k-medoids；后置深度神经网络进一步精化聚类估计，推荐配置在留出测试行程上MAE为2.90±0.15 m，与已报道的最佳单机精度约3 m相当且平均更优。
AI.conclusion: 协同式不确定性感知融合可显著提升廉价GPS传感器的定位精度，且不确定性建模（尤其数据驱动的mountain函数）与不确定性感知聚类是性能增益的关键来源。

title: OmniSLAM: Evidence-Authorized Revision of Persistent Object Maps
summary: Persistent object maps must incorporate new surfaces while retaining valid identities and correcting earlier associations. We present a map-revision module that separates historical identity changes from new-surface admission. Proposed merges are tested against shared and separate mask explanations across views; a merge is allowed only if its evidence margin remains positive after removing any one observed frame. New measured points are assigned through local identity competition, with a mask witness and a seed-frame stability check. On two preselected KITTI-360 windows, the fixed method increases mean building/car instance AP50:90 from 17.259 to 18.762 under a local evaluation protocol. Controlled output interventions attribute the gains to fragment consolidation, protection against harmful overwrites, and local assignment of new points. Four additional spatial holdouts increase mean AP from 20.263 to 23.171, although unconditional revision is slightly higher at 23.251. The extra seed-frame check yields no AP gain over nearest-seed assignment in either set. A 330-frame garage recording demonstrates offline integration with LiDAR--inertial--visual odometry. These results identify where observation-supported revision improves object maps and where conservative decisions still limit recovery.

AI.tldr: 提出一个地图修订模块，将历史身份变更与新表面准入解耦：带留一帧证据裕度的鲁棒合并检验、局部身份竞争的新点分配，在KITTI-360上提升实例AP，并明确保守决策的局限。
AI.motivation: 持久对象地图需不断纳入新观测表面，同时保持身份有效并纠正早期错误关联。现有方法未区分"改历史身份"与"纳新点"两类操作，易产生片段碎片化与有害覆写。
AI.method: 模块化设计：(1)合并候选基于跨视角的共享/分离掩码解释检验，仅当逐一移除任一观测帧后证据裕度仍为正才允许合并（留一帧鲁棒性）；(2)新测点通过局部身份竞争分配，辅以掩码见证与种子帧稳定性检查；(3)用受控输出干预做消融归因。
AI.result: 两个预设KITTI-360窗口上，mean building/car AP50:90由17.259升至18.762；四个空间留出集上mean AP由20.263升至23.171（无条件修订为23.251，略高）。增益主要来自片段合并、防有害覆写与新点局部分配；额外种子帧检查未带来AP增益。330帧车库序列验证了与LiDAR-惯性-视觉里程计的离线集成。
AI.conclusion: 观测支持的修订能有效改善对象地图，但过于保守的合并/分配判定仍限制召回恢复；种子帧检查冗余，无条件修订在部分指标上更优，说明保守性需进一步调优。

title: AutoSECO: Automated Skill Evolution for Cross-Problem Combinatorial Optimization with General-Purpose LLM Agents
summary: General-purpose large language model (LLM) agents can develop complete solvers for combinatorial optimization problems. Their specialization, however, often relies on workflows engineered for individual problems, limiting the reuse of development expertise. We propose AutoSECO, an automated skill evolution method that learns reusable solver-development guidance from experience. The challenge is that external evaluation measures the completed solver, while the skill guides decisions during development. AutoSECO connects this feedback to guidance deficiencies by tracing performance shortfalls through solver code and recorded development decisions. Revisions are expressed as general instructions and retained only if a fresh solver developed under the revised skill achieves a lower mean evaluation gap. Evolved solely on the traveling salesperson problem (TSP), the skill guides fresh agents in developing solvers for capacitated vehicle routing, job-shop scheduling, and three-dimensional bin packing without further skill evolution. On TSP, the final mean benchmark gap is 0.52\%, compared with 0.98\% for the skill-evolution baseline SkillOpt. Across all four problems, the evolved skill achieves better aggregate results than no skill guidance, the initial skill, and SkillOpt. The same frozen skill also supports solver development under alternative model--harness configurations. These findings suggest that solver-development experience can be retained as reusable expertise for general-purpose LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoSECO，从经验中学习可复用的求解器开发指导（skill），仅在TSP上演化，即可指导新智能体开发CVRP、JSP、3D装箱等未见问题求解器，并优于无指导、初始skill与SkillOpt基线。
AI.motivation: 通用LLM智能体虽能构建组合优化求解器，但其专精化依赖针对单个问题定制的工作流，开发经验难以复用，缺乏可迁移的求解器开发指导。
AI.method: AutoSECO为自动化技能演化方法：将外部对最终求解器的评测反馈，通过回溯求解器代码与记录的开发决策，定位到具体指导缺陷；修订以通用指令形式表达，仅当在新skill下重新开发的求解器取得更低的平均评估差距时才保留该修订。
AI.result: 仅在TSP上完成演化；在TSP最终平均基准差距0.52%（SkillOpt为0.98%）；在TSP、CVRP、作业车间调度、三维装箱四类问题上，聚合表现均优于无指导、初始skill与SkillOpt；同一冻结skill在替代的模型—框架配置下同样支持求解器开发。
AI.conclusion: 求解器开发经验可作为可复用专长被保留，供通用LLM智能体跨问题迁移，表明技能层面的经验演化是可行的知识积累途径。

title: ReCoRain: Reliability-Coupled Content and Noise Conditioning for Event-Guided Video Deraining
summary: Event-guided video deraining depends on reliable cross-frame correspondences, yet events generated by scene motion, rain, and sensor noise can provide ambiguous matching evidence. In diffusion-based restoration, an incorrect match can transfer unrelated content and correlate initial noise between unrelated scene locations. We propose ReCoRain, an event-guided residual video diffusion framework that couples temporal content transfer and noise correlation through a common assessment of correspondence reliability. This assessment combines RGB appearance, interval-event evidence, and forward-backward motion consistency. The content path aggregates neighboring features according to alignment reliability, while the noise path uses composed backward motion fields and their associated reliability estimates to regulate initial-noise sharing across the latent sequence. We use the same conditional noise construction during residual flow-matching training and inference, incorporating temporal noise coordination into the learned restoration process. Temporal supervision matches motion-compensated inter-frame differences in restored and clean videos under the same teacher-estimated flow and visibility mask, accommodating legitimate appearance changes. ReCoRain achieves 32.09 dB PSNR on NTURain-Syn and 28.73 dB on RainSynLight25. Enabling reliability gates in both paths reduces warping error by 33.0% relative to disabling both gates.

AI.tldr: ReCoRain：以事件相机引导的残差视频扩散去雨框架，用统一的对应可靠性评估同时调控内容迁移与初始噪声相关性。在NTURain-Syn上达32.09 dB PSNR，RainSynLight25上达28.73 dB；双路径可靠性门控使warping误差降低33.0%。
AI.motivation: 事件引导视频去雨依赖可靠的跨帧对应关系，但场景运动、雨滴与传感器噪声产生的事件会带来歧义的匹配证据。在扩散式复原中，错误匹配会迁移无关内容，并使无关场景位置的初始噪声产生虚假相关，从而损害复原质量。
AI.method: 提出ReCoRain，统一评估对应可靠性（融合RGB外观、区间事件证据与前后向运动一致性），并以此耦合两条路径：内容路径按对齐可靠性聚合邻帧特征；噪声路径利用组合后的反向运动场及其可靠性估计，调控潜序列中初始噪声的共享。训练与推理阶段采用相同的条件噪声构造，将时间噪声协调嵌入残差流匹配过程；时间监督在同一教师估计光流与可见性掩码下匹配运动补偿后的帧间差异，以容纳合理的外观变化。
AI.result: NTURain-Syn上PSNR 32.09 dB，RainSynLight25上PSNR 28.73 dB；在内容与噪声两条路径同时启用可靠性门控相较同时禁用，warping误差降低33.0%。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性驱动的双向门控（内容迁移+噪声相关）是事件引导视频扩散去雨的有效设计，可显著减少错误对应带来的伪影与噪声错配；将时间噪声协调同时纳入训练与推理，可提升复原性能。

title: Recursive Self-Editing: LLMs Program Their Own Weight Edits for Self-Improvement
summary: Recursive self-improvement asks a system to improve the very system that improves it. Today's language models improve themselves through data, training recipes or scaffolds. Whenever their weights change, gradient descent writes the update, not the model. We let the model write its own weights. In SELFWRITE, each generation the current model studies its own reasoning on fresh training problems, inspects its own weights and activations in a persistent Python session, and writes a program that constructs a low-rank weight edit for itself from white-box primitives (singular directions, activation contrasts between its right and wrong answers, rank-one projections, tensor computations), with no training or gradient tool. Every candidate is graded once on a hidden gate set against the current model; the best strictly improving edit is merged into the weights, and the edited model writes the next edit. On Qwen3.8-27B and math problems from DAPO-Math, five generations of SELFWRITE raise gate accuracy from 73.95% to 76.45% and accuracy on a held-out test split that the loop never sees from 76.30% to 77.75% (avg@4) and from 82.60% to 84.80% (pass@4), without a single gradient step. A language model can author useful changes to its own weights without gradients, and the edited model keeps writing useful edits.

AI.tldr: SELFWRITE让语言模型在持久化Python会话中检视自身权重与激活，直接编写低秩权重编辑程序来自我改写权重，无需任何梯度或训练工具；在Qwen3-27B上经五代迭代显著提升数学推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型的"自我改进"实际依赖数据、训练配方或脚手架，一旦涉及权重更新，更新内容仍由梯度下降写出而非模型本身。作者希望把权重更新的"作者身份"交还给模型，探索模型能否不借助梯度，直接写出对自己权重的有益修改，从而实现真正意义上的递归自我改进。
AI.method: 提出SELFWRITE框架：每一代中，当前模型先研究自身在新训练问题上的推理过程，并在持久化Python会话中检查自身权重与激活；随后以白盒原语（奇异方向、正确/错误答案间的激活对比、秩一投影、张量运算）编写程序，构造面向自身的低秩权重编辑，全程不使用训练或梯度工具。每个候选编辑在隐藏门集（gate set）上对当前模型评估一次，严格提升性能的最佳编辑被合并进权重，编辑后的模型再撰写下一次编辑，形成闭环迭代。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-27B与DAPO-Math数学题上，经过五代SELFWRITE，门集准确率从73.95%提升至76.45%；在循环从未见过的留出测试集上，avg@4从76.30%升至77.75%，pass@4从82.60%升至84.80%，且未执行任何一次梯度步。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型能够在无梯度条件下为自身权重撰写有用的修改，且被编辑后的模型仍能持续写出有效编辑，表明以模型为"权重作者"的白盒自改写是实现递归自我改进的一条可行路径。

title: Calibrating World Action Models: From Adaptive System 2 Takeover to Self-Evolution
summary: World action models (WAMs) deliver fast visuomotor control, yet degrade sharply in challenging scenes and act blindly when about to fail; conversely, foundation-model-based agents generalize and recover reliably, but incur prohibitive latency and cost when queried at every step. To achieve both WAM (System 1)-level speed and agent (System 2)-level reliability--- we propose \textbf{\oursfull (\ours)}, a framework that calibrates WAMs' confidence--- adaptively triggering System~2 only when necessary, and distilling System~2's knowledge to form an evolving System~1.
