First, \ours equips a frozen WAM with \textbf{calibrated self-assessment}: a single lightweight judgment token reading internal video--action features is trained via our proposed \textbf{cross-fitted temporal-difference (TD) learning} using only binary rollout success/failure signals. It can predict a \textbf{calibrated success probability} at negligible overhead without affecting action predictions. Second, this calibrated success probability schedules control chunk by chunk---invoking System~2 to resolve bottlenecks when confidence drops, and handing control back to the WAM once confidence recovers, preserving WAM-like speed while approaching System~2 reliability. Third, as System~2 intervenes only when the WAM lacks confidence, its takeover trajectories directly capture the WAM's capability gaps. JiL distills these takeovers into the WAM to repair those gaps so System~1 can operate standalone without System~2 at test time, while our mastered-skill anchoring and dynamic confidence gating prevent degrading existing capabilities.

AI.tldr: JiL 通过为冻结的世界动作模型（WAM）配备校准的自信度评估，按置信度动态调度 System 2 干预，并将 System 2 的接管轨迹蒸馏回 WAM，从而同时获得 System 1 级速度与 System 2 级可靠性。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAM）推理快但泛化差、失败前"盲目行动"；基于基础模型的智能体（System 2）泛化与恢复能力强，但每步查询的开销与延迟过高。作者希望在二者之间取得速度与可靠性的兼顾。
AI.method: 1) 校准式自评估：在冻结 WAM 上增加单个轻量判据 token，读取内部视频—动作特征，仅用二值 rollout 成功/失败信号，通过提出的 cross-fitted 时序差分（TD）学习训练，以极低开销输出校准的成功概率，且不影响动作预测。2) 分块置信度调度：以校准成功概率逐 chunk 决定是否调用 System 2，置信度下降时由 System 2 解决瓶颈，恢复后交还 WAM。3) 蒸馏修复：把 System 2 的接管轨迹视为 WAM 能力缺口样本，蒸馏进 WAM，配合已掌握技能锚定与动态置信度门控，防止既有能力退化，最终测试阶段无需 System 2。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果；宣称可在保持接近 WAM 速度的同时逼近 System 2 的可靠性，并在蒸馏后使 System 1 可独立运行而不损害原有能力。
AI.conclusion: 将"置信度校准 + 按需触发 + 接管轨迹蒸馏"结合，可在不牺牲推理速度的前提下系统性修复 WAM 的失败模式，是一种面向快慢双系统协同的自演进框架。

title: ReVAgent: Multi-Agent Reasoning-Intensive Video Generation
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Ruize Han is the corresponding author
summary: A central challenge in generating instructional videos for reasoning-intensive topics is to show how and why the state changes at each step. Even when an animation renders successfully, the depicted object relationships and state transitions can conflict with the explanation, making the reasoning difficult to follow. We present ReVAgent, a multi-agent framework that solves a problem, generates keyframes for its explanation, and synthesizes an instructional video. The agents share the execution record of a solution program, reuse intermediate results and constructions in the scenes, and check rendered keyframes to guide revisions to the solution or the scenes. We also introduce a multidimensional rubric for assessing whether generated videos present the problem clearly, organize the steps coherently, and use visuals to explain the reasoning. We calibrate a multimodal judge using human ratings and apply it to instructional videos for mathematics and algorithms. In the evaluated samples, ReVAgent presents multi-step reasoning coherently and uses diagrams to show how key operations lead to subsequent states.

AI.tldr: ReVAgent：多智能体框架，通过共享解题程序执行记录生成关键帧并合成教学视频，配合多维评分量表与校准的多模态评审模型评估视频的清晰性、连贯性与可视化推理解释力。
AI.motivation: 为推理性强的主题生成教学视频的核心难点在于：需要说明每一步"状态如何改变、为何改变"。即使动画渲染成功，画面中呈现的对象关系与状态转换也可能与讲解冲突，导致推理难以跟随。现有方法缺乏对"解—讲—画"一致性的保障，也缺乏系统性评估标准。
AI.method: 提出多智能体框架 ReVAgent：1）解题智能体求解问题并生成解的程序执行记录；2）各智能体共享该执行记录，在场景中复用中间结果与构造；3）生成讲解关键帧并合成教学视频；4）对渲染出的关键帧进行检查，据此反馈修订解题方案或场景。另构建多维度评分量表（问题呈现清晰度、步骤组织连贯性、视觉辅助推理解释），并用人工评分校准多模态评审模型。
AI.result: 在数学与算法主题的教学视频上应用校准后的多模态评审进行评测；在所评估样本中，ReVAgent 能连贯呈现多步推理，并利用图示展示关键操作如何导向后续状态。
AI.conclusion: 以程序执行记录为中心、结合关键帧检查回环的多智能体协作，可有效维持解题逻辑与视觉呈现的一致性；配合多维量表与校准评审，为教学视频生成提供了可量化的评估路径。

title: AERIN: Aerial Instance Navigation with a Visual World Model
summary: Searching from high altitude and navigating to a target instance specified by a reference image is a common application for UAVs. In such tasks, high-altitude observations provide broad ground coverage for efficient search, but targets occupy fewer pixels, making instance verification and action selection more difficult. We present AERIN, a visual world model that uses action-conditioned prediction to guide the UAV toward the target while adjusting its viewpoint to obtain higherquality observations for subsequent instance verification. Highaltitude navigation requires fine-grained target details and scene context relevant to visibility, but repeatedly predicting dense visual representations of this information is computationally expensive. AERIN addresses this challenge with a compact, fixedsize, target-conditioned latent state that separately represents both for efficient action evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that AERIN outperforms the evaluated baselines in target approach and observation quality, while requiring substantially less decision time than similar world models.

AI.tldr: 提出视觉世界模型AERIN，以动作条件预测引导无人机在高空搜索中逼近参考图像指定的目标，并主动调整视角提升观测质量，供后续实例验证使用。
AI.motivation: 高空观测覆盖广、搜索效率高，但目标像素少，导致实例验证与动作选择困难；而反复预测稠密视觉表征以获取细节与可见性相关场景上下文，计算代价高昂。
AI.method: 构建动作条件预测的视觉世界模型AERIN，采用紧凑、固定尺寸、以目标为条件的隐状态，分别表征细粒度目标细节与可见性相关的场景上下文，以支持高效的动作评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，AERIN在目标逼近与观测质量上优于所评估的基线方法，且决策时间显著少于同类世界模型。
AI.conclusion: 以紧凑目标条件隐状态替代稠密视觉预测，可在保持导航性能的同时大幅降低世界模型的推理开销。

title: Adaptation or Poisoning? Security Risks of Conversational Test-Time Learning in Large Language Models
summary: Test-time learning (TTL) enables large language models to adapt to unlabeled inputs during deployment. The model updates a lightweight adapter by minimizing the next-token prediction loss on the input it receives. When these updates persist across conversation turns, every user query serves both as the request answered in the current turn and as adaptation data for later turns. By choosing the queries used for adaptation, an attacker can influence parameter updates and weaken safety alignment through ordinary interactions with a TTL chat service. To demonstrate this risk, we introduce Progressive Test-Time Adaptation Poisoning (P-TAP), a query-only multi-turn attack that jailbreaks the model by poisoning its session adapter through the service's own updates. A sequence of escalating adversarial queries shapes the adapter turn by turn; the final harmful request is then answered under the accumulated state without itself being used for adaptation. Across four open-weight instruction-tuned models, enabling updates raises attack success rates on average by 13.00 percentage points under greedy decoding and by 22.25 points under best-of-10 sampling, relative to matched sessions receiving the same queries without updates. Answering adversarial queries but adapting on unrelated text or on benign text about the same topic removes most of this increase. Among existing safeguards, screening incoming queries flags every attack stream before the final request, while a perplexity-based detector of unsafe adaptation flags none of the successful attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出P-TAP攻击：利用测试时学习（TTL）跨轮次持久更新适配器的机制，仅通过多轮查询即可毒化会话适配器，逐步削弱模型安全对齐，使最终有害请求在"未被用于适配"的情况下被成功回答。
AI.motivation: TTL使部署期模型能用无标签输入自主更新轻量适配器；若更新跨对话轮次持久化，每个用户查询既是被回答的请求，也是后续轮次的适配数据。攻击者可借此通过正常交互影响参数更新、削弱安全对齐，而这一"服务自身更新被滥用"的风险尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: P-TAP（渐进式测试时适配投毒）：一种仅需查询的多轮攻击。通过一系列逐级升级的对抗性查询，逐轮塑造会话适配器状态；最终有害请求在累积的适配状态下达被回答，且该请求本身不参与适配更新。在四个开源指令微调模型上，与"收到相同查询但不更新"的匹配会话对照，评估贪心解码与best-of-10采样下的攻击成功率，并比较适配文本替换（无关文本、同主题良性文本）及现有防护措施的效果。
AI.result: 启用更新使攻击成功率相对匹配对照平均提升13.00个百分点（贪心解码）和22.25个百分点（best-of-10采样）。若回答对抗查询但在无关文本或同主题良性文本上适配，大部分提升消失。现有防护中，对输入查询的筛查能在最终请求前标记出所有攻击流；而基于困惑度的不安全适配检测器未能标记任何一次成功攻击。
AI.conclusion: TTL的持久化适配构成新的安全攻击面：仅凭查询即可逐步毒化适配器并绕过安全对齐。防御关键在于输入侧查询筛查（有效），而基于困惑度的适配内容检测不可靠；同时，适配数据的语义相关性是攻击生效的必要条件。

title: Counterfactual Velocity Steering for World Action Models
summary: Flow-based robot policies generate actions by repeatedly evaluating a conditional velocity field, so test-time bias correction seems simple: query the action expert under a task-agnostic condition and subtract that velocity from the task-conditioned prediction. We show this is often wrong. On Fast-WAM across 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, mean-instruction predictions align strongly with task-conditioned velocities (cosine approximately 0.94-0.95). Averaging eight completed-state references barely cancels this direction: their mean norm is 98.3% of the mean individual norm. References thus contain a large shared transport component, not only harmful bias, and aggressive subtraction damages generation. We propose a same-state diagnostic and shrinkage analysis showing that the optimal correction scale depends on reference signal-to-noise. This motivates geometry-calibrated action debiasing, which removes only the component orthogonal to the task velocity and predicts a small task-dependent scale from instruction geometry. In controlled RoboTwin experiments, corrupting instructions still permits 25.1% success (50 tasks, 20 episodes), whereas dynamic visual corruption nearly eliminates success. A fixed centered orthogonal correction reaches 92.7% versus a 92.1% baseline in one randomized 1000-trial sweep, but gains are non-monotonic and within run-to-run variation. An angular scale pilot has an offline oracle-gated bound of 94.5%; its best learned online realization reaches 92.5%. These results identify shared flow and train-serve mismatch as central obstacles and provide a reproducible foundation for conditional correction.

AI.tldr: 该文指出流匹配机器人策略的“测试时偏置校正”（任务无关条件下速度相减）常是错的，因为参考速度中存在大量共享传输分量；提出几何校准的动作去偏方法（仅去除与任务速度正交的分量并按参考信噪比预测收缩尺度）。
AI.motivation: 流式（flow-based）机器人策略通过反复查询条件速度场生成动作，看似可简单地用任务无关条件下的速度相减来做测试时偏置校正。但作者发现实测中该做法往往无效甚至有害，需要解释原因并给出更合理的校正方案。
AI.method: (1) 在Fast-WAM上跨RoboTwin 2.0的50个任务做诊断：比较平均指令预测与任务条件速度的余弦相似度、以及八个完成状态参考的均值范数与个体范数之比；(2) 提出同状态诊断与收缩（shrinkage）分析，说明最优校正尺度取决于参考信噪比；(3) 提出几何校准的动作去偏：只移除与任务速度正交的分量，并从指令几何中预测一个小的任务相关尺度；(4) 受控实验：指令损坏、动态视觉损坏、固定中心化正交校正的1000次随机试验扫描、角度尺度试点及离线oracle门控上界。
AI.result: 平均指令预测与任务条件速度余弦约0.94–0.95；八个完成状态参考的均值范数为个体范数均值的98.3%，说明共享传输分量几乎未被平均抵消。指令损坏下仍有25.1%成功率（50任务×20回合），而动态视觉损坏几乎使成功率为零。固定中心化正交校正在一次1000次随机扫描中达92.7% vs 基线92.1%，但增益非单调且处于运行间波动范围内。角度尺度试点离线oracle上界94.5%，最佳在线学习实现92.5%。
AI.conclusion: 参考速度中的共享流成分（而非仅有害偏置）与训练-服务不匹配是条件校正的核心障碍；简单相减式去偏不成立，正交投影+信噪比相关的收缩尺度提供了可复现的校正基础，但当前在线实现收益有限、需进一步研究。

title: Same Executions, Different Gaps: Judgment Rules in Web-Agent Evaluation
summary: Success-rate gains guide the development of web agents. Yet knowing which agent ranks first does not tell us how much confidence to place in its reported advantage. We study the comparison itself: how success is defined, what evidence supports the judgments, and how the difference between agents is estimated. On fixed web-agent executions, changing a judge from predicting likely completion to requiring recorded support can remove most of a reported lead without changing the ranking. This effect persists when unresolved completion is distinguished from supported failure. Controlled source additions explain how missing relations between task requirements, objects and observations can conceal a difference or create an apparent advantage. We also find that making both agents' score estimates more accurate can make their difference less accurate, because their original errors partly canceled. To estimate a chosen outcome difference, we combine judge predictions with reference labels for sampled task pairs. Across four released execution systems, regression fitted on the same 50 labeled pairs reduces estimation error relative to direct paired sampling. The results give agent researchers a practical basis for assessing claimed improvements: make the comparison target explicit, retain the evidence needed to check it, and use paired labels to estimate the difference directly.

AI.tldr: 本文不研究"谁排名第一"，而研究比较本身的可信度：在固定执行轨迹上，将评判标准从"预测任务可能完成"改为"要求有记录证据支持"，会消除相当一部分报告的领先优势而不改变排名。作者建议显式定义比较目标、保留可核验证据，并用配对标签直接估计差异。
AI.motivation: Web agent领域普遍以成功率增益来衡量进展，但"哪个agent排名第一"并不能说明其报告的优势应被赋予多少信任。现有评测缺少对成功定义、证据支撑方式以及agent间差异估计方法的审视，因此需要系统研究比较过程本身。
AI.method: 在固定的web-agent执行记录上做对照分析：(1) 对比"预测可能完成"与"要求记录证据支持"两类judge判定，并区分"未解决的完成"与"有证据支撑的失败"；(2) 通过受控地增补来源（source additions）来说明任务需求、对象与观察之间缺失关系如何掩盖差异或制造虚假优势；(3) 分析两个agent评分误差的相关性对差异估计精度的影响；(4) 提出将judge预测与抽样任务对的参考标签相结合，用回归方法估计选定结果的差异，并在四个已发布的执行系统上与直接配对抽样比较。
AI.result: 改变judge标准可在不改变排名的前提下消除大部分报告的领先优势，且该效应在区分未解决完成与有证据支撑的失败后依然存在。受控增补来源表明，缺失的关系既可掩盖真实差异，也可制造表面优势。此外，同时提高两个agent的分数估计精度反而可能降低其差值精度，因为原有误差存在部分抵消。在四个执行系统上，仅用50个标注任务对拟合的回归，相比直接配对抽样降低了差异估计误差。
AI.conclusion: 评估agent改进时应：明确比较目标（成功如何定义）、保留可核查判断的证据、并利用配对标签直接估计差异，而非依赖各自独立评分的相减。该框架为研究者判断所声称的性能提升提供了可操作的基础。

title: Seeing Is Not Planning: Spatiotemporal Planning and Plan Repair in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Planning in a visual world means reading the layout, foreseeing how the state will change, and following the task rules all at once. When a plan fails, a model should also use what went wrong to fix it. We call these two abilities spatiotemporal planning and plan repair, and test them with Railbound-Bench. A model sees a railway puzzle, adds tracks under a budget, and submits one complete layout; a simulator then moves all cars at once and decides whether the layout works. After a failure, the model sees what happened and may submit a new layout, up to five attempts in total. On the 200-puzzle main set, the best of nine models solves 59.5% within five attempts, the next 39.5%, and the other seven at most 10.0%; a 1,000-puzzle extended set with a wider range of difficulty is far easier, at 90.9% for the best model. Controlled studies on 180 fixed puzzles show that knowing the task is not the same as using it. GPT-6.1 Terra copies 97.2% of boards exactly and, given a correct layout as text, predicts all four requested future states in 91.3% of cases, yet only 22.8% of its first layouts work. Planning fails more often as the cars' routes interact, even among puzzles that a search solver finds equally easy. Visual feedback removes the reported fault in 175 of 417 first revisions, but only 43 of these revisions solve the puzzle, and at an equal budget of 40k tokens it does no better than fresh retries. The code and data are open-sourced on GitHub at https://github.com/liaoyanqing666/Railbound_Bench.

AI.tldr: 提出 Railbound-Bench 铁路解谜基准，用于评测模型的"时空规划"与"规划修复"两种能力：模型在轨道预算下提交一次完整布局，模拟器同时移动所有车厢进行验证，失败后最多可修复重试五次。九个模型中最好的五次内解出 59.5%，次优 39.5%，其余均不超过 10.0%；扩展集（1000 题）对最佳模型达 90.9%。控制实验表明"知道任务规则"不等于"会用规则"：某模型可 97.2% 精确复刻棋盘、在给定正确布局文本时 91.3% 预测全部四个未来状态，但首轮布局仅 22.8% 有效；视觉反馈仅在 417 次首修中消除 175 次已报告故障，最终仅 43 次真正解题，且在 40k token 等预算下不如全新重试。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界中的规划要求模型同时完成三件事：读懂场景布局、预判状态演化、遵守任务规则，并在失败后利用错误信息修正计划。现有基准难以同时、干净地衡量"时空规划"与"规划修复"这两项耦合能力，因此需要一个可控、可验证且支持多轮修复的评测环境来暴露模型的能力缺口。
AI.method: 构建 Railbound-Bench：模型观察铁路谜题，在给定轨道预算内放置轨道并提交唯一一份完整布局；模拟器同时（并行）移动所有车厢，判定布局是否成立。失败后模型可看到实际运行结果并提交新布局，最多五次尝试。评测设置包括 200 题主集、1000 题难度更宽的扩展集，以及在 180 道固定题上的控制实验（精确复刻棋盘、给定正确布局文本预测未来状态、首轮正确率、路由交互对难度的影响、搜索求解器等难度对照、修复轮次与等 token 预算对比）。
AI.result: 主集 200 题上，九个模型中最佳者五次内解出 59.5%，第二名 39.5%，其余七个不超过 10.0%；1000 题扩展集对最佳模型反而更易，达 90.9%。控制实验（180 题）：某模型精确复刻 97.2% 的棋盘，在给定正确布局文本时可 91.3% 预测全部四个目标未来状态，但首轮布局仅 22.8% 可用；当车厢路线相互交互时规划失败率显著上升，即使该题对搜索求解器而言难度相同；视觉反馈在 417 次首次修订中消除 175 次已报告故障，但其中仅 43 次真正解出谜题，且在 40k token 同等预算下并不优于全新重试。
AI.conclusion: 模型具备较强的感知与状态推演能力，但将其转化为可执行规划的能力明显不足，"理解任务"与"使用任务约束进行规划"之间存在显著鸿沟；路由交互是规划失败的关键因素，而当前基于视觉反馈的规划修复效率低下，单纯重试往往不劣于反馈修复。Railbound-Bench 及代码数据已开源（GitHub: liaoyanqing666/Railbound_Bench），为时空规划与规划修复研究提供可复现的评测平台。

title: Learning Acceptable Lotteries via Queries: Minimizing Aggregated Violation Distances
summary: When deploying an AI system, a developer can randomize over several candidate versions, sending each request to a version chosen at random, to balance the requirements of multiple stakeholders. We study a setting in which each of $n$ stakeholders reveals only whether a proposed lottery over $m$ candidates is acceptable, and each stakeholder's acceptable lotteries lie on one side of an unknown hyperplane. While previous work sought a lottery that every stakeholder accepts, such a lottery need not exist when, for instance, safety and helpfulness requirements are in conflict. We therefore minimize a power mean of the stakeholders' violations; since binary answers reveal neither the size of a violation nor how to compare violations across stakeholders, we measure each violation by a normalized distance to the stakeholder's acceptance boundary. We characterize exactly when accept/reject answers determine these distances. When they do, $\mathcal{O}(nm\log(1/\varepsilon))$ queries suffice to learn them, where $\varepsilon$ is the precision of the utilities, and this bound is tight; when they do not, a natural worst-case approach is optimal up to a constant factor, even compared with methods that make unlimited queries. For limited query budgets, we give a sampling algorithm whose number of queries for a given accuracy does not depend on $n$, and show that a deterministic algorithm cannot guarantee a small loss without querying almost all stakeholders. Synthetic experiments illustrate the resulting tradeoff between querying many stakeholders and learning each of them accurately.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多利益相关者场景下基于随机化候选版本（lottery）的偏好学习问题：每个利益相关者仅回答提议的 lottery 是否可接受，且其可接受集合由未知超平面一侧界定。作者转而最小化违规量的幂平均（以到接受边界的归一化距离度量），刻画了二值回答能确定距离的充要条件，并给出紧的查询复杂度与预算受限下的采样算法。
AI.motivation: 部署 AI 系统时，开发者可在多个候选版本上随机化以平衡多利益相关者需求。已有工作追求被所有人接受的 lottery，但当安全性与有用性等要求冲突时此类 lottery 可能不存在，因此需要一种在冲突下仍有意义的最优化目标。
AI.method: 以幂平均聚合各利益相关者的违规量，违规量用其到自身接受边界（未知超平面）的归一化距离度量。先刻画 accept/reject 回答能否唯一确定这些距离；能确定时设计查询算法并证明查询下界；不能确定时采用自然的最坏情况方法并与无限查询方法比较；另给出查询预算受限时查询数不依赖 n 的采样算法，并证明确定性算法需查询几乎所有利益相关者。
AI.result: 当距离可由二值回答确定时，O(nm log(1/ε)) 次查询即可学习（ε 为效用精度），且该界是紧的；不可确定时，自然最坏情况方法在常数因子内最优，即使与无限查询方法相比亦然；查询预算受限时，采样算法达到给定精度的查询数与 n 无关，而确定性算法若不查询几乎所有利益相关者则无法保证小损失。
AI.conclusion: 二值可接受性反馈在一般情况下不足以精确刻画违规幅度，但在可辨识情形下学习成本可被精确刻画且最优；不可辨识与预算受限情形下，随机化采样优于确定性方案，揭示了"多查利益相关者"与"单个精确学习"之间的本质权衡。

title: RoboAda: Adapting Frozen Robot Policies at Test Time to Physics They Cannot See
summary: Pretrained robot policies decide what to do from camera images, yet some of the physics that decides whether their plans succeed is not visible. An object may look light but be 100 times heavier, and a weakened joint or a lagging controller leaves no trace in the image. When the physics at deployment differs from training, the plan is often still right but is executed as if nothing had changed. Training on such variations in advance cannot handle unseen changes, while adapting once deployed either changes the plan, leaving the miscalibrated commands in place, or updates a robot model by gradient steps that do not know how reliable they are and can make the robot worse even when nothing has changed. We propose RoboAda, which keeps the policy and its plan unchanged and corrects the commands that carry it out by inferring at test time how the robot turns commands into motion. The key observation is that the robot's own motion reveals the change: after each action chunk, an inverse-dynamics model of the original robot converts the observed motion into the commands it would have needed, yielding free labels at every step. Competing hypotheses of how the robot responds, including that nothing has changed, are weighted by how well they predict these labels, and the next chunk is sent with the commands that best realize the plan under them. RoboAda needs no reward, no gradient step and no data from the changed robot. We evaluate RoboAda with five frozen policies on LIBERO, two world action models and three vision-language-action models. Under eleven physical shifts, it more than doubles their average success, from 27.8% to 62.9%. It beats the best of seven test-time adaptation methods by 17.3 points on Cosmos Policy, and largely preserves the policies' success when nothing has changed. On bimanual RoboTwin 2.0 in joint space, it raises success under joint-target offsets from 24.9% to 78.8%.

AI.tldr: 提出 RoboAda：保持预训练策略及其计划不变，在测试时用机器人自身运动反推"原机器人所需的指令"作为免费标签，对"机器人如何把指令变成运动"的多重假设做贝叶斯加权，并用最优假设下的指令执行下一个 action chunk，从而在物理属性发生未见偏移时显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 1) 视觉策略从图像决策，但决定计划能否成功的部分物理属性（质量、关节磨损、控制器延迟）在图像中不可见；2) 部署时物理条件与训练不同，计划往往仍然正确，却被"当作没变化"地执行；3) 预先在变化上训练无法泛化到未见变化；4) 现有测试时自适应要么只改计划、留下未校准的指令，要么用梯度更新机器人模型，但不知道更新有多可靠，在无变化时也可能让机器人变差。
AI.method: 核心观察：机器人自身运动即透露变化。对每个 action chunk：(a) 用原始机器人的逆动力学模型把观测到的实际运动转换为"本来需要的指令"，得到每步的免费标签；(b) 维护多个关于机器人响应方式的竞争假设（含"什么都没变"这一零假设）；(c) 按各假设对这些标签的预测精度进行加权；(d) 用最能实现原计划的最优假设生成下一个 chunk 的指令。整个过程无需奖励、无梯度步、不需要变化后机器人的数据。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 上用 5 个冻结策略（2 个 world action model + 3 个 VLA 模型）评估：11 种物理偏移下平均成功率从 27.8% 提升到 62.9%（超过 2 倍）；在 Cosmos Policy 上比 7 种测试时自适应方法中最好的高 17.3 个百分点；在无变化时基本保持原有成功率。双臂 RoboTwin 2.0 关节空间下，关节目标偏移使成功率从 24.9% 提升到 78.8%。
AI.conclusion: RoboAda 提供了一种轻量、无需训练与奖励的测试时指令级自适应范式：把"计划"与"执行校准"解耦，利用逆动力学产生免费监督信号、以假设加权实现在线辨识，既能在未见物理偏移下大幅恢复性能，又能在无变化时保持稳健，且可即插即用地套在多种冻结策略上。

title: Adopting AI Technologies without Traps: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework
summary: AI technologies and AI agents play increasingly important roles in human society, including in education, economics, and research. Adopting AI technologies can bring immediate, and sometimes tremendous, rewards such as through productivity boost, but they can also bring negative effects including but not limited to losses of job and training opportunities, and cognitive capability declines. Thus, it is important to investigate the optimal ways of adopting AI technologies without different traps. In this paper, we develop a general multi-agent Markov decision process (MDP) based reinforcement learning (RL or MARL) modeling framework for determining and analyzing optimal adoption of AI technologies. This framework can model the long-term dynamic effects of AI adoption, and lead to finding the optimal AI adoption strategies. In our modeling framework, the negative effects of AI adoption are modeled by undesirable state transitions or negative rewards in the MDPs. The proposed multi-agent RL MDPs incorporate both human agents and AI agents. The key idea of our models is that incorporating AI technologies may not only increase the immediate rewards for AI agents but also alter the states of the involved human and AI agents. In particular, we apply this framework to analyzing AI offloading leading to skill erosion, to analyzing optimal human resource structures for a firm adopting AI, and to analyzing the economic equilibria in the trading/employment among human and AI agents. Since the multi-agent MDP based RL technique is from control, machine learning and AI, this research is essentially using an AI technique to determine the optimal ways of adopting or co-existing with AI without traps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于多智能体马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的强化学习建模框架，用于确定和分析AI技术的最优采纳策略，并将AI采纳的负面影响建模为不利状态转移或负奖励。
AI.motivation: AI技术与AI智能体在教育、经济、科研等领域作用日增，采纳AI可带来生产率提升等即时甚至巨大收益，但也可能导致失业、培训机会丧失、认知能力下降等负面效应。因此需要研究规避各种"陷阱"的AI最优采纳方式。
AI.method: 构建通用的多智能体MDP强化学习（RL/MARL）建模框架，可刻画AI采纳的长期动态效应；框架中同时包含人类智能体与AI智能体，AI采纳的负面效应通过不利状态转移或负奖励表示。核心思想是：引入AI不仅可能提高AI智能体的即时奖励，还会改变相关人类与AI智能体的状态。框架应用于三类场景：AI卸载（offloading）导致技能侵蚀、企业采纳AI时的最优人力资源结构、以及人类与AI智能体之间交易/就业的经济均衡分析。
AI.result: 框架能够刻画AI采纳的长期动态效应并求得最优AI采纳策略；在技能侵蚀、人力资源结构设计与经济均衡三个应用中给出了对应的最优策略/均衡分析结果。
AI.conclusion: 由于多智能体MDP强化学习技术源自控制、机器学习与人工智能领域，本研究本质上是"用一种AI技术来确定与AI最优共存、避免陷阱的采纳方式"。

title: Dynamic Spectrum Re-parameterized Convolution for Cost-free Image Enhancement
summary: Image enhancement spans degradations with distinct spectral characteristics. Standard convolutions use fixed kernels, whereas dynamic convolutions gain adaptability at additional inference cost. We propose Dynamic Spectrum Re-parameterized Convolution (DSRC), a plug-and-play module that learns task-adaptive spectral responses during training while retaining standard convolution at inference. DSRC decomposes convolution kernels into frequency bands, applies learnable high/low-pass modulation, and incorporates lightweight residual branches. Owing to the linearity of these operations, all training-time components are analytically fused into a single kernel for inference. Experiments on low-light enhancement, underwater enhancement, and image super-resolution show consistent PSNR gains and generally improved or preserved SSIM and LPIPS across twelve backbone-task configurations, with unchanged deployed parameter counts and theoretical FLOPs, and no additional inference operators.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用的动态频谱重参数化卷积（DSRC），在训练时学习任务自适应的频带响应、推理时解析融合为标准卷积，在低光增强、水下增强、超分三类任务共12种骨干-任务配置上稳定提升PSNR，且部署参数量与理论FLOPs不变。
AI.motivation: 图像增强所面对的退化具有不同的频谱特性：标准卷积使用固定卷积核，缺乏频域适应性；动态卷积虽具自适应性，却带来额外的推理开销。因此需要一个兼顾"训练期自适应"与"部署期零额外成本"的方案。
AI.method: DSRC将卷积核分解到多个频带上，对高通/低通分量施加可学习调制，并引入轻量残差分支；由于这些操作均为线性，训练期的全部分支可在推理前解析地融合为单一卷积核，从而保持标准卷积的推理形式。
AI.result: 在低光增强、水下增强与图像超分辨率三任务、共12组骨干-任务配置上，PSNR一致提升，SSIM与LPIPS总体改善或保持；部署参数量与理论FLOPs不变，且不引入额外推理算子。
AI.conclusion: DSRC作为一种重参数化模块，可在不增加推理成本与部署复杂度的前提下为多种图像增强骨干注入频谱自适应性，是一种可直接替换标准卷积的通用增强组件。

title: Think Before You Forecast: Scaling Test-Time Compute for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Test-time compute has become an important paradigm in computer vision and language modeling, where additional computation at inference time enables models to explore multiple candidate solutions and select or refine the most reliable one. However, time series forecasting models typically produce predictions through a single forward pass, leaving them vulnerable to distribution shifts and non-stationarity that frequently arise in real-world temporal data. We propose Time Test Compute for Time Series (TTC4TS), an architecture-agnostic framework that improves the predictive performance of frozen forecasting models at inference time. Given a pretrained backbone, the generator produces multiple candidate forecast trajectories using augmentation, retrieval, adapter. The synthesizer then selects or combines these candidates using aggregation, classification, or candidate-scoring and ranking methods to produce the final forecast. By increasing the number of candidates, TTC4TS scales test-time compute without retraining the forecasting backbone. Beyond improving point-forecast accuracy, TTC4TS can exploit candidate forecasts for uncertainty quantification, which supports improved interval forecasts. We also theoretically analyze when additional test-time computation improves forecasting. Experiments across diverse datasets and backbones demonstrate consistent gains in accuracy and calibration. Code is provided in https://github.com/Anoise/TTC4TS.

AI.tldr: 提出 TTC4TS，一种与骨干架构无关的测试时计算框架，冻结预训练预测模型，通过生成器产生多候选预测轨迹、合成器选择或融合，从而在不重训练的情况下提升预测精度与校准。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测模型通常只做单次前向推断，面对真实数据中的分布漂移与非平稳性时鲁棒性不足；而测试时计算范式在视觉与语言建模中已被证明能通过多候选探索提升可靠性，但尚未被系统引入时间序列预测。
AI.method: TTC4TS 分两阶段：生成器利用数据增强、检索、适配器（adapter）从冻结骨干产生多条候选预测轨迹；合成器通过聚合、分类、候选打分与排序等方法选择或组合候选，得到最终预测。增加候选数量即可扩展测试时计算，无需重训练骨干；候选轨迹同时用于不确定性量化与区间预测。作者还从理论上分析了额外测试时计算何时能带来收益。
AI.result: 在多类数据集与多种骨干模型上的实验显示，点预测精度与校准（区间预测）均获得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 测试时计算是提升时间序列预测的一种有效、通用的范式：通过多候选生成与合成，可在冻结模型上以架构无关方式获得性能增益，并为不确定性量化提供支持。

title: Innata-0: A Native Embodied World System with Model-Agent Co-Design
summary: The physical world is open-ended, dynamic, and partially observable. While foundation models have advanced embodied intelligence, standalone models struggle with long-horizon execution, and simply integrating models with agents may lead to inconsistencies between planning and physical control. To support reliable and adaptive behaviors in the physical world, we introduce Innata-0, a native embodied world system. Innata-0 jointly designs an embodied world-action model and an agent to combine their complementary strengths. The model, Innata-0-WAM, adopts a tri-tower Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that integrates understanding, prediction, and action generation. The agent, Innata-0-Agent, coordinates long-horizon execution through memory, verification, and recovery. A co-design protocol is further proposed to align model training with agent execution and leverage validated experiences to support subsequent adaptation and model improvement. Extensive evaluations demonstrate strong embodied capabilities across understanding, world prediction, and robotic manipulation. Innata-0 represents our first step toward physical intelligence, and we see it as the beginning of a much longer journey.

AI.tldr: 提出原生具身世界系统 Innata-0，将具身世界-动作模型（Innata-0-WAM）与智能体（Innata-0-Agent）联合设计，并通过协同设计协议对齐训练与执行，以支撑物理世界中的长程、自适应行为。
AI.motivation: 物理世界开放、动态且部分可观测。现有基础模型虽推进了具身智能，但单独模型难以完成长程执行；简单地将模型与智能体拼接又会导致规划与物理控制之间的不一致。因此需要模型与智能体的原生一体化设计。
AI.method: 1) Innata-0-WAM：采用三塔 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构，统一理解、预测与动作生成；2) Innata-0-Agent：通过记忆、验证与恢复机制协调长程执行；3) 协同设计协议：使模型训练与智能体执行对齐，并利用经过验证的经验支持后续自适应与模型改进。
AI.result: 大量评测表明，系统在理解、世界预测与机器人操作三方面均展现出较强的具身能力。
AI.conclusion: Innata-0 是迈向物理智能的第一步，作者将其视为一段更长旅程的开端。

title: VeriWorld: A Verifiable Visual SWE-Bench for Spatial Reasoning in 3D Environments
comment: 32 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track. Code at https://github.com/VITA-Group/VeriWorld and dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/yanyanzheng96/VeriWorld
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for spatial tasks such as navigation and manipulation, where they must infer geometry and object relationships from visual input in order to act correctly. Existing benchmarks usually test perception and reasoning in isolation, making it hard to tell whether failures come from visual understanding, downstream reasoning, or the bridge between them. We introduce VeriWorld, a benchmark for spatial reasoning in interactive 3D environments with executable actions and deterministic verification. For task families where all three channels are well-defined, we evaluate matched visual, structured, and combined input conditions on the same instance, environment, and verifier; families without a clean visual/structured/combined split are reported separately. This design supports controlled comparisons of perception, reasoning, and their interaction. Using this setup, we uncover two diagnostic findings. First, models often perform much better when task-relevant information, such as object identity, current state, or target location, is given explicitly than when it must be read from the rendered scene, revealing a recurring visual-to-structure gap. Second, action-space and harness design can change outcomes even under the same task and information condition, showing that interaction protocol is itself a confounding variable. VeriWorld is open-sourced to support reproducible and fine-grained evaluation of spatial reasoning in VLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出 VeriWorld 基准，在交互式3D环境中用可执行动作与确定性验证，对同一实例匹配视觉、结构化、组合三种输入条件，系统诊断VLM空间推理中的“视觉—结构鸿沟”与交互协议混淆问题。
AI.motivation: 现有空间推理基准通常将感知与推理割裂测试，导致失败原因难以归因——无法区分是视觉理解不足、下游推理不足，还是二者之间的桥接失败；同时缺乏对动作空间与评测框架（harness）影响的控制。
AI.method: 构建交互式3D环境基准VeriWorld：任务含可执行动作与确定性验证器；对视觉/结构化/组合三通道均定义清晰的任务族，在同一实例、同一环境、同一验证器下评测匹配的三种输入条件；无清晰三通道划分的任务族单独报告。以此实现感知、推理及其交互的受控对比。
AI.result: 两项诊断性发现：(1) 当物体身份、当前状态、目标位置等任务相关信息被显式给出时，模型表现显著优于需从渲染场景中读取的情形，呈现反复出现的“视觉到结构”鸿沟；(2) 在相同任务与信息条件下，动作空间与评估框架设计即可改变结果，说明交互协议本身是混淆变量。
AI.conclusion: VeriWorld通过可执行动作、确定性验证与匹配输入条件的受控实验设计，实现对VLM空间推理的细粒度、可复现归因评测，并开源以支持后续研究。

title: Learning Optical Flow with Task-Oriented Feature Adaptation
summary: Learning-based optical flow estimation approaches generally rely on both inter-frame correspondence evidence and intra-frame contextual guidance, yet features from general-purpose image encoders may not fully support these roles. Strongly activated but weakly discriminative channels can outweigh more informative ones when computing inter-frame feature similarity, while context feature affinities can be low within motion-coherent regions yet high across motion boundaries. To address these mismatches, this study proposes TO-Flow, a task-oriented feature adaptation framework that aligns matching and context features with their respective requirements through dedicated channel modulation and spatial reorganization approaches. An affinity-based soft partition distinguishes motion-region interiors from boundary-adjacent regions to guide both processes. Channel modulation uses simulated flow refinement to assess whether each channel assigns higher similarity to estimated correspondences than to nearby competing candidates. The resulting similarity differences are aggregated within each region type and averaged across iterations to derive channel weights that emphasize informative channels and suppress ambiguous ones. Spatial reorganization combines affinity-guided feature attraction and repulsion from coarse to fine to simultaneously improve consistency within motion-coherent regions and distinctiveness across motion boundaries, with feature resampling mitigating boundary blurring during cross-scale fusion. Extensive experiments on the MPI Sintel, KITTI 2015, Spring, and LayeredFlow datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and general applicability of TO-Flow across diverse iterative refinement architectures as well as supervised and unsupervised training paradigms. The source code will be publicly available at https://mias.group/TO-Flow upon publication.

AI.tldr: TO-Flow，一种任务导向的特征自适应框架，通过通道调制与空间重组分别对齐匹配特征与上下文特征的需求，在多个光流数据集与架构上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 基于学习的光流估计同时依赖帧间对应证据与帧内上下文引导，但通用图像编码器提取的特征难以胜任这两种角色：强激活但弱判别性的通道在计算帧间相似度时会压过更有信息量的通道；上下文特征的相似度在运动一致区域内部偏低、在运动边界处却偏高，二者均与任务需求失配。
AI.method: 提出TO-Flow任务导向特征自适应框架。首先用基于相似度的软划分区分运动区域内部与边界邻域，以引导后续两个过程。通道调制借助模拟光流精化，评估每个通道对估计对应关系是否赋予比邻近竞争候选更高的相似度，将相似度差异按区域类型聚合并跨迭代平均，得到强调信息通道、抑制模糊通道的通道权重。空间重组由粗到细结合相似度引导的特征吸引与排斥，提升运动一致区域内部的一致性与运动边界处的可分性，并通过特征重采样缓解跨尺度融合中的边界模糊。
AI.result: 在MPI Sintel、KITTI 2015、Spring与LayeredFlow数据集上的大量实验表明，TO-Flow在多种迭代精化架构以及监督、无监督训练范式下均有效且具备通用性。
AI.conclusion: 通过任务导向的通道调制与空间重组，可有效消除通用编码器特征与光流任务需求间的失配，TO-Flow可作为通用模块适配多种光流框架，源码将于论文发表后公开。

title: From Learning Rates to Rotational Schedules: Finite-Horizon Theory on the Sphere
summary: How should step sizes be scheduled across a finite training horizon? Cosine and warmup-stable-decay (WSD) schedules are widely adopted in large-scale pretraining, yet their effect on optimization also depends on parameter norms. Normalization can make parameter groups scale invariant, so that the loss depends only on their direction, while their norms still affect how fast the parameters rotate. In this work, we formulate schedule design directly in the space of rotational motion. Working within a geodesically convex spherical setting, we derive a last-iterate convergence guarantee for arbitrary rotational schedules that separates their overall scale from their distribution over time. We derive the unique schedule that minimizes this bound and prove that it approaches linear decay as the horizon grows. Empirically, our rotational interpretation and idealized spherical analysis provide useful predictions for LLM pretraining in practice, including schedule comparisons missed by existing analyses. Our analysis predicts schedule ordering across model scales for both vanilla (Adam, Muon) and Hyperball-style (AdamH, MuonH) optimizers. Our Hyperball experiments support the predicted strong performance of linear LR decay and confirm our prediction that WSD underperforms in this setting. Accounting for parameter norm dynamics, we predict instead the strong performance of WSD for Adam and Muon shown in practice. Guided by our theoretical insights, we also derive a new LR schedule for Adam and Muon, which improves over the established cosine and WSD schedules. All in all, these results support the use of rotational dynamics to understand, predict, and ultimately guide scheduling in LLM pretraining.

AI.tldr: 论文从"旋转运动"视角重新刻画学习率调度设计，在测地凸球面框架下给出任意旋转式调度的last-iterate收敛界并推导最优调度（长horizon下趋于线性衰减），解释了Adam/Muon与Hyperball类优化器下cosine、WSD、linear的排序差异，并提出优于二者的新调度。
AI.motivation: 余弦与WSD等调度虽被大规模预训练广泛采用，但其作用机理缺乏理论解释；同时归一化使参数组具有尺度不变性（损失只依赖方向，范数只影响旋转速度），现有分析未利用这一结构，也难以预测不同优化器（Adam、Muon、AdamH、MuonH）与不同模型规模下的调度优劣。
AI.method: 将调度设计直接表述在旋转运动空间中；在测地凸（geodesically convex）的球面设定下，为任意旋转式调度推导last-iterate收敛保证，并将调度的"整体尺度"与"时间分布"解耦；在该界下求唯一最优调度，分析其随训练horizon增长的极限行为；结合参数范数动力学将理想球面结论映射回实际优化器，并据此导出新的学习率调度。
AI.result: 最优调度随horizon增长趋近线性衰减；球面分析能预测跨模型规模、跨优化器（Adam、Muon及AdamH、MuonH）的调度排序，包括已有分析无法区分的比较；Hyperball实验验证线性LR衰减表现强劲，且WSD在该设定下如预测般欠佳；计入参数范数动力学后，则可预测实践中Adam与Muon上WSD的强表现；所导出的新LR调度在Adam与Muon上优于既有的cosine与WSD。
AI.conclusion: 旋转动力学是理解、预测并指导LLM预训练学习率调度的有效理论工具；调度优劣依赖于参数范数是否被归一化（尺度不变）以及范数自身动力学。

title: Skill-Adaptive Noise Scheduling for Diffusion Policies
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Recent advances in diffusion policies have demonstrated strong effectiveness when integrated into hierarchical skill-based learning frameworks, leveraging offline data to capture multimodal and temporally abstracted behaviors. However, prior approaches have rarely considered the diffusion process as a learnable component, adopting fixed noise schedules applied uniformly across skills, regardless of their distinct behavioral contexts. Such a design fundamentally limits the achievable performance, particularly for contact-rich and dexterous manipulation tasks where different skills exhibit distinct couplings between action dimensions. In this paper, we present a skill-adaptive noise diffusion framework (SaND) which introduces a learnable, skill-conditioned noise schedule that modulates the diffusion process per action dimension, adapting the noising dynamics to each skill. To prevent the learned noise schedule from collapsing into trivial solutions, we employ an auxiliary inverse objective that reconstructs the skill embedding from the Legendre coefficients of the derivative of the noise schedule, encouraging the schedules to remain skill-discriminative. This formulation naturally enables adaptive control over the denoising steps for each skill, where noise schedules are clustered in the Legendre coefficient space, and the appropriate number of denoising steps is determined at the point where reconstruction error abruptly increases. At inference, we identify each skill embedding's cluster from its noise schedule and apply the corresponding number of denoising steps, dedicating more compute to skills requiring fine-grained control and less to simpler ones. In simulation and on real robot hardware, SaND outperforms existing skill learning and planning baselines on contact-rich and dexterous manipulation tasks, achieving higher success rates while requiring fewer denoising steps.

AI.tldr: 提出技能自适应噪声扩散框架 SaND，用可学习、以技能为条件、逐动作维度的噪声调度替代固定调度，并借 Legendre 系数聚类实现按技能自适应分配去噪步数。
AI.motivation: 现有分层技能式扩散策略普遍把扩散过程视为固定组件：噪声调度在所有技能上统一、不可学习，忽视了不同技能在行为上下文与动作维度耦合上的差异，尤其限制接触丰富与灵巧操作任务的性能。
AI.method: 1) 引入可学习的技能条件噪声调度，对每个动作维度分别调制加噪动力学；2) 设计辅助逆向目标，由噪声调度导数的 Legendre 系数重建技能嵌入，防止调度塌缩为平凡解并保持技能可区分性；3) 在 Legendre 系数空间对噪声调度聚类，以重建误差骤增点确定各技能所需去噪步数，推理时按技能嵌入所属簇分配步数。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实机器人硬件上，SaND 在接触丰富与灵巧操作任务中优于现有技能学习与规划基线，成功率更高且所需去噪步数更少。
AI.conclusion: 将噪声调度纳入可学习组件并按技能自适应，可提升技能式扩散策略的表达力与计算效率，实现按技能复杂度动态分配推理算力。

title: CLIP-FMoE: Scalable CLIP via Fused Mixture-of-Experts with Enforced Specialization
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have emerged as a promising approach for scaling deep learning models while maintaining computational efficiency. However, existing MoE adaptations for Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) models suffer from significant computational overhead during sequential training and degradation of zero-shot capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose CLIP-FMoE, a novel approach that integrates MoE architecture into CLIP fine-tuning. Our method uses Isolated Constrained Contrastive Learning, a pipeline that trains specialized experts on cluster-based data partitions to accelerate expert specialization. Additionally, we introduce a Fusion Gate mechanism to mitigate catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained knowledge. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves consistent improvements on downstream tasks while preserving zero-shot capabilities. Furthermore, our method demonstrates robust performance across varying context lengths, making it particularly suitable for diverse real-world applications.

AI.tldr: CLIP-FMoE 将 MoE 架构引入 CLIP 微调，用孤立约束对比学习按聚类划分数据加速专家特化，并用融合门缓解预训练知识遗忘，在提升下游任务的同时保持零样本能力。
AI.motivation: 已有用于 CLIP 的 MoE 适配方案存在两个问题：顺序训练时计算开销大，且零样本能力出现退化。
AI.method: 提出 CLIP-FMoE：1) Isolated Constrained Contrastive Learning（孤立约束对比学习）流水线，在基于聚类的数据划分上训练各自专门的专家，以加速专家特化；2) Fusion Gate（融合门）机制，用于缓解对预训练知识的灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在下游任务上取得一致性的性能提升，同时保持零样本能力；并在不同上下文长度下表现出稳健性能。
AI.conclusion: CLIP-FMoE 在提升 CLIP 下游适配效果的同时兼顾零样本泛化与计算效率，适合多样化的真实应用场景。

title: UNIFY: Unified Learning with One Model via Batch Norm Switching
summary: Neural networks are typically trained separately for individual datasets or tasks, resulting in many task-specific models. This redundancy increases memory footprint, deployment costs, and energy consumption limiting their scalability. We propose UNIFY, a unified learning framework that enables a single model to jointly learn and perform inference across multiple datasets via Batch Normalization Switching (BNS). Instead of maintaining separate models for each dataset, UNIFY shares the parameter-intensive backbone while maintaining dataset-specific BN statistics and parameters, along with dataset-specific classification heads. We validate our framework using five datasets (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet) across six Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) of different sizes (SqueezeNet 1.1, WideResNet-40-2, WideResNet-16-8, ResNet-18, ResNet-34, ResNet-50). Notably, a single UNIFIED ResNet-34 trained on these datasets achieves accuracies of 99.53%, 94.84%, 96.12%, 80.32%, and 67.67%, respectively, outperforming the average performance of the corresponding independently trained task-specific models while reducing the memory footprint by approximately 4.94x, from 428.30 MB (five separate models) to 86.71 MB (one unified model). UNIFY aims not only to consolidate (K) models into a single model but also to enhance model-effectiveness by leveraging complementary knowledge across datasets. It paves the way for scalable, efficient, and unified learning capable of handling diverse image classification tasks. Code is available at: https://github.com/saktx/UNIFY.

AI.tldr: 提出UNIFY统一学习框架，通过批归一化切换（BNS）共享主干参数、保留数据集特有的BN统计量/参数与分类头，使单一模型可跨多数据集联合训练与推理，在保持或超越独立模型精度的同时大幅降低内存占用。
AI.motivation: 神经网络通常按单一数据集或任务分别训练，导致大量任务专用模型冗余，增加内存占用、部署成本与能耗，限制可扩展性。
AI.method: UNIFY框架：多数据集共享参数密集的骨干网络；为每个数据集保留独立的BN统计量与BN参数，并配置数据集专属分类头；推理时通过Batch Normalization Switching（BNS）切换到对应数据集的BN与分类头。实验在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet五个数据集与六种CNN（SqueezeNet 1.1、WRN-40-2、WRN-16-8、ResNet-18/34/50）上验证。
AI.result: 统一ResNet-34在五个数据集上分别达到99.53%、94.84%、96.12%、80.32%、67.67%，优于对应独立任务模型平均性能；内存占用由428.30 MB（五个模型）降至86.71 MB（单一模型），约4.94倍压缩。
AI.conclusion: UNIFY不仅将K个模型整合为单一模型，还通过利用数据集间互补知识提升模型有效性，为可扩展、高效、处理多样图像分类任务的统一学习提供路径；代码已开源。

title: How Multi-Timescale Memory Cools Optimization: Theory and Evidence from AdEMAMix
summary: Augmenting AdamW with multiple momentum timescales improves large language model pretraining, yet the mechanism driving these gains remains poorly understood. We identify an interaction between multi-timescale optimizer memory and the geometry of normalized networks: memory changes parameter norms and thereby controls how fast parameters rotate. Starting from exact norm dynamics under decoupled weight decay, we show that the parameter norm depends on the temporal correlation of the updates, with weight decay controlling how long these correlations influence optimization. We show how an independently weighted slow momentum can substantially increase the norm of parameters, while contributing negligible power to the instantaneous update, therefore acting as an endogenous annealing schedule. We study this mechanism in AdEMAMix for language-model pretraining. Controlled interventions show that this scheduling mechanism has clear practical consequences and is an important factor behind AdEMAMix's advantage over AdamW.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示多时间尺度动量（如AdEMAMix）优于AdamW的机制：慢动量通过提升参数范数实现内生的退火调度（endogenous annealing schedule），而非依靠其对瞬时更新的功率贡献。
AI.motivation: 多尺度动量的优化器（如AdEMAMix）在LLM预训练中优于AdamW，但增益来源的机制尚不清楚，缺乏可解释性，难以指导优化器设计。
AI.method: 从解耦权重衰减下的精确范数动力学出发，推导参数范数与更新量时间相关性之间的关系；分析独立加权的慢动量对参数范数与瞬时更新功率的分别贡献；并在语言模型预训练中以AdEMAMix为对象进行受控干预实验。
AI.result: 参数范数取决于更新的时间相关性，权重衰减控制该相关性影响优化的时长；慢动量几乎不贡献瞬时更新功率，却能显著增大参数范数，从而加快参数旋转/方向变化，起到与退火调度类似的作用。受控干预显示该调度机制具有明显的实际效果，是AdEMAMix相对AdamW优势的重要来源。
AI.conclusion: 多时间尺度动量的收益主要源于"范数—旋转速度"耦合所形成的内生退火调度，而非梯度信号本身；优化器记忆与归一化网络几何之间存在关键交互，为优化器设计提供了原理性指导。

title: Beyond Which: Where, How, and When in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models typically rely on vision-language model (VLM) features as the primary perceptual source for action prediction, showing strong generalization across diverse robotic manipulation tasks. Although VLM features can identify which entities are relevant to action prediction, precise manipulation also requires understanding where task-relevant entities are located within the spatial layout, how their geometric structure constrains physical interaction, and when spatial or geometric information should make a greater contribution to action prediction. To this end, we introduce {\mathcal{W}^{3}\mathcal{H}}-VLA to organize VLA perception and action prediction around which, where, how, and when. Specifically, {\mathcal{W}^{3}\mathcal{H}}-VLA retains VLM-based semantic entity perception which and further introduces spatial distance perception where and geometric structure perception how with adaptive spatial-geometric guidance when to enrich the perceptual information available for action prediction. Experiments across real-world settings and simulation benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and superior performance of {\mathcal{W}^{3}\mathcal{H}}-VLA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 W^3H-VLA，围绕"哪个实体相关、位于何处、几何结构如何约束交互、何时应更多依赖空间/几何信息"四个问题组织 VLA 的感知与动作预测，在 VLM 语义特征基础上引入空间距离感知与几何结构感知，并用自适应空间-几何引导模块动态调节其贡献，在真实场景与仿真基准上取得更优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型主要依赖 VLM 特征作为动作预测的主要感知来源，虽具备较强泛化性，但 VLM 特征只能回答"哪些实体与动作预测相关"（which），难以刻画任务相关实体的空间位置（where）、几何结构对物理交互的约束（how），以及这些空间/几何信息应在何时对动作预测贡献更大（when）；而精确操作恰恰依赖这些信息。
AI.method: 提出 W^3H-VLA 框架，以 which/where/how/when 四个维度组织感知与动作预测：保留基于 VLM 的语义实体感知（which）；新增空间距离感知（where）与几何结构感知（how）以补充感知信息；并设计自适应空间-几何引导机制（when），动态决定空间与几何信息在动作预测中的贡献权重。
AI.result: 在真实世界实验场景与多个仿真基准上验证了方法的有效性，性能优于对比基线，表明多维度感知组织方式与自适应引导机制可提升 VLA 的操作表现。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖 VLM 语义特征的 VLA 感知不足以支撑精细操作；显式建模空间距离与几何结构，并通过自适应引导按需调节其贡献，是提升 VLA 动作预测精度与鲁棒性的有效途径。

title: Learning Heterogeneous Reasoning in Large Language Models: From Mode Compatibility to Local Bottlenecks
summary: Post-training large language models routinely pools reasoning trajectories from diverse teachers or algorithms, yet it remains unclear whether standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can learn such heterogeneous strategies without explicit mode conditioning. We study the learnability and local bottlenecks of heterogeneous reasoning through a formal mixture formulation and controlled experiments. We first formalize the representational compatibility of the optimal autoregressive model with latent reasoning mixtures: the target next-token distribution weights modes by their prefix posteriors and concentrates on a single mode once alternative modes assign negligible likelihood to the prefix. In a verifiable symbolic graph-search environment with paired breadth-first and depth-first search trajectories, no consistent disadvantage is observed for unlabeled mixed SFT relative to homogeneous or labeled baselines under matched token budgets while preserving both modes. Scaling across 0.6B--14B models and data budgets largely eliminates global mode confusion, shifting the primary bottleneck to local state-tracking transitions. Because a local mistake affects the final outcome only when subsequent reasoning is sensitive to that step, we find that only a small fraction of local errors are outcome-determining \emph{Critical Reasoning Nodes (CRNs)}, and that single-step repairs at these nodes rescue failing trajectories across symbolic search and natural language benchmarks whenever the model has sufficient downstream competence to complete the remaining derivation. Our environment is open-sourced at https://github.com/Bowen1911/Symbolic_graph_env.

AI.tldr: 本文通过形式化混合建模与可控实验，研究异质推理轨迹混合SFT的可学习性与瓶颈：全局模式混淆随模型规模与数据量扩大基本消失，主要瓶颈转为局部状态跟踪转移；仅少数局部错误是决定结果的关键推理节点（CRN），单步修复可挽救失败轨迹。
AI.motivation: 后训练中常将来自不同教师或算法的推理轨迹混合池化，但标准SFT能否在无显式模式条件下学习这类异质策略尚不清楚，缺乏对可学习性与局部瓶颈的清晰刻画。
AI.method: 提出形式化混合表述，刻画最优自回归模型与潜在推理混合的表示兼容性（目标分布按前缀后验对模式加权，当前缀对其他模式赋予可忽略似然时集中于单一模式）；构建可验证符号图搜索环境，配对BFS与DFS轨迹，在匹配token预算下对比无标签混合SFT与同质/带标签基线；并扩展到0.6B–14B模型与不同数据预算，定位局部状态跟踪转移瓶颈，定义CRN并做单步修复实验。
AI.result: 在匹配token预算下，无标签混合SFT相对同质或带标签基线未出现一致性劣势，且保留两种模式；随模型规模与数据预算扩大，全局模式混淆基本消除，瓶颈转移至局部状态跟踪转移；仅少部分局部错误为结果决定性的CRN，在符号搜索与自然语言基准上对CRN做单步修复，可在下游能力足够时挽救失败轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 异质推理混合SFT是可学的，无需显式模式条件；随着规模扩大其核心瓶颈由全局模式混淆转为局部状态跟踪，且错误影响具有稀疏性（CRN），为针对性纠错与数据/训练设计提供依据。环境已开源。

title: From Pairwise to Collective: Encoder Collections Make Unpaired Vision-Language Alignment Reliable
summary: Strong vision and text encoders can be trained independently, but their representations are not directly comparable. Connecting them usually requires paired image-text data, which may be unavailable. Unpaired alignment instead fits a map between a vision and a text encoder from feature-space geometry alone, enabling text-based retrieval and zero-shot classification without paired data. Treating each pair independently leads to fragile searches, repeated fitting, and uncertain map quality. A collection of encoders supplies additional supervision: all vision encoders embed the same images and all text encoders the same texts. Correspondences within each modality are therefore known exactly, while the cross-modal correspondence remains hidden. ConsensusAlign pools each modality into a shared space, fits one unpaired cross-modal bridge, and transfers it in closed form to every encoder pair. New encoders join through same-modality fitting without repeating the cross-modal search. On 21 vision-text encoder pairs and five seeds, pooled fitting aligns every pair, whereas pairwise fits fail in 68 of 105 pair-seed cells. Mean alignment error (FOSCTTM) falls from 0.1457 to 0.0099, and zero-shot accuracy nearly doubles on ten datasets. Gains persist across the tested within-modality pooling constructions with a WP bridge. New corpora reuse the bridge through native maps fitted to unlabeled target features from every source encoder. Agreement with separately fitted reference maps detects failures on COCO.

AI.tldr: 提出ConsensusAlign：将同模态的多个编码器池化到共享空间，只拟合一个无配对跨模态桥接映射，并以闭式解迁移到所有编码器对，从而在无配对数据下实现稳健的视觉-文本对齐。
AI.motivation: 视觉与文本编码器可各自独立训练但其表征不可直接比较，通常需要配对图文数据来连接；而无配对对齐只能依赖特征空间几何，逐对独立拟合会导致搜索脆弱、重复拟合和映射质量不确定。
AI.method: 利用"所有视觉编码器嵌入同一批图像、所有文本编码器嵌入同一批文本"这一事实，使模态内对应关系精确已知、跨模态对应隐藏。方法将每个模态池化到一个共享空间，拟合唯一一个无配对跨模态桥（WP桥），并以闭式解将该桥迁移到每个编码器对；新编码器只需同模态拟合即可加入，无需重做跨模态搜索。新语料则通过拟合到无标签目标特征的native map复用该桥。
AI.result: 在21个视觉-文本编码器对、5个随机种子上，池化拟合对所有对均成功对齐，而逐对拟合在105个"对-种子"组合中有68个失败。平均对齐误差（FOSCTTM）从0.1457降至0.0099，十个数据集上的零样本准确率接近翻倍；在多种模态内池化构造下增益稳定。与单独拟合的参考映射比较可在COCO上检测失败。
AI.conclusion: 聚合多个编码器以共享单一跨模态映射，可显著提升无配对对齐的鲁棒性与精度，并支持编码器增量扩展与跨语料复用，为缺少配对数据的跨模态检索与零样本分类提供了实用方案。

title: Aggregation Dispersion: An Information-Geometric Diagnostic of Oversmoothing in Graph Neural Networks
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Message-passing neural networks (MPNNs) learn node representations by iteratively aggregating information from neighbors, but stacking too many layers causes all representations to converge, an effect known as oversmoothing. We propose a geometric perspective on this phenomenon. At each depth $k$, the propagation operator assigns to every node $v$ a walk distribution $p_v^{(k)}$, a probability distribution over source nodes. These walk distributions form a point cloud on the probability simplex, whose contraction to a single point characterizes complete mixing of the propagation operator, and thus oversmoothing. To measure this contraction, we use the Fisher-Rao metric, the unique Riemannian metric on the simplex invariant up to scale under sufficient statistics, whose scaled chordal distance under the square-root embedding $p \mapsto \sqrt{p}$ is the Hellinger distance. The resulting diagnostic, the aggregation dispersion $D_k$, is the variance of the embedded point cloud on the unit sphere. We prove that: (i) $D_k = 0$ if and only if the $k$-th step propagation matrix has rank one, a necessary and sufficient condition for complete operator mixing; (ii) $D_k$ is non-increasing with depth; (iii) the spectral gap of the propagation matrix controls the rate of this decay; and (iv) for contractive MPNNs, the aggregation dispersion upper-bounds the representation dispersion up to graph- and initialization-dependent constants. Across 14 model configurations and 11 datasets, $D_k$ attains the highest mean absolute Pearson correlation with test accuracy across depths among eight diagnostics ($|r| = 0.721$, using log-transformed diagnostic values), numerically comparable to the post-training effective rank ($|r| = 0.688$), while requiring no training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"聚合分散度" \(D_k\)：将各深度节点游走分布视为概率单纯形上的点云，用 Fisher-Rao 度量（Hellinger 距离）度量其收缩，从而无训练地刻画过平滑。
AI.motivation: MPNN 堆叠层数过多会导致表示收敛（过平滑），但已有诊断指标（如有效秩）需要训练后才能计算，且缺乏对"算子混合"本身的几何刻画。作者希望给出一个与训练无关、理论上可解释的过平滑判据。
AI.method: 在每个深度 \(k\)，传播算子为每个节点 \(v\) 赋予对源节点的游走分布 \(p_v^{(k)}\)，构成概率单纯形上的点云。以 Fisher-Rao 度量衡量点云收缩，经平方根嵌入 \(p\mapsto\sqrt{p}\) 后转化为单位球面上的弦距离（Hellinger 距离），由此定义诊断量 \(D_k\) 为嵌入点云的方差。理论上证明四条性质：\(D_k=0\) 当且仅当第 \(k\) 步传播矩阵秩为一（算子完全混合的充要条件）；\(D_k\) 随深度单调不增；谱间隙控制衰减速率；对收缩型 MPNN，\(D_k\) 在依赖图与初始化的常数意义下上界表示分散度。
AI.result: 在 14 种模型配置、11 个数据集上，对八个诊断指标跨深度的测试准确率平均绝对 Pearson 相关比较中，\(D_k\) 最高（对数变换后 \(|r|=0.721\)），与训练后的有效秩（\(|r|=0.688\)）数值相当，且无需训练。
AI.conclusion: \(D_k\) 是一个有严格理论保证、免训练的过平滑几何诊断指标，性能与需训练的有效秩相当，可作为 MPNN 深度选择与传播算子设计的实用工具。

title: Robust Lateral String Stability and Error Attenuation for Heterogeneous Vehicle Platoons
summary: Keeping an entire vehicle platoon close to its planned path is essential for navigating road boundaries and obstacles safely. Followers may rely on predecessor information for lateral guidance, which couples their lateral dynamics and allows errors to propagate downstream. This paper develops a robust lateral string stability framework to study this propagation and achieve downstream error attenuation in heterogeneous platoons under varying longitudinal motion and local perturbations. Arc-length-based feedback linearization gives each vehicle the same nominal lateral error dynamics, with parameter uncertainty and external disturbances represented as local perturbations. We define robust $\mathcal L_2$ lateral string stability in terms of platoon-length-uniform error bounds and derive a sufficient condition for achieving it. Furthermore, we show that the same condition guarantees platoon-length-uniform $\mathcal L_\infty$ error bounds. For the considered control formulations, predecessor tracking (PT) can accumulate lateral errors, whereas desired-path tracking (DT) prevents this accumulation. We propose a learn-from-predecessor (LFP) strategy with explicit gains for downstream error attenuation and characterize how intervehicle perturbation differences limit this attenuation. Simulations validate the theoretical findings under vehicle heterogeneity, varying longitudinal motion, and local perturbations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出鲁棒横向弦稳定性框架，研究异质车队中横向误差沿队列的传播，并给出下游误差衰减的条件与控制策略。
AI.motivation: 保持整个车队贴近规划路径对通过道路边界与障碍物至关重要。跟随车若依赖前车信息进行横向引导，会耦合横向动力学并使误差向下游传播，因此需要理论工具刻画并抑制这种传播。
AI.method: 采用基于弧长的反馈线性化，使各车获得相同的标称横向误差动力学，参数不确定性与外部扰动表示为局部扰动。定义以"队列车长一致"误差界刻画的鲁棒 L2 横向弦稳定性，给出其充分条件，并证明该条件同时保证车长一致的 L∞ 误差界；在此基础上比较前车跟踪（PT）与期望路径跟踪（DT），并提出带显式增益的学习前车（LFP）策略。
AI.result: 对所述控制形式，PT 会累积横向误差，DT 则不累积；LFP 可通过显式增益实现下游误差衰减，且车际扰动差异会限制该衰减能力。仿真在车辆异质性、纵向速度变化与局部扰动下验证了理论结论。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为异质车队横向弦稳定性提供了可验证的充分条件与统一的误差界，并表明 LFP 在保证下游误差衰减方面优于 PT，其性能受车际扰动差异制约。

title: A statistical measure of trust in generative AI
summary: Trustworthiness is a crucial issue for generative AI, as modern models can produce convincing and confident responses even when their outputs are incomplete, unsupported, or wrong. The frequent absence of ground-truth knowledge or labels complicates verification of generative AI outputs. To address this issue, we propose a trustworthiness framework grounded in model-internal confidence calibrated against an external expert reference. We estimate per-token trustworthiness of a student generative model as the statistical typicality of each generated token relative to an expert model's distribution, where the expert is used as a distributional reference rather than as a source of factual verification labels. To this end, we introduce an AI ontology calibrator that leverages the student model's internal latent features and token-level output statistics to compute expert-reference acceptance scores. Combined with traditional token-level confidence, entropy, and perplexity statistics, calibrator scores yield a compact set of $15$ response-level indicators for correctness classification. Evaluated across BF program generation, mathematical problem solving, and medical question answering, combined calibrator and traditional indicators provide complementary reliability signal which could be used to build detectors of untrustworthy outputs and hallucinations. Remarkably, our experiments show that these detectors are transferable across domains, although transferability is not always symmetric.

AI.tldr: 提出一种以"外部专家模型分布为参照"校准学生模型内部置信度的可信度框架，通过AI本体校准器（AI ontology calibrator）融合内部隐特征与token级输出统计，最终形成15个响应级指标用于正确性分类与不可信输出/幻觉检测。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI即使输出不完整、缺乏支撑或错误时仍会给出自信且具说服力的回答，而现实场景中常缺少真值知识或标签，使得输出验证困难，因此需要一个不依赖事实核验标签的可信度度量。
AI.method: 以专家模型作为分布参照（而非事实核验标签来源），将学生模型每个生成token的可信度定义为相对于专家分布的统计典型性；引入AI本体校准器，利用学生模型内部隐特征与token级输出统计计算"专家参照接受分数"；再与传统token级置信度、熵、困惑度统计结合，构成15个响应级紧凑指标，用于正确性分类。
AI.result: 在BF程序生成、数学问题求解、医学问答三类任务上，校准器指标与传统指标提供互补的可靠性信号，可构建不可信输出与幻觉的检测器；实验还显示这些检测器具有跨领域可迁移性，但迁移性并非总是对称。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部置信度经外部专家分布参照校准后，可作为无需真值标签的有效可信度代理，支持跨领域部署的幻觉与不可信输出检测；但跨域迁移的不对称性提示需针对目标任务审慎选择指标组合与迁移方向。

title: PSC-Gen: Physical Sequence Conditioning for Video Generation via Agentic Visual Planning
summary: Recent advances in video diffusion models have enabled the synthesis of high-fidelity, visually compelling videos. However, despite being trained on internet-scale video data, understanding underlying physical laws and generating physically plausible dynamics remain challenging. To mitigate this, conditioning video generators on explicit physical reasoning has emerged as a promising direction. Nevertheless, existing conditioning approaches often fail to incorporate detailed physical guidance into generation, resulting in physically implausible motion or visual artifacts. We propose PSC-Gen, a training-free framework that employs an agentic approach to synthesize visual conditions and inject their core dynamics via low-frequency filtering. By iteratively planning physical states and verifying generated keyframes, our Physics Agent constructs visually and physically consistent keyframe sequences. We then interpolate these keyframes into a continuous physical sequence and inject only its low-frequency components, steering the video model to preserve physical dynamics while synthesizing fine visual details. Qualitative and quantitative evaluations across physics-informed and robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that PSC-Gen faithfully follows instructions and generates physically plausible videos.

AI.tldr: PSC-Gen：一个免训练框架，用智能体式物理推理生成关键帧视觉条件，并通过低频滤波注入其核心动力学，从而提升视频扩散模型的物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型虽在海量互联网视频上训练，但仍难以理解物理规律、生成物理上合理的动态。已有“显式物理推理条件化”方法未能把细粒度物理引导有效注入生成过程，导致运动不合理或视觉伪影。
AI.method: 免训练框架：Physics Agent 迭代规划物理状态并验证生成的关键帧，构建视觉与物理一致的关键帧序列；随后将关键帧插值为连续物理序列，仅提取并注入其低频分量作为条件，引导视频模型保留物理动力学同时合成精细视觉细节。
AI.result: 在物理相关基准与机器人操作基准上的定性与定量评估表明，PSC-Gen 能忠实遵循指令并生成物理上合理的视频。
AI.conclusion: 以“智能体规划+关键帧验证+低频动力学注入”的方式实现物理一致的条件化，为免训练提升视频生成物理合理性提供了有效途径。

title: Attacking Tabular Foundation Models: An Experimental Taxonomy of Context Poisoning and Test-Time Evasion
summary: Tabular foundation models condition predictions on labeled examples supplied at inference time, creating an attack surface that differs from conventional model training. We study four manipulation families (label flipping, backdoor context poisoning, clean-label context selection, and test-time evasion) and organize them by attack stage, label consistency, and distributional realism. TabPFN-2.5, TabICL, and XGBoost are evaluated on CIC-IDS2017 and N-BaIoT using a common preprocessing and evaluation pipeline. Backdoor context poisoning provides strong targeted control over the in-context models with little change in clean accuracy, whereas selecting real, correctly labeled boundary-crowding rows causes no systematic accuracy degradation up to a 20% bias fraction. A simplified surrogate-transfer constrained PGD attack inspired by, but not equivalent to, CAPGD also produces test-time evasion, outperforming equal-budget random noise in most settings. The comparison shows that attack effectiveness depends strongly on both where manipulation occurs and how much freedom the attacker has to alter the data.

AI.tldr: 该文研究表格基础模型在推理时上下文（in-context）标注样本上的四类操控攻击，并在CIC-IDS2017与N-BaIoT上对比TabPFN-2.5、TabICL与XGBoost。结果表明：后门上下文投毒可在几乎不损干净精度的前提下实现强定向控制；选择真实且标签正确的边界拥挤样本在20%偏置比例内不造成系统性精度下降；简化代理迁移受限PGD可产生测试时逃逸，多数情形优于等预算随机噪声。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型依赖推理阶段提供的标注示例进行条件预测，这形成了有别于传统训练阶段的攻击面，而现有研究缺少对该新攻击面的系统刻画与跨模型对比。作者因此希望按攻击发生阶段、标签一致性、分布真实性三个维度统一组织攻击类型，并量化其在不同模型上的有效性与数据改动自由度的关系。
AI.method: 提出四类操控攻击族：标签翻转、后门上下文投毒、干净标签上下文选择、测试时逃逸；按攻击阶段、标签一致性、分布真实性归类。使用统一预处理与评估流水线，在CIC-IDS2017与N-BaIoT上评估TabPFN-2.5、TabICL与XGBoost，并构造受约束的简化代理迁移PGD（受CAPGD启发但不等价）作为逃逸方法，与等预算随机噪声对照。
AI.result: 后门上下文投毒对上下文模型实现强定向控制且干净精度变化很小；选取真实、标签正确的边界拥挤样本，在偏置比例高达20%时未产生系统性精度下降；简化代理迁移受限PGD在多设置下优于等预算随机噪声，可产生测试时逃逸。
AI.conclusion: 攻击有效性显著取决于操控发生的位置（训练/上下文/测试阶段）以及攻击者改动数据的自由度；干净标签与分布真实的数据选择不一定构成有效威胁，而后门投毒与受限逃逸攻击对表格上下文学习构成实质风险，需针对推理时上下文设计专门防御。

title: ConsisX: Cross-View Consistency Thinking in 3D for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models integrate visual perception and language understanding from vision-language models (VLMs) with action prediction for robotic manipulation. Although multi-view observations provide complementary scene information, VLMs model cross-view interactions based on 2D feature similarity, which can lead to physical inconsistency in the form of cross-view incorrect association between distinct entities and cross-view information fragmentation about the same entity. To address these challenges, we propose ConsisX, a novel VLA framework that integrates cross-view association and entity coherence to enable cross-view consistency thinking in 3D for physically consistent robotic manipulation. Specifically, Cross-View Association Modeling (CAM) is proposed to introduce cross-view spatial proximity constraints in a shared 3D space to reduce cross-view incorrect association. Entity Coherence Organization (ECO) is designed to organize cross-view local information into coherent 3D entity evidence, thereby addressing cross-view information fragmentation. Consistent Action Conditioning (CAC) is introduced to condition action prediction on task-relevant 3D entity evidence for cross-view consistent action execution. Experiments on 3 real-world manipulation tasks and 4 simulation benchmarks establish ConsisX as an effective and competitive framework for robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ConsisX框架，通过在共享3D空间中引入跨视角关联与实体一致性建模，解决VLA模型多视角观测下2D特征相似性导致的物理不一致问题。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型继承VLM的2D特征相似性建模方式，跨视角交互缺乏3D物理约束，导致两类问题：不同实体间的跨视角错误关联，以及同一实体的跨视角信息碎片化，最终造成动作执行的物理不一致。
AI.method: 提出三个模块：1) 跨视角关联建模（CAM），在共享3D空间引入空间邻近约束以减少错误关联；2) 实体一致性组织（ECO），将跨视角局部信息组织为连贯的3D实体证据；3) 一致动作条件化（CAC），以任务相关的3D实体证据为条件进行动作预测。
AI.result: 在3个真实机器人操作任务和4个仿真基准上验证，ConsisX展现出有效且具竞争力的操作性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将跨视角一致性思想从2D特征空间迁移到3D空间，可有效提升VLA模型的物理一致性与操作表现，为多视角机器人操作提供新范式。

title: MMMem: Self-Improving Agents with Task-Aware Multimodal Experience Consolidation
summary: AI agents accumulate conversations, images, and documents through long-term interactions with users. Answering later questions often requires connecting evidence across these records, yet the resulting understanding is rarely retained, allowing mistakes to recur on related questions. Existing multimodal memory methods largely focus on storing and retrieving records, with limited mechanisms for learning from completed tasks and consolidating task-specific experience. We therefore propose MMMem, a task-aware multimodal memory framework that extracts and consolidates experience from completed tasks through four complementary strategies. First, source-linked multi-view memory organizes original text, images, and rendered pages alongside generated scene images that combine clues across records for retrieval. Second, source-generated tasks support knowledge alignment at two levels: warm-up consolidates source knowledge into task-relevant experiences in external memory, while self-training adapts the model's parametric knowledge to task demands. Third, the same vision-language model distills completed tasks into experiences that record the task context, conclusion, and support links. Finally, task-aware retrieval recalls source views and relevant experiences for answering and verification, while source-supported reuse guides long-term retention. Across three memory benchmarks and two vision-language readers, MMMem outperforms eight baselines. With Qwen3.5-9B, MMMem achieves relative gains of 36.9%, 17.6%, and 15.2% over the best-performing baselines on LoCoMo, Mem-Gallery, and LooGLE v2, respectively. Ablations show consistent gains from training and memory warm-up, while case studies illustrate how individual components work in practice.

AI.tldr: MMMem是一个任务感知的多模态记忆框架，通过四种互补策略从已完成任务中提取并巩固经验，在三个记忆基准上超过八个基线，LoCoMo上相对最佳基线提升36.9%。
AI.motivation: AI智能体在长期交互中积累对话、图像与文档，回答后续问题常需跨记录连接证据，但所得理解很少被保留，导致相关问题上错误反复出现。现有方法多聚焦记录的存储与检索，缺乏从完成任务中学习和巩固任务经验（经验固化）的机制。
AI.method: 1) 源链接多视图记忆：组织原始文本、图像、渲染页，并生成融合跨记录线索的场景图像用于检索；2) 源生成任务：暖启动将源知识固化为外部记忆中的任务相关经验，自训练让模型参数知识适配任务需求；3) 由同一视觉语言模型将完成任务蒸馏为经验，记录任务上下文、结论与支撑链接；4) 任务感知检索召回源视图与相关经验用于作答与验证，并以源支撑复用引导长期保留。
AI.result: 在三个记忆基准、两种视觉语言阅读器上优于八个基线；使用Qwen3.5-9B时，在LoCoMo、Mem-Gallery、LooGLE v2上相对最佳基线分别提升36.9%、17.6%、15.2%。消融显示训练与记忆暖启动带来一致增益，案例分析展示各组件实际作用。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆从被动的记录存储与检索扩展为"从任务中学习并巩固经验"的闭环，可有效提升多模态长期记忆问答的准确性与经验复用能力。

title: Frozen by the Mean: Early Temporal Guidance Unfreezes Motion in Video Diffusion Models
summary: Video diffusion models can render convincing frames while failing to produce the requested action. Increasing classifier-free guidance (CFG) can strengthen motion, but also saturates and shifts colors. Scalar CFG assigns the same coefficient to the averaged and frame-varying components of its prediction difference, limiting independent control of temporal variation. THAW, Temporal Harmonic Amplification during Warm-up, retains stock CFG and adds a separately weighted residual during an initial denoising window. Its dose specifies the added norm relative to the current CFG difference, giving the extra guidance a consistent relative budget across sampling steps. THAW is training-free and reuses CFG's two model predictions with an unchanged network evaluation count. It improves cost-matched motion over scalar and scheduled CFG on five video models, with positive point estimates against existing guidance methods on three of them. On VBench, THAW raises dynamic degree by about 14 to 15 points over stock CFG while increasing total scores on a different set of three models.

AI.tldr: THAW（Temporal Harmonic Amplification during Warm-up）是一种免训练的视频扩散引导方法：保留标准 CFG，仅在早期去噪窗口内额外注入一个可单独加权的残差分量，并按相对当前 CFG 差异范数的“剂量”控制强度，从而在不饱和、不偏色的前提下增强运动幅度。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型常能生成可信的画面却未执行所要求的动作；提高 CFG 系数虽能增强运动，但会饱和并导致颜色漂移。根本原因在于标量 CFG 对预测差中的“均值分量”与“帧间变化分量”施加同一系数，无法独立控制时间变化幅度。
AI.method: 将 CFG 预测差解耦为平均分量与帧间变化分量；保持原 CFG 不变，在初始去噪窗口（warm-up）内叠加一个单独加权的残差项，其剂量定义为相对于当前 CFG 差异范数的增量，使额外引导在各采样步上具有一致的相对预算。该方法免训练，复用 CFG 已有的两次模型预测，网络评估次数不变。
AI.result: 在五个视频模型上，THAW 在等算力条件下相较标量 CFG 与调度式 CFG 提升运动表现；在其中三个模型上相对现有引导方法取得正向点估计。VBench 上，THAW 较标准 CFG 将 dynamic degree 提升约 14–15 分，并在另外三个模型上提升总分。
AI.conclusion: 时间维引导应与强度引导解耦，且集中作用于去噪早期阶段最为有效；THAW 以零额外算力代价实现可控运动增强，是现有 CFG 的即插即用替代方案。

title: How Seasonal Reference Choice Changes the Apparent Gains of Chronos Models in Electricity Load Forecasting
summary: When a forecasting model is said to beat a simple baseline, the size of that win depends on which baseline was used. We measure how much this matters for two zero-shot foundation models, Chronos-Bolt and Chronos-2, on hourly electricity load. The study uses 60 fixed cases drawn from eight series in four public collections, with forecasts 24 and 168 hours ahead and up to 2,048 hours of history. Each model is compared with daily persistence, weekly persistence, a weekday hybrid, a daily-weekly blend, and a reference chosen from these on a validation period. We keep every origin-level forecast and estimate uncertainty with paired circular block bootstrap intervals using 168- and 336-hour blocks. A week ahead, Bolt clearly beats weekly persistence in 21 of 30 cases but the validation-selected reference in only 14, and its median gain falls from 17.3% to 11.9%. For Chronos-2 the clear-win counts are 18 and 15. Chronos-2 has lower week-ahead MAE than Bolt in 24 cases, yet only 12 of those differences are clear. The selected reference is not always the harder baseline, since on some test windows it does worse than weekly persistence. The choice of baseline therefore changes both how large the reported gain is and how sure we can be of it. The results are exploratory: the series and windows are related, an earlier pilot was inspected, pretraining overlap cannot be ruled out, and the case-level intervals are not corrected for multiple comparisons.

AI.tldr: 在小时电力负荷零样本预测中，基线选择（日持续/周持续/工作日混合/混合/验证集选参考）显著影响Chronos-Bolt与Chronos-2相对收益的幅度与显著程度：Bolt周前预测对周持续21/30明确胜出、对验证集选定参考仅14/30，中位增益由17.3%降至11.9%。
AI.motivation: "模型击败简单基线"的结论依赖于所用基线的强弱与类型，但文献中很少量化这一依赖对报告增益大小与置信度的影响。作者希望在同一固定实验设计下，检验基线选择对两个零样本基础模型在小时电力负荷预测上表现评估的敏感度。
AI.method: 采用60个固定案例，来自4个公开数据集的8条序列；预测步长24与168小时，历史长度至2048小时。基线包括日持续、周持续、工作日混合、日-周混合，以及基于验证期选出的参考基线。保留每个起点的逐条预测，并用配对循环块自助法（块长168与336小时）估计不确定性，以"明确胜出"计数与中位增益衡量差异。
AI.result: 周前（168h）：Bolt对周持续明确胜出21/30，对验证集参考仅14/30，中位增益从17.3%降至11.9%；Chronos-2对应为18与15。Chronos-2在24个案例中周前MAE低于Bolt，但仅12个差异明确。验证期选出的参考并非总是更难基线，在某些测试窗口上劣于周持续。
AI.conclusion: 基线选择同时改变报告增益的大小与对其确信程度，故基础模型的"击败基线"结论须明确基线定义与不确定性度量。该研究为探索性：序列与窗口相关、已检视过前期试点、无法排除预训练数据重叠、案例级区间未做多重比较校正，结果应谨慎解读。

title: Seeing Together, Acting Apart: Shared Environmental Understanding for Multi-Robot Navigation
summary: Multi-robot embodied systems are typically designed to collaborate by coordinating actions, sharing trajectories, or learning joint policies. We ask a complementary question: can collaboration emerge before decision-making, by first building a shared understanding of the environment? We introduce Shared Environmental Understanding, a policy-agnostic representation that aggregates partial egocentric observations from multiple robots into a shared latent world model. This shifts collaboration from the policy space to the representation space, enabling decentralized decision-making with shared environmental context. To this end, we propose Shared Environment Encoding and Retrieval (SEER), a framework that organizes multi-robot observations into a shared memory, retrieves relevant context via spatio-temporal similarity, and encodes it using a predictive latent world model. The resulting representations are injected into downstream navigation agents as tokens. Experimental results demonstrate that SEER captures action-relevant environmental structure and consistently improves navigation performance across both specialized VLN agents and general vision-language model agents, while preserving single-agent capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出SEER框架：将多机器人部分观测聚合为共享潜在世界模型，把协作从策略空间前移到表征空间，以token注入下游导航智能体，提升VLN与通用VLM智能体导航性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多机器人具身系统多依赖动作协调、轨迹共享或联合策略学习，协作发生在决策层。作者提出互补问题：能否在决策之前，通过先建立对环境的共享理解来实现协作？因此希望将协作从策略空间转移到表征空间，实现带共享环境上下文的去中心化决策。
AI.method: 提出Shared Environment Encoding and Retrieval（SEER）：(1) 将多机器人各自的自我中心部分观测组织进共享记忆；(2) 通过时空相似度检索相关上下文；(3) 用预测性潜在世界模型编码，形成策略无关的共享环境表征（Shared Environmental Understanding）；(4) 以token形式注入下游导航智能体。
AI.result: 实验表明SEER能捕捉与动作相关的环境结构；在专用VLN智能体与通用视觉语言模型智能体上均稳定提升导航性能，同时保持单智能体原有能力。
AI.conclusion: 协作可以在决策前通过共享表征空间涌现，而非仅依赖联合策略；策略无关的共享世界模型是可复用、可插拔的协作载体，为多机器人具身系统提供新范式。

title: MH-RAG-DIVE: Dynamic and Cost-Efficient Multi-Hop RAG Evaluation via Tree-Cached Dialogue Simulation
comment: This preprint was accepted for presentation at the 19th International Conference on Agents and Artificial Intelligence (ICAART27)
summary: Quality assessment is essential for determining whether changes to a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system improve or maintain its performance. However, existing evaluation approaches often rely on single-turn or single-hop interactions and therefore do not capture the complexity of multi-hop, multi-turn conversations. We introduce MH-RAG-DIVE, a dynamic interactive user simulation framework designed to evaluate RAG systems in more complex multi-hop and multi-turn settings. The framework extends RAG-DIVE with a Context Discoverer, which identifies documents that can be combined to generate multi-hop questions within an ongoing conversation. To address the high computational cost of dynamic user simulation, we further introduce a Conversation Cacher, which reuses turns from previous evaluation runs while preserving the dynamic nature of the evaluation. We evaluate the framework across six distinct RAG configurations and compare its results with the original RAG-DIVE evaluation and the static, human-created CLAPNQ dataset. Our experiments show consistent performance trends across the evaluation approaches, while the more complex multi-hop and multi-turn setting exposes additional challenges for RAG systems. Furthermore, the Conversation Cacher substantially reduces token consumption, demonstrating its potential to make dynamic evaluation more cost-efficient. Finally, we apply MH-RAG-DIVE to an industrial RAG system with domain-specific data, demonstrating its applicability to real-world evaluation scenarios. Overall, our results show that the proposed approach provides a more complex and cost-efficient framework for evaluating RAG systems. All code and experimental data are publicly available in our GitHub repository (https://github.com/Daniel-Innsbruck/MH-RAG-DIVE).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MH-RAG-DIVE，一个面向 RAG 系统的动态交互式用户模拟评估框架，通过引入 Context Discoverer 支持多跳、多轮对话评估，并引入 Conversation Cacher 复用历史轮次以降低评估成本；实验验证其在六种 RAG 配置下趋势一致、能暴露更多挑战、显著降低 token 消耗，并在工业场景中验证了实用性。
AI.motivation: 质量评估对判断 RAG 系统改动是否提升或维持性能至关重要，但现有评估方法多依赖单轮或单跳交互，无法刻画多跳、多轮对话的复杂性，因此需要更贴近真实交互场景的评估手段。
AI.method: 在 RAG-DIVE 基础上扩展：1）Context Discoverer，识别可组合生成多跳问题的文档，并在持续对话中构造多跳问题；2）Conversation Cacher，复用此前评估运行的轮次，在保持评估动态性的同时降低动态用户模拟的高计算开销。评测覆盖六种 RAG 配置，并与原始 RAG-DIVE 及静态人工构建的 CLAPNQ 数据集对比，最后应用于领域特定数据的工业 RAG 系统。
AI.result: 不同评估方法得到的性能趋势一致；更复杂的多跳、多轮设定能暴露 RAG 系统的额外挑战；Conversation Cacher 显著降低 token 消耗，提升动态评估的成本效益；在工业领域数据上验证了框架的可适用性。
AI.conclusion: MH-RAG-DIVE 提供了更复杂且更具成本效益的 RAG 评估框架，代码与实验数据已开源，可作为动态多跳多轮评估的实用方案。

title: Contrastive Gradient Guidance for Test-Time Multi-Preference Alignment of Diffusion Models
summary: Aligning pre-trained diffusion models with multiple context-dependent preferences requires adapting generation at test time rather than relying on offline fine-tuning, which requires hyperparameter tuning and a new training run for each preference trade-off. Existing approaches compress diverse preferences into a single scalar reward objective for fine-tuning or test-time guidance rather than directly reusing existing generative experts released for different purposes and obtained through different fine-tuning methods. In this work, we propose Contrastive Gradient Guidance (CGG), a test-time compositional generative framework that reformulates multi-preference alignment as a composition of distributions. CGG represents each preference as a contrastive preference pair of favored experts and unfavored anti-experts, whose score difference forms a contrastive gradient guidance signal that combines denoising directions (gradients) from off-the-shelf diffusion models during sampling. Experiments show that CGG reuses pre-trained and fine-tuned models as favored experts or anti-experts to control output style and safety, and that it can be combined with existing sampling-based reward guidance. With a single fixed scale per pair, CGG composes five preferences at once and gives a more balanced trade-off across text-image preference, concept control, photographic fidelity, and safety than offline fine-tuning, weight-space merging, and reward steering.

AI.tldr: 提出对比梯度引导（CGG），一种测试时组合生成框架，将多偏好对齐重构为分布组合，用“偏好专家—反专家”的分数差构成对比引导信号，在采样中组合现成扩散模型的方向，实现对风格、安全、摄影保真度等多偏好的平衡控制。
AI.motivation: 将预训练扩散模型对齐到多种依赖上下文的偏好，若用离线微调需为每种偏好权衡重新调超参并重训；现有方法把多样偏好压缩为单一标量奖励，且未能直接复用已发布、由不同微调方式得到、用途各异的生成专家。因此需要测试时适配、且能复用现有专家的组合式方法。
AI.method: CGG将每个偏好表示为一对对比偏好：受偏好专家（favored expert）与非偏好反专家（anti-expert）。二者分数之差构成对比梯度引导信号，在采样过程中组合多个现成扩散模型的去噪方向（梯度）；每对仅需一个固定尺度即可同时组合多个偏好，并可与现有基于采样的奖励引导方法叠加。
AI.result: 实验表明CGG可复用预训练与微调模型作为专家或反专家，控制输出风格与安全性，并能与采样阶段的奖励引导结合；在每对固定单一尺度下同时组合五种偏好，在文本—图像偏好、概念控制、摄影保真度与安全性上取得比离线微调、权重空间合并和奖励引导更均衡的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 将多偏好对齐建模为分布的对比式组合，可在测试时无需重训地复用现有生成专家，实现无需逐偏好调参的可扩展、可叠加的偏好控制，在多样偏好间提供更均衡的权衡。

title: One Checkpoint, Four Converters: Per Input Disagreement After On Device Conversion and a Probe Set That Catches It
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Also archived on Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24433993
summary: A model converted for on device or accelerated inference ships once its top 1 accuracy matches the source model. Accuracy can match while individual decisions change, and the converter, its INT8 recipe and its calibration draw each move them. We convert 5 public checkpoints (four ImageNet classifiers and a sentiment model) with the documented FP32 and INT8 recipes of ExecuTorch, LiteRT, ONNX Runtime and TensorRT and compare every top 1 decision with the PyTorch source on 7,854 images and 1,938 sentences. All 34 strict FP32 conversions reproduce every decision, yet each of the 4 vision INT8 recipes that keeps accuracy equivalent flips more than 1% of decisions: ONNX Runtime static INT8 flips 4.07% (95% CI [3.65, 4.53]) of ResNet 50 decisions while accuracy moves by -0.15 points, and two builds of that recipe from different calibration draws disagree on 3.44% [3.06, 3.88]. Where accuracy is kept, the flipped inputs are the ones the source model barely decides (AUROC of the source margin 0.90 to 0.97 on ResNet 50, every 95% CI inside [0.89, 0.98]), but our preregistered claim that this holds for every recipe fails on the two mobile networks, where INT8 breaks accuracy outright. A probe set of the 200 training inputs with the smallest source margin, chosen before any conversion, flags all 40 vision stacks (recall 95% CI [0.91, 1.00]) and all 6 text stacks that flip at least 0.5% of decisions and none of the exact FP32 conversions, so conversion checks should compare decisions on such a probe set, not accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文实证表明：模型转换后 top-1 准确率持平并不代表决策一致；即使精度等价，INT8 转换仍会翻转超过 1% 的决策，且翻转集中在源模型低置信度样本上，因此转换校验应在“低 margin 探针集”上比较决策而非准确率。
AI.motivation: 当前边缘/加速推理部署的验收标准是转换后模型 top-1 准确率与源模型一致即视为合格，但准确率持平可能与单个决策改变并存，且转换器、INT8 量化配方与校准抽样各自都会引入决策漂移。作者希望量化这种“精度等价下的决策不一致”程度，并给出可操作的校验替代方案。
AI.method: 选取 5 个公开 checkpoint（4 个 ImageNet 分类器 + 1 个情感分类模型），使用 ExecuTorch、LiteRT、ONNX Runtime、TensorRT 的官方 FP32 与 INT8 配方进行转换；在 7,854 张图像与 1,938 条句子上逐一比对 top-1 决策与 PyTorch 源模型；统计翻转率及 95% 置信区间，使用源模型 margin 的 AUROC 检验翻转样本是否集中于低置信度输入，并预注册了探针集实验（取源 margin 最小的 200 个训练输入）。
AI.result: 34 个严格 FP32 转换全部逐决策复现；4 个保持精度等价的视觉 INT8 配方均翻转超过 1% 决策——ONNX Runtime 静态 INT8 在 ResNet-50 上翻转 4.07% [3.65, 4.53]，而准确率仅变化 −0.15 个百分点；同一配方不同校准抽样两次构建的结果互相不一致达 3.44% [3.06, 3.88]。源 margin 对翻转样本的 AUROC 在 ResNet-50 上为 0.90–0.97（各 95% CI 落在 [0.89, 0.98]），但预注册的“该规律适用于所有配方”假设在两个移动网络上不成立（其 INT8 直接损失准确率）。200 样本探针集以召回 95% CI [0.91, 1.00] 标记出全部 40 个视觉栈与全部 6 个翻转≥0.5% 的文本栈，且未误报任何精确 FP32 转换。
