AI.tldr: 本文提出 CivilCADBench，一个面向土木工程图纸集的理解、重建与设计基准，基于真实工程图纸及源 CAD 文件（超过 25 万个 CAD 实体）。基准包含三大类难度递进的任务，用确定性评分器在几何、图层、文本和标注维度上对比模型输出与设计源文件。评估七个前沿多模态大模型发现：其读取与重绘打印内容较准确，但文件结构恢复能力差。
AI.motivation: 土木基础设施依赖工程图纸集进行设计、建造与维护，但图纸的准备与修订劳动密集，亟需自动化。多模态大语言模型（MLLM）是有潜力的候选方案，但缺乏根植于真实工程实践的评测基准；与参数化三维 CAD 模型不同，工程图纸密集、分层、多图纸，且打印是损失性投影、无图层的像素痕迹，导致"打印正确但组织错误"的隐蔽问题，现有基准难以覆盖。
AI.method: 构建 CivilCADBench 基准：数据来源为真实基础设施图纸与源 CAD 文件（超 250,000 个 CAD 实体）。设置三类难度递增任务：(1) 理解任务，采用 2,183 道经专家审核的问题，覆盖单张图纸到整套图纸；(2) 重建任务，为智能体式任务，要求模型将打印页面重建为可编辑 CAD 文件（单页或整套图纸）；(3) 设计任务，要求生成新设计。任务覆盖 232 页、28 套图纸、19 个设计任务，并由确定性评分器在几何、图层、文本、尺寸标注四方面与设计师源文件逐项比对评分。评估对象为七个前沿 MLLM。
AI.result: 七个前沿 MLLM 能较准确地读取和重绘打印内容，但文件结构恢复能力较差：最佳模型在理解任务和单页重建任务上得分超过 90%，而图层分配仅约 60%，设计任务仅 48%。
AI.conclusion: CivilCADBench 扎根真实工程实践，同时揭示了前沿模型在专业土木工程中的能力与局限，为下一代模型及面向智能土木工程的智能体系统奠定评测基础。

title: Model Immunization Cannot Reliably Protect Models from Harmful Adaptation
summary: Efficient fine-tuning techniques have substantially reduced the cost of adapting open-weight models, enabling malicious actors to readily fine-tune them toward harmful capabilities. In response, model immunization modifies a pretrained checkpoint to resist subsequent adaptation toward designated harmful capabilities while preserving its utility and adaptability for benign tasks. Furthermore, a few immunization methods have sought to keep their protection robust to some changes in the attacker's adaptation. However, fine-tuning offers attackers many more low-cost options, and we observe that existing methods still substantially overfit to the attacker configuration they are optimized against. Such overfitting stays hidden when immunization is evaluated under, or near, this configuration, so the reported protection may give a false sense of security. To rigorously evaluate model immunization, we conduct experiments, varying one component of this configuration at a time: the harmful data, the adaptation strategy, or the model initialization. Across four immunization methods on text-to-image generation and image classification, with additional results on language models, these variations substantially degrade the protection, and in many cases the immunized model relearns the harmful capability nearly as well as the un-immunized model. Existing immunization therefore cannot reliably protect models, leaving them vulnerable to harmful adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示现有"模型免疫"方法对攻击者微调配置存在严重过拟合，一旦改变有害数据、适配策略或模型初始化，保护效果显著下降甚至失效。
AI.motivation: 高效微调大幅降低了开放权重模型被恶意适配到有害能力的成本。现有模型免疫（immunization）方法虽声称能在保留良性效用的同时抵御有害适配，但其评估大多在或接近被优化的攻击配置下进行，可能掩盖过拟合，给出虚假的安全感。作者因此希望更严格地评估免疫的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 对攻击者配置进行受控的单因素消融：分别改变（1）有害数据、（2）适配/微调策略、（3）模型初始化，在文生图生成与图像分类任务上评估四种免疫方法，并在语言模型上补充实验。
AI.result: 上述任一维度的变化都会显著削弱免疫保护；在许多情况下，被免疫的模型重新学到有害能力的程度几乎与未经免疫的原始模型相当。跨四种方法、跨两类视觉任务及语言模型结论一致。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型免疫无法可靠地保护模型，模型仍易受有害适配攻击；领域需要针对攻击配置变化更具鲁棒性的免疫方法，并按更严格的评估协议报告保护效果。

title: LLM-Guided Compositional Continual Learning for Robot Manipulation with Gated Low-Rank Experts
summary: General-purpose manipulation robots must acquire new skills over time without forgetting prior ones or retraining from scratch. We present a continual learning framework that represents each skill as a dedicated expert sub- network in a Progressive Neural Network (PNN). New tasks reuse prior knowledge through low-rank adaptation (LoRA) modules on lateral connections controlled by learnable per-parent gates, enabling explicit attenuation of individual transfer paths while reducing the parameter cost of dense PNN laterals. For long-horizon deployment, a frozen local large language model decomposes natural-language instructions into sub-tasks, routes them to suitable experts, and requests a new expert only when the library is insufficient. Using a shared task-space action interface, we evaluate the framework on twelve MetaWorld tasks and in a Sawyer-to-Panda-to-UR5e cross-embodiment transfer experiment, showing improved task success relative to learning from scratch when demonstrations are limited. Real-robot manipulation experiments further demonstrate that the proposed framework supports compositional execution and expert orchestration.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向通用操作机器人的持续学习框架：在渐进神经网络(PNN)中为每项技能配置独立专家子网络，用带可学习门控的LoRA侧向连接复用先验知识，并由冻结的本地大模型做任务分解与专家路由，实现长期部署下的组合式操作。
AI.motivation: 通用操作机器人需随时间不断获取新技能，同时不能遗忘旧技能、也不能从头重训。现有渐进式网络虽能避免遗忘，但稠密侧向连接参数开销大、且难以单独调节各迁移路径；同时缺乏长时序部署下的任务分解与专家调度机制。
AI.method: 1) 以PNN结构将每个技能表示为专用专家子网络，实现无遗忘的增量学习；2) 将侧向连接用LoRA低秩适配模块参数化，并引入可学习的per-parent门控，显式衰减单条迁移路径、降低稠密侧向参数成本；3) 部署阶段用冻结的本地LLM将自然语言指令分解为子任务，路由至合适专家，仅在专家库不足时请求新建专家；4) 通过共享任务空间动作接口统一不同任务与本体。
AI.result: 在12个MetaWorld任务上及Sawyer→Panda→UR5e跨本体迁移实验中，相比从头学习取得更高的任务成功率，尤其在演示数据有限时优势明显；真机操作实验进一步验证了框架支持组合式执行与专家编排。
AI.conclusion: 将PNN式专家增长、LoRA+门控侧向迁移与LLM驱动的任务分解/专家路由结合，可在低参数成本下实现无遗忘的持续技能获取，并支撑长时序、跨本体的组合式机器人操作部署。

title: Beyond the Black Box: A Diagnosis-Driven Agent for Interpretable MIP Solver Tuning
summary:
Tuning a mixed-integer programming (MIP) solver is an instance-specific problem, where a poor configuration can increase solving time by orders of magnitude.
  Existing Bayesian optimization tuners treat solver tuning as a black-box optimization problem: each evaluation returns a single score, allowing the tuner to learn which configuration is faster, but not why.
  Inspired by the use of profilers in GPU-kernel optimization, we introduce APEC (Agent for Per-instance Explainable Configuration), a log-grounded tuning agent for MIP solvers.
  APEC has three layers: a deterministic layer that profiles each log, an interpretation layer that guides hypothesis-driven diagnosis, and a system layer that controls evaluation, enabling more reliable and interpretable solver tuning.
  On the full MIPLIB 2017 benchmark set, APEC achieves a 1.58X improvement over the default configuration with over 38% fewer parameter changes than the baselines, making the results easier to read.

AI.tldr: APEC是一个基于求解日志的MIP求解器配置调优智能体，通过"确定性日志剖析—解释性诊断—系统评估控制"三层结构实现可解释的逐实例调优，在MIPLIB 2017全集上相较默认配置取得1.58倍加速，且参数改动数比基线少38%以上。
AI.motivation: MIP求解器调优是强实例相关的问题，糟糕配置可使求解时间增加数量级。现有贝叶斯优化调优器将调优视为黑箱优化：每次评估仅返回单一分数，只能学到"哪个配置更快"，而无法解释"为什么更快"，导致结果难以解读、参数改动多、可迁移性与可信度不足。
AI.method: 受GPU内核优化中profiler的启发，提出APEC日志驱动的调优智能体，包含三层：(1) 确定性层，对每条求解日志进行剖析（profiling），提取结构化特征与瓶颈信号；(2) 解释层，基于剖析结果进行假设驱动的诊断，指导参数选择方向；(3) 系统层，负责评估与搜索过程控制，提升调优的可靠性与可解释性。
AI.result: 在MIPLIB 2017完整基准集上，APEC相对默认配置实现1.58倍加速；同时参数改动数量较基线减少38%以上，使调优结果更易阅读与理解。
AI.conclusion: 将"日志剖析+假设驱动诊断"引入求解器调优，可在取得优于黑箱贝叶斯优化的性能同时显著降低配置复杂度，说明可解释性与调优效率并不矛盾，为逐实例的MIP求解器自动调优提供了新范式。

title: KineState-SWAM: A Surgical World Action Model with Explicit Kinematics and Causal Interaction Dynamics
summary: Existing surgical world models often leave implicit how instrument motion drives localized tissue responses and how interaction history informs subsequent actions. We introduce KineState-SWAM, a surgical world-action model coupling action prediction and video generation through a persistent interaction state, separating kinematically determined instrument motion from learned scene evolution. A flow-matching policy predicts joint trajectories conditioned on interaction state, robot configuration, and task instruction. Kinematic Geometry Conditioning converts these trajectories into surface-motion tokens and spatially aligned instrument renderings using calibrated URDF kinematics. Causal Interaction Dynamics recurrently updates the state through geometry-guided attention and motion-aligned feature transport, carrying interaction history into subsequent action predictions without intermediate video synthesis. The State-Geometry Adapter combines state-dependent spatial modulation with localized geometric residuals to guide video generation. Interaction-aware supervision emphasizes tissue responses near instrument working regions. We introduce dVRK-Chole5.2k, comprising 5,255 videos spanning 17 surgical tasks. Experiments demonstrate improved action accuracy and video fidelity over evaluated baselines within matched action-conditioning settings. Ablations support preserving and transporting interaction states for long-horizon prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出 KineState-SWAM，一种通过持久交互状态耦合动作预测与视频生成的手术世界-动作模型，将运动学决定的器械运动与学习到的场景演化分离，并以显式几何条件与因果状态更新提升长时程预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有手术世界模型对器械运动如何驱动局部组织响应、以及交互历史如何影响后续动作缺少显式建模，二者常被隐式处理。
AI.method: 1) 流匹配策略以交互状态、机器人构型与任务指令为条件预测关节轨迹；2) Kinematic Geometry Conditioning 借助标定 URDF 运动学将轨迹转换为表面运动 token 与空间对齐的器械渲染；3) Causal Interaction Dynamics 通过几何引导注意力与运动对齐特征传输递归更新状态，在无中间视频合成的情况下将历史注入动作预测；4) State-Geometry Adapter 以状态相关空间调制与局部几何残差引导视频生成；5) 交互感知监督聚焦器械工作区域附近的组织响应；并构建 dVRK-Chole5.2k 数据集（5,255 段视频，17 项任务）。
AI.result: 在动作条件匹配的设置下，动作精度与视频保真度均优于所评估基线；消融实验表明保留并传输交互状态对长时程预测有增益。
AI.conclusion: 显式的运动学几何条件与持久交互状态是提升手术世界-动作模型可解释性与长时程预测能力的有效途径。

title: When Source-Domain Validation Fails to Transfer: A Staged Study of Hyperparameter Selection
comment: 25 pages, 2 figures. Expanded version of work accepted to the AAAI-27 Student Abstract and Poster Program
summary: Hyperparameters for an unseen domain are often selected using held-out examples from the available source domains. Withholding entire source domains during validation seems to better reflect deployment shift, but does this produce better selections on independent targets? We investigate this question through two complementary studies. A preliminary factorial experiment crosses particle swarm optimization and random search with pooled source validation and a leave-one-source-domain-out mean-minimum fitness on PACS and Multi-Domain Sentiment. The domain-aware fitness does not provide a consistent target advantage. We then separate selector development from confirmation using a shared pool of 64 configurations per task across four image benchmarks. Complete target-performance landscapes on VLCS and Office-Home inform one rule: retain the top 16 configurations by pooled source validation, then select the largest leave-one-source-domain-out mean-minus-standard-deviation score. The rule is frozen before evaluation on TerraIncognita and SVIRO. Across their 14 target domains, its equal-dataset-weighted balanced-accuracy difference from pooled validation is +0.097 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-0.685, +0.960]), with five wins and nine losses. Exploratory analyses reveal substantial variation across datasets, target domains, and training seeds. These results do not establish equivalence or a general failure of domain-aware validation. They show that the evaluated source-domain criteria did not establish reliable target gains under the tested protocols, and motivate assessing selection rules on datasets independent of those used to develop them.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验"留一源域"式域感知验证准则能否比池化源域验证带来更可靠的跨域目标性能选择增益，结论是未观察到稳定优势。
AI.motivation: 超参数通常用源域留出样本选择，而完全留出一整个源域做验证更贴近部署时的分布偏移，但尚不清楚这种域感知准则是否真的能在独立目标域上选出更优配置。
AI.method: 分两阶段：① 在 PACS 与 Multi-Domain Sentiment 上做析因实验，交叉粒子群优化/随机搜索与"池化源域验证"/"留一源域均值—最小值适应度"；② 将选择规则开发与确认分离，在每任务 64 个配置的共享池上，用 VLCS 与 Office-Home 的完整目标性能景观导出规则（先按池化验证保留前 16，再取留一源域均值减标准差最大者），冻结后在 TerraIncognita 与 SVIRO 上评估。
AI.result: 冻结规则在 14 个目标域上相对池化验证的等数据集加权平衡准确率差为 +0.097 个百分点，95% bootstrap 区间 [-0.685, +0.960]，5 胜 9 负；探索性分析显示不同数据集、目标域与训练种子间差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 结果既不能证明两者等价，也不能断言域感知验证普遍失效；仅表明所评估的源域准则在测试协议下未建立可靠的目标增益，并强调选择规则应在与开发无关的独立数据集上检验。

title: Coordinating Perception and Planning for Test-Time Adaptation in End-to-End Driving under Distribution Shifts
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving has achieved significant milestones, yet its reliance on the i.i.d. assumption renders it vulnerable to real-world distribution shifts. While Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) offers a promising paradigm for on-the-fly enhancement, its application to driving is hindered by two barriers: (i) multi-task adaptation dependency, where updates to upstream perception also affect downstream planning, while perception confidence alone does not directly assess these downstream effects; and (ii) continuous adaptation instability, where recursive online updates over long horizons cause compounding parameter drift. To address these challenges, we propose P2-TTA, a plug-and-play TTA framework for the continual adaptation of end-to-end driving models. P2-TTA coordinates adaptation through a joint objective combining perception entropy minimization with a retrospective temporal planning consistency objective derived from observed ego motion. To stabilize online updates, we use an EMA teacher as a moving parameter reference and reject candidate updates that increase historical planning loss. Extensive experiments across multiple models demonstrate that, by updating an average of 0.11 per mille of parameters with an average adaptation time of 19.9 ms on different backbones, P2-TTA achieves average recovery rates of 36.4%, 30.0%, and 9.3% for L2, collision rate, and PDMS, respectively, under severe distribution shifts. Under a shared perception-planning objective, P2-TTA achieves the highest L2 and collision recovery among the compared TTA baselines on UniAD.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用的测试时自适应框架P2-TTA，通过感知熵最小化与回溯式时序规划一致性联合优化，并借助EMA教师与更新拒绝机制抑制长时程参数漂移，在严重分布偏移下以极小开销（约0.11‰参数、19.9 ms）恢复端到端驾驶性能。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶依赖i.i.d.假设，现实中分布偏移下性能脆弱；现有TTA直接迁移到驾驶任务存在两大障碍：（1）多任务自适应依赖性——上游感知更新会传导至下游规划，而仅凭感知置信度无法评估该下游影响；（2）连续自适应不稳定性——长时程递归在线更新导致参数漂移累积。
AI.method: P2-TTA采用联合目标：感知端做熵最小化，规划端利用自车运动构建回溯式时序规划一致性目标；以EMA教师作为滑动参数参考，并拒绝使历史规划损失上升的候选更新（更新过滤），实现稳定在线自适应。
AI.result: 多骨干、多模型实验显示：平均仅更新0.11‰参数、平均自适应耗时19.9 ms；严重分布偏移下L2、碰撞率、PDMS平均恢复率分别为36.4%、30.0%、9.3%；在UniAD上以共享感知-规划目标取得对比基线中最高的L2与碰撞恢复。
AI.conclusion: 将感知不确定性最小化与基于自车运动的规划一致性约束耦合，并配合EMA参考与历史损失拒绝机制，可在极低计算与参数开销下缓解端到端驾驶模型的分布偏移退化，且具即插即用性。

title: Uncovering Hidden Behaviours in Language Models via Limited-Parameter Finetuning
comment: Published at NeurIPS 2026. 53 pages, 19 figures, 6 tables
summary: Large language models can have behaviours which only arise in hard-to-anticipate contexts. These hidden behaviours pose a challenge to alignment audits, which seek to uncover problematic model behaviour but are limited by the scenarios the auditor can anticipate. To address this challenge, we explore limited-parameter finetuning (LPF) on examples of a target behaviour. While training 3-25% of LoRA parameters, LPF reveals whether the model has a hidden behaviour, even when standard behavioural evaluations cannot. LPF succeeds on a suite of model organisms with hidden behaviours (8-14B parameters), and also surfaces naturally occurring hidden behaviours in open-weight models (27-35B parameters). LPF can thus distinguish between models which appear behaviourally identical to an auditor, and does not require the context in which the hidden behaviour surfaces. LPF provides a novel affordance that may be useful for auditing frontier AI models. However, we do not evaluate LPF against baselines in a realistic auditing setting, so further work is needed to determine its practicality.

AI.tldr: 有限参数微调（LPF）能够揭示仅在难以预料的情境中出现、标准行为评估无法发现的大模型隐藏行为。
AI.motivation: 大模型存在仅在难以预料情境下才显现的隐藏行为，而对齐审计受限于审计者能预想到的场景，因此需要一种不依赖激发情境即可探测隐藏行为的方法。
AI.method: 在对齐审计中采用有限参数微调（LPF）：仅训练3–25%的LoRA参数，在目标行为的示例上做微调，以探测模型是否具备该隐藏行为。
AI.result: LPF在一组带有隐藏行为的模型生物体（8–14B参数）上成功，并在开放权重模型（27–35B参数）中发现了自然出现的隐藏行为；在标准行为评估失效时仍可奏效，且能区分在审计者看来行为一致的模型。
AI.conclusion: LPF为前沿AI模型审计提供了新能力，但尚未在真实审计场景中与基线方法对比，其实际可行性仍需进一步研究。

title: SENSA: Visual-to-Brain Generation with Individualized Subject-State Transfer and Adaptation
summary:
Visual-to-brain encoding predicts neural responses to visual stimuli, supporting visual cognition research and neural decoding. However, challenges in disentangling shared from image-specific activity, together with inter-subject distribution shifts and representational heterogeneity, limit accurate encoding and cross-subject generalization with limited calibration data.
  We introduce SENSA, a structured continuous neural response generation framework that separates shared activity from image-dependent responses and calibrates a compact subject state. An independent response prior captures shared activity, while complementary visual descriptors drive separable sensor-time bases and a shared Response Refiner. Subject-Adaptive Factor Transport adjusts the spatiotemporal expression of shared bases, while Source-Grounded Residual Memory predicts image-dependent corrections in source-response coordinates. Together, they personalize a frozen generator using limited paired support.
  Experiments demonstrate that the generation backbone outperforms recent generators across three datasets, with image-identity perturbations confirming stimulus specificity. Using only 400 paired images, electroencephalography (EEG) and the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD) calibration achieve residual Pearson correlations of 0.1091 and 0.2995, respectively, demonstrating effective brain-response generation and cross-subject adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出SENSA——一种结构化连续神经响应生成框架，通过分离共享活动与图像特异响应、并以少量配对数据校准紧凑被试状态，实现准确的视觉到大脑编码与跨被试泛化。
AI.motivation: 视觉到大脑编码虽支撑视觉认知研究与神经解码，但存在三大瓶颈：共享活动与图像特异活动难以解耦、被试间分布偏移、表征异质性，导致在有限校准数据下编码精度低、跨被试泛化差。
AI.method: SENSA由四部分构成：(1) 独立响应先验捕获共享活动；(2) 互补视觉描述子驱动可分离的传感器-时间基，并共享一个Response Refiner；(3) Subject-Adaptive Factor Transport调整共享基的时空表达，实现被试个性化；(4) Source-Grounded Residual Memory在源响应坐标中预测图像依赖的残差修正。整体以冻结生成器为基础，仅用少量配对支撑数据完成个性化。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上，生成主干优于近期生成器；图像身份扰动实验验证了刺激特异性。仅用400张配对图像校准时，EEG与NSD上的残差Pearson相关分别达到0.1091与0.2995。
AI.conclusion: 通过"共享先验+被试自适应因子传输+源坐标残差记忆"的结构化分解，SENSA有效缓解了共享/特异活动纠缠与跨被试分布偏移问题，在极少校准数据下实现了有效的脑响应生成与跨被试适应。

title: World Models Are the Right Foundation for Simulating Mars Terraforming
summary: Terraforming Mars is a long-horizon, action-conditioned control problem that requires predicting atmospheric responses to interventions over centuries to identify effective policies. This position paper argues that physics-regularized recurrent state-space world models are the most promising foundation for this setting. Data-driven climate emulators lack action-conditioning, and physics-based general circulation models (GCMs) are too expensive for policy search. Among learned world models, recurrent state-space architectures with physics constraints are better suited than transformer-based alternatives: they provide native uncertainty quantification through their stochastic-deterministic decomposition, remain stable under sparse non-terrestrial training data, and enforce physical consistency at each rollout step. To make this position concrete, we describe a potential architecture combining JEPA-inspired latent encoding, universal differential equation constraints, and a Dreamer-lineage planning head. We also introduce MarsWorld, an open benchmark proposal for intervention-conditioned planetary world models, and discuss broader implications and objections.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张"物理正则化的循环状态空间世界模型"（physics-regularized recurrent state-space world models）是火星地球化这类长周期、动作条件化控制问题最有前途的基础框架，并给出一个候选架构与开放基准提案 MarsWorld。
AI.motivation: 火星地球化需要预测大气对干预措施长达数百年的响应，以筛选有效政策。现有两条路线各有硬伤：数据驱动的气候模拟器缺少动作条件化（无法回答"若施加某干预会怎样"）；物理基大气环流模式（GCM）计算代价过高，无法支撑策略搜索。因此需要一个既能动作条件化、又能长程稳定推演、且成本可控的模型范式。
AI.method: 纯论证型立场论文，无实验。核心论证：在已学习世界模型中，循环状态空间架构优于 Transformer 类方案，理由有三——(1) 通过随机-确定性分解（stochastic-deterministic decomposition）提供原生不确定性量化；(2) 在稀疏的非地球训练数据下更稳定；(3) 可在每个 rollout 步施加物理一致性约束。据此提出候选架构：JEPA 式潜变量编码 + 通用微分方程（UDE）约束 + Dreamer 系规划头。
AI.result: 无实证结果。产出为：一个具体的候选架构设计描述，以及 MarsWorld——面向"干预条件化行星世界模型"的开放基准提案；并讨论了更广泛的影响与可能的反驳意见。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为物理正则化的循环状态空间世界模型是火星地球化的最佳建模基座，呼吁社区围绕 MarsWorld 基准开展标准化评测；但该立场尚缺乏实验验证，属待检验的假设而非结论。

title: Place-Revisit Consistency Evaluation of Reference Poses
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 1 table, LBS 2026 Nanjing China
summary: Reference trajectories are widely used to evaluate odometry and simultaneous localization and mapping systems. However, local inconsistencies in benchmark reference poses can bias such evaluations. This paper presents a place-revisit consistency evaluation method for reference poses in mobile sensing datasets. When a platform revisits a previously observed place after a sufficient temporal gap, the relative pose implied by the reference trajectory should agree with relative poses estimated directly from onboard sensors. We instantiate this idea with lidar scan registration and stereo-image pose estimation, and apply it to the KITTI Odometry and SNAIL Radar. The KITTI analysis identifies several revisit regions where the public reference poses disagree with sensor-derived relative poses, with median translation discrepancies up to 6.60 m. Representative point-cloud overlays further localize these discrepancies and support the use of place revisits as a benchmark-validation tool.

AI.tldr: 提出地点重访一致性评估方法，用于检验移动感知数据集参考轨迹中的局部不一致，并在KITTI与SNAIL Radar数据集上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 里程计与SLAM系统评估广泛依赖参考轨迹，但基准参考位姿中的局部不一致会系统性偏置评估结果，现有评估流程缺乏对参考轨迹本身质量的检验手段。
AI.method: 基于“平台在足够时间间隔后重访同一地点时，参考轨迹隐含的相对位姿应与机载传感器直接估计的相对位姿一致”这一假设，实例化两种传感器相对位姿估计方式：激光雷达扫描配准与双目图像位姿估计，并应用于KITTI Odometry与SNAIL Radar数据集。
AI.result: KITTI分析识别出多个重访区域，其公开参考位姿与传感器导出的相对位姿不一致，平移偏差中位数最高达6.60 m；代表性点云叠加可视化进一步定位了这些偏差位置。
AI.conclusion: 地点重访可作为基准验证工具，用于检测并定位参考轨迹的局部不一致，提升里程计与SLAM评估的可靠性。

title: How Many Parameters Does Forecasting Need? A Survey and Code-Level Audit of Lightweight Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
summary: Long-term time series forecasting supports decisions in energy, transportation, weather and finance, where forecasts are produced continuously and often on constrained hardware. Recent work has moved in two directions. One scales Transformers and pre-trained foundation models to millions or hundreds of millions of parameters. The other shows that models with only hundreds to tens of thousands of parameters remain competitive on the standard benchmarks. Existing surveys organize forecasting models by backbone and treat efficiency as a side topic, so the reasons these small models work, and the way their sizes are reported, remain unexamined. This survey focuses on lightweight long-term forecasting. It provides a taxonomy of about thirty-five models in six families, with a common notation and an architecture diagram for each core model. It offers a structured-linear view in which the smallest models are linear maps restricted by frequency truncation or period folding, and it tests each restriction in closed form on eight benchmarks. It complements the literature review with an audit of sixteen official code repositories, which reproduces published parameter counts and reveals reporting gaps of up to 289 times. Finally, it gives practical guidance on model selection and reporting, and summarizes open problems.

AI.tldr: 该综述聚焦轻量级长期时间序列预测，提出六大家族、约35个模型的分类体系，给出"结构化线性"视角（最小模型为受频率截断/周期折叠约束的线性映射），并在八个基准上以闭式形式检验各约束；同时审计十六个官方代码库，复现参数报告并发现最高达289倍的报告差距，最后给出选型与报告规范建议及开放问题。
AI.motivation: 长期预测需在资源受限硬件上持续运行，而现有研究呈两极分化：一端将Transformer与预训练基础模型扩展至百万乃至上亿参数，另一端表明仅数百至数万参数的小模型在标准基准上仍具竞争力。既有综述按骨干网络组织模型、把效率当作附带话题，因而"小模型为何有效"及其参数规模报告方式均未被审视。
AI.method: (1) 建立约35个模型、六大家族的分类体系，统一符号并为每个核心模型配架构图；(2) 提出结构化线性视角，将最小模型解释为受频率截断或周期折叠限制的线性映射，并在八个基准上以闭式解逐一检验这些限制；(3) 对十六个官方代码仓库进行实证审计，复现已发表的参数计数以核对报告一致性。
AI.result: 闭式检验表明，频率截断与周期折叠等结构化约束足以解释小模型在标准基准上的竞争力；代码库审计成功复现已发表参数计数，并揭示不同工作间参数报告口径存在最高289倍的差距。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级长期预测的有效性可归因于结构化线性映射，参数量报告缺乏统一口径导致跨工作比较失真；论文据此提出模型选择与参数报告的实践建议，并总结该方向尚未解决的问题。

title: Eidetic Code World Model
summary: Executable code can preserve a world's structural layout, yet video renderers frequently alter the appearance of previously visited places once they leave the camera view. We present Paintress, a code-conditioned world model that couples an executable geometric proxy with an independently parameterized 3D Gaussian appearance memory in a shared metric coordinate frame. While the proxy enforces structural and visibility constraints, 3D Gaussians capture the visual realization synthesized by emitted observations. To balance stable incremental fusion with consistent readout, Paintress separates writing from reading: newly emitted frames update a persistent raw Gaussian map under confidence-gated selection, whereas a cloned reader copy is globally refined against the observation archive and rendered with coverage masks to condition generation. We also introduce Expedition-33, a benchmark for generated-appearance retention across 11 static scenes, five route families, and 15, 30, and 60 s target absences (165 settings per system). Excluded from the opening image, targets are synthesized during a shared prefix and scored against each system's own first visit at matched return cameras. Across ten systems (1,650 videos), Paintress achieves 0.1220 ROI-LPIPS, 0.0613 MAE, and 52.12% detail retention (vs. 0.2731, 0.1401, and 10.91% for CWM), with lower discrepancy at 60 s (0.1630) than CWM, AgentGarten, and Lyra 2.0 achieve at 15 s.

AI.tldr: Paintress 是一个代码条件的可交互世界模型：以可执行几何代理强制结构与可见性约束，并用独立参数化的 3D 高斯外观记忆捕捉视觉实现；通过“写—读分离”机制（置信门控增量融合 + 克隆读取端全局精修与覆盖掩码渲染）解决回访场景外观漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 可执行代码虽能保持世界的结构布局，但视频渲染器在场景离开相机视角后往往会改变已访问地点的外观，导致回访时的外观不一致（appearance retention 失败）。作者希望让生成式世界模型在长时间缺席后重返同一地点时仍能忠实还原首次观察到的外观。
AI.method: 1) 在共享度量坐标系中耦合可执行几何代理（负责结构/可见性约束）与独立参数化的 3D 高斯外观记忆（负责视觉实现）；2) 写-读分离：新生成帧在置信门控下对持久原始高斯地图做增量融合（写入），另设克隆的读取副本，针对观测档案做全局精修，并以覆盖掩码渲染以条件化生成（读取）；3) 构建 Expedition-33 基准：11 个静态场景 × 5 类路线族 × 15/30/60 s 目标缺席时长，共 165 种设置/系统；目标不出现于首帧，在共享前缀中合成，并在匹配的回访相机位姿上与系统自身首访结果比对评分。
AI.result: 在 10 个系统、1,650 段视频的评测中，Paintress 取得 ROI-LPIPS 0.1220、MAE 0.0613、细节保持率 52.12%；对比 CWM 的 0.2731、0.1401、10.91%。且 Paintress 在 60 s 缺席下的差异（0.1630）仍低于 CWM、AgentGarten、Lyra 2.0 在 15 s 时的水平。
AI.conclusion: 将结构约束与世界外观记忆解耦、并分离增量写入与一致性读取，可显著提升生成式世界模型对已访问场景外观的保持能力；在长时缺席下 Paintress 的退化速率明显慢于现有系统，说明外观记忆的持久性与读出一致性是回访保真度的关键。

title: Safe Quantum Stochastic Linear Bandits
summary: We initiate the study of safe quantum stochastic linear bandits, in which a learner maximizes an unknown linear reward while satisfying unknown linear mean constraints at every interaction. Under coherent unitary access to the joint reward-and-constraint distribution, we develop QRS-COLTS, a staged quantum resampled-scaling analog of constrained linear Thompson sampling (COLTS). With high probability, QRS-COLTS plays only feasible actions and achieves regret that is polylogarithmic in the query horizon and scales only with the square root of the number of constraints. We also study a model in which the learner queries superpositions of actions while an unsafe-action flag, a "bomb" that terminates the interaction upon violation, is measured after every query. In this setting, the bomb provides exact membership access to the safe set, and query regret is evaluated over the action superposition. For this model, we propose BCO-QLinTS, which selects feasible actions via bomb-certified quantum convex optimization without estimating the constraint matrix. Its query-weighted regret remains polylogarithmic in the horizon, with the constraints entering the bound only through the geometry of the safe set.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次研究安全量子随机线性赌博机（safe quantum stochastic linear bandits）：在每次交互都需满足未知线性均值约束的前提下最大化未知线性奖励。作者在相干幺正访问联合奖励与约束分布的条件下提出QRS-COLTS，实现仅以查询时域多对数增长、且随约束数平方根缩放的遗憾；在“炸弹”反馈模型下提出BCO-QLinTS，其查询加权遗憾同样为多对数级。
AI.motivation: 经典安全/约束线性赌博机与量子线性赌博机已有大量研究，但二者的交叉——即在量子采样优势下同时处理未知奖励与未知安全约束——尚未被系统研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，探索量子计算能否在保证安全（每次动作均可行）的同时获得相比经典算法指数级更优的遗憾界。
AI.method: 1) 研究"相干幺正访问"模型：学习者可对奖励与约束的联合分布进行量子采样。据此设计QRS-COLTS，即受限线性Thompson采样（COLTS）的阶段性量子重采样-缩放（resampled-scaling）类比算法。2) 研究带"炸弹"标志的模型：学习者查询动作叠加态，若含不安全动作则炸弹被测量出并终止交互，从而提供对安全集的精确隶属访问。据此提出BCO-QLinTS，通过炸弹认证的量子凸优化直接选取可行动作，无需估计约束矩阵。
AI.result: QRS-COLTS以高概率只执行可行动作，遗憾关于查询时域为多对数级（polylogarithmic），且仅随约束数量的平方根缩放。BCO-QLinTS在炸弹模型中同样保持查询加权遗憾为多对数级，约束仅通过安全集的几何结构进入界中，而不依赖于显式的矩阵估计。
AI.conclusion: 量子采样可为带安全约束的线性赌博机带来显著优于经典方法的遗憾保证：安全性与近最优性可同时达成，且代价对约束数量的依赖极弱。这开辟了"安全量子强化学习"这一新方向，并揭示了不同量子访问模型（相干幺正 vs. 炸弹认证）下算法设计的差异与共性。

title: Object Count Generalization Is an Interface Problem: Warping a Frozen Skill Instead of Retraining It
comment: 37 pages, 15 figures, 15 tables. Submitted to International Conference on Learning Representations 2027. Code, videos and full results are available at https://hhi-robot-learning.github.io/wave-website/
summary: Reinforcement learning policies for robot manipulation degrade when the number of objects N in the scene grows beyond the training range. This is a covariate shift that also changes the dimension of the state. We propose WAVE (Warping Actions and Views of an Expert), which extends a pretrained single-object skill to many objects without updating its weights. WAVE has three parts. First, a selection policy picks the one object the robot works on next. Second, a warping policy reads a local view of the scene around that object, whose size does not depend on N. It emits a multiplier and an offset for every quantity the skill reads and every action it outputs. Third, the skill acts under this affine warp. It is shown a scene that holds a single object, while the warp steers it around the objects it is not shown and edits the actions that are sent to the robot. Both the selection and warping policies are trained with PPO on the multi-object reward and use the skill as a black box, so WAVE is task-general and skill-agnostic. It requires only that the skill was trained on the same embodiment and that every object has a goal pose. We also bound the number of attempts needed to place all N objects, assuming positive expected net progress per attempt, and measure this progress for each object count. We evaluate WAVE on cube arrangement tasks with a gantry robot and with a Franka Panda arm. Trained with at most nine cubes, it generalizes zero-shot to several times its training count, on the gantry to scenes of up to thirty cubes. Published methods that learn multi-object manipulation show count generalization up to six objects. Fine-tuning the skill, learning from the same local view without it, and an entity transformer, even when distilled from the pretrained skill, all collapse within their training counts under the same training budget.

AI.tldr: WAVE 通过"选择+仿射规整"把一个预训练的单物体技能零权重更新地扩展到多物体场景，实现数目零样本泛化（最多 30 个立方体）。
AI.motivation: 多物体场景下物体数 N 超出训练范围会导致强化学习策略性能退化，这既是协变量偏移，也带来状态维度的变化；已有方法最多只能泛化到 6 个物体。
AI.method: 提出 WAVE（Warping Actions and Views of an Expert），分三部分：(1) 选择策略挑选下一步操作的目标物体；(2) 规整（warping）策略读取该物体周围与 N 无关的局部视图，为技能读取的每个量及输出的每个动作生成乘子与偏置，输出仿射变换；(3) 技能在仿射规整下作用于只含单个物体的虚拟场景，并据此绕开未展示物体、修正下发动作。选择与规整策略均用 PPO 在多物体奖励上训练，将技能视为黑盒，因此任务通用、技能无关；仅要求技能与同一本体训练、每个物体有目标位姿。文中还在"每次尝试期望净进展为正"假设下界定了放置 N 个物体所需尝试次数，并对各物体数测量该进展。
AI.result: 在龙门机器人与 Franka Panda 的立方体排布任务上，最多用 9 个立方体训练，可零样本泛化到数倍训练数目，龙门上达 30 个立方体。对比方法（多物体学习类已发表方法、技能微调、同局部视图但不含技能的学习、实体 Transformer 乃至从其蒸馏）在相同训练预算下均在其训练数目内崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 以"不变维度局部视图 + 仿射动作/观测规整"解耦物体数量，可在不更新技能权重的前提下实现显著的数量零样本泛化；证明技能黑盒化与局部视图是规避协变量偏移与维度变化的关键。

title: Skill-Composer: Requirement-Driven Skill Selection from Multiple Marketplaces
summary: Agent skills have become the primary vehicle through which agents reuse specialized capabilities, yet public skill marketplaces provide skills with individual items: a query, whether matched through keyword or embedding similarity, returns a list of single skills ordered by relevance or by popularity. Such an interface cannot answer the question a developer actually faces: which set of skills should be installed to cover a task's complete requirement? The highest-ranked skills are often functionally redundant, while capabilities that are genuinely required remain uncovered. In this paper, we argue that skill acquisition should be reframed from ranking to set selection. We propose Skill-Composer, an agent-native framework that selects a non-redundant skill bundle for the user requirement, which aims to cover all available required capabilities and report any gaps. Specifically, it clarifies user requirements into atomic requirement points, retrieves and merges candidate skills across fragmented marketplaces, decomposes each candidate's capabilities, and progressively discards overlapping ones, so that each retained skill provides different capabilities. This moves the decision of which skills to acquire from the developer to the agent itself. We position this reframing and sketch its workflow.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将智能体技能获取从"排序"重新表述为"集合选择"，并给出 Skill-Composer 框架，用于为用户需求挑选无冗余、覆盖完整的技能组合并报告能力缺口。
AI.motivation: 现有公共技能市场以单项技能为单位返回按相关度或热度排序的列表，无法回答开发者真正关心的问题——应安装哪一组技能才能覆盖任务的完整需求。排名靠前的技能常功能冗余，而真正必需的能力却未被覆盖。
AI.method: Skill-Composer 为智能体原生框架：将用户需求澄清为原子需求点；跨碎片化市场检索并合并候选技能；分解每个候选技能的能力；渐进式剔除重叠项，使每个保留技能提供不同能力。从而把"获取哪些技能"的决策从开发者转移给智能体。
AI.result: 本文为立场性/愿景型工作，主要给出问题重构与工作流草案，摘要中未报告定量实验结果或具体评测指标。
AI.conclusion: 技能获取应被重构为集合选择问题而非排序问题；Skill-Composer 通过去冗余、全覆盖与缺口报告的技能包选择，为智能体自主完成技能获取提供了框架雏形。

title: Controlled One-Click Benchmarking and Post-Fusion Recalibration for Support-Conditioned Medical Segmentation
comment: Accepted at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)
summary: Sparse-prompt medical segmentation is hard to compare when prompts, supports, thresholds, and splits differ. This paper uses a controlled one-click protocol: each test image receives one positive foreground click, training-only support, validation-only checkpoint selection, and no test-time threshold tuning. We propose {Support-Aware Recalibration (SAR)}, a late post-fusion recalibration block for MultiverSeg that combines large-kernel spatial gating with squeeze-and-excitation channel recalibration after support--query fusion. BUSI, NerveUS-BP-present, and Kvasir-SEG are evaluated with matched 697 foreground-present sample budgets, shared splits/clicks, and threshold-free Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC. Compared with a protocol-matched raw-support MultiverSeg baseline, the main SAR configuration shows favorable mean Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC performance on BUSI, NerveUS-BP-present, and Kvasir-SEG, while reducing logged training time in this implementation. These controlled results indicate that late post-fusion recalibration is useful under a leakage-controlled one-click protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文在受控的"单点击"协议下提出支持感知重校准模块SAR，用于MultiverSeg的后期融合后重校准，在三个数据集上取得较优的Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC。
AI.motivation: 稀疏提示（如单点击）医学分割研究中，提示形式、支持集、阈值与数据划分各不相同，导致方法间难以公平比较；需要在严格控制泄漏与阈值调优的条件下评估改进模块的实际收益。
AI.method: 采用受控单点击协议：每张测试图像仅一个正向前景点点击，仅用训练集作支持集，仅用验证集选择检查点，测试时不调阈值。提出支持感知重校准（SAR）——位于MultiverSeg支持-查询融合之后的后期重校准模块，将大核空间门控与SE通道重校准相结合。在BUSI、NerveUS-BP-present和Kvasir-SEG上以匹配的697个前景样本预算、共享划分与点击、免阈值Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC进行评估。
AI.result: 与协议匹配的原始支持MultiverSeg基线相比，主SAR配置在三个数据集上均表现出更优的平均Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC，同时在该实现中降低了记录的训练时间。
AI.conclusion: 受控结果表明，在泄漏受控的单点击协议下，融合后重校准（SAR）是有效且实用的改进方向。

title: Bridging the Gap between Continual Learning and Test-Time Adaptation with Domain Preview
summary: Domain shift is a major problem for training machine learning models. While Continual Learning (CL) assumes distribution shift during training and Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) considers new domains at test time, setups that require explicit online adaptation to domain shift during both phases remain under-explored. We propose continual learning with domain preview (CL-P), a new combination of CL and TTA where both train and test data suffer from distribution shift. The training phase of CL-P is analogous to domain-incremental learning while the testing phase consists of a TTA phase on a future domain (which we call preview), and an evaluation phase on all seen domains. The model must then adapt to new domains at train and test time. In this paper, we evaluate mainstream CL and TTA methods that adapt only at train or test time, as well as their naive combination. Experimentally, TTA heavily damages the domain on which the CL method has just trained and increases forgetting. Notably, this damage mostly comes from the BatchNorm statistics shared by all domains. In that sense, we propose DOSE (Dosing by Online Statistics of Each domain), which allows a seamless combination of any CL and TTA methods by adaptive domain inference at test time, where the adaptation is applied to each image in proportion to the probability that it comes from the preview domain. Through extensive experiments with ResNet and ViT backbones, various combinations of CL and TTA baseline methods and datasets considering diverse domains, we show that DOSE matches or improves on CL methods alone in all 24 settings and on the naive combination in all but one. The code can be found in appendix.

AI.tldr: 提出Continual Learning with Domain Preview (CL-P) 新设定，融合持续学习与测试时适应，并给出DOSE方法实现二者的无缝结合。
AI.motivation: 现有CL只考虑训练阶段分布漂移，CTTA只在测试时考虑新域，缺少同时要求在线适应训练与测试两阶段域漂移的设定，因此需要探索CL与TTA结合的场景。
AI.method: 定义CL-P：训练阶段类似域增量学习，测试阶段包含对未来域（preview）的TTA及对所有已见域的评估。作者评估主流CL、TTA方法及朴素组合，发现TTA严重破坏刚训练过的域并加剧遗忘，主因是各域共享的BatchNorm统计量。据此提出DOSE (Dosing by Online Statistics of Each domain)，在测试时进行自适应域推断，按图像来自preview域的概率成比例施加适应，从而无缝组合任意CL与TTA方法。
AI.result: 在ResNet与ViT骨干、多种CL与TTA基线组合及多域数据集上，DOSE在全部24个设定中达到或优于单独CL方法，并在除一个外的所有设定中优于朴素组合。
AI.conclusion: 朴素地在CL上叠加TTA因BatchNorm统计量共享而损害旧域性能，DOSE通过按域概率加权的自适应推断有效缓解该问题，为CL与TTA的结合提供了通用且有效的方案。

title: Beyond Domain Randomization: Real-World Policy Adaptation in Learned Dynamics for Legged Robots
summary: Reinforcement learning policies are often trained with static domain randomization for real-world deployment. However, real-world environments often exhibit unmodeled dynamic variations, such as payload changes or friction shifts, that lie outside the randomization distribution, leading to performance degradation upon deployment. We propose a framework that moves beyond static domain randomization by adapting a learned dynamics model to the deployed target conditions, with a concurrent teacher-student paradigm applied to both the policy and dynamics model. This framework integrates the dynamics model into an on-policy reinforcement learning pipeline, letting the performance of the policy align with the empirical target dynamics. Experimental validations on bipedal locomotion tasks demonstrate competitive adaptability under extreme physical variations, including a payload reaching 80% of self-weight and an oil-lubricated low-friction surface.

AI.tldr: 提出一种超越静态域随机化的框架：将动力学模型在线自适应到部署目标条件，并对策略与动力学模型同时采用师生范式，嵌入on-policy RL流程，在双足运动任务中实现极端物理变化下的强适应能力。
AI.motivation: 传统RL策略依赖静态域随机化以部署到真实世界，但真实环境存在未建模的动态变化（如负载改变、摩擦变化），超出随机化分布，导致部署时性能下降。
AI.method: 框架让学习到的动力学模型适应部署目标的真实条件；对策略和动力学模型同时施加并行的教师-学生范式；将动力学模型整合进on-policy强化学习流水线，使策略性能与经验目标动力学对齐。
AI.result: 在双足运动任务上进行实验验证，在极端物理变化下展现出有竞争力的适应性，包括负载达到自重的80%以及油润滑低摩擦表面。
AI.conclusion: 通过在线自适应动力学模型与师生并行训练，可突破静态域随机化的分布限制，提升策略在真实部署条件下的鲁棒性与泛化能力。

title: Testing Quantized KV-Cache Maintenance: Encoding Layout and Historical Restoration
summary: Repeating rows then selecting originals retains layout-dependent drift despite equal encoding counts. We measure when existing checks fail to establish preservation contracts in fixed quantized KV-cache implementations. In four-bit HQQ axis zero at sixteen cycles, median paired relative-L2 increases over same-shape re-encoding are 7.22 percentage points for Qwen3-1.7B and 11.59 for SmolLM3-3B. Matched encoded states cover sixteen shared questions per model at one and sixteen cycles. Axis one matches the shape-preserving control; lazy reorders preserve the initial state. On one known input, fixed update counts retain the difference; preserving group members removes it. Our prefix-view extension passes current-prefix checks yet changes history and next logits in six model/codec settings at residual capacities four and 128. Public lookup reaches this boundary, including one of four precommitted project-new GPU inputs; fixed query swaps isolate a conditional old-history effect. Checkpoint/dense rollback is exact. An explicit delayed lookup client admits a supported 129-token path excluded by native AR on one known context. Failed task-harm expansion precludes population failure-rate or general answer-degradation claims. Native MLX-LM fixtures expose stale caller caches; synchronization restores the tested in-place contract with native computations preserved. In rejection tests, stale callers change logits but not greedy tokens.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究固定量化 KV-cache 实现中"重放行再取原始行"时钟刻漂移问题：等编码计数下仍存在与布局相关的漂移，现有检查无法建立保持性契约。
AI.motivation: 动机是检验既有 KV-cache 复用/前缀复用检查是否真能保证"保持性契约"，即在编码次数相等的条件下，缓存状态是否严格保持原样。
AI.method: 在 4-bit HQQ 量化缓存上做配对实验，比较同形状重编码与复用路径的相对 L2；用固定查询交换、组员保留、前缀视图扩展、检查点/稠密回滚等对照隔离布局依赖效应；并在原生 MLX-LM fixture 上测试调用方缓存同步。
AI.result: 轴0、16 周期下，配对相对 L2 中位数比同形状重编码分别高 7.22 个百分点（Qwen3-1.7B）与 11.59（SmolLM3-3B）；轴1与保形对照一致；前缀视图扩展在 6 个模型/编解码设置、残差容量 4 与 128 下通过当前前缀检查却改变历史与下一 token logits；单输入上固定更新计数保留差异，保留组员可消除差异。
AI.conclusion: 现有检查不足以确立保持性契约；任务危害扩展失败，故不作总体失败率或普遍答案退化结论；原生 MLX-LM 中陈旧调用方缓存仅改变 logits 而不改变贪婪 token。

title: Gaze Graphs: A Scene-Level Representation of Visual Attention in the Operating Room
summary: Purpose: Analyzing clinicians' visual attention from exocentric camera views can support surgical scene understanding without requiring wearable eye trackers. However, existing gaze-following research in the operating room (OR) estimates only 2D gaze locations without identifying attended scene entities or localizing gaze targets in 3D space. In this work, we investigate gaze graphs as a scene-level representation of visual attention that connects clinicians to attended scene entities, and evaluate their utility for fine-grained surgical action recognition and semantic scene graph (SSG) generation. Methods: We extend the public EgoExOR dataset with gaze annotations to create EgoExOR-Gaze, the first benchmark for multi-view gaze graph generation in the OR. We propose a novel architecture that jointly estimates 3D gaze targets and predicts attended entities using only exocentric camera views. Specifically, our approach exploits 3D gaze geometry to sample local visual features across multiple views for attended entity prediction. We further utilize predicted gaze graphs for fine-grained surgical action recognition and SSG generation. Results: For gaze graph generation, our model outperforms both exocentric-only and combined exocentric-egocentric baselines. For surgical action recognition, our model incorporating predicted gaze graphs outperforms both exocentric and egocentric baselines across all evaluated metrics, with particularly strong gains in temporal metrics. For SSG generation, incorporating gaze graphs improves macro-F1 from 0.42 to 0.52 compared to exocentric inputs alone, although performance remains below that achieved with egocentric inputs. Conclusion: Our results demonstrate the value of gaze graphs for surgical action recognition and SSG generation, highlighting the importance of explicitly modeling scene-level visual attention even when egocentric views are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 提出外科手术场景中的多视角"注视图"（gaze graph）表示，仅用外视角相机联合估计3D注视目标与受关注实体，并用于细粒度手术动作识别与语义场景图生成。
AI.motivation: 现有手术室（OR）注视跟随研究仅从外视角估计2D注视点，无法识别受关注场景实体或定位3D注视目标，缺乏场景级视觉注意力表示。
AI.method: 扩展EgoExOR数据集构建EgoExOR-Gaze基准（首个OR多视角注视图生成基准）；提出新架构，仅用外视角图像联合估计3D注视目标与受关注实体，利用3D注视几何在多视角下采样局部视觉特征进行实体预测，并将预测的注视图用于手术动作识别与SSG生成。
AI.result: 注视图生成优于纯外视角及外+内视角基线；动作识别在所有指标上优于外视角与内视角基线，时间相关指标提升尤为显著；SSG生成中macro-F1由0.42提升至0.52，但仍低于使用内视角输入的效果。
AI.conclusion: 注视图对手术动作识别与SSG生成具有价值，说明即使缺少内视角，显式建模场景级视觉注意力仍然重要。

title: Beyond PINNs: Boundary-Enriched Holomorphic Networks for Laplace Problems
comment: Accepted at the AI for Science Workshop, NeurIPS 2026. 24 pages, 9 figures
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) solve partial differential equations by penalizing their residual, but this formulation can be difficult to optimize for solutions with singular behaviour. We focus specifically on the two-dimensional Laplace equation, whose strong analytical structure allows the governing equation to be enforced directly in the neural representation. We compare a hybrid harmonic-neural model with a holomorphic neural network whose output is harmonic by construction and therefore requires only boundary training. We further enrich the holomorphic model with singular functions chosen according to the interior angle and boundary conditions at each junction of boundary segments. On six singular benchmarks, the enriched model is the most accurate of the neural models we compare. On the four with a closed-form solution, however, that solution lies in the span of the enrichment terms, and a least-squares fit of these terms alone is exact to rounding error. On Motz's problem and the cracked beam, the neural core reduces the relative error of the recovered leading singular coefficient from about $10^{-2}$, for a least-squares fit with the same four terms, to about $10^{-6}$, and on four variants whose solution has a smooth part outside the span, the network is $4\times10^{4}$ to $2\times10^{7}$ times more accurate than a fit of its singular terms alone; classical least-squares fits with more singular terms, or with harmonic polynomials and rational poles, are more accurate still. Our results demonstrate how exploiting problem-specific analytical structure can provide an alternative to base and residual PINNs for challenging scientific computing problems.

AI.tldr: 该文研究二维Laplace方程奇异解的神经网络求解，比较混合调和-神经模型与按构造保证调和的全纯神经网络，并按边界段交点内角与边界条件选取奇异函数进行富集。富集模型在六个奇异基准中精度最高，但四个有闭式解的问题因解落在富集项张成空间内，仅用最小二乘拟合富集项即可达舍入误差级精确；在Motz问题与裂纹梁上，神经核心将主导奇异系数相对误差从约10^-2降至约10^-6，而在解含张成空间外光滑部分的四个变体上，网络精度比仅拟合奇异项高4×10^4至2×10^7倍，但经典最小二乘（更多奇异项、调和多项式与有理极点）仍更精确。
AI.motivation: 残差型PINN通过惩罚PDE残差求解，但对具有奇异行为的解难以优化；作者希望利用二维Laplace方程强解析结构，把控制方程直接嵌入神经表示，从而为奇异问题提供替代基函数型PINN与残差型PINN的思路。
AI.method: 以二维Laplace方程为对象，比较两类模型：(1) 混合调和-神经模型；(2) 输出按构造成调和的Holomorphic神经网络，仅需边界训练。进一步按各边界段交点的内角与边界条件选取奇异函数，对全纯模型进行富集。在六个奇异基准上评估，并与四种对照比较：仅富集项的最小二乘拟合、经典增加奇异项的最小二乘拟合、调和多项式+有理极点最小二乘。
AI.result: 富集模型在六个奇异基准中为所比较神经模型里最精确的；但四个具闭式解的问题中，该解位于富集项张成空间内，仅拟合富集项即达到舍入误差级精确，说明该组基准对"结构利用"结论存在偏置。Motz问题与裂纹梁上，神经核心将主导奇异系数相对误差由约10^-2（同四奇异项最小二乘）降至约10^-6；在四个解含张成空间外光滑部分的变体上，网络比仅拟合其奇异项精确4×10^4至2×10^7倍。然而经典最小二乘方法（更多奇异项或调和多项式+有理极点）精度更高。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用问题特定解析结构（调和性构造+按几何富集）可作为基函数型与残差型PINN在困难科学计算问题上的替代方案；但富集项本身已含闭式解时基准会高估优势，且与成熟经典谱/奇异函数最小二乘方法相比，神经网络的优势主要体现在对未知光滑部分的表示，而非整体精度上限。

title: HIVE-Bench: Evaluating Patch-Level Visual Representations for Egocentric Robot Manipulation
summary: Pretrained vision is a common start for robot learning, but most comparisons still score one pooled vector from a third-person image. Bimanual policies instead read dense patch tokens from cameras on the robot. We introduce HIVE-Bench: one shared flow-matching policy reads 20 encoders from seven families on 24 egocentric bimanual tasks, across adaptation, task sharing, and sweeps of data, model size, and layer. Keeping the patches matters. Averaging each view to one token removes most of the success, adaptation helps every pair we test, and one shared policy keeps most of the success of separate policies at a fraction of the updates. The same tokens are then scored with statistics, state and object readouts, published vision scores, and an inverse-dynamics readout. That readout of the commanded motion is one of the strongest measurements available before a policy is trained. Recognition, depth, and correspondence do not transfer reliably. Fine-tuning can improve the action readout even when other measurements move the other way, and no statistic is stable enough to replace a rollout before any deployment.

AI.tldr: 该文提出HIVE-Bench：用同一个共享flow-matching策略，在24个第一人称视角双臂任务上系统评测7个家族共20个视觉编码器，覆盖适配、任务共享以及数据量/模型规模/层数扫描，并比较多种无需rollout的视觉表征打分方式。
AI.motivation: 现有比较视觉预训练的工作多从第三人称图像中池化出单个向量来打分，而真实双臂策略是从机器人上相机读取稠密patch token，两者评测设定不匹配；因此需要一套与机器人学习实际用法一致的、可控的视觉预训练基准。
AI.method: 构建HIVE-Bench：在一个共享flow-matching策略下接入20个编码器（7个家族），在24个第一人称（egocentric）双臂任务上进行适配、任务共享与超参扫描（数据量、模型规模、层）。同时在同一批token上做多种读出评测：统计量、状态与物体读出、公开视觉基准分数、逆动力学（动作）读出，并与实际rollout结果对比。
AI.result: 保留patch token至关重要——把每个视角平均为单一token会失去大部分成功率；适配对被测的每一对（编码器-任务）都有效；共享策略以一小部分更新量即可保留单独策略的大部分成功率。在未训练策略前，对指令运动（commanded motion）的逆动力学读出是最强的可用度量之一；识别、深度、对应关系类能力不能可靠迁移；微调可提升动作读出，即使其他度量朝相反方向变化；没有任何统计量稳定到足以在部署前替代真实rollout。
AI.conclusion: 视觉表征的评测必须贴近下游使用方式（保留稠密patch、在真实双臂任务上适配）；离线代理指标（含逆动力学动作读出）只能作为参考，部署前仍需真实rollout验证。

title: Can Cities Have Personalities? Introducing the SCD City Personality Assessment
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Supplementary research materials: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24466311
summary: Descriptions of cities are shaped by human experience and institutional narratives. We introduce the SCD City Personality Assessment (SCD-CPA), a method that instantiates document-grounded ChatGPT city personas and interrogates each with an identical 24-statement instrument inspired by the four-pair structure of the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator. Rather than asking a general-purpose model to characterize cities freely, we configure a separate document-grounded conversational agent for each city and use alternative evidence portraits to compare documentary inputs. The resulting four bipolar dimensions and four-letter summaries use independently defined urban concepts and scoring rules. Tokyo, New York, and Paris form the methodological evaluation (33 assessments across repeated sessions, three GPT-6 effort settings, and alternative portraits): Tokyo's original portrait yielded 85.4% exact within-setting item agreement, while evidence substitutions shifted some dimension strengths. A five-city application to Shanghai, Dubai, Mumbai, Lagos, and Sao Paulo (15 assessments) yielded 77.8% exact and 99.4% within-one-point cross-setting agreement, indicating consistency under the tested configurations. By treating each city conversational agent as a reproducible, evidence-conditioned experimental configuration, SCD-CPA makes documented city-character perceptions comparable and exposes their sensitivity to source selection. Although the documentary evidence is explicitly controlled, the model's internal interpretation of that evidence cannot be fully observed. We also examine the robustness of SCD-CPA across three AI reasoning-effort settings. The observed consistency suggests that the methodology is relatively insensitive to the tested configuration differences and provides a framework for evaluating its stability as future generations of AI models become available.

AI.tldr: 提出 SCD-CPA 方法：为每座城市构建基于文档证据的 ChatGPT 城市人格智能体，用同一套 24 题（借鉴 MBTI 四对维度结构）问卷进行测评，以可复现、证据条件化的实验配置使城市性格描述可比，并检验其对证据来源与推理强度设置的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 城市描述受人类经验与制度性叙事塑造，而让通用大模型自由概括城市缺乏可控性与可比性。作者希望将"城市性格"感知转化为可重复、可比较、可检验来源敏感性的实验对象。
AI.method: 构建 SCD City Personality Assessment：为每座城市配置独立的文档接地（document-grounded）对话智能体，而非直接询问通用模型；用相同 24 条陈述量表测评，量表借鉴 MBTI 四对二分结构，但四个双极维度及四字母汇总采用独立定义的城市概念与评分规则；以替代性"证据画像"比较不同文档输入的影响。评估分两阶段：东京、纽约、巴黎为方法学评估（33 次测评，跨重复会话、三种 GPT-6 推理强度、替代画像）；上海、迪拜、孟买、拉各斯、圣保罗为五城市应用（15 次测评）。
AI.result: 东京原始画像在相同设置下条目完全一致率 85.4%，证据替换会改变部分维度强度；五城市应用取得 77.8% 完全一致、99.4% 单点内（within-one-point）跨设置一致率，表明在测试配置下结果具有一致性。方法对三种推理强度设置的差异相对不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 将城市对话智能体视为可复现、证据条件化的实验配置，SCD-CPA 使基于文献的城市性格感知可比较，并揭示其对来源选择的敏感性。局限在于文档证据虽被显式控制，模型对证据的内部解读无法完全观测；该框架可用于未来新一代模型下持续评估方法稳定性。

title: From Dense to Sparse: Morton-Ordered Sparse Mapping for Efficient 3D Mesh Generation
summary: Unified 3D understanding and generation require compact sequences preserving spatial structure. Dense grids yield long sequences, while serialization can separate spatial neighbors. We propose Sparse Proximity Aware Compression (SPAC), a shared sparse SDF vocabulary combining sparse encoding with reversible spatial merging. A Sparse SDF VQ-VAE quantizes near-surface features while retaining explicit coordinates, using reconstruction supervision for surface fidelity and detail. 3D Byte-Pair Encoding (3D-BPE) merges recurring face-adjacent patterns using relative offsets before serialization. Macro tokens expand exactly into leaf tokens and coordinates. After Morton serialization, a shared LLM reads geometry for captioning and predicts tokens that decode into meshes for text-conditioned generation. With fixed geometry, architecture, and band width in voxels, sparse encoder cost grows approximately quadratically with resolution. 3D-BPE reduces mean complete LLM sequence length by 45.4 percent, including coordinates, text, and control tokens. SPAC achieves strong results in both 3D captioning and text-conditioned mesh generation. Ablations show gains over leaf tokens and Morton 1D-BPE in both tasks. The project page at https://yangjj007.github.io/spac/ .

AI.tldr: 提出 Sparse Proximity Aware Compression (SPAC)，一套共享稀疏 SDF 词表，将稀疏编码与可逆空间合并结合，统一 3D 理解与生成的序列表示。
AI.motivation: 统一 3D 理解与生成需要紧凑且保留空间结构的序列；稠密网格序列过长，而简单序列化又会割裂空间相邻关系。
AI.method: Sparse SDF VQ-VAE 在保留显式坐标的同时量化近表面特征，并以重建监督保证表面保真度与细节；3D Byte-Pair Encoding (3D-BPE) 在序列化前用相对偏移合并反复出现的面相邻模式，宏 token 可精确展开为叶 token 与坐标；随后经 Morton 序列化，由共享 LLM 读取几何做描述生成，或预测可解码为网格的 token 实现文本条件生成。
AI.result: 在体素带宽固定的情况下，稀疏编码器开销随分辨率近似二次增长；3D-BPE 使含坐标、文本与控制 token 的平均完整 LLM 序列长度降低 45.4%；SPAC 在 3D 描述与文本条件网格生成两项任务上均取得强劲结果，消融显示相较叶 token 与 Morton 1D-BPE 均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏近邻感知压缩可在保持空间邻近性与精确可逆性的前提下显著压缩序列，为统一 3D 理解与生成提供有效的共享表示。

title: Beyond Fixed Prompt Configuration: Alternating Policy Learning for Adaptive Topology-Based Prompting in Few-Shot Graph Learning
summary: Graph Prompt Learning (GPL) adapts frozen pre-trained graph models to few-shot graph tasks through a small set of trainable prompts that encode task-specific information. Topology-based prompting instantiates this idea by augmenting an input graph with new prompt nodes and edges, yielding promising performance. However, prompt content and propagation structure are coupled, making it difficult to assess their individual effects and learn compatible configurations. In this paper, we empirically analyze two challenges in learning adaptive policies for topology-based prompting: asymmetric performance effects and coupled configuration selection. We then propose TTPR, a two-stage reinforcement framework that alternately optimizes two policies to generate adaptive configurations, with each policy conditioned on configurations generated by the other fixed policy. These conditional updates separate policy evaluation while preserving configuration compatibility. Specifically, TTPR models an edge-level policy to construct connection patterns and optimizes it with Connection Relative Policy Optimization (CRPO) through group-wise comparisons of complete connection patterns. The other is a node-level policy that generates prompt-node schemes and is optimized with Incremental Node Proximal Policy Optimization (INPPO) through incremental prompt-count decisions and feature generation. Across diverse datasets and pre-training strategies, TTPR ranks first in 8/10 few-shot node classification settings and attains the highest average performance across graph classification benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TTPR，一个两阶段强化学习框架，用于图提示学习中的拓扑提示：交替优化边级与节点级策略，分别用CRPO和INPPO训练，解耦提示内容与传播结构的耦合问题。
AI.motivation: 拓扑式图提示（Topology-based prompting）通过添加提示节点与边来适配冻结的预训练图模型，但提示内容与传播结构相互耦合，难以评估各自影响、难以学习兼容配置。本文实证分析了两大挑战：非对称性能效应（asymmetric performance effects）与耦合配置选择（coupled configuration selection）。
AI.method: 提出TTPR两阶段强化框架，交替优化两个策略，每个策略以另一固定策略生成的配置为条件，从而分离策略评估同时保持配置兼容性：(1) 边级策略构建连接模式，用Connection Relative Policy Optimization (CRPO) 通过完整连接模式的组内比较进行优化；(2) 节点级策略生成提示节点方案，用Incremental Node Proximal Policy Optimization (INPPO) 通过增量式提示数决策与特征生成进行优化。
AI.result: 在多种数据集与预训练策略上，TTPR在10个少样本节点分类设置中取得8个第一，并在图分类基准上取得最高平均性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将拓扑提示的配置生成拆分为条件式交替优化的边级与节点级策略，可有效缓解耦合问题并在少样本图任务上取得领先性能。

title: Bridging Continuous-Time MAPF and Industrial AGV Fleet Coordination with Lazy Priority-Based Search
comment: 18 pages, 11 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
summary: Continuous-time multi-agent path finding on roadmaps (MAPF$_R$) offers a principled way to coordinate robot fleets with geometric collision avoidance, yet its deployment on industrial automated guided vehicle (AGV) infrastructures remains challenging, as highly connected and redundant roadmaps amplify both safe-interval reasoning and multi-agent interaction handling. To bridge this gap, we formalize AGV-MAPF$_R$-CTC, a configuration-space variant of MAPF$_R$ with precomputed continuous-time conflicts that enables the reuse of MAPF$_R$ solvers for AGV fleet coordination with minimal changes. We then revisit continuous-time priority-based search (CPBS), identifying the boundary conditions required by its safe interval path planning (SIPP) low-level planner under priority-induced constraints and enabling earlier solution detection. As a central contribution, we analyze the structure of the priority search space, clarifying which agents are affected by each priority refinement and when replanning can be avoided. Building on this analysis, we introduce a novel algorithm, Lazy-CPBS, which materializes high-level nodes lazily: a child's plans are computed only when it is expanded, so siblings that are never expanded cost no low-level search. Experiments on standard MAPF benchmarks and on industrial AGV roadmaps imported from a proprietary digital-twin simulator show that CPBS-based solvers remain effective well beyond the agent counts reachable by optimal MAPF$_R$ solvers, while Lazy-CPBS substantially reduces CPBS overhead and offers the most consistent robustness/runtime trade-off across industrial layouts.

AI.tldr: 该文针对工业AGV路网上的连续时间多智能体路径规划（MAPF_R），形式化了AGV-MAPF_R-CTC变体并深入分析连续时间优先级搜索（CPBS）的优先级搜索空间结构，提出惰性实现高层节点的Lazy-CPBS算法，在标准与工业路网基准上显著优于最优MAPF_R求解器所及规模并降低CPBS开销。
AI.motivation: 连续时间路网MAPF（MAPF_R）理论上可兼顾几何避碰与机队协同，但在工业AGV基础设施上难以部署：高连通、冗余度大的路网会放大安全区间推理与多智能体交互处理的复杂度；同时最优MAPF_R求解器可扩展的智能体数量有限，难以满足工业规模需求。
AI.method: 1) 形式化AGV-MAPF_R-CTC——配置空间下的MAPF_R变体，采用预计算连续时间冲突，使现有MAPF_R求解器可几乎无改动地复用于AGV机队协调；2) 重新审视CPBS，厘清优先级约束下SIPP低层规划器所需的边界条件，并支持更早的解得检测；3) 分析优先级搜索空间结构，明确每次优先级细化所影响的智能体集合以及何时可避免重规划；4) 据此提出Lazy-CPBS：惰性物化高层节点，仅在节点被扩展时才计算子节点规划，未被扩展的兄弟节点不产生低层搜索开销。
AI.result: 在标准MAPF基准与从专有数字孪生仿真器导入的工业AGV路网上实验：基于CPBS的求解器在远超最优MAPF_R求解器可达智能体数量的规模下仍然有效；Lazy-CPBS显著降低CPBS的高层开销，并在多种工业布局上给出最一致的鲁棒性—运行时间折中。
AI.conclusion: 将预计算连续时间冲突的配置空间形式化与优先级搜索空间的结构性分析相结合，可有效把连续时间MAPF_R推广到工业AGV规模；惰性节点物化是削减CPBS冗余低层搜索的关键手段，Lazy-CPBS在工业场景下兼具效率与鲁棒性。

title: Transport-Safe Evaluation of LLM Agents: Trajectory-Dependent Judge Error and Anytime-Valid Auditing
comment: Author's accepted version (without the publisher's template) of a paper accepted at ICAART 2027 (paper \#38). The final version will be published by SCITEPRESS; DOI to be added upon publication
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are often ranked by an LLM judge whose error rates are measured once and reused for every agent. The corrected success rates can then be biased when the judge's errors depend on the trajectory and agents differ in the trajectories they produce for successes or failures. We derive the exact asymptotic bias and give a chain of checks from identification to simultaneous ranks. On a four-agent semi-synthetic benchmark, a scalar correction with oracle calibration has maximum bias 0.245 and mean pointwise coverage 0.016, and never recovers the full ranking (0/250 replications). Augmented inverse-probability weighting (AIPW) with a uniform or a design-aware random audit keeps the maximum bias below 0.003, with mean pointwise coverage of 0.939 and 0.950. In a 48-cell stress test, effective target support rises only from 0.209 to 0.805 as calibration grows from 600 to 4,800 labels, while audited AIPW keeps a mean absolute error of 0.018-0.020. Without calibration support, or with judge dependence within an externally justified bound, we report valid bounds or sensitivity sets and carry them into rank sets. An e-process confidence sequence stays valid, for a stable target, under predictable adaptive auditing and arbitrary stopping.

AI.tldr: 论文指出，用一次性测得错误率的 LLM judge 对各 agent 的修正成功率会因 judge 误差依赖轨迹而产生偏倚；作者推导该偏倚的精确渐近值，并给出从识别到同时排名的检验链，提出用 AIPW 加随机审计来纠偏，并配套给出无校准支撑时的界与敏感性集合、以及 e-process 置信序列。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM agent 评测常以 LLM judge 排名，judge 的错误率只测一次并对所有 agent 复用，从而假定 judge 误差与轨迹无关。但 judge 错误往往依赖轨迹，而不同 agent 成功/失败时产生的轨迹分布不同，这会使修正后的成功率产生系统性偏倚，导致排名不可靠。
AI.method: 推导该混淆性修正的精确渐近偏倚表达式，并构建从识别性到同时排名的检验链。提出用增广逆概率加权（AIPW）结合均匀或设计感知的随机审计进行估计，并给出无校准支撑时的有效界、依赖有外部合理性上界时的敏感性集合及其排名集合，以及可在可预测自适应审计与任意停止下保持有效的 e-process 置信序列。在四 agent 半合成基准与 48 格压力测试上评估。
AI.result: 标量修正即使有 oracle 校准，最大偏倚达 0.245，逐点覆盖均值仅 0.016，250 次重复中 0/250 恢复完整排名；AIPW 搭配随机审计将最大偏倚压到 0.003 以下，逐点覆盖均值分别为 0.939 与 0.950。48 格压力测试中，校准标签由 600 增至 4,800 时有效目标支撑仅从 0.209 升到 0.805，而审计 AIPW 的平均绝对误差稳定在 0.018–0.020。
AI.conclusion: judge 误差的轨迹依赖性使一次性标量校准在排名任务上不可靠，扩大校准标签不能替代目标支撑；随机审计加 AIPW 能在有限偏差与近名义覆盖下恢复排名，且 e-process 置信序列支持自适应审计与任意停止下的有效推断。

title: Div3DAfford: Diverse 3D affordance grounding
summary: 3D affordance grounding aims to localize 3D regions specified by an interaction query. Existing methods predict a single affordance mask, overlooking the inherent diversity of human-object interactions. We introduce diverse 3D affordance grounding, a new task that requires predicting multiple plausible regions for a given object and affordance query. We then propose Div3DAffordNet, a transformer-based set prediction model capable of generating diverse affordance regions. To address the scarcity of diverse 3D affordance data, we develop an automated pipeline leveraging 2D generative models and 3D reconstruction techniques to synthesize 3D affordances, followed by lightweight human verification (reducing the annotation time by 72X), yielding the Div3DAfford benchmark. Extensive experiments show Div3DAffordNet effectively captures multi-mask affordance regions. Our method achieves the SOTA affordance grounding performance in the multi-mask setting, reducing GED-SIM from 0.745 to 0.492, while maintaining competitive single-mask performance on the standard benchmark of 19.0 mIoU.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"多样化3D可供性定位"新任务与Div3DAffordNet集合预测模型，并构建Div3DAfford基准。
AI.motivation: 现有3D可供性定位方法只预测单一可供性掩码，忽视了人-物交互固有的多样性（同一物体同一可供性可对应多个合理区域）。同时，缺乏多样化3D可供性数据的标注。
AI.method: 提出Div3DAffordNet，基于Transformer的集合预测模型，可对给定物体与可供性查询生成多个合理的可供性区域；并设计自动化数据流水线，利用2D生成模型与3D重建技术合成3D可供性数据，辅以轻量人工校验（标注时间降低72倍），构建Div3DAfford基准。
AI.result: 在多掩码设置下达到SOTA，GED-SIM由0.745降至0.492；在标准单掩码基准上保持具竞争力的19.0 mIoU。
AI.conclusion: Div3DAffordNet能有效捕捉多掩码可供性区域，验证了多样化3D可供性定位任务的可行性与价值。

title: Yggdrasil: Tree-Routed Recurrent Experts for State Tracking and Fast CPU Inference
summary: Parallel-trainable recurrences such as Mamba, linear attention, and DeltaNet offer constant-cost streaming inference, but they suffer from two limitations: 1) they struggle to track discrete state, and 2) they read every parameter at every step, tying model capacity directly to CPU latency. We introduce Yggdrasil, a recurrent architecture that decouples capacity from per-step compute by looking up each layer's transition in a large, tree-routed bank of recurrent experts. Each router addresses its bank using the current token and the state of the layer below. We prove that this cross-layer context is necessary---a single token-indexed layer of non-expanding transitions with finitely many reachable states cannot perform conditional resets---while avoiding feedback from the layer's own past preserves parallel-scan training. Because each step traverses one tree path and reads a single expert per layer, active weights stay within a few hundred kilobytes in CPU L2 cache while the full bank resides in RAM. Among the parallel-trainable models we evaluate, Yggdrasil is the only one to solve all five state-tracking tasks. At matched active parameter counts, it achieves the lowest test bits on enwik8 (1.540 bpb) and the human genome hg38 (1.567 bpb), while stepping $3.0\times$ and $3.3\times$ faster on a single CPU core ($6.7\,μ\mathrm{s}$ and $5.8\,μ\mathrm{s}$) than the fastest streaming baseline, and delivering the highest GPU throughput of all models at batch 1024. On the Genomic Benchmarks, it is the strongest causal model at matched active parameters (86.0% mean accuracy).

AI.tldr: Yggdrasil是一种可并行训练、支持常数开销流式推理的循环架构：通过基于树路由的循环专家库，将模型容量与每步计算解耦，并通过跨层上下文路由实现条件重置与离散状态追踪。
AI.motivation: Mamba、线性注意力、DeltaNet等可并行训练循环模型存在两大缺陷：(1)难以追踪离散状态（离散状态追踪能力差）；(2)每个时间步都要读取全部参数，使模型容量直接绑定到CPU延迟，容量扩张即延迟上升。
AI.method: 将每层状态转移查表化：在大型树路由的循环专家库中为每层查询一个转移专家。路由器以当前token与下层状态作为寻址依据（跨层上下文），并证明该跨层上下文是必要的——单层、token索引、非扩张转移且可达状态有限的情形无法实现条件重置；同时避免将本层自身历史反馈进路由，从而保持并行扫描训练可行性。每步仅遍历一条树路径、每层读取单个专家，激活权重控制在数百KB以适配CPU L2缓存，完整专家库驻留RAM。
AI.result: 在评估的可并行训练模型中，Yggdrasil是唯一解决全部五个状态追踪任务的模型；在等激活参数量下取得最低测试bits：enwik8为1.540 bpb，人类基因组hg38为1.567 bpb；单CPU核步进分别快3.0×和3.3×（6.7μs与5.8μs），快于最快的流式基线；在batch 1024下GPU吞吐最高；在Genomic Benchmarks上为等激活参数下最强的因果模型（平均准确率86.0%）。
AI.conclusion: 以树路由循环专家库实现容量与每步计算解耦，配合跨层上下文路由，可在保持并行训练与常数开销推理的同时，同时获得优良的离散状态追踪、压缩性能与CPU/GPU效率。

title: Tabular Foundation Models Are Surprisingly Effective In-Context Robot Learners
summary: Can foundation models pretrained for generic numerical prediction serve as in-context robot learners? We investigate this question through tabular foundation models (TFMs), which are pretrained to infer input-output relationships from labeled examples in context. We introduce TabAct, which casts visual imitation as numerical prediction: frozen visual features and robot proprioception form the inputs, future action chunks form the targets, and each demonstration time step provides one labeled example that conditions a frozen TFM for closed-loop control. The predictor receives no robot-specific training or target-task fine-tuning. With one target-task demonstration available to each method, TabAct with TabICLv2 achieves the highest average success among all evaluated methods on both LIBERO and Meta-World, exceeding the strongest baseline by 20.9 and 5.8 percentage points, respectively. Additional demonstrations improve control without updating model weights: with five demonstrations, success reaches 94.2% on LIBERO-Object. These results demonstrate that generic numerical pretraining can provide an effective foundation for in-context robot learning.

AI.tldr: 提出TabAct，将视觉模仿学习重构为表格数值预测问题：以冻结视觉特征与本体感觉为输入、未来动作块为目标、每个演示时间步为一个上下文样本，直接条件化冻结的表格基础模型（TFM）实现闭环控制，无需机器人专属训练或目标任务微调。
AI.motivation: 探究为通用数值预测预训练的基础模型能否作为上下文机器人学习器：TFM在预训练中学会从上下文中带标签样例推断输入-输出关系，若把机器人模仿学习转成数值预测，则可能免去机器人数据训练与目标域微调。
AI.method: TabAct把视觉模仿转化为数值预测：输入为冻结视觉特征＋机器人本体感觉，目标为未来动作块；每条演示的每个时间步构成一个带标签样例，作为上下文条件化冻结的TFM（使用TabICLv2），以闭环方式输出控制动作。预测器不做任何机器人相关训练或目标任务微调。
AI.result: 在每种方法均可获得1条目标任务演示的设置下，TabAct（配TabICLv2）在LIBERO与Meta-World上均取得最高平均成功率，分别超过最强基线20.9与5.8个百分点；增加演示可在不更新权重的情况下提升控制效果，5条演示时在LIBERO-Object上达到94.2%成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通用数值预训练可为上下文机器人学习提供有效基础，TFM能在完全不进行机器人数据训练与目标域微调的条件下实现有竞争力的视觉模仿控制，且性能随上下文演示数量增加而提升。

title: Intent-Conditioned Argument Mediation for Tool-Using LLM Agents: Blocking Trusted-but-Unauthorized Arguments
comment: Accepted at ICAART 2027; final version published by SCITEPRESS. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24233094
summary: LLM agents turn a user's request and retrieved content into tool calls, and a call can reach the wrong recipient, endpoint, file or participant. Argument-level provenance blocks such values when they come from untrusted content, but accepts a trusted value that the user never requested. IntentFlow, a mediation layer between an unmodified planner and its tools, checks each authority-bearing argument against an intent contract and a provenance policy. On a synthetic benchmark of 200 attacks (oracle intent and injection labels, declared roles), attack success falls from 50.5% with provenance alone to 12.0% [8.2-17.2%]; every remaining success alters a content or payload field. IntentFlow wrongly blocks none of 200 paired benign tasks and 4 of 50 hard ones. On 50 trusted-but-unauthorized attacks, provenance-only mediation executes all 50 and IntentFlow none; a CaMeL-style check also blocks all 50 but rejects 16 of 50 benign tasks. On an offline AgentDojo-derived replay, IntentFlow blocks all 20 attacks at 75% benign success, as does a CaMeL-style check; a Progent-style allowlist blocks 19 and keeps all benign tasks. With one live planner and the same oracles, the mediator blocked all 17 corrupted calls proposed in 110 attacks.

AI.tldr: IntentFlow 在规划器与工具之间加入中介层，同时用意图契约和来源策略校验每个携带权限的参数，把攻击成功率从仅用来源策略的 50.5% 降到 12.0%，且几乎不误伤良性任务。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体把用户请求与检索内容转成工具调用，调用可能落到错误接收者、端点、文件或参与者。仅靠参数级来源追踪只能阻断来自不可信内容的值，却会接受"可信但用户从未请求"的值（如来自可信但越权的上下文），形成授权缺口。
AI.method: 提出 IntentFlow：作为未修改规划器与其工具之间的中介层，对每个携带权限的参数同时依据"意图契约"（用户实际请求了什么）与"来源策略"（值的可信来源）进行判定拦截。在 200 例攻击的合成基准（含 oracle 意图与注入标签、声明角色）上评估，并对比仅来源中介、CaMeL 风格检查、Progent 风格白名单；另在 AgentDojo 衍生的离线回放及单活规划器设置下验证。
AI.result: 合成基准上攻击成功率由仅来源策略的 50.5% 降至 12.0%[8.2–17.2%]，残余成功均篡改了内容或载荷字段；200 个配对良性任务零误拦，50 个困难任务误拦 4 个。50 例"可信但未授权"攻击中，仅来源中介全部执行、IntentFlow 全拦，CaMeL 风格检查亦全拦但误拒 16/50 良性任务。AgentDojo 回放中 IntentFlow 拦下全部 20 次攻击、良性成功率 75%，CaMeL 风格检查相同，Progent 风格白名单拦 19 次且良性全通。单活规划器、110 次攻击下，中介层拦下全部 17 次被污染的调用。
AI.conclusion: 将意图校验与来源策略结合，可弥补仅来源中介在"可信但越权"场景下的盲区，在保持高良性任务通过率的同时显著降低攻击成功率；但离线回放与白名单方法的对比显示其优势并非在所有场景下都显著。

title: PIAE: Physics-Informed Continuous Autoencoding for Compact 3D Human Motion
summary: Temporal compression reduces the sequence length that motion generators must model, but can damage articulated detail and global trajectory. These errors have unequal consequences: root-velocity and heading errors propagate through trajectory recovery and affect the placement of the entire body. We propose PIAE, a physics-informed continuous autoencoder that allocates a fixed token budget between explicitly retained kinematic signals and complementary learned features. At 8 x temporal compression, each 256-dimensional token contains 224 learned values and a 32-dimensional physical carrier. The complete token conditions neural decoding, while a parallel recovery path constrains selected outputs. On the official HumanML3D benchmark, PIAE achieves 8.936 mm global MPJPE, an 82.0% reduction relative to a same-width learned-only model. The benefit extends beyond trajectory restoration: facing-local neural-body error before analytical correction decreases by 76.6% in a frozen-checkpoint validation diagnostic, and supplying the same true trajectory to both models preserves the body-quality advantage. Targeted root-only and explicit-root hybrid controls establish strong trajectory-aware comparisons; alternative carriers reveal that torso references favor position accuracy, whereas stance anchors favor support quality. With the original 8 x AEs frozen, matched text-to-motion generators predict every carrier value and improve FID from 0.506 to 0.163. Frozen reconstruction also transfers to AIST++ without adaptation. The compressed carrier interface reduces measured generation time by 27.8% relative to its 1 x counterpart. Together, these findings demonstrate that selective preservation can use a fixed representation budget more effectively, improving neural articulated reconstruction and downstream generation in compact human motion.

AI.tldr: 提出PIAE——一种物理信息驱动的连续自编码器，在固定token预算下显式保留运动学信号（根速度/朝向）并融合学习特征，从而在8×时间压缩下大幅降低轨迹误差并提升下游生成质量。
AI.motivation: 时间压缩虽能缩短运动生成器需建模的序列长度，但会损害关节细节与全局轨迹；且不同误差后果不对等——根速度与朝向误差会经由轨迹恢复传播，影响整个人体的定位，因此需在压缩表示中区别对待。
AI.method: 将固定token预算划分为显式保留的运动学信号与互补的学习特征：8×压缩下每个256维token含224维学习值与32维“物理载体”；完整token用于条件化解码，并行恢复路径约束特定输出。设置仅根节点、显式根混合等对照，并比较不同载体（躯干参考 vs 支撑锚点）。
AI.result: HumanML3D官方基准上全局MPJPE达8.936 mm，较同宽度纯学习模型降低82.0%；冻结检查点诊断中，解析校正前的朝向局部神经人体误差下降76.6%；向两模型提供相同真实轨迹时身体质量优势仍保持。冻结8×AE后，匹配的文本到运动生成器可预测全部载体值，FID由0.506降至0.163；冻结重建可无适配迁移至AIST++；压缩载体接口使生成时间较1×版本减少27.8%。
AI.conclusion: 选择性保留能更有效地利用固定表示预算，在紧凑人体运动表示中同时改善神经关节重建与下游生成，并降低生成时延。

title: Tracing Attacker Diversity Reduction in Adaptive LLM Red Teaming
summary: Reinforcement learning can increase the success of automated red teaming but it also narrows the attack vector. This study asks where in the attacker-defender-judge learning loop does the narrowing begin and which mechanisms lead to a narrowing attack. Six mechanisms (defender adaptation, success edge, reward reinforcement, row cap, update size, and measurement) are tested across three experiment arms (co-trained, frozen defender, half learning rate) for twenty-four iterations. A frozen defender narrows attack diversity retention (ADR) earlier 0.496 relative to co-trained 0.891 at iteration twelve. Defender updates delay narrowing but dont prevent it. Successful attacks ("winners") have narrower attack diversity than the full set of generated attacks. Attacks closest to previous winners succeed 10-15 percentage points more often than those closest to previous failures. This winner-neighbor advantage holds after a defender update and for a fixed defender too. Attacks with a common opening have a common-opening advantage of 5-16 percentage points. The training row cap and update size account for little impact on ADR, and attack length accounts for only part of the ADR decrease. Narrowing appears to originate from the success only reward through the group-relative training advantage to the attacker update, with a persistent success edge setting the direction.

AI.tldr: 该研究定位了自动化红队强化学习中攻击向量收窄的起点与机制：收窄主要源于"仅奖励成功"通过组相对训练优势传导至攻击者更新，而持续的成功优势决定收窄方向。
AI.motivation: 强化学习虽能提升自动化红队攻击成功率，但会收窄攻击向量多样性。论文旨在探究收窄在"攻击者—防御者—评判者"学习回路中的起始位置及驱动机制。
AI.method: 在三个实验臂（协同训练、冻结防御者、半学习率）下进行二十四轮迭代，检验六种机制：防御者适应、成功优势、奖励强化、行数上限、更新幅度与测量方式。通过统计成功攻击与全部生成攻击的多样性差异、邻近先前成功样本的成功率提升、共同开头优势等进行机制分析。
AI.result: 冻结防御者使攻击多样性保留率（ADR）更早收窄（第十二轮0.496，协同训练为0.891）；防御者更新延迟但无法阻止收窄。成功攻击（"赢家"）多样性低于全部生成攻击；与先前成功样本最接近的攻击成功率高出10–15个百分点，且该优势在防御者更新后及固定防御者下依然存在。共同开头攻击具5–16个百分点优势。行数上限与更新幅度对ADR影响甚微，攻击长度仅解释部分下降。
AI.conclusion: 收窄起源于"仅奖励成功"机制，经组相对训练优势作用于攻击者更新，而持续存在的成功优势设定收窄方向；防御者适应等因素为次要或延迟性作用。

title: DexLatentWorld: 3D Cross-Embodiment Latent Action World Models for Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation
summary: World models facilitate planning and control in robotic manipulation by enabling agents to anticipate the consequences of their actions. However, they typically rely on action-labelled interaction data that is costly to acquire and difficult to scale. These models are also often tied to the specific embodiment they were trained on, limiting transferability to previously unseen robot morphologies. We introduce a 3D latent-action world model that learns continuous action representations directly from point-cloud observations of retargeted human manipulation demonstrations. A contrastive objective is used to encourage consistent representations of motion across embodiments. The resulting unified latent action space serves directly as the search space for model-predictive control, where sampled latent actions condition particle-based future predictions. Executable robot commands are then recovered from the predicted geometric motion without requiring an embodiment-specific action decoder. Through extensive evaluations, we demonstrate that the learned latent actions exhibit controllable and compositional motion, transfer to unseen robot embodiments, and support zero-shot manipulation with unseen gripper geometries. Following task-agnostic adaptation, our model achieves 90%, 92%, and 60% success on reaching, grasping, and placing, respectively, compared with DexWM's reported 72%, 58%, and 28%. Finally, we demonstrate zero-shot real-world manipulation with an unseen dexterous hand, achieving an 86% success rate across 50 trials on five diverse tasks involving pushing, grasping, and lifting everyday objects. These results highlight the potential of geometry-grounded latent actions as a unified, transferable interface for world-model-based robotic manipulation. Project materials, including demonstration videos and source code, are available at https://vinaymohan0409.github.io/DexLatentWorld/.

AI.tldr: 提出一种三维潜动作世界模型，从重定向的人类操作演示点云中学习连续动作表示，无需动作标签，潜动作空间可直接作为模型预测控制的搜索空间，并跨本体迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型依赖成本高、难扩展的动作标注交互数据，且与训练时的特定本体绑定，难以迁移到未见过的机器人形态。
AI.method: 基于点云观测学习3D潜动作表示；采用对比目标鼓励跨本体运动表示一致性；以潜动作作为MPC搜索空间，采样潜动作条件化粒子式未来预测；从预测的几何运动反解可执行机器人指令，无需本体专属动作解码器；并进行任务无关适配。
AI.result: 潜动作具备可控性与组合性，可迁移至未见本体并支持未见夹爪几何的零样本操作；适配后在reach/grasp/place上分别达90%/92%/60%（DexWM为72%/58%/28%）；真实世界未见灵巧手50次试验五类任务零样本成功率86%。
AI.conclusion: 几何接地的潜动作可作为世界模型驱动机器人操作的可迁移统一接口。

title: SchemaCaps: When a Compatible Tool Update Silently Widens an AI Agent's Authority
comment: Author's accepted version (without the publisher's layout). Accepted at ICAART 2027; final version published by SCITEPRESS. Artefact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24233014
summary: The tools users approve for their AI agents keep changing their JSON input schemas. Of 8 surveyed MCP clients and scanners, none is observed or documented to re-approve a tool whose input schema widens (two not determinable). We define non-amplification over the coordinates visible in the schema (declared arguments and undeclared fields, on effective values) and a re-binding rule decided by subschema inclusion, trusting no field labels by default and conservative up to its checker and tested case analysis. Evidence: a Coq proof of composition; 48 regression tests; an exact-reference benchmark, where the reviewed version of the rule silently re-bound 27 amplifying changes, now fixed; and a pilot on 604 releases of 39 public MCP servers. There, 412 of 580 compatible schema changes widen some coordinate, yet compatibility re-binds them silently. The authors' adjudicated double annotation finds at least 76 that add or widen an authority-bearing argument (66 of the 84 a name-based labeller flags, plus 10 it misses). On existing tools, the rule asks 645 re-approvals, against 1,197 for pinning the input schema (2,004 with descriptions) and 617 for compatibility. Behaviour change behind an identical schema remains out of reach.

AI.tldr: 论文关注AI代理工具JSON输入模式在用户批准后静默变更的安全风险，提出"非放大"（non-amplification）定义与基于子模式包含的重绑定（re-binding）规则，并给出Coq组合性证明、回归测试、精确基准与604个真实发布版本的实证。
AI.motivation: 用户批准的AI代理工具会持续修改其JSON输入模式；调查的8个MCP客户端/扫描器中无一被观察到或记载会对"输入模式放宽"的工具重新审批。这意味着放宽权限的变更可静默获得重绑定，形成权限放大的安全隐患。
AI.method: 1) 在模式可见坐标（声明参数与未声明字段，均基于有效值）上定义"非放大"；2) 以子模式包含关系判定是否需重新绑定，默认不信任字段标签，保守程度受检查器与已测用例分析界定；3) 用Coq证明组合性，48个回归测试与精确参考基准验证；4) 在39个公开MCP服务器的604个发布版本上做试点，并进行双人裁定式标注。
AI.result: 基准中经评审的规则旧版本曾静默重绑定27个放大性变更（现已修复）。真实试点中，580个兼容性模式变更里有412个放宽了某坐标却仍被静默重绑定；双标注至少识别出76个新增或放宽"权限承载参数"的变更（其中66个为基于名称的标注器标出，另有10个其遗漏）。在现有工具上，新规则要求645次重新审批，对比固定输入模式为1,197次（含描述为2,004次），兼容性判据为617次。
AI.conclusion: 基于子模式包含的重绑定规则能在可接受的重审批开销（645次，仅略高于兼容性判据的617次，远低于固定模式的1,197次）下，消除因模式放宽导致的静默权限放大。局限在于：同一模式背后的行为变化仍无法覆盖。

title: XShot: Cross-Shot Video Object Insertion from a Reference Video
summary: We present XShot, a framework for cross-shot video object insertion, which adds objects to a shot by watching another shot of the same scene. Video productions show a scene through many shots, and objects added to one shot must appear consistently in the others. Most video editors take the appearance of new objects from reference images and their location from a text prompt, a mask or an edited keyframe, leaving this consistency to the user. XShot reads both from a reference video of another shot, which need not be aligned with the target, and needs no mask, box or camera pose. We build on a video Diffusion Transformer and formulate the task as in-context generation over the reference video, a few images of the objects and the target video. A geometry-aware cross-shot attention estimates the epipolar geometry between the two shots from the model's own correspondences and uses it to guide where the target reads the reference and the exemplars. We train XShot with an erase-and-restore data engine: objects are erased from one shot of a film or a multi-camera recording and restored from another shot of the scene. Experiments show that XShot places objects more accurately and renders them more faithfully than open-source and commercial video editors, while leaving the rest of the shot intact.

AI.tldr: XShot 提出跨镜头视频物体插入框架：从同一场景的另一个（无需对齐的）镜头获取物体外观与位置，无需掩码、框或相机位姿，通过几何感知的跨镜头注意力与擦除-恢复数据引擎实现精准插入。
AI.motivation: 视频通过多个镜头呈现同一场景，加入某一镜头的新物体必须在其他镜头中保持一致。现有视频编辑工具通常从参考图像取外观、从文本/掩码/编辑关键帧取位置，一致性需用户自行保证。
AI.method: 基于视频 Diffusion Transformer，将任务建模为对参考视频、少量物体图像与目标视频的 in-context 生成；提出几何感知跨镜头注意力，利用模型自身对应关系估计两镜头间对极几何，引导目标从参考与示例中读取信息；采用 erase-and-restore 数据引擎训练（从影片或多机位录制的一个镜头擦除物体、从另一镜头恢复）。
AI.result: 相比开源与商业视频编辑器，XShot 物体放置更准确、渲染更忠实，同时保持镜头其余内容不变。
AI.conclusion: XShot 表明无需掩码、框或相机位姿，仅凭另一镜头即可实现外观与位置一致的高质量跨镜头物体插入，为视频制作中的多镜头一致性编辑提供了自动化方案。

title: Training Dynamics of Large State-Transition Models
summary: Next-token prediction relies on learned token embeddings whose dimension $d$ is much smaller than the vocabulary size $V$. Existing analyses of training dynamics either fix the embeddings with $d\ge V$ or train them only in restricted settings. It remains unclear whether jointly training the embeddings by gradient-based methods from random initialization leads to accurate prediction when $d<V$.
