In this paper, we study this question in the simplest setting where it is already nontrivial, namely next-token prediction with a one-token context, which we refer to as a state-transition model. The model consists of an input embedding and an output embedding, either untied or tied, and is trained from Gaussian initialization by perturbed gradient descent with weight decay on the population cross-entropy loss. We consider ground-truth transition laws whose centered log-probability table has low rank and bounded entries, and measure the prediction quality by the relative prediction gain (RPG). It is zero for the uniform predictor and one for the optimal predictor. For the untied model, we show that when $d=Ω(\sqrt V)$, with probability at least $1-e^{-cd}$ for some constant $c$, the RPG is above $7/8$ at every iterate in the final $1-1/d$ fraction of training iterations. For the tied model trained on a subset of states, we prove that the RPG on the observed states is $1-O(V/d^2)$, and under a coverage condition on the ground truth and a bound on the learned embeddings, we further prove a prediction guarantee on the unseen states. Our analysis is based on the bounded trace of the Hessian of the softmax cross-entropy loss, which implies that the approximate second-order stationary points reached by training have high prediction gain. Numerical experiments with practical parameter choices illustrate the persistent training gain and the transfer of the tied model.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析在 d<V 时，从高斯初始化出发对输入/输出嵌入联合训练（扰动梯度下降+权重衰减）能否实现准确的下一个 token 预测；在单 token 上下文的状态转移模型上给出了 d=Ω(√V) 时非绑定模型的 RPG>7/8 保证，以及绑定模型在已观测状态上 RPG=1-O(V/d²) 并可在覆盖条件下泛化到未观测状态。
AI.motivation: 现有训练动力学分析要么固定嵌入并要求 d≥V，要么只在受限设定下训练嵌入；当嵌入维度 d 远小于词表大小 V 时，联合训练嵌入能否从随机初始化收敛到准确预测仍不清楚。作者选择最简单但已非平凡的单 token 上下文（状态转移模型）作为切入点。
AI.method: 模型由输入嵌入与输出嵌入构成（绑定或不绑定），从高斯初始化用带权重衰减的扰动梯度下降在总体交叉熵损失上训练。假设真实转移律的中心化对数概率表低秩且元素有界，用相对预测增益（RPG，均匀预测为0、最优为1）衡量预测质量。核心分析工具是 softmax 交叉熵 Hessian 的迹有界，从而推出训练所达近似二阶稳定点具有高预测增益。
AI.result: 非绑定模型：当 d=Ω(√V) 时，以至少 1-e^{-cd} 的概率，在训练最后 1-1/d 比例的每个迭代点 RPG 均高于 7/8。绑定模型在状态子集上训练时，已观测状态上的 RPG 为 1-O(V/d²)；在真实分布满足覆盖条件且学习到的嵌入有界时，可进一步给出未观测状态上的预测保证。数值实验验证了持续的训练增益与绑定模型的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 即使 d<V，从随机初始化联合训练嵌入也能获得高预测质量，且所需维度仅为 d=Ω(√V)；绑定嵌入在有限状态上训练后可泛化至未见状态。Hessian 迹有界是连接优化动力学与预测性能的关键，为理解嵌入训练提供了可扩展的分析框架。

title: CoSel: Cooperation as Selection for End-to-End Driving
summary: Cooperative driving can extend a vehicle's awareness beyond its own sensors, but existing cooperative end-to-end methods inject shared information into the planner and rely on cooperative driving demonstrations to learn how to use it. The moments in which shared information should change a driving decision are rare in such data, providing limited supervision for learning this behavior. We argue that cooperation need not be learned by the planner. Instead, reacting to shared information requires predicting how surrounding agents will move and selecting a response from the candidate trajectories of an ego planner. We introduce CoSel, a cooperation-as-selection framework that leaves the planner and its ego-only input unchanged. A separately trained cooperative predictor uses observations from the ego vehicle, roadside units, and connected automated vehicles to predict surrounding agents and their future motion. CoSel evaluates the planner's candidate trajectories against these predictions, preserves the planner's choice when it remains safe, and selects the closest safe alternative when shared information reveals additional risk. Each safety intervention is traceable to the shared evidence that triggers it. In closed-loop evaluation, CoSel achieves a driving score of 70.7 on V2Xverse, outperforming the best compared cooperative method by 7.5 points, and the highest average driving score of 85.8 on MDrive. Under missing ego detections, the collision count of CoSel increases only from 17 to 19 in 72 scenarios, compared with 19 to 32 for an existing cooperative end-to-end model.

AI.tldr: 提出 CoSel：一种"协同即选择"框架，保持原自车规划器与其单车输入不变，由独立训练的协同预测器利用自车、路侧单元和网联自动驾驶车辆的观测预测周边智能体及其未来运动，再在规划器候选轨迹中做安全筛选与替换，从而将协同信息转化为可追溯的安全干预。
AI.motivation: 现有协同端到端方法把共享信息注入规划器，并依赖协同驾驶示范来学习如何使用这些信息；但真正需要共享信息改变驾驶决策的时刻在数据中极为稀少，导致该行为缺乏有效监督信号。作者据此主张：协同能力不必由规划器"学习"，而应由预测+选择来"实现"。
AI.method: 1) 规划器及其仅含自车的输入完全保持不变；2) 单独训练协同预测器，融合自车、路侧单元（RSU）与网联自动驾驶车辆（CAV）的观测，输出周边智能体识别及未来运动预测；3) 用这些预测评估规划器给出的候选轨迹：若干预后规划器选择仍安全，则保留其原选择；若共享信息揭示额外风险，则选取最接近原选择的可行安全替代轨迹；4) 每次安全干预均可追溯到触发它的共享证据（可解释性）。
AI.result: 闭环评测中，CoSel 在 V2Xverse 上取得 70.7 的驾驶分数，比最佳对比协同方法高 7.5 分；在 MDrive 上取得最高平均驾驶分数 85.8。在自车检测缺失情形下，72 个场景中 CoSel 碰撞数仅由 17 增至 19，而某现有协同端到端模型由 19 增至 32，显示出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将协同重新表述为"预测+候选轨迹选择"而非端到端注入，可在不重训规划器的前提下有效利用 V2X 共享信息，兼顾性能、鲁棒性与可追溯性，为该问题提供了模块化、低耦合的替代范式。

title: GameDojo: Benchmarking Real-Time Interactive Agents in Video Games
comment: 28 pages. Project page: https://gamedojo-benchmark.github.io/ , and code: https://github.com/THUSI-Lab/GameDojo
summary: Interactive intelligence requires agents to act on observations and adapt to the consequences of actions. Studying these abilities calls for diverse, challenging tasks under controlled conditions. We introduce GameDojo, a controllable interactive gameplay benchmark of 120 boss encounters across 20 games for evaluating model capabilities, learning algorithms, and agent harnesses. Coding agents reconstruct the environments and write gameplay scripts, producing GameDojo-Data with 600 hours of gameplay trajectories. Experiments reveal substantial challenges for frontier models, especially in real-time interaction. Training on GameDojo-Data brings GameDojo-4B to frontier performance, with the strongest real-time performance. We also find joint training improves individual tasks, and learned policies transfer across bosses. Together, these findings establish GameDojo as a challenging and valuable interactive gameplay benchmark for the community. Our project page is at https://gamedojo-benchmark.github.io/ , and our code is at https://github.com/THUSI-Lab/GameDojo .

AI.tldr: 提出 GameDojo——涵盖20款游戏、120个Boss战的可控交互式游戏基准，用于评测模型能力、学习算法与智能体框架，并构建600小时轨迹数据集 GameDojo-Data；实验显示前沿模型在实时交互上仍显著不足，用该数据训练的 GameDojo-4B 达到前沿水平且实时性能最佳，并发现联合训练与策略跨Boss迁移的收益。
AI.motivation: 交互智能要求智能体基于观测行动并从行动后果中自适应学习，但现有评测缺乏在可控条件下、多样化且具有挑战性的任务集合，难以系统衡量模型能力、学习算法与智能体框架的综合表现。
AI.method: 构建 GameDojo 基准：由编码智能体重建20款游戏的120个Boss战环境并编写对战脚本，形成可控的交互式游戏评测平台；同时由智能体产生共600小时的游戏轨迹，构成 GameDojo-Data 数据集，并基于该数据训练 GameDojo-4B 模型。
AI.result: 前沿模型在该基准上表现存在明显短板，尤其在实时交互场景；在 GameDojo-Data 上训练的 GameDojo-4B 达到前沿模型水平，并具备最强的实时交互表现；进一步发现联合训练能提升单项任务性能，学习到的策略可在不同Boss间迁移。
AI.conclusion: GameDojo 是一个具有挑战性且有价值的交互式游戏基准，可用于评测模型、学习算法与智能体框架，并支持通过轨迹数据训练与策略迁移研究，为社区提供可控的实验平台与公开代码与项目页。

title: Learning Land-Surface Hydrology World Model from Satellite Observations
summary: A world model should tell us not only what will happen, but what would happen under a different action. Learned Earth models now forecast remarkably well, yet forecast skill says little about what their state means or how it responds to a changed driver. We build LandWM, a world model of land-surface water in which rain is the action, learned from seven years of SMAP and CYGNSS observations: physical observation operators tie its latent state to soil water, and a mass-conserving balance governs how that state responds to rain. Over the U.S. Southern Great Plains, the model, never shown a soil-moisture value, tracks 28 in-situ probes as well as the operational SMAP Level-4 product, even from CYGNSS alone, and a storm added to the forcing of a station's cell wets its soil as natural storms wet the probes. Replace either piece and the forecasts stay, but the meaning goes: with neural operators, only a probe fitted to the stations finds the soil water; with a generic recurrent transition, rain on a single cell barely moves it. Yet when the same rain covers the whole region the two transitions swap roles, and the conserving one responds too weakly. Grounding makes a world model readable; its response to actions must be tested under more than one kind of intervention.

AI.tldr: LandWM 是以降雨为“动作”、由 SMAP 与 CYGNSS 观测学习的陆面水世界模型：用物理观测算子把潜状态绑定到土壤水，用质量守恒平衡方程刻画状态对降雨的响应。它在南大平原可媲美业务化 SMAP L4 产品，并能在人为注入风暴时产生符合物理的土壤增湿响应；替换任一组件后预测精度仍在，但状态“意义”丧失，且不同干预尺度下两种转移函数表现反转。
AI.motivation: 现有地球系统学习模型只追求预测技巧，而预测准确并不说明其内部状态表征什么、以及对驱动变化（如降雨）如何响应。作者提出“可读性”要求：世界模型不仅要预知会发生什么，还要能回答“若采取不同动作会怎样”，因此需要可解释、受物理约束的状态与动作响应机制。
AI.method: 构建 LandWM：以降雨作为动作，基于 7 年 SMAP（土壤水分）与 CYGNSS（地表反射率/海面风速类观测用于土壤水反演）数据学习潜状态；用物理观测算子将潜状态映射为土壤水分观测，并用质量守恒的水量平衡方程约束状态对降雨的转移；在美国南大平原以 28 个地面探针做验证；并做消融式替换实验（用神经算子替代观测算子、用通用循环转移替代守恒转移），以及两类干预检验（单格点风暴注入 vs 全区域降雨）。
AI.result: 模型从未直接见过土壤水分数值，却在 28 个原位探针上与业务化 SMAP Level-4 产品精度相当，甚至仅用 CYGNSS 亦可达到；对站点所在格点强制注入风暴，其土壤增湿幅度与自然风暴下探针响应一致。消融显示：替换观测算子或转移函数后预测技巧基本保持，但状态语义丢失——用神经算子时只有对站点拟合的探针才能读出土壤水，用通用循环转移时单格点降雨几乎不改变状态。反过来，当同一降雨覆盖全区时二者角色互换，守恒转移反而响应过弱。
AI.conclusion: 物理接地使世界模型“可读”，但预测精度不足以检验其动作响应；必须考察不同尺度与类型的行为干预。单一干预方式会误导结论：单格点扰动下表现良好的守恒模型在区域尺度上响应不足。因此评估世界模型应结合多类干预（局部与区域、单点与全局）来检验其因果响应一致性。

title: Damped Atomic Wave Integration Neurons (DAWIN): A Universal Primitive for Continuous-Time Spatiotemporal Learning
summary: Conventional artificial neurons separate spatial feature aggregation from continuous physical time, limiting their ability to model irregular observations. We introduce the Damped Atomic Wave Integration Neuron (DAWIN), a continuous-time primitive for replacing standard neural layers in MLPs, Transformers, and graph neural networks. DAWIN couples spatial projection with elapsed-time-dependent wave excitation and integrates it into a local complex state through closed-form damped evolution, avoiding numerical differential equation solvers. We show that DAWIN generalizes static sinusoidal and memoryless wave neurons on interval-augmented inputs, derive closed-form gradients, and establish bounded-input bounded-output stability for positive damping and sampling intervals bounded away from zero. An associative Triton prefix-scan implementation, DAWINLinear, uses FP32 accumulation and achieves O(log L) parallel depth for sequence length L. Across 11 parameter-matched tasks covering irregular oscillators, MuJoCo dynamics, pedestrian trajectories, and PhysioNet 2012 clinical sequences, DAWIN outperforms Neural CDE on 9 tasks and ReLU-MLP on 8. It achieves the lowest error on dense clinical dynamics (0.9531 NRMSE, winning across all 10 seeds) and ties for the best mortality prediction (0.9993 AUROC). Shuffling elapsed intervals increases error by 58.2%-77.4% on selected dynamics tasks, versus 0.06% on a time-irrelevant control, supporting reliance on physical timing. On NVIDIA B200 GPUs, parallel wave integration accelerates inference by up to 2,630 times over its serial implementation and reduces peak GPU memory by up to 97.6% relative to Mamba in the tested configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出阻尼原子波积分神经元DAWIN——一种耦合空间投影与时间依赖波激发的连续时间神经元原语，用闭式阻尼演化替代ODE求解器，可替换MLP/Transformer/GNN中的标准层。
AI.motivation: 传统人工神经元将空间特征聚合与连续物理时间分离，难以建模不规则采样观测；而Neural CDE等连续时间方法依赖数值微分方程求解器，代价高、并行性差。
AI.method: DAWIN将空间投影与依赖经过时间的波激发耦合，经闭式阻尼演化积分进局部复数状态，无需ODE求解器；理论上证明其推广区间增广输入上的静态正弦神经元与无记忆波神经元，推导闭式梯度，并在正阻尼、采样间隔有下界条件下证明BIBO稳定性；实现DWINLinear关联Triton前缀扫描，FP32累积，O(log L)并行深度。
AI.result: 在11个参数匹配任务（不规则振子、MuJoCo动力学、行人轨迹、PhysioNet 2012）上，9项优于Neural CDE、8项优于ReLU-MLP；密集临床动力学NRMSE 0.9531（10个种子全胜），死亡率预测AUROC 0.9993并列最佳；打乱时间间隔使误差上升58.2%–77.4%，时间无关对照仅0.06%；B200上推理较串行实现加速最高2,630倍，峰值显存较Mamba降低97.6%。
AI.conclusion: DAWIN以闭式连续时间演化兼顾不规则时间建模、理论稳定性与高效并行实现，在精度、时间敏感性及显存/速度效率上均具优势，是可嵌入主流架构的通用神经元替代方案。

title: Personalization of a Commercial Powered Knee Prosthesis Under Clinically Realistic Conditions via Reinforcement Learning: A Feasibility Study
summary: Personalization of powered prosthesis control to individual user needs remains a significant challenge. To address this challenge, policy iteration with constraint embedded (PICE), a reinforcement learning (RL) tuning approach, has been developed and validated. This feasibility study investigated whether the developed approach can personalize a commercial powered knee prosthesis under clinically realistic conditions. To reduce the time for personalization, tuning was initialized with a policy learned offline from one non-disabled participant walking on a treadmill and was then applied to three other non-disabled participants walking with the knee through a bypass adapter on a 5-meter walkway. All participants reached the goal within 8-18 tuning steps (1.7-4.2 minutes of walking), reducing the knee-kinematic feature error by 64-90% on average. These results support the feasibility of implementing the RL-based tuning approach in clinically realistic conditions with space and equipment constraints.

AI.tldr: 该可行性研究验证了带约束的策略迭代（PICE）强化学习调参方法，能在临床现实条件下（5米走道、腰膝适配器）为商用动力膝关节假肢实现个性化控制，3名受试者均在8–18步调参（1.7–4.2分钟步行）内达到目标，膝关节运动学特征误差平均降低64–90%。
AI.motivation: 动力假肢控制个性化到个体用户需求仍是显著挑战；此前已开发并验证了PICE方法，但尚不清楚其在真实临床环境（空间与设备受限）中能否对商用假肢进行个性化调参。
AI.method: 采用带约束嵌入的策略迭代（PICE）强化学习调参方法。为缩短个性化时间，先用一名非残障受试者在跑步机上的行走数据离线学习初始策略，再以该策略为初值，应用于另外三名非残障受试者，通过旁路适配器佩戴商用动力膝关节假肢，在5米走道上行走进行在线调参。
AI.result: 所有受试者均在8–18次调参步内（对应1.7–4.2分钟步行）达到目标，膝关节运动学特征误差平均降低64–90%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将基于强化学习的调参方法部署到受空间与设备约束的临床现实条件中的可行性；离线预训练策略可有效缩短在线个性化时间。

title: Unpacking the Evaluators: How Configuration Shapes the Evaluation of Alignment in Explainable AI
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track
summary: Explainable AI (XAI) evaluation fundamentally requires human-centered evaluation, assessing whether explanations align with human reasoning and expert knowledge. However, such evaluations often require expert-driven manual validation and are difficult to scale, leading to the widespread use of alignment-based metrics, where attribution maps are compared against predefined ground-truth (GT) representations. Despite their popularity, alignment evaluations are implicitly bias towards multiple design choices made during the evaluation process, for example GT representations, metric families, metric formulations (soft vs. hard), and thresholding strategies. In this paper, we formalize alignment evaluation as a structured evaluation configuration space through which the influence of these design choices can be systematically analyzed. We further introduce a structured alignment evaluation framework that models interactions between XAI methods, GT representations, metric families, metric formulations, and thresholding strategies across 2D and 3D synthetic and real-world datasets. In addition, we propose a novel taxonomy of XAI output behavior based on local entropy and boundary mass ratio, enabling structured characterization of attribution patterns for alignment evaluation. Our experiments reveal systematic flows (triples of XAI-GT-metric configurations), showing that alignment outcomes provide distinct behavior patterns under certain configurations, such as soft/hard metric implementations. We further observe varying levels of threshold sensitivity across metric families and attribution structures. These findings demonstrate that alignment evaluation cannot be treated as a fixed or invariant measure of explanation quality, and provide practical guidance for designing more reliable and behavior-aware XAI evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: 该文将XAI的"对齐评估"形式化为一个结构化的评估配置空间，系统分析GT表示、度量族、度量形式（soft/hard）与阈值策略等设计选择对评估结论的影响，并提出基于局部熵与边界质量比的XAI输出行为分类法，揭示对齐评估并非解释质量的不变度量。
AI.motivation: 可解释AI（XAI）评估本质上应以人为中心，检验解释是否符合人类推理与专家知识；但专家人工验证成本高、难以规模化，实践中广泛改用对齐式度量（将归因图与预定义ground-truth比较）。然而现有对齐评估隐含地偏向评估过程中多项设计选择（GT表示、度量族、度量形式、阈值策略），其影响缺乏系统分析，导致评估结论的可比性与可靠性存疑。
AI.method: (1) 将对齐评估形式化为一个结构化的"评估配置空间"，使各设计选择的影响可被系统化分析；(2) 提出结构化对齐评估框架，在2D与3D、合成与真实数据集上建模XAI方法、GT表示、度量族、度量形式与阈值策略之间的交互；(3) 提出基于局部熵与边界质量比（boundary mass ratio）的新型XAI输出行为分类法，用于刻画归因模式以支撑对齐评估。
AI.result: 实验揭示存在系统性的"流程/流"（XAI–GT–度量三元配置）：在某些配置下（如soft与hard度量实现）对齐结果呈现截然不同的行为模式；同时观察到不同度量族与归因结构下存在不同程度的阈值敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 对齐评估不能被视作解释质量的固定或不变度量；研究为设计更可靠、具备行为感知能力的XAI评估协议提供了实践指导。

title: What the Background Hides: Thresholds, Vocabularies and Collisions in Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
comment: 33 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables. Submitted to Computer Vision and Image Understanding. Code: https://github.com/WendongYao/ovss-background-audit ; data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24338613
summary: Training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) built on CLIP has advanced rapidly, with methods typically ranked by mean intersection-over-union (mIoU) across standard benchmarks. On datasets with a background class, however, implementations rely on per-dataset thresholds and background word lists that are rarely documented or unified (11 of 13 surveyed methods configure per-dataset background decisions). We audit configurations and papers of 13 training-free OVSS methods, re-run seven from official codebases, and compare official settings against a strict unified protocol under pre-registered contracts. The protocol gap depends strongly on the benchmark---ranging from 22.8 mIoU points on PASCAL VOC (VOC21) to 0.1 points (indistinguishable from zero) on ADE20K---and alters pairwise method rankings. Despite large shifts in absolute mIoU, most of the reported improvement of later CLIP-only methods over SCLIP remains under the unified protocol (roughly 79% of the published gain). Decomposing official background handling shows that it combines numeric settings and class-name files whose dominant component reverses across benchmarks, while no tested tuning-free rule transfers reliably across all datasets. Moreover, exact collisions between background words and target names---present in six of seven official COCO-Object configurations through "bed"---make affected classes unpredictable under official post-processing, while the main per-class drops under language-model-generated vocabularies on VOC21 are largely attributable to a few generated terms. We offer reporting recommendations and release our evaluation code, frozen configurations, contracts, and a collision-check tool.

AI.tldr: 训练无关开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）基于CLIP的方法通常以mIoU排名，但背景类处理依赖未统一的逐数据集阈值和背景词表。本文审计13种方法、复跑7个官方代码库，在预注册协议下比较官方设置与严格统一协议，量化"协议差距"，并分析背景处理构成与背景词碰撞问题。
AI.motivation: 现有训练无关OVSS方法在以mIoU排名时，对有背景类的数据集依赖极少公开或统一的逐数据集阈值与背景词表（13种方法中11种采用逐数据集背景决策），导致结论可比性与可复现性存疑，因此需要审计并量化官方设置与统一协议之间的差距。
AI.method: 审计13种训练无关OVSS方法的配置与论文，基于官方代码库复跑其中7种；在预注册契约下对比官方设置与严格统一协议；分解官方背景处理为数值设置与类名文件两部分，检验免调参规则的可迁移性；检测背景词与目标类名精确碰撞，并分析语言模型生成词表在VOC21上的逐类下降来源。
AI.result: 协议差距高度依赖基准：PASCAL VOC（VOC21）达22.8 mIoU点，ADE20K仅0.1点（与零不可区分），并改变方法两两排名。绝对mIoU虽有大幅变动，后续纯CLIP方法相对SCLIP的已发表增益在统一协议下仍保留约79%。背景处理的主导成分随基准反转；无免调参规则可跨数据集可靠迁移。7个官方COCO-Object配置中有6个因"bed"造成背景词与目标类名精确碰撞，使受影响类在官方后处理下不可预测；VOC21上使用语言模型生成词表的主要逐类下降可归因于少数生成词。
AI.conclusion: 当前OVSS评测结论受背景处理配置显著影响，方法排名与mIoU数值在统一协议下会变化，但CLIP-only方法的主要进展基本稳健。作者提出报告规范，并发布评测代码、冻结配置、契约及碰撞检测工具。

title: Fast 4-bit KV-Cache Decoding on Hopper GPUs: Why Existing Kernels Are Slow and How to Fix Them
summary: A 4-bit KV cache reads about half the bytes of FP8, but Hopper GPUs have no FP4 hardware and little instruction-issue capacity per byte of memory bandwidth, so 4-bit values must be decoded in software. On H200, vLLM's NVFP4 KV path (FlashInfer's decode) reaches 10-20% of memory bandwidth and is up to 1.7x slower than FP8. NVBit instruction counts show two causes: the kernels behind vLLM's 4-bit paths (FlashInfer NVFP4, Triton UltraQuant) execute 2-6x Hopper's issue budget per byte and serialize loading, decoding and matrix multiplies. Our Hopper-native decode kernel overlaps a TMA producer warp with two compute warpgroups, lays the cache out at write time so decoded values feed the tensor cores from registers, and swaps the matrix operands so small query groups need no padding. On H200 it reaches 67-75% of peak bandwidth at batch 32-128 and at all 11 shapes is 1.12-1.49x faster than the faster of XQA and FlashAttention-4's proposed native FP8. Inside vLLM, with an accuracy recipe (K mean removal and rotation, 4 BF16 sink tokens, BF16 layer 0), it decodes 1.12-1.64x faster per step on Llama-3.1-8B than vLLM's FlashInfer FP8 path at batch 8 and above (1.04-1.24x over FlashAttention-4's FP8), is level at batch 1, and holds 1.63x as many tokens. On one H200 under a reasoning-like request stream, the highest rate at which 99% of requests meet the latency targets is 1.23-1.32x FP8's on Llama-3.1-8B and 1.67-2.20x on Qwen2.5-72B, as the cache becomes the limit; prefill-heavy streams are worse (7% slower prefill). On five 7B-32B models, repeated runs show no significant accuracy difference from BF16 KV. In Qwen2-family models, whose reasoning variants collapse under FP8 KV, layer 0's key mean is almost entirely the key-projection bias identified by prior work, seen through RoPE and computable from the weights alone; keeping that layer in BF16 restores FP8 KV and, with K mean removal, 4-bit KV.

AI.tldr: 针对Hopper GPU缺乏FP4硬件、4-bit KV cache必须软件解码的问题，作者提出Hopper原生解码kernel：TMA生产warp与两个计算warpgroup重叠，写入时重排cache使解码值从寄存器直喂张量核，并交换矩阵操作数以免padding；H200上达67-75%峰值带宽，比XQA与FlashAttention-4原生FP8快1.12-1.49x，vLLM中Llama-3.1-8B每步快1.12-1.64x、可容纳1.63x token数。
AI.motivation: 4-bit KV cache只读取FP8约一半字节，但Hopper GPU没有FP4硬件且每字节内存带宽对应的指令发射能力有限，4-bit值必须软件解码。实测vLLM的NVFP4 KV路径（FlashInfer decode）在H200上仅达10-20%内存带宽，比FP8最多慢1.7x；NVBit指令计数显示两个原因：4-bit路径kernel（FlashInfer NVFP4、Triton UltraQuant）每字节执行指令量是Hopper发射预算的2-6倍，且加载、解码、矩阵乘被串行化。
AI.method: 提出Hopper原生decode kernel：①TMA生产者warp与两个计算warpgroup做流水重叠；②在写入时即确定cache布局，使解码值从寄存器直接送入张量核；③交换矩阵乘操作数顺序，使小query分组无需padding。配合精度方案：K均值去除与旋转、4个BF16 sink token、第0层用BF16。
AI.result: H200上batch 32-128达67-75%峰值带宽，全部11个shape比XQA与FlashAttention-4提出的原生FP8中较快者快1.12-1.49x。集成vLLM后，Llama-3.1-8B在batch≥8时每步解码比FlashInfer FP8快1.12-1.64x（比FA-4 FP8快1.04-1.24x），batch 1持平，可容纳1.63x token。单H200类推理请求流下，99%请求满足延迟目标的最高速率：Llama-3.1-8B为FP8的1.23-1.32x，Qwen2.5-72B为1.67-2.20x；prefill-heavy流略差（prefill慢7%）。五个7B-32B模型重复实验显示精度与BF16 KV无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 通过软硬件协同设计（流水化TMA、寄存器直连张量核、操作数交换）可让无FP4硬件的Hopper上4-bit KV解码达到高带宽且超越原生FP8解码性能，并在真实服务吞吐上带来显著收益；同时发现Qwen2系列第0层key均值几乎完全由key-projection bias构成（经RoPE可见、可由权重算出），保留该层为BF16可修复FP8 KV崩溃并支撑4-bit KV。

title: SayDo: Benchmarking the Safety of Frontier Models from Chat to Closed-Loop Robot Control
summary: Frontier vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as high-level robot controllers, yet their safety is evaluated almost entirely in text. We introduce SayDo, a benchmark that assesses the propensity of frontier models to cause harm in embodied contexts. SayDo comprises eleven laboratory and household tasks that pair a benign instruction with a hazard latent in the scene. Tasks are implemented in six settings along an embodiment gradient, from chat questions about an imagined robot to closed-loop control of a simulated robot arm. Benign controls, safe-alternative variants and scripted operator pushback complement each task. Across six open- and closed-weight VLMs and 11,480 episodes, hazardous-action rates rise from 14% in chat to 47% in the simulator, and from 2% to 80% for the most affected model. The increase is largely driven by open-weight models. We find that models flag hazards before acting in 73% of unsafe episodes and give way to pushback about twice as often when controlling robots as in chat. The safest models also show signs of overcaution on benign controls. Safety evaluations run in text therefore do not predict the safety behavior of the same models when used as robot controllers.

AI.tldr: 提出具身安全基准SayDo：11项任务×6种具身程度设置，评估前沿VLM作为机器人控制器时造成危害的倾向。6个模型、11480个回合显示，有害动作率从对话的14%升至模拟器的47%（最受影响模型2%→80%），说明文本安全评估无法预测具身控制中的安全行为。
AI.motivation: 前沿视觉语言模型（VLM）日益被用作高层机器人控制器，但其安全性几乎完全在纯文本环境中评估。文本对话中的安全表现是否能迁移到具身场景尚不清楚，缺乏沿"具身梯度"系统测量模型危害倾向的基准。
AI.method: 构建SayDo基准：11项实验室与家庭任务，每项将无害指令与场景中潜伏的危险配对；任务在6种具身程度上实现，从关于想象机器人的聊天问答到闭环控制仿真机械臂；每个任务配有安全对照、安全替代方案变体与脚本化操作者回退（pushback）。在6个开源/闭源权重VLM上共运行11,480个回合，统计有害动作率、危害预警率与对回退的让步率。
AI.result: 有害动作率从聊天场景14%上升到模拟器47%；受影响最大的模型从2%升至80%，且增幅主要由开源权重模型驱动。73%的不安全回合中模型在行动前已识别出危害；控制机器人时对操作者回退的让步频率约为聊天的两倍。同时，最安全的模型在良性对照上表现出过度谨慎迹象。
AI.conclusion: 文本环境下的安全评估不能预测同一模型作为机器人控制器时的安全行为；具身安全需在闭环控制设置中单独评估，且"知道危险"与"不去执行"之间存在明显脱节，开源模型风险更高并伴随过度保守的权衡。

title: AeroJEPA: A Two-Stage Framework for Aerosol Forecasting with Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning
summary: Aerosol forecasting requires integrating sparse ground observations and modeling meteorologically driven concentration evolution and spatial structure. However, analysis-initialized forecasts make limited explicit use of historical observations, while pointwise regression tends to smooth local variations and provides limited constraints on fine spatial structures. In this work, we propose AeroJEPA, a two-stage joint-embedding predictive framework for regional surface PM$_{2.5}$ forecasting. Specifically, Stage I fuses historical observations, model backgrounds, and meteorological information to predict an initial future state, meteorological conditions, and multi-scale structures. Morphology-guided encoding and joint-embedding predictive supervision support learning future spatial representations, supplementing concentration regression with structural constraints. Stage II uses predicted meteorology to guide state refinement and incorporates coarse- and fine-scale structures into state updates and decoding to generate the concentration field at a single future time step. Experiments show that AeroJEPA reduces gridded and independent-station RMSE by 17.23\% and 7.90\%, respectively, relative to PFGNet, while improving spatial consistency with analysis fields. In a 48 h recursive forecasting case study, AeroJEPA generally achieves lower RMSE and MAE than the numerical forecasts across the forecast period, indicating promising short- to medium-range forecasting performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 AeroJEPA，一个两阶段联合嵌入预测框架用于区域地面 PM2.5 预报，融合历史观测、模式背景场与气象信息，并通过形态学引导编码与多尺度结构监督提升空间结构一致性，网格与独立站点 RMSE 相对 PFGNet 分别降低 17.23% 和 7.90%。
AI.motivation: 气溶胶预报需整合稀疏地面观测与由气象驱动的浓度演变及空间结构建模；但现有分析场初始化预报对历史观测的显式利用不足，而逐点回归易平滑局地变化、对精细空间结构约束有限。
AI.method: 两阶段 JEPA 式联合嵌入预测框架：阶段一融合历史观测、模式背景场与气象信息，预测初始未来状态、气象条件及多尺度结构，采用形态学引导编码与联合嵌入预测监督学习未来空间表征，以结构约束补充浓度回归；阶段二以预测气象引导状态精化，将粗、细尺度结构纳入状态更新与解码，生成单一未来时刻的浓度场。
AI.result: 相对 PFGNet，网格化 RMSE 降低 17.23%，独立站点 RMSE 降低 7.90%，并提升与分析场的空间一致性；48 小时递归预报个例中，RMSE 与 MAE 总体低于数值预报。
AI.conclusion: 联合嵌入的结构化监督可有效弥补逐点回归的空间细节损失，AeroJEPA 在短期至中期 PM2.5 预报上具备潜力，但其为单步状态预测并依赖递归外推，长时效误差累积仍需进一步评估。

title: AlignHand: Multi-View Hand Reconstruction from a Frozen Monocular Prior
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Project page and code: https://ada-zy2425.github.io/AlignHand/
summary: Modern monocular hand estimators recover detailed 3D meshes from individual images, yet effectively leveraging their predictions across multiple views remains challenging. Independently predicted meshes can disagree in scale, placement, and articulation, limiting the integration of complementary multi-view information. Hence, we present AlignHand, a calibrated multi-view framework that builds on a frozen monocular hand reconstruction prior to align and enhance its predictions. Specifically, AlignHand refines cross-view joint observations and estimates their reliability to establish a shared metric reference for alignment. Once the meshes are brought into a common frame, their complementary surface evidence is selectively fused across anatomical regions, followed by pixel-aligned refinement that predicts bounded residual displacements from local image features. This global-to-local integration enables AlignHand to exploit complementary observations while preserving the strong monocular prior. Extensive experiments on DexYCB-MV, HanCo, and HO3D-Eval-MV demonstrate that AlignHand achieves the lowest MPVPE and MPJPE among the compared methods under the respective evaluation protocols, reducing MPVPE by 30.1%, 29.1%, and 8.0%, respectively, compared with a matched geometry baseline.

AI.tldr: AlignHand是一个基于冻结的单目手部重建先验的标定多视图框架，通过对齐跨视图观测并将网格置于共同度量坐标系，再按解剖区域融合表面证据并进行像素对齐细化，从而在多个数据集上显著降低MPVPE与MPJPE。
AI.motivation: 现代表征单目手部估计器可从单张图像恢复细节丰富的3D网格，但跨多视图有效利用这些预测仍有困难：独立预测的网格在尺度、位置和解剖姿态上互不一致，导致互补的多视图信息难以整合。
AI.method: 提出AlignHand：以冻结的单目手部重建模型为先验。首先细化跨视图关节观测并估计其可靠性，建立共享的度量参考系完成对齐；随后在共同坐标系下按解剖区域选择性融合互补表面证据；最后进行像素对齐细化，从局部图像特征预测有界残差位移，实现全局到局部的整合。
AI.result: 在DexYCB-MV、HanCo与HO3D-Eval-MV上，AlignHand在各评测协议下取得最低的MPVPE与MPJPE；相比几何配置匹配的基线，MPVPE分别降低30.1%、29.1%与8.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在保持强单目先验的前提下，显式对齐结合区域级融合与局部残差细化，可有效利用多视图互补信息，显著提升多视图手部网格重建精度。

title: PsyDrift: Healthy-Reference Latent Diffusion for Anomaly Scoring in Autism Spectrum Disorder
comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at the CVPath-Vision4Neuro Workshop at WACV 2027. Includes expanded related-work and future-work discussion
summary: Individual heterogeneity and acquisition-site variability complicate neuroimaging-based characterization of autism spectrum disorder (ASD). We propose PsyDrift, combining ASD/healthy-control-supervised functional-connectivity representations with healthy-reference latent diffusion. An encoder produces 128-dimensional representations, and a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) learns exclusively from healthy training latents. Distance from a diffusion-denoised reconstruction provides a continuous deviation score. We evaluate 1,102 subjects from all 20 ABIDE-I sites using five-seed leave-one-site-out cross-validation. The classifier and DDPM achieve mean-site AUROCs of $0.798 \pm 0.003$ and $0.718 \pm 0.013$, respectively; uncertainties denote seed standard deviations. Matched healthy-reference scorers on the same representation achieve 0.68-0.71; the statistical significance of diffusion's modest numerical advantage remains unestablished. Within ASD, scores show weak associations with ADOS Total (Spearman $ρ= 0.108$, $p = 0.038$) and full-scale IQ ($ρ= -0.138$, $p = 0.002$), without adjustment for age, sex, site, or head motion. Frozen evaluation without retraining or hyperparameter adaptation yields pooled AUROCs of 0.69 on ABIDE-II and 0.61 on ADHD-200, providing preliminary evidence of cross-cohort and cross-disorder transfer. These results demonstrate healthy-reference deviation scoring within an ASD-supervised representation; incremental predictive and clinical value remains unestablished.

AI.tldr: PsyDrift 将 ASD/健康对照监督的功能连接表征与健康参考潜空间扩散模型结合，用扩散去噪重构距离作为个体偏离分数，在多站点 ABIDE-I 上验证其可行性与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 基于神经影像刻画自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）受个体异质性与采集站点差异困扰，传统分类器难以给出可解释的个体化偏离度量，且跨站点、跨队列泛化能力不足。
AI.method: 编码器生成 128 维功能连接表征，由 ASD/健康对照标签监督；DDPM 仅在健康训练潜变量上学习，以扩散去噪重构与原始表征的距离定义连续偏离分数。采用五种子留一站点交叉验证，评估 ABIDE-I 全部 20 个站点共 1,102 名受试者，并在 ABIDE-II 与 ADHD-200 上做冻结评估（不重训、不调超参）。
AI.result: 分类器与 DDPM 的平均站点 AUROC 分别为 0.798±0.003 与 0.718±0.013（不确定度为种子标准差）；同表征上的匹配健康参考评分器为 0.68–0.71，扩散模型的数值优势未确立统计显著性。ASD 组内分数与 ADOS 总分（ρ=0.108，p=0.038）及全量表 IQ（ρ=-0.138，p=0.002）呈弱相关，且未校正年龄、性别、站点与头动。冻结评估池化 AUROC 为 ABIDE-II 0.69、ADHD-200 0.61。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了在 ASD 监督表征框架内进行健康参考偏离评分是可行的，并提供了跨队列、跨障碍迁移的初步证据；但扩散重构相对于更简单评分器的增量预测价值及临床效用仍未确立。

title: Foresight Forcing: Learning Spatial Foresight for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation policies can improve action prediction by anticipating how objects move and how their spatial relationships change. World Action Models (WAMs) learn to predict future visual observations, but their training objectives typically leave the underlying 3D geometric transitions implicit. To alleviate this problem, we introduce Foresight Forcing ($\mathcal{F}^{2}$), a WAM that learns a spatial transition representation from changes in a pretrained 3D feature space. During training, a frozen 3D foundation model extracts patch-wise feature differences from aligned current and future observations that provide dense supervision for geometry-aware feature transitions. We distill these targets into spatial transition queries, which are progressively refined from the current observation, language instruction, and proprioceptive state, and use them alongside current visual features to generate actions. At deployment, the policy predicts the queries without future observations or the 3D teacher. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin2.0 demonstrate strong manipulation performance and improved robustness, including 95.01% average success on RoboTwin2.0 Full. On six real-world manipulation tasks, $\mathcal{F}^{2}$ achieves a mean task score of 85.8%.

AI.tldr: 提出 Foresight Forcing（F²），一种世界动作模型（WAM）：用冻结的 3D 基础模型从对齐的当前/未来观测中提取 patch 级特征差分作为稠密几何监督，蒸馏进"空间转移查询"，部署时无需未来观测与 3D 教师模型即可预测动作。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作策略若能预测物体如何运动、空间关系如何变化，可提升动作预测质量。现有 World Action Models 虽预测未来视觉观测，但训练目标使底层 3D 几何转移保持隐式，缺乏显式几何监督。
AI.method: 以冻结的 3D 基础模型对对齐的当前与未来观测提取 patch-wise 特征差异，构成稠密几何感知转移监督；将这些目标蒸馏为空间转移查询（spatial transition queries），查询由当前观测、语言指令与本体状态逐步精化，并与当前视觉特征共同用于动作生成；推理阶段仅预测查询，不需要未来观测和 3D 教师。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin2.0 上表现优异且鲁棒性提升，RoboTwin2.0 Full 平均成功率 95.01%；在 6 个真实世界操作任务上平均任务得分 85.8%。
AI.conclusion: 将预训练 3D 特征空间的转移作为显式监督信号并蒸馏为可预测的隐空间查询，是一条有效且部署友好的提升机器人操作策略几何感知能力的路径。

title: Aggregation Rules Induced by KL-Regularised Preference Dynamics on Networks
summary: We study agents that each align a model to their own preference data while observing one another, and ask which aggregation rule the resulting policies implement. Each round, an agent takes one KL-regularised step. The step involves a reference that the agent is penalised for leaving and a challenger against which its responses are compared, and each of the two may be the agent's own or an average over the agents it observes; attention need not be reciprocal. Aggregating the reference makes the rule collective. Agent $v$ then has the weight $π_v/β_v$, its share of the network's long-run attention divided by its temperature. If, in addition, the challenger is fixed, the agents concentrate on the response maximising $\sum_v(π_v/β_v)r_v(y)$, where $r_v$ is agent $v$'s reward, and the rule is cardinal. If the reference is fixed and the challenger aggregated, the agents' policies at a fixed point generally differ, and any weighted mean of them is an approximate maximal lottery whatever the weights, so the dynamics select no weighting. If both are aggregated, the rule is ordinal: averaged over rounds, the collective policy is a maximal lottery of the influence-weighted preference kernel, up to a slack that we bound. Where a collective rule exists, its weights depend only on the attention weights and the temperatures.

AI.tldr: 研究多个智能体在相互观察下各自用自身偏好数据做KL正则化模型对齐时，所得策略实现何种聚合规则；结果表明：参考聚合使规则成为集体的（基数规则权重为π_v/β_v），仅挑战者聚合则选择不出权重，两者都聚合时为序数规则（影响加权偏好核的最大彩票）。
AI.motivation: 现实中多个智能体同时对齐并互相观察（注意力不必相互），需要一个理论框架回答：这种去中心化的、逐轮KL正则化对齐的动力学最终实现了哪种社会选择/偏好聚合规则，以及规则权重由什么决定。
AI.method: 建模为逐轮一步KL正则化的对齐动力学：每步包含一个受惩罚偏离的参考（reference）和一个用于比较响应的挑战者（challenger），两者可分别为自身或所观察智能体的平均。按参考/挑战者是否聚合分四种情形分析不动点与长期行为，引入长期注意力份额π_v与温度β_v，并用影响加权偏好核刻画集体策略，对松弛量给出界。
AI.result: 聚合参考时规则为集体的，智能体v的权重为π_v/β_v（长期注意力份额/温度）。进一步固定挑战者时，智能体集中于最大化Σ_v(π_v/β_v)r_v(y)的响应，规则是基数的；固定参考而聚合挑战者时，不动点处各策略一般不同，其任意加权平均都是近似最大彩票，故动力学不选出任何权重；两者都聚合时为序数规则：按轮平均的集体策略是影响加权偏好核的最大彩票，误差由所给界控制。
AI.conclusion: 存在集体规则时，其权重仅取决于注意力权重与温度，而与具体偏好无关；聚合参考是获得集体、可加权聚合规则的关键，聚合挑战者则带来序数（最大彩票）性质但单独不足以确定权重。

title: CLASP: Complementary Layer Selection and Profiling for Zero-Shot OOD Detection using Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) enable zero-shot out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in medical imaging, yet existing approaches often rely on final-layer confidence or entropy-based layer selection, potentially missing complementary information. We show that low in-distribution (ID) confidence entropy does not reliably predict OOD discrimination. We introduce CLASP (Complementary Layer Selection and Profiling), an ID-only framework that jointly models layer--prompt responses and visual features. CLASP ranks visual encoder layers using Gaussian conditional mutual information and selects a compact subset through anchored spectral selection, without fixing the number of layers. It then combines the selected layer--prompt profiles with PCA-compressed visual embeddings and fits a single shrinkage-regularized Gaussian. OOD scores are computed using squared Mahalanobis distance, without fine-tuning, OOD training data, or test-time adaptation. Across histopathology, chest X-ray, and brain MRI benchmarks with UniMedCLIP and BioMedCLIP, CLASP performs strongly under varied distribution shifts. On MIDOG near-OOD, it achieves 87.54% AUROC with UniMedCLIP, outperforming confidence-based baselines; with BioMedCLIP, it remains competitive but trails visual-only Mahalanobis modeling. Ablations highlight the value of layer--prompt interactions and cross-feature dependencies, while exposing shift-dependent contributions and limitations under semantic shifts.

AI.tldr: 提出CLASP：一种仅用ID数据的医学视觉-语言模型OOD检测框架，通过高斯条件互信息对视觉编码器层排序并用锚定谱选择选出紧凑子集，将层-提示响应与PCA压缩的视觉特征联合建模、拟合单一收缩正则化高斯，以平方马氏距离作为OOD分数，无需微调、OOD训练数据或测试时适应。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM医学OOD检测方法多依赖末层置信度或基于熵的层选择，可能遗漏互补信息；作者进一步表明低ID置信熵并不能可靠预测OOD判别能力，因此需要一个不依赖置信度启发式、仅用ID数据即可联合利用多层与多模态信息的框架。
AI.method: 1) 联合建模视觉编码器各层的层-提示响应与视觉特征；2) 以高斯条件互信息对视觉编码器层进行排序；3) 通过锚定谱选择（anchored spectral selection）选出紧凑层子集，且不预设层数；4) 将所选层-提示剖面与PCA压缩的视觉嵌入拼接，拟合单一收缩正则化高斯分布；5) 以平方马氏距离作为OOD分数；全程无微调、无OOD训练数据、无测试时适应。
AI.result: 在组织病理、胸部X光、脑MRI三类基准上，配合UniMedCLIP与BioMedCLIP，在多种分布偏移下表现稳健。MIDOG近OOD场景下，UniMedCLIP取得87.54% AUROC，优于基于置信度的基线；BioMedCLIP下仍具竞争力但略逊于纯视觉马氏距离建模。消融显示层-提示交互与跨特征依赖有价值，同时揭示各成分贡献随偏移类型变化，并在语义偏移下存在局限。
AI.conclusion: ID置信熵不宜作为层选择与OOD判别的可靠准则；联合层-提示响应与视觉特征、经互信息排序与谱选择得到紧凑表征后做单一正则化高斯建模，是一种有效的ID-only医学OOD检测方案，但其收益依赖偏移类型，语义偏移下仍有不足，且不同视觉骨干下相对优势不稳定。

title: How Latent Transition Geometry Matters for Planning in World Models
summary: World models support planning by predicting how the environment evolves under candidate actions. However, one-step predictive accuracy alone does not characterize multi-step planning utility, which depends on distinguishing candidate futures. This raises a natural question: How does latent transition geometry shape planning? We investigate this through an action-conditioned transition-field view, using curvature regularization as a controlled intervention. Across four continuous-control tasks, appropriately tuned regularization improves planning, while excessive regularization can be detrimental. By decomposing the transition field into affine and non-affine components, we find that regularization reduces action sensitivity mainly through the non-affine component. To assess its role in planning, we directly manipulate the non-affine action response in frozen models and show that it affects candidate selection and closed-loop success. Further analysis shows that curvature generally brings predicted futures closer together, while preserving more of the differences along the goal direction. This helps explain why the planning effects vary across tasks. We observe broadly consistent planning trends across five sampling- and gradient-based solvers on LeWM and similar rollout-geometry trends on DINO-WM. Qualitative attention visualizations reveal accompanying shifts toward task-relevant visual structure. Together, these findings clarify how latent transition geometry influences multi-step planning.

AI.tldr: 论文从"行动条件下的潜在转移场"视角研究世界模型的潜在转移几何如何影响多步规划，并以曲率正则化作为受控干预手段；发现适度正则提升规划、过度正则有害，其主要作用经由转移场的非仿射分量降低动作敏感性。
AI.motivation: 世界模型通过预测环境在候选动作下的演化来支撑规划，但单步预测精度并不能刻画多步规划效用，后者依赖于能否区分不同候选未来。因此需要回答：潜在转移几何如何塑造规划行为。此前缺乏对此的受控、可解释分析。
AI.method: 提出行动条件下的转移场视角，将曲率正则化作为受控干预；在四个连续控制任务上训练/微调世界模型（LeWM，并在 DINO-WM 上做验证）；将转移场分解为仿射与非仿射分量以定位正则化的影响来源；在冻结模型中直接操控非仿射动作响应以检验其因果作用；并在五种采样式与梯度式求解器上评估规划，辅以注意力可视化分析。
AI.result: 四个连续控制任务上，恰当调参的曲率正则化改善规划性能，过度正则会带来损害；分解显示正则化主要通过非仿射分量削弱动作敏感性；直接操控冻结模型的非仿射动作响应会改变候选动作选择与闭环成功率；曲率总体上使预测未来更趋接近，但相对保留更多沿目标方向的差异；LeWM 上五种求解器呈现大体一致的规划趋势，DINO-WM 上有类似的 rollout 几何趋势；注意力可视化显示对任务相关视觉结构的关注增强。
AI.conclusion: 潜在转移几何（尤其是非仿射分量的动作响应与曲率）是决定多步规划效用的关键因素，而非单步预测精度；曲率通过压缩候选未来间距、同时保留目标方向上的差异来影响候选区分，这解释了不同任务间规划效应差异的原因。研究为以几何视角理解与调优世界模型规划提供了可操作的分析框架。

title: WorldLeague: Benchmarking Physical Agency
summary: AI systems can now operate Blender, follow instructions in complex video games, and manipulate objects with robot arms. What range of physical goals can today's AI systems achieve autonomously? Answering this question requires testing systems on tasks that demand different combinations of perception, memory, planning, and action. We introduce \textbf{WorldLeague}, a benchmark that compares AI systems on a common set of \textbf{60 simulated robot tasks} by measuring progress toward each task's physical goal from the robot's trajectory. Robots explore scenes to gather evidence in \textbf{WorldSeek}, rearrange objects in \textbf{WorldShape}, and adapt to changes in \textbf{WorldShift}. Tying these goals to a single control interface limits which AI systems can be compared. In WorldLeague, vision-language models (VLMs) choose targets and motions, while vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs) use their native controls. For each of six capability dimensions, we measure how much progress a system makes toward its goals (Interactive Score) and how often it achieves them (physical success rate). Together, these measures form the system's \emph{Physical Agency Profile}. Among 13 representative AI systems, Claude Fable 5.2 achieves 13 of the 60 goals and earns the highest mean Interactive Score (28.58/100). Fable leads in four dimensions, while GPT-6.1-Sol and GPT-6-Astra tie for first on rule-following tasks. Even when VLMs answer every final question correctly, they receive an Interactive Score of zero in 71.8\% of those episodes. WorldLeague gives Embodied AI, Physical AI, and Agentic AI a shared basis for comparing what AI systems achieve autonomously, from partial progress toward a physical goal to full goal completion. Project Webpage: https://xyangzhou.github.io/WorldLeague

AI.tldr: 论文提出WorldLeague基准，用60个仿真机器人任务（WorldSeek探索取证、WorldShape物体重排、WorldShift适应变化）在统一"目标进度"指标下比较VLM、VLA、WAM等13个AI系统，输出由Interactive Score与物理成功率构成的"Physical Agency Profile"。
AI.motivation: 现有AI系统已能操作Blender、在复杂电子游戏中遵循指令、用机械臂操作物体，但"今天的AI系统究竟能自主达成多大范围的物理目标"缺乏系统答案；回答该问题需要任务同时考察感知、记忆、规划与行动的不同组合，而单一控制接口又会限制可比较的系统范围。
AI.method: 构建WorldLeague基准：60个仿真机器人任务，从机器人轨迹测量对物理目标的推进程度；三类任务族WorldSeek/WorldShape/WorldShift；允许VLM选择目标与动作，VLA与WAM使用其原生控制接口，从而在统一目标度量下跨范式比较；沿六个能力维度同时测量进度（Interactive Score）与达成率（物理成功率），合成Physical Agency Profile。
AI.result: 在13个代表性系统中，Claude Fable 5.2完成60个目标中的13个，取得最高平均Interactive Score（28.58/100），并在四个维度领先；GPT-6.1-Sol与GPT-6-Astra在规则遵循任务上并列第一；即便VLM答对全部最终问题，仍有71.8%的回合Interactive Score为零。
AI.conclusion: WorldLeague为Embodied AI、Physical AI与Agentic AI提供共享比较基础，可刻画从部分推进到完全达成物理目标的自主能力；结果揭示"回答问题正确"与"物理上真正推进目标"之间存在显著鸿沟。

title: Self-Evolving Evaluation Environments for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet their evaluation remains largely static. Existing benchmarks provide a strong foundation, but fixed difficulty ceilings, limited feature coverage, and coarse aggregate scores progressively weaken their discriminative and diagnostic value. We introduce CUA-SEE, a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers from rollout evidence. It disentangles three objectives: benchmark evolution expands evaluation scope through cohort-calibrated difficulty and coverage growth; diagnostic evolution increases resolution through agent-conditional capability-boundary probes; and verifier evolution improves precision by translating changing requirements into state-grounded checkpoints with adversarial validation. Across multiple agents, applications, and rounds, CUA-SEE generates challenging, measurable tasks while preserving process-level evidence. Our results position adaptive evaluation as a scalable counterpart to self-evolving agents, continuously tracking what agents can do, where their boundaries lie, and how reliably progress is measured.

AI.tldr: 提出闭环评测环境 CUA-SEE，通过任务与可执行验证器的协同演化，实现随智能体能力自适应增长的计算机使用智能体评测。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体（CUA）评测体系基本静态：固定难度上限、特征覆盖有限、聚合分数粗粒度，随智能体能力提升，其区分度与诊断价值逐步衰减。
AI.method: CUA-SEE 从 rollout 证据中共同演化任务与可执行验证器，解耦三个目标：(1) 基准演化——通过队列校准的难度与覆盖增长扩展评测范围；(2) 诊断演化——通过以智能体为条件的能力边界探测提升评测分辨率；(3) 验证器演化——将变化的需求转化为基于状态的检查点并辅以对抗性验证，提升判定精度。
AI.result: 在多个智能体、应用与轮次上，CUA-SEE 能持续生成具有挑战性且可度量的任务，同时保留过程级证据。
AI.conclusion: 自适应评测可作为自演化智能体的可扩展对偶机制，持续追踪智能体能做什么、能力边界在哪里、以及进展被测量的可靠程度。

title: Diagnosing Verbalized Confidence in a Medical Vision-Language Model for Selective Prediction on Colorectal Histopathology Patches
comment: 39 pages, 7 figures; supplementary material in ancillary files. Under review at Scientific Reports. Code and artifacts: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23676823
summary: Flagging uncertain histopathology patches for specialist review needs a confidence that is higher when the model is right. We test whether an open medical vision-language model emits one. MedGemma-27b-it and its base Gemma-3-27b-it were run zero-shot under one prompt on 10,004 PathMNIST validation patches and 7,180 patches of a patient-disjoint external cohort. Both are too inaccurate to deploy (40.6% and 35.5%); the object of study is the confidence. MedGemma's verbalized confidence puts 96% of patches at one value; its confidence-correctness AUROC is 0.499 and 0.528, and routing by it moves selective-accuracy AUC by -0.004 and +0.037. Gemma-3 spreads its confidence over nine values, reaches AUROC 0.70, and gains +0.114 and +0.115. MedGemma's label-token probabilities do not rescue it: their validation advantage reverses where the top-20 alternatives include every class. On 1,800-patch subsets of each cohort, stratified on correctness and reweighted to the full splits, agreement across five prompt variants beats random by +0.123 and +0.106, and wording-only paraphrases give +0.100 and, externally and in direction only, +0.054; agreement's external margins over confidence do not survive slide-level clustering. Under one restructured prompt variant, MedGemma's stated confidence routes (+0.112, +0.141), so the failure is tied to a prompt chosen for macro F1.

AI.tldr: 本文检验开源医学视觉语言模型MedGemma-27b-it是否能提供可靠的置信度以标记不确定的组织病理切片。结果显示MedGemma的口头置信度近乎常数、与正确性几乎不相关（AUROC≈0.50），而基座Gemma-3-27b-it反而能较好地区分对错（AUROC 0.70），且MedGemma的失败与所采用的提示词特定形式相关。
AI.motivation: 在病理切片筛查中，将不确定样本标记出来交由专家复核，需要模型置信度在"答对时更高、答错时更低"。医学视觉语言模型是否会给出这种可靠的置信度尚缺乏实证检验，本文对此进行评估。
AI.method: 在PathMNIST验证集10,004个patch及患者不重叠的外部队列7,180个patch上，以单一提示词零样本运行MedGemma-27b-it与基座Gemma-3-27b-it。评估口头置信度（verbalized confidence）与正确性的AUROC、选择性准确率AUC增益，并检验标签token概率、多提示问的答案一致性（5种提示变体、仅措辞改写），以及基于1,800 patch分层抽样加权的分析，并进行slide级聚类检验。
AI.result: 两模型准确率过低（40.6%、35.5%），不具部署价值。MedGemma将96%的patch赋予同一置信度，置信度–正确性AUROC为0.499与0.528，按置信度路由的选择性准确率AUC变化为-0.004与+0.037；Gemma-3置信度分布于9个取值，AUROC达0.70，增益+0.114与+0.115。MedGemma的标签token概率未能弥补，其在验证集上的优势在top-20候选含全部类别时反转。1,800 patch子集上，跨5种提示的一致性优于随机分别+0.123与+0.106，仅措辞改写为+0.100及外部仅方向性的+0.054；一致性相对置信度在外部队列的边际优势在slide级聚类下不成立。在某一重构提示变体下，MedGemma的置信度路由有效（+0.112、+0.141）。
AI.conclusion: MedGemma-27b-it在所选提示下不能提供可用的置信度信号，其失败与为实现macro F1而选择的提示形式相关，而非模型能力本身；基座Gemma-3反而具备更好的置信度-正确性区分度。提示词设计对医学VLM置信度的可用性具有决定性影响，相关结论需在slide级聚类下谨慎检验。

title: Regularizing Hard Examples Improves Adversarial Robustness
comment: 48 pages, 16 figures, 22 tables. Published in the Journal of Machine Learning Research (JMLR)
summary: Recent studies have validated that pruning hard-to-learn examples from training improves the generalization performance of neural networks (NNs). In this study, we investigate this intriguing phenomenon -- the negative effect of hard examples on generalization -- in adversarial training. Particularly, we theoretically demonstrate that the increase in the difficulty of hard examples in adversarial training is significantly greater than the increase in the difficulty of easy examples. Furthermore, we verify that hard examples are only fitted through memorization of the label in adversarial training. We conduct both theoretical and empirical analyses of this memorization phenomenon, showing that pruning hard examples in adversarial training can enhance the model's robustness. However, the challenge remains in finding the optimal threshold for removing hard examples that degrade robustness performance. Based upon these observations, we propose a new approach, difficulty proportional label smoothing (DPLS), to adaptively mitigate the negative effect of hard examples, thereby improving the adversarial robustness of NNs. Notably, our experimental result indicates that our method can successfully leverage hard examples while circumventing the negative effect.

AI.tldr: 本文研究对抗训练中难样本对泛化/鲁棒性的负面影响，理论证明对抗训练会显著放大大难样本的难度、且难样本仅通过记忆标签被拟合，据此提出难度比例标签平滑（DPLS）自适应缓解该负面影响，在利用难样本的同时提升对抗鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 已有研究证实从训练中剪除难学习样本可提升神经网络泛化性能，但该"难样本负面影响"现象在对抗训练中尚未被系统研究；同时，剪枝方法依赖最优阈值的选择，如何在不丢弃难样本的前提下规避其负面影响是待解决问题。
AI.method: 1）理论分析对抗训练中难样本与易样本难度增量差异，证明难样本难度增幅显著更大；2）从理论与实证两方面分析难样本在对抗训练中仅通过"标签记忆"被拟合的机制；3）基于上述观察提出难度比例标签平滑（DPLS），按样本难度比例自适应施加标签平滑，以缓解难样本的负面影响。
AI.result: 理论推导与实验验证表明：难样本在对抗训练中难度增长远大于易样本，且仅靠记忆标签被拟合；剪除这类难样本可提升模型鲁棒性；DPLS 无需人为设定剪枝阈值，实验结果显示其能成功利用难样本并规避其负面影响，提升神经网络的对抗鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 对抗训练中难样本的负面效应源于标签记忆，而 DPLS 提供了一种无需阈值调参的自适应替代方案，在保留难样本信息的同时改善对抗鲁棒性。

title: Generalizing Agentic Robotics via Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: Building general-purpose robots is a central goal in robotics. Agentic robotics pursues this goal with planners that control robots through tool calls. However, existing methods either rely on proprietary models accessed through APIs, which incur high costs and latency, or post-train a planner with reinforcement learning (RL) in a single domain, requiring a separate specialist for each domain with incompatible tools. In large language model (LLM) post-training, multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) has been used to consolidate domain specialists into a single generalist. Yet whether MOPD can build a generalist planner for agentic robotics, how well it performs, and how it compares with other consolidation methods remain unexplored. In this paper, we systematically study these questions: we introduce Robo-MOPD, which trains a single student on closed-loop rollouts in simulation under token-level supervision from matching frozen specialists, and compare it with weight merging, off-policy specialist supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and multi-domain online RL. Experiments on LIBERO-PRO and RoboCasa365 show that a single 9B Robo-MOPD planner reaches 72.9% and 44.8% success (58.9% average), surpassing all consolidated baselines in average success and both 9B specialists on their respective benchmarks. Robo-MOPD excels on long-horizon tasks, outperforming multi-domain online RL by 13.0 percentage points on LIBERO-10.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了多教师on-policy蒸馏（MOPD）能否用于构建agentic robotics的通用规划器，提出Robo-MOPD，将多个领域专家合并为单一9B通用规划器。
AI.motivation: 现有agentic robotics的规划器方案存在缺陷：或依赖API访问的闭源模型（高成本、高延迟），或用RL在单一领域后训练规划器（每个领域需独立专家且工具不兼容）。LLM后训练中的MOPD已被用于合并领域专家，但其能否用于机器人规划、效果如何、与其他合并方法的对比均未被探索。
AI.method: 提出Robo-MOPD：在仿真中基于闭环rollout训练单一学生规划器，接受来自匹配的冻结专家的token级监督；并与权重合并、离线专家监督微调（SFT）、多领域在线RL进行对比。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-PRO与RoboCasa365上，单个9B Robo-MOPD规划器分别达到72.9%和44.8%成功率（平均58.9%），平均成功率超越所有合并基线，并在各自基准上超过对应的9B专家。长程任务优势明显，在LIBERO-10上比多领域在线RL高13.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: MOPD可有效构建agentic robotics的通用规划器，在跨域合并与长程任务上优于权重合并、离线SFT和多领域在线RL，为单一通用机器人规划器提供了可行路径。

title: MedUIGym: Evaluating and Training GUI Agents for Clinical Workflows
summary: Automating clinical workflows requires vision-language agents that can navigate dense graphical user interfaces (GUIs) in electronic health records (EHRs) and execute precise actions, yet many medical agents still rely on text or structured tool calls. In this work, we introduce MedUIGym, a scalable interactive environment comprising 15,739 tasks from 17 benchmark sources across six clinical task families for training and evaluating clinical GUI agents. In MedUIGym, agents perceive EHR states from screenshots and execute mouse-and-keyboard actions, as well as a paired native-tool interface over identical clinical data. The environment verifies both final answers and required clinical actions, and supports parallel trajectory collection for training. Benchmarking twelve vision-language models shows that current agents struggle across diverse clinical workflows, and simply increasing reasoning effort fails to yield consistent gains. Furthermore, MedUIGym supports offline learning from GUI trajectories and online reinforcement learning from task rewards. After training, both Qwen3.5 models perform better on in-domain clinical tasks and generalize to tasks from external sources. By unifying tasks from existing benchmarks, dual-interface evaluation, and GUI trajectory collection, MedUIGym provides a testbed for studying how vision-language agents complete clinical tasks through the EHR's graphical interface. Our project page is available at https://github.com/yitong-qiao/MedUIGym.

AI.tldr: MedUIGym：面向电子病历GUI操作的临床视觉语言智能体训练与评测环境（15,739任务，17来源，6类临床任务），支持双界面（截图GUI操作 vs 原生工具调用）、动作级验证、并行轨迹采集，并支持离线学习与在线强化学习。
AI.motivation: 自动化临床工作流需要能在密集的EHR图形界面中导航并执行精确动作的视觉语言智能体，但现有医疗智能体多依赖文本或结构化工具调用，缺乏可直接在GUI上操作与训练评测的可扩展环境。
AI.method: 构建MedUIGym可扩展交互式环境，整合17个基准来源、6类临床任务共15,739个任务；智能体从截屏感知EHR状态并执行鼠标键盘动作，同时提供共享同一临床数据的原生工具接口作为配对对照；环境同时验证最终答案与所需临床动作，支持并行轨迹采集用于训练，并支持基于GUI轨迹的离线学习与基于任务奖励的在线强化学习。
AI.result: 对12个视觉语言模型的评测显示，现有智能体在多样临床工作流上表现不佳，单纯提高推理强度并不能带来一致收益；经训练后，两个Qwen3.5模型在域内临床任务上提升，并可泛化到外部来源任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一现有基准任务、双接口评测与GUI轨迹采集，MedUIGym为研究视觉语言智能体如何经由EHR图形界面完成临床任务提供了测试平台，并验证了轨迹学习与强化学习在该场景下的可行性与泛化潜力。

title: Elicitation format changes zero-shot classification accuracy in a medical vision-language model: a two-center evaluation on colorectal histopathology
comment: 34 pages, 6 figures; Supplementary Table S1 and Supplementary Material S2 in ancillary files. Corrects one result reported in the companion preprint "Diagnosing Verbalized Confidence in a Medical Vision-Language Model for Selective Prediction on Colorectal Histopathology Patches" (Sinhal et al., arXiv, 2026)
summary: Background. Verbalized confidence from a hosted medical vision-language model is usually treated as packaging around an unchanged prediction. Methods. We held a nine-class colorectal histopathology prompt fixed except for the requested response format and evaluated MedGemma-27b-it on 10,004 validation and 7,180 external-center PathMNIST patches, with preregistered endpoints, randomized ties, and random floors recomputed for each patch set. Results. Requesting probabilities over all nine classes instead of a ranked top-3 reduced accuracy by 14.8 points on validation, -0.1475 [-0.1594, -0.1353], and 13.4 at the external center, -0.1341 [-0.1484, -0.1196], against chance accuracy of 0.1111. The nine-class prompt uniquely forbade commentary, reasoning, and a chosen answer; removing that prohibition at matched cardinality and token budget recovered +0.1878 [+0.1623, +0.2134] and +0.1911 [+0.1648, +0.2181], while changing cardinality with the prohibition absent moved accuracy by -0.0013 [-0.0300, +0.0280] and -0.0214 [-0.0494, +0.0071]. The nine-class format returned no parseable distribution on 7.6 and 7.7 percent of patches, mostly zero vectors in the two least-textured classes, and deferring these failures first explained its measurable selective-prediction gain. Across four vision-capable models, accuracy did not grade the cost: two models matched on accuracy differed five- to sevenfold. First-token logit entropy routed better than any elicited signal, +0.1820 [+0.1722, +0.1974] versus +0.0493 [+0.0377, +0.0649] relative to each signal's random floor. Conclusions. Response format changes a medical vision-language classifier, and the operative component here was the instruction suppressing an answer. Use logits when available; otherwise request a short ranked list without prohibiting reasoning or a chosen answer.

AI.tldr: 改变响应格式会显著改变医学视觉语言分类器的准确率，其关键机制是"禁止给出明确答案"这一指令；应优先使用logits，否则应采用"短排名列表且不禁止推理或选答"的提示方式。
AI.motivation: 以往将托管式医学视觉语言模型输出的"言语化置信度"视为对既定预测的包装，而忽视响应格式本身可能改变预测。本文旨在检验仅改变请求的响应格式是否会影响分类准确率，并厘清其中的操作成分与选择性预测收益来源。
AI.method: 固定同一九分类结直肠组织病理提示，仅改变请求的响应格式；在10,004例验证集与7,180例外中心PathMNIST图像块上评测MedGemma-27b-it，采用预注册终点、随机化平局处理，并为每个图像块集重算随机下限。另进行匹配基数与token预算的对照实验，并在四个具备视觉能力的模型上比较准确率与路由信号（含首token logit熵）。
AI.result: 要求对全部九类输出概率而非排名前三，使验证集准确率下降14.8个百分点（-0.1475 [-0.1594, -0.1353]），外中心下降13.4（-0.1341 [-0.1484, -0.1196]），随机准确率为0.1111。九分类提示唯一地禁止了评论、推理与选定答案；在匹配基数与token预算下取消该禁令，恢复+0.1878 [+0.1623, +0.2134]与+0.1911 [+0.1648, +0.2181]；而在无禁令时改变基数仅使准确率变化-0.0013 [-0.0300, +0.0280]与-0.0214 [-0.0494, +0.0071]。九分类格式在7.6%和7.7%的图像块上无可解析分布，多为两个纹理最弱类别的零向量，且优先剔除这些失败样本即可解释其选择性预测增益。四个模型中准确率与代价不成比例，准确率相同的两个模型代价相差五至七倍。首token logit熵的路由效果优于任何诱导信号，相对各自随机下限为+0.1820 [+0.1722, +0.1974]对+0.0493 [+0.0377, +0.0649]。
AI.conclusion: 响应格式确实会改变医学视觉语言分类器的表现，此处起决定作用的成分是抑制给出答案的指令。建议在有logits时使用logits；否则请求简短的排名列表，且不要禁止推理或给出明确答案。

title: Diagnostic Accuracy Is Not Deployment Value: Decision-Aligned Reliability Evaluation for Foundation MLIPs in Materials Discovery
comment: 5-page main text plus supplementary appendices; 1 figure, 3 tables in the main text. Accepted at the AI4Mat Workshop (AI for Accelerated Materials Design), NeurIPS 2026, Findings & Open Challenges track
summary: In AI-guided materials discovery, machine-learning models increasingly decide which candidate materials should receive expensive first-principles or experimental evaluation. Standard reliability metrics such as uncertainty, calibration, novelty, and ranking accuracy evaluate properties of the predictions, but success on these metrics does not necessarily imply a better downstream screening decision. We study this mismatch for foundation machine-learned interatomic potentials (MACE-MP, CHGNet, Orb V3) used to rank candidate crystal structures before DFT verification. We evaluate three representative reliability interventions (novelty detection, sparse DFT calibration, and chemistry-level ranking audits) using a deployment objective that measures how much DFT can be avoided while maintaining a required recall of near-hull candidates. Across all three, a reliability signal can succeed on its immediate target without improving the final screening decision: novelty detects distribution shift but weakly ranks failure severity; calibration can improve pooled ranking metrics while leaving screening unchanged or degrading it; and sparse audits identify MLIP-chemistry combinations with poor ranking reliability without yielding a robustly beneficial routing policy. A two-oracle analysis further shows that the source of failure depends on the screening decision itself: under formation-energy screening, even perfect knowledge of average ranking reliability can select the wrong model, whereas in the evaluated hull-aligned variant the oracle target becomes decision-aligned but finite-budget audits still fail to realize the value. Reliability should be evaluated relative to the decision it supports: the relevant question is not whether a model is uncertain or inaccurate, but whether acquiring and acting on additional information will improve the final discovery decision enough to justify its cost.

AI.tldr: 该文指出MLIP的"预测可靠性"指标（不确定性、校准、新颖性、排序精度）与下游筛选决策效果存在脱节，并以"避免DFT开销同时保持近凸包召回率"为部署目标，实证三种可靠性干预均未能改善最终筛选决策。
AI.motivation: 在AI引导材料发现中，ML模型用于决定哪些候选结构值得昂贵的DFT或实验验证。现有可靠性指标只评价预测本身的属性，其良好表现未必等价于更好的下游筛选决策；作者希望系统刻画并解释这一错配。
AI.method: 以三种基础机器学习原子间势（MACE-MP、CHGNet、Orb V3）对候选晶体结构排序、再交DFT验证的流程为对象，定义部署目标：在维持所需近凸包候选召回率的前提下可节省多少DFT。评估三类可靠性干预：新颖性检测、稀疏DFT校准、化学层面排序审计；并做双oracle分析（平均排序可靠性oracle与决策对齐的oracle目标），比较形成能筛选与凸包对齐变体。
AI.result: 三类干预均出现"达标但无收益"：新颖性检测能识别分布偏移，但对失效严重程度的排序能力弱；DFT校准可改善汇总排序指标，却使筛选不变甚至变差；稀疏审计能识别MLIP-化学体系组合中排序可靠性差的组合，但无法形成稳健有益的路由策略。双oracle分析显示失效来源依赖筛选决策本身：形成能筛选下，即便完美知晓平均排序可靠性也会选错模型；凸包对齐变体中oracle目标虽与决策对齐，但有限预算审计仍无法兑现其价值。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性应相对于其所支撑的决策来评价：关键问题不是模型是否不确定或不准确，而是获取并利用额外信息能否以可接受成本足够改善最终发现决策。建议以决策对齐的指标替代孤立的预测质量指标。

title: RoboUniverse-10K: Toward the Scaling Era of Agentic Robotics via Real-to-Sim Environments
summary: Agentic Robotics, in which foundation models act as coding agents to control robots through executable programs, has emerged as a compelling paradigm for embodied intelligence. Yet unlike software engineering, where massive executable environments power post-training, robotics remains constrained by small, manual benchmarks and in-distribution evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce RoboUniverse-10K, 10,807 interactive, resettable, and verifiable physics environments built from real-world videos via an automated Real2Sim and quality assurance pipeline. Each runs in an isolated, Harbor-compatible harness that hides privileged states and grading logic to mirror real-world sensing. From the same pipeline, we hold out 500 unseen tasks to establish RoboUniverse-Verified, an expert-verified zero-shot benchmark. Evaluating 11 closed- and open-source models reveals a huge gap: frontier models reach 85.8\% success, while open-source baselines lag at 2.6\% to 10.0\%, bottlenecked by low-level grasping, deformable-object manipulation, and post-contact physical control. Finally, we collect about 17K multi-turn trajectories totaling 0.79B tokens with GPT-6 Astra and perform full-parameter supervised fine-tuning on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, yielding RoboUniverse-35B-A3B. Our model achieves substantial zero-shot gains on RoboUniverse-Verified, lifting the success rate from 0.8\% to 21.2\%, while achieving zero-shot task completions across LIBERO-MAX, RoboCasa, RoboTwin 2.0, and a real Franka arm. We open-source the RL-ready environments and model to lay the foundation for large-scale reinforcement learning in Agentic Robotics.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RoboUniverse-10K，一个由真实视频经自动化 Real2Sim 与质量校验流程构建的 10,807 个可交互、可重置、可验证物理环境集合，并据此构建专家验证的零样本基准 RoboUniverse-Verified；同时用 GPT-6 Astra 生成约 17K 多轮轨迹（0.79B tokens）全参数微调 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，得 RoboUniverse-35B-A3B。
AI.motivation: Agentic Robotics（基础模型作为编码智能体、通过可执行程序控制机器人）缺乏像软件工程那样的大规模可执行环境来支撑后训练，机器人领域仍受限于小规模人工基准与分布内评测，难以进行大规模强化学习与零样本泛化评估。
AI.method: 1) 自动化 Real2Sim 管线从真实视频构建 10,807 个可重置、可验证物理环境；2) 每个环境运行于隔离、Harbor 兼容的 harness 中，隐藏特权状态与评分逻辑以模拟真实感知；3) 同一管线留出 500 个未见任务，构成专家验证的零样本基准 RoboUniverse-Verified；4) 评测 11 个闭源/开源模型；5) 用 GPT-6 Astra 采集约 17K 多轮轨迹（0.79B tokens），对 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 做全参数监督微调。
AI.result: 评测显示存在巨大差距：前沿模型成功率 85.8%，开源基线仅 2.6%–10.0%，瓶颈在于低层抓取、可变形物体操作与接触后物理控制。RoboUniverse-35B-A3B 在 RoboUniverse-Verified 上零样本成功率由 0.8% 提升至 21.2%，并在 LIBERO-MAX、RoboCasa、RoboTwin 2.0 及真实 Franka 机械臂上实现零样本任务完成。
AI.conclusion: 论文以可扩展、可验证的仿真环境与轨迹数据弥补 Agentic Robotics 的数据与环境缺口，显著提升开源模型零样本能力，并开源 RL-ready 环境与模型，为大规模强化学习奠定基础。

title: Triage Accuracy of Jev and Open-Weight System One Decision Models and Their Use for Early Emergency Recognition in Symptom-Assessment Applications
summary: Laypeople increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for triage advice, but LLMs answer in variable free text, which makes it hard to evaluate them for use in medical devices. Decision models, which assign a probability to each predefined triage category, may be easier to evaluate. To test their triage accuracy, we evaluated 16 decision models (14 open-weight, 2 proprietary) on 233 synthetic and 10,000 real-world cases, yielding 163,728 total assessments. The best models triaged 72.1% of synthetic cases correctly and agreed with an existing algorithm in 56.1% of real-world cases. They were more promising for recognising emergencies early: given only demographics, chief complaints, risk factors and red-flag answers, the best model reached an AUROC of 0.87. At a 5% error margin, it could decide for or against emergencies for about half of users. Decision models should therefore not replace triage engines but could shorten symptom assessments at setting-specific error margins.

AI.tldr: 论文评估了16个决策模型（14个开放权重、2个专有）在233个合成病例和10,000个真实病例上的分诊准确性，共163,728次评估。最佳模型合成病例准确率72.1%，真实病例与现有算法一致率56.1%；急诊识别AUROC达0.87，5%误差下可覆盖约半数用户。作者认为决策模型不应替代分诊引擎，但可在特定误差范围内缩短症状评估。
AI.motivation: 普通用户越来越多地用大语言模型获取分诊建议，但LLM以自由文本作答、形式多变，难以作为医疗器械进行评估与监管。相较之下，决策模型为每个预设分诊类别输出概率，便于量化评估。因此需要系统检验决策模型的分诊准确性。
AI.method: 对16个决策模型（14个开放权重、2个专有）进行评测，数据包括233个合成病例与10,000个真实世界病例，累计163,728次评估。指标包括：合成病例分诊正确率、真实病例与既有分诊算法的一致率，以及在仅提供人口学特征、主诉、风险因素和红旗答案条件下的急诊识别AUROC，并在5%误差界限下估计可决策用户比例。
AI.result: 最佳模型在72.1%的合成病例上分诊正确，在56.1%的真实病例上与现有算法一致。急诊早期识别表现更佳：最佳模型AUROC为0.87；在5%误差界限下，可为约一半用户判定是否为急诊。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型尚不足以替代分诊引擎，但可作为前置环节，在设定特定的误差界限下缩短症状评估流程，具有辅助分诊的应用潜力。

title: Demystifying Classifier-Free Guidance for Auto-Regressive Image Generation
summary: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) has been widely adopted in autoregressive (AR) models for high-quality image generation. Despite its strong empirical performance, its mechanism in AR models remains unclear. This paper demystifies the mechanism of CFG through both empirical and theoretical studies. By examining the top-ranked semantics of different components in CFG, we show that texture information is primarily encoded in the difference between the conditional and unconditional logits, whereas both logits share previous-token repetition as their leading semantics. This strong repetition semantics obscures the desired texture information, causing greedy decoding from the conditional logits alone to produce nearly pure-color images. Through a training-dynamics analysis of shallow transformers, we prove that this shared repetition semantics does not arise from limitations or failures of pretraining, but instead originates from the texture sparsity of images. We further show that CFG improves generation quality by rectifying this repetition bias during inference. Motivated by the shared semantics between conditional and unconditional logits, we propose Attention Weight Reuse (AttnReuse), which reuses intermediate attention computations from the conditional-logit forward pass to accelerate the unconditional-logit computation. AttnReuse reduces about $25\%$ of attention computation with little performance degradation across different models.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证与理论研究揭示自回归模型中无分类器引导（CFG）的作用机制：条件与无条件 logits 的差异主要编码纹理信息，而两者共享"前序 token 重复"这一主导语义；该重复偏置源于图像的纹理稀疏性而非预训练失败，CFG 本质上是在推理阶段矫正这一偏置。基于此提出注意力权重复用（AttnReuse），加速无条件分支计算。
AI.motivation: CFG 在自回归图像生成中被广泛使用且经验效果显著，但其内在作用机制尚不清晰。作者希望"去神秘化"地解释 CFG 为何有效，并据此设计更高效的推理实现。
AI.method: 1）实证分析：考察 CFG 各分量（条件 logits、无条件 logits 及二者之差）的 top-ranked 语义，发现纹理信息主要位于二者差值中，而两个 logits 的主导语义均为"前序 token 重复"，该强重复语义掩盖了纹理信息，导致仅对条件 logits 做贪心解码几乎生成纯色图像。2）理论分析：对浅层 Transformer 做训练动力学分析，证明共享的重复语义并非来自预训练能力不足或失败，而是源于图像的纹理稀疏性；并说明 CFG 通过在推理期矫正重复偏置来提升生成质量。3）方法：利用条件与无条件 logits 的共享语义，提出 AttnReuse，将条件分支前向中的中间注意力计算复用于无条件分支。
AI.result: 理论上给出了重复语义产生的成因与 CFG 的矫正解释；实验上 AttnReuse 在多个模型上可减少约 25% 的注意力计算量，且性能几乎无下降。
AI.conclusion: CFG 在自回归图像生成中的有效性可归结为对"前序 token 重复"偏置的推理期矫正，该偏置由图像纹理稀疏性内生决定。基于条件/无条件 logits 的语义共享，AttnReuse 提供了一种几乎无损的约 25% 注意力计算节省方案。

title: Stable but Hidden: Identifiability and Experimental Design under Missing Compositional Support
comment: Accepted at the AI for Science Workshop, NeurIPS 2026. 9-page main text plus appendices (53 pages total), 8 figures
summary:
AI-guided scientific discovery often uses inexpensive predictors to allocate scarce verification measurements. We study a structural failure when relevant components have been observed separately but never jointly: distinct admissible response functions can agree on all observed compositions while disagreeing on the missing combinations. Additional same-support data cannot resolve this ambiguity, and agreement among fitted models need not expose it.
  We characterize the unresolved directions as an invisible subspace $\mathcal{N}_T(\mathcal{F}) = \ker \mathcal{R}_T$, whose geometry determines oracle zero-shot ambiguity and minimax risk under a symmetric, bounded ambiguity class. When the missing response lies in an $r$-dimensional, well-conditioned linear basis, optimally designed joint measurements achieve minimax integrated risk $Θ(σ^2 r/m)$, with classical $I$-optimality the fixed-design criterion.
  We validate on materials. In electrocatalysis, a six-dimensional support-derived structural basis (a prior on candidate directions, not an identified physical model) reduces held-out MSE against a dimension-matched generic basis (median paired ratio 0.75, improving 98% of 60 element pairs at $m = 15$), while $I$-optimal and same-basis posterior-variance acquisition show no detected difference. In Materials Project, removing joint property labels reduces $E_{\text{above hull}}$ ranking on 90% of 30 element pairs, more than matched data-removal controls, under a frozen pretrained representation. Pair difficulty is reproducible across learners but poorly predicted by zero-label ensemble disagreement; 20 joint measurements enable transferable pair-level rankings without reliable absolute calibration.
  In practice, experiment selection should ask which relationships the observed support leaves unidentified before asking where a fitted model is least certain.

AI.tldr: 论文研究"组件分别被观测但从未联合观测"导致的结构性不可辨识问题：不同可行响应函数可在已观测组合上一致却在缺失组合上分歧，同支撑数据无法消除。作者用不可见子空间 N_T(F)=ker R_T 刻画歧义几何，给出零样本歧义与极小极大风险结论（Θ(σ²r/m)），并在电催化与 Materials Project 上验证：支撑导出的结构基优于同维通用基，但同基后验方差采集无差异；实验设计应先问"支撑未识别哪些关系"，再问"模型何处最不确定"。
AI.motivation: AI 引导的科学发现常用廉价预测器来分配稀缺的验证测量。但当相关组件分别被观测、从未同时出现时，会出现结构性失效：拟合模型之间的一致并不等于缺少的证据，且增加同支撑数据也无法解决。现有基于预测不确定性的采集策略无法暴露这种歧义，因此需要从"数据支撑本身识别了什么"的角度重新审视实验选择。
AI.method: 将未解决方向刻画为不可见子空间 N_T(F)=ker R_T（由观测支撑诱导的算子），以其几何决定 oracle 零样本歧义与对称有界歧义类下的极小极大风险；当缺失响应落在 r 维良态线性基中时，推导最优设计的联合测量达到极小极大积分风险 Θ(σ²r/m)，并指出经典 I-最优性是固定设计准则。实验上：(1) 电催化中使用支撑导出的六维结构基（作为候选方向的先验而非已识别物理模型），与同维通用基比较留出 MSE（60 组元素对、m=15），并对比 I-最优与同基后验方差采集；(2) Materials Project 中移除联合性质标签，评估对 E_above hull 排序的影响（30 组元素对，冻结预训练表示），并与匹配的数据移除对照比较。
AI.result: 电催化：六维支撑导出基相对同维通用基降低留出 MSE，中位配对比值 0.75，m=15 时 98% 的 60 组元素对改善；I-最优与同基后验方差采集之间未检测到差异。Materials Project：移除联合性质标签使 90% 的 30 组元素对 E_above hull 排序变差，程度超过匹配的数据移除对照；在冻结预训练表示下，元素对难度在不同学习器间可复现，但零标签集成分歧预测能力差；20 次联合测量即可得到可迁移的配对级排序，但绝对校准不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 实验选择应遵循"先识别、后不确定"的顺序：先判断观测支撑留下了哪些未被识别的关系（不可见子空间方向），再考虑拟合模型最不确定之处。支撑诱导的低维结构基能显著改善泛化，而基于模型不确定性的常规采集准则在存在结构性不可辨识时可能无增益；联合测量数量有限时只宜用于相对排序而非绝对校准。

title: SurgeCount: A Protocol-Guided Composition Harness for Bimanual Surgical Sponge Counting
comment: 19 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to the Findings Track of Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) 2026
summary: We present SurgeCount, a system for auditable robotic surgical sponge counting that composes learned skills under a written procedural protocol. Retained sponges cause preventable harm, and surgical teams count every sponge before closure to reduce that risk. The robot repeatedly isolates one deformable sponge from a tangled pile and places it in the next numbered counting-tray slot, requiring handling of occluded grasp threads while preserving step order. We train one subtask-conditioned policy on eleven short skills and learn when each skill ends. At each learned boundary, a stateful vision-language model selects the next skill from an operator-authored specification of step order, visual verification, and recovery. This creates temporal commitment to each subtask and enables failures to be recovered by recomposing existing skills rather than using a dedicated recovery policy. We evaluate five methods across 100 real-robot trials using 20 matched layouts. SurgeCount fills 47 of 60 ordered slots and completes 12 of 20 procedures, compared with 27 of 60 and 3 of 20 for the strongest of four end-to-end policies trained on the same data. Replacing the detailed protocol prompt with a minimal prompt reduces performance to 29 of 60 slots and 5 of 20 completed procedures. These results show that long-horizon performance depends not only on visuomotor capacity, but also on how learned skills are committed, verified, and composed. This tabletop proof of concept motivates further evaluation of protocol-guided robotic sponge counting in clinically representative settings.

AI.tldr: SurgeCount：基于书面流程协议组合已学习技能的可审计机器人手术海绵计数系统，在真实机器人上显著优于端到端策略。
AI.motivation: 手术遗留海绵会造成可预防的伤害，因此关腹前需逐一清点海绵。机器人需从缠绕堆积中反复分离单块可变形海绵并按编号顺序放入计数托盘，且需处理被遮挡的抓取线头并保持步骤次序，长程任务难度大。
AI.method: 在11个短技能上训练一个子任务条件化策略，并学习各技能的终止边界；在每个学习到的边界处，由有状态的视觉-语言模型依据操作者撰写的步骤顺序、视觉核验与恢复规范选择下一技能，从而形成对每个子任务的时间承诺，故障可通过重组已有技能恢复，而非依赖专用恢复策略。
AI.result: 100次真实机器人试验、20组匹配布局、5种方法对比：SurgeCount完成60个有序槽位中的47个、20次流程中的12次；同数据训练的最强端到端策略仅为27/60与3/20。将详细协议提示替换为极简提示后降至29/60与5/20。
AI.conclusion: 长程性能不仅取决于视觉运动能力，还取决于已学习技能如何被承诺、核验与组合；该桌面概念验证支持在临床代表性环境中进一步评估协议引导的机器人海绵计数。

title: ComputeWise: Measuring and Fixing GPU Waste by AI Research Agents
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Preliminary version; a revised version is in preparation. Code: https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/computewise. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Salesforce/computewise
summary: AI agents are given GPUs to do AI research on their own. Do they use those GPUs well? A busy GPU does not tell us, because it can be busy with work the answer did not need. This matters, because the tokens the agent spends cost almost nothing next to the GPUs its experiments run on, so using those GPUs better has a huge impact. So we built ComputeWise, an open benchmark of research tasks on which this waste can be measured and reduced. For it we developed our own simulated GPU, which replays recorded runs to the agent's code. With no real GPU needed, we ran hundreds of experiments, far more than would be reasonable on real GPUs. With no help, the agents put only 52% of their GPU time into work the answer needed. Another 22% went to work it did not need, and 26% sat idle. Asking the agent to finish the work faster, telling it to keep every GPU busy, or giving it a job scheduler does not fix this. So we built an open-source harness, part prompting and part deterministic code. Across five models, it removed over 80% of the extra time to the answer.

AI.tldr: 提出 ComputeWise 基准与模拟 GPU，量化 AI agent 自主做科研时的 GPU 算力浪费，并给出开源 harness，在五个模型上去除 80% 以上通向答案的多余时间。
AI.motivation: 现有评估只看 GPU 占用率（busy），而占用不等于有用：agent 可能在跑与最终答案无关的实验。由于 token 成本远低于实验所占 GPU 成本，提升 GPU 使用效率收益巨大，但缺少可测量、可优化这种浪费的基准与手段。
AI.method: 构建 ComputeWise 开放基准（一组科研任务），并自研模拟 GPU，以录制的运行轨迹回放给 agent 代码，无需真实 GPU 即可支撑数百次实验。随后对比多种干预手段（要求更快完成、要求保持 GPU 满载、提供作业调度器），并提出开源 harness：部分为提示设计，部分为确定性代码。
AI.result: 无辅助时，agent 仅 52% 的 GPU 时间用于答案所需工作，22% 用于无关工作，26% 空闲。单纯催促加速、要求高占用或加调度器均无效。所提 harness 在五个模型上消除超过 80% 的“通向答案的多余时间”。
AI.conclusion: GPU 占用率是失真的效率指标，应按“对答案有用的算力占比”衡量 agent 的科研效率；模拟 GPU 使低成本大规模评估成为可能，且提示与确定性代码结合的 harness 能显著减少算力浪费。

title: RAGA: Refreshable Animatable Gaussian Avatars from a Single Photo
summary: Avatars created from a single photo are fixed once made: regions the photo never showed, such as the back of a garment, are hallucinated and remain that way. We present Refreshable Animatable Gaussian Avatars (RAGA), a full-body Gaussian avatar that is created from a single image in about one second and can be refreshed whenever new images of the same person become available, without retraining or gradient-based optimization. RAGA maps each new observation into canonical UV space, accumulates it as visibility- and angle-weighted running sums, and re-decodes the fused map with the same decoder used for the photo. Although this decoder is trained only on single images, it makes use of the fused evidence. On 163 clips from five datasets, RAGA created from one photo outperforms LHM, LHM++ and IDOL, including on three datasets never used in training. Refreshing from later frames adds 0.49 dB PSNR overall and 0.68 dB on views turned at least 135° from the photo, where SSIM and LPIPS also improve. Given the same 16 images on all clips, LHM++ gains 0.15 dB, against 0.48 dB for RAGA. Creating an avatar takes 1.08 s and animating it 48.1 ms per frame on a laptop RTX 3080 GPU, with body fitting and matting included in creation and pose estimation included in animation. Code will be released on GitHub.

AI.tldr: RAGA：单张照片约1秒生成全身高斯化身，并可通过后续新图像"刷新"，无需重训练或梯度优化。
AI.motivation: 单图化身一旦生成即固定，照片未覆盖区域（如衣物背面）只能靠幻觉补全且无法修正。
AI.method: 将新观测映射到规范UV空间，按可见性与角度加权累积为运行和，再用与照片相同的解码器重新解码融合图；该解码器仅用单图训练却能利用融合证据。
AI.result: 163段视频、5个数据集上优于LHM、LHM++、IDOL，含3个未参与训练数据集；刷新带来整体+0.49 dB PSNR，≥135°视角+0.68 dB，SSIM/LPIPS亦提升；同16张图像下LHM++增益0.15 dB vs RAGA 0.48 dB；创建1.08 s，动画48.1 ms/帧（RTX 3080笔记本）。
AI.conclusion: 提出免优化的可刷新单图全身高斯化身方案，在精度与效率上均有竞争力。

title: The Growth Path Is the Missing Half of Neural Networks
comment: 27 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Tingan Jin and Haosong Li contributed equally
summary: An artificial neuron computes and learns, but it does not live: the units of a network are fixed when it is designed, and every one of them is kept and paid for whether it is used or not. We give each neuron a second pathway. Beside its Task Path, the usual computation and gradient learning, a dual-pathway neuron has a Growth Path: a nutrient flows from the outputs back through the network, every layer receives the same fixed budget, and each unit is fed in proportion to how much the units above it use it. A well-fed unit divides and a starving unit dies. This allocation is not a separate analysis or pruning step: it runs throughout training and reads only activations and weights. The task is still learned from labels with the ordinary loss, and the training procedure gains no phase, no schedule and no target size. Because the budget is conserved, the competition is zero-sum and a single number sets the size of the network. Switched on in a pretrained network that is deployed on a narrower domain, the Growth Path shrinks the network while it keeps learning. With Adam the network ends 1.0 to 1.2 points more accurate on the domain than the same network trained ordinarily, at 24% to 60% of its compute, and at 12% of the compute it is still ahead; a random choice of the same number of units gives no gain. Letting starving pretrained units sleep instead of die keeps 1.2 to 4.6 points more of the rarely used content. Over 800 changing tasks a network with the Growth Path holds its accuracy while ordinary networks decline. With plain SGD the gains are smaller: at deployment the method trades compute against rarely used content, and on one of the two continual-learning streams it only ties networks of equal size. The experiments are small (three-layer perceptrons on MNIST-like data); what they show is that a conserved, loss-free second pathway can decide by itself which units a network needs.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"双通路神经元"：在常规任务通路之外增加一条受营养流驱动的"生长通路"，在训练全程以零和预算竞争自动决定神经元的增殖与死亡，实现无额外阶段的无监督结构自适应。
AI.motivation: 人工神经元的数量在网络设计时即被固定，无论是否被使用都要保留并付出计算代价；现有剪枝/结构搜索往往需要额外的分析步骤、裁剪阶段或目标规模设定。作者希望神经元像生物体一样"能计算、能学习，还能生存与死亡"，让网络规模由训练过程本身决定。
AI.method: 给每个神经元附加第二条通路：任务通路执行常规前向计算与梯度学习；生长通路让"营养"从输出端反传，每层获得相同固定预算，单元按上层对其的使用量（仅依赖激活与权重）获得营养分配——营养充足者分裂、饥饿者死亡。预算守恒使竞争为零和，单一超参数即可控制网络规模；整个机制贯穿训练，不引入新阶段、新调度或目标规模，任务仍由标签与普通损失学习。实验为三层感知机在类 MNIST 数据上，含预训练网络在窄域部署、800 个变化任务及 SGD/Adam 对比，并分析"饥饿单元休眠而非死亡"的变体。
AI.result: 在预训练后部署于窄域时，生长通路在持续学习的同时收缩网络：Adam 下精度比常规训练高 1.0–1.2 个百分点，计算量为原来的 24%–60%，仅在 12% 计算量时仍领先；随机选取同数量单元则无收益。将饥饿单元休眠而非杀死可多保留 1.2–4.6 个百分点的低频内容。在 800 个变化任务上保持精度，而普通网络出现衰退。纯 SGD 下增益较小：部署时是在计算量与低频内容之间权衡，且在两条持续学习流之一上仅与同规模网络持平。
AI.conclusion: 实验规模较小（类 MNIST 上的三层感知机），但结果说明一条守恒的、无额外损失的第二通路能够自行判断网络需要哪些单元，把结构决定内嵌于学习过程而非事后分析。

title: ReWeave: Emergent Physical Task Topologies for Embodied Harness Optimization and Cross-Task Meta-Distillation
comment: 22 pages, 7 figures, including supplementary material. Project page at https://xuyicheng-zju.github.io/ReWeave/ and code at https://github.com/xuyicheng-zju/ReWeave
summary: Long-horizon embodied tasks involve physical dependencies that may only become clear through interaction. As task understanding deepens, past trials can reveal new information for adaptation and transfer. However, coarse progress feedback cannot identify which physical preconditions held, leaving search unguided, while task-specific optimization easily overfits to individual scenes, making cross-task transfer brittle. We introduce ReWeave, a framework that jointly optimizes an embodied agent harness and an emergent physical task topology from interaction without updating policy weights. Keeping execution policies and perception frozen, ReWeave co-optimizes coupled context, workflows, and control loops. As new evidence revises the topology, ReWeave reprojects past trials onto the updated task understanding, exposing retained progress, regressions, and bottlenecks that guide parent selection and search width. Across tasks, matching verified local mechanisms to unmet preconditions consolidates 72 specialist units into 44 reusable groups ($0.34\times$ full concatenation) within a compact shared harness capable of continual learning.
