Applied to BIRD without retraining, the confidence scores remain informative (AUROC 0.72, against 0.79 on Spider), but the risk guarantee does not transfer, as expected without exchangeability.

AI.tldr: 将 Text-to-SQL 的置信度估计建模为潜变量正确性下的概率查询验证，用双 LLM（生成器+批评者）加多特征随机森林评分，并用 Learn-then-Test 与共形校准提供风险与错误弃答的有限样本保证。
AI.motivation: Text-to-SQL 系统常返回"执行成功但答错问题"的查询；由于执行正确性依赖仅存在于标注数据中的 gold query，部署时难以检测此类错误，因此需要可部署的置信度估计与可认证的风险控制。
AI.method: 把置信度估计形式化为潜正确性变量下的概率查询验证（校准期可通过 gold-SQL 执行观测、部署期为潜变量）。估计器分离生成与验证：生成器 LLM 写并执行 SQL，另一批评者 LLM 评判查询及执行结果；将批评者的验证分数与执行对齐分数，与生成器的语言化置信度、token 级不确定性、SQL 结构特征在 Random Forest 中融合，共两次顺序 LLM 调用。两级校准：Learn-then-Test 阈值以 1−δ 概率保证被接受查询的错误率低于用户预算；共形 p 值约束错误弃答率。Spider 上用 GPT-OSS-120B 作生成器、Gemma-4-31B 作批评者。
AI.result: Spider 上 AUARC 达 0.899；不弃答时 22.6% 查询错误；15% 风险预算（δ=0.1）下全部 10 次重采样划分均认证出阈值，平均接受 52.4% 查询、观测错误率 9.1%；5 种批评者模型结果相近。Olmo-3-32B 生成器的对照实验中 AUARC 为 89.5，优于最强 logit 基线 81.2。迁移到 BIRD 不重训练时置信分数仍具信息量（AUROC 0.72 对 Spider 0.79），但风险保证不可迁移（符合无交换性预期）。
AI.conclusion: 双模型生成—验证架构配合特征融合与两级统计校准，可在有限样本下提供可认证的 Text-to-SQL 风险控制并显著提升弃答决策质量；其风险保证依赖可交换性，跨分布迁移目前仅保留排序信息。

title: Unleashing the Value of Raw Point Clouds for 3D Understanding with LLMs
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. Tailai Chen and Jiawei Yu contributed equally
summary: Standard 3D point cloud language models typically rely on pretrained point encoders to extract 3D features and project them into representations processable by large language models (LLMs). However, these encoders are often originally optimized for pre-defined tasks, resulting in a representation bottleneck that may lead to a substantial mismatch with downstream 3D understanding. Moreover, existing models largely follow a single pass closed-book generation, limiting their ability to actively inspect task-relevant 3D regions or retrieve necessary external knowledge. In this work, we present PointTool, an encoder-free and tool-augmented framework for 3D reasoning. PointTool introduces Alignment-Free Patch Tokenization (AFPT) to locally aggregate raw point clouds while preserving fine-grained geometric structure, and Decoupled Point-Text LoRA (DPL) to facilitate global aggregation and 3D knowledge internalization within a frozen LLM. Building upon these designs, Program-Supervised Tool Reasoning (PSTR) enables the model to explicitly operate on raw 3D data and external resources through executable tools, supporting interactive 3D reasoning grounded in spatial evidence. We further introduce PointCloud-TR, a benchmark comprising 13K 3D objects, 39.8K questions, and 35.6K tool trajectories to facilitate training and evaluation of complex 3D reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that PointTool achieves strong performance on both standard and complex 3D understanding tasks, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 提出无编码器、工具增强的3D推理框架PointTool，用免对齐patch token化直接处理原始点云，并借助双路LoRA与程序监督的工具推理实现交互式3D理解，同时发布PointCloud-TR基准。
AI.motivation: 现有3D点云语言模型依赖为预定义任务优化的预训练点编码器，形成表示瓶颈，与下游3D理解存在显著不匹配；且普遍采用单次闭卷生成范式，无法主动查看任务相关3D区域或检索外部知识。
AI.method: 1) AFPT（Alignment-Free Patch Tokenization）：直接在原始点云上局部聚合，无需与文本/编码器对齐，保留细粒度几何结构；2) DPL（Decoupled Point-Text LoRA）：在冻结LLM中分别对点与文本做LoRA适配，实现全局聚合与3D知识内化；3) PSTR（Program-Supervised Tool Reasoning）：以程序监督方式让模型通过可执行工具操作原始3D数据与外部资源，实现基于空间证据的交互推理；4) 构建PointCloud-TR基准：13K物体、39.8K问题、35.6K工具轨迹。
AI.result: 在标准与复杂3D理解任务上均取得强性能，验证了无编码器+工具增强框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 摒弃预训练点编码器、以工具调用替代单次闭卷生成是提升3D推理的有效路径，所提框架与基准为复杂3D推理的训练与评测提供了支撑。

title: Low-Rank Tensor Representations for Efficient Multimarginal Optimal Transport
summary: Multimarginal Optimal Transport (MOT) suffers from exponential computational and memory costs in the number of marginals, as transport plans are represented by high-dimensional tensors. We introduce Low-Rank Multimarginal Optimal Transport (LRMOT), which restricts transport plans to tensors with bounded multilinear rank, providing a compact and structured representation of multimarginal couplings. This structure enables efficient algorithms with a low memory footprint. We establish approximation bounds for the resulting low-rank formulations and demonstrate experimentally that the proposed algorithms substantially reduce computational time while achieving solutions with low transport cost.

AI.tldr: 提出低秩多边际最优传输（LRMOT），将传输计划约束为有界多线性秩张量，从而以低内存开销高效求解多边际最优传输（MOT）。
AI.motivation: 多边际最优传输的传输计划表示为高维张量，其计算与内存开销随边际数呈指数增长，难以扩展。
AI.method: 将传输计划限制为具有有界多线性秩的张量（低秩张量分解形式），给出紧凑且有结构的耦合表示，并据此设计低内存占用的高效算法；同时建立低秩形式的近似误差界。
AI.result: 理论上给出了低秩公式的近似界；实验表明所提算法在保持较低传输代价的同时显著降低计算时间。
AI.conclusion: 低秩张量结构可在可控近似误差下有效缓解MOT的维度灾难，实现可扩展的多边际耦合求解。

title: Scenario Compliant Indoor Pedestrian Trajectory Reconstruction from Partial Observation
summary: Pedestrian trajectory reconstruction is vital for applications ranging from security surveillance to indoor navigation. While existing probabilistic and generative frameworks have shown success in outdoor GPS-based trajectory imputation, they often fail in indoor settings where movement is strictly governed by dense geometric constraints such as walls and corridors. Standard models typically treat trajectories as unconstrained coordinate sequences, leading to physically infeasible paths with high collision rates. To address this, we propose a map-conditioned generative framework based on conditional diffusion models. Our approach explicitly integrates dense scenario maps as structured spatial inputs via a CNN-based encoder, allowing environmental geometry to guide the iterative denoising process. Furthermore, we employ an endpoint-aware mechanism by embedding observations (start and end points) directly into the scenario map, providing critical spatial anchors through image-level features. Experiments on simulated indoor trajectories and the real-world Shopper trajectory dataset, with three training seeds, show that our method achieves the lowest errors among the compared generative methods. Scene conditioning reduces the collision and invalid rates by 19\% and 46\% on the simulated dataset, whereas on real shopper data the gains are consistent but small, mainly because the model rarely learns to route around obstacles between the endpoints. Compared with a shortest-path planner, which never collides, our method better captures the variability of real motion (31\% lower CRPS), but the timing of stops is reconstructed only partially. These results show that explicit environmental context improves physical consistency, while reconstructing realistic human motion in real indoor spaces remains challenging. Our code is available at https://github.com/dang-qi/trajectory_reconstruction

AI.tldr: 提出基于条件扩散模型的地图条件生成框架，将密集场景地图通过CNN编码作为结构化空间输入，并将起止点嵌入地图图像作为端点锚点，用于室内行人轨迹重建，在仿真与真实购物者数据上取得更低误差和更高物理可行性。
AI.motivation: 室内轨迹受墙壁、走廊等密集几何约束主导，现有概率与生成式方法将其视为无约束坐标序列，产生大量碰撞与物理不可行路径，而这类方法在室外GPS轨迹插补上的成功难以迁移到室内。
AI.method: 以条件扩散模型为骨干的生成式框架：用CNN编码器将密集场景地图作为结构化空间条件注入，引导迭代去噪过程；采用端点感知机制，把观测到的起点与终点直接渲染嵌入场景地图，以图像级特征提供空间锚点。
AI.result: 在仿真室内轨迹与真实Shopper数据集上、3个训练种子的实验显示：相比对比的生成式方法误差最低；场景条件使仿真数据的碰撞率与无效率分别下降19%和46%；真实数据上增益一致但较小，主因是模型很少学会绕障路由；相比永不碰撞的最短路径规划器，本方法CRPS低31%更能刻画真实运动变异性，但停留时序仅能部分重建。
AI.conclusion: 显式环境上下文可显著提升物理一致性，但在真实室内空间中重建拟人化运动仍具挑战；未来需强化绕障路由能力与停留时序建模。

title: Seeking in Space: Benchmarking Purposeful Active Exploration of Vision-Language Models for Spatial Reasoning
summary: Humans explore unfamiliar spaces with purpose, deciding where to look until they have gathered the evidence a spatial question requires. However, can vision-language models (VLMs), which reason increasingly well over curated images and videos, also seek in space when the evidence is not handed to them? We present ActSpace-Bench, a benchmark of 994 questions across 234 exploration episodes in 72 real-scanned indoor scenes, where a model starts from a single view, navigates real captured frames, and must gather evidence before answering. To assess whether such exploration is purposeful, we introduce a controlled evaluation protocol that fixes each model as the reasoner and compares its own exploration against a same-budget random walk and an oracle route, separating evidence seeking from spatial reasoning. Every question is verified to require exploration and answered from 3D annotations, masked-evidence questions test whether models know when to abstain, and over 95% of sampled questions are confirmed correct by human verification. Evaluations of 23 proprietary, open-weight, and spatially specialized VLMs reveal that the strongest models do seek evidence with purpose but lose much of it to limited memory, whereas weaker and specialized models explore no better than a random walk or fail to reason over the evidence they are given, pointing to memory and evidence-grounded reasoning as the next targets for active spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出 ActSpace-Bench：994 题、234 个探索回合、72 个真实扫描室内场景的主动空间探索基准，用严格的对照协议将"证据寻求"与"空间推理"解耦，评估 23 个 VLM 后发现强模型能有意探索但受限于记忆，弱模型/空间专用模型不及随机游走或无法基于证据推理。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 在给定图像/视频上的空间推理已较强，但真实场景中证据需主动获取。尚不清楚模型能否"有目的地"在空间中搜索证据，且既有评测把探索能力与推理能力混在一起，无法判断模型变好是"会找"还是"会想"。
AI.method: 构建 ActSpace-Bench：单视角起步，在真实采集帧中导航，先收集证据再作答。设计控制评测协议——固定同一模型作推理器，将其自身探索轨迹与同预算随机游走、oracle 路线对比，分离证据寻求与空间推理；每题经校验必须依赖探索、答案来自 3D 标注；设 masked-evidence 题测试弃答（abstention）意识；超 95% 抽样题经人工核验正确。评测 23 个闭源、开放权重与空间专用 VLM。
AI.result: 最强模型表现出有目的的定向探索，但因记忆容量有限大量丢失已获证据；较弱模型与空间专用模型的探索效率不优于随机游走，或无法对已给证据进行推理。模型间差距主要来自记忆保持与证据落地推理，而非单纯导航策略。
AI.conclusion: 主动空间智能的下一步关键在记忆机制与证据支撑的推理（memory 与 evidence-grounded reasoning），而非仅提升探索策略；该基准与对照协议为区分"会找"与"会想"提供了可复用的评测范式。

title: PartPO: Part-Level Policy Optimization for Shape-to-Program Generation
summary: We present PartPO, a reinforcement learning method for generating structured shape programs from 3D point clouds. Existing shape-to-program models are trained with supervised learning on procedurally generated data and generalize poorly to more diverse shapes, while reinforcement learning from execution feedback assigns a single scalar reward to a long program that builds many parts, making credit assignment difficult. PartPO instead builds on a core property of the task: shape programs are self-describing, with each semantically named part produced by its own code block. It segments each generated program by its parts and applies part-level rewards only to the code of the corresponding part, a category reward only to the object name, and a shape-level reward to the whole program. The required part supervision is obtained without manual annotation, by grounding part names on target meshes with an open-vocabulary segmentation model prompt-tuned on the model's own outputs. Applied to MeshCoder, PartPO improves reconstruction accuracy and execution success on ShapeNetCore and ABO over the base model, rejection-sampling fine-tuning and trajectory-level RL, and generalizes to the unseen HSSD dataset. Code will be released at https://github.com/HannuoZ/PartPO.

AI.tldr: PartPO：将程序按语义部件分段并施加部件级/类别级/形状级分层奖励的强化学习方法，用于从3D点云生成结构化形状程序，无需人工标注部件监督。
AI.motivation: 现有形状到程序模型依赖程序化生成数据上的监督学习，泛化性差；而基于执行反馈的强化学习将单一标量奖励赋给构建多部件的长程序，导致信用分配困难。
AI.method: 利用形状程序"自描述"特性（每个语义命名部件由独立代码块生成）：按部件切分生成程序，仅对对应部件代码施加部件级奖励，仅对物体名称施加类别奖励，对整体程序施加形状级奖励。部件监督无需人工标注，通过在被模型自身输出上提示调优的开词汇分割模型，将部件名称 grounding 到目标网格上获得。
AI.result: 在MeshCoder基础上，PartPO在ShapeNetCore与ABO上提升了重建精度与执行成功率，优于基座模型、拒绝采样微调及轨迹级RL，并泛化到未见的HSSD数据集。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用程序的结构化自描述性实现细粒度信用分配，并结合自动获得的部件级监督，PartPO 有效缓解了长序列奖励稀疏问题，提升了形状程序生成的准确性与泛化能力。

title: IP-GNO: An Inductive Physics-Informed Graph Neural Operator for Automated Distribution System State Estimation
summary: Distribution System State Estimation (DSSE) is a crucial tool for real-time monitoring, operation, and control of the new-age distribution systems (DSs) due to intensified voltage fluctuations and operational uncertainties introduced by volatile power injection at the nodes. Existing GNN-based approaches generally exhibit limited generalization across networks with different sizes and topologies, making zero-shot cross-grid transfer to unseen DSs a significant challenge. To overcome the aforementioned challenges, this article proposes an Inductive Physics-Informed Graph Neural Operator (IP-GNO) for scalable and transferable DSSE. The proposed framework frames complex bus voltage estimation as an operator-learning problem inspired by the Neumann series expansion of the inverse bus admittance matrix. An admittance-parameterized kernel, incorporating a self-admittance gate in the zeroth-order term and a persistent source-injection skip connection across network layers, captures the underlying electrical dependencies. Additionally, a Physics-Embedded Tree Encoding (PETE) scheme introduces five grid-size-invariant positional features derived from path impedance and a DC-linearized phase-angle prior. A sine-cosine output formulation is further employed to address phase-angle periodicity and ensure stable training. The proposed IP-GNO module is evaluated on two small (IEEE 33- and 69-bus), two medium (IEEE 123- and 136-bus), and one large (2522-bus) sized DSs. Particularly, its zero-shot cross-grid generalization capability is investigated by training the model exclusively on the IEEE 33-bus system and directly evaluating it on four unseen distribution networks of different sizes without retraining or fine-tuning. A detailed comparative analysis with the existing state-of-the-art DSSE tools proves the superiority of IP-GNO, enabling scalable DSSE across heterogeneous DSs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出归纳式物理信息图神经算子（IP-GNO），将配电系统状态估计（DSSE）建模为算子学习问题，实现跨不同规模与拓扑配电网的可扩展、可迁移状态估计，并具备零样本跨网迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 新型配电系统节点功率注入波动性强，导致电压波动与运行不确定性加剧，DSSE 对实时监测与控制至关重要。现有基于 GNN 的方法在不同规模与拓扑网络间泛化能力有限，难以实现向未见配电网的零样本迁移。
AI.method: 受母线导纳矩阵逆的 Neumann 级数展开启发，将母线电压估计表述为算子学习问题。设计导纳参数化核：零阶项引入自导纳门控，跨层引入持续源注入跳跃连接以刻画电气依赖。提出物理嵌入树编码（PETE），由路径阻抗与直流线性化相角先验构造五个与电网规模无关的位置特征。输出采用正弦-余弦形式以处理相角周期性并保证训练稳定。
AI.result: 在两类小型（IEEE 33、69 节点）、两类中型（IEEE 123、136 节点）及一个大型（2522 节点）配电系统上评估；仅在 IEEE 33 节点系统训练，直接零样本测试于四个未见的不同规模配电网，无需重训或微调即取得良好效果，并与现有先进 DSSE 工具对比显示更优性能。
AI.conclusion: IP-GNO 具备规模可扩展性与跨异构配电网的零样本迁移能力，优于现有 DSSE 方法，为异构配电系统的可扩展状态估计提供了有效方案。

title: A colour-marker tracker for pose estimation of slender surgical instruments: vision-language-model-guided adaptive colour calibration
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Extended version of a manuscript submitted to a journal
summary: Slender surgical instruments need small, narrow markers for camera-based pose estimation. A colour-stripe marker fits this requirement, but its colours in the image drift from the design values with lighting, printing and camera settings. Because the colours can only be corrected after the marker has been found, methods that rely on the design colours face a circular problem. We propose vision-language-model (VLM)-based adaptive colour calibration and compare it with two rule-based methods, which re-measure the colours from detections made with the design colours: Initial colour update does so once after tracking starts, and Colour adaptation continuously during tracking. VLM guidance uses a fine-tuned VLM to find the markers without relying on the design colours and builds the colour profile from their pixels. Recall/F1 (%) for Initial colour update, Colour adaptation and VLM guidance were 92.0/95.7, 87.8/93.3 and 98.2/99.1 on 672 synthetic image pairs; 51.3/67.2, 48.8/65.0 and 83.8/87.0 on eight degraded laboratory videos; and 38.9/55.2, 19.7/29.7 and 100/100 on a surgical-robot (da Vinci) video with strongly shifted colours. In that video the rule-based methods never found the purple/cyan marker, whereas VLM guidance found all 234 markers with no false positives. In a simulation, the hue boundary between the two stripes moved by less than 0.1 pixel for exposure gains of 0.5-2.0, compared with 2.9-4.0 pixels for a boundary found with a fixed brightness threshold. When the degradation is mild, the rule-based methods, which need no training and no GPU, are sufficient. When the colours change greatly, the gain comes from a VLM-guided candidate search that does not rely on the design colours. Combining colour-stripe markers with adaptive colour calibration enables tracking of slender surgical instruments with small markers.

AI.tldr: 针对细长手术器械的小尺寸彩色条纹标记在光照、打印与相机设置变化下颜色漂移、且"需先找到标记才能校色"的循环困境，提出基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的自适应颜色校准，并与两种基于规则的校准方法对比，显著提升标记检测鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 细长手术器械需要小而窄的标记做基于相机的位姿估计，彩色条纹标记符合尺寸要求；但图像中的颜色会因光照、打印和相机设置偏离设计值。颜色只能在标记被找到之后才可校正，因此依赖设计颜色的检测方法存在循环问题。
AI.method: 提出基于VLM的自适应颜色校准：用微调后的VLM在不依赖设计颜色的条件下定位标记，并由其像素构建颜色剖面。作为对照，实现两种规则方法——"初始颜色更新"（跟踪开始后只重新测量一次颜色）与"颜色自适应"（跟踪过程中持续更新）。另在仿真中比较色相边界定位精度（相对固定亮度阈值边界法）。
AI.result: Recall/F1 (%)：672组合成图像对上，初始更新92.0/95.7、颜色自适应87.8/93.3、VLM引导98.2/99.1；8段退化实验室视频上分别为51.3/67.2、48.8/65.0、83.8/87.0；在颜色强烈偏移的da Vinci手术机器人视频上为38.9/55.2、19.7/29.7、100/100，规则方法从未找到紫/青标记，而VLM引导找到全部234个标记且无误检。仿真中曝光增益0.5–2.0时，VLM引导下两条纹色相边界移动小于0.1像素，固定亮度阈值法为2.9–4.0像素。
AI.conclusion: 退化轻微时，无需训练、无需GPU的规则方法已足够；颜色变化剧烈时，收益来自不依赖设计颜色的VLM引导候选搜索。彩色条纹标记结合自适应颜色校准可实现小标记下细长手术器械的跟踪。

title: Language Models Steer on Injected Uncertainty Tokens, but Fail to Self-Monitor In Situ
summary:
Prompting language models to verbalize stepwise numerical confidence during generation is an increasingly popular approach for triggering backtracking and error correction in agentic reasoning. This strategy presupposes two capabilities: (1) in-situ monitoring fidelity (does confidence drop when an error occurs?) and (2) downstream steering control (does an uncertainty token causally steer the model to repair its error?). We evaluated four open-weights models (Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, and Phi-4, 14.7B) across 15,200 math benchmark attempts, isolating 2,017 reasoning errors within each model's capability frontier. Applying 27,568 counterfactual continuations across these failure points, we demonstrate a consistent decoupling between monitoring and control.
  On monitoring, all four models fail to detect their own errors. Verbalized confidence does not distinguish mistake steps from sound reasoning, yielding near-chance within-position AUROCs between 0.500 and 0.561. Even at a model's first reasoning error, trajectory confidence remains saturated at 95.1% to 99.9%, with noticeable drops ($\ge 10$ points) appearing on fewer than 9% of errors in Llama and under 1.6% in the other three models. In contrast, models respond readily to external uncertainty: injecting a low-confidence tag (10%) at the error step significantly increases downstream correction across all models (+3.7 to +22.5 points over format-matched 95% certainty; all $p \le 0.0022$), reaching up to 38.5% under active rethinking instructions. However, injecting doubt onto already-correct steps causes models to discard valid reasoning, reducing solve rates by up to 22.8 points. Inference-time self-correction is thus bottlenecked by in-situ error detection rather than downstream repair capacity: models readily steer toward recovery when prompted with doubt, yet fail to self-monitor during generation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模对照实验揭示：让语言模型在生成中口头表达数值置信度以触发自我纠错的策略存在"监控-控制解耦"——模型能响应外部注入的不确定性进行纠错，却无法在生成过程中检测自身错误。
AI.motivation: verbalize 置信度（如输出数值信心）作为触发回溯与纠错的手段日益流行，但该策略隐含两个未经检验的前提：(1) 原位监控保真性——出错时置信度是否真的下降；(2) 下游引导可控性——不确定符号能否因果性地驱动模型修复错误。作者旨在分别检验这两项能力是否成立。
AI.method: 评估四个开放权重模型（Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Phi-4 14.7B），在15,200次数学基准尝试中，于各模型能力前沿内隔离出2,017个推理错误点；在每个失败点施加27,568条反事实续写，分别测量错误步与正确步的口头置信度差异（同位置AUROC、首次错误时置信度水平），以及注入10%低置信度标签（对照格式匹配的95%高置信度）对下游纠错率的因果影响，并进行正确步注入怀疑的反向实验。
AI.result: 监控侧：四个模型均无法察觉自身错误，口头置信度对错误步与正确步几乎无区分能力，同位置AUROC仅0.500–0.561（接近随机）；首次推理错误处轨迹置信度仍饱和于95.1%–99.9%，≥10分的明显下降在Llama中不足9%的错误、其余三个模型不足1.6%。控制侧：模型对外部不确定性响应显著，在错误步注入10%低置信度标签后下游纠错率提升+3.7至+22.5分（相对格式匹配的95%确定性，均p≤0.0022），在主动反思指令下最高达38.5%；但对已正确步骤注入怀疑会使模型丢弃有效推理，解题率最多下降22.8分。
AI.conclusion: 推理期的自我纠错瓶颈在于原位错误检测，而非下游修复能力：模型在被提示怀疑时能顺利转向恢复，却在生成过程中无法自我监控。因此，仅靠让模型口头表达置信度不足以实现有效自纠错，需将监控与修复解耦设计，优先解决可靠的在线错误检测。

title: Ego-HMB: Human Motion Bridging from Egocentric Images via A Motion Bridge Diffusion Model
summary: We introduce Egocentric Human Motion Bridging, a task that generates a coherent 3D human motion sequence from two endpoint egocentric images. Unlike conventional motion in-betweening, which requires structured 3D endpoint poses, this setting uses raw first-person observations available from wearable devices in VR/AR and robotics. It presents challenges due to viewpoint variations, partial body visibility, and temporal ambiguity under cross-modal endpoint constraints. To address these challenges, we propose Ego-HMB, a unified diffusion-based framework that learns endpoint pose estimation and temporally consistent motion infilling within a single model through two training stages. First, Egocentric-to-Canonical Pretraining uses a hierarchical curriculum with progressively increasing temporal spans to strengthen endpoint pose priors. Second, Motion Bridge Diffusion Training incorporates endpoint and physics awareness, diffusing from neighboring poses to promote temporal continuity while preserving global endpoint constraints. Extensive experiments compare our approach with one-stage methods that directly generate motion from two egocentric images and two-stage pipelines that combine endpoint pose estimation with motion interpolation. Ego-HMB consistently outperforms these baselines in endpoint accuracy and motion generation quality. Code is available at https://github.com/gaogehan/Ego-HMB.

AI.tldr: 提出新任务“自我中心人体运动桥接”（Egocentric Human Motion Bridging），并给出统一的扩散框架 Ego-HMB，从两帧第一人称图像生成连贯的 3D 人体运动序列。
AI.motivation: 传统 motion in-betweening 依赖结构化的 3D 端点姿态，而 VR/AR 与机器人中可获取的是原始第一人称观测。直接使用这类观测存在视角变化、身体部分可见以及跨模态端点约束下的时序歧义等困难。
AI.method: Ego-HMB 为单一扩散模型内统一学习端点姿态估计与时序一致的运动填充，采用两阶段训练：1）Egocentric-to-Canonical Pretraining，用时间跨度递增的分层课程强化端点姿态先验；2）Motion Bridge Diffusion Training，引入端点感知与物理感知，从邻近姿态扩散以提升时序连续性并保持全局端点约束。
AI.result: 与直接从两帧自我中心图像生成运动的一阶段方法、以及“端点姿态估计+运动插值”的两阶段流水线相比，Ego-HMB 在端点精度与运动生成质量上均持续优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 说明统一扩散框架可有效缓解跨模态端点约束下的时序歧义，为可穿戴设备场景下的自我中心运动生成提供了可行方案；代码已开源。

title: Time Series Foundation Models on the Edge
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TS-LIMITS
summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) forecast zero-shot with accuracy exceeding that of task-specific models, and the smaller ones fit on edge devices. Operational deployments must refresh their forecast as new observations arrive, and privacy and latency requirements often force this refresh onto resource-constrained edge devices. To serve as a forecasting system there, a TSFM must refresh quickly, keep latency and peak memory bounded as the stream grows, and retain its accuracy as the observed history accumulates. Refreshing incrementally without altering the forecast requires temporal causality: non-causal models recompute at every update, causal attention admits a KV cache that grows linearly, and causal recurrent models update a fixed-size state in constant time and memory. We make these states persist across refreshes for every causal architecture and verify equivalence to full recomputation. We evaluate nine TSFM configurations on univariate forecasting against all three requirements, measuring accuracy as a function of context length, single-refresh latency, and latency and memory on streams of up to one million time steps on a server-grade GPU and three edge devices. No model gains on average accuracy beyond its trained context and most lose it well before the full history is reached, while KV caches leave latency and memory growing linearly with the retained history. TiRex-2 is the only one of the nine configurations meeting all three requirements: it refreshes in 14 ms on the GPU and 120 ms on a Raspberry Pi 5, keeps latency, energy and peak memory constant over a million steps, and retains its accuracy on the untruncated history.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了九种时间序列基础模型（TSFM）在边缘设备上增量刷新的三项部署要求（快速刷新、有界延迟/峰值内存、长历史下精度保持），并提出跨所有因果架构的状态持久化方法；结论是仅 TiRex-2 同时满足全部要求。
AI.motivation: TSFM 在零样本预测上精度可超任务专用模型，小模型还能部署到边缘设备。但实际运营部署必须随新观测到达而刷新预测，且隐私与延迟要求常迫使刷新发生在资源受限的边缘端。因此一个 TSFM 若要充当边缘预测系统，就必须：快速刷新、在流式数据增长时保持延迟与峰值内存有界、并在历史不断累积时维持精度。
AI.method: 作者以"时间因果性"为核心分析框架：非因果模型每次更新都需全量重算；因果注意力可用线性增长的 KV 缓存；因果循环模型则以常数时间与常数内存更新固定规模状态。作者将这类状态在每次刷新之间持久化，覆盖所有因果架构，并验证其结果与全量重算等价。随后在服务器级 GPU 与三种边缘设备上，对九种 TSFM 配置做单变量预测评测，测量三项指标：精度随上下文长度的变化、单次刷新延迟、以及长达一百万步流上的延迟与内存。
AI.result: 实验显示：没有任何模型在超出其训练上下文后还能获得平均精度提升，多数模型在远未达到完整历史前精度就已下降；KV 缓存方案的延迟与内存随保留历史线性增长。九种配置中唯有 TiRex-2 同时满足三项要求——在 GPU 上刷新耗时 14 ms、在 Raspberry Pi 5 上 120 ms，在百万步流上延迟、能耗与峰值内存保持恒定，并在未截断的完整历史上保持精度。
AI.conclusion: 因果架构中的状态持久化是实现边缘端增量刷新的可行路径，但其充分性高度依赖模型设计。现有 TSFM 普遍无法在长历史流上兼顾速度、资源有界与精度，TiRex-2 是唯一三者兼得的配置，说明面向流式部署的 TSFM 需在架构层面显式考虑因果性、常数状态与长上下文鲁棒性。

title: Hierarchical Reasoning Action Head for Tiny Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Real-time onboard robot control calls for a lightweight vision-language-action (VLA) model, yet shrinking the backbone leaves less capacity for deliberation at inference time. Chain-of-thought decoding, dual-system architectures, and larger backbones can restore deliberation but reintroduce the latency and memory costs that motivated going small. Recurrent action heads offer a lighter alternative by iterating in latent space before committing to an action, but existing designs refine a single undifferentiated state that must simultaneously encode slowly evolving task context and rapidly changing motor commands. We propose the Hierarchical Reasoning Action Head (HR-AH), which maintains two latent states updated at different frequencies: a low-level state that updates fast, grounded in action tokens and proprioception, and a high-level state that updates slowly, grounded in visual understanding and the instruction-informed low-level state. The two states exchange information through nested reasoning cycles. Because all iteration occurs in the compact head after a single backbone pass, HR-AH adds hierarchical reasoning without increasing the backbone size. With a 22.5M-parameter head, 3-4.3x smaller than those of RD-VLA and VLA-Adapter on the same backbone, HR-AH reaches 97.0% success rate on LIBERO and a 4.40 average chain length on CALVIN ABC->D, at the lowest latency among compared methods. We show that this hierarchy improves performance over a parameter-matched single-state head, and that routing distinct modalities to each level yields further gains in both accuracy and inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出分层推理动作头HR-AH，用快/慢双隐状态在紧凑头部内完成推理迭代，在不增大骨干的前提下降低VLA时延并提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 实时机载机器人控制需要轻量VLA模型，但缩小骨干会削弱推理能力；CoT解码、双系统架构、加大骨干虽能恢复推理，却重新引入时延与内存开销。循环动作头是更轻的替代方案，但现有设计只精炼单一无区分隐状态，须同时编码缓慢变化的任务上下文与快速变化的运动指令，造成表征冲突。
AI.method: 提出分层推理动作头（HR-AH），维护以不同频率更新的两个隐状态：低层状态更新快，以动作token和本体感受为依托；高层状态更新慢，以视觉理解和受指令引导的低层状态为依托。二者通过嵌套推理循环交换信息。所有迭代均在单次骨干前向之后的紧凑头部内完成，从而在不增大骨干规模的情况下引入分层推理。
AI.result: 在22.5M参数的动作头下（同骨干上比RD-VLA与VLA-Adapter小3–4.3倍），HR-AH在LIBERO上达到97.0%成功率，在CALVIN ABC→D上平均链长4.40，且为对比方法中最低时延。消融显示该分层结构优于参数匹配的单状态头；将不同模态路由到不同层级可在精度与推理开销上进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 分层、分频的隐空间循环推理可在紧凑动作头内实现，作为骨干扩容与CoT解码的轻量替代，在保持低时延的同时获得更强的具身决策性能。

title: Why Adaptive Optimizers Struggle with Large Convolution Kernels
summary: Large convolution kernels enlarge the receptive fields of ConvNets at a modest computational cost, but they are notoriously difficult to train. Existing large-kernel networks therefore rely on costly training techniques, such as parallel small-kernel branches with batch normalization. In this paper, we trace this difficulty to adaptive optimizers such as Adam, which normalize the update of every weight separately. Since input features rarely average to zero, all weights of a kernel share a common gradient, and these optimizers move the mean of a $k\times k$ kernel $k$ times as far as a single parameter. We find this mean amplification in widely used ConvNets and vision transformers, and show that it can force the maximal learning rate to fall as $1/k^2$. We further prove that the basis of the discrete cosine transform (DCT) isolates the mean and is the only orthonormal basis that diagonalizes every stationary gradient statistic with mirrored boundaries. We therefore train large kernels through their DCT coefficients and convert them back after training. The resulting method, DCT-Rep, requires only a few lines of code and adds no parameters, no inference cost and negligible training overhead. Extensive experiments on image classification, object detection, semantic segmentation and image restoration show that DCT-Rep consistently improves large-kernel ConvNets and vision transformers, by $+0.79\%$ top-1 accuracy for a large-kernel ConvNeXt-T and $+0.43\%$ for ViT-S/16 on ImageNet-1K, $+1.4$ box AP on COCO, $+1.2$ mIoU on ADE20K and up to $+0.4$ dB on image deblurring, where the gain grows with the kernel size.

AI.tldr: 论文指出大卷积核训练困难的根源在于 Adam 等自适应优化器对核内均值更新的放大效应（k×k 核均值的移动幅度是单参数的 k 倍），并证明 DCT 基可隔离均值，提出通过 DCT 系数训练大核的 DCT-Rep 方法，零参数、零推理开销，在分类/检测/分割/复原任务上一致涨点。
AI.motivation: 大卷积核能以较小计算代价扩大感受野，但难以训练；现有大核网络只能依赖并行小核分支+BN 等昂贵训练技巧。作者希望找到训练困难的真正机理，从而以低成本方式直接训练大核。
AI.method: 将训练困难归因于自适应优化器的逐权重归一化：输入特征均值非零，使 k×k 核内所有权重共享一个公共梯度，Adam 类优化器将该核的均值移动量放大 k 倍，导致最大可用学习率随 1/k² 下降。理论上证明 DCT 基能够隔离均值，且是唯一在镜像边界下对角化所有平稳梯度统计量的正交基。据此提出 DCT-Rep：在 DCT 系数空间训练大核，训练后变换回原参数空间，仅需数行代码，不增加参数、不增加推理开销，训练开销可忽略。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-1K 上，大核 ConvNeXt-T 提升 +0.79% top-1，ViT-S/16 提升 +0.43%；COCO 检测 +1.4 box AP；ADE20K 分割 +1.2 mIoU；图像去模糊最高 +0.4 dB，且增益随核尺寸增大而增大。
AI.conclusion: 大核训练困难主要源于自适应优化器的均值放大，而非架构本身；在 DCT 基下训练可从根本上缓解该问题。DCT-Rep 是一种即插即用、无参数与推理代价的通用改进，适用于大核 ConvNet 与 ViT 的多类视觉任务。

title: Optimistic Online Learning for Coding Agents with Aggregate Feedback
summary: Large language model (LLM) coding agents operating on Web development platforms can interact with repositories, issue trackers, and continuous integration services to carry out long-horizon software engineering tasks. However, behavioral drift remains a major bottleneck in such multi-turn reasoning and action trajectories. To mitigate this, activation steering has emerged as a promising approach for regularizing agent behaviors by intervening on the LLM's transformer residual streams. Nonetheless, existing methods typically apply a static steering policy across all tasks, overlooking the fact that a single policy is rarely effective across heterogeneous tasks and varying execution turns. This limitation motivates dynamic online selection among candidate steering policies. Yet, doing so in long-horizon agentic settings is challenging: verifiable task-level feedback is only revealed upon task completion, leaving the contributions of individual steering turns unobserved. To address this challenge, we formulate online steering-policy selection as a multi-armed bandit problem with delayed task-level feedback and turn-level predictive hints derived from residual-stream activations. Within this formulation, we introduce Online Optimistic Activation Steering, a meta-framework that uses hints to guide within-task steering policy selection and leverages terminal task-level feedback to correct cumulative reward estimates. Theoretically, against the best fixed policy in hindsight, we prove regret bounds that tighten with increasing hint accuracy and establish a matching lower bound with respect to prediction error and candidate policy count. Empirical evaluations on realistic coding benchmarks demonstrate that our framework outperforms both static steering policies and naive online adaptive baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文将长程LLM编码智能体的激活引导策略选择建模为带延迟任务级反馈与轮级预测提示的多臂老虎机问题，提出Online Optimistic Activation Steering元框架，实现任务内动态选择引导策略，理论上有更紧的遗憾界，实验中优于静态与朴素在线基线。
AI.motivation: LLM编码智能体在多轮推理—行动轨迹中存在行为漂移；激活引导可正则化行为，但现有方法对所有任务采用静态引导策略，忽略了任务异质性与执行轮次差异，单一策略难以通用，因此需要在线动态选择候选引导策略。而在长程智能体场景中，可验证的任务级反馈仅在任务完成时出现，单轮引导的贡献不可观测，构成核心挑战。
AI.method: 将在线引导策略选择建模为具有延迟任务级反馈与轮级预测提示（由残差流激活得到）的多臂老虎机问题；提出Online Optimistic Activation Steering元框架：用提示指导任务内的引导策略选择，并用终止时的任务级反馈校正累积奖励估计。
AI.result: 理论上，相对事后最优固定策略给出遗憾界，且该界随提示准确率提高而收紧，并建立了关于预测误差与候选策略数量的匹配下界；在真实编码基准上，该框架优于静态引导策略与朴素在线自适应基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过把延迟反馈与轮级提示结合到乐观式老虎机框架中，可有效实现长程编码智能体的动态激活引导选择，兼具理论保证与实证有效性。

title: Dynamics Forcing: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Causal Video World Models
summary: Causal video world models generate block by block from their own previous outputs. Small errors in early blocks are fed back as history and grow until the scene and the robot fall apart. Teacher forcing trains on clean ground-truth history, so the model never sees the history it will actually condition on, and it also finds a shortcut: copying the previous frame instead of predicting how the scene changes. We present Dynamics Forcing, a training scheme that keeps real video as the only supervision and reshapes how history is presented. History is perturbed in three ways: random noising, self-resampling by the model itself, and joint denoising, in which the most recent blocks are still partly noisy when the next block is predicted. On top of this we move history guidance and first-frame anchor guidance from inference into training, so that the model is pushed to use its history and its reference frame rather than ignore them. Dynamics Forcing needs no teacher model, no distillation, and no additional model at inference. Applied to a 5B video model with LoRA on 77 hours of manipulation video on a single GPU, it better matches unseen real continuations and reduces error accumulation.

AI.tldr: Dynamics Forcing 提出一种无需教师模型、无需蒸馏的因果视频世界模型训练方案，仅以真实视频为监督，通过对历史信息做三种扰动（随机加噪、自重采样、联合去噪）并把引导机制从推理阶段移入训练阶段，缓解误差累积与"复制上一帧"的捷径。
AI.motivation: 因果视频世界模型逐块自回归生成，早期块的微小误差会作为历史被反馈并逐步放大，最终导致场景与机器人崩解。Teacher forcing 用干净真值历史训练，模型从未见过推理时真正要依赖的（自生成、含噪）历史；同时模型会学到"复制上一帧"的捷径而非预测场景动态变化。
AI.method: 提出 Dynamics Forcing 训练方案：保留真实视频作为唯一监督，重塑历史呈现方式。具体包括：(1) 对历史做随机加噪；(2) 由模型自身进行自重采样；(3) 联合去噪——预测下一块时最近的块仍部分含噪。此外将历史引导与首帧锚定引导从推理阶段迁移到训练阶段，迫使模型真正利用历史与参考帧而非忽略它们。该方法不需要教师模型、不需蒸馏、推理时也不引入额外模型。
AI.result: 在单 GPU 上用 LoRA 对 5B 视频模型、77 小时操作视频进行训练，模型更贴合未见过的真实后续片段，并降低了误差累积。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练时暴露于被扰动的自生成历史并内化引导信号，Dynamics Forcing 以低成本（单 GPU、LoRA、无教师/蒸馏）有效提升因果视频世界模型的长程一致性与动态预测能力，抑制自回归误差累积。

title: Complementary Geometry in Gaussian Splatting
summary: Gaussian Splatting has achieved high visual quality in novel view synthesis, but the accuracy of its rendered geometry remains a challenge. In particular, the rendered depth is computed as an opacity-weighted average along each ray, which may not correspond to the actual scene surface. In this paper, we observe that depth predictions from different views of the same frozen Gaussian representation exhibit complementary errors, allowing us to improve novel-view geometry using information from other views without modifying the original representation. Based on this observation, we propose REVEAL, a general framework that selectively refines novel-view depth using complementary geometric information. Specifically, we first reproject depth predictions from source views to the target view and combine them using robust multi-view consensus. We then introduce a learned selection mechanism to determine whether the candidate depth is more accurate than the original prediction, based on the expected reduction in depth error. In addition, we introduce RIG, a real-world benchmark captured with synchronized RGB-D cameras, which provides ground-truth depth for evaluating both static and dynamic reconstruction models. Experiments on 6 Gaussian Splatting backbones across 3 benchmarks show that REVEAL consistently improves depth accuracy while maintaining comparable rendering quality.

AI.tldr: REVEAL：一种无需修改原高斯表示、利用多视角互补几何信息选择性精化新视角深度的通用框架，并配套提出真实场景RGB-D基准RIG。
AI.motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting在新视角合成上视觉质量高，但其渲染深度是沿光线的不透明度加权平均，未必对应真实场景表面，几何精度不足；同时作者观察到同一冻结高斯表示在不同视角下的深度预测误差具有互补性，因此可在不改动原表示的前提下借助其他视角信息提升新视角几何。
AI.method: 1) 将源视角深度重投影到目标视角，并通过鲁棒多视角一致性（consensus）融合候选深度；2) 引入学习型选择机制，基于预期深度误差的下降量判断候选深度是否优于原始预测，从而进行选择性精化；3) 构建RIG真实世界基准，使用同步RGB-D相机采集，提供真值深度，用于评测静态与动态重建模型。
AI.result: 在3个基准、6种高斯泼溅骨干网络上，REVEAL一致提升深度精度，同时保持可比的渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: 多视角互补几何信息可有效纠正高斯泼溅的深度偏差；该框架具有通用性、即插即用且不改动原表示；RIG为真实场景几何评测（含动态）提供了带真值深度的基准。

title: Does coverage explain core-set active learning? Mean, max, and the choice of distance
summary: Core-set selection casts batch active learning as a covering problem, in which the points to label minimise the covering radius of the pool. Its main argument is a generalization bound in which this radius controls the gap between the loss on the pool and on the labelled sample. We examine what this bound requires and what it says in practice. We first state it with the assumption that its proof uses at the labelled points, a zero conditional risk, and show that it then holds for any dissimilarity and any selection rule that uses no label outside the sample. The proof works point by point and involves two averages, the mean distance of the pool to the labelled sample and the purity of the cells attached to the labelled points. Keeping them gives, when labels are deterministic at the labelled points, a bound on the pool loss with no zero-loss assumption and without the factor C, the number of classes, of the original constant. We then compare scales, for deterministic labels and a regression function Lipschitz on the whole pool. With the original constant, the bound can be informative only if the radius is below the smallest distance between two classes divided by C. Without C, its radius form can be informative only once the nearest-neighbour rule built on the sample is exact on the pool. Finally, a misalignment criterion measures whether a quantity ranks selections as the gap or the test error do. Experiments on a Gaussian pool and on two image pools, digits and MNIST, the latter under eight distances, and with a network retrained at each cycle, show that the radius does not rank selections consistently with the gap and, on the image pools, that the bounds that do not use the labels of the pool are never informative and that covering in mean rather than in maximum, as greedy k-medoids does, gives a higher purity and accuracy than random sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视核心集选择（core-set selection）的泛化界，证明该界并不真正依赖半径或覆盖式选择规则，并指出其在实际尺度下几乎不可能给出有效（非平凡）的界；实验表明半径与真实泛化差距/测试误差的排序不一致，用均值覆盖（如贪心k-medoids）比最大半径覆盖更能提升纯度与精度。
AI.motivation: 核心集选择将批量主动学习建模为覆盖问题：选取待标注点以最小化池的覆盖半径，其理论依据是一个"半径控制池损失与已标注样本损失之差"的泛化界。作者希望澄清该界的成立前提、实际含义与可解释性，检验半径是否真的能解释或指导选择。
AI.method: 1) 显式给出该界证明所需的假设：已标注点的条件风险为零，并证明此时对任意相异性度量（dissimilarity）以及任何不使用样本外标签的选择规则都成立；2) 将证明逐点分解为两个平均量——池到已标注样本的平均距离与已标注点所属单元的纯度；3) 在确定性标签下保留这两个量，得到不含零损失假设、且不带类别数C因子的池损失界；4) 尺度比较：对确定性标签与在整个池上Lipschitz的回归函数，比较含C与不含C版本的界何时才非平凡；5) 提出不一致性准则（misalignment criterion），衡量某量是否像gap或测试误差那样对选择排序；6) 在高斯池及digits、MNIST两个图像池（后者用8种距离、每轮重训练网络）上实验。
AI.result: 含原常数时，界只有在半径小于类间最小距离除以C时才可能有信息量；去掉C后，半径形式的界只有在基于样本的最近邻规则在整个池上精确时才可能有信息量。实验显示：半径与gap及测试误差的排序不一致；在图像池上，不使用池标签的界从不为信息量；按均值而非最大值覆盖（贪心k-medoids）在纯度和准确率上均优于随机采样。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖半径并非控制泛化差距的有效量，原界在实践中几乎不可用；应区分平均距离与单元纯度两个量，并考虑以均值覆盖替代最大半径覆盖的选择准则。

title: MM-DataLoop: Closing the Data-Side Loop for Recursive Self-Improvement in MLLM Post-Training
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a path toward improving models through repeated evaluation and revision. We study its data side in multimodal language model (MLLM) post-training, where heterogeneous operations and cross-round evidence must be coordinated. MMDataLoop organizes data interventions into five operation families and connects them through an Observe-Diagnose-Plan-Execute-Verify-Reflect cycle with shared rule memory. Across 34 candidate rounds on Qwen3.5-0.8B and five benchmarks, we hold the base initialization, shared training schedule and evaluation protocol fixed while varying data recipes. The five-benchmark mean reaches 63.04 at R33, up 5.32 points from the zero-shot baseline; R29, R32, and R33 form a close top cluster within 0.09 points. In eightcandidate comparisons, guided search reaches the preselected target in six candidates and identifies the top observed candidate, while random arms show higher means and lower dispersion. The selected R29 recipe also scores above two full-pool baselines under the same epoch schedule. Together, these findings establish MM-DataLoop as a traceable workflow and provide an empirical basis for studying how data-side decisions shape outcomes across MLLM post-training recipes.

AI.tldr: 提出 MM-DataLoop，将多模态大模型后训练中的数据干预组织为五类操作族，并以"观察-诊断-规划-执行-验证-反思"循环加共享规则记忆串联，在固定训练配置下验证数据配方对结果的影响。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）在数据侧的机制尚不清楚：多模态模型后训练涉及异构操作与跨轮次证据的协调，缺乏可追踪的数据侧工作流与实证依据。
AI.method: 将数据干预归为五个操作族，通过 Observe-Diagnose-Plan-Execute-Verify-Reflect 六阶段循环与共享规则记忆连接；在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 上做 34 轮候选实验，覆盖五个基准，固定基座初始化、训练调度与评测协议，仅变化数据配方；另做八候选的引导搜索与随机搜索对比。
AI.result: R33 时五基准均值为 63.04，较零样本基线提升 5.32 分；R29、R32、R33 构成相差 0.09 分以内的紧凑最优簇。八候选中引导搜索 6 次命中预设目标并找出最优候选，而随机组均值更高、离散度更低。所选 R29 配方在同 epoch 调度下优于两个全池基线。
AI.conclusion: MM-DataLoop 是可追踪的工作流，为研究数据侧决策如何影响 MLLM 后训练结果提供了实证基础。

title: SGD Selects Initialization-Dependent Representation in Overparameterized ReLU Networks
summary: Overparameterized neural networks can represent the same function through many different hidden configurations, raising the question of which representation is favored by a given training algorithm. We study how stochastic gradient descent (SGD), jointly training both layers, resolves this ambiguity in finite-width, bias-free, two-layer ReLU networks trained to learn a linear teacher under Gaussian inputs. At width two, exact fitting leaves no choice: the neurons must align with the teacher directions. At every width $m \ge 4$, however, infinitely many non-aligned exact fits are possible. Despite this ambiguity, we prove that joint batch-size-one SGD from sufficiently small initialization drives every neuron arbitrarily close to one of the two teacher directions while reaching arbitrarily small population error in finite time. This occurs without explicit regularization, layerwise training, gradient clipping, or a learning-rate schedule. The dynamics additionally select an initialization-dependent allocation of the fitted function across neurons, providing a finer characterization of the representation selected by SGD. Numerical experiments reproduce the predicted alignment, fitting, and initialization-dependent allocation. Our results identify sufficient conditions under which standard SGD exhibits a strong implicit bias toward a highly structured internal representation, even when overparameterization creates infinitely many qualitatively different exact representations.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明：在有限宽度、无偏置、两层 ReLU 网络学习高斯输入下的线性教师模型时，即便存在无穷多种非对齐的精确拟合解，联合训练、批大小为 1 的标准 SGD 也能在有限时间内将每个神经元驱动到两条教师方向之一，且无需显式正则化、逐层训练、梯度裁剪或学习率调度。
AI.motivation: 过参数化网络可通过多种隐含配置表示同一函数，因此需要回答"训练算法偏好哪种表示"。已有工作多依赖显式正则、逐层训练或特殊设置，缺乏对标准 SGD 在宽度 m≥4 这类存在无穷多定性不同精确解情形下隐式偏置的充分条件刻画。
AI.method: 理论分析：有限宽度、无偏置、两层 ReLU 网络，高斯输入，线性教师；对两层联合训练且批大小为 1 的 SGD，从足够小的初始化出发进行动力学分析。关键观察是宽度 m=2 时精确拟合迫使神经元与教师方向对齐，而 m≥4 时存在无穷多非对齐精确解；作者据此给出神经元对齐与总体误差收敛的证明，并刻画由初始化决定的函数在神经元间的分配。
AI.result: 证明每个神经元的权重方向可任意接近两条教师方向之一，同时总体（population）误差在有限时间内达到任意小；该结论不依赖显式正则化、逐层训练、梯度裁剪或学习率调度。此外，动力学还选择了依赖于初始化的、跨神经元的函数分配，从而给出 SGD 所选表示的更精细刻画。数值实验复现了对齐、拟合及初始化依赖的分配现象。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：即便过参数化导致无穷多定性不同的精确表示，标准 SGD 仍表现出强烈的隐式偏置，趋向高度结构化的内部表示；论文给出了该隐式偏置成立的充分条件，并表明表示选择由初始化与 SGD 动力学共同决定。

title: MOVER: Planning Beyond Motion
summary: Residual world models forecast a driving scene through its temporal change, so feature components that stay constant over time vanish from the residual pathway. We ask whether evidence with weak temporal change, such as a waiting pedestrian or a stopped vehicle, can be used more effectively for planning, and introduce MOVER, a complementary event-routing mechanism. A training-time teacher measures how each spatially grounded event query responds when a past frame is removed from shared history and contrasts that sensitivity with the event's pooled temporal residual, prioritizing events that depend on history but receive weak residual evidence. A student predicts the resulting priorities from unperturbed history, so the teacher adds no inference cost. Under fixed total routing mass, one distribution scales a low-rank future bird's-eye-view update and biases trajectory-conditioned event reading. On nuScenes, MOVER reduces ResWorld's UniAD-style average L2 from 0.65 to 0.55 m and its collision rate from 0.23% to 0.12% without direct planner ego status (0.50 m and 0.09% with it), adding 4.1 ms per frame. Matched controls show that the complementary teacher outperforms either signal alone and that the allocation acts mainly during training. Adapted to BridgeDrive-LEAD, MOVER reaches a 96.52 +/- 0.65 driving score over three seeds on the 220-route Bench2Drive closed-loop benchmark, exceeding matched controls in each paired seed by a margin within seed variation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MOVER事件路由机制，弥补残差世界模型中时序变化微弱的事件证据被忽视的问题，在nuScenes与Bench2Drive上提升规划精度并降低碰撞率。
AI.motivation: 残差世界模型通过时序差分预测驾驶场景，导致随时间几乎不变的特征成分（如等待的行人、停止的车辆）在残差通路上被削弱，而这些微弱变化证据对规划同样关键。
AI.method: 训练期引入教师：对历史帧做移除扰动，测量各空间定位事件查询的敏感度，并与该事件的时序残差池化结果对比，优先赋予"依赖历史但残差证据弱"的事件更高权重；学生网络从无扰动历史预测这些优先级，故不增加推理开销。在固定总路由质量约束下，该分布一方面缩放低秩未来鸟瞰图更新，另一方面偏置轨迹条件的事件读取。
AI.result: nuScenes上，MOVER将ResWorld的UniAD式平均L2从0.65 m降至0.55 m，碰撞率从0.23%降至0.12%（提供自车状态时为0.50 m与0.09%），每帧仅增4.1 ms。对照实验显示互补教师优于单一信号，且该分配主要作用于训练阶段。迁移至BridgeDrive-LEAD，在220条路线的Bench2Drive闭环基准上三个随机种子取得96.52±0.65驾驶分数，每个配对种子均超过匹配对照，但优势幅度在种子波动范围内。
AI.conclusion: MOVER以零额外推理成本的事件级重分配，有效利用弱时序变化证据，提升开环与闭环规划性能，但闭环增益相对种子方差尚不显著。

title: CFANet: Learning Conflict-Free Weather Adapters for All-Weather Image Restoration
summary: All-weather image restoration aims to recover clean images from diverse weather degradations such as rain, haze, and snow. Most existing all-in-one methods handle different weather types with a unified network or rely on single-label weather modeling. However, real-world adverse weather is often compositional, where multiple known weather primitives may coexist in a single image. To this end, we propose Conflict-Free Adapter Network (CFANet) for open-compositional all-weather image restoration. CFANet first employs a Weather Mixture Router (WMR) to predict non-exclusive composition weights for rain, haze, and snow from shallow features. Guided by these weights, a Shared-Private Weather Adapter (SPWA) dynamically composes a common adapter with weather-private adapters inside each Conflict-Free Adapter Block, preserving shared restoration capability while providing weather-specific residual adaptation. Moreover, a lightweight Natural Color Adapter (NCA) performs constrained color calibration to improve color fidelity and visual naturalness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves competitive adverse weather image restoration performance and benefits downstream visual tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/wenchao-tech/CFANet-main

AI.tldr: 提出CFANet，用非排他性天气混合权重路由共享-私有适配器，实现开放组合式全天候图像复原。
AI.motivation: 现有全天候复原方法多用统一网络或单标签天气建模，而真实恶劣天气常是组合式的（雨、雾、雪可共存于同一图像）。
AI.method: 1) Weather Mixture Router (WMR)：从浅层特征预测雨/雾/雪的**非排他**组合权重；2) Shared-Private Weather Adapter (SPWA)：以权重动态组合共享适配器与各天气私有适配器，嵌入每个 Conflict-Free Adapter Block，保留通用复原能力并提供天气特定残差适配；3) Natural Color Adapter (NCA)：轻量级约束色彩校准，提升色彩保真度与视觉自然性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法在恶劣天气图像复原上取得有竞争力的性能，并有利于下游视觉任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过非排他多天气混合建模与适配器动态组合，CFANet 有效应对开放组合式全天候复原；代码已开源。

title: Policy Invariance Is Not Learning Invariance: Potential-Based Reward Shaping for Navigation with a Limited View
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Under review at the MATH4AI Workshop at AAAI 2027
summary: Potential-based reward shaping (PBRS) does not change the optimal policy, but how much it speeds up learning depends on the potential and on effects outside this guarantee. We analyse how PBRS changes the one-step reward while it preserves the discounted return: a per-step $(γ-1)Φ$ term, the terminal-state rule, a constant shift of the potential, and positive cycles in a bonus that is not potential-based. We then measure these consequences in pre-registered experiments with a PPO agent. The agent has a limited egocentric view and is tested on two MiniGrid navigation tasks (160 runs, 10 seeds per condition). On LavaCrossing, a geodesic (BFS) potential learned faster than both the sparse baseline and a Euclidean potential with a 7x7 and a 5x5 view (AUC difference +0.27 to +0.39, Holm p between 0.007 and 0.0499). The Euclidean potential did not differ from the baseline. In 20 runs with a non-potential bonus, none of the agents learned the task. The Euclidean potential caused more than twice as many deaths in lava during early training. View size did not detectably change the benefit of shaping. With a 5x5 view on SimpleCrossing, some BFS runs got stuck in loops and never learned; shifting the potential did not remove this, so the per-step term alone does not explain it.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析基于势能的奖励塑形（PBRS）如何在保持折扣回报不变的前提下改变单步奖励，并通过预注册PPO实验验证这些效应的实际影响。
AI.motivation: PBRS在理论上不改变最优策略，但其加速学习的效果取决于势函数设计及该保证之外的效应，这些效应此前缺乏系统刻画。
AI.method: 从理论上分解PBRS对单步奖励的改动：每步(γ-1)Φ项、终止状态规则、势函数常数平移以及非势能型bonus中的正循环；随后在MiniGrid的LavaCrossing与SimpleCrossing导航任务上，用有限自我中心视野的PPO智能体进行预注册实验（160次运行，每条件10个随机种子），比较BFS测地势能、欧氏势能与稀疏基线。
AI.result: 在LavaCrossing上，BFS势能学习快于稀疏基线与欧氏势能（7x7与5x5视野下AUC差+0.27至+0.39，Holm校正p在0.007至0.0499之间）；欧氏势能与基线无显著差异；20次非势能bonus运行中无一学会任务；欧氏势能在训练早期导致的岩浆死亡次数翻倍以上；视野大小未显著改变塑形收益。在SimpleCrossing的5x5视野下，部分BFS运行陷入循环无法学习，平移势函数后该现象仍存在。
AI.conclusion: 势函数质量决定PBRS的实际收益，测地势能有效而欧氏势能无效甚至有害；训练困难不能仅由每步(γ-1)Φ项解释，说明PBRS的加速机制依赖势函数与超出理论保证的效应。

title: Why Calibrated BM25 Filtering Barely Reduced Context on LongMemEval
summary: An assistant that summarizes old conversations may later need a detail from the original exchange. It can score archived passages against the question, but only passages that fit in the prompt reach the answering model. We tested whether a BM25 filter saves input tokens once that limit is taken into account. We calibrated the filter on passages that individually corrected an answer the model got wrong from the summaries alone. Across 75 LongMemEval questions, filtering changed one prompt and saved 0.096% of input tokens. With and without the filter, the model answered the same questions correctly under a second automated grading. On a random sample, two human graders' settled judgments agreed with the automated grades in 92.9% of definite comparisons (Cohen's kappa = 0.805). Building on earlier work that distinguishes retrieved evidence from delivered evidence, we give an exact test for packers that try whole passages in a fixed order and skip any that do not fit. Run the packer without the filter. The prompt changes exactly when an admitted passage scores below the cutoff. Code and data: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/Certfold

AI.tldr: 在考虑提示长度上限的前提下，BM25 过滤在 LongMemEval 上几乎不节省输入 token，也未改变回答正确性；作者转而给出针对"按固定顺序整段装箱"打包器的精确判定检验。
AI.motivation: 长期对话助手需要从归档旧对话中取出细节。虽可用检索打分筛选段落，但只有能装进提示的段落才会到达答题模型，因此"节省输入 token"必须在打包上限约束下衡量，而非只看检索层面。
AI.method: 在单独能纠正"仅凭摘要答错"的段落上校准 BM25 过滤阈值；在 75 道 LongMemEval 题上比较有/无过滤的提示与 token 消耗；用第二轮自动评分判定正确性，并在随机样本上由两名人工评分者校验（明确比较的一致率 92.9%，Cohen's kappa = 0.805）；进一步提出针对"按固定顺序尝试整段、跳过装不下者"的打包器的精确检验：无过滤运行该打包器，提示发生变化当且仅当某被接纳段落得分低于阈值。
AI.result: 75 道题中仅 1 个提示发生变化，输入 token 节省 0.096%；有/无过滤时模型在自动评分下答对的题目相同。人工评分与自动评分在 92.9% 的明确比较中一致（kappa = 0.805）。
AI.conclusion: 在提示容量约束下，BM25 过滤的收益可忽略，不应默认其能省 token；所提精确检验可在不重复运行过滤流程的情况下判定过滤是否真的改变了送达证据，延续了"检索证据"与"送达证据"的区分。

title: RadarOSV: Unified 3D Scene and Motion Perception from mmWave Radars
summary: Millimeter-wave radar offers weather-resilient sensing for 3D occupancy prediction. Existing radar occupancy methods mainly model geometry, with limited joint modeling of semantics and motion. Cascaded imaging radar provides fine spatial detail but has a limited unambiguous velocity range, whereas single-chip radar offers a wider range but coarser spatial resolution. We propose RadarOSV, to our knowledge the first radar-only framework that jointly predicts occupancy, dynamic object semantics, and ground-relative velocity from raw radar data in unified voxels, by exploiting complementary measurements from both radars. Its Polar-to-Cartesian Geometry (PCG) backbone maps polar imaging-radar features into Cartesian voxels through fixed and deformable sampling, guiding cross-radar fusion for geometry and attribute prediction. Single-chip detection outputs provide class evidence, while raw Doppler spectra supply motion features and radial-velocity candidates. The velocity readout selects from these candidates using fused features to resolve aliasing, then combines the selected radial estimate with learned motion. Ego-motion compensation uses radar-estimated velocity, so inference requires no external odometry or other sensors. On K-Radar, single-frame PCG achieves 40.7% mIoU within 12.8 m, compared with RadarOcc's reported 34.3%. On the BRIDGE-Liv dataset, compared with a cascaded-radar baseline predicting the same outputs with external ego velocity, RadarOSV improves macro-averaged accuracy across four dynamic object classes within annotated object regions from 63.1% to 75.5% and reduces object radial-velocity MAE against manual Doppler annotations from 1.03 to 0.51 m/s, while maintaining geometric occupancy mIoU.

AI.tldr: RadarOSV：首个仅用雷达原始数据、在统一体素中联合预测占据、动态目标语义与地相对速度的框架，融合级联成像雷达与单芯片雷达的互补测量。
AI.motivation: 毫米波雷达具备全天候感知能力，但现有雷达占据方法主要建模几何，对语义与运动的联合建模不足；级联成像雷达空间细节好但无模糊速度范围有限，单芯片雷达速度范围宽但空间分辨率粗。
AI.method: 提出极坐标到笛卡尔几何（PCG）主干，通过固定采样与可变形采样将极坐标成像雷达特征映射到笛卡尔体素，引导跨雷达融合以预测几何与属性；单芯片检测输出提供类别证据，原始多普勒谱提供运动特征与径向速度候选；速度读取模块用融合特征从候选中选择以解算混叠，再与学习到的运动结合；自车运动补偿采用雷达估计速度，无需外部里程计或其他传感器。
AI.result: K-Radar 上单帧 PCG 在 12.8 m 内达到 40.7% mIoU（RadarOcc 报告为 34.3%）；BRIDGE-Liv 上相比预测相同输出且使用外部自车速度的级联雷达基线，四类动态目标标注区域内宏平均精度由 63.1% 提升至 75.5%，目标径向速度 MAE 相对人工多普勒标注由 1.03 降至 0.51 m/s，同时保持几何占据 mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 融合两类雷达的互补测量可在纯雷达、无外部传感器的条件下统一实现占据、语义与速度预测，在几何精度与运动/语义精度上均优于对比基线。

title: ContinuLoc: Continuous Pose Inference over Neural Fields for UAV Geo-Localization
summary:
Cross-view UAV geo-localization involves three design choices: how to represent the UAV observation, how to represent the geo-referenced map, and how to infer pose from their interaction. The dominant paradigm organizes the map as a discretized 2DoF candidate library, coupling map representation to pose inference and thus bounding spatial localization precision by candidate sampling resolution. We decouple map representation from pose inference by encoding the geo-referenced map as a continuously queryable semantic neural field, enabling localization to be formulated as explicit optimization over a continuous 4DoF pose space parameterized by 2D ground position, in-plane heading, and viewing scale. Pose hypotheses are evaluated on demand using global descriptors in a shared semantic feature space, bypassing the sampling bottleneck of retrieval. We learn 4DoF pose-sensitive visual representations under full 4DoF supervision provided by ContinuScenes, a multi-city benchmark with dense near-nadir UAV imagery and complete pose annotations. Inference proceeds hierarchically, progressing from broad pose-space coverage to adaptive concentration on high-compatibility regions. Experiments demonstrate substantial gains over representative localization paradigms under progressively stricter 4DoF accuracy criteria.
  Code is available at https://github.com/ZhouWeikun/ContinuLoc/

AI.tldr: 该论文将地理参考地图编码为可连续查询的语义神经场，把跨视角无人机地理定位从离散候选库检索重构为连续4DoF位姿空间上的显式优化，并配套发布ContinuScenes基准与层次化推理策略。
AI.motivation: 主流范式把地图组织为离散化的2DoF候选库，导致地图表示与位姿推断耦合，定位精度被候选采样分辨率上限所限制，无法突破检索粒度瓶颈。
AI.method: 以语义神经场连续表示地图，支持按需查询；将定位表述为以地面2D位置、平面内航向、观察尺度构成的4DoF连续位姿空间上的显式优化；在共享语义特征空间中以全局描述子按需评估位姿假设；利用ContinuScenes（多城市、密集近正射无人机影像、完整位姿标注）提供的全4DoF监督学习位姿敏感表征；推理采用由广域覆盖到高兼容区域自适应聚焦的层次化流程。
AI.result: 在逐步收紧的4DoF精度准则下，相较于代表性定位范式取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 解耦地图表示与位姿推断可有效消除采样分辨率瓶颈，连续神经场表示配合4DoF监督与层次化优化是实现高精度跨视角无人机地理定位的有效途径。

title: A CPU-Only Framework for Mining Collectively-Behaving Bots in MMORPGs
summary: MMORPGs continually face automated programs (bots) that disrupt gameplay balance and in-game economies. An unsupervised Transformer framework can mine collectively behaving bot groups, but its multi-GPU training is costly in live operations. We show that such GPU-trained sequence models are not strictly necessary for this task. Our CPU pipeline pairs zone embeddings learned from movement context, which place teleport-linked zones close together, with a training-free coordinate kernel, and then applies density clustering. It trains 3-5$\times$ faster than the GPU-based Transformer (56-86$\times$ on the same CPU) while matching its mining quality on two commercial MMORPGs, and has been deployed since late 2024. We also share deployment lessons on how to set the clustering threshold and when to retrain.

AI.tldr: 提出一种纯CPU流水线用于挖掘MMORPG中的群体行为机器人：用移动上下文学习的区域嵌入将传送关联区域拉近，配合免训练的坐标核与密度聚类，训练速度比GPU Transformer快3-5倍（同CPU上快56-86倍），挖掘质量相当，并已自2024年末上线部署。
AI.motivation: MMORPG持续面临自动化脚本（机器人）破坏游戏平衡与经济；已有无监督Transformer框架可挖掘协同行为的机器人团伙，但多GPU训练在线上运维中成本过高，亟需更轻量的替代方案。
AI.method: CPU流水线：(1) 基于移动上下文学习区域嵌入，使通过传送门相连的区域在嵌入空间相邻；(2) 引入免训练（training-free）的坐标核；(3) 在所得表示上执行密度聚类以输出群体机器人簇。
AI.result: 训练速度较GPU Transformer快3-5倍，同一CPU上快56-86倍；在两款商业MMORPG上与Transformer挖掘质量持平；系统自2024年末起已实际部署。
AI.conclusion: 此类任务并非必须依赖GPU训练的序列模型；轻量CPU方案可在保持挖掘质量的同时大幅降低成本，并总结了聚类阈值设定与重训练时机的部署经验。

title: RMR-VLA: Recurrent Memory Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Long-horizon, history-dependent robotic manipulation often requires acting on visual cues that have disappeared, such as an object indicated earlier or a target hidden under a moving cup. The key challenge is to maintain what past evidence means for the next action as the scene changes. We introduce Recurrent Memory Reasoning (RMR), an explicit reasoning step that connects memory to action inside a vision-language-action model (VLA), with no external reasoning model. At each update, the VLA first infers an event from visual evidence, then revises the task state and grounds a subgoal in the current scene to guide action generation. Carrying the state and subgoal across updates lets remembered identities and task progress determine the current target, doubling RoboMME success over an otherwise identical model without recurrence. Joint training lets one VLA both reason and act; because its memory decisions are text tokens with exact likelihoods, GRPO refines them from rollout rewards without making action generation stochastic. Among the compared methods, RMR-VLA achieves the best results on RoboMME (66.46% overall, 79.83% on the Reference category) and LIBERO-Mem (90.08%).

AI.tldr: 提出Recurrent Memory Reasoning (RMR)，在VLA模型内部加入显式记忆推理步骤，将记忆与动作生成相连，无需外部推理模型，在RoboMME和LIBERO-Mem上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 长时程、依赖历史的机器人操作常需依据已消失的视觉线索行动（如先前指示的物体、移动杯子下被遮挡的目标）。核心挑战在于：场景变化时，如何保持过去证据对下一步动作的意义。
AI.method: RMR为端到端VLA模型内的显式推理步骤：每次更新时，VLA先由视觉证据推断事件，再修正任务状态，并将子目标在当前场景中接地（grounding）以引导动作生成；状态与子目标跨更新传递，使记忆中的物体身份与任务进度决定当前目标。采用联合训练使同一VLA同时推理与行动；由于记忆决策为具有精确似然的文本token，可用GRPO基于rollout奖励优化记忆决策，而不使动作生成随机化。
AI.result: 相较无循环结构的同类模型，RoboMME成功率翻倍；在对比方法中RMR-VLA表现最优：RoboMME总体66.46%（Reference类别79.83%），LIBERO-Mem达90.08%。
AI.conclusion: 将显式循环记忆推理嵌入VLA内部，可在无外部推理模型的情况下有效解决依赖历史的操作任务，兼顾推理与动作的联合优化，并在记忆类基准上达到领先性能。

title: One-shot is Enough: Boosting SAM for Medical Image Segmentation through Structured Information Modeling
summary: In recent years, Foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) have demonstrated strong generalization capabilities, but because they are primarily pre-trained on natural images, they perform poorly when faced with medical images. With sufficient labeled medical data, this challenge is somewhat alleviated. However, the difficulty and high cost of acquiring large amounts of labeled data make one-shot learning a highly attractive research paradigm. But within this paradigm, SAM struggles to fully extract its potential multi-granular information, leading to a sharp decline in performance. To address this, we propose OB-SAM, a one-shot enhancement framework for medical image segmentation. It aims to maximize the utilization of information from a single sample from the perspective of structured modeling. Specifically, we first designed a Multi-Frequency Decoupling (MFD) module, which divides features into different frequency domain components, allowing each branch to focus on information expression at different semantic levels, thereby alleviating overfitting and enhancing feature representation capabilities. Secondly, we introduce a Progressive Feature Integrator (PFI) module to promote complementary fusion among multi-level features, thereby avoiding the dominant effect of a certain level of feature in the fusion process. Furthermore, we propose an Selective Context Filtering (SCF) Module that adaptively selects key contextual information by modeling the contrast relationship between the foreground and background, thereby achieving precise localization of the lesion area. Extensive experiments across seven diverse datasets validate that OB-SAM achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 OB-SAM 单样本（one-shot）医学图像分割增强框架，通过多频解耦、渐进特征融合与选择性上下文过滤三个模块，从结构化建模角度最大化单样本信息利用，在七个数据集上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: SAM 等基础模型主要基于自然图像预训练，直接用于医学图像效果差；标注医学数据稀缺且昂贵，故 one-shot 学习极具吸引力，但 SAM 在该范式下难以充分挖掘其多粒度信息，性能显著下降。
AI.method: 1) Multi-Frequency Decoupling (MFD)：将特征分解为不同频域分量，各分支关注不同语义层级的信息表达，缓解过拟合、增强特征表征；2) Progressive Feature Integrator (PFI)：促进多层级特征互补融合，避免某一层级特征在融合中占据主导；3) Selective Context Filtering (SCF)：通过建模前景—背景对比关系自适应筛选关键上下文信息，实现病灶区域精确定位。
AI.result: 在七个多样化数据集上的大量实验表明 OB-SAM 达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
AI.conclusion: 从结构化建模视角对 SAM 进行 one-shot 增强，可有效释放基础模型在少标注医学分割中的潜力；多频解耦、渐进融合与上下文筛选三者协同是实现该目标的关�键。

title: De Novo Generation of Odorant Molecules with Targeted Olfactory Receptor Activation Patterns
summary: Odor perception arises from a combinatorial code in which each molecule activates a specific subset of olfactory receptors (ORs), and the resulting activation pattern determines the perceived smell. We present a framework for de novo generation of molecules predicted to match target multi-receptor activation profiles. We first construct a panoramic binding matrix over 20 ORs, then cluster it to discover representative activation patterns, and finally formulate a structured selectivity loss, combining pairwise ranking, distribution matching, and complexity constraints, to steer a molecular generator via reinforcement learning. Across nine target profiles of varying complexity, our method achieves high predicted selectivity within 18000 oracle calls and provides the largest gains on profiles that are rare under the prior, especially broad-spectrum and sparse-activator targets.

AI.tldr: 提出一个从头生成分子的框架，使生成分子预测匹配目标多受体激活谱（气味组合编码）。
AI.motivation: 气味感知源于组合编码：分子激活一组特定嗅觉受体（OR），激活模式决定所感知的气味。现有方法难以按目标多受体激活模式（而不仅是单一靶点）从头设计分子，尤其对稀有激活模式（广谱激活、稀疏激活）缺乏有效手段。
AI.method: 1) 基于20个OR构建全景结合矩阵；2) 对该矩阵聚类，发现具代表性的激活模式作为目标谱；3) 设计结构化选择性损失，融合成对排序（pairwise ranking）、分布匹配与复杂度约束；4) 通过强化学习驱动分子生成器优化。
AI.result: 在9个复杂度不同的目标谱上，方法在18000次oracle调用内实现高预测选择性；在先验下稀有的谱型上增益最大，尤其是广谱激活与稀疏激活目标。
AI.conclusion: 将多受体激活谱作为生成目标并结合结构化选择性损失与强化学习，可在有限oracle预算内高效实现面向气味组合编码的分子从头设计，且对稀有谱型尤为有效。

title: RadioWorld: Transferring World Models to Radio-Frequency Radiance Fields
summary: Electromagnetic (EM) wave propagation in the physical world constitutes a Radio-Frequency (RF) radiance field, providing rich information for 6G communication and sensing. However, existing neural RF field methods suffer from three fundamental limitations: (1) they predominantly rely on per-scene optimization and cannot generalize to unseen scenes; (2) they require costly reference RF measurements in each target scene; and (3) they degrade severely when extrapolating beyond the vicinity of reference measurements. To overcome these limitations, we present RadioWorld, a general framework that adapts a world model to synthesize RF radiance fields directly from physical scene geometry and transceiver locations, without requiring any reference RF measurements at inference. Specifically, RadioWorld couples two specialized modules within a dual-stream Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture: a Scene-Understanding Transformer that encodes 3D scene geometry and transceiver locations to extract environment-aware global EM propagation features, and a Field-Generation Transformer that attends to these features to synthesize the RF radiance field with the local query conditions. We also establish UrbanRF-Bench, a large-scale ray-traced benchmark spanning 657 urban scenes and 32,850 RF radiance fields across seven global cities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RadioWorld significantly outperforms specialized baselines and accurately synthesizes RF fields at arbitrary locations in unseen cities. Code, datasets, and checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: RadioWorld：一种基于世界模型的双流 MoT 框架，可直接由场景几何与收发机位置生成射频辐射场，推理时无需任何参考 RF 测量，并建立 UrbanRF-Bench 基准。
AI.motivation: 现有神经 RF 场方法存在三大局限：依赖逐场景优化而无法泛化到未见场景；每个目标场景需昂贵的参考 RF 测量；外推到测量区域之外时性能急剧下降。作者希望构建可泛化、免测量的 RF 场合成器，以支撑 6G 通信与感知。
AI.method: 提出 RadioWorld 通用框架，将世界模型适配于 RF 辐射场合成。核心为双流 Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT）架构，耦合两个专用模块：Scene-Understanding Transformer 编码 3D 场景几何与收发机位置，提取环境感知的全局电磁传播特征；Field-Generation Transformer 关注这些特征，并结合局部查询条件合成 RF 辐射场。同时构建 UrbanRF-Bench：覆盖 7 座全球城市的 657 个城市场景、32,850 个 RF 辐射场的大规模射线追踪基准。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，RadioWorld 显著优于专用基线方法，并能在未见城市中任意位置准确合成 RF 场。
AI.conclusion: 将世界模型与双流 Transformer 结合、以几何为条件生成 RF 场，可有效突破逐场景优化与参考测量依赖的瓶颈，实现跨场景、跨城市的泛化 RF 场合成；代码、数据集与检查点将于录用后开源。

title: Irreducible shallow tanh neural networks are a manifold
summary: Neural networks (NNs) have been increasingly used as function approximators, motivating the study of the geometry of their function spaces. We study the set of functions represented by shallow neural networks with hyperbolic tangent activation, fixed input and output dimensions, and $n$ hidden neurons. In particular, we prove that the subset represented by irreducible networks in the sense of Sussmann (Neural Networks, 1992), i.e., networks with no redundant neurons, is a smooth embedded submanifold of the Sobolev spaces $\mathrm{W}^{\ell,p}$ on bounded sets for any $\ell\in\mathbb{N}$ and $p\in[1,+\infty]$. The key step is to show that if a sequence of networks converges in $\mathrm{W}^{\ell,p}$ to an irreducible network with the same number of hidden neurons, then the parameters of the approximating networks remain bounded. Finally, we show that this manifold has exactly $n+1$ connected components when both the input and output are scalar, and is connected otherwise.

AI.tldr: 该文证明由激活函数为tanh、含n个隐神经元的浅层网络所表示的函数中，“不可约网络”（无冗余神经元，Sussmann意义下）所成子集是Sobolev空间W^{ℓ,p}（有界集上，任意ℓ∈ℕ、p∈[1,+∞]）的光滑嵌入子流形，并刻画了该流形的连通分量数：标量输入输出时为n+1个，否则连通。
AI.motivation: 神经网络日益作为函数逼近器使用，因此需要理解其函数空间的几何结构。已有研究多关注参数空间或函数空间的拓扑/逼近性质，但对“无冗余神经元”的网络所成函数集合是否具有良好的微分流形结构缺乏严格刻画；本文旨在为该子集建立光滑嵌入子流形结论，并厘清其连通性。
AI.method: 研究对象为固定输入输出维度、n个隐神经元、tanh激活的浅层网络所表示的函数集合。核心是证明紧性/有界性引理：若一列网络在W^{ℓ,p}中收敛到具有相同隐神经元数的不可约网络，则逼近网络的参数保持有界。借助该参数有界性，结合参数化映射的正则性与Sussmann不可约性条件，证明不可约网络函数集是W^{ℓ,p}的光滑嵌入子流形；随后通过分析符号/排列对称性等结构确定连通分量数目。
AI.result: 对任意ℓ∈ℕ、p∈[1,+∞]，不可约网络所表示的函数集合是有界集上Sobolev空间W^{ℓ,p}的光滑嵌入子流形；关键技术结论是收敛到同隐层数不可约网络时参数序列有界。连通性方面：当输入与输出均为标量时该流形恰有n+1个连通分量，其他情形下连通。
AI.conclusion: 去除冗余神经元后的浅层tanh网络函数空间具有良好几何结构（光滑嵌入子流形），其连通分量数由输入输出维度决定（标量情形为n+1，否则为1），为神经网络函数空间的几何与逼近理论提供了严格基础。

title: STAR: Structure-Aware Temporal Action Recovery for Point Supervised Temporal Action Localization
summary: Point supervised temporal action localization is becoming the need of time in this era of ever growing and non-stop video data. Existing method mainly rely on snippet level action response to generate pseudo labels. However, these labels often suffer from boundary ambiguity, over extended proposals, and weak temporal structure. To address these issues, we propose STAR, a structure-aware Temporal Action Recovery framework for point supervised temporal action localization. STAR works by enhancing the base S model with temporal difference interaction with attention module to capture forward and backward snippet changes, and introduces the learning of start, core, and end roles to model the internal temporal structure of actions. In addition, STAR further improves the pseudo label generation through All point proposal ranking and Rolebank based structural re-ranking, which suppress neighbor crossing and structurally inconsistent proposals. Finally, temporal action detector to STAR feedback supervision transfers high quality detector prediction back to the STAR model through soft start, core, end, action, and background targets. This helps to further refine the pseudo labels. Extensive experiments on four standard benchmarks shows the effectiveness of STAR. By using I3D features, STAR achieves 67.2% at AVG@0.1:0.7 on THUMOS'14, 58.1% on GTEA, 74.6% on BEOID, and 31.7% at AVG@0.5:0.95 on ActivityNet-1.3, outperforming previous point supervised methods across multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: STAR：面向点监督时序动作定位的结构感知时序动作恢复框架，通过时序差分交互、起/核/终角色建模与两级重排序改善伪标签质量，并借助检测器回传监督迭代精化，在四个基准上超越已有方法。
AI.motivation: 点监督时序动作定位中，现有方法依赖片段级动作响应生成伪标签，这些伪标签存在边界模糊、提案过度延展（over-extension）以及时序结构弱等问题，限制了定位精度。
AI.method: 1) 在基座 S 模型上引入时序差分交互与注意力模块，捕捉前后片段变化；2) 学习 start/core/end 三种角色以建模动作内部时序结构；3) 伪标签生成改进：All-point proposal ranking + 基于 Rolebank 的结构化重排序，抑制越界与结构不一致提案；4) 使用时序动作检测器向 STAR 反馈监督，以软化的 start/core/end/action/background 目标回传，进一步精化伪标签。
AI.result: 四个标准基准实验（I3D 特征）：THUMOS'14 在 AVG@0.1:0.7 达 67.2%，GTEA 58.1%，BEOID 74.6%，ActivityNet-1.3 在 AVG@0.5:0.95 达 31.7%，多个基准上优于已有 point supervised 方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构感知建模、结构化提案重排序与检测器反馈监督的闭环设计，可有效缓解点监督伪标签的边界模糊与结构缺失问题，显著提升时序动作定位性能。

title: Robust Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Models via Simulating Brain Functional Localization
summary: Concept erasure in text-to-image models aims to prevent a target concept from appearing in generated images while preserving general image generation capability. However, erased concepts can still be reactivated by attacks. Prior attacks mainly search text or image input spaces, leaving the initial latent space underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce IVO (Initial latent Variable Optimization), a new concept reactivation attack that changes the starting point of image generation by optimizing the initial latent. Comprehensive experiments across 8 erasure methods show that IVO reactivates erased concepts more effectively than the attack baselines, revealing a blind spot in erasure robustness evaluation. This motivates us to localize model components associated with the target concept and then treat them as intervention sites for more robust concept erasure. We propose CeFlune (Concept Erasure via Functional Localization of Unit Neurons), which adapts brain functional localization to text-to-image models. CeFlune defines linear modules as Unit Neurons and localizes concept-responsive ones by comparing their response trajectories in the model's task and resting states. It then updates the localized Unit Neurons to constrain their responses and the erased model's predictions. Across U-Net diffusion and flow-matching transformer architectures, CeFlune achieves a favorable balance between concept erasure and general image generation capability in comparisons with up to 15 baseline methods. Under IVO and 4 other evaluated attacks, CeFlune also shows lower concept reactivation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出初始潜变量优化攻击IVO揭示了概念擦除的鲁棒性盲区，并据此提出基于神经元功能定位的CeFlune方法实现更鲁棒的概念擦除。
AI.motivation: 现有概念擦除方法擦除的概念仍可被攻击重新激活；已有攻击主要搜索文本或图像输入空间，而初始潜空间这一生成起点尚未被充分探索，导致擦除鲁棒性评估存在盲区。
AI.method: 1) IVO：通过优化初始潜变量改变图像生成起点，实现概念重激活攻击；2) 基于IVO揭示的漏洞，将线性模块定义为Unit Neurons，比较其在任务态与静息态的响应轨迹以定位概念相关单元，并更新这些单元以约束其响应及模型预测，即CeFlune。
AI.result: 在8种擦除方法上，IVO的重激活效果优于基线攻击；CeFlune在U-Net扩散与流匹配Transformer架构上，与最多15种基线相比，在概念擦除与通用生成能力间取得良好平衡，并在IVO及另外4种攻击下表现出更低的重激活率。
AI.conclusion: 初始潜空间是被忽视的脆弱入口；借鉴脑功能定位的神经元级干预可提升概念擦除的鲁棒性，兼顾通用生成质量。

title: Near-Far Attention: Region-Aware Sparse Retrieval for Long-Context LLM Decoding
summary: Sparse attention reduces the cost of long-context decoding, but token selection introduces additional scoring and ranking overhead. Moreover, uniform page scoring overlooks differences in relevance between near and far context. We propose Near-Far Attention (NFA), which adapts retrieval to regional attention patterns while keeping candidate scoring lightweight. During prefill, the Lightweight Gate Estimator identifies regions that can be skipped during decoding, adding less than 1% to dense-prefill time. For the remaining regions, the Calibration-Free Subspace Extractor supplies compact features shared by page-level and token-level scoring without offline calibration. The Distance-Aware Two-Level Selector then scores near and far pages differently and jointly ranks candidate tokens under a shared budget. Evaluations across model families, parameter scales, and GQA/MLA architectures show aggregate task quality comparable to full attention. On Qwen3-8B at 512K context length, NFA achieves up to $5.49\times$ operator speedup and $2.97\times$ whole-model decoding speedup over FlashInfer, including selection overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出 Near-Far Attention（NFA），按近/远区域差异化打分并轻量化稀疏检索，在保持全注意力水平任务质量的同时显著加速长上下文解码。
AI.motivation: 长上下文解码中稀疏注意力虽降低成本，但 token 选择本身带来额外打分与排序开销；且现有方法对所有 page 采用统一的均匀打分，忽视了近端与远端上下文在相关性上的差异。
AI.method: NFA 包含三部分：（1）预填充阶段用 Lightweight Gate Estimator 识别解码时可跳过的区域，附加开销小于 dense-prefill 时间的 1%；（2）Calibration-Free Subspace Extractor 为剩余区域提供紧凑特征，供 page 级与 token 级打分共享，且无需离线校准；（3）Distance-Aware Two-Level Selector 对近端与远端 page 采用不同打分方式，并在共享预算下联合排序候选 token。
AI.result: 在多种模型家族、参数规模及 GQA/MLA 架构上评估，聚合任务质量与全注意力相当。Qwen3-8B、512K 上下文下，相较 FlashInfer 取得最高 5.49× 的算子加速和 2.97× 的整模型解码加速，且已包含选择开销。
AI.conclusion: NFA 通过距离感知的两级打分与轻量无校准特征提取，在几乎不增加预填充成本的前提下实现高效稀疏检索，验证了按区域注意力模式自适应检索的有效性。

title: GeLiFiSH: Recursive LiDAR Keypoint Estimation with Ground and Moving Object Segmentation
summary: LiDAR registration and loop closure often rely on sparse keypoints, which must remain repeatable across sessions, viewpoints, and sensors. To handle differing scan patterns, detectors typically operate on accumulated submaps, which introduces latency and processes each submap independently, so repeated observations are never fused. Height-based detectors also reference structure to an estimated ground, so its inconsistency across sessions propagates into the keypoints. Moreover, dynamic objects leave ghost trails that can be mistaken for static structure. We present GeLiFiSH (Geometric LiDAR Filtering with Sequential Hypothesis testing), a learning-free filter that recursively estimates persistent keypoints at scan rate. A height-structure detector runs on a rolling voxel map, and detections initialize tracks with a position, covariance, and existence probability, accepted or rejected by a sequential probability ratio test. Ground segmentation provides a sensor-agnostic height reference, and moving object segmentation removes dynamic points before map insertion. On SemanticKITTI, HeLiMOS, and HeLiPR, spanning five LiDARs and multiple sessions, GeLiFiSH attains the highest average keypoint repeatability among the compared detectors and the second-highest cross-session registration recall from keypoints alone, behind ISS which extracts four times as many keypoints. With one parameter set and no sensor-height prior, both ground and moving object segmentation modules outperform their baselines on average.

AI.tldr: GeLiFiSH：一种无需学习的LiDAR关键点滤波方法，在滚动体素地图上递归估计可重复的持久关键点，通过序贯概率比检验管理轨迹，并集成地面分割与动态点去除。
AI.motivation: 现有LiDAR配准与回环检测依赖稀疏关键点，但关键点需跨会话、视角与传感器保持可重复性。现有检测器存在三方面问题：(1) 为应对不同扫描模式而在累积子图上独立处理，导致延迟且重复观测从不融合；(2) 基于高度的检测器将结构参考到估计地面，地面不一致会传播到关键点；(3) 动态物体留下鬼影轨迹，易被误判为静态结构。
AI.method: 提出GeLiFiSH（Geometric LiDAR Filtering with Sequential Hypothesis testing），一种无学习的滤波器，以扫描频率递归估计持久关键点。具体包括：高度-结构检测器运行于滚动体素地图上；检测初始化带有位置、协方差与存在概率的轨迹，并由序贯概率比检验（SPRT）接受或拒绝；地面分割提供传感器无关的高度参考；运动物体分割在建图插入前移除动态点。
AI.result: 在SemanticKITTI、HeLiMOS与HeLiPR（涵盖五种LiDAR、多会话）上，GeLiFiSH在对比检测器中取得最高平均关键点可重复性；仅用关键点做跨会话配准召回率排名第二，仅次于提取关键点数为其四倍的ISS。单一参数集、无传感器高度先验下，地面分割与运动物体分割模块平均性能均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: GeLiFiSH的递归融合框架与序贯假设检验机制有效提升关键点的跨会话可重复性，且地面分割与动态点去除的联合设计使其具备传感器无关、参数通用且低延迟的优势，为LiDAR配准与回环检测提供了统一的持久关键点提取方案。

title: GALILEO: Geometric RoPE with Galilean Key Transport for Dynamic Scenes
summary: Geometry-aware rotary positional encodings, such as RayRoPE, help attention reason about the 3D spatial relationships between tokens and the query camera. However, they implicitly assume a static scene, encoding each key at its observed position regardless of when it was captured. For dynamic scenes with temporally separated input views, this mismatch places the same moving object at a different position in each input frame, so it can be rendered at an inaccurate position. While temporal encodings inform attention when a token was observed, they do not resolve where its content should be at the query time. We introduce a simple and general approach that aligns positional encodings with dynamic scene geometry through Galilean transport. Before positional encoding, each key's 3D position is transported to the query time using its estimated velocity and the temporal offset. By modifying only key positions, our method integrates directly with existing encodings, including RayRoPE and URoPE, without altering their formulations. Velocities can be obtained from arbitrary sources. By default, we estimate them from token correspondences within the network. Integrated into LVSM, our method improves dynamic view synthesis on Syn4D, dynamic Objaverse, and real-world Stereo4D videos over baselines. Ablations show that encoding velocities as token features yields smaller gains, while attention visualizations reveal that our method attends to query-time locations of moving content, unlike RayRoPE. Beyond view synthesis, our method also reduces tracking errors on dynamic objects in a pretrained 3D point tracker and improves moving-vehicle generation in a video generator.

AI.tldr: 提出"伽利略传输"（Galilean transport）方法，将键token的3D位置随速度与时间偏移传输到查询时刻后再做位置编码，使几何感知位置编码（RayRoPE/URoPE）能正确处理动态场景。
AI.motivation: 现有几何感知旋转位置编码（如RayRoPE）隐式假设场景静态，按观测时刻的位置编码每个key；在时间分离的动态场景中，同一运动物体在各帧位置不同，导致渲染位置不准。时间编码只告诉注意力"何时观测"，不解决"查询时刻内容应在何处"的问题。
AI.method: 在位置编码之前，利用每个key的估计速度与时间偏移，把其3D位置传输至查询时刻，仅修改key位置，不改变RayRoPE、URoPE等原有编码公式，可直接集成。速度可来自任意来源，默认由网络内部token对应关系估计。
AI.result: 集成到LVSM后，在Syn4D、动态Objaverse及真实Stereo4D视频上的动态视图合成优于基线；消融显示将速度作为token特征编码收益更小；注意力可视化显示本方法关注运动内容的查询时刻位置。此外，在预训练3D点跟踪器上降低动态物体跟踪误差，并在视频生成器中改善运动车辆生成。
AI.conclusion: 通过简单的key位置时间传输，可使几何感知位置编码显式对齐动态场景几何，方法通用、即插即用，并在视图合成、点跟踪和视频生成等多任务上带来一致增益。

title: Physics-Constrained Neural ODEs for Learning Traffic Dynamics and Trajectories from Road Entry/Exit Times
summary: We consider the problem of learning microscopic traffic dynamics and reconstructing vehicle trajectories from section entry/exit timestamps (EET) recorded by cameras and from the positions of a probe vehicle leading the platoon. The dynamics are difficult to recover as each vehicle's position is measured only at two points, and its trajectory between them is unknown. By combining Neural ODEs with a local density approximation, we learn a follow-the-leader model whose speed--density relation is a neural network. With such sparse data, an unconstrained network may learn physically unrealistic relations, such as negative speeds or non-zero speeds on a fully congested road. We therefore introduce a normalization that, applied to a monotone neural network with a learned regime change, enforces the endpoint conditions, guaranteeing an admissible speed--density relation while provably retaining the ability to approximate any admissible one. We validate the method on first- and second-order simulations, recovering the speed--density relation of the first-order model and reconstructing the trajectories of both models, with mean maximum position errors of 2.50~m and 2.51~m, respectively, on a 125~m road segment. On real-world ring-road data, the proposed model still yields an admissible relation, whereas both baselines violate the constraints; the large spread in the data, however, highlights the limitations of a first-order model with homogeneous driver behaviors.

AI.tldr: 结合Neural ODE与局部密度近似，从稀疏的车辆进出时间戳与探针车位置数据中学习跟驰模型并重建轨迹，通过带制度切换的单调网络归一化保证速度—密度关系的物理可行性。
AI.motivation: 每辆车仅在两处（路段进出口）被观测，中间轨迹未知，导致微观交通动力学难以从稀疏数据中辨识；无约束神经网络在稀疏数据下易学出负速度、完全拥堵时非零速度等非物理关系。
AI.method: 将Neural ODE与局部密度近似结合，学习速度—密度关系由神经网络表示的follow-the-leader跟驰模型；提出一种归一化方法，作用于带可学习制度切换的单调神经网络，强制满足端点条件（拥堵时速度为零、自由流端点等），并证明其仍可逼近任意可行速度—密度关系。
AI.result: 在一阶与二阶仿真中验证：成功恢复一阶模型的速度—密度关系并重建两种模型的轨迹，在125 m路段上的平均最大位置误差分别为2.50 m与2.51 m。真实环路数据上，所提模型仍给出可行关系，而两个基线均违反约束；但数据离散度大，暴露了一阶模型与同质驾驶员假设的局限。
