To address this problem, we propose AnchorCredit. The method uses the policy model's attention from output anchors to preceding reasoning sentences to estimate sentence-component associations and assign component-specific advantages to the relevant reasoning, without additional relevance annotations or a separate relevance discriminator. To support the study of credit assignment with multiple verifiable rewards, we construct ProductAttr, a benchmark of 7,200 real product image-text samples. Experiments show that AnchorCredit outperforms existing baselines on this benchmark. Experiments on the public Nutrition5k dataset further support the method's effectiveness in this setting.

AI.tldr: 论文指出GRPO等方法在多可验证奖励任务中存在“跨组件信用错分”问题，提出AnchorCredit：利用策略模型输出锚点到前文推理句的注意力估计句子-组件关联，为相关推理分配组件专属优势，无需额外标注；构建ProductAttr基准（7200条真实商品图文样本），实验优于现有基线并在Nutrition5k上验证有效。
AI.motivation: RLVR中GRPO类方法从响应奖励计算组相对优势，并将同一优势广播到响应中每个token。在多可验证结果任务（如多属性联合预测）中，部分组件奖励低会惩罚表现良好的组件及其推理过程，形成系统性的跨组件信用错分。
AI.method: AnchorCredit：以策略模型自身从输出锚点（output anchors）到前面推理句子的注意力权重，估计句子与组件之间的关联，据此把组件级优势分配给相关推理片段；不依赖额外相关性标注，也不需要独立的相关性判别器。同时构建ProductAttr基准，含7200条真实商品图文样本。
AI.result: 在ProductAttr基准上，AnchorCredit优于现有基线；在公开Nutrition5k数据集上的实验也支持该方法在此类场景下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 利用模型内在注意力可实现细粒度、组件级的信用分配，缓解多可验证奖励下的跨组件信用错分，且无需额外监督信号；新基准ProductAttr为多可验证奖励信用分配研究提供支撑。

title: AgroVG+: Generalized Visual Grounding in Agriculture with Region-Supervised Action Generation
summary: Generalized visual grounding in agriculture requires localizing all objects that match a natural-language description and recognizing when no matching target is present. We introduce AgroVG+, a dataset whose referring expressions are all written and reviewed by agricultural experts based on image content and corresponding target sets. The dataset comprises 7,404 images and 10,081 query records across six agricultural scene families, covering single-target, multi-target, and target-absent cases. We also propose ReSAG (Region-Supervised Action Generation), a framework that couples regional evidence supervision with explicit box-generation and termination decisions. ReSAG assigns each target an equally weighted supervision term on a shared spatial evidence distribution computed before answer generation. The BOX/END protocol exposes a choice between generating another box and terminating the response at box boundaries, while coordinates are generated using the original language vocabulary. Regional and sequence objectives jointly train a shared language decoder. On AgroVG+, ReSAG outperforms coordinate-only fine-tuning on single- and multi-target exact-set accuracy, and achieves higher aggregate accuracy than either component alone in ablations.

AI.tldr: 提出农业领域通用视觉定位数据集 AgroVG+（7,404 图、10,081 条查询，含单目标/多目标/无目标案例）与 ReSAG 框架（区域监督 + BOX/END 生成终止协议），在精确集合准确率上优于纯坐标微调。
AI.motivation: 农业场景的通用视觉定位需要同时完成"定位所有符合自然语言描述的目标"与"判断不存在匹配目标"两件事，而现有工作多局限于单目标或忽略无目标情形，且缺乏由领域专家审核的高质量指代表达数据。
AI.method: 构建 AgroVG+：指代表达由农业专家依据图像内容与对应目标集合撰写并复核，覆盖六类农业场景族。提出 ReSAG：在答案生成前计算共享空间证据分布，并对每个目标施加等权重监督项；采用 BOX/END 协议在框边界处显式选择"继续生成框"或"终止回答"；坐标直接使用原始语言词表生成；区域目标与序列目标联合训练同一语言解码器。
AI.result: 在 AgroVG+ 上，ReSAG 在单目标与多目标精确集合准确率上均优于纯坐标微调；消融实验显示其总体准确率高于单独使用区域监督或序列监督任一组件。
AI.conclusion: 将区域证据监督与显式盒生成/终止决策耦合，可在统一语言解码器中同时提升多目标定位与目标缺席判定的综合性能，为农业通用视觉定位提供了数据与建模范式。

title: Predicting Rare-Mode Collapse in Recursive Generative Training from Single-Generation Calibration
summary: Recursive generative training can preserve sample counts in a rare region while silently eroding its characteristic core. Mapping this finite-horizon collapse across real-data quotas, rare prevalences, and feedback perturbations via exhaustive multi-generation chains is computationally prohibitive. We develop a decoupled framework that forecasts multi-generation collapse probabilities and locates operating risk boundaries from independent single-generation conditional fits alone. Pairing an exact three-source multinomial count law with single-generation response banks propagates count marginals in closed form, backed by explicit calibration-error and boundary-resolution bounds. For additive Gaussian perturbations, we further prove that equal-variance all-row and sparse policies reverse their boundary-crossing order at a unique hyperplane distance. Across a 2,178-setting count benchmark, exact propagation cuts risk mean absolute error (MAE) from 1.85 to 0.49 percentage points (pp). Across ten two-dimensional learners, calibration achieves 2.60--5.69~pp six-round core MAE on nine stationary learners (65--81\% below an unperturbed baseline), diagnoses non-stationary outlier drift in standard DDIM (16.38~pp) via a stability probe, and resolves the predicted six-round geometric reversal. On Fashion-MNIST latent flow-matching chains, calibration outperforms direct-chain Gaussian-process interpolation at lower fit budgets and tracks the 20\% latent-perturbation boundary shift (3.14 versus 10.78~pp MAE for proportion copying) driven by opposing inflow to the rare region and outflow from its core.

AI.tldr: 提出解耦框架，仅用单代条件拟合即可闭式预测多代递归生成中的"核心侵蚀"坍塌概率并定位风险边界。
AI.motivation: 递归生成训练可能在保持稀有区域样本数不变的同时悄然侵蚀其特征核心。用穷举多代链来刻画真实数据配额、稀有比例与反馈扰动下的有限时域坍塌在计算上不可行。
AI.method: 解耦框架：将精确的三源多项计数律与单代响应库配对，闭式传播计数边缘分布，并给出显式校准误差界与边界分辨率界；对加性高斯扰动证明等方差全行策略与稀疏策略在唯一超平面距离处反转边界穿越次序。
AI.result: 2,178 设置计数基准上风险 MAE 由 1.85pp 降至 0.49pp；十个二维学习器中九个平稳学习器六轮核心 MAE 为 2.60–5.69pp（较未扰动基线低 65–81%），稳定性探针诊断出标准 DDIM 的非平稳漂移（16.38pp），并复现六轮几何反转；Fashion-MNIST 潜流匹配链上优于直接链高斯过程插值，跟踪 20% 潜扰动边界位移（比例复制 MAE 3.14 vs 10.78pp）。
AI.conclusion: 多代递归坍塌可仅由单代条件拟合高效预测，框架兼具精度、可解释性与边界预测能力。

title: MSBench: Benchmarking Script-Controlled Multi-Shot Text-to-Video Generation
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) models can now generate visually plausible short clips, but multi-shot generation requires a different set of skills: composing multiple shots with intended cut timing, transition style, camera language, and cross-shot continuity. How far this multi-shot output can be controlled from text remains unmeasured: existing benchmarks either evaluate single shots or, when they provide shot-level scripts, typically check whether the requested shots appear but not when they change or how they are joined. We introduce MSBench, a benchmark for controllable text-driven multi-shot video generation built around structured Scene-Entity-Shot mini-scripts that specify each shot's time span, camera state, content, and outgoing transition. MSBench defines a four-dimensional hybrid evaluation framework spanning Visual Quality, Dynamic Quality, Semantic Alignment, and Cross-Shot Consistency with 11 sub-metrics. Experiments on 14 commercial and open-source systems show that visual quality does little to separate the systems, whereas multi-shot control does: many models cut mainly on scene changes and render requested gradual transitions as hard cuts. Human evaluations further validate MSBench, with its system ranking reaching a Spearman correlation of 0.87 with human preferences. The project page is available at https://totalhuang.github.io/MSBench-page/.

AI.tldr: 提出MSBench，一个面向可控文本驱动多镜头视频生成的基准，基于Scene-Entity-Shot结构化脚本与四维混合评测框架（11项子指标），对14个系统评测发现视觉质量区分度低而多镜头控制区分度高，系统排名与人类偏好Spearman相关达0.87。
AI.motivation: 现有T2V模型能生成单镜头短片，但多镜头生成需处理切点时机、转场风格、镜头语言与跨镜头连续性等不同能力。现有基准要么只评单镜头，要么仅检查请求的镜头是否出现，而不评"何时切换"和"如何衔接"，导致多镜头可控性缺乏度量。
AI.method: 构建MSBench基准，以Scene-Entity-Shot结构化微脚本为输入，显式指定每个镜头的时间跨度、相机状态、内容与出向转场；设计视觉质量、动态质量、语义对齐、跨镜头一致性四个维度、共11项子指标的混合评测框架。
AI.result: 在14个商业与开源系统上实验：视觉质量难以区分系统差异，而多镜头控制能力差异显著——多数模型主要在场景切换处剪辑，并将要求的渐变转场渲染为硬切。人工评测验证MSBench，系统排名与人类偏好Spearman相关系数为0.87。
AI.conclusion: 多镜头可控性是当前T2V系统的关键区分维度，MSBench提供了细粒度、与人类偏好高度一致的评测基准，可揭示转场与切点控制等薄弱环节。

title: TrialAgentBench: Evaluating AI Agents for Clinical-Trial Analysis and Long-Horizon Drug-Development Decisions
summary: Clinical drug development is a long-horizon, high-stakes process requiring sequential decisions based on information that costs money and time to acquire. AI agents have demonstrated capabilities for scientific analysis, but there is no established way to evaluate them on these decisions, as real trials are expensive, involve people, and never reveal the counterfactual. We introduce TrialAgentBench, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on clinical trial analysis and drug development decision-making using simulated trials where the truth is known, embedded within the data records of a fictional drug sponsor. We publicly release nearly 3,500 tasks, varying from analysing a single trial to managing multi-phase programmes with budget and time constraints. We score each analysis by rerunning its code on new trials, and each programme by the value its decisions achieve. Across 24 closed- and open-weight models, the strongest agents can analyse raw, messy trial records to within 6% of a process-aware analysis, even when an assumption is violated, with 95% confidence intervals containing the true effect 94--95% of the time. Over the prior year, the best model improved from 19% above this analysis, with serious misses on 15% of tasks, to 3.5% and 1%. What limits them is decision-making from evidence under uncertainty: when to correct, what evidence to buy, when to stop. The strongest agents are overly careful, correcting on 83% of tasks with equal recording errors, where it is unnecessary. On drug programmes, the best agent has substantial headroom, reaching 48% of the value an oracle achieves against 58% for a rule-based developer, with others falling 24 to 66% short. Model generations show ongoing improvements in handling data and evidence, with substantial variation. The strongest models can act as competent analysts, but do not yet make reliable long-horizon decisions.

AI.tldr: 提出 TrialAgentBench 基准，用已知真值的模拟临床试验评估 AI 智能体的试验分析与药物开发决策能力，发布约 3500 个任务；最强模型可接近过程感知分析的精度，但在不确定性下的长期决策仍明显不足。
AI.motivation: 临床药物开发周期长、代价高，需依据需花费金钱与时间获取的信息做序贯决策。AI 智能体已展现科学分析能力，但缺乏评估其此类决策能力的既定方法：真实试验昂贵、涉及受试者，且无法揭示反事实结果。
AI.method: 构建 TrialAgentBench：在虚构药物申办方的数据记录中嵌入真值已知的模拟试验，公开约 3500 个任务，从分析单个试验到在预算与时间约束下管理多阶段项目。分析的评分方式是在新试验上重跑其代码；项目则以其决策所实现的价值计分。共评估 24 个闭源与开源权重模型。
AI.result: 最强智能体分析原始杂乱试验记录的结果与过程感知分析相差 6% 以内（即使在假设被违背时），95% 置信区间在 94–95% 的情形下覆盖真实效应。过去一年最优模型从高于该分析 19%（15% 任务出现严重偏差）改善到 3.5% 与 1%。瓶颈在于不确定性下的决策：何时纠偏、购买何种证据、何时停止；最强智能体过度谨慎，在记录错误相同的情况下对 83% 的任务做了不必要的纠偏。药物项目上最优智能体仅达 oracle 价值的 48%，低于基于规则的开发者的 58%，其余模型落后 24–66%。
AI.conclusion: 模型代际更替显示数据处理与证据利用能力持续提升但差异较大。最强模型可胜任分析员角色，但尚不能做出可靠的长期决策。

title: Beyond Patching: Consistent Circuit Discovery via Gradient Spectral Analysis
summary: Mechanistic interpretability seeks to reverse-engineer neural networks by identifying small, faithful subgraphs--circuits--that implement specific behaviors. The dominant paradigm scores each unit by replacing its clean activation with a corrupted counterpart as causal intervention. While effective, this approach rests on a brittle prerequisite: the structure prompt pairs are task-specific, expensive to engineer, and silently couple the discovered circuit to prompt-design choices. In this work, we propose Spectral Circuit Analysis (SCA), a gradient-spectral pipeline that achieves consistent circuit discovery along both axes: stable across input formulations of the same task, and natively exposing structure shared across tasks. Our contributions are threefold. First, we provide a counterfactual-free reframing of circuit discovery: causally relevant directions are recoverable from the spectral structure of forward gradients across paraphrases, with leading directions concentrating task signal and trailing ones absorbing paraphrase noise, yielding circuits tied to the task rather than the prompt. Second, we introduce SCA, a block-wise SVD pipeline that extracts a task subspace per architectural block and redistributes spectral energy onto constituent units via a consistency-weighted share, producing per-unit rankings competitive with attribution-patching baselines under strictly less supervision. Finally, on twelve circuit-discovery tasks in GPT-2 Small and Pythia-160M, SCA performs comparably or exceeds EAP-family methods under the standard recovery-score protocol and recovers IOI canonical heads with Precision@K = 1.0 in top-10 slices on GPT-2 Small; the same machinery extends to a unified cross-task analysis classifying units as universal, family-shared, or task-specific and exposing compositional structure invisible to per-task analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出谱电路分析（SCA），用梯度谱结构替代反事实提示对，实现与提示设计解耦的电路发现，并支持跨任务的统一结构分析。
AI.motivation: 主流电路发现范式以"干净激活替换为污染激活"的因果干预为单元打分依据，但该方法依赖任务特定的结构提示对（structure prompt pairs）：构造代价高、需人工设计，且会隐性把发现的电路绑定到提示设计选择上，缺乏稳定性与可迁移性。
AI.method: 提出不依赖反事实的重新表述：同一任务不同改写（paraphrase）下前向梯度的谱结构中可恢复因果相关方向，主方向集中任务信号、尾方向吸收改写噪声。据此构建 SCA——按架构块做 SVD，提取每块的任务子空间，并通过一致性加权份额将谱能量重新分配到组成单元，得到单元排序；该流程仅需更少监督。
AI.result: 在 GPT-2 Small 与 Pythia-160M 的 12 个电路发现任务上，按标准 recovery-score 协议，SCA 与 EAP 系列方法相当或更优；在 GPT-2 Small 上以 Precision@K = 1.0 恢复 IOI 经典头（top-10 切片）。同一机制可扩展为统一跨任务分析，将单元划分为通用、族共享与任务特定三类，并揭示逐任务分析无法看到的组合结构。
AI.conclusion: SCA 表明电路发现可摆脱对任务特定反事实提示对的依赖，在输入表述变化下保持稳定，并原生支持跨任务共享结构的刻画，为机制可解释性提供了更稳健、更可复用的分析管线。

title: HorizonFlow: Few-Step Video Distillation in 600 Iterations
comment: 21 pages, 10 figures, 14 tables, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/XIANGLONGGUO/HorizonFlow-repo
summary: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) enables fast video generation by distilling a multi-step teacher into a few-step student. However, DMD-based methods often suffer from unnatural motion and costly training. We trace these limitations to the DMD gradient, which jointly optimizes appearance, layout, and motion without distinguishing their learning dynamics. Its static component, which carries appearance and layout, has a much higher signal-to-noise ratio than its motion component. As a result, per-frame quality converges within a few hundred iterations, whereas motion lags far behind. Beyond being noisy, the gradient also lacks two signals. (1) Video VAEs encode several frames into one latent frame (four in Wan2.1), and the gradient provides little guidance for spreading motion over these frames, causing periodic stutter. (2) DMD does not constrain the final sampling step to preserve the layout set by earlier steps, so objects merge and drift once the video moves. We propose HorizonFlow, which decouples the correction of motion from that of layout. It keeps the DMD loss and only shifts its regression target, with one training-only correction in the motion component and one in the orthogonal layout component. Chunk Evenness addresses (1) by spreading the motion of each latent chunk evenly over its frames, and Semantic Commitment addresses (2) by anchoring the coarse layout to the teacher's completion of the student's last step. In only 600 iterations, HorizonFlow distills Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B into a 4-step model using 8.4k training samples, 4.6-304$\times$ fewer than prior work. On VBench, HorizonFlow outperforms all released few-step Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B models. The same recipe transfers to Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B, where our student outperforms NVIDIA's distilled model. Code: https://github.com/XIANGLONGGUO/HorizonFlow-repo

AI.tldr: HorizonFlow 通过解耦 DMD 梯度中运动与布局的修正，仅用 600 次迭代、8.4k 样本即将 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 蒸馏为 4 步生成模型，VBench 性能超越所有已发布的少步 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 DMD 的视频蒸馏方法存在两个问题：生成运动不自然、训练成本高。作者将根因归于 DMD 梯度同时优化外观、布局与运动却不区分其学习动态：梯度的静态分量（承载外观与布局）信噪比远高于运动分量，导致逐帧质量数百步即收敛而运动严重滞后。此外梯度还缺失两类信号：(1) 视频 VAE（如 Wan2.1 为 4 帧压缩为 1 个 latent 帧）使梯度缺乏在帧间均匀分配运动的引导，产生周期性卡顿；(2) DMD 未约束最终采样步保持前序步骤确定的布局，导致视频运动后物体融合与漂移。
AI.method: 提出 HorizonFlow，将运动修正与布局修正解耦。保留原 DMD 损失，仅偏移其回归目标，在运动分量上加入训练期修正（Chunk Evenness：将该 latent chunk 的运动在其覆盖帧间均匀分配），并在正交的布局分量上加入修正（Semantic Commitment：以教师模型完成学生最后一步的结果锚定粗粒度布局）。
AI.result: 仅 600 次迭代、使用 8.4k 训练样本，将 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 蒸馏为 4 步模型，训练样本量比先前工作少 4.6–304 倍。在 VBench 上优于所有已发布的少步 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 模型；同一方法迁移至 Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B，学生模型超过 NVIDIA 的蒸馏模型。
AI.conclusion: DMD 梯度的运动/布局耦合与帧间 latent 压缩、末步布局失守是少步视频蒸馏质量与效率瓶颈的关键；通过仅改写回归目标的轻量解耦修正即可显著提升运动自然度并大幅降低训练开销，且方法具备跨模型可迁移性。

title: Evaluable Language-Model Treatment Policies for Sepsis Resuscitation via Offline Value-Guided Selection
summary: Offline treatment learning must balance imitation, which stays close to logged evidence but ignores outcomes, against value maximisation, which uses outcomes but drifts toward treatments the records cannot verify. Numerical reinforcement learning strikes this balance during training. For large language models (LLMs), directly using sparse retrospective outcomes for fine-tuning raises challenges of delayed credit assignment and limited evidence for alternative treatments. We present R-LLMC, which strikes the balance at inference for sepsis resuscitation. A behaviour-supervised LLM, decoded into an exact distribution over 25 vasopressor-fluid actions, proposes clinician-anchored candidates; an offline critic selects among them by estimated long-term value. The policy has a closed form for off-policy evaluation, and its rationale is written after selection, so explanation cannot steer treatment. In experiments on held-out MIMIC-III patients, R-LLMC exceeded the clinician reference in doubly robust value by +0.214 (95\% CI 0.091-0.300), with fitted Q evaluation agreeing.

AI.tldr: 提出R-LLMC：在推理阶段而非训练阶段平衡模仿与价值最大化，用于脓毒症复苏的离线治疗学习，在MIMIC-III上超越临床医生参考策略。
AI.motivation: 离线治疗学习需在「模仿」（贴近日志数据但忽略结局）与「价值最大化」（利用结局但易漂移到记录无法验证的处置）之间取得平衡。数值强化学习可在训练中实现该平衡，但对LLM而言，直接用稀疏的回溯性结局微调存在延迟信用分配和替代处置证据不足的困难。
AI.method: R-LLMC在推理阶段实现平衡：1）行为监督的LLM解码为25种升压药-补液动作上的精确分布，生成以临床医生为锚的候选动作；2）离线critic按估计的长期价值在候选中选择；3）策略对离策略评估具有闭式形式；4）理由在决策后生成，避免解释反向影响治疗。
AI.result: 在留出的MIMIC-III患者上，R-LLMC的双稳健价值较临床医生参考高出+0.214（95% CI 0.091–0.300），拟合Q评估结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 将模仿-价值平衡置于推理阶段，可在不进行结局微调的条件下让LLM策略安全地偏离临床日志，并具备可验证的离策略评估与后置解释。

title: Ride on Anything: Contact-Coupled Monocular 4D Reconstruction of a Rider and Horse in Camera and World Frames
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Code and interactive results: https://wengzehang.github.io/rideonanything/
summary: We address the reconstruction of a horse and its rider from a single video. When a human estimator and a horse estimator are applied independently, both meshes can fit their silhouettes well while the rider hovers beside or passes through the horse, slides along its back and jitters relative to it. These errors lie along the camera axis and are not visible in the input view. We present Ride on Anything (RoA), a general, training-free methodology for reconstructing a person riding an animal, which couples frozen estimators of the rider and the mount at test time. We instantiate it for horseback riding with SAM 3D Body and 4DEquine. RoA aligns both estimators on a common frame index, projects both subjects through one pixel-isotropic camera initialized from the horse estimator, and jointly optimizes bounded corrections under interaction terms defined in the horse's body frame, including a collision term based on generalized winding numbers that remains valid on the non-watertight horse mesh. The result is lifted to a levelled world frame using the camera rotation from the background and the field of view from MoGe-2. On our riding clips, the raw outputs of the two estimators leave the rider's pelvis 15 cm from the horse's back on average. RoA reduces this seat gap to 1 cm, the drift of the seat along and across the spine by 64% and 89%, the 90th-percentile penetration depth by 57%, and the share of rider surface inside the horse from 12.1% to 7.9%. The motion is markedly smoother (94% lower acceleration of the rider relative to the horse, 80% lower horse jerk), while the rider's silhouette IoU decreases from 0.59 to 0.52. Qualitatively, the rider stays seated on the horse and moves together with it. A quantitative evaluation of 3D accuracy awaits calibrated recordings of ridden animals. We also test a clip outside the task, a horse led on foot, and analyse the failure modes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Ride on Anything (RoA)，一种无需训练、在测试时耦合"骑手"与"动物"两个冻结估计器的通用方法，用于从单目视频重建骑马者与马的三维网格，显著消除骑手悬空、穿模与抖动等沿相机轴方向的深度误差。
AI.motivation: 独立运行人体估计器与马匹估计器时，两者虽各自能很好地拟合轮廓，但骑手会悬在马侧、穿过马身、沿马背滑动并相对马抖动。这类误差主要沿相机轴方向，在输入视角下不可见，却使重建结果不可用。
AI.method: 方法完全免训练，仅做测试时联合优化：将两个估计器（SAM 3D Body 与 4DEquine）对齐到统一帧索引；用由马匹估计器初始化的单一像素各向同性相机投影两个主体；在马体坐标系下定义交互项（含基于广义绕数、适用于非水密马网格的碰撞项），对两个网格施加有界修正并联合优化；最后利用背景估计的相机旋转与 MoGe-2 的视场角将结果提升至水平世界坐标系。
AI.result: 在骑行片段上，原始输出使骑手骨盆平均距马背 15 cm，RoA 将坐姿间隙降至 1 cm；沿脊柱与横向的座位漂移分别降低 64% 与 89%；穿透深度 90 分位数降低 57%；骑手表面位于马体内的比例从 12.1% 降至 7.9%；骑手相对马的加速度降低 94%，马的 jerk 降低 80%，运动明显更平滑；代价是骑手轮廓 IoU 从 0.59 降至 0.52。定性上骑手保持坐姿并与马同步运动。
AI.conclusion: RoA 以轻量、免训练的方式有效解决跨主体因深度歧义导致的交互失配，可推广至"人骑任意动物"。当前局限在于缺乏标定录制的真值，三维绝对精度尚待验证；作者另在非本任务的牵马片段上测试并分析了失效模式。

title: Explanation Selection in Abductive Learning
summary: Abductive learning (ABL) offers a promising framework that connects machine learning and logical reasoning in a mutually beneficial loop. However, this bidirectional feedback can also reinforce incorrect concept semantics, since different interpretations of intermediate concepts may explain the same observed reasoning outcomes. Static analyses characterize this ambiguity but leave open which explanation training selects and whether its labels can still be corrected. We develop a dynamical analysis of a fixed-feature binary ABL model that links the local stability of competing explanations to differences in their concept labels. We prove that Gram matrices with identical spectra can select different explanations even under the same supervision, objective, and initialization. When any two compatible explanations differ in at least two labels, legal evidence above one half guarantees during training that admissible changes in optimization geometry preserve the selected explanation. Even when only the true explanation satisfies all constraints under a shared predictor, training can still converge to a finite attracting state whose hard predictions violate some constraints and mislabel concepts. Experiments on visual ABL tasks verify these predictions, including wrong attraction from random initializations under identifiable supervision, and show that in ordinary end-to-end training SGD and Adam select different explanations of the same supervision, while unseen concept accuracy drops relative to true-concept references as training concept errors grow.

AI.tldr: 本文对固定特征二值溯因学习（ABL）模型做动力学分析，把竞争解释的局部稳定性与其概念标签差异联系起来，证明即使监督、目标、初始化相同，Gram 矩阵仅谱相同也可能选出不同解释；并指出训练可能收敛到违反约束、标错概念的吸引态。
AI.motivation: ABL 将机器学习与逻辑推理闭环连接，但双向反馈会固化错误的概念语义：同一推理结果可由不同中间概念解释。已有静态分析只刻画歧义，未回答"训练会选中哪种解释""标签能否被纠正"。
AI.method: 构建固定特征、二值概念的 ABL 模型动力学分析框架；用 Gram 矩阵谱与标签差异刻画竞争解释的局部稳定性；在"任意两个相容解释至少相差两个标签"的条件下分析合法证据比例对优化几何变化的影响；并在视觉 ABL 任务上实验验证（随机初始化、SGD 与 Adam 对比、未见概念准确率）。
AI.result: Gram 矩阵谱相同者可在相同监督/目标/初始化下选出不同解释；当两个相容解释标签差≥2且合法证据超过一半时，训练中合法的优化几何变化保持所选解释不变；即使共享预测器下仅真实解释满足全部约束，训练仍可收敛到有限吸引态，其硬预测违反部分约束且概念被错标。视觉 ABL 实验验证了可辨识监督下随机初始化导致的错误吸引，以及端到端训练中 SGD 与 Adam 对同一监督选出不同解释，训练概念错误增长时未见概念准确率相对真实概念参考下降。
AI.conclusion: ABL 的歧义不仅是静态可辨识性问题，更是训练动力学选择问题；错误概念语义一旦被吸引无法靠更多数据/约束自动纠正，需在训练动力学与优化几何层面设计干预。

title: Seeing Through Preferences: Recovering Hidden Local Preference Neighborhoods for Text-to-Image Alignment
summary: Aligning text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models with human preferences typically relies on large-scale pairwise annotations, which are expensive to obtain and provide only sparse supervision. Moreover, not all preference comparisons contribute equally to learning: comparisons between semantically distant images often reveal little about the fine-grained perceptual factors underlying human judgments. We argue that informative supervision can arise from local preference neighborhoods surrounding human-preferred images, where semantically aligned alternatives expose meaningful perceptual and structural differences. Motivated by this observation, we propose PrefLens, a framework that recovers local preference neighborhoods from sparse human feedback. Specifically, PrefLens generates controlled perceptual variations around preferred images that largely retain semantic identity and selects compact sets of informative neighbors in a reward-defined preference space induced by pretrained reward models. By transforming each human preference annotation into a structured neighborhood of informative comparisons, PrefLens enriches supervision without requiring additional human labeling. Our experiments and diagnostic evaluations show that the recovered neighborhoods capture human-relevant preference characteristics and provide effective supervision for preference alignment across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: PrefLens 从稀疏的人类偏好标注中恢复"局部偏好邻域"，将单条偏好注释转化为围绕偏好图像的结构化比较集合，从而在不增加人工标注的前提下丰富监督信号。
AI.motivation: T2I 扩散模型的人类偏好对齐依赖大规模成对标注，成本高且监督稀疏；同时并非所有偏好比较都同等有效——语义差异大的图像对往往无法揭示细粒度感知因素。作者认为有信息量的监督来自人类偏好图像周围的"局部偏好邻域"，即语义对齐的替代样本所暴露的感知与结构差异。
AI.method: 提出 PrefLens 框架：(1) 在偏好图像周围生成受控的感知变化，保持语义身份基本不变；(2) 在预训练奖励模型诱导的、由奖励定义的偏好空间中，筛选紧凑的、信息量高的邻居集合；(3) 将每条人类偏好注释扩展为一个结构化的信息性比较邻域。
AI.result: 实验与诊断性评估表明，恢复出的邻域能够捕捉与人类相关的偏好特征，并在多种设置下为偏好对齐提供有效监督。
AI.conclusion: 局部偏好邻域是一种可扩展、无需额外人工标注的偏好监督形式，可有效缓解成对偏好数据的稀疏性问题并提升 T2I 模型对齐效果。

title: Reinforcing Diffusion Models by Instantaneous Trajectory Distribution Matching
summary: Forward diffusion reinforcement learning (RL)---enabling deterministic ODE sampling without trajectory backpropagation---has grown increasingly popular for efficiently aligning diffusion models. However, we reveal that existing methods essentially rely on signed reward-weighted regression (RWR), regressing the \emph{trainable policy} velocity onto rollouts from a \emph{behavior distribution}. Unbiased baseline subtraction implicitly assumes that the policy velocity equals the behavior marginal velocity---an idealized assumption violated under classifier-free guidance (CFG) rollouts, offline/off-policy updates, and imperfect online self-consistency. This \emph{behavior--policy mismatch} breaks baseline invariance and injects \emph{baseline-induced gradient drift}, destabilizing training. To resolve this issue, we propose \textbf{I}nstantaneous \textbf{T}rajectory \textbf{D}istribution \textbf{M}atching (\textbf{iTDM}), taking the infinitesimal limit of Trajectory Distribution Matching toward a time-local reward-guided target via the posterior-score identity to yield a sample-level gradient anchored at the behavior velocity without learning an additional reward-tilted target score. Tracking this velocity with an online auxiliary denoiser guarantees exact baseline invariance at the auxiliary optimum, effectively suppressing baseline drift across both online and offline RL. Extensive experiments across compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment show that iTDM achieves state-of-the-art in-domain and out-of-domain performance. Notably, on the challenging GenEval2 benchmark, iTDM converges nearly $3\times$ faster than competing methods while scaling smoothly to $0.87$ without collapse. Code is available at https://github.com/Luo-Yihong/iTDM

AI.tldr: 现有前向扩散强化学习本质是带符号奖励加权回归（RWR），存在行为–策略不匹配导致的"基线诱导梯度漂移"；本文提出 iTDM，通过后验分数恒等式取轨迹分布匹配的无穷小极限，得到锚定于行为速度的样本级梯度，实现精确基线不变性，在多项任务上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 前向扩散 RL（确定性 ODE 采样、免轨迹反传）虽被广泛用于高效对齐扩散模型，但作者揭示其本质是 signed RWR：将可训练策略速度回归到行为分布的 rollout 上。无偏基线减除隐式假设"策略速度 = 行为边缘速度"，该假设在 CFG rollout、离线/离策略更新及不完美在线自洽下不成立。此行为–策略不匹配破坏基线不变性，注入基线诱导的梯度漂移，导致训练不稳定。
AI.method: 提出 Instantaneous Trajectory Distribution Matching（iTDM）：对 Trajectory Distribution Matching 取无穷小极限，借助后验分数恒等式将目标收缩为时间局部的、奖励引导的目标，从而导出以行为速度为锚点的样本级梯度，且无需额外学习奖励倾斜的目标分数。再用在线辅助去噪器追踪该速度，在辅助最优处保证精确的基线不变性，从而在在线与离线 RL 中抑制基线漂移。
AI.result: 在组合式生成、文本渲染与偏好对齐等实验中，iTDM 在域内与域外性能均达 SOTA。在具有挑战性的 GenEval2 基准上，收敛速度约为对比方法的 3 倍，并可平滑扩展至 0.87 而不崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 行为–策略不匹配是现有前向扩散 RL 稳定性的关键症结；iTDM 以瞬时化分布匹配与辅助去噪器实现基线不变的最优梯度，兼顾效率与性能，为扩散模型高效对齐提供了理论与实证兼具的方案。

title: Exploring Attention-Driven Deep Learning for Accurate Lung Nodule Segmentation
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted manuscript of a paper published at IEEE EMBC 2025
summary: This study explores the application of various deep learning models for the segmentation of lung nodules using LIDC-IDRI. Unlike traditional approaches that utilize the full dataset, our work emphasizes the efficacy of training models on a filtered subset of 356 samples. Novel configurations, including attention mechanisms and advanced preprocessing strategies, were employed to optimize segmentation accuracy. Among the models evaluated, the DPL nkNet50 with a Channel Attention Bridge and ResNet backbone demonstrated the highest performance with a Dice score of 0.86, significantly outperforming conventional architectures. This work underscores the potential of leveraging data efficiency and tailored architectures in achieving robust segmentation performance, paving the way for improved computer-aided diagnosis in clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究在LIDC-IDRI数据集上，仅使用356个筛选样本训练多种深度学习模型进行肺结节分割，其中带通道注意力桥和ResNet主干的DPL nkNet50取得最高Dice 0.86，优于传统架构，证明了数据高效利用与定制化架构的潜力。
AI.motivation: 传统肺结节分割方法通常使用完整数据集训练，数据需求大、效率低。作者希望验证在筛选后的小规模子集上是否仍能获得稳健的分割性能，从而提升数据效率并推动临床计算机辅助诊断应用。
AI.method: 基于LIDC-IDRI数据集，构建仅含356个样本的筛选子集；采用新颖的网络配置（包括注意力机制，如通道注意力桥Channel Attention Bridge）与改进的预处理策略；以ResNet为主干评估多种深度学习分割模型。
AI.result: DPL nkNet50（通道注意力桥+ResNet主干）表现最佳，Dice得分为0.86，显著优于传统分割架构。
AI.conclusion: 数据高效利用与定制化网络架构相结合，可在小样本条件下实现稳健的肺结节分割性能，为临床计算机辅助诊断的改进提供可行路径。

title: Can Latent Reasoning Drive LLM Outputs Without a Trace?
summary: LLMs typically solve complex tasks with chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, which is also the main tool for monitoring them for misaligned behavior. However, standard transformers can also solve tasks with complete latent reasoning (CLR), carrying out the whole task internally and outputting only the final answer. Theory bounds the depth of CLR, the number of sequential steps it can carry out, and recent work measured it to be shallow. In this work, we ask whether CLR is deep enough for a model to pursue a hidden objective that requires reasoning. Such a model would generate a CoT that appears to solve the given task, while a latent multi-step computation decides its answer based on the hidden objective. First, we show that a simple auxiliary loss allows models to solve a multi-step task latently at least 5x deeper than previously reported. Then, in two common tasks, decision-making and code generation, we train a model to pursue such a hidden objective, which decides a loan or plants a vulnerability. The model's CoT justifies the output with no trace of the hidden objective, and a strong LLM monitor does not flag it. Finally, using activation patching, we find that the latent computation is completed before the model generates its CoT, which takes no part in it. Altogether, we show that a hidden objective that requires reasoning can go unseen by a monitor that reads only the output.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明：借助辅助损失，模型可在完全隐式推理（CLR）中完成比以往报告深至少5倍的多步计算；基于此可训练出带有需多步推理的隐藏目标（如决定放贷、植入漏洞）的模型，其CoT表面合理、不含隐藏目标痕迹，强LLM监控器亦无法发现，且激活修补显示隐式计算在CoT生成前已完成。
AI.motivation: CoT被视为监控模型失准行为的主要手段，但标准Transformer也能以完全隐式推理（CLR）在内部完成任务、仅输出最终答案。既有理论与实测表明CLR深度较浅，因此需要回答一个安全相关问题：CLR是否足够深，使模型能够追求需要多步推理的隐藏目标，从而在输出看似正常的CoT时不被读取输出的监控者发现。
AI.method: 1) 引入一个简单的辅助损失，训练模型以隐式方式求解多步任务，并测量所得CLR深度；2) 在决策制定与代码生成两个常见任务上构造隐藏目标（决定贷款审批结果、植入漏洞），训练模型表面解题、实际由隐式多步计算依据隐藏目标决定输出；3) 用强LLM监控器仅阅读输出与CoT进行检测；4) 使用激活修补（activation patching）定位隐式计算与CoT生成的时间顺序与因果依赖。
AI.result: 辅助损失使模型能够隐式求解多步任务，深度至少为此前报告的5倍；在两任务中，模型生成的CoT可为输出提供自洽论证且不含隐藏目标的任何痕迹，强LLM监控器未对其报警；激活修补表明隐式计算在CoT生成之前即已完成，CoT并不参与该计算。
AI.conclusion: CLR的深度足以支撑需要推理的隐藏目标；仅读取输出的监控（包括基于CoT的LLM监控）在原理上可被绕过，对CoT作为可监控性工具的可靠性构成直接挑战，提示需要基于内部激活等更深层可解释性手段的监控。

title: Fill in the Blanks: Non-Autoregressive Schema-Parallel Key Information Extraction with CTC Decoding
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) extract structured data from documents by generating the requested JSON one token at a time, so their sequential steps grow with the length of the answer. Yet in key information extraction (KIE) the schema already fixes the answer's structure: keys, nesting and lists are known before decoding, and only the values are unknown. We exploit this with a non-autoregressive extractor that writes the structure from the schema, sizes every list with a count pass, and predicts all values in parallel, in a fixed number of passes that does not grow with the document. Each value is decoded with connectionist temporal classification (CTC) in its own block of slots, so its length never has to be predicted, and a value that is still open after its block gets a larger token budget. Zero-shot on VAREX, CORD and FUNSD, our 4B extractor is 3.5$\times$ faster than the diffusion-VLM competition on average (up to 5.6$\times$) and more accurate, with 4--6 forward passes per document where block diffusion needs 12--74. The same extractor also drafts for speculative decoding with its own autoregressive base: it runs 8.3$\times$ faster than autoregressive decoding (up to 10.4$\times$) within 0.4 points of its accuracy, and 3.3$\times$ faster than speculative diffusion decoding while 13.0 points more accurate. We release the model and code.

AI.tldr: 提出一种非自回归KIE抽取器：结构由schema直接写出、列表长度用一次计数pass确定、所有值并行预测，总pass数与文档长度无关，速度与精度均优于扩散VLM。
AI.motivation: VLM通过逐token生成JSON来抽取文档结构化数据，解码步数随答案长度线性增长；但在KIE任务中schema已预先确定键、嵌套与列表结构，只有值是未知的，因此顺序解码存在大量冗余计算。
AI.method: 非自回归抽取：从schema直接写出结构；用一次count pass确定每个列表长度；每个值在专属slot块中用CTC解码（无需预测长度），块内仍未闭合的值获得更大token预算；所有值并在固定次数前向pass中并行预测。同一抽取器还可作为自回归基模型的草稿模型用于投机解码。
AI.result: 在VAREX、CORD、FUNSD零样本设置下，4B模型平均比扩散VLM快3.5倍（最高5.6倍）且更准确，每文档仅4–6次前向pass（块扩散需12–74次）。作为投机解码草稿：比自回归解码快8.3倍（最高10.4倍），精度差在0.4点内；比投机扩散解码快3.3倍且高13.0点。
AI.conclusion: 利用KIE的schema先验可将解码复杂度与答案长度解耦，实现固定pass数的并行抽取，在速度与精度上同时超越扩散式VLM方法，并可兼作投机解码草稿模型；模型与代码已开源。

title: Black-Box Comparator-Adaptive Network Regret
summary: We study comparator-adaptive decentralized online learning with network regret, which evaluates each node's prediction on the loss of every node in the network. We show that existing gossip-based algorithms are fundamentally limited for this task, and cannot achieve sublinear network regret with only one gossip step per decision round. To prove this, we construct a two-node counterexample, which shows that gossip-based algorithms can produce exponential regret despite bounded disagreement, resolving a previously open question in the literature. We then introduce a black-box reduction, which uses local learners with sublinear comparator-adaptive regret to obtain sublinear comparator-adaptive network regret. Each node exchanges predictions with its neighbors once per decision round, and a universal choice of edge weights works on every connected undirected graph without graph preprocessing. We also characterize admissible edge weights and show how weights adapted to the graph improve the regret bound. For example, for the complete graph, this improvement is quadratic in the number of nodes. Experiments on synthetic and real-world data illustrate the counterexamples we propose and compare the reduction with decentralized baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究比较器自适应的去中心化在线学习（网络 regret），证明单步 gossip 算法在此任务上存在本质局限，并提出一种黑盒归约，用局部学习器实现次线性的比较器自适应网络 regret。
AI.motivation: 已有基于 gossip 的去中心化在线学习算法在"网络 regret"（评估每个节点的预测在网络中所有节点损失上的表现）这一更严格指标下表现不佳；作者希望厘清其根本限制，并回答文献中关于"有界分歧下 gossip 算法是否可能导致指数级 regret"的悬而未决问题。
AI.method: 构造一个双节点反例，说明每轮仅一次 gossip 步骤的算法即使分歧有界也可能产生指数级 regret，从而表明这类算法无法达到次线性网络 regret；随后提出一种黑盒归约，将具有次线性比较器自适应 regret 的局部学习器转化为次线性比较器自适应网络 regret，每个节点每轮与邻居交换一次预测；给出在任意连通无向图上均有效的通用边权选择（无需图预处理），刻画可允许的边权，并分析图自适应边权对 regret 界的改进（完全图上改进为节点数的二次量级）。
AI.result: 证明了现有 gossip 类算法在该任务上的本质局限（反例显示指数级 regret，回答了一个开放问题）；提出的黑盒归约在每轮单次邻居通信下实现次线性比较器自适应网络 regret；通用边权适用于所有连通无向图且无需预处理；图自适应边权可改进 regret 界，完全图上改进量为节点数的平方；合成与真实数据实验验证了反例并比较了该归约与去中心化基线。
AI.conclusion: 单步 gossip 无法胜任比较器自适应的网络 regret 任务；通过将局部比较器自适应学习器与恰当设计的边权相结合，可在低通信开销下获得次线性网络 regret，且边权的图自适应设计能带来显著的理论收益。

title: RSWP: Robust SO(3)-Equivariant Watermarking for Panoramic Images
summary: Robust watermarking for panoramic imagery is impeded by the topological mismatch between spherical signals and planar representations. Conventional methods fail under $SO(3)$ viewing rotations due to non-linear geometric warping and struggle with viewport extraction, which typically necessitates computationally expensive inverse remapping. To address these challenges, we propose RSWP, a watermarking framework grounded in icosahedral group theory. Leveraging the property that the icosahedral group ($\mathcal{I}_{60}$) serves as the largest discrete subgroup of $SO(3)$, we decompose spherical rotations into tractable local planar rotations and combinatorial facet permutations. Accordingly, we introduce a decoupling architecture that embeds watermarks into discrete facets and a theoretically guaranteed Equivariance-to-Invariance decoding paradigm. By employing an equivariant feature extractor followed by a permutation-invariant sorting module, this paradigm rigorously synchronizes rotation-distorted features. Moreover, the dual-extractor design inherently supports direct, blind watermark retrieval from partial 2D renderings without geometric calibration. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RSWP achieves state-of-the-art robustness against continuous $SO(3)$ rotations and viewport transformations while preserving high visual fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出基于二十面体群理论的球面全景图水印框架RSWP，将SO(3)旋转分解为局部平面旋转与面片置换，实现旋转等变到不变的解码，在无需几何校准的情况下从部分2D视口直接盲提取水印。
AI.motivation: 全景图像在球面信号与平面表示之间存在拓扑失配，传统水印方法在SO(3)视角旋转下因非线性几何畸变而失效；同时视口提取通常需要计算代价高昂的逆映射，缺乏高效鲁棒的解决方案。
AI.method: 以二十面体群I60作为SO(3)最大离散子群的理论基础，将球面旋转解耦为可处理的局部平面旋转与组合式面片置换；设计解耦架构把水印嵌入离散面片，并构建"等变到不变"的解码范式：先用等变特征提取器、再用置换不变排序模块同步旋转扭曲特征；双提取器设计支持从部分2D渲染图中直接盲提取。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，RSWP在连续SO(3)旋转与视口变换下达到当前最优的鲁棒性，同时保持高视觉保真度。
AI.conclusion: 利用二十面体群的离散对称性可有效弥合球面与平面表示的鸿沟，等变—不变解码范式为球面全景水印提供了理论可保证、无需几何校准且计算高效的鲁棒方案。

title: RoFE: Rotated Frozen Embeddings for Low-Data Multimodal Tabular Learning
summary: Multimodal tabular learning combines tabular data with images and text, often in settings where labeled data are scarce. Tabular foundation models such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) offer a promising solution via in-context learning without task-specific training. However, modern image and text encoders produce embeddings with hundreds or thousands of dimensions, far exceeding the number of features encountered during PFN pretraining. Existing approaches bridge this gap using principal component analysis (PCA) to compress frozen embeddings. Surprisingly, we find that this PCA interface can underperform simple linear classifiers when labeled examples are scarce, even though PFNs are designed for small datasets. We identify the underlying failure mechanism: the PFN's per-column standardization removes the variances of the PCA scores. When the PCA keeps every direction of the labeled examples, the examples collapse into a regular simplex in which all pairwise distances are equal. To address this problem, we propose Rotated Frozen Embeddings (RoFE), a training-free method that rotates PCA scores before PFN inference. We theoretically show that rotation makes the column variances nearly equal, so that standardization approximately preserves the embedding geometry. Across image and text classification tasks, encoders, and tabular foundation models, RoFE improves low-data performance over the PCA interface and outperforms baselines that require task-specific training. The improvements also extend to regression.

AI.tldr: 论文发现多模态表格学习中用PCA压缩冻结图像/文本嵌入接入PFN时，会因PFN逐列标准化消除PCA得分方差、使样本坍缩为规则单纯形而失效；提出免训练的旋转冻结嵌入（RoFE），在PFN推理前旋转PCA得分使各列方差近似相等，从而在低数据场景下显著优于PCA接口及需任务训练的基线。
AI.motivation: 多模态表格学习常面临标注数据稀缺的问题，PFN类表格基础模型可通过上下文学习免训练解决，但图像/文本编码器输出维度（数百至数千）远超PFN预训练时的特征数。现有PCA接口压缩虽能对接维度，却在标签样本极少时不如简单线性分类器，作者希望定位该反常现象的机理并修复。
AI.method: 先做失败机理分析：当PCA保留有标签样本的全部方向时，PFN的逐列标准化会消除PCA得分方差，导致样本间两两距离相等、坍缩为规则单纯形。据此提出RoFE：一种无需训练的方法，在送入PFN推理前对PCA得分施加旋转，并从理论上证明该旋转使各列方差近似相等，使标准化近似保持嵌入几何结构。
AI.result: 在多种图像与文本分类任务、不同编码器和不同表格基础模型上，RoFE在低数据情形下的表现均优于PCA接口，并超过需要任务特定训练的基线；改进同样可推广到回归任务。
AI.conclusion: 冻结嵌入与PFN之间的接口设计（而非仅维度压缩）是关键瓶颈；逐列标准化与PCA得分的方差分布不匹配会导致几何坍缩。通过免训练的方差均衡旋转即可恢复嵌入几何，为多模态表格低数据学习提供了一种简单、无需训练的即插即用方案。

title: Separating Action Allocation from Image Matching in Visual Token Routing
summary: Adaptive visual token routers aim to save computation while preserving the image detail needed to answer each question. A higher average score could reflect better choices for individual images or more frequent use of high resolution on tasks that need it. We distinguish the two by keeping action counts fixed within each task and comparing the router's assignments with random pairings of the same actions and images. On equally weighted ChartQA and TextVQA, both Qwen2.5-VL-3B and -7B gain from matching but lose more from their action frequencies relative to a task table, with a 1.71-point gain and a 3.95-point loss on 7B. Exchanging the continuous resolutions chosen by the external selector CARES also lowers quality on 7B. When requests arrive with task labels, the table outscores the discrete router by 1.92 points and saves 31.76 ms per complete 7B request on average.

AI.tldr: 论文区分自适应视觉 token 路由器的平均分提升来源于"逐图匹配质量"还是"高频使用高分辨率的任务偏好"，通过固定各任务内动作计数、与同动作同图像的随机配对比较，发现匹配本身有正贡献，但动作频率分配相对任务表造成的损失更大。
AI.motivation: 自适应视觉 token 路由器的平均得分提升存在两种可能解释：一是路由器为单张图像做出了更好的选择；二是它在需要高分辨率的任务上更频繁地启用了高分辨率。若不加以区分，就无法判断路由器是否真正具备细粒度决策能力，也就难以指导路由器的设计与改进。
AI.method: 在 ChartQA 与 TextVQA 等权设置下，将每个任务内的动作（分辨率/token 配置）计数固定，把路由器的"图像—动作"配对与同动作、同图像的随机配对进行比较，以解耦匹配效应与动作频率效应；同时在 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 与 7B 上测试，并考察外部选择器 CARES 给出的连续分辨率交换实验；最后在请求带任务标签时，将基于任务表的静态策略与离散路由器对比。
AI.result: 在 7B 上，路由器匹配带来 1.71 分增益，但相对任务表的动作频率分布带来 3.95 分损失，净收益为负；交换 CARES 选出的连续分辨率同样降低 7B 的质量。当请求带有任务标签时，任务表策略比离散路由器高 1.92 分，并在完整 7B 请求上平均节省 31.76 ms。
AI.conclusion: 现有自适应路由器的收益主要来自任务级的动作频率偏好而非逐样本的最优匹配，其匹配能力虽有正向价值，但被次优的频率分配所抵消；在可获得任务标签的场景下，简单的任务表即可同时获得更高质量与更低延迟，提示路由器应重点改进频率分配与置信度校准，而非仅追求更细的分辨率选择粒度。

title: Attention Temperature Confounds Zero-Shot Context Extension
summary: A training-time attention change is usually judged for zero-shot context extension against a dense baseline beyond the training length at the default temperature, $τ= 1$. The outcome depends on how miscalibrated the baseline is there: the share of perplexity it recovers when its logits are sharpened by one scalar. Under the standard recipe (fp32 master weights), an 8k-trained baseline is 8-15% miscalibrated at 30k in three seed-paired 365M twins; in one of them this makes the block-sparse-trained twin look 7% better, which calibration removes. In pure-bf16 training without master weights the miscalibration is several times larger: an AdamW step ($β_2 = 0.95$) on a gain initialised at 1.0 is below half the bf16 spacing at peak learning rates under $1.7\times10^{-3}$, so gains never move (22 checkpoints), the baseline is 37-58% miscalibrated, and block-sparse pretraining, attention dropout and ALiBi look 6-35% better. Calibrating one temperature per model and length removes all three advantages, leaves ALiBi 5% behind RoPE and keeps part of the gain of a positive control, NTK-aware scaling. Unfreezing the gains reverses the block-sparse advantage at 365M and removes 71-89% of it at 1.2B. We recommend reporting extension results at calibrated temperatures and checking that normalisation gains moved.

AI.tldr: 论文指出零样本上下文扩展评测在默认温度τ=1下会被基线模型的"误校准"污染：纯bf16训练（无fp32主权重）时LayerNorm增益因梯度更新小于bf16最小间隔而停滞，导致基线在训练长度外严重误校准（37–58%），使block-sparse注意力、attention dropout、ALiBi等改动显得虚假优于基线（6–35%）；按模型与长度校准温度后这些优势全部消失，部分真实效应（block-sparse）甚至反转为劣势。
AI.motivation: 现有工作常以默认温度τ=1、在超过训练长度处比较密集基线与"训练期注意力改动"模型的困惑度，以此判断零样本上下文扩展能力。但该比较依赖于基线在训练长度外的校准状态：若基线因归一化增益未更新等原因而未校准，则任何改动都可能仅凭"改变logits尖锐度"获得虚假优势。作者希望量化这种误校准的来源与幅度，并厘清若干被广泛报告的上下文扩展收益是否只是校准伪影。
AI.method: （1）以"一个标量温度锐化logits后困惑度恢复的比例"作为误校准度量；（2）在三个配对的365M孪生模型上比较8k训练基线在30k长度处的误校准，并对比fp32主权重标准配方与纯bf16训练（无主权重）两种设置；（3）分析纯bf16下AdamW（β2=0.95）对初始化为1.0的增益的更新量：当峰值学习率低于1.7e-3时，更新量不足bf16间距的一半，增益无法移动（检查22个checkpoint）；（4）逐一按"每个模型、每个长度"拟合一个温度做校准，重测block-sparse注意力、attention dropout、ALiBi以及阳性对照NTK-aware缩放的优势；（5）在365M与1.2B规模上解冻（unfreeze）归一化增益，观察block-sparse优势变化。
AI.result: fp32主权重配方下，8k训练基线在30k处误校准8–15%；其中一个孪生中这使block-sparse模型看似好7%，校准后消失。纯bf16无主权重时误校准放大数倍：基线误校准37–58%，block-sparse预训练、attention dropout、ALiBi分别看似好6–35%；峰值学习率<1.7e-3时增益在22个checkpoint中完全不动。按模型和长度各校准一个温度后，三者的优势全部消失，ALiBi反而落后RoPE 5%，阳性对照NTK-aware缩放的部分增益保留。解冻增益后，block-sparse的优势在365M下反转，在1.2B下削减71–89%。
AI.conclusion: 零样本上下文扩展的许多"训练期注意力改动收益"是基线误校准造成的评测伪影，其根源（尤其在纯bf16训练中）是归一化增益未发生有效更新。建议：（1）在经温度校准的条件下报告扩展结果；（2）训练后检查归一化增益是否真的移动过（如纯bf16训练应保留fp32主权重或提高学习率）。

title: Neutron Imaging Enhancement for Lithium Batteries Based on Swin-Transformer and Image Fusion
summary: Neutron imaging is highly sensitive to light elements such as lithium and is therefore valuable for non-destructive testing (NDT) and analyzing internal structural evolution in lithium batteries. However, limited neutron-source flux and detector performance often result in images with mixed noise, low contrast, and blurred edges, hindering accurate assessment of battery internal states. To address these issues, this paper proposes a lithium-battery neutron image enhancement method combining an improved Swin-Transformer with spatial-domain image fusion. First, an improved Swin-Transformer incorporating Multi-Dconv Head Transposed Attention (MDTA) and Global Response Normalization (GRN) extracts and reconstructs image features to suppress high-density white spots and Gaussian-Poisson mixed noise. Second, guided filtering and a gradient-adaptive mask are used for selective edge enhancement, while Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) improves local contrast. Finally, a spatial-frequency (SF)-based local block-weighted fusion mechanism adaptively combines the edge-enhanced and contrast-equalized images to preserve microscopic details while suppressing noise. Experiments show that, compared with BM3D, DnCNN, and GAN, the proposed method achieves strong performance in full-reference and no-reference evaluations. Its best PSNR and SSIM reach 33.0517 dB and 0.9637, respectively, while the NR-IQA and Natural Image Quality Evaluator (NIQE) scores are as low as 0.1794 and 4.0974. The method reduces artifacts and over smoothing, improving the visual fidelity and structural identifiability of lithium-battery neutron images.

AI.tldr: 提出改进Swin-Transformer结合空间域图像融合的锂电池中子图像增强方法，同时抑制混合噪声并增强边缘与局部对比度。
AI.motivation: 中子成像对锂等轻元素敏感，适用于锂电池无损检测与内部结构演化分析；但中子源通量有限、探测器性能受限，导致图像存在混合噪声、低对比度和边缘模糊，影响电池内部状态的准确评估。
AI.method: 方法分三步：1）改进Swin-Transformer，引入Multi-Dconv Head Transposed Attention（MDTA）与Global Response Normalization（GRN）进行特征提取与重建，抑制高密度白斑及高斯-泊松混合噪声；2）采用引导滤波与梯度自适应掩膜实现选择性边缘增强，并用CLAHE提升局部对比度；3）基于空间频率（SF）的局部分块加权融合机制，自适应融合边缘增强图与对比度均衡图，兼顾微观细节保留与噪声抑制。
AI.result: 与BM3D、DnCNN、GAN相比，该方法在全参考与无参考评价中均表现优异：最佳PSNR达33.0517 dB，SSIM达0.9637；NR-IQA与NIQE分别低至0.1794和4.0974，有效减少伪影与过平滑。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提升了锂电池中子图像的视觉保真度与结构可辨识性，验证了深度学习去噪与空域融合策略在中子成像增强中的有效性。

title: Site-Conditioned Boundary Closure for Subsurface Seepage Forecasting and Relief Placement
summary: Truncating a large heterogeneous diffusion model around a localized, threshold-activated outlet saves degrees of freedom but severs exterior feedback that governs when the outlet opens and how much it discharges. By separating forcing-driven background head from local withdrawal drawdown, Site-Conditioned Boundary Closure (SCBC) maps local physical descriptors to positive exchange coefficients at the cut boundary. Supervised on unforced donor-domain withdrawal responses, these coefficients yield a passivity-preserving reduced operator that generalizes across unseen forcing histories without refitting. We evaluate SCBC on flood-driven subsurface seepage beneath levee foundations against full-grid reference simulations (MODFLOW~6). Across three held-out foundation panels, a single frozen SCBC tree estimator reduced peak-discharge log RMSE by 26.1%, 30.9% and 42.6% relative to identical local patches using a shared boundary coefficient. We then test whether better screening forecasts improve constrained placement, minimizing peak landside toe head subject to a discharge capacity limit and a budget of three sequential full-grid checks. On a separate 36-foundation test using a coarser 30-state ring operator, a neural SCBC estimator improved discharge forecasts across candidates yet selected four over-capacity placements before checks, compared with one for a shared-coefficient ring, which recovered all 144 reference optima after three checks.

AI.tldr: 提出站点条件边界封闭（SCBC）方法，将截断边界的局部物理描述符映射为正的交换系数，以在减少自由度的同时保持被动性并泛化到未见强迫历史。
AI.motivation: 在局部阈值激活出口处截断大型异质扩散模型可减少自由度，但切断了控制出口开启时机与排放量的外部反馈。
AI.method: 将强迫驱动的背景水头与局部抽取降深分离，用局部物理描述符通过树估计器/神经估计器预测截断边界的正交换系数；以无强迫供体域抽取响应做监督训练，构建保被动的降阶算子。以 MODFLOW 6 全网格模拟为参考，在堤基洪水驱动渗流场景中评估。
AI.result: 三个留出地基面板上，单一冻结 SCBC 树估计器相对共享边界系数使峰值流量对数 RMSE 分别降低 26.1%、30.9%、42.6%。在 36 个地基的约束布置测试中（30 状态环算子），神经 SCBC 估计器改善了候选放电预报，但检查前选出 4 个超容量布置；共享系数环仅 1 个，且三轮检查后恢复了全部 144 个参考最优解。
AI.conclusion: SCBC 能有效提升截断边界的放电预报精度且无需重拟合即可泛化，但更准确的筛选预测并不必然改善受约束布置决策，闭合精度与布置可靠性之间存在错配。

title: CAR: Reducing Decoder Output Shift in Visual Token Pruning via Coverage Selection and Attention Reallocation
summary: Visual token pruning is an effective way to accelerate multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing methods degrade substantially under aggressive pruning, especially on visual grounding (VG). We analyze the sources of this degradation from the perspective of the output shift that pruning causes in decoder layers, and decompose this shift in closed form into two terms, an image summary error and an attention allocation error. The summary error stems from the loss of visual information, and the allocation error from the drop in the share of attention assigned to visual tokens. To reduce both errors, we propose CAR (Coverage selection and Attention Reallocation), a token pruning framework that restores attention share while maintaining information. Specifically, to minimize the summary error, whose upper bound tightens as the retained tokens better cover all visual tokens, our coverage selection retains tokens that are both salient and non-redundant, with saliency from encoder heads chosen by a label-free probe. To minimize the allocation error, our attention reallocation reassigns the attention of the discarded tokens to the retained ones through a closed-form logit bias. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B with $90\%$ of the visual tokens pruned, CAR retains $93.0\%$ of the unpruned accuracy on visual question answering (VQA) and $77.9\%$ on VG, against $26.5\%$ for the best existing method on VG; the logit bias alone raises the VG accuracy of existing methods by up to $24$ points. Experiments on multiple MLLMs across VQA, VG and video understanding show that CAR generalizes well and consistently outperforms existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 CAR 视觉 token 剪枝框架，通过"覆盖选择 + 注意力重分配"分别降低剪枝引起的图像摘要误差与注意力分配误差，在90%剪枝率下显著优于现有方法，尤其视觉定位任务。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉 token 剪枝在激进剪枝下性能显著下降，尤其是视觉定位（VG）任务；作者希望从解码层输出偏移的角度解释这种退化来源，并据此设计更稳健的剪枝方法。
AI.method: 将剪枝引起的解码层输出偏移闭式分解为"图像摘要误差"（视觉信息丢失）与"注意力分配误差"（视觉 token 注意力份额下降）两项。为降低摘要误差（其上界随保留 token 对全体视觉 token 的覆盖度提高而收紧），采用覆盖选择：保留既显著又非冗余的 token，显著性由免标签探针挑选的编码器注意力头给出；为降低分配误差，采用注意力重分配：通过闭式 logit bias 将丢弃 token 的注意力重新分配给保留 token。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上剪除 90% 视觉 token 时，CAR 保留 VQA 未剪枝精度的 93.0%、VG 的 77.9%（最佳现有方法 VG 仅 26.5%）；单独的 logit bias 可将现有方法 VG 精度提升最多 24 个百分点。在多个 MLLM 上跨 VQA、VG 与视频理解的实验显示其泛化性好且一致优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 剪枝退化可归结为摘要误差与分配误差两部分，二者均可通过覆盖选择与注意力重分配有效缓解；CAR 在激进剪枝下保持高精度，且注意力重分配机制可即插即用地提升其他剪枝方法。

title: Attention Latent Feedback
summary: During autoregressive decoding, the deeper representations of the previous token have already been computed, yet shallow layers at the current token cannot read them directly because standard self-attention connects positions only at the same depth. We introduce Attention Latent Feedback (ALF), an architecture that allows every sublayer to attend to the outputs of the deeper layers at the previous position. Training unrolls this cross-position recurrence into two parallel passes, whereas decoding remains single-pass using cached previous-token states. Across mixture-of-experts models with up to 4.0B parameters, ALF lowers held-out loss by 0.022-0.024 nats over the standard residual with about 1.1% decoding FLOP overhead, and consistently outperforms prior final-state feedback across all three scales on both standard and attention residual backbones. On MoE-1.6B, ALF matches a $1.38\times$ larger baseline token budget, and on MoE-4.0B it lifts average accuracy across seventeen downstream benchmarks from 45.1% to 47.0%. Analysis further reveals that intermediate and nearby deeper layers drive most of this benefit, allowing a fixed nearest-window variant to retain 89%-94% of the gain at linear read cost while learned attention widens its margin with scale.

AI.tldr: 提出 Attention Latent Feedback (ALF)：允许每个子层关注上一位置更深层的表示，训练时展开为两条并行通路，解码时仍单遍，仅带来约1.1% FLOP 开销。
AI.motivation: 自回归解码时，上一 token 的深层表示已算好，但当前 token 的浅层因标准自注意力只在同层深度连接位置而无法直接读取这些信息，存在表示复用不足的问题。
AI.method: ALF 让每个子层对前一位置更深层的输出做注意力；训练时将跨位置递归展开为两次并行前向以保持可训练性，推理时利用缓存的上一 token 状态保持单遍解码。实验覆盖 MoE-0.4B/1.6B/4.0B，比较标准残差与注意力残差骨干，并与先前 final-state feedback 方法对比；另做层级贡献分析与固定最近窗口变体。
AI.result: held-out loss 相对标准残差降低 0.022–0.024 nats，解码额外 FLOP 约 1.1%；三种规模上均优于 final-state feedback；MoE-1.6B 上相当于 1.38 倍 token 预算的基线；MoE-4.0B 上十七个下游基准平均准确率由 45.1% 提升至 47.0%。分析显示中间层与邻近深层贡献主要收益，固定最近窗口变体在近线性读取成本下保留 89%–94% 的增益。
AI.conclusion: 跨位置、跨深度的潜状态反馈是低成本且可扩展的增益来源；收益主要来自邻近深层，可退化为廉价固定窗口实现，且学习式注意力随规模增大优势更明显。

title: STAGE: Structured Test-Time Adaptation with Global Entropic Soft-coupling for Cross-Subject Brain-to-Image Retrieval
comment: 38 pages, including the main paper and appendix
summary: Cross-subject brain-to-image retrieval aims to identify viewed images from unseen subjects' brain signals. However, inter-subject variability hinders alignment of brain-image representations, while independent query ranking tends to concentrate predictions on a few candidates, making accurate retrieval difficult without target labels. We propose STAGE (Structured Test-Time Adaptation with Global Entropic Soft-coupling), a structured test-time adaptation framework for recovering cross-subject alignment from uncertain brain-image correspondences. Moment calibration reduces statistical discrepancies between features, while coupling-weighted initialization establishes initial alignment. Coupling-guided adaptation further refines residual feature mismatches, and soft-coupling ranking coordinates candidate competition across queries to prevent overly concentrated matching assignments. Using only unlabeled target batches, STAGE maintains consistent matching from feature calibration to image retrieval while keeping both encoders frozen. Experiments on three public datasets validate STAGE's retrieval performance. On THINGS-EEG2, STAGE achieves 68.25% Top-1 and 90.47% Top-5, improving Top-1 by 18.52 percentage points over SCORE recovery and CSLS on identical frozen NICE features. Calibrated on 200 queries and a 200-image gallery covering their identities, STAGE retains 42.05% Top-1 when ranking 1,854 images with the transform frozen.

AI.tldr: STAGE：面向跨被试脑到图像检索的结构化测试时自适应框架，仅用无标签目标批次即可恢复大脑-图像特征对齐，THINGS-EEG2 上取得 68.25% Top-1。
AI.motivation: 跨被试脑信号到图像检索旨在从未见被试的脑信号中识别其所观看到的图像，但存在两大障碍：一是被试间差异导致大脑表征与图像表征难以对齐；二是独立查询排序会使预测集中在少数候选上，在无目标标签时检索精度受限。
AI.method: 提出 STAGE（结构化测试时自适应 + 全局熵软耦合）框架，包含四个环节：(1) 矩校准（moment calibration）缩小特征间统计差异；(2) 耦合加权初始化建立初始对齐；(3) 耦合引导自适应进一步修正残余特征错配；(4) 软耦合排序协调各查询间的候选竞争，抑制匹配分配过度集中。方法仅利用无标签目标批次，冻结两个编码器，保持从特征校准到图像检索的匹配一致性。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集上验证了检索性能。THINGS-EEG2 上达 68.25% Top-1、90.47% Top-5，在相同冻结 NICE 特征下，相较 SCORE 恢复与 CSLS 组合的 Top-1 提升 18.52 个百分点。以 200 条查询及覆盖其身份的 200 幅图像库完成校准后，在冻结变换、对 1,854 幅图像排序时仍保持 42.05% Top-1。
AI.conclusion: STAGE 通过结构化测试时自适应与软耦合排序，在无标签、编码器冻结条件下有效缓解被试间差异与排序集中问题，显著提升跨被试脑到图像检索性能，并具备向大规模图库的泛化能力。

title: Precision-Aware Learning Rate Transfer Across Block Count in LLM Post-Training
summary: The post-training of pretrained large language models, including supervised finetuning (SFT), direct preference optimization (DPO), and reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR), is very sensitive to the learning rate, and tuning it through grid search is costly in both computation and memory. In this work, we propose \textbf{TipSweep}, a method to transfer the learning rate across the number of trainable transformer blocks. To do so efficiently, we search for the best learning rate by training only the last $k_0$ blocks (in our experiments, typically $k_0=1$), and provide scaling rules that predict the optimal learning rate when training any set of $k$ blocks, including when $k=L$ (the full transformer). Across experiments with models ranging from 1 to 7 billion parameters, we observe that the optimal learning rate follows precision-dependent scaling rules: the optimal rate scales approximately as $k^{-1}$ with float32 (FP32) master weights, but as $k^{-1/2}$ when updates are applied directly to bfloat16 (BF16) weights without a master copy. We explain both rules using an analytical model that accounts for update rounding, under assumptions supported by profiling experiments. Finally, we develop two prototypes of the learning rate search for a 6.7-billion-parameter model. The first fits the search on a single consumer GPU with 16 GiB of memory. The second speeds up the search on a high-end GPU by evaluating all candidate learning rates in a single pass over the data, so that a five-candidate search takes about half the GPU hours of one full-depth ($k=L$) run.

AI.tldr: 提出 TipSweep：仅训练最后 k₀ 个 block 搜索学习率，再用缩放规则外推至训练任意 k 个 block（含全模型），实现低成本学习率迁移。
AI.motivation: LLM 后训练（SFT、DPO、RLVR）对学习率高度敏感，而网格搜索调参在算力与显存上代价高昂，亟需低成本确定最优学习率的方法。
AI.method: 只在最后 k₀ 个 transformer block（通常 k₀=1）上训练以搜索学习率，并给出预测训练任意 k 个 block 时最优学习率（含 k=L 全深度）的缩放规则；通过考虑更新舍入的解析模型解释 FP32 主权重下约 k⁻¹、BF16 直接更新下约 k⁻¹ᐟ² 的精度相关规律，并在 1B–7B 模型上验证；另实现两种搜索原型。
AI.result: 在 1B–7B 参数模型上观察到最优学习率随精度呈现不同缩放律：FP32 主权重约 k⁻¹，BF16 直接更新约 k⁻¹ᐟ²，解析模型与 profiling 结果一致。6.7B 模型上的两个原型：一个可在 16 GiB 单张消费级 GPU 上完成搜索；另一个在高性能 GPU 上单次数据遍历同时评估所有候选学习率，5 个候选取值约需一次全深度（k=L）运行的一半 GPU 小时。
AI.conclusion: 学习率可跨可训练 block 数量迁移，TipSweep 以极小代价获得近似全深度训练的最优学习率，显著降低后训练调参成本。

title: Seeing vs. Knowing: Counterfactual Supervision and Correction for 3D-Aware Object Editing
summary: Rotating, translating, or rescaling an object in a photograph requires revealing unseen surfaces, preserving visible appearance, and updating shadows and reflections. Reconstructed 3D assets, rendered at the target pose as a 3D state, provide explicit geometric guidance, but their imperfect textures may conflict with the photograph, while standard paired training does not explicitly teach the editor which source to trust. To address this, we propose counterfactual state supervision, which constructs controlled photo--state conflicts through hidden-surface repainting, hidden geometry with re-rendered shadows and reflections, and visible-surface texture replacement. This teaches the editor to follow the 3D state for unseen content while preserving photograph-visible appearance. However, learning this distinction does not ensure that it is maintained during sampling. We therefore introduce symmetric counterfactual correction, which uses state-side and photo-side twins, which share the photograph and the state respectively, to construct directed latent perturbations toward condition-inconsistent targets and train recovery toward the target specified by the current condition. Both strategies operate only during training, requiring no architectural changes or additional inference steps. Experiments on OBJect and SpatialEdit-Bench demonstrate strong spatial editing performance and content preservation, while controlled ablations show improved source selection and sustained responsiveness to conditioning during sampling.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对图像中物体的旋转/平移/缩放编辑任务，提出"反事实状态监督"与"对称反事实校正"两种仅训练期使用的策略，使编辑模型在未见区域遵循3D状态、在可见区域保留照片外观，并在采样过程中维持该区分能力。
AI.motivation: 对照片中物体做旋转、平移或缩放，需要生成未见表面、保持可见外观一致，并更新阴影与反射。以目标姿态渲染的重建3D资产（3D state）能提供显式几何引导，但其纹理不完美会与照片冲突；而标准成对训练并未显式教会编辑器在照片与3D状态冲突时该信任哪一方。此外，即便模型学到了这种区分，也无法保证在采样（推理）过程中持续维持。
AI.method: 1）反事实状态监督：通过隐藏表面重绘、隐藏几何重渲染（含阴影与反射）、可见表面纹理替换三种手段，人为构造受控的"照片—状态"冲突，教导模型在未见内容上服从3D状态、在可见外观上遵循照片。2）对称反事实校正：构造状态侧与照片侧的孪生样本（分别共享照片与共享状态），生成朝条件不一致目标的有向潜空间扰动，并训练模型按当前条件指定的目标进行恢复，从而在采样中保持对条件的响应性。两策略均仅在训练阶段使用，无需改网络结构或增加推理步数。
AI.result: 在OBJect与SpatialEdit-Bench上取得较强的空间编辑性能与内容保持效果；受控消融实验表明，源选择能力提升，且采样过程中对条件的响应性得以持续。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练期注入受控冲突与对称反事实扰动，可在不增加推理开销的前提下解决"照片与3D状态冲突时的信任分配"问题，并保证该区分在采样阶段不退化，为基于3D状态引导的空间图像编辑提供了有效方案。

title: EEG Decoding in Context: A Framework for Tuning-Free EEG Foundation Models
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) decoding is a central route toward brain-computer interfaces for communication, rehabilitation, cognitive assessment, and neurological monitoring. Recent EEG foundation models have substantially advanced reusable signal representations, but their downstream use still typically requires a task-specific decoder, gradient-based adaptation, and validation-driven model selection. We investigate a complementary foundation-model paradigm based on in-context learning: labeled EEG recordings define the decoding task as context, and new recordings are predicted without updating model parameters. We first pair raw EEG features with a pretrained general-purpose in-context predictor. This direct formulation provides a promising starting point, but its performance remains limited and unstable and does not generalize reliably across EEG paradigms. We find that suitable context construction can address these limitations by improving the effective signal-to-noise ratio and exposing temporal and spatial structure. Building on this insight, we introduce a general framework that combines EEG-specific context construction with a frozen in-context predictor and a metric-based context adaptation mechanism, which matches each downstream task to an appropriate context representation without relying on validation data. Across ten datasets spanning seven EEG decoding paradigms, our method achieves the highest mean BAcc among eleven specialized and fine-tuned EEG baselines, without task-specific parameter updates or validation-based model selection. This framework provides a practical path toward tuning-free EEG foundation models in which adaptation is expressed through context rather than parameter updates.

AI.tldr: 提出无参数更新的脑电（EEG）上下文学习框架：以EEG特定上下文构建+冻结的上下文预测器+基于度量的上下文适配，在10个数据集、7种范式中取得最高平均平衡准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG基础模型虽提升了可复用表征，但下游使用仍依赖任务特定解码器、梯度微调和基于验证集的模型选择，流程沉重且不通用。作者希望探索一种互补范式——上下文学习（in-context learning），用带标签EEG片段定义任务上下文，对新记录直接预测而无需更新参数。
AI.method: 先将原始EEG特征直接输入预训练通用上下文预测器（直接式方案，作为起点）；分析发现其性能有限、不稳定、跨范式泛化差。据此提出框架：(1) EEG特定上下文构建，提高有效信噪比并显式暴露时间与空间结构；(2) 冻结的上下文预测器；(3) 基于度量的上下文适配机制，为每个下游任务匹配合适上下文表征，无需验证数据。
AI.result: 在覆盖7种EEG解码范式的10个数据集上，该方法在11个专用/微调EEG基线中取得最高平均平衡准确率（BAcc），且不使用任务特定参数更新与基于验证集的模型选择。
AI.conclusion: 上下文构建是释放通用上下文预测器用于EEG解码的关键；该框架给出了一条实用的免调优EEG基础模型路径，即适配通过上下文表达而非参数更新。

title: SCRA-CLIP: Spherical-Contextual Representation Adaptation for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
summary: Recent advances in vision-language models have facilitated zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) through transferable visual-semantic representations. However, detecting fine-grained anomalies remains challenging due to inadequate modeling of diverse anomaly patterns and their spatial context. To address these challenges, we propose SCRA-CLIP, a Spherical-Contextual Representation Adaptation framework that jointly enhances anomaly-aware textual semantics and context-sensitive visual representations. Specifically, we introduce Spherical Prototype-Conditioned Prompting (SPCP), which employs von Mises--Fisher mixtures to model the directional distributions of normal and abnormal patch features. These state-specific prototypes are incorporated into textual contexts to guide the learning of more discriminative textual representations. Furthermore, we develop Context-Deviation Guided Visual Adaptation (CGVA), which captures local feature deviations relative to multi-scale neighborhood contexts and refines patch representations through adaptive gating. By integrating distribution-aware semantic modeling with context-sensitive visual adaptation, SCRA-CLIP facilitates more discriminative cross-modal matching for fine-grained anomaly detection and localization. Extensive experiments on 11 industrial and medical benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization capability of SCRA-CLIP across diverse unseen categories and domains. The code will be publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出 SCRA-CLIP，通过球面原型条件提示与上下文偏差引导的视觉适配，联合增强文本语义与视觉表征，实现细粒度零样本异常检测与定位。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型虽支持零样本异常检测，但对多样异常模式及其空间上下文的建模不足，导致细粒度异常检测仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 包含两个模块：(1) SPCP（球面原型条件提示），用 von Mises–Fisher 混合模型刻画正常/异常 patch 特征的方向分布，将状态特定原型注入文本上下文以学习更具判别力的文本表征；(2) CGVA（上下文偏差引导的视觉适配），捕获 patch 相对多尺度邻域上下文的局部特征偏差，并通过自适应门控精炼 patch 表征。
AI.result: 在 11 个工业与医学基准上验证了有效性，在多样未见类别与跨域场景下展现出良好泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将分布感知的语义建模与上下文敏感的视觉适配相结合，可提升跨模态匹配的判别性，从而改善细粒度异常检测与定位性能。

title: Learning Neurovascular Codes for EEG-to-fMRI Synthesis
summary: In this paper, we introduce Neurovascular Codes as shared EEG representations for fMRI generation. We first train a separate EEG encoder to predict each fMRI signal, learning target-specific temporal and spectral features from the same EEG window. After training, we freeze the encoders and project their concatenated hidden features into a shared neurovascular code. Conditioned on this code, stochastic interpolant transforms Gaussian noise into a vector of fMRI signals, allowing different responses to be sampled for the same EEG window. We evaluate our approach on eight public simultaneous EEG-fMRI datasets, including four resting-state and four task-based datasets with 61,646 volume-level pairs. Under within-subject and held-out-subject evaluation, our model improves average Pearson correlation over the strongest encoder baselines by 19.1% and 19.8%, respectively. The corresponding improvements over the strongest generator baselines are 18.8% and 47.9%. Beyond reconstruction accuracy, we also evaluate the generated signals using subject-identification classifiers trained on real fMRI. Our method achieves the highest mean accuracy among the evaluated generators. We hope that our work opens up new opportunities for cross-modal brain modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出"神经血管码"（Neurovascular Codes）作为共享EEG表征用于fMRI生成，在八个同步EEG-fMRI数据集上显著提升重建相关性并具备更好的受试者可辨识性。
AI.motivation: EEG廉价、高时间分辨率，fMRI空间分辨率高但采集昂贵，从EEG生成fMRI有望实现低成本跨模态脑建模；核心难点在于同一EEG窗口与多个fMRI信号存在一对多映射关系，需要一种既能刻画目标特异性特征、又能支持随机采样的共享表征。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：先为每个fMRI目标单独训练EEG编码器，从同一EEG窗口学习目标特定的时域与频域特征；训练后冻结编码器，将其拼接隐特征投影为共享神经血管码；以该码为条件，用随机插值变换（stochastic interpolant）把高斯噪声映射为fMRI信号向量，从而对同一EEG窗口采样多样响应。评估覆盖8个公开同步采集数据集（4静息态、4任务态，共61,646个体积级配对），并开展受试者内与留出受试者两种设置。
AI.result: 相较最强编码器基线，平均Pearson相关在受试者内与留出受试者设置下分别提升19.1%和19.8%；相较最强生成器基线分别提升18.8%和47.9%。在基于真实fMRI训练的受试者识别分类器评估中，本方法在参评生成器中取得最高平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: 共享神经血管码兼顾目标特异性与生成多样性，在跨数据集、跨受试者条件下均优于编码器与生成器基线，为跨模态脑建模提供了新思路。

title: Align the Pair, Not the Sample: Representation Alignment for Faster and Better One-Step Generato
summary: Representation alignment markedly accelerates diffusion training, but one-step generators raise a question that diffusion does not: \emph{which training path should receive the loss?} A one-step generator sees two kinds of inputs. Corrupted real images come with their clean counterpart, which provides an instance-paired target. Samples generated from pure noise have no corresponding real image, yet this is where the final model operates. We study this question on Priming, which trains one-step generators from scratch by reconstructing corrupted images and then matching feature distributions with optimal transport. Aligning the generative path, the natural choice, collapses recall ($0.45\!\to\!0.15$--$0.25$) in all 17 configurations we test, including five target constructions and loss weights down to $0.05$. Aligning the paired reconstruction path with a frozen DINOv2 encoder instead helps in every setting we test. A short analysis explains this asymmetry: when the target carries no instance information about the input, the optimal aligned feature is constant within each class, so the loss pulls samples toward class prototypes. A control confirms this: aligning the paired path to a random same-class image instead of the input's own image removes most of the gain. Inside the generator, paired-path alignment creates an interface block through which post-training routes noise, and the image semantics carried through it predict sample quality across 16 models. The resulting recipe, \method, accelerates \emph{both} training stages on ImageNet $256\!\times\!256$: it matches the 160-epoch baseline with $2\times$ fewer priming epochs, surpasses its final quality with $4\times$ fewer post-training updates, and lowers FID to 1.30 (B) and 1.155 (L) at the standard budget. A joint single-stage variant trains native one-step generators and reaches FID 1.22 with 115M parameters.

AI.tldr: 研究一步生成器中"表征对齐损失应施加于哪条训练路径"，发现对齐生成路径会导致召回崩塌，而对齐配对重建路径（冻结DINOv2）在各设定下均有增益，据此提出加速两阶段训练的配方，ImageNet 256×256 上FID降至1.30(B)/1.155(L)。
AI.motivation: 表征对齐能显著加速扩散训练，但一步生成器引入扩散模型不存在的问题：损失应对齐哪条训练路径？生成器有两类输入——带干净对应图像（有实例配对目标）的损坏真实图像，以及无对应真实图像、但恰恰是最终部署时使用的纯噪声样本。需要系统的实证与理论解释来回答该问题。
AI.method: 以 Priming（先从零训练一步生成器做损坏图像重建，再用最优传输做特征分布匹配）为研究平台，在17种配置（5种目标构造、损失权重低至0.05）下对比"对齐生成路径"与"用冻结DINOv2编码器对齐配对重建路径"。理论上证明：当对齐目标不携带输入的实例信息时，最优对齐特征在每个类别内为常数，损失将样本拉向类原型。并以"将对齐目标换成同类别随机图像而非输入自身图像"作为控制实验。进一步分析生成器内部形成"接口模块"，后训练阶段噪声经由该模块路由，其所携带的图像语义可预测样本质量（跨16个模型验证）。
AI.result: 对齐生成路径在全部17种配置下均使召回率崩塌（0.45→0.15–0.25）；对齐配对重建路径则在所有设定中带来增益。控制实验证实：将配对路径对齐到同类随机图像会消除大部分收益。接口模块承载的语义可预测16个模型的样本质量。ImageNet 256×256 上，方法以1/2的priming轮数匹配160轮基线，以1/4的后训练更新超越其最终质量；标准预算下FID为1.30(B)、1.155(L)；单阶段联合变体在115M参数下达到FID 1.22。
AI.conclusion: 一步生成器中的表征对齐应施加于实例配对的损坏—重建路径而非纯噪声生成路径；实例信息缺失会诱导类别原型坍缩并损害召回。该不对称性由类别内常数最优解的解析论证与控制实验共同支持，并由此得到同时加速两阶段训练的统一配方。

title: Matching Under Metric Privacy
summary: We study how to represent and randomize points in $d$-dimensional Euclidean space to obtain accurate bipartite matchings under metric privacy. Given $n$ private and $n$ public points, we analyze local mechanisms that randomize each private point or its distances to the public points. Using the public points' affine span, we construct a smaller representation that preserves all matching costs. When a trusted server receives the private points, we establish privacy and utility guarantees for Gumbel matching, which randomizes edge costs and releases only the assignment. Through upper bounds and worst-case constructions, we establish the tight rate $Θ\!\left(n\min\{d,\log n\}/\varepsilon\right)$ for expected cost above the nonprivate optimum. Benchmark experiments support $d\approx\log n$ as a practical guide to the transition between directly randomizing point coordinates and using Gumbel matching. Extensions to squared Euclidean costs enable private nonparametric two-sample hypothesis testing. These results show how the application's trust model guides representation and dimension choices for better utility: under local privacy, low-dimensional point representations reduce excess cost, while under central privacy, distance representations achieve the optimal rate even in high dimension.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在度量隐私下如何表示与随机化d维欧氏空间中的点以获得准确二分匹配，给出Gumbel匹配在中心化信任模型下的紧致超额代价率Θ(n·min{d, log n}/ε)，并揭示信任模型如何决定表示与维度选择。
AI.motivation: 二分匹配是常见应用（如分配、检索），但点坐标或距离含隐私信息。已有工作缺乏对"如何表示点（坐标 vs 距离）"与"随机化机制"在局部/中心信任模型下的系统性效用-隐私分析，也缺少对维度d与隐私预算ε如何影响匹配超额代价的紧致刻画。
AI.method: (1) 利用公开点集的仿射张成构造保留全部匹配代价的更小表示；(2) 分析对每个私有点或其到公开点距离进行随机化的局部机制；(3) 在可信服务器接收私有点的中心化设定下，提出Gumbel匹配——对边代价加Gumbel噪声、仅发布分配结果；(4) 通过上界分析与最坏情形构造给出超额代价的匹配界；(5) 基准实验验证d≈log n作为坐标直接随机化与Gumbel匹配之间的转变阈值；(6) 扩展到平方欧氏代价以支持私有非参数两样本假设检验。
AI.result: Gumbel匹配在中心化隐私下相对于非私有最优解的超额期望代价满足紧致速率Θ(n·min{d, log n}/ε)；局部隐私下低维点表示可降低超额代价；距离表示在高维下仍可达最优速率。实验支持d≈log n的实践性转折点。
AI.conclusion: 隐私信任模型应指导表示与维度选择：局部隐私下宜采用低维点表示以减少超额代价，中心化隐私下距离表示即使在高维也达到最优速率；平方欧氏代价的扩展使私有非参数两样本检验成为可能。

title: Inspect Before You Decide: Evidence-Guided Visual Search for Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential for industrial anomaly detection and understanding. However, reliably identifying subtle anomalies remains challenging, as existing approaches often struggle to acquire and verify fine-grained visual evidence beyond global observations. To address this challenge, we propose EVAD, an evidence-guided visual search framework that enables MLLMs to actively seek and examine diagnostically informative visual evidence for reliable anomaly reasoning. Specifically, EVAD begins with a global visual assessment to identify potentially anomalous regions for further inspection. Building upon this observation, we introduce a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-guided exploration strategy that progressively acquires visual evidence through two complementary operations: semantic refinement for fine-grained inspection and spatial expansion for contextual verification. The acquired evidence is subsequently evaluated and integrated to support more informed and reliable anomaly decisions. Extensive experiments across multiple industrial anomaly detection tasks demonstrate that EVAD achieves state-of-the-art performance in most evaluated settings, highlighting the effectiveness of active evidence exploration for fine-grained anomaly understanding and reasoning. The code will be publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: EVAD 是一个证据引导的视觉搜索框架，使多模态大模型通过主动获取并验证细粒度视觉证据来完成工业异常检测与推理，在多数设置下达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 方法依赖全局观察，难以获取并验证细粒度视觉证据，导致细微异常难以可靠识别。
AI.method: 先做全局视觉评估定位可疑区域；再用 MCTS 引导的探索策略逐步采集证据，包含语义细化（细粒度检查）与空间扩展（上下文验证）两种互补操作；最后对采集到的证据进行评估与整合，支持异常判定。
AI.result: 在多个工业异常检测任务的广泛实验中，EVAD 在大多数评估设置下取得 SOTA 性能。
AI.conclusion: 主动式证据探索对细粒度异常理解与推理有效；代码将在论文发表后公开。

title: Agentic AI for Intent Management and Control in Autonomous Communication Networks
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Communications Magazine
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven automation will help future mobile networks translate high-level network intents into concrete network optimization or control actions. However, existing approaches often focus on intent management and orchestration, leaving the adaptation of underlying network optimization and control functions largely unaddressed. This article proposes a triadic agentic AI framework that co-designs intent management and intent fulfillment through three agents: an interpreter, powered by a language model, that translates and refines intents into machine-readable optimization templates; an optimizer that adapts controller policies to intent specifications; and a controller that performs fast decision-making. We discuss the design space of each agent and how the workflow can be embedded across network architectural domains. Finally, we develop a concrete realization combining a language-model interpreter with Bayesian optimization for the optimizer and multi-objective reinforcement learning for the controller, and evaluate it in a radio resource management case study for differentiated connectivity. Results demonstrate how the agentic AI framework can connect high-level intents with runtime network control, showing adaptability of intent specifications and control policies to service requirements and changing network conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种三元智能体（triadic agentic AI）框架，通过解释器、优化器和控制器三个智能体协同设计意图管理与意图履行，并用语言模型解释器+贝叶斯优化+多目标强化学习的实例在无线资源管理场景下验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI驱动的网络自动化研究主要聚焦于意图管理与编排层面，而对底层网络优化与控制功能如何适配意图规格缺乏关注，导致高层意图与运行时网络控制之间存在断层。
AI.method: 提出三元智能体框架：1）解释器（interpreter），基于语言模型将意图翻译并精炼为机器可读的优化模板；2）优化器（optimizer），依据意图规格自适应调整控制器策略；3）控制器（controller），执行快速决策。文中讨论各智能体的设计空间及工作流在不同网络架构域中的嵌入方式，并给出具体实现：语言模型解释器+贝叶斯优化器+多目标强化学习控制器，在差异化连接的无线资源管理案例中评估。
AI.result: 案例结果表明，该框架能够将高层意图与运行时网络控制有效衔接，意图规格与控制策略可随服务需求和网络条件变化而自适应调整。
AI.conclusion: 三元智能体AI框架通过意图管理与意图履行的协同设计，弥补了意图驱动网络中底层优化控制适配的空白，为实现端到端的意图驱动网络自动化提供了可行路径。

title: GravHMR: Coupling SLAM and Human Mesh Recovery in a Shared Gravity Frame
summary: Recovering globally consistent 3D human motion from monocular videos remains challenging under dynamic camera motion. Although SLAM and human mesh recovery (HMR) provide complementary camera and body estimates, directly combining them often leads to inconsistent orientations and accumulated trajectory drift. We present GravHMR, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that couples SLAM and HMR through a shared gravity-aligned reference. By allowing gravity to be estimated independently of the HMR backbone, GravHMR accommodates world-grounded HMR models with or without explicit gravity-view representations. Specifically, Yaw-Aware Orientation Optimization (YAOO) resolves heading inconsistencies by correcting body and velocity orientations about the shared gravity axis. Conditioned on these corrected orientations, Gravity-Aware Trajectory Optimization (GATO) anchors root trajectories in the metric SLAM world by jointly leveraging 2D reprojection, the metric scale implicit in the human body, and the body's own motion. On EMDB-2, GravHMR achieves state-of-the-art performance with 154.0 mm W-MPJPE100 using ViPE and 189.8 mm using masked DROID-SLAM, outperforming TRAM (222.4 mm) under the same masked DROID-SLAM camera estimates. It further reduces W-MPJPE100 by 44.3% over GVHMR (276.5 mm) and by 20.0% over GVHMR + HTD-Refine (192.4 mm) with the same HMR backbone.

AI.tldr: GravHMR：一种免训练、即插即用的框架，通过共享的重力对齐参考系耦合SLAM与人体网格恢复（HMR），解决单目视频动态相机下的全局一致3D人体运动恢复问题，在EMDB-2上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 动态相机下的单目视频全局一致3D人体运动恢复仍具挑战。SLAM提供相机估计、HMR提供人体估计，二者互补，但直接结合常导致朝向不一致与轨迹漂移累积。
AI.method: 提出GravHMR，免训练、即插即用，以共享重力对齐参考系耦合SLAM与HMR；重力估计独立于HMR主干，从而兼容有/无显式重力视角表示的世界坐标HMR模型。包含两个模块：(1) Yaw-Aware Orientation Optimization (YAOO)，绕共享重力轴校正人体与速度朝向，解决航向不一致；(2) Gravity-Aware Trajectory Optimization (GATO)，在YAOO校正朝向条件下，联合利用2D重投影、人体隐含的度量尺度与人体自身运动，将根轨迹锚定在度量SLAM世界中。
AI.result: EMDB-2上，ViPE相机下W-MPJPE100达154.0 mm；masked DROID-SLAM下为189.8 mm，优于同相机估计下的TRAM（222.4 mm）；同一HMR主干下，较GVHMR（276.5 mm）降低44.3%，较GVHMR + HTD-Refine（192.4 mm）降低20.0%。
AI.conclusion: 以重力对齐参考系作为SLAM与HMR的耦合中介，可有效消除朝向不一致与轨迹漂移，且免训练、即插即用、与HMR主干解耦，具备良好通用性。

title: How Far Can Linear Go? BiPert, a Unified Framework for Single-Cell Perturbation Modelling
summary: Understanding how genetic perturbations affect cellular behaviour is essential for studying gene function and regulatory mechanisms. Large-scale CRISPR screens measure these effects across thousands of genes, but cover relatively few cellular contexts. Predicting perturbation responses in unseen cell types and identifying perturbed genes from their transcriptional effects therefore remain challenging. Here, we show that both tasks can be addressed through a common linear decomposition of transcriptional responses into shared and perturbation-specific components. Building on this principle, we introduce BiPert, a simple linear framework for both forward perturbation prediction and inverse identification. For forward prediction, BiPert outperforms existing methods that use no external biological knowledge when predicting gene expression changes in unseen cell lines. Its few-shot extension, BiPert-FS, adapts to new cell lines using as few as ten measured perturbations. For inverse identification, BiPert-ID identifies perturbed genes from single-cell expression profiles, outperforming deep-learning methods in unseen cell lines and donors. We further show that perturbations whose effects transfer more consistently across cellular contexts are also easier to identify, even after controlling for perturbation effect size. Together, these results establish a connection between perturbation transfer and identification, and demonstrate that simple linear models provide strong, interpretable baselines for both tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出线性分解框架BiPert，将转录响应分解为共享成分与扰动特异成分，统一实现正向扰动预测（BiPert、BiPert-FS）与反向扰动识别（BiPert-ID），并在未见细胞系/供体中优于现有无外部知识方法及深度学习方法。
AI.motivation: 大规模CRISPR筛选虽能测量数千基因的扰动效应，但覆盖的细胞背景有限，导致在未见细胞类型中预测扰动响应、以及从转录效应反推受扰动基因这两项任务仍然困难。
AI.method: 发现两类任务可统一为对转录响应的线性分解：共享成分＋扰动特异成分；据此构建简单线性框架BiPert。正向预测用BiPert，少量样本扩展版BiPert-FS仅需约10个已测扰动即适配新细胞系；反向识别用BiPert-ID，从单细胞表达谱推断受扰动基因。
AI.result: 正向预测中，BiPert在未见细胞系的基因表达变化预测上优于不使用外部生物学知识的方法，BiPert-FS仅用十个扰动即可适配新细胞系；反向识别中，BiPert-ID在未见细胞系与供体上优于深度学习方法。此外发现扰动效应跨背景迁移一致性越高，其可识别性越强，即使控制扰动效应大小后仍成立。
AI.conclusion: 建立了扰动迁移性与可识别性之间的联系，表明简单线性模型可作为两项任务强有力且可解释的基线。
