AI.result: 在三个流式视频基准上，MORSE在每个"冻结骨干"对比组内均取得最高答案准确率。OVO-Bench上基于Qwen3-VL-8B的harness平均0.30秒/查询，准确率75.1%，较使用同一冻结骨干的次优harness高3.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将递归自我改进从"闭集工具内的重写"扩展为"失败驱动的开放世界方法检索"，可在不训练骨干模型的前提下显著提升流式视频记忆系统的问答质量与效率；"先质量、后效率（容差约束）"的验证选择策略能有效兼顾两者。

title: FlexGaze: Weakly Supervised Gaze Estimation at Scale
comment: 23 pages, including 12 pages of supplementary material
summary: Most gaze estimation models are trained on data collected using specialized equipment. The limited diversity of subjects, scenes, and head poses in these datasets hinders generalization to new conditions. We present FlexGaze, a family of 3D gaze estimators pretrained with weak supervision from gaze labels (pseudo-labels) automatically generated from in-the-wild images. We use off-the-shelf models to predict 2D gaze targets and scene depth, then combine these predictions to generate 3D gaze labels for approximately 3.24 million head instances. At inference, FlexGaze predicts gaze from a head crop alone and can handle profile and rear views without requiring face detection or head pose estimation. We use data augmentation during training to improve robustness to variations in crop position and scale. Pretrained using only these generated gaze labels, FlexGaze generalizes to unseen benchmarks. After supervised fine-tuning on public gaze datasets, we evaluate FlexGaze on eight benchmarks under a unified evaluation protocol. Our models match or outperform publicly available gaze estimators with several times as many parameters on most benchmarks. We release our dataset of generated gaze labels, all trained models, and code via https://github.com/ihp-lab/FlexGaze.

AI.tldr: FlexGaze是一族基于弱监督（伪标签）预训练的3D视线估计器，可用于单头部件输入并在多基准上匹配或超越参数量数倍于己的公开模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视线估计模型多在专用设备采集的数据上训练，受试者、场景与头姿多样性有限，导致对新条件的泛化能力差。
AI.method: 利用现成模型预测2D视线目标与场景深度，二者结合自动生成约324万头实例的3D视线伪标签；仅以头部裁剪为输入，无需人脸检测或头姿估计，可处理侧脸与背面视角；训练中使用数据增强提升对裁剪位置与尺度的鲁棒性；先在伪标签上预训练，再在公开数据集上监督微调。
AI.result: 仅用生成标签预训练即可泛化到未见基准；在统一评测协议下的八个基准上，多数任务中匹配或优于参数量数倍于己的公开视线估计器。
AI.conclusion: 弱监督伪标签可有效替代专用设备标注，配合简单头部输入与数据增强即可获得强泛化、轻量的3D视线估计模型；作者开源了伪标签数据集、全部模型与代码。

title: 3AGameFactory-Motion: Agentic Rigging and Reliable Complex Motion Generation for Diverse 3D Assets
summary: Animating arbitrary 3D assets from instructions requires both structural inference and motion control, yet existing motion benchmarks mostly cover conventional human or animal skeletons with simple instructions. We introduce DivDynBench, which evaluates rigging and motion generation across six morphology categories, with instructions requiring multi-phase part coordination and explicit timing, angle, repetition, and trajectory constraints. With large language models, we systematically compare three common paradigms: specialized motion generation, video generation followed by motion recovery, and direct agent-driven generation. We analyze their control capabilities, cross-morphology adaptability, and generation costs. Guided by this comparison, we propose an Agentic Motion Framework in which an agent writes compact parametric skeleton and motion programs, and a deterministic executor performs rigging, kinematic solving, and geometric correction. Compact parameter control reduces generation overhead and improves rigging reliability and motion-control accuracy, providing practical guidance for deploying complex 3D motion generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 DivDynBench 基准，跨六类形态评测指令驱动的绑定与运动生成；系统比较三种范式后提出 Agentic Motion Framework，由智能体输出紧凑参数化骨骼与运动程序、确定性执行器完成绑定与运动学求解，兼顾开销、可靠性与控制精度。
AI.motivation: 从指令驱动任意 3D 资产动画需要结构推断（绑定）与运动控制两方面能力，但现有运动基准多局限于常规人/动物骨架与简单指令，缺乏对多形态、多阶段部件协同及显式时序/角度/重复/轨迹约束的评测。
AI.method: 构建 DivDynBench：覆盖六类形态类别，指令含多阶段部件协同及显式时序、角度、重复次数、轨迹约束；借助大语言模型系统比较三类范式——专用运动生成、视频生成后运动恢复、智能体直接生成，并从控制能力、跨形态适应性、生成成本三方面分析。基于比较结论提出 Agentic Motion Framework：智能体编写紧凑的参数化骨骼与运动程序，确定性执行器负责绑定、运动学求解与几何修正。
AI.result: 三类范式在控制能力、跨形态适应性与生成成本上各有取舍；紧凑参数化控制可降低生成开销，并提升绑定可靠性与运动控制精度。
AI.conclusion: DivDynBench 为复杂 3D 运动生成提供了系统性评测与范式对比，Agentic Motion Framework 验证了"智能体规划+确定性执行"路线的实用价值，为部署复杂 3D 运动生成提供实践指导。

title: ReplaySAM: Zero-Shot 3D Particle-Pack Segmentation with SAM 2
summary: X-ray computed tomography (XCT) provides non-destructive three-dimensional (3D) images of particle packs, making their internal structure accessible for quantitative analysis. Extracting particle-level measurements from these volumes first requires identifying and separating individual particles, a task that remains challenging in dense, irregular packs. Existing workflows often require manual correction or task-specific training, while promptable models need a strategy for automatically locating individual particles and recovering their instance masks. We present ReplaySAM, which adapts the pretrained Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) to three-dimensional particle-pack segmentation without additional training. It generates point prompts from foreground geometry and fuses SAM2 predictions across orthogonal slice sequences to recover particle instances. On XCT volumes of real quartz and iron-ore particle packs, ReplaySAM achieves higher mean instance Dice scores than expert-assisted watershed and nnInteractive under the evaluated protocols. ReplaySAM thus provides a training-free framework for 3D particle-pack instance segmentation, with geometry-based prompting that eliminates manual prompt placement.

AI.tldr: 提出ReplaySAM，一种免训练框架，将预训练的SAM2适配到三维颗粒堆积实例分割，通过几何驱动的点提示与跨正交切片序列预测融合恢复颗粒实例。
AI.motivation: XCT可无损获取颗粒堆积的三维图像，但从中提取颗粒级测量需先识别并分离单个颗粒，这在致密、不规则堆积中仍很困难；现有流程依赖人工修正或任务特定训练，可提示模型也缺乏自动定位颗粒并恢复实例掩码的策略。
AI.method: 基于预训练SAM2，无需额外训练：由前景几何生成点提示，消除人工提示放置；在正交切片序列上运行SAM2，并融合多方向预测以恢复完整颗粒实例。
AI.result: 在真实石英与铁矿石颗粒堆积的XCT体数据上，所评估协议下ReplaySAM的平均实例Dice高于专家辅助的分水岭方法与nnInteractive。
AI.conclusion: ReplaySAM为三维颗粒堆积实例分割提供了免训练框架，其基于几何的提示策略免除了人工提示标注，具备实用性与可迁移性。

title: QSRadar: Query-Conditioned Sparse Radar-Camera Fusion for Efficient 3D Object Detection
comment: Radar-camera fusion, 3D object detection, autonomous driving
summary: Reliable 3D object detection for autonomous trucks requires both the semantic detail provided by cameras and the geometric and motion cues measured by 4D radar. Existing radar-camera detectors commonly construct global radar bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations, whose computational and memory costs grow with the perception range. Sparse query-based detectors offer greater efficiency, but global feature construction can obscure point-level radar geometry and motion information. We present QSRadar, a query-conditioned sparse radar fusion framework for efficient long-range 3D detection. Built on a Sparse4Dv3-style visual-temporal detector, QSRadar retrieves a compact set of raw radar points around each evolving object hypothesis. The selected points are represented in an anchor-aligned coordinate frame, augmented with motion residuals, radar cross section, and sweep timing, and aggregated by a query-conditioned set encoder. Radar neighborhoods are retrieved again after each anchor refinement, coupling evidence selection with object estimation. Under the official MAN TruckScenes validation protocol, QSRadar achieves 38.09 mAP and 52.20 NDS, compared with 37.08 mAP and 50.78 NDS for our reproduced Sparse4D-Radar global Radar-BEV baseline. In matched tests on an RTX 4090 D, QSRadar reduces latency by 45%, peak memory usage by 49%, and GFLOPs by 43%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QSRadar，一种查询条件化的稀疏雷达融合框架，用于自动驾驶卡车的长距离高效3D检测。
AI.motivation: 现有雷达-相机检测器构建全局雷达BEV表示，计算与内存开销随感知范围增长；稀疏查询式检测器虽高效，但全局特征构建会模糊点级雷达几何与运动信息。
AI.method: 基于Sparse4Dv3风格的视觉-时序检测器，在每个演化中的目标假设周围检索少量原始雷达点；将点表示在锚对齐坐标系中，并加入运动残差、RCS和扫描时序信息，由查询条件化的集合编码器聚合；每次锚框精化后重新检索雷达邻域，使证据选择与目标估计耦合。
AI.result: 在MAN TruckScenes官方验证协议下取得38.09 mAP、52.20 NDS，优于复现的Sparse4D-Radar全局Radar-BEV基线（37.08 mAP、50.78 NDS）；RTX 4090 D匹配测试中延迟降低45%、峰值内存降低49%、GFLOPs降低43%。
AI.conclusion: 查询条件化的稀疏雷达点检索可在提升长距离3D检测精度的同时显著降低计算与内存开销，验证了局部点级融合相对全局BEV构建的优越性。

title: Teaching How to Reason, Beyond What to Answer: Evidence-Faithful On-Policy Distillation for streaming video understanding
summary: Moment Retrieval (MR) aims to localize the temporal segment in a video that corresponds to a given textual description. However, a textual query often provides only a sparse semantic description of the target event, whereas the video contains rich and fine-grained visual variations. This mismatch creates an inherent gap between textual semantics and visual content, making a single textual input insufficient for precise cross-modal alignment. As a result, when multiple temporally adjacent or semantically similar segments exist, the model may struggle to distinguish the target moment from confusing candidates. To address this challenge, we propose a Multi-Perspective Auxiliary Representation (MPAR) framework, which aims to bridge this alignment gap by enriching a single textual input with complementary visual cues from multiple perspectives. Specifically, MPAR consists of three key components: (1) Auxiliary Representation Initialization (ARI) constructs multiple learnable representation slots from the original query, preserving the query intent while preparing flexible carriers for subsequent visual cue injection; (2) Visual-Induced Semantic Structuring (VISS) injects target-specific visual attributes into each representation while preserving semantic coherence with the original query; and (3) Multi-Perspective Semantic Aligner (MPSA) aligns each auxiliary representation with corresponding video regions to enhance discriminative localization. By constructing multi-perspective auxiliary representations and guiding the model to attend to relevant visual regions across these representations, our model achieves more accurate moment localization. Extensive experiments on MR benchmarks demonstrate that our MPAR outperforms state-of-the-art methods, validating the effectiveness of MPAR.

AI.tldr: 提出多视角辅助表示框架 MPAR，通过从原查询构建多视角辅助表示注入视觉线索，缓解文本语义稀疏与视频视觉丰富之间的跨模态对齐鸿沟，提升时刻检索精度。
AI.motivation: 时刻检索（MR）需在视频中定位与文本描述对应的时间片段，但文本查询往往只提供稀疏的语义描述，而视频包含丰富细粒度视觉变化，二者存在固有的语义—视觉模态鸿沟。单一文本输入难以实现精准跨模态对齐，当存在多个时间相邻或语义相似的候选片段时，模型易混淆目标与干扰项。
AI.method: MPAR 框架包含三个组件：(1) 辅助表示初始化（ARI）：从原始查询构建多个可学习表示槽，在保留查询意图的同时为后续视觉线索注入提供灵活载体；(2) 视觉引导语义结构化（VISS）：向每个表示注入目标特定的视觉属性，同时保持与原查询的语义一致性；(3) 多视角语义对齐器（MPSA）：将每个辅助表示与对应视频区域对齐，增强定位的判别性。整体通过多视角辅助表示引导模型关注相关视觉区域。
AI.result: 在时刻检索基准上的大量实验表明，MPAR 优于现有最先进方法，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以多视角辅助表示补充单一文本输入的语义稀疏性，可有效弥合跨模态对齐鸿沟，实现更准确的时刻定位。

title: Bi-Refine: Semantic Verification-Guided Progressive Refinement for Moment Retrieval
summary: Moment Retrieval (MR) aims to identify the temporal segment in an untrimmed video that corresponds to a natural language query. Existing approaches commonly refine temporal predictions within the localization pathway, without explicitly verifying candidate-level semantic consistency. Moreover, directly reusing semantic scores as feedback can cause over-correction when the verification signal is unreliable. To address these issues, we propose Bi-Refine, a semantic verification-guided progressive refinement framework that formulates MR as a closed-loop verification-and-refinement process. A Heuristic Localization Branch first generates candidate moments, while a Semantic Verification Branch evaluates their query consistency in a semantically enriched latent space. Query supervision further trains the verifier with the same candidate moment but different queries, encouraging it to distinguish the matched query from semantically similar mismatched queries. The resulting verification features are incorporated into a Progressive Refinement Loop that updates both query representations and multimodal features. To suppress potentially harmful updates, a lightweight reliability estimator gates query updates and reweights candidate contributions in feature feedback. A convergence-based adaptive stopping strategy additionally terminates unnecessary refinement during inference. Experiments on three standard MR benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and state-of-the-art performance of our method.

AI.tldr: 提出Bi-Refine框架，将时刻检索（MR）建模为闭环"验证—精修"过程，通过语义验证分支给出候选级一致性反馈，并以可靠性门控与自适应停止策略实现渐进式精修，在三个标准基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有MR方法多在定位路径内部直接精修时间预测，缺乏对候选时刻的显式候选级语义一致性验证；同时若直接把语义分数当作反馈，在验证信号不可靠时会导致过度校正（over-correction）。
AI.method: 1) 启发式定位分支先生成候选时刻；2) 语义验证分支在语义增强的隐空间中评估候选与查询的一致性；3) 采用查询监督，用同一候选时刻配不同查询训练验证器，使其区分匹配查询与语义相似的不匹配查询；4) 验证特征进入渐进精修循环，同时更新查询表示与多模态特征；5) 轻量可靠性估计器对查询更新进行门控，并对特征反馈中的候选贡献重新加权以抑制有害更新；6) 推理阶段引入基于收敛的自适应停止策略，提前终止无效精修。
AI.result: 在三个标准MR基准上实验验证了方法的有效性，并达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: 将MR重构为闭环验证与精修过程，并显式引入候选级语义验证，是提升定位精度的有效途径；配合可靠性门控与收敛自适应停止，可在避免过度校正的同时兼顾效率。

title: FireDesmoke: Fire Smoke Removal via Real Smoke Transfer and Semantic Rectification
summary: Fire smoke removal must restore dense and medium smoke regions while preserving the clear (smoke-free) content. Existing methods either leave the smoke or alter the visible content, and generative models may hallucinate people or remove flames. Real fire smoke is spatially local: the degradation and its corruption of semantic features are both concentrated in the smoke regions. We propose FireDesmoke, built on this locality: Real Smoke Transfer calibrates smoke fields on real-fire recordings and transfers their spatial layout onto clean images to synthesize training pairs, and Semantic Rectification uses pixel features to rectify the tokens of a frozen foundation encoder where smoke corrupts them. With matched training budgets, replacing the transferred pairs with SmokeBench pairs lowers dense-smoke PSNR by 0.74 dB, and removing Semantic Rectification leaves clear regions 1.31 dB below the input. On what is, to the best of our knowledge, the first paired dataset of real fire smoke for image restoration, with 1,500 test frames from a held-out viewpoint, FireDesmoke improves dense- and medium-smoke PSNR by 3.73 and 2.63 dB while keeping clear regions at the input level (+0.41 dB); no other compared method gains at least 1 dB in dense smoke without lowering clear-region PSNR, and no hallucinated person is found in its outputs. It achieves state-of-the-art overall results on this benchmark and, trained on SmokeBench, the highest PSNR with the second-best SSIM and LPIPS.

AI.tldr: FireDesmoke 利用真实火灾烟雾的空间局部性，通过真实烟雾迁移合成训练对并用语义整流修正冻结编码器的烟雾污染 token，实现了浓/中烟雾区域的高保真去除，同时保持清晰区域不变且不产生幻觉内容。
AI.motivation: 现有去烟方法要么残留烟雾，要么篡改可见内容；生成式模型还可能幻觉出人物或抹除火焰。真实火灾烟雾的退化及其对语义特征的破坏在空间上都集中于烟雾区域，这一局部性未被现有方法充分利用。
AI.method: 1) 真实烟雾迁移（Real Smoke Transfer）：在真实火灾录像上校准烟雾场，并将其空间布局迁移到干净图像上以合成配对训练数据；2) 语义整流（Semantic Rectification）：用像素特征对冻结基础编码器中被烟雾污染的 token 进行校正。
AI.result: 同等训练预算下，用 SmokeBench 配对数据替代迁移配对数据使浓烟 PSNR 下降 0.74 dB；移除语义整流后清晰区域比输入低 1.31 dB。在首个真实火灾烟雾配对图像复原数据集（1,500 帧、留出视角测试）上，浓烟与中烟 PSNR 分别提升 3.73 与 2.63 dB，清晰区域保持输入水平（+0.41 dB）；对比方法中无人在浓烟上提升≥1 dB 且不降低清晰区域 PSNR，其输出中未发现幻觉人物。在 SmokeBench 上训练时取得最高 PSNR、次优 SSIM 与 LPIPS。
AI.conclusion: 以烟雾空间局部性为核心的设计在真实火灾场景下达到该基准的整体最优结果，兼顾浓/中烟雾去除、清晰区域保真与无幻觉生成。

title: Beyond Binary Correctness: A Surrogate for Confidence Learning in Large Language and Vision-Language Models
summary: Confidence estimation for large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) aims to assess how likely a particular generated response is to be correct. We investigate how learning this assessment can benefit from the model's predictive reliability on the underlying query. Binary correctness supervision, however, assigns identical labels to occasional errors and frequent failures, as well as isolated successes and consistent success. These outcomes can arise from substantially different predictive behavior under stochastic decoding. We propose a confidence-learning framework that supplements realized response correctness with query-level predictive reliability. We estimate reliability through repeated generations under a fixed model and decoding configuration, then combine the empirical success rate with individual correctness to construct a graded confidence surrogate. The surrogate differentiates responses sharing the same correctness label while preserving the average predictive reliability of the sampled response pool. To learn this target, we condition an independent confidence estimator on the query and its full generated response, and optimize backbone LoRA adapters together with a projection and scalar confidence head using mean squared error. Repeated sampling is required only for supervision construction; inference scores an individual response without additional generations. We establish ordering and mean preservation properties of the surrogate and derive a selective-risk bound connecting population surrogate prediction error to the error rate among accepted responses. We evaluate the framework across language and vision-language models, examining confidence calibration and selective prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种置信度学习框架，在二元正确性监督之外引入查询级别的预测可靠性（重复采样的经验成功率），构建分级置信度代理目标，用LoRA+投影+标量头以MSE训练独立置信度估计器，推理时无需额外采样，并给出保序/均值保持性质与选择性风险界。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM/VLM置信度估计依赖二元正确性标签，但随机解码下偶然错误与频繁失败、孤立成功与稳定成功被赋予相同标签，无法区分不同预测行为的响应，监督信号过于粗糙。
AI.method: 在固定模型与解码配置下对同一查询重复生成，估计查询级经验成功率作为可靠性；将经验成功率与单条响应正确性结合，构造分级置信度代理标签（保持采样池平均可靠性）；以查询+完整响应为条件训练独立置信度估计器，优化主干LoRA适配器、投影层与标量置信头，损失为MSE；重复采样仅用于监督构建，推理时单次打分；理论上证明代理标签的排序性与均值保持性，并推导连接群体代理预测误差与接受响应错误率的选择性风险界。
AI.result: 在语言模型与视觉语言模型上评估，考察置信度校准与选择性预测表现（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 以查询级可靠性细化的分级置信度监督优于二元标签，可在不增加推理成本的前提下改善置信度校准与选择性预测，并有理论性质与风险界支撑。

title: FolioWeaver: A LayerGraph-Grounded Agent for Layered Image Generation and Editing
summary: Layered image generation separates images into compositable layers, allowing users to manipulate individual elements independently. However, such asset-level editability does not enable the generation system to interpret successive feedback, perform targeted edits, and preserve unaffected content. We introduce FolioWeaver, a LayerGraph-grounded agent that unifies layered-image generation and iterative editing through a persistent Executable Scene State. FolioWeaver constructs a LayerGraph and generates independent visual assets conditioned on a shared scene reference. An Editing Agent performs feedback-driven modifications and self-repair through scoped actions, selective layer execution, and visual verification, enabling targeted updates while reusing unchanged assets. We also publicly release LayerFolio, a dataset of 100,377 human-reviewed layered scenes spanning six visual domains, together with two evaluation protocols: AtomicQA for measuring requirement satisfaction and CBLP for assessing layer organization. Experiments demonstrate that FolioWeaver achieves superior layer organization and composite fidelity compared with direct layered-generation methods. Analyses validate the contributions of component adaptation, execution-grounded repair, and cross-domain training. FolioWeaver advances layered-image generation toward persistent, controllable, and iterative visual creation. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/FolioWeaver/LayerFolio.

AI.tldr: FolioWeaver：以LayerGraph为支撑、基于持久可执行场景状态的分层图像生成与迭代编辑智能体，并发布LayerFolio数据集与两项评测协议。
AI.motivation: 现有分层图像生成虽具备资产级可编辑性，但系统无法理解连续反馈、执行定向编辑并保留未受影响内容，缺乏持久场景状态与可追踪的编辑机制。
AI.method: 构建LayerGraph并以共享场景参考为条件生成独立视觉资产；引入Editing Agent，通过受限作用域动作（scoped actions）、选择性图层执行与视觉验证实现反馈驱动的修改与自修复，复用未变更资产；发布LayerFolio（100,377个人工审核分层场景，覆盖六个视觉域）及AtomicQA（需求满足度）与CBLP（图层组织）两项评测协议。
AI.result: 相比直接式分层生成方法，FolioWeaver在图层组织与合成保真度上更优；消融分析验证了组件适配、执行接地修复与跨域训练的贡献。
AI.conclusion: FolioWeaver推动分层图像生成迈向持久、可控、可迭代的视觉创作。

title: Pixel as the Common Language: Unified Multimodal Embedding via Visual Rendering
summary: Multimodal embedding models map heterogeneous inputs into a shared representation space, yet text-only, image-only, and composed inputs are still presented in distinct formats and follow different routes through the model. This fragmentation prevents heterogeneous tasks from jointly optimizing the same end-to-end encoding process, limiting supervision transfer across input configurations. To address this issue, we propose unification before encoding and instantiate this paradigm in RenderEmbed. The framework uses Visual Substrate Rendering to convert heterogeneous inputs into a common visual substrate for encoding with a VLM. From the resulting visual tokens, Progressive Hierarchical Anchor Encoding produces compact retrieval representations by interleaving learnable anchors and fusing their states across layers, retaining broad context and fine-grained cues. Interventional Rendering Learning trains these representations to remain sensitive to content changes and stable across rendering variations through complementary semantic and rendering interventions. Extensive experiments on MMEB and ViDoRe v2, spanning diverse retrieval tasks, show that RenderEmbed outperforms prior state-of-the-art models at the same scale and exhibits strong out-of-domain generalization. Compared with MetaEmbed, RenderEmbed improves MMEB Overall Precision@1 by 1.7 points, with a larger 2.1-point gain on out-of-domain tasks. Transfer and scaling analyses further show that a shared visual pathway enables more effective learning from heterogeneous supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出"编码前统一"范式，并用RenderEmbed实例化：把文本、图像及组合输入统一渲染为公共视觉基底，由VLM编码并从视觉token生成紧凑检索表征，在MMEB与ViDoRe v2上取得同规模SOTA并具强域外泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态嵌入模型中，纯文本、纯图像与组合输入仍以不同格式呈现并走不同的模型路径，这种碎片化使异构任务无法联合优化同一端到端编码过程，限制了跨输入配置的监督迁移。
AI.method: 三项组件：(1) Visual Substrate Rendering——将异构输入转换为公共视觉基底，用VLM统一编码；(2) Progressive Hierarchical Anchor Encoding——在视觉token中交错插入可学习锚点并跨层融合其状态，得到兼顾全局上下文与细粒度线索的紧凑检索表征；(3) Interventional Rendering Learning——通过语义干预与渲染干预，使表征对内容变化敏感、对渲染变化稳定。
AI.result: 在MMEB与ViDoRe v2多类检索任务上优于同规模先前SOTA，域外泛化强；相较MetaEmbed，MMEB Overall Precision@1提升1.7点，域外任务提升达2.1点。迁移与缩放分析显示共享视觉通路能更有效地利用异构监督学习。
AI.conclusion: "编码前统一"是可行且有效的多模态嵌入设计范式，统一视觉通路带来更强监督迁移与更好的跨域泛化，为异构检索任务的联合端到端优化提供了新思路。

title: SalivaryHSI-Seg: A New Challenging Benchmark for Ex Vivo Salivary Gland Hyperspectral Tissue Segmentation
summary: Salivary gland tumors are common lesions in oral and maxillofacial practice, and accurate identification of tumor regions and surrounding salivary gland tissues is important for tissue assessment, pathological sampling, and clinical decision support. Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) records continuous spectral responses together with spatial imaging information, providing a promising way to capture fine-grained tissue-discriminative information. Nevertheless, the development of salivary gland HSI tissue segmentation remains limited due to the lack of standardized benchmarks with pixel-level annotations and unified evaluation protocols. To address this issue, we introduce SalivaryHSI-Seg, a hyperspectral tissue segmentation benchmark for ex vivo salivary gland specimens, containing 119 HSI samples from 31 patients with multi-class pixel-level annotations. We establish a patient-level five-fold cross-validation protocol and evaluate different input representations, model architectures, and challenging subsets with small tumor and complex boundary. Based on this benchmark, we further propose HyBSD, a hyperspectral boundary-guided spectral-difference network for full-HSI salivary gland tissue segmentation. HyBSD exploits boundary-guided spectral-difference cues to improve tissue delineation in ambiguous transition regions. Extensive experiments show that full-HSI input provides more discriminative information than sampled spectrums, and that HyBSD achieves 74.97% mDice and 87.76% Tumor Dice, with further advantages on the challenging subsets. Dataset and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建唾液腺高光谱组织分割基准 SalivaryHSI-Seg（31例患者、119个离体样本、像素级多类标注、患者级五折交叉验证），并提出边界引导光谱差分网络 HyBSD，在全集高光谱输入下取得74.97% mDice与87.76% Tumor Dice。
AI.motivation: 唾液腺肿瘤在口腔颌面外科中常见，准确识别肿瘤区域及其周围唾液腺组织对组织评估、病理取材和临床决策支持至关重要。高光谱成像（HSI）可同时记录连续光谱响应与空间信息，具备刻画细粒度组织判别特征的潜力。但该方向缺乏带像素级标注的标准化基准与统一评测协议，制约了唾液腺HSI组织分割研究的发展。
AI.method: 1) 构建 SalivaryHSI-Seg 基准：119个离体唾液腺HSI样本（来自31例患者），提供多类像素级标注；2) 建立患者级五折交叉验证协议，系统评测不同输入表示（全集高光谱 vs. 采样光谱）、不同模型架构，以及小肿瘤、复杂边界等困难子集；3) 提出 HyBSD——高光谱边界引导光谱差分网络，利用边界引导的光谱差分线索，改善模糊过渡区域的组织边界刻画。
AI.result: 实验表明，全集高光谱输入比采样光谱提供更具判别力的信息；HyBSD 达到 74.97% mDice 和 87.76% Tumor Dice，并在小肿瘤与复杂边界等困难子集上表现出进一步优势。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了唾液腺高光谱组织分割在标准化基准与统一评测方面的空白，并验证了边界引导光谱差分建模在细粒度组织勾画中的有效性；数据集与代码将公开。

title: SF-Flow: Spectral Flow Matching with High Structural Fidelity for Hallucination-Suppressed Scientific Image Generation
summary: Scientific image generation focuses on reproducing experimental appearance while following a prescribed spatial layout. A key challenge is acute data sparsity, which requires operating with unpaired collections of materials (real images and prescribed layouts), where no direct supervision is feasible. Work on unpaired translation has shown that it is possible to reproduce the texture and intensity variations of real images, but it is extremely hard to retain the intended phase boundaries in the prescribed locations. This paper tackles this challenge and introduces SF-Flow, a flow-matching model trained only on real material images that imposes spectral constraints during generation, producing images that are high-fidelity and consistent with the prescribed layouts. Because layouts enter only at generation time, the approach extends to layout maps outside the distribution of any available training layouts. We evaluate the method on synchrotron tomography of concrete, lens-coupled laboratory microCT of powders, and industrial XCT of additively manufactured metal. Without instrument-specific modeling, we show that SF-Flow achieves substantially higher template agreement and joint fidelity--structure score than previous methods, including contrastive unpaired translation.

AI.tldr: 提出SF-Flow：仅在真实材料图像上训练的流匹配生成模型，生成时施加谱约束，实现无需配对数据、无仪器特定建模的科学图像生成，布局一致性显著优于CUT等方法。
AI.motivation: 科学图像生成需同时复现真实实验外观并遵循给定空间布局，但存在严重数据稀疏问题：只有互不配对的材料图像与布局集合，缺乏直接监督。已有非配对翻译方法能再现纹理与强度变化，却难以在指定位置保留相位边界。
AI.method: SF-Flow为流匹配（flow-matching）模型，仅用真实材料图像训练；生成过程中引入谱域约束，布局仅在生成阶段输入，因此可推广至训练分布外的布局图；无需针对具体成像仪器建模。
AI.result: 在混凝土同步辐射断层成像、透镜耦合实验室microCT粉末成像、增材制造金属工业XCT三组任务上，SF-Flow的模板一致性与联合保真度—结构评分均显著优于已有方法（含对比非配对翻译CUT）。
AI.conclusion: 谱约束流匹配可在无配对监督下实现高保真且布局一致的科学图像生成，并具备跨仪器、跨布局分布的泛化能力。

title: When "A or B" Is Less Likely than A: Coherent Probabilities for Vision Decision Models
summary: Vision decision models answer a multiple-choice question about an image with one probability per option, and software uses them directly. We show that the probabilities depend on how the options are grouped: a merged option "A or B" receives on average 11.5 points less probability than the sum of A and B. This under-additivity appears at every model size from 0.85B to 26B and remains after fine-tuning on labels. We propose CORE, which asks each training question with its options regrouped and trains the answers to all these questions toward one target distribution over the original options, summed into each question's groups. On 1,050 items from seven benchmarks, CORE reduces the total variation distance between the answer to a regrouped question and the original answer summed into the same groups from 14.8 to 5.8 points on the 0.85B model, against 9.4 for the best baseline trained on the same questions. At all five model sizes, CORE reduces this distance without lowering accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示视觉决策模型的多选概率存在"亚可加性"缺陷：选项合并后概率显著偏低，提出CORE训练方法修正该问题且不损失准确率。
AI.motivation: 视觉决策模型对图像多选问题逐选项输出概率，软件直接使用这些概率。作者发现概率依赖于选项的分组方式：合并选项"A or B"获得的概率平均比A与B之和低11.5个百分点。该问题在0.85B至26B各规模模型上均存在，且在标签微调后依然保留，说明现有训练方式无法保证概率在不同选项粒度下的一致性。
AI.method: 提出CORE训练策略：对每个训练问题以重新分组后的选项形式多次提问，并将所有这些问题对原始选项上的同一目标分布按各组求和后的结果作为监督目标，使模型在不同选项分组下输出一致的概率。
AI.result: 在七个基准共1,050个样本上，0.85B模型中将重分组问题答案与原答案按组求和后的总变差距离从14.8降至5.8（同问题最佳基线为9.4）；在全部五种模型规模上，CORE均在不降低准确率的前提下减小该距离。
AI.conclusion: 视觉决策模型的选项概率存在系统性亚可加性偏差，源于训练目标未约束选项粒度一致性；CORE通过重分组提问与组内求和目标有效降低该偏差，且跨模型规模保持准确率不降，为概率可用的视觉决策模型提供了简单有效的训练修正方案。

title: LMnOP: Pruning 3D Gaussian Splatting via Leave-Many-Out Importance
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting renders photorealistic views in real time. However, a single scene often needs millions of Gaussians, so these models are costly to store and render. Pruning reduces this cost by keeping a subset of the Gaussians. A common score is the leave-one-out importance, which is the loss increase when a Gaussian alone is removed. At high pruning ratios, many Gaussians are removed together, so Gaussians that are redundant alone but essential together are lost. We present LMnOP (Leave-Many-Out Pruning), which estimates the importance of each Gaussian under the removal of the other Gaussians. This leave-many-out importance is the average loss increase when a Gaussian is removed while the others are also removed at random. We compute the exact mean and variance of each pixel's color under random removal in closed form, and approximate the importance from them without sampling removal patterns. We refine each Gaussian's probability of remaining with its importance and prune once at the end. Without fine-tuning, LMnOP achieves the best results in 16 of 18 metrics on three datasets at 90% and 99% removal. It improves SSIM and LPIPS over GaussianPOP in all 13 scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出LMnOP（Leave-Many-Out Pruning），用于3D高斯泼溅模型的高比例剪枝。以随机去除其他高斯条件下的期望损失增量作为重要性度量，闭式计算随机去除下像素颜色的均值与方差，无需采样即可近似重要性，并在剪枝前迭代更新保留概率。无需微调即在三个数据集、90%和99%去除率下于18项指标中16项最优，全部13个场景的SSIM与LPIPS优于GaussianPOP。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯泼溅可实时渲染逼真视图，但单场景常需数百万高斯，存储与渲染代价高。剪枝通过保留子集降低成本，常用重要性分数为留一法（leave-one-out）损失增量。然而高剪枝率下大量高斯被同时去除，单独冗余但组合起来必要的高斯会被误删，留一法重要性因此失效。
AI.method: 提出留多法（leave-many-out）重要性：在随机去除其他高斯的同时去除某高斯所引起的平均损失增量。对随机去除下的每个像素颜色，闭式推导其精确均值与方差，据此近似重要性而无需采样去除模式；随后用重要性迭代精化每个高斯的保留概率，最终一次性完成剪枝。
AI.result: 无需微调，在三个数据集、90%与99%去除率下，18项指标中16项取得最佳；在全部13个场景中SSIM与LPIPS均优于GaussianPOP。
AI.conclusion: 以期望损失增量刻画高比例剪枝下的高斯重要性，配合闭式统计量与概率精化的一次性剪枝，可在免微调条件下显著优于现有剪枝方法。

title: Thermal-Guided Low-Light UAV Image Enhancement: A Reliability-Aware Guidance Network and a Unified Benchmark
summary: Thermal-guided low-light image enhancement (LLIE) is promising for nighttime unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) perception because thermal imagery remains informative under severe visible degradation. However, the degraded visible image serves as both the alignment reference and the enhancement target, making thermal guidance uncertain in its spatial correspondence and local utility under low illumination, sensor differences, and UAV motion. Misaligned or unsuitable thermal cues may introduce artifacts, while spatially varying degradation requires region-specific restoration rather than uniform enhancement. To address these challenges, we propose a Reliability-Aware Multi-Strategy Guidance Network (RMGNet) for thermal-guided UAV LLIE under weak optical-thermal alignment. Its Reliability-Aware Guidance Calibration Module (RAGCM) performs coarse-to-fine displacement estimation and jointly evaluates the reliability of aligned thermal guidance and the usability of degraded visible evidence. Based on calibrated guidance, degradation, and reliability cues, the Multi-Strategy Enhancement Routing Module (MSERM) generates candidates for detail preservation, highlight-protected relighting, and thermal compensation, then spatially routes their contributions. We further construct the UAV weakly aligned Optical-Thermal dataset (UWOT), the largest UAV-oriented benchmark to date for weakly aligned optical-thermal low-light enhancement, containing 5,000 triplets. Extensive experiments show that RMGNet outperforms representative single-modal and multimodal state-of-the-art methods in enhancement quality while retaining competitive computational efficiency and greater robustness to practical cross-modal misalignment. The dataset and code will be publicly available at https://github.com/mmic-lcl/Datasets-and-benchmark-code.

AI.tldr: 提出可靠性感知多策略引导网络RMGNet，解决弱对齐条件下热红外引导无人机低光照增强中热引导空间不确定与区域化退化问题，并构建最大规模弱对齐光学-热红外基准UWOT（5000组三模态数据）。
AI.motivation: 夜间无人机视觉感知中可见光图像严重退化，热红外成像仍具信息量，故热引导LLIE有前景。但退化可见图像同时充当对齐参考与增强目标，在低照度、传感器差异与无人机运动下，热引导的空间对应性与局部可用性均不确定；错位或不适用的热线索会引入伪影，且空间变化的退化需要区域自适应修复而非统一增强。
AI.method: RMGNet包含两个核心模块：(1) 可靠性感知引导校准模块RAGCM，执行由粗到细的位移估计，并联合评估对齐后热引导的可靠性与退化可见证据的可用性；(2) 多策略增强路由模块MSERM，基于校准后的引导、退化与可靠性线索，生成细节保持、高光保护重光照、热补偿三类候选，并进行空间路由加权。同时构建UWOT数据集（5000组三模态样本，弱对齐光学-热红外）。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，RMGNet在增强质量上优于代表性单模态与多模态SOTA方法，同时保持有竞争力的计算效率，并对实际跨模态错位具有更强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模热引导可靠性与区域自适应多策略路由，可在弱光学-热对齐下实现稳健的无人机低光照增强；UWOT基准与代码将公开，为后续弱对齐跨模态LLIE研究提供平台。

title: What Remains After Concept Erasure? Sparse Autoencoder Probes for Auditing Diffusion Models
summary: Concept erasure aims to remove selected visual concepts from text-to-image diffusion models while preserving the generation of non-target concepts. Evaluation typically measures target suppression and non-target preservation in generated images, but a concept's absence from these outputs does not establish its removal from the model. We introduce SAE-Audit, a white-box audit using sparse autoencoder (SAE) probes to test whether activation interventions can restore target-concept generation without changing model weights or test prompts. After verifying target suppression, we compare the original and edited models using a shared SAE representation learned from original-model activations, identifying features whose target-related responses weaken after erasure. We inject sparse directions derived from the original-model responses into the edited model, keeping these directions fixed across test prompts, and evaluate recovery on held-out scene families. Experiments span six erasure methods and four domains: objects, artistic styles, copyrighted content, and nudity. Interventions using a few dozen selected SAE features yield higher average recovery rates than matched random-feature interventions, with recovery concentrated in objects and nudity following cross-attention edits. Most styles and copyrighted concepts show limited recovery under the tested intervention settings. These findings show that output suppression can coexist with responsiveness to sparse concept directions supplied from the original model.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAE-Audit 白盒审计方法，用稀疏自编码器探针检验概念擦除模型中是否存在可被稀疏方向重新激活的目标概念。
AI.motivation: 现有概念擦除评估只关注生成图像中目标概念是否消失，但输出缺失不等于模型内部真正移除该概念，需要更深入的内部审计手段。
AI.method: 在原始模型激活上学习共享 SAE 表示，先验证目标抑制，再比较原始与编辑模型，识别擦除后目标相关响应减弱的特征；将从原始模型响应导出的稀疏方向（跨测试提示固定）注入编辑模型，在留出场景族上评估恢复率，覆盖六种擦除方法与四类领域。
AI.result: 少量（数十个）选定 SAE 特征干预的平均恢复率高于匹配的随机特征干预；交叉注意力编辑后，恢复集中在物体与裸露两类；多数艺术风格与受版权保护概念在测试设置下恢复有限。
AI.conclusion: 输出层面的抑制可以与对原始模型提供的稀疏概念方向的响应性共存，说明概念擦除未必真正移除概念，需采用白盒审计评估擦除的彻底性。

title: AxE: Benchmarking Agent-Environment Generalization of Video World Models via Grounded Events
summary: Edge cases are not the long tail; they are the norm. An embodied system deployed across changing environments, bodies, objects, and tasks will routinely encounter combinations that were absent from its training data. General-purpose physical intelligence therefore requires world models that reuse prior knowledge, predict consequences, and adapt with little or no additional training. Yet current evaluations of conditional video generation emphasize visual quality, prompt alignment, or isolated physical plausibility, leaving systematic generalization difficult to measure. We introduce AxE Bench, a benchmark that organizes condition changes along eight factors of the acting agent and of its environment, and pairs every original condition with controlled variants that change one side or both. WBench-plus applies the same structure to an existing multi-turn benchmark, pairing each WBench scenario with variants on the environment side, through its world setting or camera behavior, or on the agent side, through its interaction instructions. Additionally, to score generated futures, we develop an evaluation harness that combines vision-language reasoning with targeted computer-vision evidence, converting each video into temporally localized events and comparing generated events with reference events in both time and semantics. We summarize each model with the AxE Score, event Fidelity weighted by its Stability across original-variant pairs. Across twenty models, generated events match reference events far more often in timing than in content: no model exceeds a Fidelity of 13.01, the highest Stability is 0.55, and the highest AxE Score is 7.10. Together, these components turn world-model generalization from an informal aspiration into a falsifiable evaluation program for real and simulated interactions. Our project website can be found at: AxEBench.github.io

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AxE Bench 基准，沿作用主体与环境的八个因素组织条件变化，并构建基于视觉语言推理与计算机视觉证据的事件级评测框架，以 AxE Score（事件保真度×稳定性）衡量世界模型的条件泛化能力；在 20 个模型上最高 Fidelity 仅 13.01、AxE Score 仅 7.10。
AI.motivation: 具身系统部署于不断变化的环境、本体、物体与任务中，边缘情况实为常态，因此通用物理智能需要能复用先验知识、预测后果并低训练量适应的世界模型。然而现有条件视频生成评测侧重视觉质量、提示对齐或孤立物理合理性，无法系统度量泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建 AxE Bench：沿作用主体的八个因素及环境因素组织条件变化，每个原始条件配对一个单侧或双侧改变的控制变体；并将同一结构应用于多轮基准 WBench，形成 WBench-plus（环境侧通过世界设定或相机行为，主体侧通过交互指令改变）。同时开发评测工具链，结合视觉语言推理与针对性计算机视觉证据，将视频转化为时序定位事件，在时间与语义两个维度对比生成事件与参考事件。
AI.result: 20 个模型的生成事件在时间上匹配参考事件远多于在内容上匹配：无模型 Fidelity 超过 13.01，最高 Stability 为 0.55，最高 AxE Score 为 7.10。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将世界模型泛化从非正式愿景转化为可证伪的评测范式，适用于真实与仿真交互场景。

title: Separating Protocol Effects from Spatio-Temporal Evidence in Person Re-Identification Re-Ranking
summary: Spatio-temporal priors re-rank person re-identification matches using the camera pair and the time gap, and are reported to add large gains on Market-1501. We ask how much of such a gain encodes the evaluation protocol rather than learned spatio-temporal evidence. Starting from a course-project re-ranker that adds log camera-transition and log time-gap terms to cosine similarity, we train a strong ResNet-50 baseline (Rank-1 94.3 %, mAP 86.2 % over three seeds), choose the fusion weights on an identity-disjoint validation split and evaluate on the official test set with control priors. The repository form adds 2.30 mAP points, but a one-parameter penalty on same-camera pairs alone adds 2.19: the protocol never places a true match in the query's camera, so the penalty removes distractors for free. The time term of that form is almost unused; a pair-level diagnostic traces this to its modelling the time gap given a match without dividing by the gap distribution of all candidate pairs. A likelihood-ratio prior adds 4.04 points without the penalty and 5.62 with it; shuffling the time stamps removes the extra gain, so about 3.43 points are tied to identity. The prior fixes the first-ranked match of 4.2 % of the queries and breaks it for 0.1 %. The gain shrinks as the visual baseline improves (11.9 to 5.62 points between a 70.5 % and a 86.2 % mAP model) and concentrates on queries whose true matches share the query's video sequence. The study covers one dataset, one backbone and three seeds.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑时空先验在行人重识别中的增益来源：在Market-1501上，单参数的"同摄像头惩罚"即可获得几乎全部增益，真正的时空证据贡献有限；更合理的似然比先验仍有约3.43个点的增益与身份信息相关。
AI.motivation: 时空先验（摄像头对+时间间隔）在Market-1501上被报告能带来大幅mAP提升，但作者怀疑其中相当一部分增益来自评测协议本身（协议从不在查询摄像头中放置真匹配），而非学习到的时空证据。
AI.method: 以课程项目的重排序器为起点，在余弦相似度上加入对数摄像头转移项与对数时间间隔项；训练强ResNet-50基线（三随机种子：Rank-1 94.3%、mAP 86.2%）；在身份互斥验证集上选择融合权重，在官方测试集上以对照先验评估；做了单参数同摄像头惩罚对照、基于似然比的先验、时间戳打乱实验，以及配对级诊断。
AI.result: 原式先验提升2.30 mAP，而仅同摄像头惩罚即得2.19（协议免费去除干扰项）；原式时间项几乎不起作用，诊断表明其只建模"给定匹配下的时间间隔"而未除以全部候选对的时间间隔分布。似然比先验无惩罚时提升4.04，加惩罚后5.62；打乱时间戳后额外增益消失，约3.43个点与身份相关。先验修正了4.2%查询的首位匹配，仅破坏0.1%。增益随视觉基线增强而衰减（mAP 70.5%→86.2%时由11.9降至5.62点），并集中于真匹配与查询同视频序列的查询。
AI.conclusion: 时空先验在Market-1501上的大部分"增益"来自评测协议的漏洞（同摄像头惩罚），而非时空证据；正确的似然比建模仍有实质但更小的收益。结论受限于单一数据集、单一骨干网络与三个种子。

title: Preserve to Compress: Beyond Low-Dimensional Latents in One-Step Diffusion Codec
summary: Pretrained latent diffusion models bring powerful generative priors to ultra-low-bitrate image compression, but their latent spaces reflect a reconstruction--generation tradeoff. Low-dimensional latents reduce modeling cost but can discard image details, while higher-dimensional latents improve reconstruction yet make diffusion optimization harder under a fixed computational budget. Generative codecs that adopt these pretrained spaces also inherit this compromise, even though compression requires fidelity to a specific source image. In particular, low-dimensional latent interfaces can discard source details before coding and restrict how much decoded information reaches the image decoder. We propose Preserving Information for Compression and Synthesis (PICS), a one-step generative image compression framework that adapts these interfaces to preserve source information. Our Information-Preserving Adaptors (IPAs) expose richer features for coding and retain decoded information throughout reconstruction, while deferred decoder adaptation stabilizes training and helps the image decoder exploit the expanded representations. Experiments on Kodak, DIV2K, and CLIC 2020 show average BD-rate savings of 52.64% and 39.61% over StableCodec at matched LPIPS and DISTS, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出PICS——一种单步生成式图像压缩框架，通过信息保留适配器改造预训练潜扩散模型的信息瓶颈，在Kodak、DIV2K、CLIC 2020上于LPIPS/DISTS匹配时相较StableCodec分别取得52.64%和39.61%的平均BD-rate节省。
AI.motivation: 预训练潜扩散模型的潜空间存在"重建—生成"权衡：低维潜变量建模成本低但丢弃图像细节，高维潜变量重建更好但在固定算力预算下扩散优化更难。采用此类潜空间的生成式编解码器继承了该折衷，而压缩任务要求对特定源图像保持保真度；低维潜接口会在编码前丢失源细节，并限制传入图像解码器的解码信息量。
AI.method: 提出PICS单步生成式压缩框架，对预训练潜接口进行适配以保留源信息：设计信息保留适配器（Information-Preserving Adaptors, IPAs），为编码暴露更丰富的特征，并在整个重建过程中保留解码信息；同时引入延迟解码器适配（deferred decoder adaptation）以稳定训练，并帮助图像解码器利用扩展后的表征。
AI.result: 在Kodak、DIV2K与CLIC 2020数据集上，于LPIPS和DISTS指标匹配条件下，相较StableCodec分别实现平均52.64%和39.61%的BD-rate节省。
AI.conclusion: 通过适配预训练潜扩散模型的潜接口而非改变其生成先验，可有效缓解重建—生成权衡带来的信息损失，在单步生成式图像压缩中显著超越现有生成式编解码器基线。

title: UUBench: Understanding the Unspoken toward Full-Duplex Multimodal Interaction
comment: 49 pages, 37 figures, 9 tables, including appendices. Preview version; work in progress
summary: Effective real-time, full-duplex multimodal interaction requires systems to understand not only what users say, but also the communicative needs conveyed through prosody, facial expressions, gestures, and context, and to generate audiovisual responses that appropriately address those needs. Existing evaluations offer limited insight into whether systems translate an understanding of such unspoken needs into effective responses. We introduce UUBench, a benchmark for assessing how well multimodal interactive systems Understand the Unspoken intent and address users' implicit communicative needs. The inherent subjectivity of implicit intent inference poses a key challenge for evaluation. To address this, we introduce Process-Oriented Scoring, which grounds the assessment of intent fulfillment in observable auditory and visual cues, such as prosody and gestures. Rather than relying solely on a single overall score, it evaluates how well a response addresses the communicative needs conveyed by each applicable primitive dimension. We aggregate the dimension-level scores according to each dimension's relevance to the annotated evidence. Beyond intent fulfillment, Outcome-Oriented Scoring evaluates the naturalness, appropriateness, and human-likeness of the reply itself under audio-only, visual-only, and audiovisual conditions. To make these judgments traceable to observable evidence, we propose a Fact-Grounded Scoring JEV module, which uses structured, timestamped audiovisual observations of the user and the digital human's reply to assess one dimension or criterion at a time. UUBench provides a foundation for assessing whether multimodal interactive systems respond effectively to meaning beyond literal wording, supporting progress toward context-aware, real-time, full-duplex interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出UUBench基准，用于评估多模态交互系统对用户"未言明意图"（语调、表情、手势、语境等传达的隐含沟通需求）的理解与回应能力，并配套过程导向评分、结果导向评分与事实锚定评分JEV模块。
AI.motivation: 实时全双工多模态交互要求系统不仅理解用户"说了什么"，还要理解语调、面部表情、手势与语境所传达的沟通需求，并生成能恰当回应的视听响应。现有评测难以判断系统是否真正把对这类"未言明需求"的理解转化为有效回应；而隐含意图推断本身具有主观性，给评测带来核心挑战。
AI.method: 1) 构建UUBench基准，聚焦"理解未言明意图"（Understand the Unspoken intent）；2) 提出过程导向评分（Process-Oriented Scoring），将意图满足度评估锚定在可观测的听觉与视觉线索（语调、手势等）上，按各适用原始维度逐项评估，并依据维度与标注证据的相关性加权聚合，而非仅给单一总分；3) 提出结果导向评分（Outcome-Oriented Scoring），在纯音频、纯视觉、视听三种条件下评估回复的自然度、恰当性与拟人性；4) 提出事实锚定评分JEV模块（Fact-Grounded Scoring JEV），利用对用户及数字人回复的结构化、带时间戳的视听观测，逐维度/逐准则进行评判，使判断可追溯至可观测证据。
AI.result: 构建了包含过程导向评分、结果导向评分与JEV事实锚定模块的完整评测框架；通过维度级评分与相关性加权聚合、多模态条件下的结果评估以及带时间戳证据支撑的逐项判断，提升了对隐含意图回应质量评估的细粒度与可追溯性。
AI.conclusion: UUBench为评估多模态交互系统能否有效回应字面之外的意义提供了基础，推动面向语境感知、实时、全双工交互的研究进展。

title: OpenViVE: New Benchmark and Dual-Stream Co-Attention Framework for Vietnamese Visual Entailment
summary: Visual Entailment (VE) determines whether a textual hypothesis is entailed, contradicted, or unverifiable from an image. However, existing VE benchmarks are largely English-centric and do not capture Vietnamese-specific linguistic distinctions or culturally grounded visual contexts. To address this gap, we introduce OpenViVE, the first large-scale native Vietnamese VE benchmark, containing 62,268 balanced image-hypothesis pairs from 10,378 culturally grounded images. OpenViVE is constructed using an Artifact-Aware Hybrid LLM-Human Pipeline that combines constrained generation, human validation, and PMI-guided refinement. The pipeline substantially reduces hypothesis-only shortcuts, with Contradiction accuracy dropping from 96% to 66% after artifact refinement. We further evaluate a dual-stream PhoBERT-ConvNeXt framework with bidirectional co-attention to align visual evidence with Vietnamese hypotheses. The framework achieves 84.84% accuracy and 84.90% macro-F1 on the test set, while PhoBERT consistently outperforms multilingual XLM-R variants. These results highlight the importance of language-specific encoding and explicit cross-modal interaction for Vietnamese VE.

AI.tldr: 提出首个大规模越南语原生视觉蕴含基准 OpenViVE（62,268 对图文假设，10,378 张文化相关图像），并用 artifact-aware 混合 LLM-人类流水线构建；同时提出 PhoBERT-ConvNeXt 双向共注意力双流模型，测试集准确率 84.84%、宏 F1 84.90%。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉蕴含（VE）基准以英语为中心，未涵盖越南语特有的语言差异与文化语境视觉内容，缺乏原生越南语 VE 评测资源。
AI.method: 构建 OpenViVE 基准：采用 Artifact-Aware Hybrid LLM-Human Pipeline，结合受限生成、人工校验与 PMI 引导的精炼，以抑制仅凭假设即可作答的捷径（hypothesis-only shortcuts）。建模方面提出双流 PhoBERT-ConvNeXt 框架，通过双向共注意力（bidirectional co-attention）对齐视觉证据与越南语假设，并与多语言 XLM-R 变体对比。
AI.result: 经 artifact 精炼后，Contradiction 类别准确率由 96% 降至 66%，显示捷径被显著削弱；所提框架在测试集上达到 84.84% 准确率与 84.90% 宏 F1，且 PhoBERT 一致优于多语言 XLM-R 变体。
AI.conclusion: 语言特定编码与显式跨模态交互对越南语视觉蕴含至关重要；OpenViVE 填补了非英语、文化接地 VE 评测的空白。

title: WaDiS: Boundary-Preserving Diffusion Segmentation via Multi-Scale Wavelet Conditioning and Frequency-Aware Gating
summary: Diffusion models have shown strong potential in medical image segmentation due to their generative capabilities and robustness. However, existing methods often struggle to preserve fine anatomical boundaries and to retain multi-scale structural information due to the loss of spatial and frequency details during feature encoding, particularly in complex clinical imaging conditions. This work presents WaDiS, a wavelet-powered conditional latent diffusion framework for medical image segmentation that addresses these limitations through multi-scale wavelet conditioning and frequency-aware information filtering for boundary preservation. The model adopts a multi-scale wavelet conditioning encoder to retain rich structural features, leveraging its lossless nature to better preserve semantic priors critical to the diffusion process. In addition, a Frequency-Aware Gating Block (FAGB) is introduced into the skip connections of the diffusion U-Net, enabling adaptive spectral filtering and residual fusion to better emphasize boundary structures while reducing irrelevant content. To improve generalization across clinical domains, we adopt a structure-preserving color augmentation strategy during training. Specifically, global color statistics are transferred between samples in the LAB color space, allowing the model to decouple appearance from structure and focus more on anatomical shape rather than color bias. Experiments on five benchmark datasets demonstrate that WaDiS consistently outperforms existing diffusion-based and conventional segmentation methods, with notable improvements in boundary accuracy, robustness to noise, and generalization under color variation. The code for this work will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出WaDiS——基于小波的条件潜扩散医学图像分割框架，通过多尺度小波条件编码、频域感知门控块（FAGB）与结构保持颜色增强，提升边界精度与跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式分割方法在特征编码过程中丢失空间与频域细节，难以保持细致的解剖边界与多尺度结构信息，在复杂临床成像条件下尤为明显；同时模型易受颜色偏置影响，跨临床域泛化不足。
AI.method: (1) 多尺度小波条件编码器：利用小波变换的无损特性保留丰富结构特征，为扩散过程提供更完整的语义先验；(2) 频域感知门控块（FAGB）：嵌入扩散U-Net跳跃连接，进行自适应谱域滤波与残差融合，突出边界结构、抑制无关内容；(3) 结构保持颜色增强：在LAB色彩空间于样本间迁移全局颜色统计量，使模型解耦外观与结构，关注解剖形状而非颜色偏置。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上，WaDiS 稳定优于现有扩散式与传统分割方法，在边界精度、抗噪鲁棒性以及颜色变化下的泛化性方面均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 将小波多尺度条件与频域感知门控引入条件潜扩散分割框架，可有效缓解特征编码中的空间/频域信息损失，配合结构保持颜色增强显著改善边界刻画与跨域泛化，为医学图像分割提供了新的频域建模范式。

title: Multimodal View Training: Learning More Through Different Modalities
summary: Can a language model learn more from the same information simply by encountering it in different forms? We answer this in the affirmative by introducing Multimodal View Training (MVT), a simple training approach that presents identical information through text, speech, and images, without requiring new facts or supervision. Starting from a text sample, MVT generates corresponding audio and rendered-text image views, and trains a multimodal language model to produce the same target output across all three views. To further bring these benefits to text-only large language models (LLMs), we train lightweight connector modules to pretrained audio and vision encoders, allowing the LLM to learn from multimodal inputs while retaining its text-only architecture at inference. Across question answering, machine unlearning, and knowledge editing, adaptive MVT improves QA recall by +15.2 percentage points, forget quality by +40.7 points, and editing generality by +25.2 points over text-only training. Combining MVT with standard augmentation further improves QA and editing generality. Our theoretical analysis illustrates how training across modalities can shift weight updates toward shared factual content and reduce their reliance on features specific to each view.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态视图训练（MVT）：将同一信息以文本、语音、图像三种视图呈现并强制模型输出同一目标，可在不引入新事实或新监督的情况下提升语言模型的知识利用效率。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型能否仅通过"同一信息的不同呈现形式"学到更多，即在不增加新知识的前提下提升知识获取、遗忘与编辑效果。
AI.method: 从文本样本出发生成对应音频与渲染文本图像视图，训练多模态语言模型在三种视图下产生相同目标输出；并训练轻量连接器模块，将音频与视觉编码器接入预训练纯文本LLM，使推理阶段仍保持纯文本架构。另给出理论分析。
AI.result: 在问答、机器遗忘、知识编辑三类任务上，自适应MVT相较纯文本训练分别提升QA召回+15.2个百分点、遗忘质量+40.7分、编辑泛化性+25.2分；与标准数据增强结合后，QA与编辑泛化性进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态训练可将权重更新导向共享的事实性内容，降低对各视图特有特征的依赖；多视图呈现是提升LLM知识利用的高效、无需新监督的训练范式。

title: PathStream: Towards Streaming Diagnostic Copilots for Whole-Slide Pathology
summary: Pathologists reach a diagnosis by integrating morphological evidence across regions and magnifications along viewing trajectories. Existing pathology AI rarely reflects this process: models predict from selected image regions, answer questions within fixed visual contexts, or navigate slides autonomously. We formalize pathologist-led streaming diagnosis, in which the pathologist controls navigation while a copilot selectively describes incoming views and synthesizes accumulated evidence into a final diagnosis. We record five pathologists' viewing trajectories on 1,791 TCGA whole-slide images (WSIs) spanning ten organs, with response labels, morphological descriptions, and session-level findings and diagnoses. We construct PathStreamBench to assess response timing, morphological description, and session-level diagnosis, alongside auxiliary video understanding. We introduce PathStream, which jointly learns streaming responses and diagnosis through two-stage training, with a diagnosis-attention loss guiding attention during diagnosis to relevant visual and textual evidence accumulated as the examination unfolds. PathStream outperforms 14 vision-language models and three domain-fine-tuned baselines on the core tasks, achieving a trajectory WSI Relevance score of 77.87, surpassing the strongest domain-fine-tuned baseline's 62.76. Without additional training, its diagnostic capabilities generalize to new educational pathology videos, three external centers, and an unseen organ.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"病理学家主导的流式诊断"范式并构建PathStreamBench基准（5位病理学家、1791张TCGA全切片、10个器官的阅片轨迹与描述标注），提出PathStream模型，通过两阶段训练与诊断注意力损失联合学习流式响应与会话级诊断，核心任务显著优于14个视觉语言模型和3个领域微调基线，并具跨视频、跨中心、跨器官泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有病理AI与真实诊断过程脱节：模型要么仅从选定图像区域预测，要么在固定视觉上下文中回答问题，要么自主导航切片，均未体现病理学家沿阅片轨迹整合多区域、多倍率形态学证据的认知过程。缺少一个能刻画"人主导导航、AI辅助流式描述并累积证据形成诊断"的评测与建模框架。
AI.method: 1) 形式化"病理学家主导的流式诊断"任务：由病理学家控制导航，copilot选择性描述到来的视野并将会话中累积的证据综合为最终诊断；2) 数据采集：记录5位病理学家在10个器官、1791张TCGA全切片上的阅片轨迹，附响应标签、形态学描述及会话级发现与诊断；3) 构建PathStreamBench，评测响应时机、形态学描述、会话级诊断，并辅以视频理解任务；4) 提出PathStream模型，两阶段训练联合学习流式响应与诊断，引入诊断注意力损失，引导诊断时关注随检查推进累积的相关视觉与文本证据。
AI.result: 在核心任务上超越14个视觉语言模型与3个领域微调基线；轨迹级WSI相关性得分达77.87，显著高于最强领域微调基线的62.76。无需额外训练即可泛化至新的教学病理视频、三个外部中心的数据及未见过器官的诊断。
AI.conclusion: 将诊断建模为病理学家导航下的流式证据累积过程是可行且有效的：PathStream在流式响应与会话级诊断上均取得领先性能，并展现出良好的零样本跨域泛化，为贴近真实阅片工作流的病理AI提供了新基准与建模范式。

title: GUI-Q: Task-Sensitive Granularity and Relation-Preserving Quantization for GUI Agents
summary: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents enable automated interactions with mobile, web, and desktop interfaces. However, their large memory footprint and repeated model calls hinder deployment on resource-constrained devices, motivating post-training quantization (PTQ) without full retraining. Quantization can degrade GUI response accuracy and distort the instruction-vision affinities and local spatial relations needed for GUI target selection. Small coordinate errors can cause missed clicks, while early action errors can alter subsequent interface states and disrupt task execution. Local reconstruction error alone does not directly assess whether these responses and relations are preserved. We propose GUI-Q, a PTQ framework that targets response and relation preservation with 4-bit weights and 16-bit activations (W4A16). Task-Sensitive Granularity Allocation (TSGA) allocates finer groups under a scale-byte budget by combining response sensitivity with the measured reduction in activation-weighted distortion. Relation-Preserving Symmetry Selection (RPSS) then selects symmetric or asymmetric grids to preserve instruction-vision affinities and local spatial relations in GUIs. Across three GUI-capable models, GUI-Q improves mean grounding TargetHit by 8.04 to 12.55 points over the strongest evaluated 4-bit configurations, while reducing static peak graphics processing unit (GPU) memory by 49.9% to 56.2% relative to bfloat16 (BF16). Fixed-output replay with packed 4-bit execution provides 1.7 to 2.8 times model-call speedups. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: GUI-Q：面向GUI智能体的后训练量化框架，通过任务敏感粒度分配与关系保持对称选择，在W4A16下保持响应与关系，提升目标定位并显著降低显存。
AI.motivation: GUI智能体模型内存占用大、需反复调用模型，难以部署于资源受限设备。PTQ免重训练，但量化会损害GUI响应准确率，并扭曲目标选择所需的指令-视觉亲和性与局部空间关系；小的坐标误差会导致点击失败，早期动作误差还会改变后续界面状态。仅用局部重建误差无法直接评估这些响应与关系是否保持。
AI.method: 提出GUI-Q，以W4A16（4比特权重、16比特激活）为目标保持响应与关系：1）Task-Sensitive Granularity Allocation（TSGA）在scale字节预算下，结合响应敏感度与激活加权失真下降的实测值，为敏感任务分配更细粒度分组；2）Relation-Preserving Symmetry Selection（RPSS）选择对称或非对称量化网格，以保持GUI中的指令-视觉亲和性与局部空间关系。
AI.result: 在三个具备GUI能力的模型上，GUI-Q相较最强4比特配置将平均grounding TargetHit提升8.04–12.55个点；静态峰值GPU显存相对BF16降低49.9%–56.2%；固定输出回放配合打包4比特执行带来1.7–2.8倍模型调用加速。
AI.conclusion: 面向GUI智能体的量化应直接以响应与关系保持为目标而非仅最小化局部重建误差；GUI-Q在几乎不损精度（实测反而提升定位）的同时大幅降显存并加速推理，代码将开源。

title: Audio-Visual Rearrangement
summary: We introduce Audio-Visual Rearrangement (AVR), a novel task in which an agent hears a spoken request, retrieves a suitable object, and delivers it to the requesting user or an instruction-specified destination. AVR requires the agent to understand the spoken request and acoustically localize the speaker for delivery. To support this task, we construct a dataset covering three query types: explicit target specification, speaker-relative spatial references, and implicit user intent, spanning eight subtypes with diverse object selection and delivery requirements. Moreover, we propose a framework that integrates a motion-aware spatial audio module into an audio-visual large language model to encode spatial cues from the spoken request and update them as the agent moves. We further incorporate auxiliary supervision for speech understanding, spatial audio perception, and visual grounding through multitask instruction tuning to improve action prediction. Experiments establish baseline performance in both seen and unseen environments, laying the groundwork for future research on embodied intelligence and human-robot interaction. The code will be publicly available soon.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出新任务Audio-Visual Rearrangement（AVR）：智能体根据语音请求找到合适物体并送达请求者或指定地点，需语音理解与声源定位能力。作者构建含三类查询、八个子类型的数据集，并提出将运动感知空间音频模块融入音视频大语言模型的框架，配合多任务指令微调实现辅助监督，在可见与未见环境中建立基线。
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能研究多依赖文本指令与视觉输入，缺少在真实交互中同时利用语音请求语义与空间声学线索（如说话人定位、相对方位）完成物体取送的任务设定与数据支撑。
AI.method: 构建AVR数据集，覆盖显式目标指定、说话人相对空间指代、隐含用户意图三类查询及八个子类型；提出将运动感知空间音频模块集成到音视频大语言模型，编码语音请求中的空间线索并随智能体移动更新；通过多任务指令微调引入语音理解、空间音频感知与视觉定位的辅助监督以提升动作预测。
AI.result: 在可见与未见环境中均给出基线性能，验证了所提框架在该任务上的可行性。
AI.conclusion: AVR为结合语音理解与空间音频定位的具身取送任务提供了数据集与基线框架，为具身智能与人机交互的后续研究奠定基础，代码将公开。

title: TriSegAgent: Context-Efficient 3D Annotation with MLLMs via Tri-Planes
summary: Interactive segmentation models turn a few clicks into a segmentation prediction across domains, so annotators only decide where the prediction still needs correction. Annotation thus becomes a loop of inspecting the prediction and clicking again. Each step of this loop is a visual judgment, which suits general-purpose multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents. In this work, we focus on letting these agents run this loop on 3D volumes. However, the MLLM in such an agent takes only 2D images as input, so the agent must observe the 3D volume in 2D. Since the loop calls the MLLM many times, this observation must be token-compact enough to keep every call cheap, yet informative enough to show error regions in the 3D prediction. We meet both needs with tri-planes, the three orthogonal planes that cross at one point in the volume. We show, both theoretically and empirically, that tri-planes are context-efficient yet keep sufficient detail to show error regions in the 3D prediction. Building on tri-planes, we introduce TriSegAgent, an MLLM agent that refines the 3D prediction iteratively. Within the agent, the MLLM only judges the prediction on tri-planes, while a visual harness turns each judgment into a 3D action in code. To make the loop reliable, the harness places each click at an exact voxel in the volume and checks whether to accept the 3D prediction. To evaluate the agent, we build a diverse benchmark of 690 regions of interest (ROIs) from 35 public medical datasets across three imaging modalities. With frontier MLLMs, TriSegAgent reaches an overall Dice about 10 points above the strongest baseline, and its lead is even larger on targets below 3 cm. With flash-level MLLMs, it outperforms a recent 3D segmentation agent built on a frontier MLLM.

AI.tldr: 提出 TriSegAgent：用三正交平面（tri-planes）作为 2D 观察表示，让 MLLM 智能体以迭代点击方式精化 3D 医学分割预测。
AI.motivation: 交互式分割把分割转化为"检查预测—再点击"的视觉判断循环，天然适合多模态大模型（MLLM）智能体；但 MLLM 只接受 2D 输入，且循环需多次调用，故对 3D 体的 2D 观察必须"token 紧凑"又要"信息充分"以暴露 3D 预测中的错误区域。
AI.method: 以过同一体素点的三个正交平面（tri-planes）作为观察表示，并从理论与实验证明其上下文高效且保留足够细节；构建 TriSegAgent：MLLM 仅在 tri-planes 上做判断，视觉 harness 将判断转写为代码形式的三维动作，把点击定位到精确体素，并判定是否接受该 3D 预测；另构建含 35 个公开医学数据集、3 种成像模态、690 个 ROI 的评测基准。
AI.result: 在前沿 MLLM 下，整体 Dice 比最强基线高约 10 点，在小于 3 cm 的目标上优势更大；使用 flash 级 MLLM 时仍优于基于前沿 MLLM 的近期 3D 分割智能体。
AI.conclusion: tri-planes 是兼顾 token 效率与错误可辨识性的有效 3D 观察接口，配合精确体素级动作的 harness，可让通用 MLLM 智能体在 3D 交互式分割中稳定闭环并取得显著性能提升。

title: OmniSenMo: A Unified Multisensory Language Model for Generalizable Human Motion Estimation, Understanding, and Prediction
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) estimate, understand, and predict human motion, but mainly from RGB cameras. Depth, LiDAR, mmWave, and WiFi complement RGB under poor lighting, through occlusions, and in privacy-sensitive applications, but existing multisensory models cover only some of these sensing tasks. Covering all of them from any sensor subset is challenging, since the tokens of heterogeneous sensors are semantically inconsistent and spatially misaligned, paired multisensory data are scarce, and the tasks need different temporal granularities. We present OmniSenMo, a multisensory language model that takes the human skeleton as a common reference for all sensors. Its skeleton-grounded motion representation turns each sensor into joint tokens, one per body joint, so that any sensor subset is fused joint by joint and expressed in the motion vocabulary that the language model learned from motion capture and text. We pretrain it on all five sensors generated by our multisensory simulator, and Multi-Granularity Observation gives each task the frames it needs. On a cross-action split of MM-Fi, the same model with all five sensors outperforms the models compared on each task, including LEO-Fuse in pose estimation (84.1 vs. 89.0 mm MPJPE) and HoloLLM in unseen-action recognition (69.2% vs. 42.8%). Even without RGB, it outperforms both methods that use RGB, and in a cross-dataset validation on XRF55, it recognizes unseen actions far better than HoloLLM.

AI.tldr: OmniSenMo 是一个多传感器语言模型，以人体骨架为共同参照，将 RGB、深度、LiDAR、毫米波与 WiFi 任一子集的异构数据统一转为逐关节 token，实现任意传感器组合下的运动估计与识别，并在 MM-Fi 与 XRF55 上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 MLLM 的人体运动理解主要依赖 RGB 相机；深度、LiDAR、mmWave 与 WiFi 可在弱光、遮挡及隐私敏感场景中作为互补模态，但已有的多传感器模型仅覆盖部分感知任务。统一覆盖全部传感器并支持任意传感器子集输入存在三大障碍：异构传感器 token 语义不一致且空间未对齐；成对多传感器数据稀缺；不同任务所需时间粒度不同。
AI.method: 提出 OmniSenMo：(1) 以人体骨架为所有传感器的共同参照，构建 skeleton-grounded motion representation，将每种传感器转换为逐关节的 joint tokens，从而支持任意子集按关节逐一融合，并以语言模型从动作捕捉与文本中学到的运动词汇表进行表达；(2) 使用自研多传感器模拟器生成五种传感器数据做预训练，以缓解成对数据稀缺；(3) 提出 Multi-Granularity Observation，为不同任务提供所需的时间帧粒度。
AI.result: 在 MM-Fi 的 cross-action split 上，五传感器全用的同一模型在各任务上均优于对比模型：位姿估计 MPJPE 为 84.1 mm，优于 LEO-Fuse 的 89.0 mm；未见动作识别准确率 69.2%，优于 HoloLLM 的 42.8%。即使不使用 RGB，仍超过两种使用 RGB 的方法；在 XRF55 跨数据集验证中，未见动作识别效果远超 HoloLLM。
AI.conclusion: 以骨架为统一语义锚点、配合模拟器预训练与多粒度观测，可有效解决异构传感器语义/空间不一致、配对数据稀缺与任务时间粒度差异问题，实现任意传感器子集输入的通用多传感器人体运动语言建模。

title: Visual-RFT++: Extending Visual Reinforcement Fine-Tuning to Multimodal Tool Use
comment: Our code is available at https://github.com/Liuziyu77/Visual-RFT
summary: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) has recently become a central paradigm for advancing Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), as demonstrated by systems such as OpenAI's o3 and the R1 series. Despite significant progress in LLMs, how to leverage RFT to unify visual perception, step-by-step reasoning, and agentic tool use into one coherent training paradigm remains an open challenge. In this work, we present Visual Reinforcement Fine-Tuning++ (Visual-RFT++), a unified framework that extends RFT to both visual perception tasks and multimodal agentic workflows, enabling LVLMs to reason with images, act upon images, and evaluate their own outputs using verifiable reward. With Visual-RFT++, open-source LVLMs not only show significant gains on diverse visual perception tasks, but also acquire agentic abilities such as web searching for real-time information and code-based image manipulation (e.g., cropping, rotation, and analysis). Across visual perception tasks, including fine-grained classification, few-shot detection, reasoning grounding, and open-vocabulary detection, Visual-RFT++ delivers strong gains over SFT, including a +24.3 percentage points improvement in one-shot fine-grained classification and +21.0 percentage points on COCO's 4-shot setting and +15.4 percentage points on LVIS with around several hundred samples. To evaluate agentic behaviors, we introduce the Multimodal Agentic Tool Bench (MAT) with MAT-Search and MAT-Coding. Visual-RFT++ surpasses its baseline by +18.6 F1 / +13.0 EM percentage points on MAT-Coding and +10.3 F1 / +8.7 EM percentage points on MAT-Search. It also shows gains of 29.3 F1 and 25.9 EM percentage points on multi-hop QA benchmarks such as 2Wiki and HotpotQA, demonstrating strong cross-modal generalization. Visual-RFT++ introduces a data-efficient and reward-driven framework that strengthens both visual reasoning and agentic adaptability.

AI.tldr: Visual-RFT++ 将强化微调（RFT）扩展为统一框架，同时覆盖视觉感知任务与多模态智能体工作流，使开源 LVLM 在细粒度分类、少样本检测、推理定位、开放词表检测及工具使用（搜索、代码图像操作）上均显著优于 SFT 基线。
AI.motivation: RFT 已成为推进大型推理模型（如 o3、R1 系列）的核心范式，但如何用 RFT 将视觉感知、逐步推理与智能体工具调用统一到同一训练范式中仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 提出 Visual-RFT++ 统一框架，把 RFT 从纯文本推理扩展到视觉感知与多模态智能体流程，基于可验证奖励（verifiable reward）让 LVLM 完成"读图推理—对图像采取动作—自评输出"的闭环；并构建多模态智能体工具基准 MAT（含 MAT-Search 与 MAT-Coding）用于评测。
AI.result: 视觉感知任务显著超越 SFT：单样本细粒度分类 +24.3 个百分点，COCO 4-shot +21.0 个百分点，LVIS（数百样本） +15.4 个百分点；智能体任务 MAT-Coding +18.6 F1 / +13.0 EM，MAT-Search +10.3 F1 / +8.7 EM；多跳问答 2Wiki、HotpotQA 上 +29.3 F1 / +25.9 EM，体现跨模态泛化。
AI.conclusion: Visual-RFT++ 提供了一个数据高效、奖励驱动的训练框架，同时增强视觉推理能力与智能体适应性，为开源 LVLM 统一感知、推理与工具使用提供了可行路径。

title: Accuracy Is Not Evidence: Measuring and Training Evidence Dependence in Video Temporal Grounding
comment: Preprint, 47 pages. Code, models and data: https://jinzijie-bupt.github.io/Accuracy-Is-Not-Evidence/
summary: In video temporal grounding, a correct interval can come from finding the event, answering blind or fitting one annotation style, and Recall at IoU scores them alike. We measure evidence dependence, how much the answer rests on the event's frames. Our fixed-answer audit edits either the frames inside the annotated interval or, as a placebo, as many frames elsewhere in the same video, and compares the two drops in the annotated answer's likelihood. Supervised fine-tuning and three public checkpoints trained with IoU-reward reinforcement learning raise the accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-7B by 9 to 20 points, partly by answering blind and by fitting one annotation. Yet their answers rest on the event no more than the base model's, and the same holds for IoU-reward training on our data at the audit's frame rate. This comparison is a difference of the model's own likelihoods, so we can train on it. A placebo contrast and a bound on the placebo drop rule out learning to react to any edit. With them, evidence dependence rises in all five base models we train, and the weight on clean supervision controls how much. Added to IoU-reward training, the objective raises evidence dependence while keeping the accuracy gain. Masking the event's frames makes the trained models decline or miss the event more often than their base; masking as many other frames does not. The dependence moves to another event when the query names it, and holds on a second dataset and under patch scrambling, an edit never used in training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"证据依赖性"(evidence dependence)指标，通过"固定答案审计"(fixed-answer audit)：分别扰动标注区间内帧与同视频等量其他帧，比较标注答案似然下降的差异，以区分模型是真找到事件还是盲答/拟合标注风格。可微对比可直接用于训练，配合安慰剂对比与上界约束，在5个基座模型上均提升证据依赖性，且与IoU奖励训练结合可保持精度增益。
AI.motivation: 视频时序定位中，Recall@IoU无法区分模型是真正定位到事件，还是"盲答"(不看视频直接输出)或"拟合某一种标注风格"——三者都可能得到正确区间且得分相同。现有评测只衡量答案正确性而不衡量答案是否依赖事件帧，因此需要一种能刻画"答案在多大程度上依托于事件帧"的度量与可训练目标。
AI.method: 1) 定义证据依赖性：以标注答案的似然为固定答案，比较两类编辑造成的似然下降。2) 固定答案审计：编辑标注区间内的帧 vs. 安慰剂编辑(编辑同视频中同样数量的区间外帧)，以两者似然下降之差作为证据依赖性度量。3) 由于该度量为模型自身似然之差，可微，故可直接作为训练目标；并加入安慰剂对比项与安慰剂下降的上界约束，防止模型学成"对任意编辑都敏感"。4) 与IoU奖励强化学习联合训练；在第二数据集、patch scrambling(训练中未用的编辑类型)及查询换指另一事件时检验迁移性。
AI.result: Qwen2.5-VL-7B经监督微调及三个用IoU奖励RL训练的公开checkpoint，精度提升9–20点，但部分来自盲答与拟合单一标注风格；其证据依赖性并不高于基座模型，且在审计帧率下用自有数据做IoU奖励训练同样如此。加入所提目标后，5个被训练基座模型的证据依赖性全部上升，上升幅度受干净监督权重的控制；与IoU奖励训练结合可在大幅提升证据依赖性的同时保留精度增益。遮蔽事件帧使模型更常"判断错误或漏检"事件，而遮蔽等量其他帧无此效果；依赖性在查询点名另一事件时随之转移，并在第二数据集、patch scrambling下依然成立。
AI.conclusion: Recall@IoU高分并不能证明模型真正依赖事件内容；现有SFT与IoU奖励RL带来的精度增益可能部分源于捷径(盲答、拟合标注风格)。证据依赖性提供了一个可微、可训练、能入RL目标的诊断兼优化指标，可有效抑制捷径而无损精度，并具备跨数据、跨编辑类型的泛化性。建议时序定位评测与训练同时报告证据依赖性。

title: Quantization for Action, Execution for Deployment: Joint Precision and Execution Selection for World Action Models
summary: World action models guide robots by predicting the effects of actions or generating commands from observations. A model may compare hundreds of candidate futures before acting, repeatedly reading weights that must fit in device memory. Post-training quantization reduces the number of bits used to store pretrained weights, but a smaller model is not necessarily a deployable one: temporary tensors can exceed graphics processing unit (GPU) memory limits, while even small prediction errors can change the selected action. This creates two coupled challenges: identifying bit assignments that preserve task performance and determining which of them meet real execution constraints, without exhausting costly task trials. We present PTQ4WAM, a framework for choosing layer-wise bit assignments and execution routes under memory, latency and task-evaluation budgets. Calibration measurements guide candidate proposals, optionally with a language model agent. We profile full-model routes on the GPU before spending task trials on feasible assignments. Fusing group rescaling and reading visual history in place can make an otherwise infeasible assignment deployable. Across 15 workloads from four model families, the median task score is 99.2% of the corresponding 32-bit floating-point (FP32) score. On fixed GPU replays, the median speedup over FP32 is 2.36 times and the median reduction in peak allocated memory is 71.5%. The code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: PTQ4WAM：面向世界动作模型的层级比特分配与执行路径联合选择框架，在内存、延迟与任务评测预算约束下，取得中位任务分数达 FP32 的 99.2%，固定 GPU 回放下加速 2.36×、峰值显存降低 71.5%。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型需在设备内存中反复读取权重以比较数百条候选未来，部署受显存与延迟限制。训练后量化（PTQ）虽降低权重位宽，但模型变小不等于可部署：临时张量可能超出 GPU 显存上限，且微小预测误差即可改变所选动作。因此存在两个耦合难题——寻找保持任务性能的比特分配，并在不耗尽昂贵任务试验的前提下判定其是否满足真实执行约束。
AI.method: 提出 PTQ4WAM 框架：1）以校准测量指导候选比特分配提案，可选引入语言模型智能体辅助搜索；2）在 GPU 上对全模型执行路径做剖析（profiling），先筛出满足内存/延迟约束的可行分配，再消耗任务试验进行评估；3）通过融合分组重缩放（fused group rescaling）与原地读取视觉历史（in-place reading of visual history）降低临时张量开销，使原本不可行的分配变得可部署。
AI.result: 在来自四个模型族的 15 个工作负载上，中位任务分数为对应 FP32 分数的 99.2%；固定 GPU 回放中，相对 FP32 的中位加速为 2.36 倍，峰值分配内存中位降低 71.5%。
AI.conclusion: 将比特分配搜索与执行路径剖析相结合，可在有限任务试验预算下联合优化任务性能与部署约束；量化收益不仅来自位宽压缩，还依赖执行路径层面的内存优化。代码即将开源。

title: ToWo-VTON: Take-Off Wear-On Virtual Try-On via Topology-aware Decoupling
summary: Virtual Try-On (VTON) aims to synthesize garment transfer without physical trials. Although recent methods perform well on upper-body garments, they still struggle in lower-body and full-body scenarios with complex occlusions and large silhouette changes. To address this limitation, we introduce ToWo (Take-Off Wear-On), a two-stage paradigm that decouples body structure estimation from garment synthesis. Take-Off first generates a tight-fitting body proxy that provides estimated structural guidance, and Wear-On then synthesizes the target garment conditioned on this prior. This decoupling reduces source-garment interference, supporting garment placement under substantial silhouette variations. Built on this paradigm, we propose ToWo-VTON, a unified topology-aware framework with structure-aware supervision. We construct the Body-Fitting DressCode (BFDC) dataset via body-aware diffusion and VLM-based filtering to provide body-proxy supervision across upper-, lower-, and full-body cases. We instantiate ToWo-VTON on both diffusion-based and MLLM-guided backbones. For diffusion-based models, we fine-tune on BFDC using the body proxy as the person input. For the MLLM-guided model, we use native backbone conditioning for the body proxy and target garment, and add Garment Boosting Attention (GBA) to preserve garment details. Experiments on VITON-HD and DressCode demonstrate improvements over the evaluated baselines, with KID reductions of 26.1% and 58.6% for diffusion-based and MLLM-guided implementations, respectively. The combined BFDC-training and Take-Off/Wear-On strategy also produces more coherent limb layouts and garment boundaries across the evaluated garment categories.

AI.tldr: ToWo提出两阶段“Take-Off / Wear-On”范式，将身体结构估计与服装合成解耦，并构建BFDC数据集提供人体代理监督，在VITON-HD与DressCode上取得显著KID改进。
AI.motivation: 现有虚拟试衣方法在上衣场景表现良好，但在下装与全身场景中，面对复杂遮挡和大幅轮廓变化仍效果不佳。源服装信息会干扰人体结构判断，导致服装放置不准确。
AI.method: 1) 两阶段范式：Take-Off先生成紧身人体代理（body proxy）作为结构引导，Wear-On再以该先验为条件合成目标服装，从而降低源服装干扰；2) 构建Body-Fitting DressCode (BFDC)数据集，通过身体感知扩散与VLM过滤生成上/下/全身的人体代理监督；3) 提出ToWo-VTON统一拓扑感知框架，含结构感知监督，并在扩散骨干与MLLM引导骨干上分别实例化：扩散模型用body proxy作为人物输入在BFDC上微调，MLLM模型采用原生骨干条件并引入Garment Boosting Attention (GBA)保留服装细节。
AI.result: 在VITON-HD与DressCode上优于所评估基线，扩散实现与MLLM引导实现的KID分别降低26.1%与58.6%；BFDC训练结合Take-Off/Wear-On策略在各服装类别上生成更连贯的肢体布局与服装边界。
AI.conclusion: 将身体结构估计与服装合成解耦是提升下装与全身虚拟试衣的有效途径；配套的人体代理监督数据与拓扑感知框架可显著改善轮廓变化大、遮挡复杂场景下的合成质量。

title: LiveMirror: Real-Time Diffusion Virtual Try-On on a Consumer GPU and Its Self-Supervised Adaptation to Indian Ethnic Wear
summary: Diffusion virtual try-on (VTO) models produce convincing garment transfers from a single product photograph, but at hundreds of milliseconds to seconds per image every deployment today is offline or falls back to AR mirrors that need a rigged 3D asset per product. We present LiveMirror, a live-camera try-on mirror that renders a flat garment photograph onto a moving person with a diffusion model on one 16 GB consumer GPU. Its core is asynchronous keyframe try-on: generation never blocks the display, every displayed frame is an optical-flow warp of the latest generated keyframe, and keyframes are replaced only through a cross-fade. The display runs at camera rate (25 FPS at 720p) while a new try-on arrives every 370-490 ms; we measure the residual flicker, give a stage-by-stage latency budget, and report which accelerations (step count, consistency LoRA, tiny decoder, compilation) keep garment prints intact. We then show that the same GPU fixes the model's biggest cultural blind spot: try-on models trained on VITON-HD and DressCode render a knee-length kurta or sherwani as a torso-length top or a dress over bare legs. A thigh-covering mask, self-supervised pairs built automatically from 24.9k on-model e-commerce photographs, and 3.2 GPU-hours of attention-only fine-tuning of CatVTON halve the perceptual error on ethnic wear (LPIPS 0.137 to 0.077 on IndoFashion, 0.135 to 0.073 on Atlas; 200 held-out pairs per source) with no regression on Western tops. A two-pass hem-aware mask then removes the remaining failure, recoloured trousers below the hem, on all but 3-4% of pairs at no training cost; in the mirror the hem comes from the previous keyframe for free. The adapted model beats FASHN VTON 1.5 on every aggregate ethnic-wear metric at about $20\times$ lower inference cost, and its weights drop straight into the mirror.

AI.tldr: 提出 LiveMirror：单张 16GB 消费级 GPU 上以扩散模型实现实时摄像头虚拟试衣镜。核心为异步关键帧试衣（显示帧均为最新关键帧的光流形变，关键帧交叉淡入替换），显示达 720p/25FPS，新试衣结果每 370–490ms 到达。同时用大腿覆盖掩码、自监督成对数据与注意力微调修复南亚传统服饰（kurta/sherwani）的生成缺陷，并以两遍下摆感知掩码解决下摆以下裤装变色问题。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式 VTO 模型单图耗时数百毫秒至数秒，部署只能离线；AR 镜子方案又需每件商品配备绑定的 3D 资产。此外，在 VITON-HD/DressCode 上训练的模型存在明显文化偏差：把及膝 kurta/sherwani 生成为及腰上衣或露腿连衣裙。
AI.method: LiveMirror 采用异步关键帧架构：生成不阻塞显示，每帧显示为最新关键帧的光流形变，关键帧仅通过交叉淡化替换；报告残差闪烁、逐阶段延迟预算，并评估步数裁剪、一致性 LoRA、轻量解码器、编译等加速对印花保真度的影响。模型偏差修复方面：设计大腿覆盖掩码，从 24.9k 张模特电商图自动构建自监督成对数据，对 CatVTON 仅微调注意力层（3.2 GPU 小时）；再用两遍下摆感知掩码消除下摆以下裤装变色，镜中下摆可直接取自上一关键帧。
AI.result: 显示端 720p/25FPS，试衣结果每 370–490ms 更新一次。民族服饰感知误差减半：IndoFashion 上 LPIPS 0.137→0.077，Atlas 上 0.135→0.073（各 200 对留出样本），西方上衣无退化。两遍下摆感知掩码在无训练成本下，仅 3–4% 样本仍存在下摆以下裤装变色。聚合民族服饰指标全面优于 FASHN VTON 1.5，推理成本约低 20 倍，权重可直接用于镜子。
AI.conclusion: 异步关键帧+光流形变的架构使扩散 VTO 在消费级 GPU 上具备实时镜面交互能力；少量自监督数据与注意力微调即可显著缓解训练数据的文化偏差，配合下摆感知掩码基本消除残余失败，且可直接部署于实时镜子系统。

title: Benchmarking Geospatial Foundation Models under Calibrated Label Errors
comment: 100 pages (15 pages main text and references, 85 pages appendix), 78 figures, 68 tables. Extended version including supplementary material
summary: Earth-observation labels from maps, older products or hurried annotation arrive misaligned, coarse, loosely outlined or incomplete. Geospatial foundation models (GFMs) are nevertheless benchmarked with labels taken as correct. A practitioner therefore cannot tell which encoder to choose when the labels are imperfect. We present a benchmark protocol for fine-tuning under such labels. Four spatially structured error types are calibrated to equal label mIoU and applied identically to every model and seed. Every contrast is paired and read against an equivalence margin of $\pm 3$ points and a minimum detectable effect. We apply it to nine encoders, six decoder heads and ten datasets. In an exploratory reading at a matched learning rate the satellite-pretrained and web-pretrained DINOv3 encoders are equivalent within the margin on 8 of 9 datasets. Multispectral GFMs and an ImageNet ResNet-50 are equivalent within the margin on about half of them. Labels with random offsets cost the least at equal label quality. Under other decoder heads the verdicts mostly hold on FLAIR-2 and are decoder dependent on HLS Burn Scars. On four of five real label pairs the real label costs more than its matched simulated type. No choice of pretraining data makes an encoder consistently more robust, so the encoder is better chosen by its accuracy under imperfect labels.

AI.tldr: 提出在标签不完美条件下微调地理空间基础模型的基准协议：将四类空间结构误差校准到相同标签mIoU并统一施加，以配对比较+±3点等价边界判定编码器差异。
AI.motivation: 现实中的对地观测标签（来自地图、旧产品、仓促标注）存在错位、粗化、轮廓松散或不完整，但地理空间基础模型（GFM）的评测通常把这些标签视为正确，导致从业者在标签不完美时无法判断该选哪个编码器。
AI.method: 构建微调基准协议：设定四类空间结构误差，将其校准至相等的标签mIoU，并以同一方式施加于每个模型与随机种子；每项对比均配对进行，并对照±3个百分点的等价边界与最小可检测效应。实验覆盖9个编码器、6种解码器头和10个数据集。
AI.result: 在匹配学习率的探索性分析中，卫星预训练与网络预训练的DINOv3编码器在9个数据集中的8个上处于等价边界内；多光谱GFM与ImageNet ResNet-50约在一半数据集上等价。相同标签质量下，随机偏移类标签造成的损失最小。更换解码器头后，结论在FLAIR-2上基本保持，在HLS Burn Scars上依赖解码器。5组真实标签对中4组显示真实标签的代价高于其匹配的模拟误差类型。
AI.conclusion: 没有任何预训练数据选择能使编码器持续更鲁棒；因此应依据编码器在不完美标签下的精度来选型，而非依据预训练数据来源。

title: Assembly-JEPA: Using World Models for Fine-Grained Industrial Image Verification
summary: Automated verification of industrial assembly processes remains a challenging problem due to substantial visual variability, limited availability of labeled defect data, and the fine-grained nature of many assembly errors. Existing approaches often rely on object detection, CAD models, or supervised classification pipelines, which can struggle to generalize across changing products and assembly configurations. In this work, we propose a novel self-supervised assembly verification framework based on Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs). Starting from the JEPA-based world model LeWorldModel, we investigate how the architecture must be adapted to verify the correctness of fine-grained assembly operations. To this end, we formulate assembly verification as a predictive world modeling task operating on before-and-after observations of assembly processes. Experimental results on industrial assembly tasks demonstrate that the proposed approach reliably detects both fine-grained incorrect assembly states and action-state mismatches, achieving an AUROC of 86.9% on a newly introduced assembly verification dataset. These results indicate that JEPA-based predictive representations constitute a promising foundation for robust and data-efficient industrial assembly verification.

AI.tldr: 提出基于JEPA自监督世界模型的装配过程验证框架，将装配正确性验证建模为前后观测的预测性世界建模任务，在工业装配任务上可检测细粒度错误装配状态与动作-状态不匹配，新数据集上AUROC达86.9%。
AI.motivation: 工业装配过程自动验证面临三大挑战：视觉变异性大、缺陷标注数据稀缺、装配错误多为细粒度。现有方法依赖目标检测、CAD模型或监督分类流程，难以在产品与装配配置变化时泛化。
AI.method: 提出基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的自监督装配验证框架。以JEPA世界模型LeWorldModel为起点，研究架构需如何适配细粒度装配操作验证；将装配验证形式化为作用于装配过程"前—后"观测的预测性世界建模任务。
AI.result: 在工业装配任务实验中，该方法可靠检测细粒度错误装配状态及动作-状态不匹配，在新建的装配验证数据集上取得86.9%的AUROC。
AI.conclusion: JEPA式预测表征可作为鲁棒、数据高效的工业装配验证的有前景基础，为免标注、可泛化的装配验证提供了新思路。

title: RoomTokens: Masked Diffusion over Structured Tokens for Indoor Scene Synthesis
summary: Generating 3D indoor scenes requires a representation that captures object semantics, instance identity, height structure, and orientation while respecting room geometry. Methods that model scenes as sequences of object vectors learn spatial constraints implicitly, leaving collisions and boundary violations to losses or post-processing; semantic-map methods make occupancy explicit, but collapse instance and directional structure. We introduce RoomTokens, a sliced structured-token representation in which each token stores semantic class, instance-color identity, and facing field.
