This representation allows a scene to be generated as a discrete grid while preserving cues for instance grouping, orientation estimation, and 3D extent prediction. To learn the RoomToken distribution, we propose MDIRT (Masked Diffusion over RoomTokens), a masked discrete diffusion model that denoises semantic/instance-color/facing channels jointly with a shared cross-slice backbone. Architectural tokens are clamped as explicit floor- plan constraints, so the model samples furniture layouts that respect room geometry while retaining instance and object-attribute structure. Experiments on 3D-FRONT show that RoomTokens with MDIRT improve layout fidelity and physical consistency over sequence/vector- and map-based methods, suggesting structured spatial tokens as a practical choice for discrete 3D scene synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出 RoomTokens 结构化切片 token 表示与 MDIRT 掩码离散扩散模型，将 3D 室内场景生成为离散网格，同时保留实例、朝向与语义信息，并在 3D-FRONT 上取得更优的布局保真度与物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 室内场景生成方法存在两类局限：序列/向量式表示隐式学习空间约束，碰撞与越界只能依赖损失函数或后处理；语义地图式表示虽显式建模占用，却丢失实例身份与朝向结构。因此需要一个同时编码语义、实例、高度结构与朝向、又能显式约束房间几何的表示。
AI.method: 设计 RoomTokens：一种切片式结构化 token，每个 token 编码语义类别、实例颜色标识与朝向场（facing field），使场景可作为离散网格生成并支持实例分组、朝向估计与 3D 范围预测。提出 MDIRT（Masked Diffusion over RoomTokens），在共享跨切片骨干网络上对语义/实例颜色/朝向三个通道联合去噪；并将建筑元素 token 钳制为显式平面图约束。
AI.result: 在 3D-FRONT 数据集上，RoomTokens+MDIRT 相比序列/向量式与地图式方法，在布局保真度和物理一致性（碰撞、边界合规）上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 结构化空间 token 可将离散扩散生成与显式几何约束结合，是离散 3D 场景合成的一种实用表示选择。

title: BEND: Spectral Bregman Losses for Multi-Image Unlearning in Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models memorize training images and reproduce them almost verbatim when prompted, creating copyright and privacy liabilities. Data unlearning erases the influence of specific training samples from a trained model without retraining, and is two-sided: it must forget the targets while preserving generation quality on everything else. Prior methods use the squared-L2 diffusion loss, at most with a hand-set frequency mask; however, it is known that every Bregman divergence is a mathematically valid choice and the squared-L2 is only the simplest example. BEND is the first to search this family: it fits a spectral Bregman divergence to the unlearning task through a bilevel loop, so the loss itself is shaped to forget thoroughly while protecting quality. It also redirects a memorized image to the mean of its retain images, where ReTrack, the state of the art, redirects it to a single near-copy. On Stable Diffusion, a single BEND model erases all 48 verifiably memorized benchmark images at once. It forgets at least as much as per-target, sequential, and jointly trained ReTrack (SSCD 0.084 versus 0.094-0.120), at the quality of the model before unlearning (CLIP-IQA 0.81 versus 0.64-0.69). BEND also outperforms the state of the art on CelebA-HQ in all three measures of the benchmark, and matches or exceeds it on MNIST and CIFAR-10.

AI.tldr: BEND 首次提出在 Bregman 散度族中为扩散模型遗忘任务搜索损失函数：通过双层优化拟合谱域 Bregman 散度，并将被记忆图像重定向至其保留集的均值，在 Stable Diffusion 上一次遗忘全部 48 张可验证记忆图像，遗忘更强且生成质量几乎无损。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型会近乎逐字复现训练图像，带来版权与隐私风险。数据遗忘需双向平衡：既要彻底遗忘目标样本，又要保持其余生成质量。已有方法固定使用 squared-L2 扩散损失（至多加手工频域掩码），而理论上前提是任意 Bregman 散度均合法，squared-L2 只是最简单特例，因此损失函数本身值得被优化。
AI.method: 提出 BEND：在谱域参数化的 Bregman 散度族上，用双层优化（bilevel loop）针对遗忘任务拟合散度形式，使损失函数被"塑形"以兼顾彻底遗忘与质量保护；同时改写遗忘目标的重定向方式，将被记忆图像推向其保留集（retain images）的均值，而非 SOTA 方法 ReTrack 所采用的单张近复制样本。
AI.result: 在 Stable Diffusion 上，单个 BEND 模型一次性遗忘全部 48 张经可验证记忆的基准图像。遗忘程度不低于逐目标、顺序及联合训练的 ReTrack（SSCD 0.084 vs 0.094–0.120），且生成质量维持在遗忘前水平（CLIP-IQA 0.81 vs 0.64–0.69）。在 CelebA-HQ 上三项指标均优于 SOTA，在 MNIST 与 CIFAR-10 上持平或超过。
AI.conclusion: 损失函数的选择是扩散模型遗忘的关键设计维度；在 Bregman 散度族中任务自适应地搜索损失，配合向保留集均值重定向，可同时实现强遗忘与高质量保持，并具备跨数据集、跨基准的泛化性，优于现有 SOTA。

title: EditGRN: Inversion-Free Image Editing by Source-Target Generative Synchronization
summary: Text-guided image editing faces a persistent trade-off between preserving source content and realizing coherent target semantics. We explore this challenge through training- and inversion-free image editing based on discrete generative models. Existing inversion-free discrete editors primarily rely on post-hoc probability correction, creating a disconnect between local token-level adjustments and globally coherent semantic generation. To bridge this gap, we introduce EditGRN, a training- and inversion-free framework with trajectory-wide source-target generative synchronization in discrete space. EditGRN adopts a dual-branch design---the source branch constructs source references and the target branch generates the target image-enabling trajectory-wide synchronization between the two. Exploiting GRN's ability to recover clean tokens from arbitrary binary corruptions, the source branch directly constructs corrupted source states at each refinement step to extract useful editing features, without recovering a specific source-generation trajectory. The target branch synchronizes with the source branch through the same corruption schedule, fusing the corresponding source context with editable representations intra-model. By synchronizing source context with target generation along the entire trajectory, our approach faithfully preserves the background while producing high-quality edits that blend seamlessly with the surrounding scene through intra-model fusion. PIE-Bench show state-of-the-art performance on background preservation and text alignment across diverse editing tasks against continuous and discrete baselines.

AI.tldr: EditGRN：基于离散生成模型（GRN）的无训练、无反转图像编辑框架，通过双分支在整条生成轨迹上同步源与目标特征，兼顾背景保持与文本对齐。
AI.motivation: 文本引导图像编辑存在"保持源内容"与"实现连贯目标语义"之间的固有权衡。现有无反转离散编辑方法依赖事后的概率校正，导致局部 token 级调整与全局语义生成之间脱节。
AI.method: 提出 EditGRN 双分支框架：源分支在每个细化步骤直接构造二值损坏的源状态，利用 GRN 从任意二值损坏中恢复干净 token 的能力提取编辑特征，无需恢复特定的源生成轨迹；目标分支采用相同的损坏调度与源分支同步，在模型内部融合对应源上下文与可编辑表示，实现轨迹级源-目标生成同步。
AI.result: 在 PIE-Bench 上，相较于连续与离散基线方法，在多种编辑任务的背景保持与文本对齐指标上取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
AI.conclusion: 沿整条轨迹融合源上下文可忠实保持背景，并生成与周围场景自然融合的高质量编辑结果，表明轨迹级同步优于事后概率校正范式。

title: PixelOne: From Options to Pixels in a Single Forward for GUI Grounding
summary: GUI grounding requires precise clicks at low latency. Recent models such as GUI-Decisions and GUI-Swift predict coordinates in one forward pass using fixed global bins with local refinement. However, screenshot downsampling removes detail needed to locate small controls, while fixed bins cover larger pixel ranges at higher resolutions. We introduce PixelOne, which transfers spatial knowledge from a search teacher to a student that predicts clicks directly from screenshots at native resolution. The teacher uses VideoJEV's text-option scorer to select rows and columns and progressively zoom into candidate regions. The student inherits the teacher's parameters and matches its distributions over explored regions through spatial distillation alongside box supervision. At inference, the same decision head selects a visual token, and a lightweight pixel head predicts the click within it, all in one forward pass. A click-aligned loss encourages pixels inside the target box to score above those outside. Across four benchmarks, PixelOne-Pro-35B-A3B achieves 83.8% mean accuracy, the highest among the evaluated single-forward grounders, with a mean latency of 0.43 s per target.

AI.tldr: 提出PixelOne：将搜索式教师的空间知识蒸馏给学生，使学生能在原生分辨率截图上单次前向预测点击，兼顾高精度与低延迟（Pro-35B-A3B 平均准确率83.8%，平均延迟0.43秒）。
AI.motivation: GUI grounding需要在低延迟下实现精确点击。现有单次前向方法（GUI-Decisions、GUI-Swift）用固定全局分箱+局部细化，但截图下采样丢失小控件所需细节，而固定分箱在高分辨率下覆盖的像素范围过大，导致精度受限。
AI.method: 1) 教师模型基于VideoJEV的文本选项打分器，选择行与列并逐步缩放至候选区域，形成搜索式定位；2) 学生模型继承教师参数，在原生分辨率截图上直接预测点击；3) 通过空间蒸馏匹配教师在探索区域上的分布，并结合框监督；4) 推理时共享同一决策头选择视觉token，轻量像素头在该token内回归点击坐标，单次前向完成；5) 引入点击对齐损失，使目标框内像素得分高于框外。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，PixelOne-Pro-35B-A3B取得83.8%的平均准确率，为所评估的单次前向grounder中最高，同时平均每个目标延迟仅0.43秒。
AI.conclusion: 通过将渐进搜索教师的空间能力蒸馏为单次前向的token选择+像素回归范式，PixelOne在原生分辨率下实现了精度与延迟的较优折中，说明搜索式监督可有效迁移至高效推理模型。

title: JONES-19: A Cultural Image Dataset Based on The Grammar of Ornament
comment: 13 pages. Published in the Proceedings of the 22nd International Conference on Culture and Computer Science (KUI '25), Berlin, Germany, September 2025. Dataset available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/harvardseas-cultural-ornaments/JONES-19
summary: We introduce JONES-19, a high-quality image dataset documenting 1,901 ornament designs belonging to nineteen human cultures. The images and their annotations are based on an open access archive of The Grammar of Ornament (London, 1856), by Owen Jones. The dataset poses numerous challenges as a benchmark for computer vision classification tasks and for research at the intersection of machine learning and art and design: a small sample size, image samples of human-designed artifacts rather than common objects in-context or natural scenes, imbalanced class distribution, and image distinctions based on fine details involving line patterns, reliefs, and colors. As a design-inspired dataset, JONES-19 can serve as a benchmark for various research fields, such as visual recognition, data-efficient learning, art-historical research, architectural style analysis, and cultural heritage. This paper describes the curation of the JONES-19 dataset and reports a baseline classification benchmark that evaluates the suitability of the dataset for training classifiers and exposes insights into inter-class relationships--particularly cultural similarities--by examining patterns in misclassification errors. The dataset and its accompanying documentation are available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/harvardseas-cultural-ornaments/JONES-19.

AI.tldr: 本文发布JONES-19数据集：基于1856年Owen Jones《The Grammar of Ornament》开放档案整理的19种人类文化的1901个装饰图案图像及标注，用于视觉分类、数据高效学习、艺术史与文化遗产研究基准。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉数据集多基于自然场景或常见物体，缺少以人类设计的装饰性人工制品为对象、类别区分依赖线条纹样/浮雕/色彩等细粒度特征的基准；同时该类艺术与设计交叉研究亟需高质量小样本数据集。
AI.method: 以《The Grammar of Ornament》(London, 1856)开放获取档案为基础，进行图像采集、清洗与标注，构建包含19个文化类别、1901个图案的JONES-19数据集；并设计分类基线实验，通过误分类错误模式分析类间关系（尤其是文化相似性）。
AI.result: 给出JONES-19的构建流程与基线分类性能，验证其可用于训练分类器的适用性；误分类模式揭示了类间相似性结构，特别是不同文化装饰风格之间的关联。数据集呈现小样本、类别分布不均衡、依赖细粒度线条与色彩细节等挑战。
AI.conclusion: JONES-19可作为视觉识别、数据高效学习、艺术史研究、建筑风格分析与文化遗产等领域的基准数据集，数据集及文档已在Hugging Face公开。

title: AIGI-26: A Benchmark for AI-Generated Image Detection Across Diverse Modern Generators
summary: Existing AI-generated image (AIGI) detection benchmarks predominantly rely on earlier synthesis systems with limited content diversity and conspicuous artifacts, failing to fully reflect the detection challenges posed by high-fidelity images from contemporary models. We introduce AIGI-26, a benchmark of 253,200 images covering 26 recent open- and closed-source generators. Its novel, diverse, and heterogeneous sources provide a basis for systematically evaluating detection methods on modern generated imagery. Additionally, to capture subtle statistical discrepancies across complementary forensic views, we propose the multi-aspect forensic detection network (MAFDNet). Its fixed forensic operators expose complementary texture, local prediction, resampling, and chromatic responses, summarized by a hierarchical encoder using multiscale means and standard deviations. In parallel, a spectral branch captures Fourier log-magnitude and neighboring-frequency phase variation across radial bands and directional axes. Fusing these descriptors combines local inconsistencies with global spectral organization for authenticity detection. Trained on 12,660 AIGI-26 images, MAFDNet achieves 88.5% accuracy and 94.9% average precision on the 240,540-image test set, with only 1.04M parameters and 1.39 GFLOPs per $256\times256$ input. MAFDNet also demonstrates effective cross-dataset generalization on DailyBench and Treasure-37.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AIGI-26高保真AIGI检测基准（253,200张图、26个近源与闭源生成器）及多视角取证网络MAFDNet，融合纹理/预测/重采样/色度响应与频谱描述子，仅1.04M参数即在240,540张测试集上取得88.5%准确率与94.9% AP，并在DailyBench、Treasure-37上展现良好跨数据集泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGI检测基准多基于早期合成系统，内容多样性有限且伪影明显，无法反映当代高保真生成图像带来的检测挑战，需要更具现代性、多样性与异质性的评测基准与更具判别力的检测方法。
AI.method: 构建AIGI-26基准；提出MAFDNet：用固定取证算子提取纹理、局部预测、重采样与色度互补响应，经多尺度均值/标准差的分层编码器汇总；并行频谱分支在径向频带与方向轴上捕获Fourier对数幅值与邻频相位变化；融合局部不一致性与全局频谱组织进行真伪判别。
AI.result: 仅用12,660张AIGI-26图像训练，在240,540张测试集上达88.5%准确率、94.9%平均精度，参数量1.04M、256×256输入单次1.39 GFLOPs；在DailyBench与Treasure-37上亦具有效跨数据集泛化。
AI.conclusion: 现代高保真AIGI检测需依赖高质量、异质性基准与多视角取证特征融合；MAFDNet以极低计算开销实现强性能与泛化能力，可作为轻量化AIGI取证的有效范式。

title: Advancements in Diabetic Retinopathy Classification Using Novel Multi-Stacked U-Net Architectures
summary: Diabetes leads to several health complications throughout the body, with the complication in the eyes being Diabetic Retinopathy. It leads to damaging or abnormal changes in the blood vessels' structure, causing vision loss. The need for massive screening of a large population of diabetic patients has created a necessity for computer-aided, fully automatic diagnosis of DR. CNNs have shown great promise in the classification of DR based on the Fundus images. Building a reliable model faces considerable challenges due to the limited availability of high-quality annotated datasets and issues with varying image quality and class imbalances. This paper aims to demonstrate the UNET, and its Stacked Architecture variant and their performance across several datasets. This paper has compared and studied the UNET architecture's performance across multiple stacks and has come to a soft conclusion that the architecture performs its best at three stacks, and any more leads to deterioration of its performance. The model aims at classifying the images into five categories, 0 to 4, where 0 is no DR, and 4 is proliferative DR.

AI.tldr: 本文比较UNET及其堆叠架构变体在多个眼底图像数据集上对糖尿病视网膜病变五级分类的性能，得出三层堆叠效果最佳、继续加深会退化性能的软结论。
AI.motivation: 糖尿病患者基数大，需要对大量人群进行糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）筛查，因此迫切需要计算机辅助的全自动诊断。CNN在基于眼底图像的DR分类上表现良好，但高质量标注数据有限、图像质量不一及类别不平衡等问题使构建可靠模型面临挑战，需考察网络深度对性能的影响。
AI.method: 以UNET为基础架构并构建其堆叠（Stacked）变体，在不同堆叠层数下跨多个DR数据集训练分类模型，输出0~4共五个等级（0为无DR，4为增殖期DR），对比研究不同堆叠深度下的性能表现。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的比较表明，UNET堆叠架构在三个堆叠层时性能最佳，堆叠层数继续增加则导致性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 作者给出较温和（soft）的结论：UNET堆叠结构的最优深度约为三层，过深的堆叠无益反而有害；该结果可为DR自动筛查模型的设计提供参考。

title: OCCA-Seg: Object and Channel Context Aggregation for Semantic Segmentation of Remote Sensing Images
summary: Semantic segmentation, which assigns a class label to each pixel, is a key task in computer vision. However, semantic segmentation of remote sensing images (RSIs) remains challenging because of complex scenes and objects at multiple scales, which limits segmentation accuracy. To address these challenges, we propose a context aggregation scheme called object and channel context aggregation (OCCA), consisting of three components: object contextual attention module (OCAM), channel contextual attention module (CCAM), and aggregation module (AM). Firstly, motivated by the observation that each pixel shares the class label of the object to which it belongs, object-level context represents each pixel through aggregating context from its corresponding object class. Secondly, because feature channels are correlated with object categories, channel-wise context models channel-wise contextual dependencies conditioned on object categories. Finally, the context information from OCAM and CCAM are fed into AM and used to weight and modulate the object context, enhancing the discriminative ability of the segmentation model. The experiments on several public remote sensing datasets including LoveDA, UAVid, ISPRS Potsdam, and Vaihingen datasets demonstrate competitive improvements over existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出对象与通道上下文聚合（OCCA）方案，用于提升遥感图像语义分割精度。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像场景复杂、目标尺度多样，导致语义分割精度受限。
AI.method: OCCA 包含三个模块：对象上下文注意力模块（OCAM），基于“像素与其所属对象共享类标签”的观察，通过聚合所属对象类的上下文来表示每个像素；通道上下文注意力模块（CCAM），利用特征通道与目标类别的相关性建模类别条件下的通道上下文依赖；聚合模块（AM），融合 OCAM 与 CCAM 的上下文信息，对对象上下文进行加权与调制。
AI.result: 在 LoveDA、UAVid、ISPRS Potsdam、Vaihingen 等多个公开遥感数据集上取得优于现有方法的竞争性提升。
AI.conclusion: 对象级与通道级上下文的协同聚合可增强分割模型的判别能力，有效应对遥感图像的复杂场景与多尺度目标。

title: RigidAnchor: Cross-View Geo-Localization for UAV via Iterative Planar Rigid Alignment
summary: A UAV that flies without GNSS has to estimate its absolute position and heading without any external signal. Most existing methods for UAV-to-satellite cross-view geo-localization (U-S CVGL) treat the task as image retrieval: they compress the UAV image and each satellite tile into separate descriptors, rank the tiles by their similarity, and return the center of the best tile. The output can therefore only lie on a pre-defined grid, its accuracy is limited by the tile size, and no heading is produced. Regressing the pose in a single pass removes the grid, but it leaves no chance to correct the estimate afterwards. We observe that satellite tiles are not independent samples. They are laid on the map at a fixed spacing, scale and orientation, so neighboring tiles join into one continuous satellite block with a consistent metric, and a nadir UAV view of that block differs from it by a planar rigid transform only, i.e. a 2D translation plus an in-plane rotation. We therefore reformulate U-S CVGL as solving for this transform between two images of different sizes. Position and heading then become parts of one geometric quantity, and the accuracy is no longer limited by the tile grid. We propose RigidAnchor, which solves the transform iteratively. The network encodes the two images and builds a multi-level correlation pyramid between them. At each iteration, it indexes the pyramid with every aerial cell carried through the current estimate, pools the descriptors of all cells into one hidden state, and lets two decoupled heads predict a translation increment and a rotation increment, the latter being composed rather than added. On Bearing-UAV-90K, the cross-view mean errors are 78.6% lower in position and 69.7% lower in heading than Bearing-UAV, and HSR@15 increases by 19.06 points. Code is available at https://github.com/wwsource/RigidAnchor.

AI.tldr: 提出RigidAnchor，将UAV-卫星跨视角地理定位重构为求解两幅不同尺寸图像间的平面刚体变换（2D平移+面内旋转），通过多级相关金字塔迭代求解平移与旋转增量，突破瓦片网格精度限制并同时输出位置与航向。
AI.motivation: 现有U-S CVGL多被视为图像检索，将UAV图像与各卫星瓦片分别编码后按相似度排序并返回最佳瓦片中心，输出只能落在预设网格上、精度受瓦片尺寸限制且无法给出航向；单次回归位姿虽去网格但无后续纠错机会。作者观察到卫星瓦片按固定间距、尺度与朝向铺设，相邻瓦片拼接成具有一致度量的连续卫星块，下视UAV视图与该块仅相差一个平面刚体变换。
AI.method: 将任务重构为求解两幅不同尺寸图像间的平面刚体变换，使位置与航向成为同一几何量。RigidAnchor迭代求解该变换：网络编码两幅图像并构建多级相关金字塔；每次迭代用当前估计携带每个空中单元索引金字塔，将所有单元描述子池化为一个隐状态，由两个解耦头分别预测平移增量与旋转增量，其中旋转以复合（compose）而非相加方式更新。
AI.result: 在Bearing-UAV-90K上，跨视角平均位置误差较Bearing-UAV降低78.6%，航向误差降低69.7%，HSR@15提升19.06个点。
AI.conclusion: 以连续卫星块上的平面刚体变换替代离散检索，可在不依赖GNSS与外源信号条件下实现不受瓦片网格限制的绝对位置与航向联合估计，并通过迭代细化获得可纠正的精度提升。

title: Reconstructing 3D+t Cardiovascular Flow From Sparse Planar Velocity Fields With Neural Fields
summary: Reconstructing time-resolved three-dimensional (3D+t) cardiovascular flow from sparse planar measurements is challenging because each plane observes only the two in-plane velocity components, on a small part of the volume. We propose a plane-aware neural-field framework that learns a continuous 3D velocity field from space and time coordinates through a per-plane projection, and then investigate the potential benefits of physics constraints. We evaluate the framework on computational aortic and aneurysm datasets, and on planes resampled from a real cardiac 4D Flow MRI scan. A plain multi-layer perceptron (MLP) was more accurate than classical radial basis function (RBF) interpolation on both computational datasets. For the aorta, a physics-constrained SIREN (PC-SIREN) reduced the rRMSE further to $0.3756$, compared with $0.4273$ for the plain MLP and $0.7256$ for RBF, and it was the most accurate model in every anatomical segment of the MRI data. For the aneurysms the plain MLP remained the most accurate model, with an rRMSE of $0.07$ to $0.16$ against $0.55$ to $0.71$ for PC-SIREN. Further experiments investigated scanning configuration, number of scans, and spatial resolution. These findings show that continuous neural fields can reconstruct volumetric cardiovascular flow from sparse planar measurements, and that physics constraints have to be matched to the flow.

AI.tldr: 提出平面感知神经场框架，从稀疏平面测量重建3D+t心血管流场，并评估物理约束的适用条件。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏二维平面测量重建三维时间分辨心血管流场（3D+t）十分困难：每个平面仅观测面内两个速度分量，且只覆盖体数据的一小部分。作者欲验证连续神经场能否胜任该任务，并探究物理约束是否带来增益。
AI.method: 构建平面感知（plane-aware）神经场：以时空坐标为输入学习连续三维速度场，并通过逐平面投影算子与观测平面匹配。比较三种模型：普通MLP、物理约束SIREN（PC-SIREN）、经典RBF插值。在计算主动脉与动脉瘤数据集，以及由真实心脏4D Flow MRI重采样的平面上评测，并进一步考察扫描配置、扫描数量与空间分辨率的影响。
AI.result: 两个计算数据集上MLP均优于RBF。主动脉上PC-SIREN将rRMSE降至0.3756（MLP 0.4273，RBF 0.7256），且在MRI数据每个解剖分区中最准确；动脉瘤上MLP最优，rRMSE为0.07–0.16，而PC-SIREN为0.55–0.71。
AI.conclusion: 连续神经场可从稀疏平面测量重建体心血管流场，性能优于经典RBF插值；但物理约束的收益依赖流场本身特性，须与目标流动相匹配，例如主动脉大尺度平滑流动受益，动脉瘤复杂局部流动则受损。

title: AdvMTO: Multimodal and Temporal Adversarial Object Attacks via 2D Gaussian Splatting for BEV-Based 3D Object Detection
summary: Adversarial object attacks pose a threat to BEV-based 3D object detectors in autonomous driving. Existing attacks typically target a single modality, coordinate camera and LiDAR observations at the current timestamp, or model temporal persistence mainly in camera streams. Without a unified construction of current and historical observations, attacks can leave part of the detector's accumulated evidence unsuppressed, limiting their effectiveness. In this paper, we propose AdvMTO, a 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) framework for suppressing detection of persistent adversarial objects. Its oriented surfels encode appearance, geometry, and opacity in one object state, from which camera images and scanline LiDAR returns are generated. AdvMTO then constructs current and historical inputs through detector-native processing, regenerating LiDAR returns in each native source sweep for fusion detectors. We optimize bounded appearance perturbations for each detector, propagating gradients through historical BEV memory for temporal camera detectors. For fusion detectors, bounded geometry refinement along local normals further perturbs both sensing modalities. Experiments on nuScenes demonstrate effective suppression of traffic-cone detection across three BEV detectors. Temporal ablations further highlight the importance of detector-native history modeling for both attack construction and optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出 AdvMTO：基于 2D 高斯泼溅（2DGS）的统一框架，从同一物体状态同时生成相机图像与扫描线式 LiDAR 回波，并通过检测器原生处理构造当前与历史观测，抑制 BEV 3D 检测器对持续对抗物体的检测。
AI.motivation: 现有针对 BEV 3D 检测器的对抗物体攻击多只针对单一模态，或仅在当前时间戳对齐相机与 LiDAR，时序持续性建模主要局限于相机流；缺乏对当前与历史观测的统一建模，导致检测器累积证据中仍有部分未被压制，攻击效果受限。
AI.method: 以带朝向的面元（oriented surfels）在单一物体状态中编码外观、几何与不透明度，用 2DGS 渲染出相机图像与扫描线 LiDAR 回波；再经检测器原生处理流程重建当前与历史输入（对融合检测器在每条原始扫描中重新生成回波）。优化上，对每个检测器优化有界外观扰动，并让梯度回传穿过时序 BEV 记忆以攻击时序相机检测器；对融合检测器额外沿局部法向进行有界几何细化，从而同时扰动两种传感模态。
AI.result: 在 nuScenes 数据集上，对三种 BEV 检测器均能有效抑制交通锥（traffic-cone）的检测；时序消融实验进一步表明，检测器原生的历史建模对攻击构造与优化都至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 统一的可微 2DGS 物体表示与检测器原生时序建模，能有效提升对 BEV 3D 检测器的持续性对抗攻击效果，历史观测建模是不可忽略的关键因素。

title: Uncovering Separable and Composable Skill Mechanisms in Vision-Language Models
summary: Recent work has sought to localize the internal mechanisms underlying visual reasoning skills in vision-language models. These methods largely overlook separability and composability in both mechanism identification and evaluation. We propose separability and composability as two important desiderata for skill localization. Separability requires identified mechanisms to contribute primarily to their target skills while having limited effects on other skills, enabling precise diagnosis and targeted intervention. Composability requires skill mechanisms to be combinable to support complex tasks, allowing a small set of mechanisms to account for broader capabilities. In this work, we propose a multi-skill interpretability framework DISCO, built around these two properties. For identification, we propose Separable Head Selection, which selects skill-specific attention heads based on their contributions across skills. For evaluation, we are the first to design metrics for measuring separability and composability of identified heads. Extensive experiments on three VLMs and four fundamental visual reasoning skills demonstrate the effectiveness of DISCO. It achieves the highest separability, outperforming the strongest baseline by 24.80, 18.38, and 13.75 points across the three models, respectively, while also achieving the highest composability on all three models.

AI.tldr: 提出多技能可解释性框架DISCO，以"可分离性"与"可组合性"为技能定位的两大准则，通过Separable Head Selection识别技能专属注意力头，并首次给出二者的量化指标。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型视觉推理技能的内部机制定位工作，在机制识别与评估两个环节均忽略了机制的可分离性与可组合性，导致难以精确诊断与定向干预，也无法用小规模机制解释更广泛能力。
AI.method: 将可分离性（机制主要贡献目标技能、对其他技能影响有限）与可组合性（技能机制可组合支撑复杂任务）定义为技能定位的核心desiderata；构建多技能可解释性框架DISCO：识别阶段采用Separable Head Selection，基于注意力头在各技能上的贡献差异筛选技能专属头；评估阶段首次设计可分离性与可组合性的度量指标。
AI.result: 在3个视觉语言模型与4项基础视觉推理技能上的实验表明DISCO有效：可分离性最优，在三个模型上分别超过最强基线24.80、18.38和13.75个百分点，并在三个模型上均取得最高的可组合性。
AI.conclusion: 可分离性与可组合性应作为技能定位的关键设计准则；DISCO在机制识别与评估两方面同时落实这两点，验证了技能专属注意力头既精确又可通过组合覆盖复杂能力。

title: DyLoMo-DiT: Dynamic Looped Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Transformers
comment: 46 pages, 29 figures, 33 tables. Code, weights and project page: https://oneboxcream.github.io/DyLoMo-DiT/
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) scale model capacity by increasing both parameter count and computation. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants expand parameter capacity while keeping per-token computation roughly fixed, but still require substantial parameter storage. In this paper, we propose Dynamic Looped MoE DiT (DyLoMo-DiT), which reuses parameters rather than adding them: a weight-shared loop repeatedly applies the middle layers, while sparse experts allocate parameter capacity across tokens. This design deepens the network without adding parameters, freeing the parameter budget for other uses, such as more experts or more distinct layers. It also allocates compute dynamically, varying the number of passes across noise levels. Experiments show that DyLoMo-DiT makes more effective use of parameter and compute budgets, with further gains from assigning more passes to low-noise steps. On ImageNet $256\times256$, DyLoMo-DiT reduces FID by 11-24% relative to DiT and 36-56% relative to DiT-MoE at matched parameter and compute budgets. For text-to-image generation, a scaled DyLoMo-DiT achieves a higher GenEval score than FLUX.1 (0.714 vs. 0.673), with less than one tenth of its active parameters (1.05B vs. 12B).

AI.tldr: DyLoMo-DiT 通过"权重共享循环中间层 + 稀疏专家"在参数量与计算量受限下复用而非增加参数，并根据噪声水平动态分配循环次数，在 ImageNet 256×256 与文本到图像任务上显著优于 DiT、DiT-MoE 及 FLUX.1。
AI.motivation: DiT 靠增加参数与计算提升容量，MoE 变体虽扩大参数容量并保持每 token 计算近似固定，但仍需大量参数存储。核心痛点是参数预算的利用效率不高，需要在固定参数与计算预算下寻找更有效的容量扩展方式。
AI.method: 提出 DyLoMo-DiT：(1) 权重共享的循环结构，反复施加中间层，在不新增参数的前提下加深网络，从而把参数预算释放给更多专家或更多独立层；(2) 稀疏 MoE 专家按 token 分配参数容量；(3) 动态计算分配，按噪声水平改变循环次数，并为低噪声步分配更多 pass。
AI.result: 在参数与计算预算匹配条件下，ImageNet 256×256 上 FID 相对 DiT 降低 11–24%，相对 DiT-MoE 降低 36–56%；低噪声步分配更多 pass 带来额外增益。文生图方面，缩放版 DyLoMo-DiT 的 GenEval 得分为 0.714，高于 FLUX.1 的 0.673，而激活参数仅 1.05B（对比 12B），不足其十分之一。
AI.conclusion: 参数复用（循环共享）与稀疏专家的组合，配合按噪声水平动态分配计算，能更高效地利用参数与计算预算，是扩散 Transformer 扩容的一条高效路径。

title: PinGround: Pinning Queries to Points for Parallel Grounding in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can localize through their text interface, grounding open-vocabulary objects, complex referring expressions, text lines and layout regions with strong semantic understanding. They write the boxes one after another as a single sequence, although the instances of a query, unlike the words of a sentence, form an unordered set with no sequential dependence. The number of decoding steps therefore grows with the number of instances, which makes dense scenes the most expensive. Decoding the instances in parallel avoids this growth, but streams that cannot see each other duplicate some instances and miss others. We propose \method, which writes a single point into each query as a spatial anchor and asks for the matching instance nearest to that point within a local radius, or \none. Given the image, the anchored queries are independent, so they are decoded in parallel as leaves of a prefix tree that shares the image and the query, and the model is trained on the same tree. Coarse-to-fine anchors refine only the regions where instances are found, duplicate suppression keeps one box per instance, and set-level reinforcement learning optimizes the set F1. Only the prompt and the attention mask change, not the architecture. On three different VLMs and 12 benchmarks covering detection, OCR, layout and referring, \method is at most 5.5 F1 below sequential decoding trained on the same data, while its speedup grows with instance density and reaches 21.9$\times$ on dense scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出 \method：把每个查询实例转为"点锚定+局部半径内就近匹配"的独立查询，使实例可并行解码为共享图像与前缀的树状叶子，在不改架构的前提下实现稠密场景最高 21.9× 加速，F1 损失不超过 5.5。
AI.motivation: VLM 通过文本接口以单序列逐个写出框来做定位，但实例本质是无序集合、不存在序列依赖，导致解码步数随实例数增长，稠密场景代价最高；而朴素并行解码因各流互不可见，会造成实例重复与漏检。
AI.method: 在每个查询中写入一个点作为空间锚，要求模型输出局部半径内距该点最近的匹配实例（或 \none），从而使锚定查询彼此独立；以共享图像与查询的前缀树形式并行解码叶子节点，训练亦在同一树上进行；辅以由粗到细的锚点仅细化有实例的区域、去重抑制保证一实例一框、集合级强化学习优化 set F1；仅改动 prompt 与 attention mask，不改动模型架构。
AI.result: 在 3 个 VLM 与 12 个基准（检测、OCR、版面、指代）上，\method 较同数据训练的序列解码 F1 最多低 5.5，但加速比随实例密度增长，稠密场景达 21.9×。
AI.conclusion: 将定位视为无序集合而非序列、用空间锚点实现可并行且无重复漏检的实例解码，是一种架构无关、以极小精度代价换取随密度扩展加速的有效方案。

title: SafeRank-ReID: Candidate-Conditioned Re-Ranking under Identity Conflicts for Multimodal Person Re-Identification
comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia Asia 2026 (MMAsia 2026). 8 pages, 5 figures
summary: Multimodal Person Re-Identification (ReID) exploits complementary identity cues from different sensing modalities to mitigate the performance degradation caused by challenging imaging conditions. Existing methods typically estimate Modality Reliability at the query level, making it difficult to identify conflicting inputs that retain normal visual quality but correspond to an incorrect identity. Such inputs may receive high confidence, promote irrelevant gallery candidates, and lead to negative fusion. To address this issue, we propose SafeRank-ReID, a candidate-conditioned safe re-ranking framework for Multimodal Person Re-Identification (ReID). To capture the varying support of the same modality for different candidates, we introduce a candidate-conditioned evidence arbitration mechanism that integrates unimodal retrieval evidence, input quality, and cross-modal consistency to estimate trust and conflict logits for each modality-candidate pair. Together, these logits contribute to the normalized modality weights, allowing support strength to vary across modalities and candidates while reducing the contribution of potentially unreliable evidence. A candidate-set refinement module subsequently applies self-attention to jointly model candidate representations and predicts residual scores from their competitive relations, thereby refining the initial fused ranking. For fusion results that remain uncertain after refinement, a query-level fallback gate estimates an interpolation coefficient from the overall conflict level and cross-modal uncertainty, adaptively combining the fused scores with those of the most reliable unimodal branch. Experiments on RGBNT201 and MSVR310 show that SafeRank-ReID maintains competitive clean-input retrieval while improving robustness to Identity Conflicts across person and vehicle benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SafeRank-ReID，一种候选条件化的安全重排序框架，用于多模态行人重识别，通过证据仲裁、候选集精化与回退门控抑制错误身份冲突导致的负融合。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态 ReID 方法在查询级别估计模态可靠性，难以识别"视觉质量正常但身份错误"的冲突输入，这类输入会获得高置信度并引入无关候选，导致负融合。
AI.method: （1）候选条件化证据仲裁：对每个模态-候选对整合单模态检索证据、输入质量与跨模态一致性，估计信任与冲突 logit，归一化为候选相关的模态权重；（2）候选集精化：以自注意力联合建模候选表示，基于竞争关系预测残差分数以修正初始融合排序；（3）查询级回退门控：对精化后仍不确定的查询，依据整体冲突水平与跨模态不确定性估计插值系数，将融合分数与最可靠单模态分支分数自适应组合。
AI.result: 在 RGBNT201 与 MSVR310 数据集上，方法在保持有竞争力的干净输入检索性能的同时，提升了行人与车辆基准上对身份冲突的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将可靠性建模从查询级细化到候选级并结合不确定性回退，可有效缓解多模态 ReID 中的负融合问题，兼顾正常检索精度与冲突场景鲁棒性。

title: Video Generalized Category Discovery
summary: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to categorize unlabeled data from both known and unknown classes using labeled data from only the known classes. While recent GCD methods have shown promise on static images, their performance degrades in videos due to temporal dynamics, larger intra-class variation, and the lack of temporal consistency in existing approaches. We introduce VideoGCD, a framework tailored for video action recognition under the GCD setting. Our method integrates (i) a partitioned Mixture-of-Experts module that encourages specialization for known and novel categories, (ii) a novel-class balancing loss to reduce bias toward known classes, and (iii) a temporal optimal transport loss that promotes consistent routing across frames. Experiments on three video benchmarks demonstrate that VideoGCD significantly improves performance over existing GCD methods, particularly on novel categories. Our findings highlight the importance of combining temporal modeling and expert specialization for video GCD.

AI.tldr: 提出 VideoGCD——面向视频动作识别的广义类别发现框架，通过分区式专家混合、新类平衡损失与时间最优传输损失，提升已知/未知类的联合聚类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 GCD 方法多在静态图像上有效，直接迁移到视频时因时间动态、类内变化更大以及缺乏时间一致性而性能下降，因此需要专门针对视频场景设计 GCD 方案。
AI.method: 框架包含三个组件：(i) 分区式 Mixture-of-Experts 模块，促使专家分别专精于已知类与新类；(ii) 新类平衡损失，缓解对已知类的预测偏置；(iii) 时间最优传输损失，约束跨帧路由（routing）的一致性。
AI.result: 在三个视频基准上相较已有 GCD 方法显著提升，尤其在新类（novel categories）上收益更为明显。
AI.conclusion: 结合时间建模与专家专精化是解决视频 GCD 的关键，二者协同带来性能增益。

title: TAED: Trajectory-Aligned Encoder--Decoder Distillation for Detection Transformers
summary: Distilling localization knowledge into compact detection transformers (DETRs) requires consistent teacher-student query correspondence across decoder layers. However, in DETRs with encoder-based query selection, the teacher and student select top-K proposals independently. Same-rank queries can originate from different spatial locations and correspond to different objects, making rank-based layer-wise supervision unreliable. To address this problem, we propose Trajectory-Aligned Encoder-Decoder Distillation (TAED), a framework for knowledge transfer between DETRs of different capacities. Encoder feature distillation matches normalized multi-scale features to strengthen student representations and increase the number of teacher-student query pairs from the same encoder locations. Source-indexed query alignment pairs native queries from the same encoder locations and retains pairs associated with the same object for which the teacher provides reliable and more accurate final localization than the student. Trajectory-aligned localization distillation maintains these correspondences and uses teacher proposals and corresponding decoder-layer box predictions to guide student refinement, without introducing additional queries. On COCO, TAED improves DINO-R18 and two-stage Deformable DETR-R18 by 2.5 and 1.7 AP, respectively. Further gains on D-FINE and ECDet demonstrate applicability to recent real-time DETRs at no additional inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出TAED框架，通过编码器特征蒸馏、源索引查询对齐和轨迹对齐定位蒸馏，解决基于编码器查询选择的DETR中师生查询独立选取导致逐层蒸馏不可靠的问题。
AI.motivation: DETR类检测器蒸馏依赖师生查询对应关系，但采用编码器查询选择时师生各自独立选Top-K提案，同序号查询可能来自不同空间位置、对应不同目标，使基于序号的逐层监督不可靠。
AI.method: TAED包含三部分：(1) 编码器特征蒸馏，匹配归一化多尺度特征以增强学生表征并增加来自同一编码器位置的师生查询对数量；(2) 源索引查询对齐，将来自同一编码器位置的原生查询配对，仅保留教师最终定位可靠且更准确、且指向同一目标的配对；(3) 轨迹对齐定位蒸馏，维持这些对应关系，用教师提案及对应解码层框预测指导学生细化，且不引入额外查询。
AI.result: COCO上TAED使DINO-R18和两阶段Deformable DETR-R18分别提升2.5和1.7 AP；在D-FINE和ECDet上亦有增益，证明可适用于近期实时DETR且无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 以编码器位置与目标一致性为基础的轨迹对齐蒸馏可替代不可靠的序号对齐监督，有效提升紧凑DETR的定位能力，且具良好的通用性与零附加推理成本。

title: SPROUT: Predicting Objective-Grounded Prompt Utility for Efficient Text-to-Image Preference Tuning
summary: Preference tuning of text-to-image diffusion models spends most of its compute generating candidate images, yet training prompts are typically sampled uniformly at random, wasting compute generating images that provide too little signal for model alignment. To best utilize the available compute, we study prompt selection, where at each iteration we identify the most useful prompts for preference tuning. We separate prompt selection into a utility score, an estimator of that utility score, and batch selection. Within this framework, we propose Selection by PRedicting Objective-grounded UTility (SPROUT). The utility score is predicted on every prompt in the pool, including unseen prompts, by a text-only model, refit after every iteration on all utilities observed so far. A randomized acceptance rule then turns these predictions into a batch, so no images are generated beyond those used for training. For direct group preference optimization (DGPO), the objective-grounded utility is the norm of the gradient that the objective produces from a prompt's group of images. Fine-tuning Stable Diffusion 1.5 with DGPO on GenEval, SPROUT matches the final score of uniform sampling in about 44% of the iterations and improves the area under the learning curve with respect to both uniform sampling and CGPO, a recent variance-based prompt sampler. The efficiency gains hold under four held-out reward models never used in training, and the ranking of methods carries over to DPG-Bench and T2I-CompBench++. Our code is available at https://github.com/ADDAPT-ML/SPROUT.

AI.tldr: 提出提示词选择框架与SPROUT方法，用文本模型预测目标梯度范数作为效用并随机接受成批，大幅提升偏好调优的算力效率。
AI.motivation: 文生图扩散模型偏好调优的大部分算力消耗在生成候选图像上，而训练提示通常均匀随机采样，导致大量对模型对齐信号贡献很小的图像被浪费生成。因此希望在每次迭代中筛选最有用的提示，最大化有限算力的利用效率。
AI.method: 将提示选择分解为三部分：效用分数、效用分数估计器和批选择。在此框架下提出SPROUT：用一个纯文本模型对提示池中所有提示（含未见提示）预测效用分数，该模型在每次迭代后用迄今观测到的全部效用重新拟合；再通过随机接受规则将预测转化为批次，除训练所需图像外不额外生成图像。对直接分组偏好优化（DGPO），目标 grounded 效用定义为该目标由一个提示的图像组所产生的梯度范数。
AI.result: 在GenEval上用DGPO微调Stable Diffusion 1.5，SPROUT约用44%的迭代次数即达到均匀采样的最终得分；相对于均匀采样和近期基于方差的提示采样器CGPO，均提升了学习曲线下面积。效率增益在四个训练中未使用的留出奖励模型上依然成立，方法排序也延续到DPG-Bench和T2I-CompBench++。
AI.conclusion: 提示选择是提升偏好调优算力效率的有效杠杆；以目标梯度范数作为效用、配合轻量文本代理模型与随机接受规则，可在不增加图像生成成本的前提下加速对齐并具备跨奖励模型与跨基准的泛化性。代码已开源。

title: Draft Forcing: Target-guided Speculative Drafting and Learned Verifier for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models enable streaming synthesis chunk by chunk, yet invoking the large model for every chunk remains costly. While chunk-level speculative decoding can offload chunks to a lightweight draft model, existing approaches suffer from two limitations: (1) an off-the-shelf draft diverges from the target's trajectory, compounding errors in history; and (2) they either omit verification or rely on costly post-decode aesthetic scores rather than verifying consistency against the target. We address both with Draft Forcing, a framework coupling target-guided drafting with an on-policy trained verifier. Specifically, to align the draft for high acceptance, we opt for feature-level drafting, conditioning it on multi-layer target hidden states persisted from committed chunks, whose outputs are pushed to match target trajectories with multi-aspect losses. For verification, we propose an on-policy trained feature-space verifier predicting CDF-calibrated frame-wise relative RMSE against the target. It is trained on speculative rollouts as contexts anneal from random to inference-aligned mixtures, and gates proposals without VAE decoding. On the 14B Self-Forcing target, Draft Forcing achieves $1.63\times$ DiT and $1.57\times$ end-to-end speedups on VBench with minimal quality loss, and up to $1.93\times$ DiT ($1.82\times$ end-to-end) when combined with orthogonal KV compression. It generalizes to accelerate a streaming variant of MiniMax-H3, generating over $50\%$ draft frames with competitive quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 Draft Forcing 框架，将目标引导式草稿与在线策略训练的特征空间验证器耦合，实现自回归视频扩散模型的分块推测解码，在 14B Self-Forcing 上取得 1.63× DiT / 1.57× 端到端加速且质量损失极小。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型可逐块流式合成，但每个块都调用大模型代价高昂。现有的块级推测解码存在两点缺陷：(1) 现成草稿模型偏离目标轨迹，历史误差累积；(2) 要么省略验证，要么依赖昂贵的解码后美学分数，而非与目标做一致性校验。
AI.method: 1) 特征级草稿：以已提交块中持久化的多层目标隐藏状态为条件，并用多方面损失将草稿输出拉向目标轨迹，提高接受率；2) 验证器：在线策略训练的特征空间验证器，预测经 CDF 校准的逐帧相对 RMSE（相对目标），训练上下文从随机混合退火至推理对齐混合，无需 VAE 解码即可门控候选。
AI.result: 在 14B Self-Forcing 上，VBench 上获得 1.63× DiT 与 1.57× 端到端加速，质量损失极小；与正交 KV 压缩结合可达 1.93× DiT（1.82× 端到端）。可泛化至流式版 MiniMax-H3，超过 50% 的帧由草稿生成且质量具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: Draft Forcing 通过目标对齐的特征级草稿与免解码的在线策略验证器，解决了误差累积与验证缺失问题，显著加速自回归视频扩散推理并具跨模型泛化性。

title: Analyzing and Improving FlowMap Distillation of Autoregressive Video Models
summary: FlowMap distillation offers a natural route to few-step generative modeling by directly learning a teacher's denoising trajectories. Yet for autoregressive (AR) video generation, existing few-step models still rely on distribution matching distillation (DMD) to remain competitive, sacrificing sample diversity and requiring a large bidirectional teacher. In this work, we analyze what limits standalone AR FlowMap distillation and introduce two complementary guidance mechanisms to close this gap: (1) anti-drifting guidance, which helps the AR teacher correct drifted student rollouts by training an auxiliary model to mimic student drift and using it as a negative guidance branch; and (2) motion-aware guidance, which makes motion easier for a FlowMap student to learn by locating motion patches and selectively applying skip-layer guidance. Empirically, our approach applies to $π$-Flow, MeanFlow, and consistency distillation with 1.3B AR teachers, improving generation quality and reducing drift over 30 s rollouts. Notably, our 4-step $π$-Flow students match DMD students distilled from 14B teachers on VBench while preserving the sample diversity of their AR teachers, demonstrating that pure FlowMap distillation is effective for few-step autoregressive video generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出抗漂移引导（anti-drifting guidance）与运动感知引导（motion-aware guidance）两种互补机制，使纯 FlowMap 蒸馏在自回归视频生成中达到与 DMD 相当的质量，同时保留样本多样性且只需 1.3B 教师。
AI.motivation: FlowMap 蒸馏可直接学习教师去噪轨迹以实现少步生成，但在自回归（AR）视频生成中，现有少步模型仍依赖 DMD 才具竞争力，其代价是牺牲样本多样性并需大型双向教师。作者因此分析限制独立 AR FlowMap 蒸馏的因素，试图弥补该差距。
AI.method: 两项引导机制：(1) 抗漂移引导——训练辅助模型模仿学生漂移，将其作为负向引导分支，帮助 AR 教师纠正漂移的学生 rollout；(2) 运动感知引导——定位运动 patch，并选择性施加 skip-layer guidance，降低 FlowMap 学生学习运动的难度。
AI.result: 方法适用于 π-Flow、MeanFlow 与 consistency distillation，在 1.3B AR 教师上提升生成质量并减少 30 秒 rollout 中的漂移；4 步 π-Flow 学生在 VBench 上匹配由 14B 教师蒸馏的 DMD 学生，并保持其 AR 教师的样本多样性。
AI.conclusion: 纯 FlowMap 蒸馏可有效用于少步自回归视频生成，无需依赖 DMD 与大型双向教师即可兼顾质量与多样性。

title: AirVT-15k: A Query-Diverse UAV Video-Text Dataset and Query-Adaptive Evidence Alignment Network for Retrieval
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle video-text retrieval (UAV-TVR) requires matching language to both scene context and subtle object changes. A harbor-layout query relies on global scene context, whereas a departing-vessel query requires local functional cues and motion states. Existing benchmarks provide diverse aerial descriptions but give limited attention to distinct evidence needs within the same video. We introduce AirVT-15k, a benchmark of 15,504 UAV videos and 155,040 captions, with ten complementary bilingual captions per video describing scenes, object states, and temporal changes. We also propose AirFocus-CST, which selects query-relevant frames and patches, encodes temporal feature differences, and combines coarse-to-fine interaction (CFI) with optimal-transport alignment (OTA). Average mean recall reaches 63.67% on AirVT-15k and 24.41% on CapERA, improving over the strongest baselines by 2.96 and 1.91 percentage points, respectively. The dataset and code are available at https://chenxi000233.github.io/AirVT-15k-site/.

AI.tldr: 提出无人机视频-文本检索基准AirVT-15k（15,504视频/155,040双语字幕）与AirFocus-CST方法，平均Recall达63.67%（AirVT-15k）与24.41%（CapERA）。
AI.motivation: UAV-TVR需同时匹配场景上下文与细粒度物体变化：如"港口布局"类查询依赖全局场景，而"离港船只"类查询依赖局部功能线索与运动状态。现有基准虽提供多样航拍描述，但对同一视频内不同证据需求关注不足。
AI.method: 构建AirVT-15k基准，每视频配10条互补双语字幕，覆盖场景、物体状态与时间变化；提出AirFocus-CST，选择查询相关帧与图像块，编码时序特征差异，并结合由粗到细交互（CFI）与最优传输对齐（OTA）。
AI.result: AirVT-15k平均平均召回率63.67%，CapERA上24.41%，分别较最强基线提升2.96与1.91个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 面向无人机视频-文本检索的证据自适性建模（帧块级聚焦+时序差异+CFI/OTA对齐）有效，且新基准弥补了同一视频多粒度证据需求的评测空白。

title: LeJEPA Features Are Not Isotropic, and Should Not Be
summary: The SIGReg term in LeJEPA regularizes features to have an isotropic Gaussian distribution. Our first result is to show that this regularizer, in practice, cannot achieve its goal. We design a modified regularizer to enforce the objective better. This leads to slightly improved performance. For example, on ImageNet-100, our modified regularizer reaches the final accuracy of SIGReg in 1.3$\times$ fewer epochs. Our second result argues that self-supervised encoders should not have isotropic Gaussian features. We show that the alignment term in LeJEPA conflicts with SIGReg, because it couples the magnitude of the features with their directions. In contrast, isotropic Gaussian features would entail independent magnitude and directions. Features obtained with LeJEPA are, in fact, not isotropic. So LeJEPA has two issues. Its regularizer is weak, and the isotropic Gaussian target is too strict. Our third result is about reformulating the isotropic Gaussian regularizer to enforce only the marginal distributions of the magnitude and direction, without enforcing independence. This leads to a simple regularization term, PolarReg, that can be optimized reliably across many different datasets, batch sizes and embedding dimensions without any hyper-parameter changes. On ImageNet-1k, our technique matches the accuracy of LeJEPA and its variants in 4.7$\times$ fewer epochs. It improves the final accuracy by 1.8 points.

AI.tldr: 论文指出LeJEPA的SIGReg正则项在实践中无法达成各向同性高斯目标，且该目标本身过严；为此提出只约束幅值与方向边缘分布（不要求独立）的PolarReg，在ImageNet-1k上以4.7倍更少epoch达到LeJEPA及其变体精度，最终精度提升1.8个点。
AI.motivation: LeJEPA使用SIGReg强制特征服从各向同性高斯分布，但作者认为该正则项实际难以实现目标（正则太弱），且"各向同性高斯特征"这一目标本身与LeJEPA中的对齐项冲突（对齐项将特征幅值与方向耦合，而各向同性高斯要求幅值与方向独立），因此需要更合理的正则设计。
AI.method: 1) 设计改进版SIGReg以更好地实现原目标；2) 分析表明自监督编码器不应具有各向同性高斯特征，实证显示LeJEPA学到的特征并非各向同性；3) 将各向同性高斯正则重构为仅约束幅值与方向的边缘分布、不强制二者独立的PolarReg，形式简单、可稳定优化。
AI.result: 改进版SIGReg带来小幅提升：ImageNet-100上以1.3倍更少epoch达到SIGReg的最终精度。PolarReg在多种数据集、batch size和嵌入维度下无需调超参即可可靠优化；ImageNet-1k上以4.7倍更少epoch匹配LeJEPA及其变体精度，并最终精度提升1.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: LeJEPA存在两个问题：正则项过弱、各向同性高斯目标过严。放松独立性约束、仅正则化幅值与方向边缘分布的PolarReg更契合自监督学习，收敛更快、精度更高且超参数鲁棒。

title: Shift by Analogy for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
summary: Compositional zero-shot learning recognizes attribute-object pairs absent from training. An unseen pair has a semantic description but lacks an observed visual reference. We propose Shift by Analogy (SBA) to make unseen compositions visually seen through a shift-then-match process. Its core add-subtract-add rule transfers an attribute change between two seen image-text residuals on a source object to a reference residual on the target object. This shifts the target's own text feature toward its visual center; learned refinement produces a proxy for matching query images. During training, each target is excluded from its supports, and recognition is learned using references constructed from other pairs. An analogy library and same-object attention extend this construction across candidates, while joint learning integrates proxy matching with semantic and primitive evidence. Visual-center analysis confirms substantially improved correspondence for unseen compositions. Experiments across three standard benchmarks show that SBA consistently outperforms strong CZSL baselines under both closed- and open-world evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出"平移类比"(Shift by Analogy, SBA)框架，通过"平移-再匹配"过程为未见属性-物体组合作成代理视觉特征，在三个标准基准上稳定超过强CzSL基线。
AI.motivation: 组合零样本学习(CZSL)中，未见属性-物体对只有语义描述而缺乏观测到的视觉参照，导致语义-视觉对应关系弱化。作者希望让"看不见"的未见组合在视觉空间中变得"可见"。
AI.method: 核心是"加-减-加"(add-subtract-add)规则：利用两个已见图像-文本残差之间的属性变化，将其迁移到源物体上，再作用于目标物体上的参考残差，从而把目标自身的文本特征平移向它的视觉中心；随后通过可学习的精修得到代理特征用于匹配查询图像。训练时每个目标被排除在其支持集之外，识别由其他组合构造的参照完成；并引入类比库与同物体注意力在多候选上扩展构造，联合学习将代理匹配与语义证据、原语证据融合。
AI.result: 视觉中心分析显示未见组合的语义-视觉对应显著改善；在三个标准基准上，SBA在封闭世界与开放世界两种评测下均一致优于强CzSL基线。
AI.conclusion: 以类比残差平移构造未见组合的视觉代理是一种有效途径，可在无需真实未见样本的前提下提升CZSL泛化能力。

title: Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization
summary: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to compress a large dataset into a small synthetic one that remains effective for training neural networks. Despite its success in supervised learning, DD remains underexplored in self-supervised learning (SSL), where distilled data must preserve the information needed to learn representations that remain consistent across augmentations. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mutual Information Prototype Alignment (MIPA), an efficient SSL dataset distillation approach that optimizes synthetic images to preserve augmentation-invariant information. Specifically, MIPA treats synthetic images as learnable prototypes and uses a frozen encoder to assign real samples to them based on feature similarity. A synthetic dataset that preserves such augmentation invariance should yield stable prototype assignments across multiple augmented views of the same real image. MIPA encourages this by maximizing mutual information between cross-view assignments while avoiding trivial solutions in which all real samples are assigned to only a few synthetic prototypes. Evaluations on image classification benchmarks show that synthetic data generated by MIPA yield higher-quality representations than existing distillation approaches while reducing time and storage demands during distillation.

AI.tldr: MIPA：将合成图像视为可学习原型，用冻结编码器按特征相似度把真实样本分配给原型，并以跨增强视图分配间的互信息最大化（同时抑制平凡解）来蒸馏数据，从而保留增强不变信息。
AI.motivation: 数据集蒸馏（DD）在监督学习中已取得成功，但在自监督学习（SSL）中研究不足；SSL 场景下蒸馏数据必须保留学习"跨增强一致表征"所需的信息，而现有方法难以保证这种增强不变性。
AI.method: 提出互信息原型对齐（MIPA）：1）把合成图像作为可学习原型，用冻结编码器依据特征相似度将真实样本软分配到原型；2）核心假设是——若合成数据保留增强不变性，则同一真实图像的不同增强视图应产生稳定的原型分配；3）通过最大化跨视图分配之间的互信息来施加约束，并显式避免"所有真实样本集中到少数原型"的平凡解。
AI.result: 在图像分类基准上，MIPA 生成的合成数据所训练出的表征质量优于现有蒸馏方法，同时在蒸馏阶段降低了时间与存储开销。
AI.conclusion: 以原型分配一致性和互信息最大化作为蒸馏目标，可有效实现面向自监督学习的数据集蒸馏，兼顾表征质量与蒸馏效率。

title: Mind the Gaps: State-Guided Supervision Allocation for Object Detection Dataset Distillation
comment: Jiehui Xie and Zhengxun Jin contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Sung-Ho Bae and Chaoning Zhang
summary: Recent advances in dataset distillation have enabled large-scale training datasets to be compressed into compact synthetic sets. However, dataset distillation for object detection remains challenging, as it requires preserving diverse classification and localization signals under limited image budgets. Existing approaches often emphasize individual-image informativeness without explicitly accounting for supervision accumulated across the distilled dataset, potentially leading to redundant supervision and uneven class-scale coverage. To address this limitation, we propose State-Guided Supervision Allocation (SGSA), a framework that formulates object detection dataset distillation as a dataset-level progressive supervision allocation problem. SGSA establishes class-scale supervision quotas and maintains a global state that tracks detector predictions accumulated from previously selected synthetic images. The remaining gaps between the target quotas and accumulated supervision guide adaptive object sampling, detector-guided canvas refinement, and marginal-gain-based candidate selection, encouraging complementary supervision across images. On MS COCO, SGSA outperforms a matched OD3 baseline by 3.73-4.06 mAP points across three image budgets (0.25%-1.0%). On PASCAL VOC, SGSA outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline by 4.53-6.90 mAP50 points across three image budgets. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of dataset-level supervision allocation guided by accumulated detector feedback under limited image budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出状态引导监督分配框架SGSA，将目标检测数据集蒸馏建模为数据集级的渐进监督分配问题，在COCO与VOC上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 在有限图像预算下，目标检测数据集蒸馏需同时保留多样的分类与定位信号。现有方法偏重单图信息量，未显式考虑跨蒸馏数据集的监督累积，导致监督冗余以及类别—尺度覆盖不均。
AI.method: 将检测数据集蒸馏形式化为数据集级渐进监督分配：1）建立类别—尺度监督配额；2）维护全局状态，追踪已选合成图像所累积的检测器预测；3）以目标配额与累积监督之间的剩余差距指导自适应目标采样、检测器引导的画布精炼，以及基于边际增益的候选筛选，从而鼓励图像间监督互补。
AI.result: MS COCO上在0.25%–1.0%三个图像预算下较匹配的OD3基线提升3.73–4.06 mAP；PASCAL VOC上在三个预算下较最强评估基线提升4.53–6.90 mAP50。
AI.conclusion: 在有限图像预算下，由累积检测器反馈引导的数据集级监督分配是有效的，能缓解监督冗余并改善覆盖均衡性。

title: SceneCast: Learning Indoor Scene Synthesis from Curated Synthetic Videos with LLM Reward
summary: 3D indoor scene synthesis requires generating objects to form a complete and coherent scene. Existing approaches rely heavily on manually annotated datasets, leading to high costs and limited generalization. We present SceneCast, an annotation-free framework that trains on large-scale, unlabeled videos, addressing two key challenges: (1) Videos provide only partial views of a scene, requiring the model to extrapolate unseen 3D regions, which is inherently error-prone; (2) Raw videos available online are uncurated, suffering from uncontrolled conditions and variable data quality. First, we design a Transformer-based model that predicts objects sequentially and is fine-tuned with reinforcement learning (RL), where an LLM acts as a spatial common-sense evaluator. The LLM provides reward signals through chain-of-thought reasoning and code-executable geometric checks to refine object configurations. Second, we introduce \trim, a data curation approach that generates training videos with controllable video generation models. Crucially, it retains only high-quality prefix clips via multi-criteria quality assessment with an entropy-based weighting strategy. Evaluated on curated synthetic video sets, our annotation-free approach outperforms state-of-the-art supervised methods in scene quality.

AI.tldr: SceneCast：一种无需人工标注的3D室内场景合成框架，利用大规模未标注视频训练，通过Transformer顺序预测物体并用LLM作为空间常识评估器的强化学习微调，同时提出可控视频生成的数据筛选方法Trim，在合成视频集上超越有监督SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有3D室内场景合成方法高度依赖人工标注数据集，标注成本高且泛化能力受限。作者希望转向大规模无标注视频作为训练信号，但需要解决两个核心难题：(1) 视频仅提供场景的部分视角，模型须外推未观测的3D区域，易出错；(2) 网络原始视频未经整理，条件不可控、质量参差不齐。
AI.method: (1) 模型侧：设计基于Transformer的序列式物体预测模型，并以强化学习微调，其中LLM充当空间常识评估器，通过思维链推理与可代码执行的几何校验生成奖励信号，用于精炼物体配置。(2) 数据侧：提出Trim数据筛选方法，利用可控视频生成模型合成训练视频，并通过多准则质量评估结合基于熵的加权策略，仅保留高质量的前缀片段。
AI.result: 在筛选后的合成视频集上评测，该无标注方法在场景质量上优于当前最先进的有监督方法。
AI.conclusion: 表明无标注视频监督可替代昂贵的人工标注用于3D室内场景合成，且LLM奖励与可控生成的数据筛选能有效缓解部分视角外推误差与数据质量不可控问题。

title: TowerBridge: Bridging the Dual-Encoder Modality Gap via Weight-Space Programming
summary: CLIP-style dual encoders map images and text through two separate towers into a shared embedding space, where the two modalities occupy distinct regions separated by a modality gap. Retrieval fails when wrong matches, or hard negatives, outrank the correct one, and the gap is the usual suspect. Yet removing it post hoc degrades retrieval on every CLIP checkpoint we test. We introduce a paired statistic that identifies directions where the two towers agree more on hard negatives than on matched pairs. Mildly attenuating these directions improves retrieval while largely preserving the gap. We arrive at this correction through weight-space programming: guided by the statistic, an LLM agent inspects both towers and writes closed-form weight edits without backpropagation. Free to edit any component, the agent improves COCO test retrieval on all 13 CLIP checkpoints and edits an output projection in 12 of the 13. We distill and refine its recurring correction into TowerBridge, a closed-form recipe motivated by a first-order analysis of the hard-negative margin. Computed in seconds from 25,000 labelled pairs, it requires no model-specific tuning and leaves the architecture and inference cost unchanged. TowerBridge improves COCO test retrieval by 16.8 RSUM and Flickr30k test retrieval by 6.6 on average across all 21 evaluated CLIP checkpoints, including 8 unseen by the agent, while limiting any drop in ImageNet zero-shot accuracy to 0.5 points. It also reduces hubness on all 21 checkpoints and improves retrieval on 4 of 5 dual encoders from other families.

AI.tldr: 论文发现CLIP双塔之间的"模态间隔"并非检索失败的主因，真正有害的是少数方向上两塔对困难负样本的一致性高于正样本对；据此提出免反向传播、闭式的权重编辑方法TowerBridge，在21个CLIP检查点上平均提升COCO检索16.8 RSUM、Flickr30k 6.6，并降低hubness。
AI.motivation: CLIP式双编码器把图像与文本映射到共享空间，两模态各占不同区域并形成"模态间隔（modality gap）"，常被视为难负样本反超正样本、导致检索失败的原因。但作者发现事后消除该间隔会在其测试的每个CLIP检查点上恶化检索，说明间隔本身不是症结，需要定位真正有害的方向。
AI.method: 1) 提出一个配对统计量（paired statistic），识别两塔在困难负样本上比在匹配对上更一致的方向；适度衰减这些方向可提升检索而基本保留模态间隔。2) 采用权重空间编程（weight-space programming）：由该统计量引导，LLM agent检查两塔结构并直接写出闭式权重编辑，无需反向传播；agent可自由编辑任意组件。3) 将agent反复出现的修正蒸馏、提炼为TowerBridge：基于难负样本margin的一阶分析给出的闭式配方，仅需25,000对标注数据、数秒内计算完成，无需针对模型调参，不改变架构与推理开销。
AI.result: agent版本在全部13个CLIP检查点上提升COCO测试检索，其中12个选择了编辑输出投影层。TowerBridge在全部21个评估检查点（含8个agent未见过的）上平均提升COCO测试检索16.8 RSUM、Flickr30k测试检索6.6，ImageNet零样本精度下降不超过0.5个点；在全部21个检查点上降低hubness，并在另外4/5个其他家族的双编码器上提升检索。
AI.conclusion: 检索失败不应归咎于模态间隔本身，而应归咎于"难负样本一致性"方向；对这些方向的轻度、闭式权重衰减即可显著提升跨模态检索，且方法通用、低成本、不损零样本能力，并具备跨架构可迁移性。

title: NNS-GS: Non-Local Neural Scattering for Relightable Gaussian Splatting
summary: Creating relightable 3D assets of translucent objects is challenging because changing the illumination at one surface location can affect the appearance elsewhere through subsurface scattering. Existing Gaussian-based scattering models typically predict scattering from local features, making this dependence difficult to capture. We present Non-Local Neural Scattering for Gaussian Splatting (NNS-GS), which learns non-local scattering together with geometry-guided local reflection. The scattering module learns how illumination from light-visible surface regions in light space contributes to the shading point in view space, conditioned on regional diffuse responses and spatial relationships. The reflection module supplies these diffuse responses and uses additional geometric guidance to better capture specular highlights and sharp shadow boundaries. To reduce component mixing and support controllable scattering appearance, anchor-based progressive training establishes the diffuse-scattering base before introducing specular reflection and supervises the components separately. Under calibrated point lighting, NNS-GS improves mean PSNR over existing methods by 2.47 dB and 0.81 dB on the synthetic and real translucent scenes, respectively. Additional synthetic comparisons further show that NNS-GS better matches the reference when adjusting scattering attenuation.

AI.tldr: 提出 NNS-GS，一种面向半透明物体的可重光照 3D 高斯泼溅方法，通过非局部神经网络散射模块学习光照空间到视空间非局部散射贡献，并结合几何引导的局部反射模块与锚点式渐进训练，实现散射与反射的解耦建模。
AI.motivation: 半透明物体的可重光照 3D 资产构建困难：改变某一表面位置的光照会通过次表面散射影响其他区域的外观。现有基于高斯的散射模型通常仅从局部特征预测散射，难以刻画这种非局部依赖关系，同时反射与散射成分容易混淆，散射外观难以控制。
AI.method: 方法包含两个模块与一个训练策略。(1) 非局部散射模块：在光照空间中聚合可见表面区域的光照贡献，依据区域漫反射响应与空间关系，预测其对视空间着色点的贡献；(2) 反射模块：提供上述漫反射响应，并引入额外几何引导以更好捕捉高光与锐利阴影边界；(3) 锚点式渐进训练：先建立漫反射-散射基底，再引入镜面反射，并对各成分分别监督，以减少成分混合、支持可控散射外观。
AI.result: 在校准点光源条件下，NNS-GS 在合成与真实半透明场景上的平均 PSNR 分别比现有方法提升 2.47 dB 与 0.81 dB；额外合成对比表明，在调整散射衰减时 NNS-GS 与参考结果更为吻合。
AI.conclusion: 非局部散射建模与几何引导局部反射相结合，配合分离监督的渐进训练，可有效提升半透明物体可重光照重建的渲染精度与散射可控性。

title: Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations
summary: Recent unified multimodal models aim to combine visual understanding and generation within a single model, yet effectively integrating the two capabilities remains challenging. Leveraging pretrained vision-language models offers a way to build on already learned multimodal knowledge, but making this knowledge effectively accessible to visual generation remains nontrivial. We find that a central challenge lies in the heterogeneous visual representations used for understanding and generation. To address this challenge, we introduce Integral, which converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space across the two capabilities. Integral implements this design through two complementary components. Abstraction Fusion constructs shared visual tokens by aggregating hierarchical representations from the frozen vision encoder, while Block-wise MoT introduces a lightweight generative stream that interacts with the vision-language model only at block boundaries. Our approach effectively preserves the pretrained understanding capability while extending it to strong visual generation. Controlled comparisons further demonstrate that sharing visual representations between understanding and generation substantially improves generative learning compared with using a separate visual representation space, despite comparable reconstruction fidelity. These results suggest that representations learned by pretrained vision-language models already provide an effective foundation for visual generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Integral，通过构建理解与生成共享的视觉表示空间，将预训练视觉-语言模型改造为统一多模态模型。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型需同时具备视觉理解与生成能力，但二者所用视觉表示异质，导致预训练 VLM 已学到的多模态知识难以有效迁移至生成任务。
AI.method: 提出 Integral，含两个互补组件：Abstraction Fusion 聚合冻结视觉编码器的层级特征以构造共享视觉 token；Block-wise MoT 引入轻量生成流，仅在块边界与 VLM 交互，从而保留预训练理解能力。
AI.result: 在保持预训练理解能力的同时获得了较强的视觉生成能力；控制实验显示，在重建保真度相当的情况下，共享视觉表示相比独立表示空间显著提升生成学习效果。
AI.conclusion: 预训练 VLM 学到的视觉表示本身即可为视觉生成提供有效基础，共享表示是统一理解与生成的关键设计。

title: Test-Time Latent Computation to Improve Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Recent work on Large Language Models (LLMs) suggests that reasoning capabilities can be enhanced at test time not only through longer token-level reasoning traces, but also through additional computation in latent space. This raises a natural question for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs): can additional computation in latent space improve visual perception at test time? In this work, we first verify that MLLMs contain stable reusable layers that can be re-forwarded at inference time without disrupting normal generation. Based on this observation, we propose \textbf{Lo}ok \textbf{Ba}ck in the \textbf{L}atent \textbf{S}pace (\textbf{Lobals}), a training-free decoding method that identifies the contiguous layer window with the strongest visual-token attention and re-forwards through it, allowing the model to revisit visual evidence in latent space. We demonstrate that this latent-space revisit strategy can improve MLLMs' performance across diverse multimodal settings, including general vision-language tasks, visual hallucination tasks, and vision-centric tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练解码方法 Lobals，通过在潜空间中回溯复用视觉注意力最强的连续层窗口，在测试时增强 MLLM 的视觉感知能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 研究表明测试时除更长的 token 级推理链外，潜空间额外计算也能提升推理能力；由此引出问题：潜空间计算能否在测试时改善 MLLM 的视觉感知。
AI.method: 先验证 MLLM 中存在稳定、可复用的层，可在推理时重复前向而不破坏正常生成；据此提出 Lobals：定位对视觉 token 注意力最强的连续层窗口，对该窗口进行重复前向，使模型在潜空间中重新审视视觉证据，全程免训练。
AI.result: 在通用视觉语言任务、视觉幻觉任务与视觉中心任务等多类多模态设置上均取得性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间回溯重访策略是一种无需训练、即插即用的测试时增强手段，可有效提升 MLLM 的视觉感知与多模态表现。

title: Boosting zero-shot learning through neuro-symbolic integration
summary: Zero-shot learning (ZSL) aims to train deep neural networks to recognize objects from unseen classes, starting from a semantic description of the concepts. Neuro-symbolic (NeSy) integration refers to a class of techniques that incorporate symbolic knowledge representation and reasoning with the learning capabilities of deep neural networks. However, to date, few studies have explored how to leverage NeSy techniques to inject prior knowledge during the training process to boost ZSL capabilities. Here, we present Fuzzy Logic Prototypical Network (FLPN) that formulates the classification task as prototype matching in a visual-semantic embedding space, which is trained by optimizing a NeSy loss. Specifically, FLPN exploits the Logic Tensor Network (LTN) framework to incorporate background knowledge in the form of logical axioms by grounding a first-order logic language as differentiable operations between real tensors. This prior knowledge includes class hierarchies (classes and macroclasses) along with robust high-level inductive biases. The latter allow, for instance, to handle exceptions in class-level attributes and to enforce similarity between images of the same class, preventing premature overfitting to seen classes and improving overall performance. % CHECK: original sentence had no verb ("Both class-level and attribute-level prototypes through an attention mechanism ...") FLPN learns both class-level and attribute-level prototypes, the latter through an attention mechanism specialized for either convolutional- or transformer-based backbones. FLPN achieves state-of-the-art performance on the GZSL benchmarks AWA2 and SUN, matching or exceeding the performance of competing algorithms with minimal computational overhead. The code is available at https://github.com/FrancescoManigrass/FLPN

AI.tldr: 提出模糊逻辑原型网络（FLPN），将零样本分类建模为视觉-语义嵌入空间中的原型匹配，并用逻辑张量网络（LTN）将一阶逻辑公理形式的先验知识注入训练损失，在AWA2与SUN上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 零样本学习（ZSL）需要从语义描述出发识别未见类，但现有研究很少探索如何利用神经符号（NeSy）技术在训练中注入先验知识来提升ZSL能力；同时模型容易对已见类过早过拟合。
AI.method: FLPN将分类任务表述为视觉-语义嵌入空间中的原型匹配，并通过优化NeSy损失训练。具体利用LTN框架，将一阶逻辑语言落地为真实张量间的可微运算，从而把逻辑公理形式的背景知识编码进损失，包括类层级（类与宏类）以及鲁棒的高层归纳偏置（如处理类级属性中的例外、约束同类图像相似性）。同时FLPN学习类级原型与属性级原型，后者借助分别针对卷积/Transformer骨干定制的注意力机制获得。
AI.result: 在GZSL基准AWA2和SUN上达到SOTA性能，与竞争算法持平或更优，且计算开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 将NeSy先验以逻辑公理形式注入原型匹配损失，可有效防止对已见类的过早过拟合并提升广义零样本性能，是一种低开销、可扩展的ZSL方案；代码已开源。

title: REACT: Response-based Expert Assembly from Contextual Trajectories
summary: Dense feed-forward networks are unaffected by how their neurons are grouped: every neuron is evaluated. Sparse execution makes this grouping consequential, because each input can access only a few experts. An arbitrary partition can therefore retain pretrained weights while separating computations that an input needs together. We argue that upcycling should organize neurons according to their responses to similar inputs. To establish this correspondence, we introduce a context-guided upcycling approach REACT, Response-based Expert Assembly from Contextual Trajectories, that uses frozen denoising trajectories to connect input contexts with pretrained neuron responses. We first identify contexts after timestep-wise centering to account for distribution shifts across noise levels, then use their associated responses to allocate intact neurons to routed experts. The same contexts initialize the corresponding router entries, aligning expert contents with their intended inputs, while global activation statistics select an always-active shared expert. Layer-wise reconstruction and end-to-end adaptation refine this initialization for sparse execution. On ImageNet-1K, our approach achieves better generation quality while activating only 37.5% of the original FFN parameters and reducing total per-token activated parameters by 27.6%.

AI.tldr: 提出 REACT 方法，依据神经元对相似输入上下文的响应进行专家化重组（upcycling），在稀疏执行下保持预训练权重并提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 稠密前馈网络的神经元分组不影响计算，但稀疏执行下每次输入只能访问少数专家，任意划分会把本需协同计算的部分拆开。因此应按照神经元对相似输入的响应来组织神经元。
AI.method: REACT（Response-based Expert Assembly from Contextual Trajectories）：利用冻结的去噪轨迹建立输入上下文与预训练神经元响应的对应关系；先经逐时间步中心化缓减噪声水平带来的分布漂移以识别上下文，再按相关响应将完整神经元分配给路由专家；同一上下文初始化路由器条目以实现内容与输入对齐，并用全局激活统计选出常激活的共享专家；最后通过逐层重构与端到端适配精调初始化。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-1K 上取得更优生成质量，仅激活原 FFN 参数的 37.5%，每 token 总激活参数减少 27.6%。
AI.conclusion: 以响应对齐为准则的上下文引导 upcycling 能有效缓解任意划分造成的计算割裂，在显著降低激活参数的同时提升稀疏执行性能。

title: ColonoWorld: Camera-Controlled Full-Procedure Colonoscopy Video Generation
comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld
summary: Navigation systems in colonoscopy are advancing from guiding the endoscopist to steering the scope autonomously. Since an incorrect motion can injure the patient, developing and evaluating these systems calls for a world model of colonoscopy. Such a model must follow a commanded scope motion, keep the colon anatomy consistent, and show lesions and procedural events. Yet camera-controlled generators trained on general scenes lose the colon's structure under motion, and endoscopic generators offer no camera control. We present ColonoWorld, a colonoscopy world model conditioned on a camera trajectory and a coarse 3D tube of the colon, trained on in vivo videos. From a whole-colon tube, it generates a full cecum-to-rectum procedure, even for unseen colon shapes. It also places polyps, instruments, and irrigation at specified locations and times. ColonoWorld outperforms state-of-the-art video generators, reducing camera trajectory error by 32% and FVD by 29%. Our code and annotations will be released at https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld.

AI.tldr: ColonoWorld 是一个以相机轨迹与结肠粗三维管状结构为条件的结肠镜世界模型，可生成从盲肠到直肠的完整手术视频，并支持息肉、器械与冲洗事件的定点定时注入，将相机轨迹误差降低 32%、FVD 降低 29%。
AI.motivation: 结肠镜导航系统正从辅助导引走向自主操控内镜，错误运动可能造成患者损伤，因此需要可评估的结肠镜世界模型。该模型必须：遵循指令化的内镜运动、保持结肠解剖结构一致、并能呈现病变与手术事件。然而现有方法存在两类缺陷：通用场景训练的相机可控生成器在运动下丢失结肠结构；内镜专用生成器缺乏相机控制能力。
AI.method: 提出 ColonoWorld，基于在体（in vivo）视频训练，以相机轨迹和结肠粗三维管状结构作为双重条件进行视频生成。输入整段结肠管状几何即可生成完整结肠镜流程，并能泛化到未见过的结肠形态；同时可在指定空间位置与时间点插入息肉、器械和冲洗等事件。
AI.result: 相较当前先进视频生成器，相机轨迹误差降低 32%，FVD 降低 29%；能够从整段结肠管状结构生成盲肠至直肠的完整操作序列，并适用于未见结肠形状。
AI.conclusion: ColonoWorld 在结构一致性与相机可控性之间取得统一，为结肠镜自主导航系统的开发与评测提供了可信的世界模型基础；代码与标注将在项目主页公开。

title: BASE: A Backend-Agnostic Streaming Embodiment Layer for Full-Duplex Conversational Avatars
summary: Many end-to-end spoken dialogue models can now converse in real time and full duplex, and turning them into 3D avatars requires full-body gestures, listening feedback, and turn-taking. Existing methods couple the motion generator tightly to one dialogue model by reading its internal states or training speech and motion jointly. The motion module must then be retrained whenever the dialogue model changes, cannot be attached to cloud APIs that expose only audio, and entangles role, voice, and motion style. We propose BASE, a backend-agnostic streaming embodiment layer whose only interface to the dialogue model is its emitted speech. First, a conversation state manager driven solely by audio handles speaking, listening, idling, barge-in, and proactive turns on one timeline, while role, voice, motion style, and 3D appearance are set independently. Second, to run an offline 2 s flow-matching gesture model on live audio, we reformulate inference as sliding-window continuation with overlapped look-ahead ensembling, which removes seam jitter. Third, we show that the remaining streaming gap comes from errors accumulating in the self-generated motion history rather than missing future speech; our Drift-Aware History Perturbation (DAHP) reduces this gap in about 50 min on one GPU by injecting inference-like drift into ground-truth training histories, and transfers to a second generator. On BEAT2, streaming BASE reaches an FGD of 0.342, on par with the tightly coupled MIBURI (0.333), and viewers prefer its body motion over MIBURI's in 82% of forced-choice judgments. Without retraining, the same layer drives a cascaded pipeline, three open full-duplex models, and a cloud API in real time.

AI.tldr: 提出BASE——一种后端无关的流式具身层，仅以对话模型输出的语音为接口，实时生成全身手势、倾听反馈与轮次转换动作，并与对话模型解耦。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端语音对话模型虽已支持实时全双工，但转为3D虚拟形象需要全身动作。现有方法将动作生成器与某一对话模型紧耦合（读取内部状态或联合训练），导致对话模型一变更就需重训动作模块，无法接入仅提供音频的云API，且角色、音色与动作风格相互纠缠。
AI.method: 1) 仅由音频驱动的对话状态管理器，在统一时间轴上处理说、听、空闲、打断与主动轮次，并独立设定角色、音色、动作风格与3D外观；2) 将离线2秒流匹配手势模型改写为滑动窗口续接+重叠前瞻集成推理，消除拼接抖动；3) 提出漂移感知历史扰动（DAHP），在真实训练历史中注入类推理漂移，弥补自生成动作历史误差累积导致的流式差距，单GPU约50分钟完成且可迁移至第二个生成器。
AI.result: 在BEAT2上，流式BASE取得FGD 0.342，与紧耦合的MIBURI（0.333）相当；强制选择评测中82%的观看者更偏好其身体动作。无需重训即可实时驱动级联流水线、三个开源全双工模型及一个云API。
AI.conclusion: 仅以语音为接口的解耦式流式具身层可在不牺牲动作质量的前提下实现后端无关的实时3D化身驱动，为对话模型与动作生成的模块化组合提供可行路径。

title: LiquidGazeNet: Towards Event-Based Near-Eye Gaze Estimation under Low-Light Conditions
summary: Near-eye gaze estimation under low-light nighttime conditions is challenging because the quality and effective temporal resolution of conventional intensity frames can be reduced. This paper presents LiquidGazeNet, an event-only gaze-estimation framework that combines polarity-aware spike-latency encoding with a custom LTC-based recurrent module. Positive- and negative-polarity events are represented in separate channels, while exponentially decayed time surfaces retain per-pixel temporal recency across successive event windows. A shared convolutional encoder extracts spatial features from each window, and a two-layer recurrent module composed of LTC-inspired cells integrates them causally over short temporal sequences. The network is trained using a hybrid objective that combines screen-space coordinate regression with centre-referenced directional consistency. The framework is evaluated on Gaze-FELL under cross-subject and cross-scene protocols and is further assessed through event-representation, temporal-module, window-duration, and computational ablations. LiquidGazeNet achieves mean errors of 3.75 degrees and 2.41 degrees under cross-subject and cross-scene evaluation, respectively. The results indicate that polarity-aware temporal-recency encoding, together with recurrent integration, is effective for event-only gaze estimation under the evaluated low-light nighttime conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出仅依赖事件相机的LiquidGazeNet框架，结合极性感知脉冲延迟编码与基于LTC的循环模块，实现低光夜间近眼视线估计。
AI.motivation: 低光夜间近眼视线估计困难，传统强度帧的质量与有效时间分辨率下降，需借助事件相机的高时间分辨率与高动态范围特性。
AI.method: 正负极性事件分通道表示，并用指数衰减时间表面保留逐像素时间新近性；共享卷积编码器提取每窗口空间特征；两层LTC启发循环单元对短序列做因果时序整合；混合损失结合屏幕坐标回归与以中心为参考的方向一致性约束。
AI.result: 在Gaze-FELL数据集上，跨被试平均误差3.75°、跨场景2.41°；并通过事件表示、时序模块、窗口时长与计算量消融验证各组件有效性。
AI.conclusion: 极性感知的时间新近性编码与循环时序整合相结合，在评估的低光夜间条件下可有效实现仅事件的视线估计。

title: HOSE: Hierarchical Orthogonal Subspace Erasure for Concept Unlearning in Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate harmful or sensitive content, such as pornographic or violent imagery, raising serious security concerns. Model editing has recently emerged as an efficient approach to mitigate this issue. It modifies pretrained models with minimal parameter updates to alter specific concepts while preserving overall model capabilities. However, due to the entangled representations of different concepts in diffusion models, direct modifications inevitably disrupt non-target concepts. Meanwhile, U-Net's hierarchical heterogeneity hinders unified strategies from balancing erasure and quality. To address these issues, we propose Hierarchical Orthogonal Subspace Erasure (HOSE). This method projects parameter updates into the subspace orthogonal to general knowledge, thereby eliminating interference with non-target concepts. Considering the hierarchical heterogeneity of the U-Net architecture, we further propose a hierarchical adaptive mechanism, constructing differentiated subspace projections for different layers to precisely adapt to the model's hierarchical structure, thereby resolving the inherent trade-off between erasure and image quality in unified constraints. Experimental results demonstrate the proposed method reduces harmful content generation by 80% compared with the unedited model. While it inevitably incurs some image quality degradation, it still outperforms other editing-based baselines in terms of quality preservation, and achieves a significantly better trade-off between harmful content suppression and quality loss than these baselines. Notably, our approach demonstrates higher adversarial robustness than existing SOTA method, indicating that the target concepts have been more thoroughly erased. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/sevenqiiu/HOSE.

AI.tldr: 提出层次化正交子空间擦除方法HOSE，通过将参数更新投影到与通用知识正交的子空间消除对非目标概念的干扰，并为U-Net不同层构建差异化子空间投影，在有害内容抑制与图像质量间取得更优权衡。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型可能生成色情、暴力等有害内容，存在严重安全隐患。模型编辑虽能以极少参数更新改变特定概念并保留整体能力，但扩散模型中概念表征相互纠缠，直接修改必然破坏非目标概念；同时U-Net的层级异质性使统一策略难以兼顾擦除效果与生成质量。
AI.method: HOSE（Hierarchical Orthogonal Subspace Erasure）：1）将参数更新投影至与通用知识正交的子空间，从而消除对非目标概念的干扰；2）针对U-Net架构的层级异质性，提出层次自适应机制，为不同层构造差异化的子空间投影，精确适配模型的层次结构，以解决统一约束下擦除与图像质量之间的固有权衡。
AI.result: 相比未编辑模型，有害内容生成减少80%；虽存在一定图像质量下降，但在质量保持上优于其他基于编辑的基线方法，且在有害内容抑制与质量损失的权衡上显著更优；对抗鲁棒性高于现有SOTA方法，表明目标概念被更彻底地擦除。源码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 正交子空间投影结合层次自适应机制可有效缓解概念纠缠与U-Net层级异质性问题，实现更彻底的概念擦除、更优的擦除—质量权衡及更强的对抗鲁棒性，为扩散模型安全编辑提供了有效方案。

title: Spatial-Zero: Self-Evolving Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models from Zero Data
comment: 19 pages, including appendices. 4 figures and 3 tables in the main text
summary: Spatial reasoning requires a vision-language model~(VLM) to understand metric distances, three-dimensional relationships, and viewpoint-dependent geometry. Learning these capabilities typically requires externally curated training data. This paper introduces Spatial-Zero, a VLMs' training framework that can self-evolve through autonomous spatial exploration with zero data. Spatial-Zero addresses two key challenges in autonomous spatial exploration: reliably generating valid spatial interaction tasks and providing accurate supervision for learning from these tasks. Specifically, a proposer specifies object configurations and questions, and a Coder turns them into executable scene programs that produce multi-view images and explicit scene geometry. A Geometric Oracle checks spatial constraints, visibility, and answer uniqueness and derives ground-truth labels from executed geometry; these labels supervise the Solver and ground difficulty feedback, while validation outcomes guide subsequent task generation. Across six spatial reasoning benchmarks and three VLM backbones, Spatial-Zero yields consistent gains through iterative self-evolution. After three iterations, Qwen3.5-9B improves average accuracy by 3.23 percentage points; with Qwen3.5-4B, Spatial-Zero also outperforms existing VLM self-evolution methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/YutongLi2024/Spatial-Zero

AI.tldr: 提出 Spatial-Zero，一个无需任何外部数据的视觉语言模型空间推理自进化训练框架，通过"提案器—编码器—几何预言机—求解器"闭环自主生成并验证空间任务，在6个基准、3个骨干上稳定提升性能。
AI.motivation: 空间推理要求VLM理解度量距离、三维关系与随视角变化的几何，而现有能力学习通常依赖人工精心构建的外部训练数据，成本高且难以扩展。作者希望实现零数据条件下的自主空间探索式自我进化。
AI.method: 框架分四部分：Proposer 指定物体配置与问题；Coder 将其转换为可执行的场景程序，渲染多视角图像并给出显式场景几何；Geometric Oracle 校验空间约束、可见性与答案唯一性，并从执行后的几何中导出真值标签；这些标签用于监督 Solver，并提供难度反馈，同时验证结果反过来指导后续任务生成，形成迭代自进化闭环。
AI.result: 在六个空间推理基准、三个VLM骨干上，迭代自进化带来一致增益；迭代三轮后 Qwen3.5-9B 平均准确率提升3.23个百分点；在 Qwen3.5-4B 上亦优于现有VLM自进化方法。
AI.conclusion: 以可执行场景程序+几何预言机为核心的零数据自进化框架，能可靠生成有效空间任务并提供准确监督，是一种可扩展、无需外部标注数据的空间推理能力提升方案。

title: Decompose and Describe: Narrowing the Diagnosis-to-Report Gap in 3D CT Report Generation
summary: Automated 3D CT report generation could support radiology workflows, yet medical vision-language models (MedVLMs) often omit diagnostic findings from generated reports. We ask whether the diagnostic ability of these models carries over to free-form reporting. Across five MedVLMs, diagnostic VQA achieves higher macro-F1 than reports generated from the same CT studies and evaluated on the same disease categories. We call this task-dependent discrepancy the diagnosis-to-report gap. Conventional Report Adaptation improves reporting for most models but does not close the gap. To investigate and narrow it, we introduce DeCAD (Decompose CT Analysis and Describe), which progressively decomposes CT report generation at diagnostic, regional textual, and regional visual levels. The model identifies positive findings before writing a report, organizes diagnosis and description into regional tasks, and restricts each task to visual tokens from the corresponding region. Diagnostic and regional textual decomposition improve report-level diagnostic performance across the five MedVLMs, whereas regional visual decomposition provides limited additional gains. In a standard VLM without medical VQA pretraining, the first two levels remain effective; regional visual decomposition also provides further gains with a region-level contrastively pretrained encoder. Full DeCAD achieves state-of-the-art performance on CT-RATE and Merlin. Analyses show greater CT-token attention during diagnosis and higher recall of reference-positive findings in both the diagnostic output and final report than with Report Adaptation. These results show that explicitly organizing diagnosis improves diagnostic reporting and helps narrow the diagnosis-to-report gap.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"诊断到报告差距"（diagnosis-to-report gap）现象：MedVLM在诊断性VQA上表现优于同一批CT生成的自由报告；为此提出DeCAD，在诊断、区域文本、区域视觉三个层级逐步分解CT报告生成任务，从而缩小该差距并在CT-RATE与Merlin上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 自动化3D CT报告生成可支持放射科工作流，但现有医学视觉语言模型（MedVLM）生成的报告常遗漏诊断性发现。作者追问：模型的诊断能力能否迁移到自由形式的报告生成中，并发现二者存在系统性落差。
AI.method: 先定量比较五种MedVLM在诊断性VQA与同批CT报告生成（相同疾病类别、macro-F1）上的表现，定义diagnosis-to-report gap；再验证常规Report Adaptation能否弥合。随后提出DeCAD（Decompose CT Analysis and Describe）：(1) 诊断分解——先识别阳性发现再撰写报告；(2) 区域文本分解——将诊断与描述组织为区域性子任务；(3) 区域视觉分解——每个子任务仅允许关注对应区域的视觉token。并在无医学VQA预训练的通用VLM及区域级对比预训练编码器上做消融。
